# SAOMD — All adventure dialogue

English source text. Native story and action order is retained.

## Story 1001 · Horunka

After the start of the death game, Kirito  
leaves Klein behind and heads for the next  
town, despite Klein's insistence that he stay.

**Kirito:** Okay, listen. I'm heading out  
right now for the next village.  
I want you to come.

<!-- uid=1001:1:1 -->

**Klein:** Huh...?

<!-- uid=1001:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** If what he said is true, the only  
way we'll survive is by making  
ourselves as strong as possible.

<!-- uid=1001:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** We'll have an easier time  
collecting cash and points if we  
operate out of the next village.

<!-- uid=1001:4:1 -->

**Klein:** Well...thanks... But I stood in  
line all night with my friends to  
buy SAO.

<!-- uid=1001:5:1 -->

**Klein:** I can't leave them.

<!-- uid=1001:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=1001:7:1 -->

**Klein:** I'll be fine. Last game I played,  
I ran a guild. I'm more than  
prepared.

<!-- uid=1001:8:1 -->

**Klein:** And with all the stuff you taught  
me, I'll get by. No sweat!

<!-- uid=1001:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Okay...

<!-- uid=1001:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** But if you're in a jam, you  
message me. Okay?

<!-- uid=1001:11:1 -->

**Klein:** Sure!

<!-- uid=1001:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'll be seeing you, Klein.  
Take care.

<!-- uid=1001:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** I can do this! This world can't  
beat me... I will survive!!

<!-- uid=1001:14:1 -->


## Story 1002 · Horunka

During that time, 2,000 people have died.

the first floor.

two thousand players were  
already dead.

<!-- uid=1002:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...And we still haven't beaten

## Story 25002 · A Fledgling World

Kirito reactivates ALO using "The Seed" which

**Kazuto:** That night in the parking lot, the  
police came and arrested Sugo.

<!-- uid=25002:1:1 -->

he denied everything and tried to  
pin the blame on Akihiko Kayaba.

<!-- uid=25002:2:1 -->

**Kazuto:** But after the police questioned  
one of his employees, Sugo  
confessed to everything.

<!-- uid=25002:3:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Fortunately, when the 300 SAO  
players came to, they had no  
memory of the experiments.

<!-- uid=25002:4:1 -->

**Kazuto:** No one had neurological or  
psychiatric problems. Everyone  
could go back to their lives.

<!-- uid=25002:5:1 -->

**Kazuto:** But VRMMOs were dealt a fatal blow  
with this latest incident. It  
all but destroyed the industry.

<!-- uid=25002:6:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ALO was forced to shut down, and  
other VRMMOs on the market were  
doomed for cancellation.

<!-- uid=25002:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** What's this?

<!-- uid=25002:8:1 -->

**Kayaba:** The beginnings of a new world.  
I call it the Seed.

<!-- uid=25002:9:1 -->

**Kayaba:** Once it sprouts, you'll know what  
it is. What you do with it is up  
to you. Delete it if you want.

<!-- uid=25002:10:1 -->

**Kayaba:** However, if you still have a tiny  
bit of fondness left for the  
virtual world, take care of it.

<!-- uid=25002:11:1 -->

**Kazuto:** After I saved Asuna, I asked Agil  
to check out the thing Kayaba  
called the Seed.

<!-- uid=25002:12:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Turned out it was a full-dive MMO  
that Kayaba developed. It came in  
a package called the World Seed.

<!-- uid=25002:13:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Kayaba modified it so anyone could  
easily download it and use it to  
create their own online world.

<!-- uid=25002:14:1 -->

**Kazuto:** After Agil said it was safe, I had  
him upload it so everyone could  
access it for free.

<!-- uid=25002:15:1 -->

**Kazuto:** It turned out that was exactly  
what VRMMOs needed to keep  
the genre going.

<!-- uid=25002:16:1 -->

**Kazuto:** All of ALO's data was transferred  
to a new company that decided  
to keep it online and running.

<!-- uid=25002:17:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Several hundred companies and  
even individual gamers launched  
their own virtual game servers.

<!-- uid=25002:18:1 -->

you can create a character in one  
world and transfer it to another.

## Story 31002 · The World of Guns

One year after the SAO incident, Kirito is  
contacted by Kikuoka, who asks him to investigate  
something called the Death Gun incident...

**Kazuto:** About a year after we beat SAO,  
I got a call from Seijiro Kikuoka,

<!-- uid=31002:1:1 -->

**Kazuto:** the task force leader for the Tech  
Bureau of the Ministry of Internal  
Affairs and Communications...

<!-- uid=31002:2:1 -->

**Kazuto:** AKA the Virtual Reality Section.

<!-- uid=31002:3:1 -->

**Kazuto:** He told me a man wearing an  
AmuSphere was found dead from  
acute heart failure.

<!-- uid=31002:4:1 -->

**Kazuto:** The man had a certain game  
installed on his AmuSphere's  
system:

<!-- uid=31002:5:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Gun Gale Online,  
or "GGO" for short.

<!-- uid=31002:6:1 -->

**Kazuto:** The deceased was the guy who won  
GGO's biggest tournament, the BoB.  
His character's name was XeXeed.

<!-- uid=31002:7:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Reports showed that at the time  
of death, he was appearing on a  
show called MMO Stream.

<!-- uid=31002:8:1 -->

**Kazuto:** According to a player's blog, at  
the same time as the heart attack,  
something strange happened in GGO.

<!-- uid=31002:9:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Some players were in-game watching  
the show when a player stood up  
and started acting erratically.

<!-- uid=31002:10:1 -->

**Kazuto:** He was shouting something about  
"judgment" at XeXeed's image on  
the TV, then fired his gun at it.

<!-- uid=31002:11:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Then another death followed.  
It happened about ten days ago.

<!-- uid=31002:12:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Same setup as before. Another  
top-ranking GGO player had died  
of heart failure.

<!-- uid=31002:13:1 -->

**Kazuto:** He was meeting with his squad when  
a strange player went up and shot  
him...point blank.

<!-- uid=31002:14:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Just like with XeXeed, the shooter  
said something about judgment and  
power right before shooting him.

<!-- uid=31002:15:1 -->

**Kazuto:** And in both incidents, the shooter  
identified himself by the same  
character name...

<!-- uid=31002:16:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Death Gun.

<!-- uid=31002:17:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Is it possible that this player  
can kill someone by shooting  
them in-game...?

<!-- uid=31002:18:1 -->

**Kazuto:** It seems impossible, but it looked  
like Kikuoka hadn't dismissed that  
possibility.

<!-- uid=31002:19:1 -->

**Kazuto:** That's why he called me. He wanted  
my help to investigate these  
mysterious deaths.

<!-- uid=31002:20:1 -->

**Kazuto:** You can't stop a player's heart in  
the real world by actions in-game.  
It had to be a coincidence.

<!-- uid=31002:21:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Then again...something about this  
whole affair bothered me.

<!-- uid=31002:22:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Four thousand people died in  
Aincrad.

<!-- uid=31002:23:1 -->

**Kazuto:** A year had passed, and what had  
happened to me in SAO had begun  
to fade into memory.

<!-- uid=31002:24:1 -->

**Kazuto:** But now, once again, people were  
dying in VR. I just couldn't  
ignore this.

<!-- uid=31002:25:1 -->

**Kazuto:** It was almost like someone was  
calling to me, making sure I  
wouldn't forget...

<!-- uid=31002:26:1 -->

## Story 37002 · Crimson Memories

Regretting the sins he committed in SAO,  
Kirito is reassured by Aki that he too has  
the right to be saved before being sent off  
into Gun Gale Online as Kirito the Hero.

**Death Gun:** Are you Kirito?

<!-- uid=37002:2:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...

<!-- uid=37002:5:1 -->

**Aki:** Is something wrong, young man?

<!-- uid=37002:6:1 -->

<!-- uid=37002:8:1 -->

**Aki:** Go on, lay it on me.

<!-- uid=37002:9:1 -->

spill your guts to a beautiful  
nurse like me, after all.

<!-- uid=37002:10:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...I guess I'd better take  
advantage of it then, huh?

<!-- uid=37002:11:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Well, um... You used to be a  
surgical nurse before coming to  
rehabilitation, right, Ms. Aki?

<!-- uid=37002:12:1 -->

**Aki:** That's right. What about it?

<!-- uid=37002:13:1 -->

**Kazuto:** W-Well, I apologize if this sounds  
incredibly insensitive, but...

<!-- uid=37002:14:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...How well do you remember the  
patients who died?

<!-- uid=37002:15:1 -->

**Aki:** ...Hmm.

<!-- uid=37002:16:1 -->

**Aki:** If I make an effort to remember  
them, I can still see their names  
and faces.

<!-- uid=37002:17:1 -->

**Aki:** Even for patients I only spent an  
hour with in the operating room.

<!-- uid=37002:18:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Have you ever wished you could  
forget them?

<!-- uid=37002:19:1 -->

**Aki:** Hmm... I'm not sure if this answer  
will satisfy you or not...

<!-- uid=37002:20:1 -->

**Aki:** But I think that if someone really  
needs to forget something,  
they will.

<!-- uid=37002:21:1 -->

**Aki:** They won't even have to wish they  
could forget it.

<!-- uid=37002:22:1 -->

**Aki:** After all, it's the things you  
wish you could forget the most  
that you remember the best, right?

<!-- uid=37002:23:1 -->

**Aki:** So I think things like that are  
what, deep down, you know  
you shouldn't forget.

<!-- uid=37002:24:1 -->

**Kazuto:** If that's true, then I must  
be a true monster.

<!-- uid=37002:25:1 -->

**Aki:** Why do you say that?

<!-- uid=37002:26:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...When I was in SAO, I killed  
three play--I mean, people.

<!-- uid=37002:27:1 -->

**Kazuto:** And I'd completely forgotten about  
them over this last year.

<!-- uid=37002:28:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Even now, I still can't remember  
what two of them looked like,  
or what their names were...

<!-- uid=37002:29:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Which means I'm the kind of person  
who can even forget about people  
I've killed myself...

<!-- uid=37002:30:1 -->

**Aki:** Kirigaya.

<!-- uid=37002:31:1 -->

**Aki:** I never played Sword Art Online  
myself...

<!-- uid=37002:32:1 -->

**Aki:** So I may not fully grasp the  
weight of this "killing"... But  
I do know this.

<!-- uid=37002:33:1 -->

**Aki:** Whatever you did, what you had to  
do--you did it in order to save  
someone else, didn't you?

<!-- uid=37002:34:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I...

<!-- uid=37002:35:1 -->

**Aki:** In medicine, sometimes we have to  
make hard choices when it comes to  
who lives and who dies.

<!-- uid=37002:36:1 -->

**Aki:** ...Naturally, that doesn't mean  
it's okay to go around killing as  
long as you have a good reason.

<!-- uid=37002:37:1 -->

**Aki:** But everyone involved in choices  
like that has the right to think  
of those who were saved too.

<!-- uid=37002:38:1 -->

**Aki:** And that's just as true for you.

<!-- uid=37002:39:1 -->

**Aki:** As long as you think about the  
people you saved, you have the  
right to be saved as well.

<!-- uid=37002:40:1 -->

**Kazuto:** The right... to be saved?

<!-- uid=37002:41:1 -->

**Kazuto:** But... but I forgot about the  
people I killed!

<!-- uid=37002:42:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I abandoned my responsibility to  
them. There's no way I have the  
right to be saved...

<!-- uid=37002:43:1 -->

**Aki:** If you'd really forgotten about  
them, you wouldn't be agonizing  
like this now.

<!-- uid=37002:44:1 -->

**Aki:** So when the time comes for you

come back.

<!-- uid=37002:45:1 -->

**Aki:** And when it does...

<!-- uid=37002:46:1 -->

**Aki:** It needs to include the people  
you fought to protect and save  
as well.

<!-- uid=37002:47:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...

<!-- uid=37002:48:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I, uh... I just wanted to say  
thank you. For earlier.

<!-- uid=37002:49:1 -->

**Aki:** Hey, don't worry about it.

<!-- uid=37002:50:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Link Start!

<!-- uid=37002:51:1 -->

**Aki:** See you later,  
Kirito the Hero.

<!-- uid=37002:52:1 -->

<!-- uid=37002:53:1 -->

## Story 4 · Memory Defrag

**Kirito:** Sword Art Online. SAO. That was  
the name of the game that became  
my world.

<!-- uid=4:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** SAO ran on hardware fundamentally  
differently from previous  
generation tech. NerveGear.

<!-- uid=4:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** The NerveGear is a sleek helmet  
that covers the head and face.

<!-- uid=4:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** By sending signals directly to the  
brain, it can access the user's  
senses,

<!-- uid=4:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** giving them the ability to freely  
move about a virtual environment.  
The ultimate in VR tech.

<!-- uid=4:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** However, when SAO officially  
launched, 10,000 players were  
unaware of its terrifying secret.

<!-- uid=4:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** It was an inescapable trap:  
a death game.

<!-- uid=4:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** On that fateful day, I was teaching  
Klein, a guy I met in the Town of  
Beginnings, the basics of combat.

<!-- uid=4:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** We first noticed that something  
was wrong right after we beat our  
first mob.

<!-- uid=4:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** The logout button that was  
supposed to be in the game menu  
was gone.

<!-- uid=4:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Suddenly and without warning,  
every last SAO player was warped  
to the plaza in the starting town.

<!-- uid=4:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** As fear and uncertainty washed  
over us, an avatar in a red robe  
appeared in the sky.

<!-- uid=4:12:1 -->

**???:** Attention, players.  
I welcome you to my world.

<!-- uid=4:13:1 -->

**???:** My name is Akihiko Kayaba.  
And as of this moment,  
I am in control of this world.

<!-- uid=4:14:1 -->

**Akihiko Kayaba:** I'm sure most of you have already  
noticed an item missing from your  
main menus. The logout button.

<!-- uid=4:15:1 -->

**Akihiko Kayaba:** Let me assure you,  
this is not a defect in the game.

<!-- uid=4:16:1 -->

**Akihiko Kayaba:** I repeat. This is not a defect.

<!-- uid=4:17:1 -->

**Akihiko Kayaba:** This is how Sword Art Online was  
designed to be.

<!-- uid=4:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Akihiko Kayaba: the development  
director of SAO and the inventor  
of the NerveGear.

<!-- uid=4:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** He told us that death in SAO  
meant death in the real world.

<!-- uid=4:20:1 -->

Aincrad, to Floor 100...

<!-- uid=4:23:1 -->

<!-- uid=4:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** I grabbed Klein and ducked into  
a quiet alley.

<!-- uid=4:25:1 -->


## Story 140011 · \[Furinkazan\] Klein Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** Klein!

<!-- uid=140011:1:1 -->

**Klein:** Hey, K-dawg!  
Been a while, man!

<!-- uid=140011:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** You're right about that.

<!-- uid=140011:3:1 -->

**Klein:** Still rocking the dark-and-  
mysterious vibe, I see! Still,  
you look...brighter than before.

<!-- uid=140011:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Uh, yeah.  
Sorry for worrying you back then.

<!-- uid=140011:5:1 -->

**Klein:** Don't worry about it, man.

<!-- uid=140011:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** I've actually been hearing a lot  
about you lately, Klein. Seems  
your guild's been flourishing.

<!-- uid=140011:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** What was it called again?  
Fooly-cousin or something?

<!-- uid=140011:8:1 -->

**Klein:** Not even close! Furinkazan, man!  
You said it wrong on purpose  
now, didn't you!

<!-- uid=140011:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hahaha, sorry.

<!-- uid=140011:10:1 -->

**Klein:** You're hopeless.

<!-- uid=140011:11:1 -->

**Klein:** But I guess if you're making dumb  
jokes like that, it means you're  
all healed up.

<!-- uid=140011:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. Thanks.

<!-- uid=140011:13:1 -->

**Klein:** So, what're you doing here,  
anyway?

<!-- uid=140011:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, you know.

<!-- uid=140011:15:1 -->

**Klein:** Uh-huh...

<!-- uid=140011:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=140011:17:1 -->

**Klein:** ...So?

<!-- uid=140011:18:1 -->

**Klein:** Let's just pretend I don't know.  
What are you up to?

<!-- uid=140011:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hm?  
W-Well...  
You know...

<!-- uid=140011:20:1 -->

**Klein:** You're acting really weird, man.

<!-- uid=140011:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Th-That's rich coming from you!  
What are YOU doing here?

<!-- uid=140011:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** This floor was cleared a long time  
ago, so it's not like there's  
anything left to do here.

<!-- uid=140011:23:1 -->

**Klein:** I was just getting together with  
some guild members to  
gather materials.

<!-- uid=140011:24:1 -->

**Klein:** Some of them are still pretty low  
level, so I thought it'd be  
perfect to hunt mobs around here.

<!-- uid=140011:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** O-Oh...

<!-- uid=140011:26:1 -->


## Story 140013 · \[Furinkazan\] Klein Lv.30

Character Story

**Klein:** Hey, Kirito.

<!-- uid=140013:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** H-Hey, Klein.

<!-- uid=140013:2:1 -->

**Klein:** You're still here, huh?

<!-- uid=140013:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Y-Yeah.

<!-- uid=140013:4:1 -->

**Klein:** Oh, that reminds me. I heard  
some Laughing Coffin guys  
are lurking around this area.

<!-- uid=140013:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Th-They are?

<!-- uid=140013:6:1 -->

**Klein:** Me and the Furinkazan guys  
are gonna get out of here.  
You should be careful too.

<!-- uid=140013:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. Sure.

<!-- uid=140013:8:1 -->

**Klein:** Hey... Did you hear me?  
I didn't stutter or mumble  
or anything, right?

<!-- uid=140013:9:1 -->

**Klein:** Wait...!

<!-- uid=140013:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wh-What?

<!-- uid=140013:11:1 -->

**Klein:** Don't tell me...  
You hooked up with a lady!

<!-- uid=140013:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hooked up...?  
What's that supposed to mean?

<!-- uid=140013:13:1 -->

**Klein:** Maybe this conversation needs  
to wait until you're a bit older.

<!-- uid=140013:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** What are you talking about?

<!-- uid=140013:15:1 -->

**Klein:** Hmm...  
In any case, it looks like  
I might have guessed wrong...

<!-- uid=140013:16:1 -->

**Klein:** Listen, if you've hooked up,  
it means you have a girlfriend.  
Or, you know, a lover.

<!-- uid=140013:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh?!

<!-- uid=140013:18:1 -->

**Klein:** I thought maybe you were  
meeting up with your lady  
on this floor or something...

<!-- uid=140013:19:1 -->

**Klein:** But judging from that reaction,  
I guess that's not it.

<!-- uid=140013:20:1 -->

**Klein:** What are you hiding, Kirito?

<!-- uid=140013:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** N-Nothing.  
It's nothing...

<!-- uid=140013:22:1 -->

**Klein:** Don't play dumb. It's not nothing!  
It's gotta be something!

<!-- uid=140013:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** C-Catch you later, Klein!

<!-- uid=140013:24:1 -->

**Klein:** What?!  
You think you can run from me?!  
Get back here, Kirito!

<!-- uid=140013:25:1 -->


## Story 140015 · \[Furinkazan\] Klein Lv.50

Character Story

**Kirito:** Phew...

<!-- uid=140015:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Something the matter, Kirito?  
You've been running all over  
the place...

<!-- uid=140015:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's nothing...  
Just someone I know trying  
to figure out what I'm up to.

<!-- uid=140015:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Huh?  
Why don't you just tell them?

<!-- uid=140015:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** They're obviously worried and  
just trying to look out for you.

<!-- uid=140015:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** No way. I don't want him knowing.

<!-- uid=140015:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** What? Why not?

<!-- uid=140015:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Because...it's embarrassing.

<!-- uid=140015:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Huh-?

<!-- uid=140015:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehehe.

<!-- uid=140015:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wh-What?

<!-- uid=140015:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Even you get embarrassed  
around some people, huh?

<!-- uid=140015:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, you're friends, right?  
So tell him. Or do boys not need  
to talk to communicate?

<!-- uid=140015:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Don't make fun of me...

<!-- uid=140015:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's just his guild is brand new,

<!-- uid=140015:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** so when I heard that Laughing  
Coffin was getting active again,

<!-- uid=140015:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** I got kind of worried...

<!-- uid=140015:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Because they're supposedly  
targeting new guilds, right?

<!-- uid=140015:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, one of the reasons  
I came to this floor  
was to investigate that.

<!-- uid=140015:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Don't you think you should  
have warned him because  
of the danger?

<!-- uid=140015:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** He already knew. And he said  
he's leaving this floor.

<!-- uid=140015:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hmm, I see.  
Well, then there shouldn't be  
anything to worry about.

<!-- uid=140015:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** It worked out without him knowing  
after all.

<!-- uid=140015:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah...

<!-- uid=140015:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, the Knights of the Blood  
Oath are about ready to head back.  
Thanks for the help!

<!-- uid=140015:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** Be careful, Asuna.  
See you later.

<!-- uid=140015:26:1 -->


## Story 140017 · \[Furinkazan\] Klein Lv.70

Character Story

**Kirito:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=140017:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Turns out the rumors of  
Laughing Coffin being on this  
floor are just that-rumors.

<!-- uid=140017:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** I guess I'll head back too...

<!-- uid=140017:3:1 -->

**Klein:** Oh ho, Laughing Coffin, huh?

<!-- uid=140017:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh?!  
Wha-!  
Klein!

<!-- uid=140017:5:1 -->

**Klein:** What the heck are you still  
doing here?

<!-- uid=140017:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** You first! I thought you said  
Furinkazan was leaving!

<!-- uid=140017:7:1 -->

**Klein:** Everyone DID leave.  
I'm the only one who stayed.

<!-- uid=140017:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** B-But why...?

<!-- uid=140017:9:1 -->

**Klein:** Because you were worrying me!

<!-- uid=140017:10:1 -->

**Klein:** I know I said you looked better,  
but I still couldn't help thinking  
you were acting really weird!

<!-- uid=140017:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** K-Klein...

<!-- uid=140017:12:1 -->

**Klein:** Tell me what you're hiding.

<!-- uid=140017:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=140017:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** The truth is...

<!-- uid=140017:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** I came here to help out the  
Knights of the Blood Oath.

<!-- uid=140017:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** I was helping them investigate  
rumors that said Laughing Coffin  
was here.

<!-- uid=140017:17:1 -->

**Klein:** Hm? So that's it?  
You should've just told me!

<!-- uid=140017:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Then I saw you and Furinkazan.

<!-- uid=140017:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** There are other rumors...  
Ones that say Laughing Coffin is  
after members of new guilds.

<!-- uid=140017:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** So I just wanted to watch over you  
and the others from a safe  
distance.

<!-- uid=140017:21:1 -->

**Klein:** Huh...?

<!-- uid=140017:22:1 -->


## Story 140018 · \[Furinkazan\] Klein Lv.80

Character Story

**Klein:** Watch over us...? You mean...  
You mean we're being targeted.

<!-- uid=140018:1:1 -->

**Klein:** You were just trying to help us?  
Is that what you're saying?

<!-- uid=140018:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Y-Yeah... Is that wrong?

<!-- uid=140018:3:1 -->

**Klein:** So you knew from the start

<!-- uid=140018:4:1 -->

**Klein:** about our low-level guild members?

<!-- uid=140018:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** I did.

<!-- uid=140018:6:1 -->

**Klein:** What the heck, Kirito! Don't keep  
that kind of stuff to yourself! Why  
didn't you just SAY something?

<!-- uid=140018:7:1 -->

**Klein:** Seriously, you should LEAD with  
that!

<!-- uid=140018:8:1 -->

**Klein:** You WERE worried about us, right?

<!-- uid=140018:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** I-I didn't want to say anything  
to annoy you guys...

<!-- uid=140018:10:1 -->

**Klein:** Who would be annoyed  
by something like that?!

<!-- uid=140018:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** W-Well...

<!-- uid=140018:12:1 -->

**Klein:** Geez, I thought you had more  
social skills than that!

<!-- uid=140018:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Klein... I AM a solo player...

<!-- uid=140018:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** I don't think I could work with  
you guys even if I wanted to.

<!-- uid=140018:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** So...I'd appreciate it if you'd  
think of this as some sort of  
weird fluke.

<!-- uid=140018:16:1 -->

**Klein:** K-dawg, man...  
It's easy for you to say that.

<!-- uid=140018:17:1 -->

**Klein:** Don't think I'm fine  
distancing myself like you are.

<!-- uid=140018:18:1 -->

**Klein:** I'm never going to NOT worry about  
you as long as you insist on  
isolating yourself...

<!-- uid=140018:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** K-Klein...

<!-- uid=140018:20:1 -->

**Klein:** At any rate, thanks.  
I'm glad you told me.

<!-- uid=140018:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** S-Sure...

<!-- uid=140018:22:1 -->


## Story 140031 · 【神聖剣】ヒースクリフ Lv.10

Character Story

**Heathcliff:** We defeated the floor boss...  
Now this floor is open to travel.

<!-- uid=140031:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Good work, Commander.

<!-- uid=140031:2:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** You too, Asuna. Once it's been  
activated, let's return to  
Grandzam.

<!-- uid=140031:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yes, sir.

<!-- uid=140031:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=140031:5:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** I must commend you as well,  
Black Swordsman. Your attacks  
were superb.

<!-- uid=140031:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Thanks...

<!-- uid=140031:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** K-Kirito! You should be more  
respectful towards the commander!

<!-- uid=140031:8:2 -->

**Asuna:** H-He left...

<!-- uid=140031:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** I apologize, Commander. He is  
skilled with the sword, but lacks  
social grace, I'm afraid...

<!-- uid=140031:10:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** Hahaha, I don't mind. He is always  
there when we need him to  
fight the floor bosses.

<!-- uid=140031:11:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** I believe I am coming to grasp  
his personality a bit better. And  
his skills speak for themselves.

<!-- uid=140031:12:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** If possible, I would like to  
recruit him into the guild. What  
do you think of that, Asuna?

<!-- uid=140031:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well... I don't believe that  
would work.

<!-- uid=140031:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's doubtful that a dedicated  
solo player like Kirito would  
ever consent to joining a guild.

<!-- uid=140031:15:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** I see. That's unfortunate.  
If he ever changes his mind,  
be sure to bring up the offer.

<!-- uid=140031:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** I will...

<!-- uid=140031:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...Commander!

<!-- uid=140031:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** Please don't assume that Kirito  
and I are in constant contact!

<!-- uid=140031:19:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** Hahaha, are you not?

<!-- uid=140031:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** N-No, we are not!

<!-- uid=140031:21:1 -->


## Story 140033 · 【神聖剣】ヒースクリフ Lv.30

Character Story

**Asuna:** Understood. So I just have to  
take down that dungeon's boss.

<!-- uid=140033:1:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** Sorry, Asuna. Even though you're  
my vice commander,

<!-- uid=140033:2:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** all I ever do is assign you  
glorified chores.

<!-- uid=140033:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** I don't mind. You're very busy,  
after all. And this situation is...  
troubling.

<!-- uid=140033:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Since it isn't a floor boss, there  
is an endless stream of players  
attempting to fight it...

<!-- uid=140033:5:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** Well, part of me understands why  
those players are taking such  
risks.

<!-- uid=140033:6:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** An extremely rare piece of  
equipment is said to slumber  
within the dungeon's depths.

<!-- uid=140033:7:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** If some treasure hunter could get  
their hands on it, it would make  
quite the story.

<!-- uid=140033:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** But they could be killed...

<!-- uid=140033:9:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** Indeed. That boss is quite  
formidable. If it starts looking  
too dangerous, retreat at once.

<!-- uid=140033:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yes, Commander.

<!-- uid=140033:11:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** You're free to choose who comes  
with you. Kuradeel has expressed  
his interest.

<!-- uid=140033:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** I...won't be bringing him along.  
He seems intent on holding me  
back for some reason.

<!-- uid=140033:13:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** I see. Well, it's up to you.  
I will also reward any non-  
members whose help you require.

<!-- uid=140033:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Th-That's generous of you.

<!-- uid=140033:15:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** By chance, did the Black Swordsman  
cross your mind just now?

<!-- uid=140033:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** H-He did not! Why would you  
say such a thing, Commander?!

<!-- uid=140033:17:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** Hehehe...

<!-- uid=140033:18:1 -->


## Story 140035 · 【神聖剣】ヒースクリフ Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** Attackers, hang back!  
Heal yourselves!

<!-- uid=140035:1:1 -->

**Knight of the Blood Oath:** Y-Yes, ma'am!

<!-- uid=140035:2:1 -->

**Monster:** GRRRAAAAAGH!!

<!-- uid=140035:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** This thing is strong... Maybe  
even stronger than some of  
the floor bosses we've fought.

<!-- uid=140035:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito did mention...

<!-- uid=140035:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** that people are saying the event  
bosses outside of the main story  
are tougher than floor bosses...

<!-- uid=140035:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** And that the developer intended  
people to come back and try again  
after they'd leveled some more...

<!-- uid=140035:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ha ha, I don't know why I'm  
thinking about that right now.

<!-- uid=140035:8:1 -->

**Monster:** GRRAAAAAAAH!!

<!-- uid=140035:9:1 -->

**Knight of the Blood Oath:** Vice Commander Asuna!  
W-Watch out!

<!-- uid=140035:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Wha-?

<!-- uid=140035:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Aaaaaaaahhh!

<!-- uid=140035:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Tch!

<!-- uid=140035:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** K-Kirito!

<!-- uid=140035:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** I knew as soon as I heard that  
a Knights' raid party was here  
that it would be you, Asuna.

<!-- uid=140035:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm glad I made it in time.

<!-- uid=140035:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** Th-Thank you...

<!-- uid=140035:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** You can't keep fighting like this.  
You have to retreat.

<!-- uid=140035:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** I know... I was hoping to avoid  
that, but I guess we have no  
choice.

<!-- uid=140035:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** All units, withdraw!

<!-- uid=140035:20:1 -->

**Knight of the Blood Oath:** U-Understood!

<!-- uid=140035:21:1 -->


## Story 140037 · 【神聖剣】ヒースクリフ Lv.70

Character Story

**Heathcliff:** I see...

<!-- uid=140037:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Commander, I am sorry...  
I failed my mission...

<!-- uid=140037:2:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** Not at all. That boss was much  
stronger than we could have  
ever imagined.

<!-- uid=140037:3:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** I am more relieved that you  
returned without any casualties.

<!-- uid=140037:4:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** You commanded your troops  
perfectly. Thank you.

<!-- uid=140037:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** S-Sir...

<!-- uid=140037:6:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** This time, I will go myself.

<!-- uid=140037:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** You're going yourself to defeat  
the monster, Commander?!

<!-- uid=140037:8:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** I am.

<!-- uid=140037:9:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** I must defeat it before rumors  
spread that there is a monster  
even the Knights cannot best.

<!-- uid=140037:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Th-This is all my fault...

<!-- uid=140037:11:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** It absolutely is not.

<!-- uid=140037:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** B-But...the monster is truly  
overwhelming.

<!-- uid=140037:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Would it not be better to enlist  
the aid of the Assault Team?

<!-- uid=140037:14:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** They are not interested in  
anything other than clearing  
the floors.

<!-- uid=140037:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Then I'll come with you!  
I'll do better this time!

<!-- uid=140037:16:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** No, you should rest. I'll bring  
other guild members with me  
for this round.

<!-- uid=140037:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** My HP is already fully recovered!

<!-- uid=140037:18:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** It's not that.  
Your spirit needs rest too.

<!-- uid=140037:19:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** Judging your limits only by the  
gauges you can see will result  
in egregious mistakes, Asuna.

<!-- uid=140037:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** I understand, Commander...

<!-- uid=140037:21:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** Hahaha, have faith, and await  
my return. You are in charge  
while I'm away.

<!-- uid=140037:22:1 -->


## Story 140038 · 【神聖剣】ヒースクリフ Lv.80

Character Story

**Kirito:** So he was able to defeat that  
monster after all?

<!-- uid=140038:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah... According to the ones who  
accompanied him, he didn't have  
hardly any trouble.

<!-- uid=140038:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** They say he felled it  
in a single stroke.

<!-- uid=140038:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Whoa... That's incredible.

<!-- uid=140038:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** It is. Divine Blade, his unique  
skill, is...truly amazing.

<!-- uid=140038:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Not just that... Looking at his  
actions in battle from a technical  
perspective,

<!-- uid=140038:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** and taking into account how  
he's always level-headed and  
charismatic even...

<!-- uid=140038:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** it's easy to see...  
That man is everything I'm not.

<!-- uid=140038:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** You're wrong, Kirito.  
You're amazing in your own right!

<!-- uid=140038:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Asuna...

<!-- uid=140038:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** So don't say things like that,  
okay?

<!-- uid=140038:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** O-Okay... Sorry...  
But, you know,

<!-- uid=140038:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** I think you made the right call  
joining the Knights of the Blood  
Oath, Asuna.

<!-- uid=140038:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** With such a great commander and  
so many strong players around,

<!-- uid=140038:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** you're pretty safe. You don't  
have to worry about getting  
killed so much.

<!-- uid=140038:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** I suppose...

<!-- uid=140038:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, speaking of our great  
commander, he seems to have  
taken a liking to you, Kirito.

<!-- uid=140038:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh? Really? But we've only  
ever really spoken during battles  
against floor bosses...

<!-- uid=140038:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** He said you were a very  
skilled swordsman.

<!-- uid=140038:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Did he? That means a lot, coming  
from someone like him.

<!-- uid=140038:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** What?! So it's not good enough  
when I tell you?!

<!-- uid=140038:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** N-No, I didn't mean it that way!

<!-- uid=140038:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** Of course you did! Your reaction  
earlier was totally different!

<!-- uid=140038:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hahaha...

<!-- uid=140038:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** Don't try to just laugh this off!

<!-- uid=140038:25:1 -->


## Story 140151 · \[Hero's return\] Kirito Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** (Ordinal Scale, a brand new ARMMO,  
was a megahit from the second  
it launched.)

<!-- uid=140151:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** (It also gave us one of our  
biggest challenges yet.)

<!-- uid=140151:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** (The hints of which were already  
apparent by the time my  
story begins.)

<!-- uid=140151:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** (Something relatively minor  
happened while we were  
playing ALO,)

<!-- uid=140151:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** (the player base for which had  
been declining, thanks to the  
imminent release of OS.)

<!-- uid=140151:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Want to tackle this quest today?

<!-- uid=140151:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sure!

<!-- uid=140151:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** Actually... Sorry, I can't.

<!-- uid=140151:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** What's up, Sugu?

<!-- uid=140151:9:1 -->

## Story 140083 · \[Blue Silver Knight\] Eugeo Lv.30

Character Story

## Story 140085 · \[Blue Silver Knight\] Eugeo Lv.50

## Story 140088 · \[Blue Silver Knight\] Eugeo Lv.80

Character Story

**Kirito:** Phew! That finally took  
care of them.

<!-- uid=140088:1:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...

<!-- uid=140088:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** D-Don't worry about it! They  
weren't that strong, but they're  
good at long-range attacks.

<!-- uid=140088:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** You can't fly, huh, Eugeo?  
That must make this world  
pretty inconvenient for you...

<!-- uid=140088:4:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...Kirito.

<!-- uid=140088:5:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Why did you risk  
your life to save me?

<!-- uid=140088:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh...? Well, that's because...

<!-- uid=140088:7:1 -->

when you've only just met them  
and don't even know their identity?

<!-- uid=140088:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** That might be how most people  
think. But to me, friendship isn't  
about where you came from...

<!-- uid=140088:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Or how long I've known you...  
At least, that's how I feel.

<!-- uid=140088:10:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...!

<!-- uid=140088:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** The only thing that matters

<!-- uid=140088:12:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Kirito...

<!-- uid=140088:13:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I heard you were asking about  
why I was acting strange earlier.

<!-- uid=140088:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Uh, yeah...

<!-- uid=140088:15:1 -->

**Eugeo:** That's because...somewhere deep  
inside of me, you—

<!-- uid=140088:16:1 -->

**Eugeo:** No, not you. Someone like you...

<!-- uid=140088:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Eugeo...

<!-- uid=140088:18:1 -->

**Eugeo:** You didn't feel like a stranger to  
me. I guess I looked upset because  
I was searching for those memories.

<!-- uid=140088:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** And when you tried to remember,  
your eye started to hurt...  
Are you all right now?

<!-- uid=140088:20:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Yeah, I'm fine! But I think I'll hold  
off trying to dig up the past  
for a little bit.

<!-- uid=140088:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, that sounds like  
a good idea to me.

<!-- uid=140088:22:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I'm sorry I made you worry, Kirito.

<!-- uid=140088:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** No, I'm the one who should  
apologize. I should've been  
more considerate.

<!-- uid=140088:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** But...can you think  
of me in this way?

<!-- uid=140088:25:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Huh...?

<!-- uid=140088:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's about what you said before...  
Even if he looks like me, I'm  
not the person in your memories.

<!-- uid=140088:27:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...!

<!-- uid=140088:28:1 -->

**Kirito:** But even so...it feels like a miracle  
that I was able to meet you, and  
I want to think of you as a friend.

<!-- uid=140088:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** Even if it's only been a short time,  
I can already tell that we can  
trust you and Alice.

<!-- uid=140088:30:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Kirito...

<!-- uid=140088:31:1 -->

**Kirito:** So I hope you can think of me  
as a friend too.

<!-- uid=140088:32:1 -->

**Kirito:** I want to be someone that you can  
put that much faith in.

<!-- uid=140088:33:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...Heh heh!

<!-- uid=140088:34:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Man, you sure are twisting  
my arm there!

<!-- uid=140088:35:1 -->

**Kirito:** What do you mean?

<!-- uid=140088:36:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Talking like that doesn't really  
give me the option to turn  
you down, huh?

<!-- uid=140088:37:1 -->

**Kirito:** Whaa—?!

<!-- uid=140088:38:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Ha ha, I'm kidding! I can tell  
you're speaking from the heart.  
I really can...

<!-- uid=140088:39:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Alright! I guess we've got each  
other's backs from here on out,  
Kirito...

<!-- uid=140088:40:1 -->

## Story 150015 · \[Blue Rose Integrity Knight\] Eugeo Lv.50

Character Story

**Eugeo:** Alice, could you dig a bit deeper

<!-- uid=150015:21:1 -->

## Story 150021 · \[Howl at the Moon\] Eugeo Lv.10

Character Story

**Eugeo:** Kirito, bad news!

<!-- uid=150021:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Uh oh, I don't like the sound

<!-- uid=150021:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Eugeo...!

## Story 150025 · \[Howl at the Moon\] Eugeo Lv.50

Character Story

**Eugeo:** Where do you think those wolves  
are hiding?

<!-- uid=150025:1:1 -->

**Eugeo:** We've been searching the forest  
for hours, and we haven't seen  
hide nor hair of them.

<!-- uid=150025:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wait...

<!-- uid=150025:3:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Alright, Kirito, what's on your  
mind?

Those wolves are REALLY smart.

<!-- uid=150025:5:1 -->

clever as any human.

**Eugeo:** Cottages? Out here in the middle

been abandoned?

<!-- uid=150025:14:1 -->

people are living here.

**Kirito:** Look at this.

**Eugeo:** You think that the people living  
in this village got turned into

<!-- uid=150025:25:1 -->

<!-- uid=150025:28:1 -->

<!-- uid=150025:31:1 -->

<!-- uid=150025:32:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Yeah, that's what started this

<!-- uid=150025:33:1 -->

<!-- uid=150025:34:1 -->

We need to find them, quick!

**Kirito:** Woo! Another quest cleared.  
I got a special New Year's kimono!

<!-- uid=150105:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** Congrats!

<!-- uid=150105:2:1 -->

**Player:** Nice! Supposedly only a select few  
players get that outfit.

<!-- uid=150105:3:1 -->

**Player:** I know of a handful who were after  
it, so don't let it out of your  
sight, lest it get stolen.

<!-- uid=150105:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Really? Okay, I'll be on my guard.

<!-- uid=150105:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** Wait... Stolen how, exactly?

<!-- uid=150105:6:1 -->

**Player:** Some players have the ability  
to steal from another player's  
inventory. Mostly bad guys.

<!-- uid=150105:7:1 -->

**Player:** There are also Noble Thieves who  
can pull off a kind of hit-and-run  
thievery, so watch your back.

<!-- uid=150105:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yikes... That sounds pretty scary.

<!-- uid=150105:9:1 -->

**Player:** Wait, you didn't know that before  
you went looking for this kimono?  
What are you, a noob?

<!-- uid=150105:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Heh... Yeah, actually.

<!-- uid=150105:11:1 -->

**Player:** Geez. Then you REALLY better  
watch your back.

<!-- uid=150105:12:1 -->

**Player:** If people find out a noob like you  
has that kimono, you're gonna have  
a lot of new "friends," get me?

<!-- uid=150105:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh yeah...?

<!-- uid=150105:14:1 -->


## Story 150107 · \[Fortune comes in at the merry gate\] Kirito Lv.70

Character Story

**Kirito:** Hnh?!

<!-- uid=150107:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Augh!

<!-- uid=150107:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** What kind of attack is that?!

<!-- uid=150107:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Some sort of long-distance spell!

<!-- uid=150107:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** So the attacker might not even be  
hiding nearby?!

<!-- uid=150107:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Maybe not. This is an evil  
Shaman's ability!

<!-- uid=150107:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Urgh... We're totally getting  
targeted...

<!-- uid=150107:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeah, no kidding!

<!-- uid=150107:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** I don't recall getting attacked  
this much before you found that  
stupid kimono!

<!-- uid=150107:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** What can I say?  
I'm a real popular guy...

<!-- uid=150107:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** They all want that outfit, right?

<!-- uid=150107:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** I hope that's all they want...!

<!-- uid=150107:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** What's that supposed to mean?

<!-- uid=150107:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** I've done a lot of things in a lot  
of VRMMOs... Not all of them good.

<!-- uid=150107:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** I can't guarantee I haven't made  
a few enemies along the way.

<!-- uid=150107:15:1 -->

**Leafa:** Ahh, I see what you mean.  
Not to mention you were  
instantly good at this game...

<!-- uid=150107:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...and just about anyone who's  
played a VRMMO knows the name  
Kirito by now.

<!-- uid=150107:17:1 -->

**Leafa:** I wouldn't be surprised if they've  
put a bounty of sorts on your  
head.

<!-- uid=150107:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Okay, okay!  
Just stop talking...

<!-- uid=150107:19:1 -->


## Story 150108 · \[Fortune comes in at the merry gate\] Kirito Lv.80

Character Story

**Shaman Player:** Damn! Ungh...

<!-- uid=150108:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha, didn't expect me to have  
an item that can trace curses,  
did you?

<!-- uid=150108:2:1 -->

**Shaman Player:** No, but I should've guessed.  
I'd heard all the rumors about  
Kirito, the noob.

<!-- uid=150108:3:1 -->

**Shaman Player:** I knew taking you on was a risk,  
but I didn't think you'd take me  
down THAT easily.

<!-- uid=150108:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** Oh people are talking about him. 

<!-- uid=150108:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** So they aren't just out to steal  
my kimono?

<!-- uid=150108:6:1 -->

**Shaman Player:** Hah! Come on, a rising star like  
you attracts the wrong kind of  
attention anywhere they go!

<!-- uid=150108:7:1 -->

**Shaman Player:** Entertainment, sports, you name  
it. The story's always the same.

<!-- uid=150108:8:1 -->

**Shaman Player:** Don't let all the talk get to you.  
Just keep doing what you're doing  
and it'll fade.

<!-- uid=150108:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** O-Okay, sure.

<!-- uid=150108:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** That's rich, coming from the  
guy who attacked us!

<!-- uid=150108:11:1 -->

**Shaman Player:** Hey, we're not actually evil.  
We just act evil in-game.

<!-- uid=150108:12:1 -->

**Shaman Player:** That's why we all engage you in  
normal conversation when we lose.

<!-- uid=150108:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Which is pretty funny, actually.  
Everyone's personality totally  
changes after each fight.

<!-- uid=150108:14:1 -->

**Shaman Player:** Heh, it definitely leads to some  
amusing moments.

<!-- uid=150108:15:1 -->

**Shaman Player:** I guess that's a point of pride  
for us eccentrics, though.

<!-- uid=150108:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha, well done.

<!-- uid=150108:17:1 -->

**Shaman Player:** At any rate, I'm done attacking  
you. I certainly can't beat you.

<!-- uid=150108:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Alright then.

<!-- uid=150108:19:1 -->

**Shaman Player:** But AE's full of people playing  
bad guys, and a couple of them  
like to overdo it.

<!-- uid=150108:20:1 -->

**Leafa:** Really? That doesn't sound cool...

<!-- uid=150108:21:1 -->

**Shaman Player:** I've only ever heard rumors, mind  
you. But supposedly they're pretty  
nasty.

<!-- uid=150108:22:1 -->

**Shaman Player:** Just keep an eye out for them  
and you'll be fine.

<!-- uid=150108:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** Got it. Thank you!

<!-- uid=150108:24:1 -->


## Story 150151 · \[Fellowship on the Field\] Kirito Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** Hey, look over there! It's Epi...  
I mean, Princess!

<!-- uid=150151:1:1 -->

**ArFA-sys:** You're right!  
Hey! Hi! Princess! Over here!

<!-- uid=150151:2:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** Oh wow, it's Kiri-poo and Sinon.  
And...who are you again?

<!-- uid=150151:3:1 -->

**ArFA-sys:** It's me! The ArFA-sys! And this is  
Kureha! We fought each other in  
the tournament?

<!-- uid=150151:4:1 -->

**Orchis:** Good afternoon, both of you.

<!-- uid=150151:5:2 -->

**Kureha:** H-Hey... So, are we...cool?

<!-- uid=150151:6:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** Ha ha ha, relax, girl. We cool.

<!-- uid=150151:7:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** I mean, it was totally fun  
fighting you in the last few  
minutes of that BoB tournament!

<!-- uid=150151:8:1 -->

**Kureha:** Yeah, I suppose you wouldn't hold  
a grudge... You did beat us, after  
all...

<!-- uid=150151:9:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** Duh, of course I won. I've been  
hanging out in the Monolith so  
much I know it inside and out.

<!-- uid=150151:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** That fight was really something  
to see.

<!-- uid=150151:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah. All four of you were  
incredible.

<!-- uid=150151:12:1 -->

**Kureha:** I thought we almost had it...

<!-- uid=150151:13:1 -->

**ArFA-sys:** Yeah, we were really close!

<!-- uid=150151:14:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** You wanna rumble again? I'm always  
ready to throw down. Still, it's  
sooo hilarious you know Kiri-poo.

<!-- uid=150151:15:1 -->

**Kureha:** It's amazing that we have mutual  
friends! Although not knowing did  
make it easier to fight you, hehe.

<!-- uid=150151:16:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** Why? Oh, you're just like Kiri-  
poo: too nice for your own good.  
I should've told you my sob story.

<!-- uid=150151:17:1 -->

**Kureha:** You have a sob story?

<!-- uid=150151:18:1 -->


## Story 150153 · \[Fellowship on the Field\] Kirito Lv.30

Character Story

**Kureha:** ...So you're selling items in-game  
for real money to pay for your  
little brother's operation?

<!-- uid=150153:1:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** Yeah, that's the story.  
Makes you just wanna cry, huh?

<!-- uid=150153:2:1 -->

**Kureha:** W-Well, yeah! I'm moved!  
I heard that people used GGO  
to earn pocket money,

<!-- uid=150153:3:1 -->

**Kureha:** but I never thought anyone would  
use the real money market for  
such a noble cause!

<!-- uid=150153:4:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** Yeah, boohoo, it's so sad and I'm  
a little angel. Whatever. It's not  
like it matters anymore.

<!-- uid=150153:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wait, why not?

<!-- uid=150153:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Did you get enough cash to pay  
for your brother's operation?

<!-- uid=150153:7:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** Yeah. My parents are taking him to  
the US for it soon.

<!-- uid=150153:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Really?! That's great!

<!-- uid=150153:9:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** It's okay. I saved up all that  
money, but my parents wouldn't  
take it.

<!-- uid=150153:10:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** So they ended up paying for it  
entirely on their own.

<!-- uid=150153:11:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** They said something dumb like  
"save that money for yourself.  
Put it in a college fund." Ugh.

<!-- uid=150153:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** Wow...

<!-- uid=150153:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, it makes sense to me.  
They're looking out for you.

<!-- uid=150153:14:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** You're sweet, Kiri-poo. You talk  
too much, and you make me want  
to gag, but you're sweet.

<!-- uid=150153:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Words can hurt, Princess.

<!-- uid=150153:16:1 -->

**Kureha:** It sounds like things aren't easy  
for you... I'm glad I didn't know  
all that before we fought.

<!-- uid=150153:17:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** Hehe, I knew it. You'd have gotten  
teary-eyed and rolled over on the  
spot.

<!-- uid=150153:18:1 -->

**Kureha:** Definitely! I wouldn't have been  
able to give it my all, that's for  
sure.

<!-- uid=150153:19:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** Hah! I knew it. All of Kiri-poo's  
friends are a bunch of  
goody-two-shoes.

<!-- uid=150153:20:1 -->


## Story 150155 · \[Fellowship on the Field\] Kirito Lv.50

Character Story

**ArFA-sys:** Well, I have a mom too! And I want  
to see her again soon!

<!-- uid=150155:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh yeah, I almost forgot  
about that...

<!-- uid=150155:2:1 -->

**Kureha:** Apparently even some ArFA-sys  
units have someone who takes  
on a parental role for them.

<!-- uid=150155:3:1 -->

**Kureha:** Wait a sec... Does that mean your  
support mech has one too?

<!-- uid=150155:4:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** No idea, but I'll ask.  
Hey, Orchis. Got a  
mom?

<!-- uid=150155:5:1 -->

**Orchis:** A mom? No. No, I don't.

<!-- uid=150155:6:1 -->

**Orchis:** MHCRs made in the SBC Monolith  
before its downfall did not have  
familial ties.

<!-- uid=150155:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** I guess that's pretty normal.  
Still, you are a robot. Who  
made you?

<!-- uid=150155:8:1 -->

**Orchis:** It doesn't matter. My maker is  
long dead.

<!-- uid=150155:9:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** D'aww, poor Orchis! No need to  
be sad! You've got me!

<!-- uid=150155:10:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** Just think of me as your new  
mommy!

<!-- uid=150155:11:1 -->

**Orchis:** You, my mommy? I'll be honest,  
the image doesn't really fit.

<!-- uid=150155:12:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** O-Ouch...

<!-- uid=150155:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...You know, I haven't seen my  
mom for a while.

<!-- uid=150155:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sinon...

<!-- uid=150155:15:1 -->


## Story 150157 · \[Fellowship on the Field\] Kirito Lv.70

Character Story

**Kirito:** Things...are a bit complicated  
with my parents, but I am really  
grateful for all they've done.

<!-- uid=150157:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** For a little while, though,  
I didn't even want to see them.

<!-- uid=150157:2:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** Wow, so even the poster boy for  
moral goodness here went through  
a rebellious phase. Cute.

<!-- uid=150157:3:1 -->

**Kureha:** That is SO unexpected!

<!-- uid=150157:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey, come on. Of course I did.  
But...right about that time, I  
wasn't able to see them anymore...

<!-- uid=150157:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** So I regret a lot of the things  
I said and did back then.  
I should've been nicer to them.

<!-- uid=150157:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Kirito...

<!-- uid=150157:7:1 -->

**ArFA-sys:** Wow, sounds complicated. I don't  
get your point, though. Why bring  
this up?

<!-- uid=150157:8:1 -->

**Orchis:** I'd like to know as well.

<!-- uid=150157:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha, sorry. Basically, I'm  
saying we should all be more  
appreciative of our parents.

<!-- uid=150157:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** They won't be there forever.  
Cherish them while you can.

<!-- uid=150157:11:1 -->

**Kureha:** But I'm sorry to hear that you  
had some bad things happen  
in your past, Kirito.

<!-- uid=150157:12:1 -->


## Story 150158 · \[Fellowship on the Field\] Kirito Lv.80

Character Story

**Kureha:** So, anyway... You guys want to go  
hit the Monolith?

<!-- uid=150158:1:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** The Monolith? Why?

<!-- uid=150158:2:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** The place is a ghost town now.  
All the drops have dried up.

<!-- uid=150158:3:1 -->

**Kureha:** Who cares about the drops!  
Let's go find Orchis's parents!

<!-- uid=150158:4:1 -->

**Orchis:** My parents? But...

<!-- uid=150158:5:1 -->

**Kureha:** You were born in the Monolith,  
right, Orchis? There must be some  
trace of them there.

<!-- uid=150158:6:1 -->

**Kureha:** If we look hard enough, we just  
might learn more about you!

<!-- uid=150158:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hmm... We spent most of our time  
there so far hunting for items.

<!-- uid=150158:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** None of us have checked out the  
backstory or looked for clues  
about the Monolith's past, right?

<!-- uid=150158:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hopefully we'll find some info or  
flavor text. Not many people play  
this game for the story after all.

<!-- uid=150158:10:1 -->

**ArFA-sys:** I'm all for it! I want to know  
more about Orchis's mom too!

<!-- uid=150158:11:1 -->

**Orchis:** Sure, I don't mind. There's no  
guarantee we'll find anything even  
remotely related to me, though.

<!-- uid=150158:12:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** Sounds like a lot of effort,  
but if you want to do it,  
I'm in.

<!-- uid=150158:13:1 -->

**Epidanthia:** You've been great to me, so I want  
to do something to pay you back.

<!-- uid=150158:14:1 -->

**Orchis:** Princess...

<!-- uid=150158:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Great, then it's settled!  
Let's go!

<!-- uid=150158:16:1 -->

**ArFA-sys:** Hold on, please. I'm going to  
ask Master to come too!

<!-- uid=150158:17:1 -->

**Kureha:** Good idea!

<!-- uid=150158:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Got it. We'll wait here until  
you hear back.

<!-- uid=150158:19:1 -->

**ArFA-sys:** Thanks!

<!-- uid=150158:20:1 -->


## Story 150171 · \[Black Master Swordman\] Kirito Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** Hmm... I see...

<!-- uid=150171:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** What do you see, Kirito?

<!-- uid=150171:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ah! Hey Asuna. This Magic Flag  
we found looks like it might be  
really handy.

<!-- uid=150171:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** The one we set up to disable  
flight?

<!-- uid=150171:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** No, we just made that one to help  
set up the Squad Jam rules.

<!-- uid=150171:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Normally, these flags are supposed  
to be used to buff a party, right?

<!-- uid=150171:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, that's right.

<!-- uid=150171:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, apparently there are  
a couple of these scattered  
around the arena.

<!-- uid=150171:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh! That certainly spices things  
up a bit. I like it.

<!-- uid=150171:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** In fact, I might even...  
Actually, you know what?  
Forget I said anything.

<!-- uid=150171:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Er... You didn't?

<!-- uid=150171:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh... Well, hey! It'll be that  
much more of a surprise then!

<!-- uid=150171:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** And besides, I don't think it'll  
work quite as I hope it will...

<!-- uid=150171:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh... Right... Well, anyway...  
If you do manage to find them,  
fill me in on whatever it is?

<!-- uid=150171:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm happy to help however I can.

<!-- uid=150171:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Got it. Thanks, Asuna!

## Story 150173 · \[Black Master Swordman\] Kirito Lv.30

Character Story

**Kirito:** Urraaagh!!

<!-- uid=150173:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** Kirito! You're being too reckless!

<!-- uid=150173:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** Sinon's right! Swords are at a  
huge disadvantage in this  
tournament!

<!-- uid=150173:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ugh... I totally forgot...

<!-- uid=150173:4:1 -->

**Player:** Hit that swordsman who charged us  
like an idiot!

<!-- uid=150173:5:1 -->

**Player:** Ready spells and...FIRE!

<!-- uid=150173:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** A-AH!

<!-- uid=150173:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** See?  
What'd I tell you.

<!-- uid=150173:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** You helped make the rules for this  
tournament. How could you forget  
them?

<!-- uid=150173:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey, I didn't forget! I just sort  
of...acted on instinct?

<!-- uid=150173:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** We get that you want to swing your  
big sword around, but stop being  
an idiot and use magic or a bow.

<!-- uid=150173:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Nooo! My sword's still useful!  
It is! I swear!

<!-- uid=150173:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** Are you seriously still being  
stubborn about this?!

<!-- uid=150173:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yes! Asuna's getting me a certain  
Magic Flag! If I have that, it'll  
change everything! I hope...?

<!-- uid=150173:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** What? Explanation, please.

<!-- uid=150173:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** You see... You'll just have to  
wait until I have it to find out!

<!-- uid=150173:16:1 -->


## Story 150175 · \[Black Master Swordman\] Kirito Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** Kirito! I found it!  
The Magic Flag!

<!-- uid=150175:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Alright! Thanks, Asuna!

<!-- uid=150175:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** Nice work, Asuna.

<!-- uid=150175:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** So... What does this Magic Flag  
do that makes swords worth it  
in this tournament?

<!-- uid=150175:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** This item's called the "Banner of  
Power"!

<!-- uid=150175:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** It doubles the speed of every  
slice. I can do interesting things  
with this, hehe.

<!-- uid=150175:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Stop beating around the bush and  
tell us already!

<!-- uid=150175:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeah! Tell us, tell us!

<!-- uid=150175:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha! It'll be easier to show  
you. Asuna, set up the flag for  
us, will you please?

<!-- uid=150175:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** You got it.  
Just hit this here, and...done!

<!-- uid=150175:10:2 -->

**Kirito:** Yes. Yeees...  
Take...THIS!  
HYAAAH!!

<!-- uid=150175:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...Wow.

<!-- uid=150175:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** Wh-What was that?!

<!-- uid=150175:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Did you just shoot wind out of  
your sword?!

<!-- uid=150175:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Woohoo!  
The experiment is a success!

<!-- uid=150175:16:1 -->


## Story 150177 · \[Black Master Swordman\] Kirito Lv.70

Character Story

**Sinon:** What just happened?

<!-- uid=150177:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** It was almost like a laser beam  
just shot out of the tip of your  
sword!

<!-- uid=150177:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sort of! I sliced so hard, it  
turned the air into a blade of  
pure pressure. Cool, right?

<!-- uid=150177:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's...insane. That means your  
sword's now a long-distance  
weapon!

<!-- uid=150177:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha, that's right. I thought a  
player with enough sword skill  
might be able to pull this off.

<!-- uid=150177:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** No hogging it! Let me try!

<!-- uid=150177:6:1 -->

**Leafa:** Me too!

<!-- uid=150177:7:2 -->

**Sinon:** Calm down, you two.  
I don't think you can do it.

<!-- uid=150177:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** You're both magic-focused races,  
so your strength and melee skill  
levels are lower than Kirito's.

<!-- uid=150177:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** Without Kirito's ridiculous skill  
levels and the flag's buff,  
I doubt it'll be possible.

<!-- uid=150177:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** I agree with Sinon. I can't use  
magic or ranged weapons well,  
but this makes up for it.

<!-- uid=150177:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Aw, rats... I really wanted to  
try, too...

<!-- uid=150177:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeah! Besides, this is supposed  
to be a ranged tournament!  
You're spoiling it for all of us!

<!-- uid=150177:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** H-Hey, hold it! You should be  
happy your teammate's more  
powerful!

<!-- uid=150177:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** And what was with that sudden  
change of attitude the second you  
heard you couldn't do it?!

<!-- uid=150177:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** Heh. I think they're jealous of  
your innovative new combat style.

<!-- uid=150177:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** I am! No fair, Kirito!

<!-- uid=150177:17:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeah! I wanna do it too!!

<!-- uid=150177:18:1 -->

Character Story

black-clad moron? He's charging

## Story 150201 · \[Unleashed Werewolf\] Eugeo Lv.10

## Story 150203 · \[Unleashed Werewolf\] Eugeo Lv.30

Character Story

<!-- uid=150207:5:1 -->

## Story 160071 · \[Trust in Each Other\] Kirito Lv.10

Character Story

the other day.

celebration? Thank you, Liena.

<!-- uid=160071:2:1 -->

without your help.

<!-- uid=160071:3:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I thought we were done for when  
Ms. Azurica called us up to see her  
at the end...

from you and Golgorosso, she didn't  
have any issues.

<!-- uid=160071:8:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I see. That's good to hear. It

**Sortiliena:** But be more careful next time.

**Sortiliena:** they had a deep and almost...

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=160071:19:1 -->


## Story 160073 · \[Trust in Each Other\] Kirito Lv.30

Character Story

**Kirito:** It's called nanakusa-gayu.  
You make it by adding seven  
spring herbs to rice porridge.

<!-- uid=160073:1:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Rice porridge... So it's another  
rice-based dish then.

<!-- uid=160073:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's right.  
Although... Hm?

<!-- uid=160073:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Water dropwort, shepherd's purse,  
Jersey cudweed, chickweed,  
nipplewort, turnip leaf, and...

<!-- uid=160073:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** daikon leaf... Some of those are  
pretty rare in real life. I wonder  
if they have them all here...

<!-- uid=160073:5:1 -->

**Eugeo:** What are you mumbling about?

<!-- uid=160073:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, sorry... I was just wondering  
if it'd even be possible to get  
all seven herbs here.

<!-- uid=160073:7:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Another ingredient hunt, eh?  
What sort of herbs do you mean?

<!-- uid=160073:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Uh, hang on... I don't actually  
know them all that well myself...

<!-- uid=160073:9:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Weren't Aincrad-style  
swordsmanship and food...

<!-- uid=160073:10:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...the only things you  
properly remembered?

<!-- uid=160073:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Are you kidding? Nobody could  
remember all there is to know  
about every kind of food.

<!-- uid=160073:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Then again, considering how  
cooking isn't all that deeply  
pursued here...

<!-- uid=160073:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Maybe that way of thinking itself  
is a bit odd...

<!-- uid=160073:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** After all, I doubt the medieval  
era had anywhere near the variety  
we do in modern times...

<!-- uid=160073:15:1 -->

**Eugeo:** There he goes mumbling again...

<!-- uid=160073:16:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...

<!-- uid=160073:17:1 -->


## Story 160075 · \[Trust in Each Other\] Kirito Lv.50

Character Story

**Sortiliena:** Kirito.

<!-- uid=160075:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hi Liena. What's up?

<!-- uid=160075:2:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** How is your search going? Are you  
finding the ingredients you need  
for your herb rice porridge?

<!-- uid=160075:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, yeah, I am, actually. Just a  
few more and I'll have all seven.

<!-- uid=160075:4:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I see. Well, it's not as though  
you have a deadline to meet.

<!-- uid=160075:5:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** You could always just look for  
them during your training breaks.

<!-- uid=160075:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm afraid I can't, actually.  
This is kind of superstitious,

<!-- uid=160075:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** but the reason it uses seven herbs  
is because you're supposed to eat  
it on the seventh day of the year.

<!-- uid=160075:8:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** What happens if you don't?

<!-- uid=160075:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, uh... nothing, really.

<!-- uid=160075:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** You're just supposed to wish for a  
year of good health when you eat  
it on that day.

<!-- uid=160075:11:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I see. You certainly know a lot  
about this, don't you...?

<!-- uid=160075:12:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I doubt anyone knows as much  
about ingredients or food as you  
do, even among the nobility.

<!-- uid=160075:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, uh... That's probably in  
large part due to cultural  
differences...

<!-- uid=160075:14:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Your Aincrad style is supple,  
yet capable of adapting to  
many different situations.

<!-- uid=160075:15:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** It is similar to my family's  
Serlut style. Or at least,  
that is what I thought...

<!-- uid=160075:16:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** If I wish to be a proper heir to  
the Serlut style, perhaps I still  
need to learn to make use of its...

<!-- uid=160075:17:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...flexibility and adaptability in  
all aspects of my life... much as  
you have done.

<!-- uid=160075:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Liena...?

<!-- uid=160075:19:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** But never mind that.  
I look forward to trying this  
herb rice porridge of yours.

<!-- uid=160075:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Thank you, Liena!

<!-- uid=160075:21:1 -->


## Story 160077 · \[Trust in Each Other\] Kirito Lv.70

Character Story

**Kirito:** This is it: nanakusa-gayu.

<!-- uid=160077:1:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=160077:2:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I suppose I knew what to expect

herbs mixed in.

ingredients...? And we're supposed

**Kirito:** That's right. I'm sure it'll

Character Story

## Story 160147 · \[Black Suited Gunner\] Kirito Lv.70

Character Story

**Kirito:** Huh, so that's what happened.

<!-- uid=160147:1:1 -->

I'm glad it happened.

<!-- uid=160147:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** When I think back to when I was  
the Lightning Flash and a member  
of the KoB, of course it wasn't...

<!-- uid=160147:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...all good times. I mean, I was

all for the longest time too.

<!-- uid=160147:10:1 -->

<!-- uid=160147:11:1 -->

<!-- uid=160147:12:1 -->

just like us and that girl.

<!-- uid=160147:15:1 -->

not, there's someone out there...

<!-- uid=160147:17:1 -->

<!-- uid=160147:18:1 -->

players.

what could he be planning?

<!-- uid=160147:20:1 -->

<!-- uid=160147:21:1 -->

## Story 160151 · \[Heart of the Sword\] Kirito Lv.10

**Thokk:** I was just thinking about what  
happened when we got caught up  
in that time stream earlier.

## Story 160153 · \[Heart of the Sword\] Kirito Lv.30

Character Story

**Monster:** Grraaagh!

<!-- uid=160153:1:1 -->

**Thokk:** Makoto!

<!-- uid=160153:2:1 -->

**Makoto:** Roger! I'll take it out!

<!-- uid=160153:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hyaaah!

<!-- uid=160153:4:1 -->

**Thokk:** No, don't do that! You have to  
use a smokescreen!

<!-- uid=160153:5:1 -->

**Makoto:** What?! Uh oh!

<!-- uid=160153:6:1 -->

**Monster:** GRAAAAAHHHH!

<!-- uid=160153:7:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oww... That thing got me good.

<!-- uid=160153:8:1 -->

**Thokk:** I warned you before we started.  
Once it starts turning around  
more, it goes berserk.

<!-- uid=160153:9:1 -->

**Thokk:** That's why you have to deploy a  
smokescreen, to block its vision.

<!-- uid=160153:10:1 -->

**Makoto:** Sorry. It's just when you called  
out my name, I thought you wanted  
me to go and finish it off.

<!-- uid=160153:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** That's fair. It's not like I said  
anything more specific.

<!-- uid=160153:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** Times like this are why I'd really  
like to have that synchronization  
system in place between players.

<!-- uid=160153:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's a bit of mouthful to say,  
don't you think? Can't you come up  
with something a bit snappier?

<!-- uid=160153:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** Me? You're the one who called it  
synchronization! But alright.  
Do you have any ideas, then?

<!-- uid=160153:15:1 -->

**Makoto:** Um, well... What about calling it,  
like, the "Seeker System?"

<!-- uid=160153:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** Eh, that doesn't sound too  
great, either.

<!-- uid=160153:17:1 -->

**Makoto:** In any case, if you're going to  
implement a system like that, it  
needs to balanced, right?

<!-- uid=160153:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** It won't be much fun if only the  
players are strong. Will you make  
the enemies tough, too?

<!-- uid=160153:19:1 -->

**Thokk:** Obviously. I wouldn't have it any  
other way. Watching those fights  
gave me a lot of food for thought.

<!-- uid=160153:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** They made me realize I wanna  
make tough enemies be the main  
reason to keep playing my game.

<!-- uid=160153:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** They can't be beaten solo. You  
have to rely on your bond with  
your partner to take them down.

<!-- uid=160153:22:1 -->

**Thokk:** Right now, that's what I think  
is going to be the selling point  
for Nibelungen Purgatory's combat.

<!-- uid=160153:23:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hee hee, sounds like it's going  
to be awesome. I can't wait to  
try it for myself.

<!-- uid=160153:24:1 -->


## Story 160155 · \[Heart of the Sword\] Kirito Lv.50

Character Story

**Makoto:** ...That's the gist of her idea,  
basically.

<!-- uid=160155:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh. A synchronized combat system.

<!-- uid=160155:2:1 -->

want people going into the game  
with any prior knowledge about it.

<!-- uid=160155:4:1 -->

I won't tell her you came to us.

<!-- uid=160155:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yep, our lips are sealed, hee hee.

<!-- uid=160155:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, a lot of games with concepts  
like that rely on something like  
an affinity stat.

<!-- uid=160155:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** And it'll go up the longer you're  
partied with someone, making, say,

<!-- uid=160155:8:1 -->

see in RPGs and stuff, at least.

<!-- uid=160155:9:1 -->

a pretty old-fashioned way to do  
it at this point?

<!-- uid=160155:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Plus, if you make it based on

players in the beginning stages.

for a VRMMO nowadays.

for a system that works at a more  
emotional level.

<!-- uid=160155:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ohhh. Then even players who have just met can still be synchronized if they're compatible.

<!-- uid=160155:17:1 -->

**Makoto:** Ahaha, wow, you two know your  
stuff. I figured Kirito would, but  
I'm impressed you do, too, Asuna.

<!-- uid=160155:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, it's no big deal, really.  
To be honest, I haven't actually  
been gaming for all that long.

<!-- uid=160155:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** But I was surrounded by it  
because of my dad's company.

<!-- uid=160155:20:1 -->

until I borrowed my brother's,  
so...

<!-- uid=160155:21:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh, I see. That's pretty neat.

<!-- uid=160155:22:1 -->


## Story 160157 · \[Heart of the Sword\] Kirito Lv.70

Character Story

**Kirito:** ...Actually, you know, I just  
remembered something else.

<!-- uid=160157:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** The Cardinal System has a way of  
deciphering players' general  
emotions, doesn't it?

<!-- uid=160157:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah! That's what allows our  
avatars to have different facial  
expressions in the first place.

<!-- uid=160157:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh wow, I had no idea that's how  
that all worked.

<!-- uid=160157:4:1 -->

you might be able to transmit to  
friends what you're planning.

<!-- uid=160157:5:1 -->

**Makoto:** Really? That's actually possible?

<!-- uid=160157:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** You can't get too detailed about  
it, but I think it might work for  
at least basic directions.

<!-- uid=160157:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** You could have your basic thought  
process show up on their screen  
and then work from there.

<!-- uid=160157:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wow, that's amazing it allows for  
so much!

<!-- uid=160157:9:1 -->

in expression, status, and even  
each player's line of sight.

<!-- uid=160157:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Because as it is, your character  
already visibly reflects a lot of  
what you do and and experience.

<!-- uid=160157:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** So if you make an AI that monitors  
all that and conveys those changes  
in text, you might get somewhere.

<!-- uid=160157:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** It won't be accurate all the time  
at first, but feed it more data  
and it should improve over time.

<!-- uid=160157:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Once you get used to it, I bet  
you'll be able to pull off some  
big feats with friends in battles.

<!-- uid=160157:14:1 -->

**Makoto:** Whoa, that sounds awesome! Do you  
mind if I share all of that with  
Thokk?

<!-- uid=160157:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Of course not. Go right ahead!

<!-- uid=160157:16:1 -->

emotions, doesn't it?

<!-- uid=160167:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah! That's what allows our  
avatars to have different facial  
expressions in the first place.

<!-- uid=160167:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh wow, I had no idea that's how  
that all worked.

<!-- uid=160167:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** If you were tap into that system,  
you might be able to transmit to  
friends what you're planning.

<!-- uid=160167:5:1 -->

**Makoto:** Really? That's actually possible?

<!-- uid=160167:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** You can't get too detailed about  
it, but I think it might work for  
at least basic directions.

<!-- uid=160167:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** You could have your basic thought  
process show up on their screen  
and then work from there.

<!-- uid=160167:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wow, that's amazing it allows for  
so much!

<!-- uid=160167:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. What I'd do is track changes  
in expression, status, and even  
each player's line of sight.

<!-- uid=160167:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Because as it is, your character  
already visibly reflects a lot of  
what you do and and experience.

<!-- uid=160167:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** So if you make an AI that monitors  
all that and conveys those changes  
in text, you might get somewhere.

<!-- uid=160167:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** It won't be accurate all the time  
at first, but feed it more data  
and it should improve over time.

<!-- uid=160167:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Once you get used to it, I bet  
you'll be able to pull off some  
big feats with friends in battles.

<!-- uid=160167:14:1 -->

**Makoto:** Whoa, that sounds awesome! Do you  
mind if I share all of that with  
Thokk?

<!-- uid=160167:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Of course not. Go right ahead!

<!-- uid=160167:16:1 -->
