## Story 160173 · \[Strength to Accept the Past\] Kirito Lv.30

Character Story

**Thokk:** Oh, Sinon. Hi.

<!-- uid=160173:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hey, Thokk. I came to check in  
things. Anything unusual happen  
recently?

<!-- uid=160173:2:1 -->

**Thokk:** Nope. All quiet on the home front.  
Hellfire Urdr's ring hasn't done  
anything weird, either.

<!-- uid=160173:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** Well, that's good to hear. I know  
Kirito was concerned about that,  
too.

<!-- uid=160173:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** He figures she won't stay sealed  
too long, so the sooner we get  
things set up, the better.

<!-- uid=160173:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** Don't worry. I know what I'm  
doing here. Hellfire Urdr will be  
taken care of in my VRMMO.

<!-- uid=160173:6:1 -->

**Thokk:** I'll be giving her a good place  
so she can be safely reborn and  
given a new lease on life.

<!-- uid=160173:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** That's reassuring. I'm not so  
worried now.

<!-- uid=160173:8:1 -->

**Thokk:** Oh, while you're here, Sinon,  
there's something I wanted to  
ask you. About Kirito, I mean.

<!-- uid=160173:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** Kirito? What is it?

<!-- uid=160173:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** I already knew that Kirito was  
famous here in ALO for being  
a top-tier player and all that.

<!-- uid=160173:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** And I know that he also runs  
around GGO fighting with that  
Photon Sword of his.

<!-- uid=160173:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** But I get the feeling there's more  
to him than that. Something else  
that makes him so different...

<!-- uid=160173:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...

<!-- uid=160173:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** Just what kind of person is he,  
really? I wanna know.

<!-- uid=160173:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** I don't think that's for me to  
tell you. We're talking about his  
personal life. You should ask him.

<!-- uid=160173:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** N-No way. I can't do that!

<!-- uid=160173:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Why not?

<!-- uid=160173:18:1 -->

**Thokk:** I mean, 'cause...he's s'posed to  
be my nemesis! Maybe not so much  
lately, but he IS a fairy!

<!-- uid=160173:19:1 -->

**Thokk:** Makoto's cozying up to him, y'see,  
what with their history. I need  
to keep him at arm's length!

<!-- uid=160173:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** It might feel a bit obvious, but  
then why don't you ask Makoto  
since you and she are so close?

<!-- uid=160173:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** I would, but the problem with that  
is she didn't hang out with him  
and Leafa back then.

<!-- uid=160173:22:1 -->

**Thokk:** So I'm wondering if something  
happened with him during that  
time she wouldn't know about.

<!-- uid=160173:23:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...Wow, you're real sharp, Thokk.

<!-- uid=160173:24:1 -->

**Thokk:** What was that?

<!-- uid=160173:25:1 -->

**Sinon:** Uh, nothing. Nothing at all.

<!-- uid=160173:26:1 -->


## Story 160175 · \[Strength to Accept the Past\] Kirito Lv.50

Character Story

**Thokk:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=160175:1:1 -->

**Makoto:** What are you up to, Thokk?  
Working on Nibelungen Purgatory  
some more?

<!-- uid=160175:2:1 -->

**Thokk:** Kinda. I'm surfing the web while  
I tell the programmers what they  
need to work on.

<!-- uid=160175:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** C'mon, Thokk. You're supposed to  
be working here. Concentrate.

<!-- uid=160175:4:1 -->

**Thokk:** I'm not doing it to slack off.  
It actually helps me relax so  
I can work better.

<!-- uid=160175:5:1 -->

**Makoto:** Yeah, like I haven't heard that  
one before. Of course you'd say  
that.

<!-- uid=160175:6:1 -->

**Thokk:** Interesting...

<!-- uid=160175:7:1 -->

**Makoto:** Anyway, are you looking something  
up? You sure have a lot of windows  
open.

<!-- uid=160175:8:1 -->

**Thokk:** The SAO Record Collection...

<!-- uid=160175:9:1 -->

**Makoto:** SAO? You mean that old VRMMO that  
used to be online before ALO where  
all those deaths happened?

<!-- uid=160175:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yep. SAO was built to run on the  
NerveGear, which was a predecessor  
to the AmuSphere.

<!-- uid=160175:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** They were rigged to kill. People  
literally had to fight for their  
lives for two whole years.

<!-- uid=160175:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** And this book here assembles bits  
and pieces of records to try  
and tell the bigger story.

<!-- uid=160175:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** Okay, but why are you reading  
such a thing in the first place?

<!-- uid=160175:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** We saw a glimpse of what that sort  
of fighting is like in GGO, but in  
SAO, it was part of everyday life.

<!-- uid=160175:15:1 -->

**Thokk:** Not many people could come out of  
an ordeal like that without at  
least a few scars haunting them.

<!-- uid=160175:16:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wait, you don't think that  
Kirito...that Kazu was caught up  
in that mess, do you?

<!-- uid=160175:17:1 -->

**Thokk:** ...

<!-- uid=160175:18:1 -->


## Story 160177 · \[Strength to Accept the Past\] Kirito Lv.70

Character Story

**Thokk:** Like you've said before, it took  
experience to stay so calm during  
that fight with Death Gun.

<!-- uid=160177:1:1 -->

**Thokk:** And I can't think of a "better"  
place to get it than SAO, where  
every fight could be your last.

<!-- uid=160177:2:1 -->

**Makoto:** B-But Kazu's never said a word  
about it. How can you be so sure  
he was involved in it?

<!-- uid=160177:3:1 -->

**Thokk:** Of course he hasn't. What survivor  
is gonna feel like talking about  
it after what they went through?

<!-- uid=160177:4:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's fair. It's probably not the  
easiest thing for them to discuss  
when it was so traumatic.

<!-- uid=160177:5:1 -->

**Makoto:** But then why is Kazu still hanging  
out in virtual worlds? Why doesn't  
he stay away from them?

<!-- uid=160177:6:1 -->

**Thokk:** There are parts of this book  
that reference someone known as  
the "Black Swordsman."

<!-- uid=160177:7:1 -->

**Thokk:** And the details surrounding this  
swordsman remind me of our own  
Spriggan, Kirito.

<!-- uid=160177:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** What makes you say that? What sort  
of player was this Black  
Swordsman in SAO?

<!-- uid=160177:9:1 -->

**Thokk:** At first they weren't well liked  
because they'd played the beta and  
knew some of what lay ahead.

<!-- uid=160177:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** They got called “beaters" and got  
shunned for it, so they kept  
progressing on their own.

<!-- uid=160177:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** But in the end, their actions  
exposed Akihiko Kayaba, who was  
secretly inside the game, too.

<!-- uid=160177:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** And that helped lead to everyone  
finally escaping from SAO. At  
least, that's what's written here.

<!-- uid=160177:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** ...

<!-- uid=160177:14:1 -->

**Makoto:** But I don't have the guts to walk  
up and ask him, either. I'm scared  
what the answer might be.

<!-- uid=160177:15:1 -->

**Thokk:** But it would make sense if he was  
there. It'd explain why he was  
able to fight Death Gun so well.

<!-- uid=160177:16:1 -->

**Makoto:** Yeah, you're not wrong about that,  
I guess.

<!-- uid=160177:17:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hmm... Hey, speak of the devil.  
Kirito just messaged me!

<!-- uid=160177:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** He wants to know if we want to  
hunt monsters with him in Alfheim  
to blow some steam and stuff.

<!-- uid=160177:19:1 -->

**Makoto:** He realizes we're both busy, so  
we don't have to go, but what  
do you think?

<!-- uid=160177:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** I am getting pretty tired of how  
still the air is down here.  
I say we go!

<!-- uid=160177:21:1 -->

**Makoto:** Okay. Then I'll let him know  
we're on our way.

<!-- uid=160177:22:1 -->

<!-- uid=160185:12:1 -->

birthday present ever...

<!-- uid=160185:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** H-Hey, come on, you don't have to  
cry about it!

<!-- uid=160185:14:1 -->

**Eugeo:** We...

<!-- uid=160185:15:1 -->

**Alice:** We were all together back then...

<!-- uid=160185:16:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Our paths may separate here, but  
our memories will always remain.

<!-- uid=160185:17:1 -->

**Alice:** I'll live on inside of you.  
So...

<!-- uid=160185:18:1 -->


## Story 160187 · \[Blooming Blue Rose Glacier\] Eugeo Lv.70

Character Story

**Eugeo:** So... don't cry, Kirito.

<!-- uid=160187:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah... Our memories will always  
be here.

<!-- uid=160187:2:1 -->

**Eugeo:** That's right. And we'll be best  
friends forever.

<!-- uid=160187:3:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Kirito... Where are you?  
I can't see you...

<!-- uid=160187:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm here. I'm right here.

<!-- uid=160187:5:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Hey... I can see something  
glittering in the darkness...  
It looks just like stars...

<!-- uid=160187:6:1 -->

**Eugeo:** The stars I saw looking up at the  
night sky... next to the base of  
the Gigas Cedar...

<!-- uid=160187:7:1 -->

**Eugeo:** It also reminds me... of the  
way your sword gleams...

<!-- uid=160187:8:1 -->

**Eugeo:** That's it... Kirito... You should  
name your black sword the  
"Night Sky Sword"...

<!-- uid=160187:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah... That's a great name.  
Thanks, Eugeo.

<!-- uid=160187:10:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Make sure you watch over this  
tiny world... as gently as the  
night sky...

<!-- uid=160187:11:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...This was for the best, right?

<!-- uid=160187:12:1 -->

**Alice:** Yes. Don't worry. I'm sure those  
two will lead the world in the  
right direction.

<!-- uid=160187:13:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Yeah, you're right.  
Well... shall we get going?

<!-- uid=160187:14:1 -->

**Alice:** Okay.

<!-- uid=160187:15:1 -->


## Story 160188 · \[Blooming Blue Rose Glacier\] Eugeo Lv.80

Character Story

**Alice:** ...Nnn.

<!-- uid=160188:1:1 -->

**Alice:** I must have dozed off.

<!-- uid=160188:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=160188:3:1 -->

**Alice:** Good morning, Kirito.  
You weren't cold, were you?

<!-- uid=160188:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=160188:5:1 -->

**Alice:** I see... Okay, let's go fetch some  
water, then.

<!-- uid=160188:6:1 -->

**Alice:** Oh, and we should collect a lot of  
firewood too, in case it gets  
chilly again tonight.

<!-- uid=160188:7:1 -->

**Alice:** Another lovely day... This may

of the upcoming...

<!-- uid=160188:8:1 -->

**Alice:** ...battle against the Dark  
Territory... But I promise you.

<!-- uid=160188:9:1 -->

<!-- uid=160188:10:1 -->


## Story 160211 · \[Future-Slicing Knight\] Bercouli Lv.10

Character Story

**Soldier:** Your Excellency, our forces are  
advancing to the Eastern Gate in  
good time. No issues to report.

<!-- uid=160211:1:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Great. I knew I had nothing to  
worry about with Fanatio in  
charge of their deployment.

<!-- uid=160211:2:1 -->

**Soldier:** Also, the vice commander should  
be returning to the Central  
Cathedral sometime today.

<!-- uid=160211:3:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Hm? Did she forget something?

<!-- uid=160211:4:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Not that it's too big of a deal,  
I suppose. She does have a dragon,  
after all.

<!-- uid=160211:5:1 -->

**Supply Officer:** Your Excellency! I wish to discuss  
a matter concerning the garrison's  
supply corps.

<!-- uid=160211:6:1 -->

**Bercouli:** What is it?

<!-- uid=160211:7:1 -->

**Priest:** Your Excellency! One of the  
Knights that was in cold sleep is  
showing signs of reawakening!

<!-- uid=160211:8:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Whoa, slow down, people. I can  
only handle so much at once. Let's  
take this one at a time...

<!-- uid=160211:9:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Whew... I think things have  
finally calmed down.

<!-- uid=160211:10:1 -->

**Bercouli:** I was so busy, I lost track of  
time. Looks like the sun's already  
going down.

<!-- uid=160211:11:1 -->

**???:** Your Excellency!

<!-- uid=160211:12:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Hm?

<!-- uid=160211:13:1 -->

**Fanatio:** I have returned, sir.

<!-- uid=160211:14:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Oh, Fanatio. Nice work out there.  
But what brings you back?

<!-- uid=160211:15:1 -->

**Bercouli:** I told you I'd be taking off for  
the front in a few days, didn't I?  
You could've just waited there.

<!-- uid=160211:16:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Y-Yes, I realize that.

<!-- uid=160211:17:1 -->


## Story 160213 · \[Future-Slicing Knight\] Bercouli Lv.30

Character Story

**Fanatio:** However... I couldn't help but  
feel the need to check in on  
your health.

<!-- uid=160213:1:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Huh? Well, as you can see, I'm  
doing just as fine as always.

<!-- uid=160213:2:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Yes, but you've been so busy  
managing everything in the  
Administrator's absence.

<!-- uid=160213:3:1 -->

**Fanatio:** With so few Integrity Knights at  
our disposal right now, so much  
work is falling to you.

<!-- uid=160213:4:1 -->

**Fanatio:** As the vice commander, I feel it's  
my duty to look after your health.

<!-- uid=160213:5:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Ha ha, fair enough. I appreciate  
you checking in on me, but you  
really don't need to... Hm?

<!-- uid=160213:6:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Is something the matter?

<!-- uid=160213:7:1 -->

**Bercouli:** I just realized I haven't had  
anything to eat all day.

<!-- uid=160213:8:1 -->

**Fanatio:** See? This is exactly what I'm  
talking about. You must eat or you  
won't have the stamina to march.

<!-- uid=160213:9:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Ahaha, I can handle a little  
marching. But I can't fight on an  
empty stomach, that's for sure.

<!-- uid=160213:10:1 -->

**Bercouli:** I guess I should make my way over  
to the dining hall and grab a bite  
to eat.

<!-- uid=160213:11:1 -->

**Fanatio:** I'll... I'll come with you.

<!-- uid=160213:12:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Oh, did you forget to have  
anything all day too?

<!-- uid=160213:13:1 -->

**Fanatio:** No, sir. I've had breakfast and  
lunch. I just haven't had anything  
for dinner yet...

<!-- uid=160213:14:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Wait, is that why you came all the  
way back here? To have dinner  
with me?

<!-- uid=160213:15:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Y-Yes, I realize that.

<!-- uid=160213:16:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Ha ha, well, that's awfully  
considerate of you. Food always  
tastes better with company.

<!-- uid=160213:17:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Y-Yes, I think so too.

<!-- uid=160213:18:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Come on, let's get some food.

<!-- uid=160213:19:1 -->


## Story 160215 · \[Future-Slicing Knight\] Bercouli Lv.50

Character Story

**Bercouli:** Hm? There are no cooks here...?

<!-- uid=160215:1:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Perhaps they've already gone home  
for the day?

<!-- uid=160215:2:1 -->

**Bercouli:** I don't know. Usually there's  
always someone around... Wait,  
I think I know what's going on.

<!-- uid=160215:3:1 -->

**Bercouli:** A lot of our cooks went along on  
the march, didn't they? That'd  
explain why this place is empty.

<!-- uid=160215:4:1 -->

**Fanatio:** That's... a bit of a problem.

<!-- uid=160215:5:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Yeah. I hope there's at least  
some food left...

<!-- uid=160215:6:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Ugh... It doesn't look like there's  
anything I can eat without  
having someone prepare it.

<!-- uid=160215:7:1 -->

**Fanatio:** ...

<!-- uid=160215:8:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Guess I'll just have to go hungry  
tonight and wait for someone to  
show up tomorrow. Oh well.

<!-- uid=160215:9:1 -->

**Fanatio:** I'll... I'll cook something  
for you.

<!-- uid=160215:10:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Oh, you can cook?

<!-- uid=160215:11:1 -->

**Fanatio:** I... have next to no experience  
working in the kitchen...

<!-- uid=160215:12:1 -->

**Fanatio:** But I feel as if I'd fail you as  
my superior if I were to leave you  
hungry! Please, leave this to me!

<!-- uid=160215:13:1 -->

**Bercouli:** You may be my subordinate, but  
you don't need to feel obliged to  
cook for me...

<!-- uid=160215:14:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Well, if you want to try, I won't  
stop you. Just don't feel like you  
have to make anything fancy.

<!-- uid=160215:15:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Understood. I shall do my best!

<!-- uid=160215:16:1 -->


## Story 160217 · \[Future-Slicing Knight\] Bercouli Lv.70

Character Story

**Fanatio:** I suppose I should... cut this up?

<!-- uid=160217:1:1 -->

**Fanatio:** I'm not good with knives, though.  
Maybe I'll just use my sword...  
On second thought, maybe not.

<!-- uid=160217:2:1 -->

**Bercouli:** ...

<!-- uid=160217:3:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Now to add a little seasoning...  
Hopefully this condiment will  
work okay.

<!-- uid=160217:4:1 -->

**Bercouli:** U-Uh, shouldn't you at least taste  
it beforehand?

<!-- uid=160217:5:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Y-Yes. You're right.  
Hmm...

<!-- uid=160217:6:1 -->

**Fanatio:** It's... It's sweet!

<!-- uid=160217:7:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Come on. We're not here to  
eat dessert.

<!-- uid=160217:8:1 -->

**Fanatio:** E-Excuse me. It would seem that  
wasn't the right flavoring...

<!-- uid=160217:9:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Guess it's time to eat.

<!-- uid=160217:10:1 -->

**Fanatio:** R-Right...

<!-- uid=160217:11:1 -->

**Bercouli:** The vegetables in this stew...  
sure are huge...

<!-- uid=160217:12:1 -->

**Fanatio:** S-Sorry...

<!-- uid=160217:13:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Eh, it's not like their size will  
affect how they taste. Now let's  
take a bite... \*munch munch\*

<!-- uid=160217:14:1 -->

**Fanatio:** H-How is it?

<!-- uid=160217:15:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Mmm... I-It's definitely got  
a unique flavor...

<!-- uid=160217:16:1 -->

**Fanatio:** I-I see...

<!-- uid=160217:17:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Now for the next dish. This is...  
grilled meat, I think? That's  
what it is, right?

<!-- uid=160217:18:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Yes, that's correct!

<!-- uid=160217:19:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Let's see... \*munch munch\*...  
It... doesn't taste like it's been  
fully cooked...

<!-- uid=160217:20:1 -->

**Fanatio:** My deepest apologies! Allow me  
to cook it again with my Heaven-  
Piercing Blade!

<!-- uid=160217:21:1 -->

**Bercouli:** N-No, stop! You'll burn the whole  
table to a crisp if you do that!

<!-- uid=160217:22:1 -->


## Story 160218 · \[Future-Slicing Knight\] Bercouli Lv.80

Character Story

**Fanatio:** \*sigh\*... I'm sorry. Truly sorry,  
Your Excellency...

<!-- uid=160218:1:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Uh, that's okay! It's the thought  
that counts! It was an interesting  
experience, anyway...

<!-- uid=160218:2:1 -->

**Fanatio:** It seems my dedication to my  
Knight training has left much  
to be desired in other areas...

<!-- uid=160218:3:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Don't feel too bad. All of us  
Integrity Knights are like that.

<!-- uid=160218:4:1 -->

**Bercouli:** But with what happened recently,  
we've been freed from the  
Administrator's spell over us.

<!-- uid=160218:5:1 -->

**Bercouli:** In fact, maybe it's experiences  
like this that'll help us learn  
how to live like humans again.

<!-- uid=160218:6:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Your Excellency...

<!-- uid=160218:7:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Now then, what do you say we  
get some shuteye so we can  
head out tomorrow?

<!-- uid=160218:8:1 -->

**Bercouli:** The real fight still lies ahead,  
after all.

<!-- uid=160218:9:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Indeed! I shall always remain at  
your side, sir, wherever the battle  
may take us!

<!-- uid=160218:10:1 -->

**NPC:** I couldn't eat another bite...

**Asuna:** Okay!

<!-- uid=160241:18:1 -->

**Alice:** We shall accompany you as well.

## Story 160243 · \[Wish for Happiness\] Eugeo Lv.30

Character Story

<!-- uid=160243:6:1 -->

## Story 160245 · \[Wish for Happiness\] Eugeo Lv.50

Character Story

**Kirito:** This fridge is huge. But then  
again, this IS a major restaurant  
in Asuka Empire's capital city.

<!-- uid=160245:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** True. It makes sense they would  
have fish, veggies, meats, and  
lots of other ingredients on hand.

<!-- uid=160245:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** With this much to choose from,  
I think I could make pretty much  
any kind of zoni there is...

different varieties.

differ from region to region, the  
way they make the stock can be

<!-- uid=160245:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** completely different, and

<!-- uid=160245:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oho, looks like your chef spirit  
is fired up something fierce.

<!-- uid=160245:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** I think this'll be a real treat,  
Alice and Eugeo.

<!-- uid=160245:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe. Just give me a few minutes.

<!-- uid=160245:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Here you go!

<!-- uid=160245:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** This is Kanto-style zoni. I started  
with bonito flakes and kelp stock  
and added chicken and root veggies.

<!-- uid=160245:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ooh, it looks great.

<!-- uid=160245:17:1 -->

**Alice:** Thank you for this meal.

<!-- uid=160245:18:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I can't wait to try it.

<!-- uid=160245:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Be careful, you two.  
It's hot.

<!-- uid=160245:20:1 -->

**Alice:** Hoo, hoo...  
...!  
The mochi... It's...!

<!-- uid=160245:21:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I-It's stretching?!

<!-- uid=160245:22:1 -->

Character Story

## Story 160265 · \[Figureless Identity\] Joker Lv.50

## Story 240037 · \[MHCP-002\] Strea Lv.70

Character Story

**Leafa:** Hey, Strea.

**Strea:** Hm? Yes, Auntie?

**Leafa:** Auntie?!

**Strea:** So I just thought,  
as Kirito's daughter,  
I should call you "auntie."

**Leafa:** I-I'm way too young to be an aunt!

<!-- uid=240037:6:1 -->

**Strea:** That's why we weren't affected the

<!-- uid=240037:16:1 -->

**Strea:** To Cardinal's automatic

different entities.

okay, Leafa?

<!-- uid=240037:20:1 -->

**Leafa:** U-Uh, okay.

<!-- uid=240037:21:1 -->

## Story 240045 · \[Multi-Wielder\] Rain Lv.50

## Story 240047 · \[Multi-Wielder\] Rain Lv.70

Character Story

**Rain:** Hi, Kirito... Hi, Liz...

<!-- uid=240047:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hi, Rain...

<!-- uid=240047:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Rain...

<!-- uid=240047:3:1 -->

**Liz:** Um, Rain... About before...

<!-- uid=240047:4:1 -->

**Rain:** I-I'm sorry, about before!  
I should have answered  
your question...

<!-- uid=240047:5:1 -->

**Liz:** Y-You didn't do anything wrong!  
It was my fault for being so nosy!

<!-- uid=240047:6:1 -->

**Rain:** Th-That's not true!

<!-- uid=240047:7:1 -->

**Liz:** No, really! I was wrong!

<!-- uid=240047:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Come on, you two.  
You're getting stuck in a loop.

<!-- uid=240047:9:1 -->

**Rain:** Ah... Yeah...

<!-- uid=240047:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** I think that's enough apologizing  
for one day.

<!-- uid=240047:11:1 -->

**Liz:** You know, I...  
I've never made friends with  
other Leprechauns before...

<!-- uid=240047:12:1 -->

**Liz:** I was so happy when we got to be  
friends, Rain, so...

<!-- uid=240047:13:1 -->

**Liz:** So that's why I wanted to get to  
know you better...b-by asking  
those things...

<!-- uid=240047:14:1 -->

**Liz:** I'm sorry.

<!-- uid=240047:15:1 -->

**Rain:** Actually, I was happy you asked.  
I could tell you were really  
interested in what I had to say.

<!-- uid=240047:16:1 -->

**Rain:** So that's why I want to tell you  
what happened in SAO.

<!-- uid=240047:17:1 -->

**Liz:** Rain...

<!-- uid=240047:18:1 -->

**Rain:** I have a master. A master who  
taught me how to smith, how to  
fight... A master who's an NPC.

<!-- uid=240047:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** An NPC?

<!-- uid=240047:20:1 -->

**Rain:** Yeah. But not just any NPC.  
One with AI, one capable of  
complex thought.

<!-- uid=240047:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** AI, huh? I see...

<!-- uid=240047:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** I guess there were other NPCs in  
Aincrad besides Yui who had AI.

<!-- uid=240047:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah...

<!-- uid=240047:24:1 -->

**Rain:** My master lived a hermit's life  
in the mountains,

<!-- uid=240047:25:1 -->

**Rain:** tempering both metal  
and her own body.

<!-- uid=240047:26:1 -->

**Rain:** I roamed all over, trying to  
escape that death game. That's  
how I came to the mountains.

<!-- uid=240047:27:1 -->

**Rain:** That's where I met her and  
where I became her student.

<!-- uid=240047:28:1 -->

**Rain:** My master was about my mother's  
age. She eschewed others and  
lived a life of isolation.

<!-- uid=240047:29:1 -->

**Rain:** I spent the better part of two  
years learning to fight and to  
forge in those mountains.

<!-- uid=240047:30:1 -->

**Kirito:** But would just training like that  
get your level and your skills  
as high as they are?

<!-- uid=240047:31:1 -->

**Rain:** Well, my master's home was  
an instance map,

<!-- uid=240047:32:1 -->

**Rain:** and I got a bonus from  
studying under her.

<!-- uid=240047:33:1 -->

**Rain:** That's how I got so  
much more EXP, even though  
I was fighting weak monsters.

<!-- uid=240047:34:1 -->

**Kirito:** So it was just that bonus  
that helped you get stronger?

<!-- uid=240047:35:1 -->

**Rain:** It was. I gained lots of EXP and  
materials from going out to  
hunt mobs.

<!-- uid=240047:36:1 -->

**Rain:** Once I'd trained enough under my  
master, she kicked us out.

<!-- uid=240047:37:1 -->

**Rain:** Then me and the others-oh, uh,  
by "others," I mean her other NPC  
disciples...

<!-- uid=240047:38:1 -->

**Rain:** Well, we all went down to the  
lower floors and joined parties  
with other players.

<!-- uid=240047:39:1 -->

**Liz:** So that's what happened...

<!-- uid=240047:40:1 -->

**Asuna:** If you didn't join up with  
the Assault Team to fight  
the tough floor bosses and

<!-- uid=240047:41:1 -->

**Asuna:** gain EXP that way, you wouldn't  
have been able to level very  
efficiently, right?

<!-- uid=240047:42:1 -->

**Rain:** Right. And that's how I was going  
to get strong...or so I thought.

<!-- uid=240047:43:1 -->

**Rain:** I was still scared, still didn't  
believe in myself.

<!-- uid=240047:44:1 -->

**Rain:** But I figured I was at least able  
to help the Assault Team...

<!-- uid=240047:45:1 -->

**Rain:** Then an incident...or rather an  
event happened.

<!-- uid=240047:46:1 -->

**Kirito:** What kind of event?

<!-- uid=240047:47:1 -->


## Story 240048 · \[Multi-Wielder\] Rain Lv.80

Character Story

**Rain:** The illness that killed my master.

<!-- uid=240048:1:1 -->

**Liz:** She got sick?

<!-- uid=240048:2:1 -->

**Rain:** It's more accurate to say she'd  
always been sick.

<!-- uid=240048:3:1 -->

**Rain:** It seems that scenario was due to  
play out once her disciples  
reached a certain level.

<!-- uid=240048:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** So that scenario got triggered...

<!-- uid=240048:5:1 -->

**Rain:** Yeah... I was heartbroken, even  
though I knew she was just an NPC.

<!-- uid=240048:6:1 -->

**Rain:** I knew in my head that it was just  
the programmed scenario, but...  
I was still overcome with grief.

<!-- uid=240048:7:1 -->

**Rain:** I went into mourning...

<!-- uid=240048:8:1 -->

**Rain:** I don't really remember  
how long I spent just crying  
in my master's home.

<!-- uid=240048:9:1 -->

**Rain:** That's when I heard the  
announcement that SAO  
had been beaten.

<!-- uid=240048:10:1 -->

**Rain:** So...that's how I spent my time  
in SAO.

<!-- uid=240048:11:1 -->

**Rain:** Heh, it's kind of embarrassing  
to talk about.

<!-- uid=240048:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm glad you told us.  
You're glad too, right, Liz?

<!-- uid=240048:13:1 -->

**Liz:** O-Of course I am...  
Um, then...you went back  
to your real life afterwards?

<!-- uid=240048:14:1 -->

**Rain:** Yeah. After rehab, my life  
was like it had been before,  
like I'd never even played.

<!-- uid=240048:15:1 -->

**Rain:** Then I started slowly remembering  
about my master...

<!-- uid=240048:16:1 -->

**Rain:** I thought I couldn't keep going  
like that, so I got a job and  
started singing...

<!-- uid=240048:17:1 -->

**Rain:** This time, I wanted to be strong.

<!-- uid=240048:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** Because you wanted to help  
Seven, right?

<!-- uid=240048:19:1 -->

**Rain:** Hahaha, it wasn't that big of  
a deal...

<!-- uid=240048:20:1 -->

**Liz:** You know, Rain... Your master  
lives on in your avatar.

<!-- uid=240048:21:1 -->

**Liz:** You carry that strength she gave  
you even now here in ALO.

<!-- uid=240048:22:1 -->

**Rain:** Liz... I... Thank you...  
Thank you... \*sniff\*

<!-- uid=240048:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** Rain...

<!-- uid=240048:24:1 -->

**Rain:** Ehehe, here I go crying again...  
My master would scold me if  
she saw...

<!-- uid=240048:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, I bet she would.

<!-- uid=240048:26:1 -->

**Asuna:** Then why don't you come with us?  
We can all get stronger together,  
so your master won't scold you.

<!-- uid=240048:27:1 -->

**Rain:** Yeah. Spasiba.

<!-- uid=240048:28:1 -->

## Story 240125 · \[Happy Memories\] Sachi Lv.50

Character Story

**Kirito:** A long time ago, I joined a guild  
in SAO and lost people very  
special to me. Remember?

<!-- uid=240125:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** I do.

<!-- uid=240125:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** The Christmas after it happened,  
I went in search of a special  
monster.

<!-- uid=240125:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** I wanted to see if defeating it  
would really let me bring a dead  
player back to life...

<!-- uid=240125:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Was that even possible?

<!-- uid=240125:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** There was a rumor that this boss  
dropped an item that could revive  
a player.

<!-- uid=240125:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** I never heard about that...  
So...what happened?

<!-- uid=240125:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** I found the revival item...and  
learned it only worked on someone  
dead for less than ten seconds.

<!-- uid=240125:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** I guess...ten seconds is how long  
it took for the NerveGear to fry  
your brain after your avatar died.

<!-- uid=240125:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...

<!-- uid=240125:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** That Hollow Anima monster... maybe  
it was coincidence its name was so  
similar to the Hollow Area.

<!-- uid=240125:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** But ALO shares the same core  
system as SAO.

<!-- uid=240125:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** So I'm having trouble accepting  
it... It can't just be pure  
coincidence...

<!-- uid=240125:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** And if...if SAO's Hollow Data  
is here...

<!-- uid=240125:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Maybe the people I couldn't save  
are here somewhere too...

<!-- uid=240125:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Maybe I can see them again...  
Or at least, I get that feeling.

<!-- uid=240125:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** So that's what was bothering you.

<!-- uid=240125:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito...  
Do you still want to see them?

<!-- uid=240125:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** I don't know...

<!-- uid=240125:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** I thought I had moved on.  
I thought I could forget them...

<!-- uid=240125:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** But there's still a part of me  
that wants to find them again,  
to talk with them...

<!-- uid=240125:21:1 -->


## Story 240127 · \[Happy Memories\] Sachi Lv.70

Character Story

**Kirito:** The Moonlit Black Cats... One of  
them...left me a message.

<!-- uid=240127:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** She said that...that I was like  
Santa from that song about the  
red-nosed reindeer...

<!-- uid=240127:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** That I was a warm and caring  
person who encouraged her to try  
harder...

<!-- uid=240127:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Every time I remember what she  
said...all I can think of is how I  
failed to protect her...

<!-- uid=240127:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** How worthless I am... How I have  
no right to protect anyone...

<!-- uid=240127:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito...

<!-- uid=240127:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha... After that I locked myself  
in my room in town for days...

<!-- uid=240127:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** But Kirito...

<!-- uid=240127:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah...?

<!-- uid=240127:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** You cried, you suffered, and you  
moved on. You continued to live  
your life.

<!-- uid=240127:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** I... Yeah, I guess I did.

<!-- uid=240127:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** I remember that, you know? When  
you came back to the Assault  
Team...

<!-- uid=240127:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** You seemed lost, and there was an  
incredible sadness in your eyes.  
But you fought harder than ever.

<!-- uid=240127:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Asuna...

<!-- uid=240127:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** After what you just told me,  
I think I finally understand why  
you were able to move on.

<!-- uid=240127:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** It was what she said to you that  
broke you out of your shell,  
wasn't it?

<!-- uid=240127:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Umm... You mean the Santa thing?

<!-- uid=240127:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah. You decided that even if you  
couldn't be the person she thought  
you were now...

<!-- uid=240127:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** You'd keep fighting so that one  
day you could be that sort of  
person to others in need.

<!-- uid=240127:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=240127:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Umm... Sorry. I kinda got preachy  
there.

<!-- uid=240127:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Asuna... Thank you. Honestly,  
I can't remember much from when  
I locked myself away anymore...

<!-- uid=240127:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** But maybe it was her words that  
helped me get back on my feet and  
move on...

<!-- uid=240127:23:1 -->

## Story 240143 · \[Unfulfilled Wish\] Leafa Lv.30

Character Story

## Story 240148 · \[Unfulfilled Wish\] Leafa Lv.80

**Monster:** Graaaaaaah!

## Story 240181 · \[Void Runner\] Leafa Lv.10

Character Story

**Leafa:** Hey, Kazuto! Looks like there's a  
Japanese castle in ALO

<!-- uid=240181:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** that was created for the second  
part of the collab with that  
Japanese-themed game.

<!-- uid=240181:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah? That doesn't fit in with  
ALO's theme at all... Though it's  
not the first time that happened.

<!-- uid=240181:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** Ahaha, yeah, you're right.

<!-- uid=240181:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** There's a new quest to go along  
with the castle too. You have to  
sneak inside it.

<!-- uid=240181:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** Wanna give it a try?

<!-- uid=240181:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** What? So we have to sneak in and  
defeat an evil lord or something?

<!-- uid=240181:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** Nope, not defeat him. He stole  
some treasure and hid it inside,

<!-- uid=240181:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** so we have to sneak in and steal  
it back.

<!-- uid=240181:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ah, okay. Then we aren't  
supposed to attack the lord?

<!-- uid=240181:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** Well, it doesn't specifically say  
that we CAN'T...

<!-- uid=240181:11:1 -->

**Leafa:** Why? Do you want to do a no-kill  
run?

<!-- uid=240181:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm more interested in that part  
than exploring a castle, really.

<!-- uid=240181:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Alright, let's give it a shot.

<!-- uid=240181:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yay! Thank you!

<!-- uid=240181:15:1 -->

## Story 240185 · \[Void Runner\] Leafa Lv.50

Character Story

**Leafa:** That was close...

<!-- uid=240387:22:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...!

## Story 240391 · \[All Aboard\] Yui Lv.10

## Story 240393 · \[All Aboard\] Yui Lv.30

Character Story

**Kirito:** Alright, conversion is complete!

<!-- uid=240393:1:1 -->

**Yui:** ...

<!-- uid=240393:2:1 -->

has dealt me.

text...

<!-- uid=240393:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Uh... You're a navigator sent

**Kirito:** You may be a child, but you have  
a wealth of knowledge on Unital  
for assisting the Adapts.

<!-- uid=240393:16:1 -->

much different than what it is  
in ALO.

**Kirito:** Yui. Could you walk a little

<!-- uid=240393:22:1 -->

**Yui:** Like this?

<!-- uid=240393:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** Good. Now, jog a little.

<!-- uid=240393:24:1 -->

**Yui:** L-Like this?

<!-- uid=240393:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** Now jump as high as you can.

**Yui:** O-Okay! Yah!

<!-- uid=240393:27:1 -->

**Yui:** Like this...?

<!-- uid=240393:28:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...Man. You've only got the  
physical abilities of the  
average kid...

<!-- uid=240393:29:1 -->

**Yui:** Huh? What's wrong with that?

<!-- uid=240393:30:1 -->

**Kirito:** In the real world, children and  
adults have considerably different  
physical capabilities.

<!-- uid=240393:31:1 -->

**Kirito:** The enemies in OS are balanced  
around the average adult's  
athletic ability.

<!-- uid=240393:32:1 -->

**Kirito:** So, it's going to be impossible  
for you to fight effectively in  
battle...

<!-- uid=240393:33:1 -->

**Yui:** Oh...

<!-- uid=240393:34:1 -->


## Story 240395 · \[All Aboard\] Yui Lv.50

## Story 240191 · \[Golden Knight\] Alice Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** Well, Alice, Eugeo...  
This is the land of Alfheim.

<!-- uid=240191:1:1 -->

**Alice:** So this...is the surface?

<!-- uid=240191:2:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Wow...  
It's really just like  
you guys said!

<!-- uid=240191:3:1 -->

**Alice:** I can hardly believe it... There  
was a whole world all the way up  
here above our own...

<!-- uid=240191:4:1 -->

**Amayori:** Grroouuh!

<!-- uid=240191:5:1 -->

**Alice:** What is it, Amayori?  
Whoa!

<!-- uid=240191:6:1 -->

**Alice:** All those people...  
They're floating in the air!

<!-- uid=240191:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh! Those are fairies.  
Well, technically, everyone living  
in this world is a fairy.

<!-- uid=240191:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** There are nine different races of  
fairies, and they each have their  
own region.

<!-- uid=240191:9:1 -->

**Alice:** Can all fairies fly like that?

<!-- uid=240191:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah.

<!-- uid=240191:11:1 -->

**Eugeo:** You use those wings  
on your back to fly, right?

<!-- uid=240191:12:1 -->

**Eugeo:** It's amazing...  
All this time I thought fairies  
only existed in children's stories.

<!-- uid=240191:13:1 -->

**Eugeo:** There's nothing like this in the  
world I come from... At least,  
I don't think so.

<!-- uid=240191:14:1 -->

**Alice:** Of course not. In our world, there  
are only humans and the Forces  
of Darkness.

<!-- uid=240191:15:1 -->

**Alice:** Well... That's assuming you and  
I even come from the same world.

<!-- uid=240191:16:1 -->

**Sinon:** What do you mean?

<!-- uid=240191:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Those two are both Integrity Knights,  
but that doesn't necessarily mean they're  
from the same world.

<!-- uid=240191:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** After all, Alice said she's  
never met Eugeo before.  
Which could mean...

<!-- uid=240191:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** They could be from dimensions  
with slightly different parameters...  
Parallel universes, in other words.

<!-- uid=240191:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** Ah, that makes sense.

<!-- uid=240191:21:1 -->

**Alice:** That enormous fortress  
hanging in the sky...

<!-- uid=240191:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's the floating castle Aincrad.  
Our home is up there.

<!-- uid=240191:23:1 -->

**Alice:** You live in a place like that?

<!-- uid=240191:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yep! You'll see it yourself when  
you and Eugeo come to  
stay with us.

<!-- uid=240191:25:1 -->

**Alice:** Much as I appreciate your kindness,  
I don't intend on spending the  
time to get to know you.

<!-- uid=240191:26:1 -->

**Alice:** I'm afraid your hospitality won't  
be necessary.

<!-- uid=240191:27:1 -->

**Kirito:** H-Hey, wait!

<!-- uid=240191:28:1 -->

**Kirito:** But... Erm... Do you really think that's  
a good idea? There are so many things  
you don't know about this world...

<!-- uid=240191:29:1 -->

**Alice:** I can take care of myself.

<!-- uid=240191:30:1 -->

**Kirito:** B-But you'll need our help to find  
the other Divine Objects, right?

<!-- uid=240191:31:1 -->

**Alice:** I can search for them myself.

<!-- uid=240191:32:1 -->

**Kirito:** But, um... Er, the thing is...  
I got it!

<!-- uid=240191:33:1 -->

**Kirito:** A friend of ours here has a little  
dragon! She'll know all about  
what you can feed yours.

<!-- uid=240191:34:1 -->

**Kirito:** It'll just take a second to  
prepare something... Don't  
you want to try it out?

<!-- uid=240191:35:1 -->

**Alice:** ...

<!-- uid=240191:36:1 -->

**Amayori:** Ggrruu!

<!-- uid=240191:37:1 -->

**Kirito:** H-Hey. Doesn't she look hungry?

<!-- uid=240191:38:1 -->

**Alice:** Very well, then...  
I suppose Amayori could  
do with a rest.

<!-- uid=240191:39:1 -->

**Kirito:** Phew... Good.  
In that case...

<!-- uid=240191:40:1 -->

**Kirito:** So if you two are gonna be in  
this world for a while, why not  
use our house as a base?

<!-- uid=240191:41:1 -->

**Eugeo:** But how are we supposed to  
get up somewhere that high?

<!-- uid=240191:42:1 -->

**Kirito:** What'd we tell you?  
We're all fairies here...  
We fly up there.

<!-- uid=240191:43:1 -->

**Alice:** I guess I could travel up  
there on Amayori...

<!-- uid=240191:44:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I see. In that case, could you  
give me a lift up there?

<!-- uid=240191:45:1 -->

**Alice:** Doesn't look like I really  
have a choice...

<!-- uid=240191:46:1 -->


## Story 240193 · \[Golden Knight\] Alice Lv.30

Character Story

**Sinon:** Hey, Kirito...  
How are those two doing?

<!-- uid=240193:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** They're taking it easy  
at our place for now.

<!-- uid=240193:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** They must've been exhausted.

to relax and take stock of things.

<!-- uid=240193:3:1 -->

<!-- uid=240193:4:1 -->

you're fighting in one fierce

catch up on some rest.

<!-- uid=240193:6:2 -->

**Leafa:** I'm not so sure about that.

<!-- uid=240193:9:1 -->

share information on her.

<!-- uid=240193:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** That...doesn't sound good.

<!-- uid=240193:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Once word spreads that there  
are super-strong mystery players

<!-- uid=240193:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** those two are sure to build up  
a following here. Whether they  
like it or not...

think they'll be found as long  
as they stay indoors.

<!-- uid=240193:15:1 -->

Objects as soon as possible...

**Kirito:** I mentioned this to Asuna before,  
but we've just met a couple of people  
from another world and timeline.

<!-- uid=240193:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's the understanding we're  
going with, anyway.

<!-- uid=240193:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** So until they return to their  
world, all we can do is try  
to help them.

<!-- uid=240193:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah...

<!-- uid=240193:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** There is one other thing I want

<!-- uid=240193:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Let's not use game terminology or

<!-- uid=240193:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Whatever world Alice and Eugeo  
come from, it seems like they don't  
understand those kinds of words.

<!-- uid=240193:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** Instead of making them  
uncomfortable all the time,  
let's just try to avoid it.

<!-- uid=240193:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** Okay. Got it.

<!-- uid=240193:25:1 -->

## Story 240198 · \[Golden Knight\] Alice Lv.80

Character Story

**Kirito:** Phew...

<!-- uid=240198:1:1 -->

<!-- uid=240198:6:1 -->

<!-- uid=240198:9:1 -->

**Alice:** There are just too many things

<!-- uid=240198:10:1 -->

**Alice:** And at this rate, I'll never achieve

<!-- uid=240198:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=240198:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm sorry. We only wanted to

<!-- uid=240198:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** But it looks like that just  
left you and Eugeo even more  
confused.

<!-- uid=240198:14:1 -->

**Alice:** ...

<!-- uid=240198:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Okay...  
I'll explain everything.

<!-- uid=240198:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...and that about covers it.

version of it.

<!-- uid=240198:17:1 -->

it boils down to this:

<!-- uid=240198:18:1 -->

**Alice:** All people in this world  
are bound by certain rules.

<!-- uid=240198:19:1 -->

**Alice:** One is that you must periodically  
leave this world.

<!-- uid=240198:20:1 -->

**Alice:** You are chosen to receive missions  
from the gods, which you call  
"quests."

<!-- uid=240198:21:1 -->

**Alice:** You build bonds of camaraderie  
through joining "guilds" and  
adding "friends."

<!-- uid=240198:22:1 -->

**Alice:** It is not possible to fight  
within areas you call  
"safe zones."

<!-- uid=240198:23:1 -->

**Alice:** And lastly...

<!-- uid=240198:24:1 -->

**Alice:** As the gods are able to restore  
the lives of those who perish  
in this world...

<!-- uid=240198:25:1 -->

**Alice:** They command that you spend  
your lives half in duty and  
half in play.

<!-- uid=240198:26:1 -->

**Alice:** That must be why those gawkers  
from earlier were so foolhardy.

<!-- uid=240198:27:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's it.  
So do you believe me?

<!-- uid=240198:28:1 -->

**Alice:** Yes. I can understand it if  
I think of it in terms of  
our world's Taboo Index.

<!-- uid=240198:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** T-Taboo Index...? Uh...yeah.

<!-- uid=240198:30:1 -->

**Alice:** Ever since I set foot in this  
world, I've been bewildered  
by everything.

<!-- uid=240198:31:1 -->

telling the truth, I'll never be  
able to find the Divine Objects.

<!-- uid=240198:32:1 -->

**Kirito:** Alice...

<!-- uid=240198:33:1 -->

**Kirito:** A-And if there's anything you

ask me!

<!-- uid=240198:34:1 -->

**Kirito:** We're here for you and Eugeo...

<!-- uid=240198:35:1 -->

**Alice:** ...How many times do I need

<!-- uid=240198:36:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...?

<!-- uid=240198:37:1 -->

mind. Understood?

<!-- uid=240198:39:1 -->

## Story 250053 · \[Pumpkin Knight\] Alice Lv.30

Character Story

**Asuna:** Halloween is a sort of holiday  
that happens around this time  
every year.

<!-- uid=250053:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** I read that it was originally a  
harvest festival where people  
thanked the gods for their crops.

<!-- uid=250053:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Nowadays, the history is mostly  
ignored and people just dress up  
as monsters and have fun.

<!-- uid=250053:3:1 -->

**Alice:** Interesting. So it is an ancient  
and revered tradition among  
your people.

<!-- uid=250053:4:1 -->

**Alice:** Perhaps the appearance of this  
demonic castle has something to do  
with your Halloween tradition?

<!-- uid=250053:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** H-Hey, maybe it does? Ha ha...

<!-- uid=250053:6:1 -->

**Alice:** However, I still don't see the  
connection between donning the  
guise of monsters and the harvest.

<!-- uid=250053:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Good question! Apparently, it has  
to do with winter.

<!-- uid=250053:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Long ago, people thought that  
evil spirits appeared with the  
coming of the cold weather.

<!-- uid=250053:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** So I guess it's something we've  
inherited from our ancestors'  
superstitions.

<!-- uid=250053:10:1 -->

**Alice:** And now these ancient tales have  
been proven true by the Dread  
Bastion's appearance.

<!-- uid=250053:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, uh... Ha ha.  
Yeah, I guess they have.

<!-- uid=250053:12:1 -->

**Alice:** Wait...

<!-- uid=250053:13:1 -->

**Alice:** How strange...

<!-- uid=250053:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Strange? What is?

<!-- uid=250053:15:1 -->

**Alice:** I am an Integrity Knight, sworn to  
battle the Forces of Darkness.  
My life is war.

<!-- uid=250053:16:1 -->

**Alice:** I have never known what life is  
like for the common folk, nor have  
I ever cared to learn...

<!-- uid=250053:17:1 -->

**Alice:** And yet, this talk of harvest  
festivals and old traditions...  
It tugs at something within me...

<!-- uid=250053:18:1 -->

**Alice:** I find it all strangely...  
familiar.

<!-- uid=250053:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Alice...

<!-- uid=250053:20:1 -->

## Story 250057 · \[Pumpkin Knight\] Alice Lv.70

Character Story

**Alice:** You're right. It is unlike me.

## Story 250103 · \[Ring the Bell\] Alice Lv.30

Character Story

**Alice:** Is everything all right, child?

my blade.

## Story 250111 · \[Gorgeous Priestess Costume\] Suguha Lv.10

Character Story

**Suguha:** What should I do...?

<!-- uid=250111:1:1 -->

**Kazuto:** What's wrong?

<!-- uid=250111:2:1 -->

**Suguha:** My school's got a bunch of  
different work-study classes  
on offer...

<!-- uid=250111:3:1 -->

**Suguha:** But I can't decide on one.

<!-- uid=250111:4:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Oh yeah? What are your options?

<!-- uid=250111:5:1 -->

**Suguha:** Well, this time around they're all  
jobs that are deeply tied to their  
location.

<!-- uid=250111:6:1 -->

**Suguha:** So the options are things like  
tour guide, store manager, and  
assistant at a shrine or temple.

<!-- uid=250111:7:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Ah yeah, tourism would be big in  
Kawagoe. It does have the nickname  
Little Edo, after all.

<!-- uid=250111:8:1 -->

**Suguha:** Yeah, I know. Which one sounds  
like the most fun?

<!-- uid=250111:9:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Why don't you just pick the  
easiest one?

<!-- uid=250111:10:1 -->

**Suguha:** Did you even hear what I was  
asking myself? Easy doesn't always  
equal fun, y'know!

<!-- uid=250111:11:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I was just trying to help!  
Geez...

<!-- uid=250111:12:1 -->

**Suguha:** If this were VR or something else  
you were super into, you'd be full  
of ideas. But noooo!

<!-- uid=250111:13:1 -->

**Suguha:** This has nothing to do with you,  
so you're barely paying attention!

<!-- uid=250111:14:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Okay, okay, I'm sorry.  
You're right. Why don't  
you ask someone else?

<!-- uid=250111:15:1 -->

**Kazuto:** You've got a lot of older friends  
you could talk to, don't you?

<!-- uid=250111:16:1 -->

**Suguha:** Oh yeah, you're right!

<!-- uid=250111:17:1 -->

**Suguha:** That's the first good idea you've  
had all day!

<!-- uid=250111:18:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Gee, thanks...

<!-- uid=250111:19:1 -->


## Story 250113 · \[Gorgeous Priestess Costume\] Suguha Lv.30

Character Story

**Shino:** A work-study program, eh?

<!-- uid=250113:1:1 -->

**Suguha:** Yeah, and Kazuto was actually  
making it harder to decide.

<!-- uid=250113:2:1 -->

**Shino:** So that's why you came to me?

<!-- uid=250113:3:1 -->

**Suguha:** Exactly! I wanted to get the  
opinion of someone far older  
and wiser than myself!

<!-- uid=250113:4:1 -->

**Shino:** I-I'm not that much older than  
you...

<!-- uid=250113:5:1 -->

**Suguha:** Besides, I've heard you have like  
a million part-time jobs, so I  
figured you'd have some pointers.

<!-- uid=250113:6:1 -->

**Shino:** Well, I don't work all those jobs  
because I want to... Here, let me  
see that list.

<!-- uid=250113:7:1 -->

**Shino:** Okay, let's talk about this one.

<!-- uid=250113:8:1 -->

**Suguha:** Helping out at a shrine, you mean?

<!-- uid=250113:9:1 -->

**Shino:** Yeah. It's the start of the new  
year, which is their busiest time.

<!-- uid=250113:10:1 -->

**Suguha:** You think they would've just said  
they couldn't take anyone on  
for a work-study program.

<!-- uid=250113:11:1 -->

**Shino:** Hey, now that you mention it,  
I think this shrine is hiring  
part-timers.

<!-- uid=250113:12:1 -->

**Shino:** Yeah, I'm pretty sure I saw their  
job listing in a magazine.

<!-- uid=250113:13:1 -->

**Shino:** I decided it was too far from  
my house, and it looked like  
hard work, to boot.

<!-- uid=250113:14:1 -->

**Suguha:** This is actually pretty close to  
my house. Wait, how about this?  
I'll choose this one...

<!-- uid=250113:15:1 -->

**Suguha:** And then you take their part-time  
job and start at the same time!

<!-- uid=250113:16:1 -->

**Shino:** Hmm... It'd be nice to work  
together, but it's so far away...

<!-- uid=250113:17:1 -->

**Suguha:** All the more reason for you to  
stay at my house! You know,  
when you have a shift!

<!-- uid=250113:18:1 -->

**Shino:** B-But won't Kazuto be there too?

<!-- uid=250113:19:1 -->

**Suguha:** Huh? Well, yeah...  
He's my brother.

<!-- uid=250113:20:1 -->

**Shino:** Ah, well, you know, schedules can  
be tough to coordinate, and I  
need to have an interview...

<!-- uid=250113:21:1 -->

**Suguha:** Right, the interview! If you pass,  
you should totally ask if it's  
okay for us to work together!

<!-- uid=250113:22:1 -->


## Story 250115 · \[Gorgeous Priestess Costume\] Suguha Lv.50

Character Story

**Suguha:** Your total is... Uhh...

<!-- uid=250115:1:1 -->

**Shino:** Suguha, be careful. That one is  
a different price.

<!-- uid=250115:2:1 -->

**Suguha:** You're right. I'm sorry!

<!-- uid=250115:3:1 -->

**Worshiper:** Are you finished?

<!-- uid=250115:4:1 -->

**Suguha:** Ah, so sorry! I'll just be a

<!-- uid=250115:5:1 -->

**Suguha:** Whew...

**Shino:** Nice work, Suguha.

**Shino:** Yeah. That was quite the sigh you

from way over there!

<!-- uid=250115:9:1 -->

**Suguha:** Ha ha, yeah, these winter nights  
get pretty cold.

<!-- uid=250115:10:1 -->

**Shino:** Here, have a sip of this.  
It'll get you warmed up.

<!-- uid=250115:11:1 -->

**Suguha:** Ooh, hot cocoa? Yes, please!

<!-- uid=250115:12:1 -->

**Shino:** You really should be more careful.

register takes getting used to.

<!-- uid=250115:13:1 -->

**Shino:** Just keep at it. It'll get easier.

**Suguha:** Yeah, I hope so...

**Suguha:** Hah! You haven't been around me

<!-- uid=250115:17:1 -->

**Suguha:** In my head, I know exactly what  
I'm doing and how to do it,

<!-- uid=250115:18:1 -->

**Suguha:** but when I'm actually standing in

<!-- uid=250115:19:1 -->

**Shino:** ...

<!-- uid=250115:20:1 -->


## Story 250117 · \[Gorgeous Priestess Costume\] Suguha Lv.70

Character Story

**Suguha:** I've never been so nervous in  
front of people before. Why now?

<!-- uid=250117:1:1 -->

**Shino:** It might actually be a good sign.  
Think about it.

<!-- uid=250117:2:1 -->

**Shino:** What's the philosophy in almost  
any job? The customer is always  
right.

<!-- uid=250117:3:1 -->

**Shino:** And now there's the added pressure  
of them telling us not to be shy  
because we serve a higher power.

<!-- uid=250117:4:1 -->

**Shino:** So when your customer is, in a  
sense, a literal deity, of course  
you're going to be nervous!

<!-- uid=250117:5:1 -->

**Suguha:** E-Exactly...!

<!-- uid=250117:6:1 -->

**Shino:** Though, top Sylph warrior or not,  
I guess you're still in middle  
school. This should be easy.

<!-- uid=250117:7:1 -->

**Shino:** Unless...

<!-- uid=250117:8:1 -->

**Suguha:** Unless what, Shino?

<!-- uid=250117:9:1 -->

**Shino:** This is the first job you've  
ever had, isn't it?

<!-- uid=250117:10:1 -->

**Suguha:** W-Well, yeah... I'm too young for  
a real job, and I've done stuff  
like this in ALO, but...

<!-- uid=250117:11:1 -->

**Suguha:** It was just me and a bunch of  
my Sylph friends playing around.

<!-- uid=250117:12:1 -->

**Shino:** Okay then. New strategy.  
Your customers are no longer  
godlike. They're opponents.

<!-- uid=250117:13:1 -->

**Suguha:** Say what?

<!-- uid=250117:14:1 -->

**Shino:** We're going to turn those nerves  
into the excitement you feel  
before a battle.

<!-- uid=250117:15:1 -->

**Shino:** Pretend you're trying to get the  
jump on your opponent. Except your  
opponent is the customer's needs.

<!-- uid=250117:16:1 -->

**Shino:** I know you're fast, so this should  
be second nature to you.

<!-- uid=250117:17:1 -->

**Suguha:** Yeah, maybe...

<!-- uid=250117:18:1 -->


## Story 250118 · \[Gorgeous Priestess Costume\] Suguha Lv.80

Character Story

**Suguha:** Two charms and a votive picture.  
That will be 2,500 yen.

<!-- uid=250118:1:1 -->

**Suguha:** Thank you for your patronage.

<!-- uid=250118:8:1 -->

thing.

**Suguha:** Ha ha, don't worry about that.

<!-- uid=250118:10:1 -->

**Suguha:** I always try to keep things fun,

## Story 250121 · \[The Bunny Ace\] Yuuki Lv.10

**Sinon:** That should be obvious, right?

**Yuuki:** I...guess? I also guess I'm the  
lucky one who gets to know  
who the joker really is!

<!-- uid=250121:16:1 -->

Kirito or Asuna to tell.

## Story 250355 · \[Zekken in the Wilderness\] Yuuki Lv.50

Character Story

**Strea:** Ahh, I see...

<!-- uid=250355:1:1 -->

**Strea:** Yuuki and Kirito might have

**Strea:** Yup!

<!-- uid=250355:5:1 -->

**Strea:** Okay! Yuuki, your reflexes are  
active, a result of your innate  
speed and agility.

<!-- uid=250355:6:1 -->

**Strea:** Whereas Kirito's speed is all  
based on reacting. In other words,  
he's good at reading an opponent.

<!-- uid=250355:7:1 -->

**Strea:** You both might be equally fast,  
but the reason why you're fast  
is fundamentally different.

<!-- uid=250355:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** I see...

<!-- uid=250355:9:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Does that mean it's impossible  
for me to chop bullets in half?

<!-- uid=250355:10:1 -->

**Strea:** I don't know if it's impossible,  
but I don't think the strategy  
fits you.

<!-- uid=250355:11:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Oh... Then what do I do?

<!-- uid=250355:12:1 -->

**Strea:** Hehe, why are you asking me?  
That's a question you have to  
ask yourself!

<!-- uid=250355:13:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hey, don't be like that!  
Tell me, tell me!

<!-- uid=250355:14:1 -->

**Strea:** I'm not trying to be mean.  
I just think it'll stick better  
if you figure it out yourself.

<!-- uid=250355:15:1 -->

**Strea:** Besides, it's not like I have the  
solution hidden up my sleeve.  
I don't know either.

<!-- uid=250355:16:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Oh... Sorry...

<!-- uid=250355:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** So, Yuuki.  
Figure anything out yet?

<!-- uid=250355:18:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Maybe!  
It's worth a shot, anyway!

<!-- uid=250355:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** If you need any backup,  
I'm happy to help!

<!-- uid=250355:20:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Thanks, Asuna! And you too, Strea!

<!-- uid=250355:21:1 -->

**Strea:** Have fun! I'll stop by later to  
see how you're doing.

<!-- uid=250355:22:1 -->

## Story 260023 · \[A Gale Blows Via Time & Space\] Leafa Lv.30

Character Story

here lately...

<!-- uid=260023:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hmm... You know, it doesn't look

<!-- uid=260023:12:1 -->

<!-- uid=260023:14:1 -->

**Sakuya:** They DO seem as though they've  
been cut by something sharp.

<!-- uid=260023:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Vacuum cuts...

<!-- uid=260023:16:1 -->

## Story 260101 · \[Brilliant Gift\] Yuuki Lv.10

Character Story

**Leafa:** Hey, Yuuki.

<!-- uid=260101:1:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hm? What's up, Leafa?

<!-- uid=260101:2:1 -->

<!-- uid=260101:3:1 -->

to anyway. Why do you ask?

<!-- uid=260101:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** There's a competition I was  
hoping we could enter together!

<!-- uid=260101:5:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Oh, okay...  
Hmm... What to do...

<!-- uid=260101:6:1 -->

**Leafa:** Huh? Did you already have plans?

<!-- uid=260101:7:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Not officially. I was just talking  
to Asuna and Silica about a new  
area they found,

<!-- uid=260101:8:1 -->

**Yuuki:** and I was thinking of joining  
them, is all.

<!-- uid=260101:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** I see...

<!-- uid=260101:10:1 -->

**Yuuki:** So what's this competition  
you wanted to take part in?

<!-- uid=260101:11:1 -->

**Leafa:** Well, it's a small-scale arena  
type thing with teams of two.

<!-- uid=260101:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** And the map and conditions and  
whatnot really favor AGI builds.

<!-- uid=260101:13:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Ah, now I get you. In other words,  
it's basically made for the  
Speedaholic and the Zekken.

<!-- uid=260101:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** Ugh, stop that.

<!-- uid=260101:15:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Ha ha, sorry. But, hmm, I really  
don't know what to do.

<!-- uid=260101:16:1 -->

**Yuuki:** We haven't been playing GGO all  
that long, but the AGI-focused  
style...

<!-- uid=260101:17:1 -->

**Yuuki:** ...we developed in ALO does  
work there pretty well.

<!-- uid=260101:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** Right?

<!-- uid=260101:19:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Okay, I've decided. I'll pass on  
Asuna and Silica's offer and join  
you in the competition.

<!-- uid=260101:20:1 -->

**Leafa:** Really?! Awesome, thanks!

<!-- uid=260101:21:1 -->

**Yuuki:** No problem. Now let's make sure  
we win this thing!

<!-- uid=260101:22:1 -->

## Story 260113 · \[Orderly Knight\] Alice Lv.30

Character Story

**Kirito:** It's called nanakusa-gayu.

spring herbs to rice porridge.

<!-- uid=260113:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Water dropwort, shepherd's purse,  
Jersey cudweed, chickweed,

**Kirito:** Are you kidding? Nobody could

<!-- uid=260113:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Maybe that way of thinking itself

<!-- uid=260113:14:1 -->

## Story 260115 · \[Orderly Knight\] Alice Lv.50

Character Story

**Sortiliena:** Kirito.

**Kirito:** I'm afraid I can't, actually.

<!-- uid=260115:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** but the reason it uses seven herbs

it on the seventh day of the year.

<!-- uid=260115:8:1 -->

<!-- uid=260115:9:1 -->

differences...

many different situations.

<!-- uid=260115:15:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** It is similar to my family's  
Serlut style. Or at least,  
that is what I thought...

the Serlut style, perhaps I still  
need to learn to make use of its...

<!-- uid=260115:17:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...flexibility and adaptability in  
all aspects of my life... much as  
you have done.

<!-- uid=260115:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Liena...?

<!-- uid=260115:19:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** But never mind that.  
I look forward to trying this  
herb rice porridge of yours.

<!-- uid=260115:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Thank you, Liena!

<!-- uid=260115:21:1 -->

## Story 260128 · \[Amaterasu the Sun Goddess\] Suguha Lv.80

## Story 260195 · \[One Summer's Memory\] Ronie Lv.50

Character Story

**Grand Chamberlain:** I come from a line of rural,  
ruined nobles... Fallen  
aristocrats, if you will.

<!-- uid=260195:1:1 -->

**Ronie:** A noble family...?

<!-- uid=260195:2:1 -->

**Grand Chamberlain:** Fearing for our livelihood, my  
mother wed a Centorian noble.

<!-- uid=260195:3:1 -->

**Grand Chamberlain:** Distant kin of the Serluts.  
...A branch of the family,  
you might say.

<!-- uid=260195:4:1 -->

**Tiese:** A branch of the family...

<!-- uid=260195:5:1 -->

**Grand Chamberlain:** Branch or not, the family's  
standing was immeasurably  
higher than ours...

<!-- uid=260195:6:1 -->

**Grand Chamberlain:** Born as a distant relative of the  
Serlut family,

<!-- uid=260195:7:1 -->

**Grand Chamberlain:** I came to serve as the head  
family's butler. As a protector  
of the Serlut family,

<!-- uid=260195:8:1 -->

**Grand Chamberlain:** I was told to learn this  
school of swordsmanship.

<!-- uid=260195:9:1 -->

**Ronie:** I see. You... said you were proud  
of the Serlut style.

<!-- uid=260195:10:1 -->

**Ronie:** Could that pride come from  
a place of love for your mother,

<!-- uid=260195:11:1 -->

**Ronie:** who joined the Serluts in order to  
defend the honor of her own line?

<!-- uid=260195:12:1 -->

**Grand Chamberlain:** Precisely. Though it may not  
have been my mother's truest wish  
to marry to preserve her line,

<!-- uid=260195:13:1 -->

**Grand Chamberlain:** her powerful will, not love, was  
what protected our domain.  
I feel only pride in that.

<!-- uid=260195:14:1 -->

now...?

<!-- uid=260195:15:1 -->

**Grand Chamberlain:** As I am the second son, my elder  
brother now protects the family.

<!-- uid=260195:16:1 -->

**Ronie:** I see...

<!-- uid=260195:17:1 -->

**Grand Chamberlain:** It appears as though you are both  
concerned about your own futures.

<!-- uid=260195:18:1 -->

**Tiese:** Oh, did you overhear us...?

<!-- uid=260195:19:1 -->

**Grand Chamberlain:** My apologies for listening in.

<!-- uid=260195:20:1 -->

**Grand Chamberlain:** But marriages between nobles can  
occur for a variety of reasons.

<!-- uid=260195:21:1 -->

**Grand Chamberlain:** It is true that some may live  
unhappy lives…

<!-- uid=260195:22:1 -->

**Grand Chamberlain:** But I hope that your paths are  
every bit as worthy of pride as  
my own mother's.

<!-- uid=260195:23:1 -->

**Grand Chamberlain:** I truly wish that from the  
bottom of my heart.

<!-- uid=260195:24:1 -->

**Ronie:** Mister Chamberlain...

<!-- uid=260195:25:1 -->

**Tiese:** Thank you...

<!-- uid=260195:26:1 -->

**Monster:** GRAAAAAHHHH!

<!-- uid=260273:7:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oww... That thing got me good.

<!-- uid=260273:8:1 -->

**Thokk:** I warned you before we started.  
Once it starts turning around  
more, it goes berserk.

<!-- uid=260273:9:1 -->

**Thokk:** That's why you have to deploy a  
smokescreen, to block its vision.

<!-- uid=260273:10:1 -->

**Makoto:** Sorry. It's just when you called  
out my name, I thought you wanted  
me to go and finish it off.

<!-- uid=260273:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** That's fair. It's not like I said  
anything more specific.

<!-- uid=260273:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** Times like this are why I'd really  
like to have that synchronization  
system in place between players.

<!-- uid=260273:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's a bit of mouthful to say,  
don't you think? Can't you come up  
with something a bit snappier?

<!-- uid=260273:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** Me? You're the one who called it  
synchronization! But alright.  
Do you have any ideas, then?

<!-- uid=260273:15:1 -->

**Makoto:** Um, well... What about calling it,  
like, the "Seeker System?"

<!-- uid=260273:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** Eh, that doesn't sound too  
great, either.

<!-- uid=260273:17:1 -->

**Makoto:** In any case, if you're going to  
implement a system like that, it  
needs to balanced, right?

<!-- uid=260273:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** It won't be much fun if only the  
players are strong. Will you make  
the enemies tough, too?

<!-- uid=260273:19:1 -->

**Thokk:** Obviously. I wouldn't have it any  
other way. Watching those fights  
gave me a lot of food for thought.

<!-- uid=260273:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** They made me realize I wanna  
make tough enemies be the main  
reason to keep playing my game.

<!-- uid=260273:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** They can't be beaten solo. You  
have to rely on your bond with  
your partner to take them down.

<!-- uid=260273:22:1 -->

**Thokk:** Right now, that's what I think  
is going to be the selling point  
for Nibelungen Purgatory's combat.

<!-- uid=260273:23:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hee hee, sounds like it's going  
to be awesome. I can't wait to  
try it for myself.

<!-- uid=260273:24:1 -->


## Story 260275 · \[Together For Eternity\] Yuuki Lv.50

Character Story

**Makoto:** ...That's the gist of her idea,  
basically.

<!-- uid=260275:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh. A synchronized combat system.  
Interesting...

<!-- uid=260275:2:1 -->

**Makoto:** Do you two have any ideas I could  
share with her? Oh, but we'll have  
to keep this conversation secret.

<!-- uid=260275:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** Like she said before, she doesn't  
want people going into the game  
with any prior knowledge about it.

<!-- uid=260275:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Right, I remember. Don't worry,  
I won't tell her you came to us.

<!-- uid=260275:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yep, our lips are sealed, hee hee.

<!-- uid=260275:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, a lot of games with concepts  
like that rely on something like  
an affinity stat.

<!-- uid=260275:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** And it'll go up the longer you're  
partied with someone, making, say,  
both of your attacks stronger.

<!-- uid=260275:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's pretty common practice to  
see in RPGs and stuff, at least.

<!-- uid=260275:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** But don't you think that's  
a pretty old-fashioned way to do  
it at this point?

<!-- uid=260275:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Plus, if you make it based on  
time, it won't have much use to  
players in the beginning stages.

<!-- uid=260275:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's a good point. It might be  
a bit too old school of an idea  
for a VRMMO nowadays.

<!-- uid=260275:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** I remember how my friends and  
I used to haul our handhelds out  
to play co-op games together.

<!-- uid=260275:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Or how we used to play traditional  
MMOs over voice chat. It was kind  
of the same idea.

<!-- uid=260275:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** But I guess when you get down to  
it, it's still just dishing out  
verbal orders to one another.

<!-- uid=260275:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah. I think Thokk wants to go  
for a system that works at a more  
emotional level.

<!-- uid=260275:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ohhh. Then even players who have just met can still be synchronized if they're compatible.

<!-- uid=260275:17:1 -->

**Makoto:** Ahaha, wow, you two know your  
stuff. I figured Kirito would, but  
I'm impressed you do, too, Asuna.

<!-- uid=260275:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, it's no big deal, really.  
To be honest, I haven't actually  
been gaming for all that long.

<!-- uid=260275:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** But I was surrounded by it  
because of my dad's company.  
My brother played often, too.

<!-- uid=260275:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** I never even used a VR device  
until I borrowed my brother's,  
so...

<!-- uid=260275:21:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh, I see. That's pretty neat.

<!-- uid=260275:22:1 -->


## Story 260277 · \[Together For Eternity\] Yuuki Lv.70

Character Story

**Kirito:** ...Actually, you know, I just  
remembered something else.

<!-- uid=260277:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** The Cardinal System has a way of  
deciphering players' general  
emotions, doesn't it?

<!-- uid=260277:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah! That's what allows our  
avatars to have different facial  
expressions in the first place.

<!-- uid=260277:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh wow, I had no idea that's how  
that all worked.

<!-- uid=260277:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** If you were tap into that system,  
you might be able to transmit to  
friends what you're planning.

<!-- uid=260277:5:1 -->

**Makoto:** Really? That's actually possible?

<!-- uid=260277:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** You can't get too detailed about  
it, but I think it might work for  
at least basic directions.

<!-- uid=260277:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** You could have your basic thought  
process show up on their screen  
and then work from there.

<!-- uid=260277:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wow, that's amazing it allows for  
so much!

<!-- uid=260277:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. What I'd do is track changes  
in expression, status, and even  
each player's line of sight.

<!-- uid=260277:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Because as it is, your character  
already visibly reflects a lot of  
what you do and and experience.

<!-- uid=260277:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** So if you make an AI that monitors  
all that and conveys those changes  
in text, you might get somewhere.

<!-- uid=260277:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** It won't be accurate all the time  
at first, but feed it more data  
and it should improve over time.

<!-- uid=260277:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Once you get used to it, I bet  
you'll be able to pull off some  
big feats with friends in battles.

<!-- uid=260277:14:1 -->

**Makoto:** Whoa, that sounds awesome! Do you  
mind if I share all of that with  
Thokk?

<!-- uid=260277:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Of course not. Go right ahead!

<!-- uid=260277:16:1 -->


## Story 260278 · \[Together For Eternity\] Yuuki Lv.80

Character Story

**Thokk:** Huh. So you're saying I should  
feed the Cardinal System's  
monitoring data to an AI...

<!-- uid=260278:1:1 -->

**Thokk:** And then use that data to transmit  
accurate player orders to their  
partner instantaneously. Hmm...

<!-- uid=260278:2:1 -->

**Thokk:** That should all be doable. I don't  
see any reason it can't work, at  
least in theory.

<!-- uid=260278:3:1 -->

that could really improve players'  
ability to coordinate moves.

<!-- uid=260278:4:1 -->

**Makoto:** Pretty good idea once you think  
about it, right?

<!-- uid=260278:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** It really is, but how did you ever  
come up with it? You're not tech  
savvy like that, Makoto.

<!-- uid=260278:6:1 -->

**Makoto:** Ahaha, that's because I didn't.  
I asked Kirito and Asuna for their  
opinions on what might work.

<!-- uid=260278:7:1 -->

**Thokk:** Ah, I should've known. Their ideas  
are always a cut above the rest.

<!-- uid=260278:8:1 -->

you should maybe let them join  
the development team?

that!

<!-- uid=260278:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** They're exactly the kind of  
players I want to go into it fresh  
and unaware of what's in store!

<!-- uid=260278:11:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hee hee, now you're talking.  
I always like seeing you get all  
fired up like that. It's cute!

<!-- uid=260278:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** Anyway, thanks. I appreciate the  
suggestion. I'll see what I can  
do with it!

<!-- uid=260278:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** Glad to hear I could help.  
Good luck with your work!

<!-- uid=260278:14:1 -->

transform into a weird and  
creepy world!

<!-- uid=260323:12:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...You know, Kirito, I always

beat you... Everyone loved you...

Alice might be no exception...

<!-- uid=260323:14:1 -->

**Eugeo:** But now, I finally understand.

<!-- uid=260323:15:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Alice taught me that...

**Alice:** You stopped again, Kirito.

<!-- uid=260323:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** You're one to talk, Alice. You

at that family of cotton rabbits.

<!-- uid=260323:19:1 -->

**Alice:** Look, I'm almost done.

<!-- uid=260323:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey, uh... I think we should head

**Alice:** We're still okay. Let's keep at it  
just a little more, alright?

<!-- uid=260323:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** Okay, fine. But just a little.

<!-- uid=260323:25:1 -->

## Story 260327 · \[Grand Blossoming\] Alice Lv.70

## Story 260333 · \[Wandering Integrity Knight\] Alice Lv.30

Character Story

**Alice:** Er, Selka, about that shopping

**Selka:** It's fine, sis. I shouldn't have  
bothered you about it.

<!-- uid=260333:2:1 -->

**Alice:** I see...

**Selka:** Huh? What's wrong?

<!-- uid=260333:5:1 -->

**Alice:** Uh, it's... nothing. Really.

<!-- uid=260333:6:1 -->

Is there something you want

**Alice:** As long as you buy me the  
materials, I can build it myself.  
But...

**Selka:** Would I even know what  
to get without you there?

<!-- uid=260333:11:1 -->

**Alice:** Huh?

<!-- uid=260333:14:1 -->

**Selka:** Oh, it's not like I'm trying to

all the time. I'm sure you could  
use a break, right?

<!-- uid=260333:16:1 -->

**Alice:** But I mustn't leave Kirito al--

<!-- uid=260333:17:1 -->

**Selka:** Don't worry. I'd look after him  
while you're gone.

<!-- uid=260333:18:1 -->

**Selka:** It's just the next town over.  
I'm sure with that dragon,  
it's an even shorter trip.

<!-- uid=260333:19:1 -->

**Alice:** Yes, but...

<!-- uid=260333:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ah...

<!-- uid=260333:21:1 -->

**Selka:** Did you hear that? Even Kirito's  
telling you to go!

<!-- uid=260333:22:1 -->

**Selka:** It'll be okay. I'll take good care  
of him.

<!-- uid=260333:23:1 -->

**Selka:** But I won't make you go if you  
really don't want to, sis. I'll let  
you decide what to do.

<!-- uid=260333:24:1 -->

**Alice:** ...

<!-- uid=260333:25:1 -->

You really don't mind watching  
Kirito for a little while?

<!-- uid=260333:26:1 -->

**Selka:** Not at all! Just don't forget to  
get the stuff I need to give  
Sister Azariya too, okay?

<!-- uid=260333:27:1 -->

**Alice:** Of course.

<!-- uid=260333:28:1 -->

## Story 260337 · \[Wandering Integrity Knight\] Alice Lv.70

Character Story

home.

**Alice:** ...

## Story 260338 · \[Wandering Integrity Knight\] Alice Lv.80

**Alice:** ...

**Kirito:** Uh...

<!-- uid=260341:16:1 -->


## Story 260343 · \[Illusive Sylph\] Leafa Lv.30

Character Story

**Asuna:** Argo, the info broker we're  
talking about is an NPC.

<!-- uid=260343:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** What's there to compete with when  
it's not another player?

<!-- uid=260343:2:1 -->

**Argo:** Tsk-tsk-tsk! Ya just don't get it,  
Asu!

<!-- uid=260343:3:1 -->

**Argo:** Any good broker procures all the  
intel they can get, even if it's  
from an NPC. It's 'bout pride!

<!-- uid=260343:4:1 -->

**Argo:** We're always lookin' for any legit  
info that helps folks through the  
game, big or small.

<!-- uid=260343:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** R-Right...

<!-- uid=260343:6:1 -->

**Argo:** So, let's make a deal:  
tell me whatcha know!  
I'll be happy to pay ya for it!

<!-- uid=260343:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** What are you looking for? Like,  
info on stuff we've completed  
around here?

<!-- uid=260343:8:1 -->

**Argo:** Yep! And I insist on payin' ya  
for it. I don't wanna be a mooch  
just 'cause we're friends.

<!-- uid=260343:9:1 -->

**Argo:** Once I've confirmed whatever ya  
tell me is true, I'll pay a fair  
price for it. Sound reasonable?

<!-- uid=260343:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** Um...

<!-- uid=260343:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** W-Well...

<!-- uid=260343:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** What should we do?

<!-- uid=260343:13:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hmm?

<!-- uid=260343:14:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I don't get it. Why are you guys  
so hesitant? We can at least  
tell her what we--

<!-- uid=260343:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yuuki, no! Stop! Don't say  
another word!

<!-- uid=260343:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sorry, Argo. Can you give us  
a little time to talk it over  
first?

<!-- uid=260343:17:1 -->

**Argo:** Sure, no prob. Take yer time.  
The more ya remember, the  
more it's worth it fer me too.

<!-- uid=260343:18:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I don't get it. Why don't you guys  
want to say anything to her?

<!-- uid=260343:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** You realize what she does, right?  
She's a merchant who buys and  
sells info to other players.

<!-- uid=260343:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Meaning that whatever we tell  
her about the caravan quests we  
did won't be a secret.

<!-- uid=260343:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** She'll share that information with  
other players if they pay her  
enough for it.

<!-- uid=260343:22:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Yeah, so?

<!-- uid=260343:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** Remember what we talked about at  
the ruins? About that relic we  
found in there?

<!-- uid=260343:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** There's a reason we decided to  
leave that diary behind instead  
of taking it with us.

<!-- uid=260343:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** We thought it was best to let  
it remain in its original home  
since it's so personal.

<!-- uid=260343:26:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Right, of course... Oh, I get  
why you're all so worried now!

<!-- uid=260343:27:1 -->

**Yuuki:** If more people find out about  
those ruins, someone else might  
find that diary and take it.

<!-- uid=260343:28:1 -->

**Leafa:** Mm-hm. It's not that we don't  
trust Argo to choose the right  
people to share that info with.

<!-- uid=260343:29:1 -->

**Leafa:** The problem is who THOSE people  
talk to afterwards. It could get  
out of hand really quickly.

<!-- uid=260343:30:1 -->

**Yuuki:** That's why you think we  
shouldn't talk about it with  
anyone else.

<!-- uid=260343:31:1 -->

**Kirito:** Exactly. I don't think we should  
mention the waterway we took,  
either, just to be safe.

<!-- uid=260343:32:1 -->

**Kirito:** We can tell her about the other  
stuff we learned at this bazaar.

<!-- uid=260343:33:1 -->

**Asuna:** Y-Yeah. Hopefully that'll be enough  
to satisfy her so she stops being  
so curious.

<!-- uid=260343:34:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's what I'm thinking. Just be  
careful how you word things when  
we speak to her.

<!-- uid=260343:35:1 -->

**Kirito:** She's clever and she'll use every  
trick in the book to try and wring  
info out of us.

<!-- uid=260343:36:1 -->

**Yuuki:** R-Right. Okay.

<!-- uid=260343:37:1 -->


## Story 260345 · \[Illusive Sylph\] Leafa Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** So about the quests around here.  
Um... You can make a lot of money  
off the fruit from that tree.

**Argo:** Mm-hm, mm-hm. Go on.

<!-- uid=260345:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** Uh, the rugs they sell there are  
really expensive, but you can  
barter the price down.

<!-- uid=260345:3:1 -->

negotiating might come  
away with a bargain.

## Story 260365 · \[Thinking of You\] Sortiliena Lv.50

Character Story

<!-- uid=260365:1:1 -->

**Ronie:** I don't think we can really ask

<!-- uid=260365:2:1 -->

putting in a little effort,

<!-- uid=260365:3:1 -->

worthwhile?

<!-- uid=260365:4:1 -->

improve these too?

<!-- uid=260365:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's easy. They're overly moist

<!-- uid=260365:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** So, all we have to do is  
get rid of that water.

<!-- uid=260365:7:1 -->

<!-- uid=260365:9:1 -->

**Ronie:** ...?
