**Ronie:** Flat rocks? Uh, yes, I think we  
should be able to find plenty  
lying around outside...

<!-- uid=260365:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Then we'll clean one of those up  
and use it as a frying pan.

<!-- uid=260365:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** This way, we can heat up the rock  
and get rid of the water in the  
sweets with its residual heat.

<!-- uid=260365:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** Do you think you could also get  
something we can use to heat  
it up with, Ronie?

<!-- uid=260365:17:1 -->

**Ronie:** Y-Yes, of course.

<!-- uid=260365:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** Thanks.

<!-- uid=260365:19:1 -->

**Ronie:** Um, you said residual heat, right?  
That sounds kind of complex, b-but  
okay, I'll go look for a rock.

<!-- uid=260365:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Great. I'll look with you.

<!-- uid=260365:21:1 -->

Featherman, but...

## Story 260405 · \[VR World Emperor\] Alice Lv.50

Character Story

**Kirito:** I've been thinking, we don't know  
each other that well yet. How about  
we share a little about ourselves?

<!-- uid=260405:1:1 -->

**Mona:** We are the great Phantom Thieves!  
We do not reveal our secrets so  
easily.

<!-- uid=260405:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, I'm guessing we're all  
around the same age. You're high  
school students, right?

<!-- uid=260405:3:1 -->

than us.

<!-- uid=260405:4:1 -->

so I'm guessing you're Tokyoites.

<!-- uid=260405:5:1 -->

I think they're nice people.

<!-- uid=260405:6:1 -->

**Skull:** What are you, amateur detectives?!

<!-- uid=260405:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ah, sorry. But I don't think any of  
us can resist a mystery!

<!-- uid=260405:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** We won't pry if you'd rather us  
not. But we'll tell you about  
ourselves, get the ball rolling.

<!-- uid=260405:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Then again, we're just a bunch of  
ordinary students. Well...one  
of us is a bit of a special case.

<!-- uid=260405:10:1 -->

corporation.

<!-- uid=260405:11:1 -->

**Noir:** Oh! That's pretty tough, huh?

<!-- uid=260405:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Tough... Yeah, you could say that.

<!-- uid=260405:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** A lot is expected of me, and... I'm  
not totally free to choose my own  
life. It's a pain sometimes.

<!-- uid=260405:14:1 -->

**Noir:** Like...your parents won't let  
you pick who you marry?

<!-- uid=260405:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Urk...

<!-- uid=260405:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Nnnrgh...

<!-- uid=260405:17:1 -->

**Noir:** Bingo?

<!-- uid=260405:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** I can't...deny that...

<!-- uid=260405:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** But...what's the deal? Why the  
sudden burst of curiosity?

<!-- uid=260405:20:1 -->

**Noir:** Because I think you and I have  
a lot in common.

<!-- uid=260405:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** We do?

<!-- uid=260405:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wait a sec, Noir! That means...

but you're a berserk healer too?!

<!-- uid=260405:23:1 -->

**Noir:** I'm...not sure I follow?

<!-- uid=260405:24:1 -->

**Oracle:** He's calling you crazy violent.

<!-- uid=260405:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito! Why would you mention  
that?!

<!-- uid=260405:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** If they suddenly saw you transform  
from dainty debutante into violent  
killing machine, they'd freak.

<!-- uid=260405:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** Phrasing, Kirito! Come on!

<!-- uid=260405:28:1 -->

**Mona:** Well, in that case, you should know  
that Noir here is the Beauty Thief!

<!-- uid=260405:29:1 -->

**Noir:** M-Mona! D-Don't tell them that!

<!-- uid=260405:30:1 -->

**Oracle:** Beauty and the Berserker...  
Sounds like a movie.

<!-- uid=260405:31:1 -->


## Story 260407 · \[VR World Emperor\] Alice Lv.70

Character Story

**Leafa:** I had a thought when I saw your

help us fight better as a team!

<!-- uid=260407:1:1 -->

what I'm talking 'bout, right?

all sorts of annoying rumors.

<!-- uid=260407:16:1 -->

**Sinon:** Gah?!

<!-- uid=260407:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** N-No... We're just friends.

<!-- uid=260407:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** E-Exactly! That's exactly right!

<!-- uid=260407:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** Besides, Kirito already married

<!-- uid=260407:20:1 -->

**Panther:** Th-They're married?!  
...Wait, what do you  
mean by "once"?

<!-- uid=260407:21:1 -->

**Joker:** ...They got divorced.

<!-- uid=260407:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** N-No! We got married in-game!

life.

<!-- uid=260407:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey, Sinon? Can we choose our

people the wrong idea.

<!-- uid=260407:25:1 -->

**Sinon:** Right...

<!-- uid=260407:26:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...Sorry, Queen. Looks like  
Leafa's idea didn't pan out after  
all.

<!-- uid=260407:27:1 -->

just thinking the same thing.

<!-- uid=260407:28:1 -->


## Story 260408 · \[VR World Emperor\] Alice Lv.80

Character Story

**Joker:** I think it's about time we took  
on that boss again.

able to team up and take it out!

## Story 260421 · \[Flame Blade Wielding Demon\] Asuna Lv.10

Character Story

<!-- uid=260421:1:1 -->

the type to let a loss go.

<!-- uid=260421:2:1 -->

**Gleam Eyes Asuna:** Or to put a game aside before you  
complete it...right?

<!-- uid=260421:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...Asuna, fake or not, it seems

<!-- uid=260421:4:1 -->

**Gleam Eyes Asuna:** Heh heh heh...

<!-- uid=260421:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Now, it's time for this battle  
to begin!

<!-- uid=260421:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Let's go, Eugeo!

<!-- uid=260421:7:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Right!

<!-- uid=260421:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Gah...!

<!-- uid=260421:9:1 -->

**Gleam Eyes Asuna:** Is that all?

<!-- uid=260421:10:1 -->

**Gleam Eyes Asuna:** Well, Kirito? Do you want to keep  
going?

<!-- uid=260421:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Heh... You've been really helpful,

<!-- uid=260421:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm understanding more and more of

## Story 260423 · \[Flame Blade Wielding Demon\] Asuna Lv.30

Character Story

**Kirito:** Phew...

<!-- uid=260423:1:1 -->

**Eugeo:** We barely made it out of there  
alive...

<!-- uid=260423:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. It could be that she just  
let us get away.

<!-- uid=260423:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Or rather, that she's probably  
programmed to not follow  
retreating players too far.

<!-- uid=260423:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** The devs must want us to figure  
out how to defeat her by facing  
her multiple times.

<!-- uid=260423:5:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Which means there's a definite way  
to deal with her...?

<!-- uid=260423:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's what I think. The problem  
is figuring out what that is...

<!-- uid=260423:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** How do you feel about this, Eugeo?

<!-- uid=260423:8:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Me? Well...

<!-- uid=260423:9:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I don't know Asuna as well as you,  
and I've only fought alongside her  
a handful of times, but...

<!-- uid=260423:10:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Something about the way that fake  
Asuna fought seemed different from  
the real Asuna.

<!-- uid=260423:11:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...It was the same with Alice.  
She may have looked the same, but  
the general way she moved was off.

<!-- uid=260423:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** So even though her appearance is  
identical, her fighting style  
is quite different...

<!-- uid=260423:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...I could see that being another  
design choice.

<!-- uid=260423:14:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Really?

<!-- uid=260423:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. The appearance of this  
dungeon's boss depends on who's  
facing it, right?

<!-- uid=260423:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Appearance alone is one thing,  
but going so far as to imitate a  
fighting style is pretty tough.

<!-- uid=260423:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** In fact, the fake Alice couldn't  
use Alice's special move. Her  
imitation didn't stretch that far.

<!-- uid=260423:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** This is just a guess, but I think  
each of these fakes has their own  
basic ways of acting.

<!-- uid=260423:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Like they act one way with a  
sword, another with a lance,  
and yet another with a rapier.

<!-- uid=260423:20:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...I see. That's an interesting  
hypothesis.

<!-- uid=260423:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Right? Next time let's pay close  
attention to how the fake Asuna  
moves.

<!-- uid=260423:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** If she resembles Asuna only in  
appearance...that's likely to  
lead to a breakthrough.

<!-- uid=260423:23:1 -->


## Story 260425 · \[Flame Blade Wielding Demon\] Asuna Lv.50

Character Story

**Kirito:** ...!

<!-- uid=260425:1:1 -->

**Gleam Eyes Asuna:** What's the matter, Kirito? You're  
not fighting as well as you did  
before.

**Gleam Eyes Asuna:** Are you close to your limit?  
If you are...maybe you should  
quit?

**Kirito:** Sorry, but that's one thing  
I can't do...!

fighting style is pretty different  
from the real Asuna's.)

**Kirito:** (Which should mean...)

<!-- uid=260425:6:1 -->

**Eugeo:** There are rules to how she moves?

<!-- uid=260425:7:2 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, I'm almost certain of it.

<!-- uid=260425:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** That fake Asuna was just tricking  
us by using Asuna's likeness.

<!-- uid=260425:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** She looks the exact same, sounds  
similar, and even has some of her  
memories... But that's it.

<!-- uid=260425:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** This goes without saying, but  
when she uses the same actions,  
her movements also look the same.

<!-- uid=260425:11:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...So we never would have noticed  
if we hadn't watched her carefully.

<!-- uid=260425:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Probably not... It'd be incredibly  
hard to spot the difference if she  
used Asuna's Linear technique.

<!-- uid=260425:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** No wonder we thought the fake  
Asuna was moving like the real  
one.

<!-- uid=260425:14:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I see. So, what'd you mean when  
you said she's acting according to  
rules?

<!-- uid=260425:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** I mean literal rules, plain and  
simple.

<!-- uid=260425:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Gleam Eyes Asuna is most likely  
programmed to attack in a clear,  
specific way.

<!-- uid=260425:17:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...!

<!-- uid=260425:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Of course, the devs tried to cover  
it up, so it's hard to figure out.

<!-- uid=260425:19:1 -->

**Eugeo:** So if we can figure out this  
pattern...

<!-- uid=260425:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's right. We'll be able to  
take her down no matter how  
tough she is!

<!-- uid=260425:21:1 -->


## Story 260427 · \[Flame Blade Wielding Demon\] Asuna Lv.70

Character Story

**Gleam Eyes Asuna:** Heh heh heh... What's the matter,

<!-- uid=260441:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** (We only have one more shot at  
X'rphan Yuuki. How should we  
approach her...?)

<!-- uid=260441:19:1 -->


## Story 260443 · \[Earth-Rupturing White Dragon\] Yuuki Lv.30

Character Story

**Kirito:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=260443:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** We seem to be in a tight spot...

<!-- uid=260443:2:1 -->

**Eugeo:** You're telling me...

<!-- uid=260443:3:1 -->

**Silica:** Does no one have any ideas?

<!-- uid=260443:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...I can't come up with anything.

<!-- uid=260443:5:3 -->

**Kirito:** It'd make sense if our experiences  
so far could be applied to fighting  
fake Yuuki as well, but...

<!-- uid=260443:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** You got to face the fake me as  
many times as you wanted, right?

<!-- uid=260443:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's right. I never got the  
sense that she wouldn't let us  
run away.

<!-- uid=260443:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** I think it's because she was a  
mid boss. Quest bosses are made  
in a different way...

<!-- uid=260443:9:1 -->

**Liz:** But there's usually some things in  
common between the mid and quest  
bosses, right?

<!-- uid=260443:10:1 -->

**Liz:** Take the fake me, for example.  
We were able to defeat her pretty  
easily, but maybe...

<!-- uid=260443:11:1 -->

**Liz:** Wait a second...

<!-- uid=260443:12:1 -->

**Liz:** Hey, I just thought of something.  
Do the bosses here respawn?

<!-- uid=260443:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm not sure. Normally they  
won't until the quest  
is cleared...

<!-- uid=260443:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** I didn't see the fake Alice when I  
went through the dungeon to come  
find you either, Kirito.

<!-- uid=260443:15:1 -->

**Liz:** Oh... Then maybe it won't work...

<!-- uid=260443:16:1 -->

**Liz:** It's just that the standard move  
here would be to raise our level  
against the previous boss.

<!-- uid=260443:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ah!

<!-- uid=260443:18:1 -->

**Liz:** I mean, Grinding earlier bosses  
is the most effective way to get  
ready for one you can't beat...

<!-- uid=260443:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Liz. You know...  
You just might have figured  
it out.

<!-- uid=260443:20:1 -->

**Liz:** What?

<!-- uid=260443:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Now that you mention it, you're  
right. If we can't go forward,  
we should go back...

<!-- uid=260443:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Because it's likely that the  
answer we need is there!

<!-- uid=260443:23:1 -->


## Story 260445 · \[Earth-Rupturing White Dragon\] Yuuki Lv.50

Character Story

**Kobold Lisbeth:** Heh heh heh... I see you've made  
it here at last.

<!-- uid=260445:1:1 -->

**Liz:** Agh... Isn't that the same line I  
used earlier?

<!-- uid=260445:2:1 -->

**Liz:** It kind of makes me feel like the  
devs got lazy...

<!-- uid=260445:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Come on, let's cut them a little  
slack.

<!-- uid=260445:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** But look, she respawned.  
There has to be a reason for that.

<!-- uid=260445:5:1 -->

**Liz:** Right! And the fake Alice hadn't  
reappeared, you said?

<!-- uid=260445:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yes. It's been a little while  
since Kirito and Eugeo defeated  
her, too.

<!-- uid=260445:7:1 -->

**Liz:** Hmm. I look as strange as ever...  
But I assume she's the same  
monster as before?

<!-- uid=260445:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's hard to say. I guess the  
best way to find out is to  
fight her.

<!-- uid=260445:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Based on the last time we fought,  
it's just about time for...

<!-- uid=260445:10:1 -->

**Kobold Lisbeth:** Hisss!

<!-- uid=260445:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Whoa!

<!-- uid=260445:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yep, a surprise attack! Just like  
last time!

<!-- uid=260445:13:1 -->

**Liz:** Oh, come on. Do you really have to  
repeat even your cowardly attacks?

<!-- uid=260445:14:1 -->

**Liz:** Hmph... What an idiot! If you're  
going to be a fake me, act a little  
more like me, won't you?!

<!-- uid=260445:15:1 -->

**Liz:** Let's get her, everyone! We might  
figure out a way to beat Yuuki  
while we're at it!

<!-- uid=260445:16:1 -->


## Story 260447 · \[Earth-Rupturing White Dragon\] Yuuki Lv.70

Character Story

**Kobold Lisbeth:** Gaaah...!

<!-- uid=260447:1:1 -->

**Liz:** Phew. It really is easier the  
second time around.

<!-- uid=260447:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** She has fixed attack patterns,  
after all. The more you fight her,  
the easier she should be.

<!-- uid=260447:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Still, that's interesting...

<!-- uid=260447:5:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Did you notice something, Kirito?

<!-- uid=260447:6:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...It looks like Liz's equipment  
only drops once, huh?

<!-- uid=260447:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** I noticed that too, but that's  
not what I wanted to say.

<!-- uid=260447:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Kobold Lisbeth and X'rphan  
Yuuki... They might look like  
totally different enemies, but...

<!-- uid=260447:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Fighting her again made me notice.  
There's something similar between  
these two, don't you think?

<!-- uid=260447:10:1 -->

**Liz:** Really? Like what?

<!-- uid=260447:11:1 -->

**Silica:** The way they fight and their  
Weapon Types really seem to be  
nothing alike to me...

<!-- uid=260447:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** That is true. It might be hard to  
notice because of all the ways  
the two are different.

<!-- uid=260447:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Still, I think they share  
something hidden in common.

<!-- uid=260447:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** And that is...?

<!-- uid=260447:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's simple. What did Silica just  
say?

<!-- uid=260447:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Their fighting styles and Weapon  
Types are nothing alike...

<!-- uid=260447:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** But what if we looked at  
everything else? For example...

<!-- uid=260447:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** If you took the fake Lisbeth's  
attack patterns and sped them up,  
you'd get the fake Yuuki.

<!-- uid=260447:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...!

<!-- uid=260447:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Their Weapon Types are different,  
so naturally their Sword Skills  
are as well.

<!-- uid=260447:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** But isn't it true that their  
weapons have similarly positioned  
Sword Skills?

<!-- uid=260447:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** Like Sharp Nail for swords and  
Rage Blow for maces?

<!-- uid=260447:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's exactly right. They're both  
beginner abilities used to mow  
enemies down, right?

<!-- uid=260447:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** Their weapons may be different,  
but they act in similar ways. That  
goes for their techniques, too.

<!-- uid=260447:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** Take Kobold Lisbeth's techniques  
and apply them to X'rphan Yuuki's  
Weapon Type and...

<!-- uid=260447:26:1 -->

**Eugeo:** And then you can figure out exactly  
how the fake Yuuki is going to act!

<!-- uid=260447:27:1 -->

**Kirito:** Exactly, Eugeo. Pretty good  
deduction on my part, wouldn't  
you say?

<!-- uid=260447:28:1 -->

**Liz:** I'll say! That's the kind of  
insight I expect from you, Kirito!

<!-- uid=260447:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** Heh heh. I couldn't be happier  
to hear that.

<!-- uid=260447:30:1 -->

**Kirito:** Still, there's a fundamental  
problem with this line of  
thought...

<!-- uid=260447:31:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yuuki's so fast that I'm not sure  
we can pull this off against her  
no matter how hard we practice.

<!-- uid=260447:32:1 -->

**Everyone:** ...

<!-- uid=260447:33:1 -->

**Asuna:** We might need to fight the fake  
Liz until it looks to us like  
she's standing still.

<!-- uid=260447:34:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. And we need to get to that  
level in a little over ninety  
minutes...

<!-- uid=260447:35:1 -->

**Kirito:** This'll be pretty tough. Are you  
ready, everyone?

<!-- uid=260447:36:1 -->


## Story 260448 · \[Earth-Rupturing White Dragon\] Yuuki Lv.80

Character Story

**Liz:** One me, two mes, three mes...  
So many...

<!-- uid=260448:1:1 -->

**Liz:** Another me defeated!  
I've lost count at this point!

<!-- uid=260448:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh... Um, yeah. Sorry.

<!-- uid=260448:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sorry about this, Liz. This is  
all getting so crazy...

<!-- uid=260448:4:1 -->

**Liz:** Don't apologize, you two.  
When I said I was ready, that  
included this.

<!-- uid=260448:5:2 -->

**Liz:** If anything, I've finished myself  
off so many times that I've  
started to feel numb to it.

<!-- uid=260448:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** You don't get many chances to  
fight this many shapeshifters or  
doppelgangers, after all...

<!-- uid=260448:7:1 -->

**Liz:** Stop worrying about me! All those  
Kobold Lizes will be cheering us on  
from the grave!

<!-- uid=260448:8:1 -->

**Liz:** So... Are we about ready?

<!-- uid=260448:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, I think so.

<!-- uid=260448:10:1 -->

**Eugeo:** We've really drilled her attack  
patterns into our brains by now.

<!-- uid=260448:11:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Still... I'm a little worried.  
I don't think we can say we know  
every last thing she'll do.

<!-- uid=260448:12:1 -->

**Silica:** Not to mention that we'll have to  
adjust to the fake Yuuki's speed  
once we face her...

<!-- uid=260448:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** So we couldn't get perfectly  
ready after all. Agh...

<!-- uid=260448:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** We're almost out of time, though.  
We can't spend any longer working  
out our plan.

<!-- uid=260448:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Okay. Let's head to the depths of  
the dungeon once more.

<!-- uid=260448:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** There's not much time left...  
This battle will decide whether we  
come out of this crying or smiling!

<!-- uid=260448:17:1 -->

## Story 260453 · \[Knight's Pride\] Alice Lv.30

Character Story

**Eugeo:** Elite Disciple Eugeo, of the  
North Centoria Imperial  
Swordcraft Academy.

<!-- uid=260453:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Kirito, of the same.

<!-- uid=260453:2:1 -->

**Alice:** Alice Synthesis Thirty...  
Integrity Knight of the  
Axiom Church in Centoria.

<!-- uid=260453:3:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Alice...?  
Is that... really you?

<!-- uid=260453:4:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Alice!

<!-- uid=260453:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Eugeo!

<!-- uid=260453:7:1 -->

**Alice:** ...Mind your manners, cur.  
Do not forget, I have the right  
to take up to 70% of your Life.

<!-- uid=260453:8:1 -->

**Alice:** Touch me without permission again,  
and I will cut your hand off where  
you stand.

<!-- uid=260453:9:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Alice...

<!-- uid=260453:10:1 -->

**Alice:** ...

<!-- uid=260453:11:1 -->

**Alice:** I suppose I can't really call that  
first encounter a positive one.

<!-- uid=260453:12:1 -->

**Alice:** But it's strange. I am without a  
doubt the same person I was back  
then, and yet...

<!-- uid=260453:13:1 -->

**Alice:** My thoughts and feelings now  
are entirely different from then.

<!-- uid=260453:14:1 -->

**Alice:** Perhaps meeting those two had  
changed me.

<!-- uid=260453:15:1 -->

**Alice:** That technically wasn't our  
first encounter, though.

<!-- uid=260453:16:1 -->

**Alice:** (Alice Zuberg...)

<!-- uid=260453:17:1 -->

**Alice:** That was the real name of the girl  
who owned this body.

<!-- uid=260453:18:1 -->

**Alice:** But she's already gone from  
this world.

<!-- uid=260453:19:1 -->

**Alice:** My existence has been brief,  
but she had already met Kirito  
and Eugeo long ago.

<!-- uid=260453:20:1 -->

**Alice:** Of course, that girl too...

<!-- uid=260453:21:1 -->

**Alice:** My... Our precious little  
sister, Selka.

<!-- uid=260453:22:1 -->


## Story 260455 · \[Knight's Pride\] Alice Lv.50

Character Story

**Kirito:** Huh...

<!-- uid=260455:1:1 -->

**Alice:** It's about time we returned.

<!-- uid=260455:2:1 -->

**Selka:** Alice!

<!-- uid=260455:3:1 -->

**Selka:** Good morning, Alice!

<!-- uid=260455:4:1 -->

**Selka:** You too, Kirito!

<!-- uid=260455:5:1 -->

**Selka:** ...Good morning, Eugeo.

<!-- uid=260455:6:1 -->

**Alice:** Good morning, Selka. You knew  
just where to find us!

<!-- uid=260455:7:1 -->

**Alice:** (It took me more than a month to  
get used to speaking with her  
naturally...)

<!-- uid=260455:8:1 -->

**Alice:** Selka, Alice Zuberg's younger  
sister.

<!-- uid=260455:9:1 -->

**Alice:** I cherish her more than anything.

<!-- uid=260455:10:1 -->

**Alice:** But sometimes I wonder if I,  
Alice Synthesis Thirty am a mere  
imposter of Alice Zuberg.

<!-- uid=260455:11:1 -->

**Alice:** There's not a day that goes by  
that I question whether I'm worthy  
enough to call Selka my sister.

<!-- uid=260455:12:1 -->

**Alice:** But I know this much is certain,  
the feeling of warmth and love I  
feel when I'm with her is genuine.

<!-- uid=260455:13:1 -->

**Alice:** I must reach the World's End Altar  
for her sake as well.

<!-- uid=260455:14:1 -->

**Alice:** To be honest, I don't know if I'll  
ever be able to see her again...

<!-- uid=260455:15:1 -->

**Alice:** I wonder what will happen once  
I go out into the real world.

<!-- uid=260455:16:1 -->

**Alice:** ...

<!-- uid=260455:17:1 -->

**Alice:** But turning back is not an option.

<!-- uid=260455:18:1 -->

**Alice:** I must avenge Uncle.

<!-- uid=260455:19:1 -->

**Alice:** I need to restore his honor after  
he lost his life in a sham of a  
duel.

<!-- uid=260455:20:1 -->


## Story 260457 · \[Knight's Pride\] Alice Lv.70

Character Story

**Alice:** ...It's warm.

<!-- uid=260457:1:1 -->

**Alice:** I want to stay here a while  
longer.

<!-- uid=260457:2:1 -->

**Alice:** What is this sense of relief?  
It's like...

<!-- uid=260457:3:1 -->

**Alice:** It's as if I'm being held in  
the arms of my father.

<!-- uid=260457:4:1 -->

**Alice:** The feeling of being completely  
protected, where all is right,  
with nothing to worry about.

<!-- uid=260457:5:1 -->

**Alice:** I'd forgotten this feeling long  
ago. It's such a precious,  
wonderful feeling.

<!-- uid=260457:6:1 -->

**Alice:** But I need to wake up.  
There's something I must do.

<!-- uid=260457:7:1 -->

**Alice:** Ngh...

<!-- uid=260457:8:1 -->

**Alice:** ...Uncle?

<!-- uid=260457:9:1 -->

**Alice:** That's right! I was captured by  
Emperor Vecta and his Wyrm!

<!-- uid=260457:10:1 -->

**Alice:** You saved me, didn't you, Uncle?  
I knew you would.

<!-- uid=260457:11:1 -->

**Bercouli:** ...

<!-- uid=260457:12:1 -->

**Alice:** ...?!

<!-- uid=260457:13:1 -->

**Alice:** Un...cle...

<!-- uid=260457:14:1 -->

**Alice:** (Those aren't just old scars, he's  
covered in wounds and bleeding all  
over...)

<!-- uid=260457:15:1 -->

**Alice:** (And there's a dreadful wound  
inflicted deep into his chest.)

<!-- uid=260457:16:1 -->

**Alice:** U...Uncle!  
Commander Bercouli!

<!-- uid=260457:17:1 -->

**Alice:** His life... His life is...

<!-- uid=260457:18:1 -->

**Alice:** ...already gone.

<!-- uid=260457:19:1 -->


## Story 260458 · \[Knight's Pride\] Alice Lv.80

Character Story

**Alice:** ...

<!-- uid=260458:1:1 -->

**Alice:** The man Uncle risked his life to  
defeat possesses a strange power.

<!-- uid=260458:2:1 -->

**Alice:** The power of Resurrection. It  
really is unfair.

<!-- uid=260458:3:1 -->

**Alice:** One side risks their life while  
the other risks nothing. I will  
never acknowledge such a duel.

<!-- uid=260458:4:1 -->

**Alice:** I won't forgive him for making  
such a mockery of Uncle's death!

<!-- uid=260458:5:1 -->

**Alice:** (I came to an answer after  
reflecting on all my different  
encounters.)

<!-- uid=260458:6:1 -->

**Alice:** (This is a conclusion I reached  
on my own, not the will of Kirito,  
Asuna, Sinon and the others.)

<!-- uid=260458:7:1 -->

**Alice:** If the enemy is immortal in this  
world...

<!-- uid=260458:8:1 -->

**Alice:** Then I will have to cut him down  
in the real one.

<!-- uid=260458:9:1 -->

**Alice:** As long as I reach the World's End  
Altar, I can catch him by  
surprise.

<!-- uid=260458:10:1 -->

**Alice:** I will not tolerate a power like  
Resurrection that scorns my  
Uncle's death!

<!-- uid=260458:11:1 -->

**Alice:** I need to hurry. There isn't much  
time left.

<!-- uid=260458:12:1 -->

**Alice:** I will fight to the end for the  
sake of everyone I love!

<!-- uid=260458:13:1 -->

## Story 260621 · \[Wind Caressing the Earth\] Leafa Lv.10

**Asuna:** Hmm... Now where could they be?

<!-- uid=260621:3:1 -->

<!-- uid=260621:4:1 -->

longer than I expected to switch  
trains.

<!-- uid=260621:5:1 -->

**Shino:** Eh, don't sweat it. I'd be more  
surprised if you actually did

<!-- uid=260621:7:1 -->

<!-- uid=260621:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** ???

<!-- uid=260621:12:1 -->

**Suguha:** We figured since you're treating

<!-- uid=260621:13:1 -->

<!-- uid=260621:15:1 -->

<!-- uid=260621:22:1 -->

<!-- uid=260621:27:1 -->

<!-- uid=260621:28:1 -->

**Suguha:** Ah, I can totally imagine that!

<!-- uid=260621:29:1 -->

## Story 260625 · \[Wind Caressing the Earth\] Leafa Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** I guess now that I think about it,  
most of you spent less than a day  
in Underworld, huh?

<!-- uid=260625:1:1 -->

**Suguha:** Yeah, Kazuto was in there for two  
virtual years and you were there  
for just over a month.

<!-- uid=260625:2:1 -->

**Shino:** You know, talking about it like  
this, it feels a little strange.

<!-- uid=260625:3:1 -->

**Shino:** Our world and Underworld have  
their differences, but they've got  
plenty in common, too.

<!-- uid=260625:4:1 -->

**Suguha:** Not only that, there's a lot in  
its setting that has a similar  
vibe to worlds like ALO.

<!-- uid=260625:5:1 -->

**Suguha:** Obviously ALO's filled with fairy  
races, but they both otherwise  
have a wide variety of monsters.

<!-- uid=260625:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's true. On the surface, you  
might say there isn't a lot that  
seems wholly unique to Underworld.

<!-- uid=260625:7:1 -->

**Shino:** When you put it like that, is  
that to say there are more  
differences when you dig deep?

<!-- uid=260625:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Absolutely. Especially when it  
comes to Underworld's culture,  
which is really distinct.

<!-- uid=260625:9:1 -->

**Suguha:** Huh, that's cool to hear. What's  
something that makes it so  
unique in that regard?

<!-- uid=260625:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hmm... I'd say the presence of  
the Sacred Tongue, for one thing.

<!-- uid=260625:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** It might sound roughly like plain  
English to us, but there it's used  
to do stuff not unlike magic.

<!-- uid=260625:12:1 -->

**Suguha:** Oh, I know what you're talking  
about! You mean when people are  
yelling "System Call!" and stuff.

<!-- uid=260625:13:1 -->

**Suguha:** I remember that witch-looking lady  
I fought was chanting that to fire  
off her spells or whatever.

<!-- uid=260625:14:1 -->

**Shino:** It's intriguing stuff. The words  
"System Call" sound like they  
could be a programming language.

<!-- uid=260625:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, it's a computer term. Not  
exactly something you'd expect  
to hear in an incantation.

<!-- uid=260625:16:1 -->

**Suguha:** Guess that's goes to show just  
how much can change when you  
visit different worlds like that.

<!-- uid=260625:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Right. You could say it's one of  
the things that makes Underworld  
stand out as its own thing.

<!-- uid=260625:18:1 -->


## Story 260627 · \[Wind Caressing the Earth\] Leafa Lv.70

Character Story

**Asuna:** Talking about the Sacred Tongue  
reminds me of something else that  
really sets Underworld apart.

<!-- uid=260627:1:1 -->

**Suguha:** And that is?

<!-- uid=260627:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, you know how ALO's setting  
is so heavily inspired by Norse  
mythology?

<!-- uid=260627:3:1 -->

**Suguha:** Of course! Everything from place  
names to weapons and more is  
dripping with Norse inspiration.

<!-- uid=260627:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** But it's not purely Norse since  
ALO is built by Japanese devs and  
run by a Japanese company.

<!-- uid=260627:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** You see bits of Japanese culture  
in things like the katanas and  
also the food you can craft.

<!-- uid=260627:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Not to mention there's still  
Valentine's Day and Japanese  
school uniforms in the game, too.

<!-- uid=260627:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** When you think about it, ALO's  
really a hodgepodge of cultures  
with different parts mixed in.

<!-- uid=260627:8:1 -->

**Suguha:** That's true. It's not always  
entirely consistent in that way,  
is it?

<!-- uid=260627:9:1 -->

**Shino:** Sure, but there's nothing wrong  
with that, if you ask me.

<!-- uid=260627:10:1 -->

**Shino:** There are lots of foreign-made  
games with Japanese concepts  
like samurai and ninja in them.

<!-- uid=260627:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Exactly. In fact, you just said  
something really important for  
the point I'm trying to make.

<!-- uid=260627:12:1 -->

**Shino:** I did?

<!-- uid=260627:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yep. You just said the word  
"games," didn't you?

<!-- uid=260627:14:1 -->

**Shino:** And...?

<!-- uid=260627:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** The thing you have to remember  
about Underworld is, it's not  
a game.

<!-- uid=260627:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's easy to forget that at times,  
but I'd say that's easily the  
biggest difference about it.

<!-- uid=260627:17:1 -->


## Story 260628 · \[Wind Caressing the Earth\] Leafa Lv.80

Character Story

**Suguha:** Right, duh! It's so obvious when  
you say that!

<!-- uid=260628:1:1 -->

**Suguha:** You know, seeing as we've all  
spent so much time playing games  
inside these virtual spaces...

<!-- uid=260628:2:1 -->

**Suguha:** We might be more prone to  
mistaking it as just another game  
without even realizing it.

<!-- uid=260628:3:1 -->

**Shino:** Yeah. There were beta test players  
who logged in after word about it  
spread to foreign game forums.

<!-- uid=260628:4:1 -->

**Shino:** We fought a lot of people who  
never stopped thinking Underworld  
was simply another game.

<!-- uid=260628:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Indeed. Games like ALO and GGO  
have some things set in stone, but  
they can be flexibly expanded.

<!-- uid=260628:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's not the case when it comes  
to Underworld. Or rather...Project  
Alicization.

<!-- uid=260628:7:1 -->

**Shino:** Even if it still takes place in a  
virtual space, the way it  
functions is totally different.

<!-- uid=260628:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Exactly. That's how you end up  
with all these cultures in it  
mirroring the real world's.

<!-- uid=260628:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** The people there have souls just  
like us and built their world  
up over many, many years.

<!-- uid=260628:10:1 -->

**Shino:** ...Yeah. I get what you mean now.

<!-- uid=260628:11:1 -->

**Suguha:** This whole discussion's really  
reminded me just how deep that  
whole world really is.

<!-- uid=260628:12:1 -->

**Shino:** For sure. I hope someday we'll  
have the chance to pay another  
visit to Underworld.

<!-- uid=260628:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** I...think that time will come,  
yeah.

<!-- uid=260628:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** In fact, it might not be long  
before our world and Underworld  
grow even closer to each other!

<!-- uid=260628:15:1 -->

## Story 340015 · \[Black Swordsman\] Kirito Lv.50

Character Story

**Kirito:** Asuna?  
You're not asleep yet?

in thought.

**Kirito:** I do?

<!-- uid=340015:4:1 -->

less from my wife, though.

<!-- uid=340015:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** But this isn't worth

rusty, living like this.

**Asuna:** Aww, Kirito...

<!-- uid=340015:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sorry, I shouldn't say things

## Story 340017 · \[Black Swordsman\] Kirito Lv.70

Character Story

**Kirito:** Hmph!

<!-- uid=340017:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** HAAAH!

<!-- uid=340017:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Phew.  
Yeah, that's about how it goes.

<!-- uid=340017:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hey, Kiritoooo!

<!-- uid=340017:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh? What's wrong, Asuna?  
I said you could sleep in!

<!-- uid=340017:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** But you were gone so long!

<!-- uid=340017:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Besides, I figured I'd come  
out for a little walk.

<!-- uid=340017:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh yeah, I guess it is almost  
morning already.

<!-- uid=340017:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** So, how's your practice going?

<!-- uid=340017:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, well...

<!-- uid=340017:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Honestly, everything's perfect.

<!-- uid=340017:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** I guess that's the SAO  
skill system for you.

<!-- uid=340017:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** The System Assist feature takes  
over for me once I activate  
the skill. It's pretty automatic.

<!-- uid=340017:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, that's good.

<!-- uid=340017:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, but it wasn't enough to  
give me the edge over Heathcliff.

<!-- uid=340017:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** I can't get complacent.

<!-- uid=340017:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** But listen, Kirito...

<!-- uid=340017:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** You got an extra skill by  
virtue of being one of the  
strongest players in SAO, right?

<!-- uid=340017:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** How could you possibly  
get any more powerful?

<!-- uid=340017:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** True. More to the point, you're  
talking about skills from  
outside the system, right?

<!-- uid=340017:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** What do you mean?

<!-- uid=340017:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** Players can make their own

<!-- uid=340017:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** Are you serious?

<!-- uid=340017:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** I've heard it's possible, but  
it takes time. You can't make  
a new skill overnight.

<!-- uid=340017:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** That would pretty much be

## Story 340021 · \[Skill Connect\] Kirito Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** Rrrrr.....  
HRRRAAAAHH!!

<!-- uid=340021:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Phew...

<!-- uid=340021:3:1 -->

**Yui:** Daddy... Was that...?

<!-- uid=340021:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** You guessed it.  
Double Circular...

<!-- uid=340021:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, not quite. It's similar,  
but fundamentally different.

<!-- uid=340021:6:1 -->

**Yui:** I suppose it would have to be.  
That was a sword skill in SAO's  
unique skill tree for Dual Blades.

<!-- uid=340021:7:1 -->

**Yui:** But you can't use Dual Blades like that in  
ALO, and there's no such thing as  
unique skills here either.

<!-- uid=340021:8:1 -->

**Yui:** So it should be impossible to use  
that technique here...

<!-- uid=340021:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** It is. That's why I said it was  
"similar." I equipped two swords  
and mimicked it,

<!-- uid=340021:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** but I didn't use the system's  
help at all for it.

<!-- uid=340021:11:1 -->

**Yui:** That was...completely unassisted?

<!-- uid=340021:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. It took me hours and hours  
of practice to get it right...

<!-- uid=340021:13:1 -->

**Yui:** ...Is something the matter?

<!-- uid=340021:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm happy I figured out how to do  
it, but...honestly, using Dual  
Blades feels weird...

<!-- uid=340021:15:1 -->

**Yui:** What do you mean?

<!-- uid=340021:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** I keep thinking that I'm letting  
myself be defined by my unique  
skill. By Dual Blades.

<!-- uid=340021:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Why did Heathcliff-Why did Kayaba  
add it to SAO?  
I just don't understand...

<!-- uid=340021:18:1 -->

**Yui:** But it wasn't the only unique  
skill in SAO, right?

<!-- uid=340021:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, there were about ten in all.  
At least, so I heard.

<!-- uid=340021:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** But the only ones publicly known  
were my Dual Blades and  
Heathcliff's Divine Blade.

<!-- uid=340021:21:1 -->

**Yui:** I have a bit of a theory...  
Kayaba's purpose in adding unique  
skills was to inspire the players.

<!-- uid=340021:22:1 -->

**Yui:** By creating powers that rivaled  
his own, he hoped to grant SAO's  
players a modicum of hope.

<!-- uid=340021:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** I thought about that.  
From what we know of Kayaba,

<!-- uid=340021:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** There's no doubt that was at  
least part of it...

<!-- uid=340021:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** But I can't shake the feeling that  
there's something more to it...

<!-- uid=340021:26:1 -->

**Yui:** Daddy...

<!-- uid=340021:27:1 -->


## Story 340023 · \[Skill Connect\] Kirito Lv.30

Character Story

**Asuna:** Kirito.

<!-- uid=340023:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Asuna! What's up?

<!-- uid=340023:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** The other day, you had a long talk  
with Yui about unique skills,  
right?

<!-- uid=340023:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh? Oh, yeah. I did. Why?

<!-- uid=340023:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** She said that when you use  
Dual Blades, you wonder why  
Heathcliff-Kayaba-put it in SAO.

<!-- uid=340023:5:1 -->

no matter how much I think  
about it.

<!-- uid=340023:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Remember when we went to  
Jotunheimr? You showed me a new  
technique: Skill Connect.

<!-- uid=340023:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Maybe your reasons for coming up  
with it were similar to Kayaba's  
reasons for making unique skills?

<!-- uid=340023:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hmm... Maybe...

<!-- uid=340023:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** But I only came up with Skill  
Connect because using Dual Blades  
in ALO was just so...ineffective...

<!-- uid=340023:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** I needed it if I wanted to keep up  
with all of you out there.

<!-- uid=340023:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** You mean Dual Blades skills  
like Double Circular were hard  
to use?

<!-- uid=340023:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Totally.  
I worked hard to recreate the  
skills I used in SAO in ALO.

<!-- uid=340023:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** I managed to succeed to some  
extent...

<!-- uid=340023:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** But in the end, I was just  
swinging my swords around to  
simulate the movements.

<!-- uid=340023:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** In other words, I wasn't using  
skills or magic at all. I just  
made a bunch of regular attacks.

<!-- uid=340023:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** They only dealt physical damage?

<!-- uid=340023:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yup, no magic at all.  
That's probably why my attacks  
fared so poorly in ALO at first.

<!-- uid=340023:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ahh, I get it!  
You made basic attacks that  
mimicked Dual Blades skills,

<!-- uid=340023:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** then used Skill Connect to combo  
them into a magic-supplemented  
ALO sword skill. That's smart!

<!-- uid=340023:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Thanks. Still, it was no easy feat  
to link them up like that...

<!-- uid=340023:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehehe... Klein was shouting about  
how he'd force you to teach him  
"those ridic sword hacks!!"

<!-- uid=340023:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh no, not again...  
Ugh, that guy can be a real pain  
in the...

<!-- uid=340023:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh stop. Be nice to the poor boy  
and show him your moves.

<!-- uid=340023:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** Fine, I'll teach him the theory.  
But I doubt that he'll actually  
listen to me...

<!-- uid=340023:25:1 -->


## Story 340025 · \[Skill Connect\] Kirito Lv.50

Character Story

**Klein:** Whoa-ho! Hey there, Kirito,  
ol' buddy ol' pal!

<!-- uid=340025:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** AH! K-Klein? What's goi-

<!-- uid=340025:2:1 -->

**Klein:** Heeey, so we're best buds, right?!  
RIGHT?!

<!-- uid=340025:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Um...yes? You're certainly burning  
with excitement today...

<!-- uid=340025:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Also, could you please remove  
the arm? I don't need a Klein  
hug today.

<!-- uid=340025:5:1 -->

**Klein:** Sooo, I've got a bit of a favor to  
ask from the world's coolest dude.

<!-- uid=340025:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** You want me to teach you how to  
do a Skill Connect, right?

<!-- uid=340025:7:1 -->

**Klein:** Aww, you can read me like a book!  
Then again, we have been through  
so much together! We're besties!

<!-- uid=340025:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Not really. Asuna told me you  
wanted me to teach you.

<!-- uid=340025:9:1 -->

**Klein:** I love how you're so mercilessly  
straight to the point! So! Let the  
lesson begin, teach!

<!-- uid=340025:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Okay. Before we get down to the  
nitty-gritty, I need to make sure  
you understand the theory.

<!-- uid=340025:11:1 -->

**Klein:** No prob.

<!-- uid=340025:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** After every sword skill, there's  
a short period of time that you  
can't act: a recovery delay.

<!-- uid=340025:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** However, triggering another sword  
skill overrides this delay,  
letting you combo multiple skills.

<!-- uid=340025:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** I simplified a bit, but that's the  
theory behind the Skill Connect.

<!-- uid=340025:15:1 -->

**Klein:** Hmmm... Wait a sec... Doesn't that  
mean you can only use Skill  
Connect when using Dual Blades?

<!-- uid=340025:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sharp as ever, Klein.  
That's right.

<!-- uid=340025:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Theoretically, anyway...  
But remember, this isn't really a  
skill. It's a system exploit.

<!-- uid=340025:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Triggering the sword skill I want  
to combo into with my off-hand  
felt like the easiest option...

<!-- uid=340025:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** But a skilled player might be able  
to figure out a way to do it with  
a two-handed weapon.

<!-- uid=340025:20:1 -->

**Klein:** Hmm, interesting idea...  
Hey, can I see it again?

<!-- uid=340025:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sure.  
Watch closely...

<!-- uid=340025:22:1 -->

## Story 340093 · \[Lofty Captain\] Kirito Lv.30

Character Story

**Captain:** Sailing is an ancient, sacred,

## Story 340095 · \[Lofty Captain\] Kirito Lv.50

Character Story

**Captain:** To sail against the wind,  
you need to tack the sails at  
just the right angle.

<!-- uid=340095:1:1 -->

**Captain:** That way, a layer of air comes in  
underneath. That air builds up  
and lifts the ship up a little.

<!-- uid=340095:2:1 -->

**Captain:** We use that lift to push forward,  
and that's how we sail if the  
wind's going the wrong way!

<!-- uid=340095:3:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Umm... Say that again, please?  
When did I get off a pirate ship

<!-- uid=340095:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** Ahh, I know this. It's the same

<!-- uid=340095:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** Not flying straight against the

<!-- uid=340095:6:1 -->

faster that way than with the  
wind at our backs!

<!-- uid=340095:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** Oh... Interesting. Actually doing  
it makes it much easier to  
understand.

<!-- uid=340095:8:1 -->

**Captain:** Don't worry! The theory isn't  
gonna be on the test. Next up,  
you're learning the rudder.

<!-- uid=340095:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Right!

<!-- uid=340095:10:1 -->

**Captain:** Ships aren't just all wind and

read the waves, too.

<!-- uid=340095:11:1 -->

**Captain:** So look alive and pay attention!

<!-- uid=340095:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Aye-aye, cap'n!!

<!-- uid=340095:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hey, Yuuki?

<!-- uid=340095:14:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hey, Asuna, what's up?

<!-- uid=340095:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** I thought you wanted to learn  
about sailing with Kirito?

<!-- uid=340095:16:1 -->

**Yuuki:** O-Oh yeah, that.  
It was hard, so...

<!-- uid=340095:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, so you gave up?

<!-- uid=340095:18:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I couldn't get my head around

<!-- uid=340095:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Maybe you're more of the

<!-- uid=340095:20:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Haha! That or I'm not that great

<!-- uid=340095:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's not true, Yuuki!  
You're really good at picking up  
new things!

<!-- uid=340095:22:1 -->

**Yuuki:** But Kirito's still way better

<!-- uid=340095:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's just because he's  
interested in it. He likes putting

<!-- uid=340095:24:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Yeah... I bet that'll make  
him a great helmsman!

## Story 340097 · \[Lofty Captain\] Kirito Lv.70

Character Story

You know, I think you're right.  
I was getting too caught up in

<!-- uid=340097:36:1 -->

**Kirito:** All right! Let's do this!

recon of this place...

<!-- uid=350063:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** I talked to most of the Card  
Soldiers, and they all say the  
same thing.

<!-- uid=350063:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** The king, who's apparently a total  
jerk, said he's going to execute  
all his worthless retainers.

<!-- uid=350063:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah, and all the Card Soldiers  
figure that if they're going to  
get the axe, why bother working?

<!-- uid=350063:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey... You don't think we're to  
blame for all this, are you?

<!-- uid=350063:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Maybe... We did beat up a whole  
bunch of his troops on the way  
in here...

<!-- uid=350063:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Okay, no. That doesn't make sense.

<!-- uid=350063:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** They added in this new dungeon for  
us players. There's no way we're  
not going to play it.

<!-- uid=350063:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** I guess you're right. The devs  
wouldn't just make players the  
bad guys like that for no reason.

<!-- uid=350063:9:1 -->

**???:** So, you're the intruders I've  
heard so much about.

<!-- uid=350063:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** We are? Oh, I guess we are!  
Who is this guy?  
Another Card Soldier?

<!-- uid=350063:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** He's dressed funny.

<!-- uid=350063:12:1 -->

**???:** I am in charge of these brave  
soldiers.

<!-- uid=350063:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** So...the captain of the Card  
Soldiers?

<!-- uid=350063:14:1 -->

**Card Captain:** Not anymore, at least. The king  
just dishonorably discharged me.  
Oh, woe is me...

<!-- uid=350063:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Why?

<!-- uid=350063:16:1 -->

**Card Captain:** Because I failed in my duty  
and allowed you intruders  
to infiltrate our kingdom!

<!-- uid=350063:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...

<!-- uid=350063:18:1 -->

**Card Captain:** But don't feel bad. This country  
once welcomed people like you  
as friends, not enemies.

<!-- uid=350063:19:1 -->

**Card Captain:** The king put an end to all of  
that when he closed the borders  
of our kingdom...

<!-- uid=350063:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** This country is closed to the rest  
of the world?

<!-- uid=350063:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Captain, would you mind filling us  
in on the whole story?

<!-- uid=350063:22:1 -->


## Story 350065 · \[The King of Poker\] Kirito Lv.50

Character Story

**King:** This kingdom is mine, you hear me!  
MINE! I will not tolerate this  
foreign blight upon my land!

<!-- uid=350065:1:1 -->

**King:** Curse you, you useless fools!  
Can't you do anything right?  
Destroy the intruders, already!

<!-- uid=350065:2:1 -->

**Card Soldier:** Y-Yes, milord... But, you see...

<!-- uid=350065:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** So that's the king.

<!-- uid=350065:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** He does seem pretty tyrannical.  
His soldiers don't look very  
happy either...

<!-- uid=350065:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey... I know that captain asked  
us to beat up the king for him,  
but is that the right thing to do?

<!-- uid=350065:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Why not? The people want to pull  
this king down. And from what I  
can see, I don't blame them.

<!-- uid=350065:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** But isn't that a rather...violent  
solution?

<!-- uid=350065:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, we gathered all the info we  
could here, and it seems like  
that's what we're supposed to do.

<!-- uid=350065:9:1 -->

**King:** You there! Who are you?!  
Intruders?! Seize them!  
Seize theeem!!

<!-- uid=350065:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, he finally noticed us.  
Do we really have to fight?

<!-- uid=350065:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** Okay, I know you're having a moral  
dilemma here, but they're coming  
this way. Fight, or no fight?

<!-- uid=350065:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...

<!-- uid=350065:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Wait, guys!  
I just remembered something!

<!-- uid=350065:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** They said this king was a really  
kind person until just recently.

<!-- uid=350065:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** And they also mentioned that he  
changed right after he married the  
young queen...

<!-- uid=350065:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** The queen, huh? This is the throne  
room, but I don't see her.

<!-- uid=350065:17:1 -->

**King:** Capture them! We'll execute  
them later, as an example  
to our enemies!

<!-- uid=350065:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hmm... Should we let ourselves  
get caught? It might move the  
story forward.

<!-- uid=350065:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** Sure, fine. I'd feel slightly bad  
about mowing down all these  
poor saps.

<!-- uid=350065:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, let's do it.

<!-- uid=350065:21:1 -->


## Story 350067 · \[The King of Poker\] Kirito Lv.70

Character Story

**Card Soldier:** Come with us! You're going to rot  
in the dungeon until the day of  
your execution.

<!-- uid=350067:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** So this is prison. Neat.

<!-- uid=350067:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** Eh. I've seen worse. Besides,  
it looks like you were right.  
This is part of the story.

<!-- uid=350067:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah... I just hope we can find  
a better way to end this than  
regicide.

<!-- uid=350067:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** So, I was thinking. In a lot of  
games, the king gets replaced by  
a demon or something, right?

<!-- uid=350067:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** That does happen a lot, but I  
don't think that's the case this  
time.

<!-- uid=350067:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah. If the king was a monster,  
he wouldn't have captured us.  
He'd have us killed on the spot.

<!-- uid=350067:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** Besides, that king... I think he  
was afraid of something.

<!-- uid=350067:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, I got that feeling too...

<!-- uid=350067:9:1 -->

**???:** It's all my fault...

<!-- uid=350067:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Er, am I going crazy, or did I  
just hear a woman's voice?

<!-- uid=350067:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** Try turning around. There's a  
beautiful lady in that cell  
across the way.

<!-- uid=350067:12:1 -->

**???:** Though I may not look it in here,  
I'm the queen.

<!-- uid=350067:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** What's the queen doing in a dirty  
old dungeon like this?

<!-- uid=350067:14:1 -->

**Queen:** After the king and I were wed,  
we had many a happy day  
together...

<!-- uid=350067:15:1 -->

**Queen:** The king was rather old to marry,  
but he loved me like no other.

<!-- uid=350067:16:1 -->

**Queen:** But that love became his downfall.  
It drove him mad.

<!-- uid=350067:17:1 -->

**Queen:** Eventually, he locked me in here  
and did everything in his power  
to keep others away...

<!-- uid=350067:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** Uh... What?

<!-- uid=350067:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** So, long story short, he's an  
obsessed stalker-slash-sociopath?

<!-- uid=350067:20:1 -->

**Queen:** When he forbid me from even seeing  
my parents, I spoke harsh words  
to him.

<!-- uid=350067:21:1 -->

**Queen:** That's when he imprisoned me  
in this dank dungeon...

<!-- uid=350067:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Riiight. Okay, I see what we've  
got to do here.

<!-- uid=350067:23:1 -->

**Sinon:** You do? How?

<!-- uid=350067:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** Easy. We just convince the king to  
repent from his creepy ways. And I  
know just how to do it, too...

<!-- uid=350067:25:1 -->


## Story 350068 · \[The King of Poker\] Kirito Lv.80

Character Story

**???:** My love...

<!-- uid=350068:1:1 -->

**King:** Wh-What are you doing here?!

<!-- uid=350068:2:1 -->

**Queen:** Those you just locked in the  
dungeon brought me to see you.

<!-- uid=350068:3:1 -->

**King:** What?! You again?!  
How did you escape?!

<!-- uid=350068:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** That moldy cell was practically  
falling apart. I just kicked the  
wall down, and voila.

<!-- uid=350068:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** You should've seen it, it was  
frightening. Anyway, we'll just be  
back here. Take it away, Queen.

<!-- uid=350068:6:1 -->

**Queen:** My love... I never want to leave  
your side.

<!-- uid=350068:7:1 -->

**Queen:** So please, go back to the kind  
and gentle man I used to know.

<!-- uid=350068:8:1 -->

**King:** Urk... I cannot do that!  
You're just too beautiful!

<!-- uid=350068:9:1 -->

**King:** If I let the unwashed masses gaze  
upon your celestial beauty... Why,  
I cannot even bear to imagine it!

<!-- uid=350068:10:1 -->

**King:** Thus, I cannot allow anyone, even  
our retainers, to see you! And  
ESPECIALLY not filthy invaders!

<!-- uid=350068:11:1 -->

**Queen:** Your fear is unnecessary.  
You locked me deep underground,  
and still I return to you.

<!-- uid=350068:12:1 -->

**King:** ...

<!-- uid=350068:13:1 -->

**Queen:** Even if the heavens themselves try  
to separate us... Yes, even if you  
try to separate us...

<!-- uid=350068:14:1 -->

**Queen:** With my own will and my own heart,  
I will always return to your side.

<!-- uid=350068:15:1 -->

**Queen:** And the reason is simple. Because  
I love you, and no other.

<!-- uid=350068:16:1 -->

**King:** I... I love you too! I'm so sorry!

<!-- uid=350068:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Wow, that was cheesy. It was like  
watching the worst Renaissance-era  
romantic fluff.

<!-- uid=350068:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, I'm glad it all worked out.  
I guess love conquers everything?  
Even though it was the problem?

<!-- uid=350068:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Honestly, I don't follow, but at  
least we don't have to lead a  
coup.

<!-- uid=350068:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah. That would have been  
regrettable. Probably.

<!-- uid=350068:21:1 -->

**King:** Strange travelers, you have my  
deepest apologies. I loved my  
queen so much that I grew mad...

<!-- uid=350068:22:1 -->

**King:** Thank you for helping me see the  
light. Here, take this as a token  
of my gratitude.

<!-- uid=350068:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ahh, now THIS is the ending I  
wanted to see!

<!-- uid=350068:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** Same. We'll happily accept this  
reward!

<!-- uid=350068:25:1 -->


## Story 350091 · \[Orgulous God\] Kirito Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** Rrraaaah!

<!-- uid=350091:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Whew... Man, this form really is  
amazing.

<!-- uid=350091:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, hey, Kirito. I see you're in  
that form again.

<!-- uid=350091:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, I am. I wanted to give it  
another test run.

<!-- uid=350091:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** The power of these Divine Objects  
is truly immense.

<!-- uid=350091:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** I figured once that quest was  
over, our Divine Objects would  
lose all of their strength.

<!-- uid=350091:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** But for whatever reason, that  
hasn't happened yet.

<!-- uid=350091:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** For now at least. They're so  
strong, I have to imagine they  
won't be around forever.

<!-- uid=350091:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** They might get wiped once the  
game gets updated or the devs  
defrag its data.

<!-- uid=350091:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** And so you plan to make the most  
of yours until it's gone?

<!-- uid=350091:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yep! Got to make hay while the  
sun shines. I want to put it  
through its paces while I can.

<!-- uid=350091:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, sounds fun. You're making  
me want to tackle a tough quest  
with mine now.

<!-- uid=350091:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's a good idea. Got to enjoy  
it while the fun-Huh?

<!-- uid=350091:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** What?!

<!-- uid=350091:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito! You turned back into a  
Spriggan!

<!-- uid=350091:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Augh, I can't believe it. Did they  
already fix things?

<!-- uid=350091:16:1 -->

**Odin:** He who wields my power...

<!-- uid=350091:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Aaaah! Holy crap, it's...  
it's Odin!

<!-- uid=350091:18:1 -->


## Story 350093 · \[Orgulous God\] Kirito Lv.30

Character Story

**Odin:** Indeed I am. I have taken form  
as a spirit and granted you my  
almighty power.

<!-- uid=350093:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** I guess that means the Divine  
Objects are still active in the  
game, then.

<!-- uid=350093:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Y-Yeah. Looks like it.

<!-- uid=350093:3:1 -->

**Odin:** Do you wish to borrow my strength  
in pursuit of even more formidable  
trials?

<!-- uid=350093:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** What?!

<!-- uid=350093:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** I wonder if he's talking about a  
high level quest of some sort.

<!-- uid=350093:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, right. Probably, haha. Almost  
wonder if he overheard me  
talking earlier.

<!-- uid=350093:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** In that case, yes, Odin. Grant me  
your strength. I still need it.

<!-- uid=350093:8:1 -->

**Odin:** As you wish...

<!-- uid=350093:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Whoa!

<!-- uid=350093:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm back in my Odin form.

<!-- uid=350093:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, that's good! I guess that  
means you now have Odin's personal  
seal of approval.

<!-- uid=350093:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. I shouldn't have to worry  
about these powers going away for  
the time being.

<!-- uid=350093:13:1 -->


## Story 350095 · \[Orgulous God\] Kirito Lv.50

Character Story

**Kirito:** Yeah. This is where I want to  
test our strength, Odin.

<!-- uid=350095:1:1 -->

**Odin:** But why? Why do you wish to use  
my strength here, of all places?

<!-- uid=350095:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well... because this is where it  
all began with the Divine Objects  
quest.

<!-- uid=350095:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** You can find even more high-level  
enemies running around in  
Thrymheim than on the surface.

<!-- uid=350095:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** I first came here because I heard  
about a player who defeated those  
enemy mobs singlehandedly.

<!-- uid=350095:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** And that's how I met those two and  
got involved with all of this.

<!-- uid=350095:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** With your strength, as a solo  
player, I might finally be able to  
pull off what they accomplished.

<!-- uid=350095:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's basically it. I guess you  
could say I want to get back to  
basics, return to those roots.

<!-- uid=350095:8:1 -->

**Odin:** I find your words rather difficult  
to comprehend.

<!-- uid=350095:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, I know. Sorry about that.  
I'm probably sounding a bit too  
self-centered aren't I.

<!-- uid=350095:10:1 -->

**Odin:** Be that as it may, if you intend  
fight your utmost here, I shall  
lend you my strength.

<!-- uid=350095:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Thanks, Odin. I'd appreciate it.

<!-- uid=350095:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Aright. Let's get this party  
started.

<!-- uid=350095:13:1 -->


## Story 350097 · \[Orgulous God\] Kirito Lv.70

Character Story

**Kirito:** Take this!

<!-- uid=350097:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** That should take care of all the  
enemies in this area.

<!-- uid=350097:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** The monsters in Jotunheimr are  
definitely stronger than what  
you'll find in Alfheim.

<!-- uid=350097:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** But they're still not as tough as  
the demons that showed up during  
the Divine Object quest.

<!-- uid=350097:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm not going to able to relive  
that battle after all, am I...?

<!-- uid=350097:5:1 -->

**???:** Is that you, fairy warrior?

<!-- uid=350097:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** U-Urdr! It's you again!

<!-- uid=350097:7:1 -->

**Urdr:** Indeed. What is it that brings  
you here to Jotunheimr?

<!-- uid=350097:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Uh, how do I explain it...? I came  
here to do a little battle-I mean,  
training.

<!-- uid=350097:9:1 -->

**Urdr:** Is that to say you have come to  
test your strength? To see how  
much power you wield?

<!-- uid=350097:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, that's right.

<!-- uid=350097:11:1 -->

**Urdr:** You are welcome to stay as long as  
you wish, for you and your friends  
saved this land from Thrymr.

<!-- uid=350097:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Thrymr? What are you...  
Wait a second.

<!-- uid=350097:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Uh, it's true that we did all  
fight him. But that was just one  
event.

<!-- uid=350097:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** There was another time just  
recently where we got mixed up  
with all you gods. Remember?

<!-- uid=350097:15:1 -->

**Urdr:** Hmm?

<!-- uid=350097:16:1 -->

**Urdr:** Forgive me. I don't believe I  
understand what it is you're  
trying to say.

<!-- uid=350097:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** You don't remember?! Not even a  
little bit?

<!-- uid=350097:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh... I guess it makes sense.  
None of what happened was supposed  
to be possible within ALO.

<!-- uid=350097:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** It was basically something of a  
miracle that only a handful of us  
got to experience.

<!-- uid=350097:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** With the system back to normal,  
it's like it never happened. Maybe  
that's why she doesn't remember.

<!-- uid=350097:21:1 -->

**Urdr:** Is something the matter,  
fairy warrior?

<!-- uid=350097:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, no. It's fine. I was just  
thinking to myself.

<!-- uid=350097:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** It seems like Urdr's back to the  
way she used to be, too.

<!-- uid=350097:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** She's just a plain old quest NPC  
in Jotunheimr once again...

<!-- uid=350097:25:1 -->


## Story 350098 · \[Orgulous God\] Kirito Lv.80

Character Story

**Kirito:** Urgh! What's going on?!

<!-- uid=350098:1:1 -->

**Odin:** Wait.

<!-- uid=350098:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Odin? Why are you here?

<!-- uid=350098:3:1 -->

**Urdr:** Who might you be?

<!-- uid=350098:4:1 -->

**Odin:** Urdr, goddess of the  
hill giants...

<!-- uid=350098:5:1 -->

**Odin:** I sense a great force at work  
controlling your memories. No,  
your entire being.

<!-- uid=350098:6:1 -->

**Urdr:** Forgive me. I don't believe I  
understand.

<!-- uid=350098:7:1 -->

**Odin:** Hmm... It would appear that even  
my powers cannot break down the  
barrier that I see before you.

<!-- uid=350098:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Odin, don't! You shouldn't try to  
infiltrate the system!

<!-- uid=350098:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's... to be expected that she  
would turn out like this in the  
end.

<!-- uid=350098:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's probably for the best for  
this world if she stays the way  
that she is.

<!-- uid=350098:11:1 -->

**Odin:** Hrm...

<!-- uid=350098:12:1 -->

**Odin:** Once again, Kirito, the meaning  
of your words completely eludes  
me.

<!-- uid=350098:13:1 -->

**Odin:** However, I noticed while you were  
talking with her that you bore a  
pained expression on your face.

<!-- uid=350098:14:1 -->

**Odin:** I couldn't help but wonder if her  
condition had something to do with  
it. That is all.

<!-- uid=350098:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Odin, I...

<!-- uid=350098:16:1 -->

**Odin:** Forgive me. It would appear that  
I overstepped my bounds.

<!-- uid=350098:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=350098:18:1 -->

**Urdr:** Fairy warrior?

<!-- uid=350098:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** What is it, Urdr?

<!-- uid=350098:20:1 -->

**Urdr:** The bond we have forged together  
shall one day bear fruit. I am  
certain of it.

<!-- uid=350098:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh?!

<!-- uid=350098:22:1 -->

**Urdr:** The time will come where shall  
meet again. Until then, be  
patient...

<!-- uid=350098:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** "Meet again"? What are you  
talking about?!

<!-- uid=350098:24:1 -->

**Urdr:** ...

<!-- uid=350098:25:1 -->

**Urdr:** You'd best be on your way, fairy  
warrior. Please, carry on with  
your training as before.

<!-- uid=350098:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** And just like that, she's back to  
her old self once again...

<!-- uid=350098:27:1 -->

**Kirito:** But still... Thanks, Urdr.  
And you, too, Odin. Thanks...

<!-- uid=350098:28:1 -->


## Story 360011 · \[Ultrafast Dualblades\] Kirito Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=360011:1:1 -->

**Yui:** Daddy, what's the gloomy face for?  
You're staring at the map of ALO  
very intently...

<!-- uid=360011:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** O-Oh, it's nothing really...  
I was just thinking we've seen  
almost all of this world now...

<!-- uid=360011:3:1 -->

**Yui:** Indeed! There's Alfheim, then the  
world below, Jotunheimr, and the  
world below that, Nibelheim.

<!-- uid=360011:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** And Thrymheim too, of course,  
even though it was only open for a  
limited time.

<!-- uid=360011:5:1 -->

**Yui:** Oh! We had some other events too  
where we got to travel across the  
seas to new lands.

<!-- uid=360011:6:1 -->

**Yui:** Although... We weren't able to do  
too much exploring...

<!-- uid=360011:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hm? Oh yeah, we went to the land  
of humans on that pirate quest,  
didn't we.

<!-- uid=360011:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** And then they visited us during  
the circus event too.

<!-- uid=360011:9:1 -->

**Yui:** If I recall, there aren't any  
fairies living out there.

<!-- uid=360011:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah... Which makes me wonder.  
How is that area treated within  
the setting of ALO?

<!-- uid=360011:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** I wonder if it's going to be  
"something-heim," just like the  
other areas we've been to so far.

<!-- uid=360011:12:1 -->

**Yui:** Why don't we look it up?

<!-- uid=360011:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, I see. Midgard, huh...  
In Norse mythology, that's the  
world where humans live.

<!-- uid=360011:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Heh, my interest is piqued!

<!-- uid=360011:15:1 -->

**Yui:** You don't have any other quests  
you need to clear right now,

<!-- uid=360011:16:1 -->

**Yui:** so how about we go there?

<!-- uid=360011:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah! Let's invite Asuna, too.

<!-- uid=360011:18:1 -->


## Story 360013 · \[Ultrafast Dualblades\] Kirito Lv.30

Character Story

**Kirito:** Hey, you made it.

<!-- uid=360013:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Of course! Wow, I haven't been  
here since that pirate event!

## Story 360033 · \[Gilded Hero\] Kirito Lv.30

<!-- uid=360041:15:1 -->

**Makoto:** where butterflies flutter  
all around a beautiful land...  
Something like that?

<!-- uid=360041:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yeah, that's the kind of image  
that the graphics team is  
working on.

<!-- uid=360041:17:1 -->

**Thokk:** But these angels are villains...  
This world has got to be more  
than just pretty, right?

<!-- uid=360041:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh, I guess you're right... Yeah,  
a place that's too "heavenly"  
would seem far too beautiful.

<!-- uid=360041:19:1 -->

**Thokk:** I just want a little something...  
extra. To give it more  
personality, you know?

<!-- uid=360041:20:1 -->

**Makoto:** I see... I feel like I'm as  
useless here as ever.

<!-- uid=360041:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** Well, then who do you think might  
be good to speak with?

<!-- uid=360041:22:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hmm, let's see...

<!-- uid=360041:23:1 -->


## Story 360043 · \[To the World's Core\] Kirito Lv.30

Character Story

**Leafa:** Really? And that's why you  
came to me?

<!-- uid=360043:1:1 -->

**Makoto:** Yes, because I think it's so easy  
to mix fairies and angels in  
one's mind. Even I do it.

<!-- uid=360043:2:1 -->

**Makoto:** It seems important to distinguish  
between Thokk's game and ALO.

<!-- uid=360043:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** So, I thought an old-school ALO  
player like you might understand  
this world better than any other.

<!-- uid=360043:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** W-Well, if you really think I  
could be of any help, I'd be  
happy to talk.

<!-- uid=360043:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** So... Where's Thokk?

<!-- uid=360043:6:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh, sorry. She's not here yet.

<!-- uid=360043:7:1 -->

**Makoto:** It seems like she's running late  
in a meeting with the  
development team...

<!-- uid=360043:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Oh, okay.  
In that case, Sei...

<!-- uid=360043:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** Ah, sorry, Makoto.  
Would you like to pass some time  
questing together?

<!-- uid=360043:10:1 -->

**Makoto:** Heh, it's just the two of us here.  
You can call me Sei, it's fine.  
And sure, I could quest!

<!-- uid=360043:11:1 -->

**Makoto:** You know, this might be the first  
time the two of us have quested  
together.

<!-- uid=360043:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hehe, guess so!  
Alright, let's do this!

<!-- uid=360043:13:1 -->

**Thokk:** ...

<!-- uid=360043:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** We said we'd meet here,  
but neither of them are around!

<!-- uid=360043:15:1 -->

**Thokk:** Makoto! Where did you go?!

<!-- uid=360043:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** Hm...?  
I have a message...?

<!-- uid=360043:17:1 -->

**Thokk:** I'm going to quest with Leafa,  
so come meet us here.

<!-- uid=360043:18:1 -->

**Thokk:** Tch, the nerve of that Makoto...  
Lessee now... Aw, that's so far  
from here!

<!-- uid=360043:19:1 -->

**Thokk:** I'm a busy girl, you know!  
...Then again, I am the one asking  
for her advice.

<!-- uid=360043:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** Guess I should go meet them...

<!-- uid=360043:21:1 -->


## Story 360045 · \[To the World's Core\] Kirito Lv.50

Character Story

**Makoto:** Hyah!

<!-- uid=360045:1:1 -->

**Monster:** Graah...!

<!-- uid=360045:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** Great work, Sei.  
That was the last one.

<!-- uid=360045:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** Yeah, that was pretty fun.  
I've never gotten to quest while  
flying around at night, either.

<!-- uid=360045:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeah, the quest is to defeat  
these flying monsters in  
the right order.

<!-- uid=360045:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** I did this quest a lot in the past  
to master how to fly.

<!-- uid=360045:6:1 -->

**Leafa:** Not only can you raise your flying  
level, you can enjoy ALO at night.  
Two birds with one stone, right?

<!-- uid=360045:7:1 -->

**Makoto:** You know, you're right...  
The town's lights from up here are  
so pretty...

<!-- uid=360045:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Aren't they?!  
They're on par with Tokyo  
at night!

<!-- uid=360045:9:1 -->

**???:** Heeey!

<!-- uid=360045:10:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh, it's Thokk.

<!-- uid=360045:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** Phew... I finally caught up with  
you two...

<!-- uid=360045:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** Thokk! Turn around and  
take a look!

<!-- uid=360045:13:1 -->

**Thokk:** Huh...? Whoa!  
What a view...!

<!-- uid=360045:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** I've never flown this high before,  
and I never knew ALO looked this  
pretty at night.

<!-- uid=360045:15:1 -->

**Leafa:** I heard you wanted to make it  
clear that the game you're working  
on is different from ALO,

<!-- uid=360045:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** so I thought I'd start by  
showing you everything ALO's world  
has to offer.

<!-- uid=360045:17:1 -->

**Leafa:** That's why I brought you here.

<!-- uid=360045:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** So that's what this was.

<!-- uid=360045:19:1 -->

**Thokk:** ...

<!-- uid=360045:20:1 -->


## Story 360047 · \[To the World's Core\] Kirito Lv.70

Character Story

**Thokk:** I see...  
I think I've had a breakthrough!

<!-- uid=360047:1:1 -->

**Makoto:** Huh...? In terms of how your game  
will differentiate itself  
from ALO?

<!-- uid=360047:2:1 -->

**Thokk:** Of course! Even scenes at night  
are fantastic and beautiful  
in ALO.

<!-- uid=360047:3:1 -->

**Thokk:** So in that vein, Purgatory during  
the day will be a heavenly place  
where you'd expect angels to live.

<!-- uid=360047:4:1 -->

**Thokk:** But once it's night, it'll  
transform into a weird and  
creepy world!

<!-- uid=360047:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** Wouldn't it be neat if that's  
where you see the game's wicked  
and eerie side?

<!-- uid=360047:6:1 -->

**Makoto:** I think that would be good! Then  
it really would be an embodiment  
of both heaven and hell.

<!-- uid=360047:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** Was I able to give you some good  
advice? It'd make me so happy  
if I did.

<!-- uid=360047:8:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yeah! But now that we're here,  
could I ask you some questions?

<!-- uid=360047:9:1 -->

**Thokk:** I'm thinking of going with pretty  
serious enemies, ones that'll make  
you scared just to see them.

<!-- uid=360047:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** How do you think most VRMMO  
players would feel about that?

<!-- uid=360047:11:1 -->

**Leafa:** The PvP in ALO is designed to be  
tough, but the world itself  
is a bright place.

<!-- uid=360047:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** Current ALO players might get cold  
feet if that scary stuff is  
front and center...

<!-- uid=360047:13:1 -->

**Thokk:** The enemy angels are going to  
start off as cold, unemotional  
creatures...

<!-- uid=360047:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** But they'll gradually regain  
their emotions as they face off  
against humans, the players.

<!-- uid=360047:15:1 -->

**Leafa:** Oh, I see.  
I like how dramatic that is!

<!-- uid=360047:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** I think ALO players might come  
around to it if you're able to  
find common ground with them.

<!-- uid=360047:17:1 -->

**Leafa:** Oh, and you said that players will  
have human avatars. What's the  
story with those humans?

<!-- uid=360047:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** Are they chosen heroes?  
Noble swordsmen?

<!-- uid=360047:19:1 -->

**Thokk:** No, just regular, unfortunate  
civilians who got mixed up in  
the conflict.

<!-- uid=360047:20:1 -->

**Leafa:** Whaat?! O-Oh, okay...

<!-- uid=360047:21:1 -->

**Makoto:** Not your cup of tea, Leafa?

<!-- uid=360047:22:1 -->

**Leafa:** Well...

<!-- uid=360047:23:1 -->


## Story 360048 · \[To the World's Core\] Kirito Lv.80

Character Story

**Leafa:** It's just...when users dive  
into ALO, they become flying,  
fantastic creatures.

<!-- uid=360048:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** They must dive because they want  
to become fairies, right?

<!-- uid=360048:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** Players first get into VRMMOs  
because they want to be reborn  
as something they aren't...

<!-- uid=360048:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** I think that's something we all  
have in common...so...

<!-- uid=360048:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** Well, becoming a plain villager  
would make me feel a bit let down,  
or like I've been faked out...

<!-- uid=360048:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** Agh... Your point might just  
shake the very foundation of  
my game...

<!-- uid=360048:6:1 -->

**Leafa:** Oh, sorry! I didn't mean to reject  
your game outright or anything!  
Starting out as someone weak

<!-- uid=360048:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** and climbing your way up in the  
face of giant enemies to get  
stronger is great in its own way!

<!-- uid=360048:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** But angels are so visually  
appealing, and I think you should  
make use of that.

<!-- uid=360048:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** It might be neat to at least be  
able to take their equipment and  
don what looks like holy armor?

<!-- uid=360048:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** I see...if the game starts with  
you wandering into Purgatory and  
taking the angels' equipment...

<!-- uid=360048:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** That'd mean I could make the  
main characters look cool too!

<!-- uid=360048:12:1 -->

**Makoto:** Heh, I like it. Yeah, I have to  
say it's more exciting when you  
get to wear cool clothes in-game.

<!-- uid=360048:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** I think everyone would be able to  
enjoy the game that way.

<!-- uid=360048:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yeah! I'll gather up and share  
your ideas with the dev team,  
Leafa!

<!-- uid=360048:15:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hehe! I'm just glad I could be  
of help.

<!-- uid=360048:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** Thanks a bunch!

<!-- uid=360048:17:1 -->


## Story 360061 · \[A Duty to Honor\] Kirito Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** Is it... over?

**Kirito:** Cardinal...  
Was this for the best...?

<!-- uid=360061:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...Oh, right! Eugeo!

<!-- uid=360061:3:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...

<!-- uid=360061:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Eugeo! Eugeo! Oh man, there's  
so much blood!

<!-- uid=360061:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Stop bleeding, dammit!  
Why won't it stop?!

<!-- uid=360061:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Come on, Eugeo, don't leave me!  
Eugeo!

<!-- uid=360061:7:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...Kirito.

<!-- uid=360061:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Eugeo...!

<!-- uid=360061:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hang in there. I'll heal you up  
right now!

<!-- uid=360061:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm not going to let you die...  
There's no way I'm letting you die!

<!-- uid=360061:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Eu...

**Eugeo:** Stay cool... Kirito.

<!-- uid=360061:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...!

<!-- uid=360061:14:1 -->

**Eugeo:** It's okay... This is how it should

**Eugeo:** I... fulfilled my role...

**Eugeo:** Our paths were always destined
