## Story 360063 · \[A Duty to Honor\] Kirito Lv.30

Character Story

**Eugeo:** If things hadn't turned out this  
way... you and I would have ended  
up fighting over Alice.

<!-- uid=360063:1:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Me, to restore Alice's memories...

<!-- uid=360063:2:1 -->

**Eugeo:** And you, to protect the soul of  
Alice the Integrity Knight...

<!-- uid=360063:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Then... fight me! Heal up your  
wounds and fight me! You're  
stronger than I am now!

<!-- uid=360063:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** If you need to fight me for  
Alice's sake, then--!

<!-- uid=360063:5:1 -->

**Eugeo:** My sword is already broken...  
Besides, it was my weakness that  
led to the Administrator...

<!-- uid=360063:6:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...controlling me and causing me  
to turn my sword against you.

<!-- uid=360063:7:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I have to atone for what  
I've done...

<!-- uid=360063:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** No, you don't! You didn't do  
anything wrong at all!

<!-- uid=360063:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** If you hadn't been here,  
I could never have beaten  
Chudelkin or the sword golem...

<!-- uid=360063:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...or the Administrator! There's  
nothing to blame yourself for,  
Eugeo!

<!-- uid=360063:11:1 -->

**Eugeo:** You think so...?  
I hope you're right...

<!-- uid=360063:12:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...You know, Kirito, I always  
envied you. Nobody could ever  
beat you... Everyone loved you...

<!-- uid=360063:13:1 -->

**Eugeo:** In fact, I was even scared that  
Alice might be no exception...

<!-- uid=360063:14:1 -->

**Eugeo:** But now, I finally understand.  
Love isn't something you seek.  
It's something you give.

<!-- uid=360063:15:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Alice taught me that...

<!-- uid=360063:16:1 -->

**Alice:** You stopped again, Kirito.

<!-- uid=360063:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** You're one to talk, Alice. You  
were just staring openmouthed  
at that family of cotton rabbits.

<!-- uid=360063:18:1 -->

**Alice:** No, I wasn't!

<!-- uid=360063:19:1 -->

**Alice:** Look, I'm almost done.  
What about you?

<!-- uid=360063:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm going faster than you.  
This is all I've got left.

<!-- uid=360063:21:1 -->

**Alice:** Then let's keep at it a little  
more and finish it up.

<!-- uid=360063:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey, uh... I think we should head  
back now, before he finds us.

<!-- uid=360063:23:1 -->

**Alice:** We're still okay. Let's keep at it  
just a little more, alright?

<!-- uid=360063:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** Okay, fine. But just a little.

<!-- uid=360063:25:1 -->


## Story 360065 · \[A Duty to Honor\] Kirito Lv.50

Character Story

**Alice:** All done!

<!-- uid=360065:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Done!

<!-- uid=360065:2:1 -->

**Eugeo:** So this is where you guys have  
been all day. What're you doing  
here, anyway?

**Alice:** Aww, he found us.

<!-- uid=360065:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Told you so.  
What a waste.

<!-- uid=360065:5:1 -->

**Alice:** It's not a waste.  
Here, give me that.

**Alice:** I know it's still three days from

**Eugeo:** Huh? Y-You guys made something

<!-- uid=360065:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** You told us the wooden sword your

<!-- uid=360065:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's not as good as a real sword,  
like the one your brother has,

<!-- uid=360065:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** but it's way better than any other  
wooden sword you can buy!

<!-- uid=360065:11:1 -->

**Eugeo:** You're right... It's even heavier  
than my brother's sword! This is  
amazing. I'll take good care of it.

<!-- uid=360065:12:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Thanks, you guys. This is the best  
birthday present ever...

<!-- uid=360065:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** H-Hey, come on, you don't have to  
cry about it!

<!-- uid=360065:14:1 -->

**Eugeo:** We...

<!-- uid=360065:15:1 -->

**Alice:** We were all together back then...

<!-- uid=360065:16:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Our paths may separate here, but  
our memories will always remain.

<!-- uid=360065:17:1 -->

**Alice:** I'll live on inside of you.  
So...

<!-- uid=360065:18:1 -->


## Story 360067 · \[A Duty to Honor\] Kirito Lv.70

Character Story

**Eugeo:** So... don't cry, Kirito.

<!-- uid=360067:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah... Our memories will always  
be here.

<!-- uid=360067:2:1 -->

**Eugeo:** That's right. And we'll be best  
friends forever.

<!-- uid=360067:3:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Kirito... Where are you?  
I can't see you...

<!-- uid=360067:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm here. I'm right here.

<!-- uid=360067:5:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Hey... I can see something  
glittering in the darkness...  
It looks just like stars...

<!-- uid=360067:6:1 -->

**Eugeo:** The stars I saw looking up at the  
night sky... next to the base of  
the Gigas Cedar...

<!-- uid=360067:7:1 -->

**Eugeo:** It also reminds me... of the  
way your sword gleams...

<!-- uid=360067:8:1 -->

**Eugeo:** That's it... Kirito... You should  
name your black sword the  
"Night Sky Sword"...

<!-- uid=360067:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah... That's a great name.  
Thanks, Eugeo.

<!-- uid=360067:10:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Make sure you watch over this  
tiny world... as gently as the  
night sky...

<!-- uid=360067:11:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...This was for the best, right?

<!-- uid=360067:12:1 -->

**Alice:** Yes. Don't worry. I'm sure those  
two will lead the world in the  
right direction.

<!-- uid=360067:13:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Yeah, you're right.  
Well... shall we get going?

<!-- uid=360067:14:1 -->

**Alice:** Okay.

<!-- uid=360067:15:1 -->

Character Story

**Kirito:** ...

## Story 360081 · \[Black Sword Integrity Knight\] Kirito Lv.10

Character Story

**Eugeo:** So, Integrity Knights Kirito and  
Sinon, just to make sure...

<!-- uid=360081:1:1 -->

any intruders they see, right?

**Sinon:** That's right.

<!-- uid=360081:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** What are you trying to pull here?

## Story 360095 · \[Linking Wills Sword God\] Kirito Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** Ooh, this looks just as great as

to say...

**Kirito:** I decided to try getting hit by  
an enemy attack to see how I could

**Kirito:** It's hard to say. If we take too

could beat us to the punch.

**Asuna:** True, but we can't go in blind.

<!-- uid=360095:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** I think things will go better if

the wolf when we're really ready.

<!-- uid=360095:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...Yeah, you might have a point

**Kirito:** Okay, let's follow Yuuki's

make it up the mountain.

live my life on the net though.

**Yuuki:** Sounds a lot like me!

<!-- uid=360103:8:1 -->

Do you like figures?! DO YOU  
LIKE FEATHERMAN?!

<!-- uid=360103:9:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Er, sorry... Shut-in isn't quite  
right, and I've never heard of  
Featherman. But...

<!-- uid=360103:10:1 -->

**Yuuki:** It's true that this world and my  
friends saved me.

<!-- uid=360103:11:1 -->

**Oracle:** Whoa...

<!-- uid=360103:12:1 -->

**Yuuki:** If it weren't for them, I don't  
know what would've happened to me.

<!-- uid=360103:13:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Like, I can't let Kirito there  
beat me, and Asuna's basically  
family.

<!-- uid=360103:14:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Leafa and I are besties, and Sinon  
is just SO cool. And such a cutie!

<!-- uid=360103:15:1 -->

**Oracle:** Interesting...

<!-- uid=360103:16:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hey, Oracle? How do you feel about  
all your friends?

<!-- uid=360103:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, I want to know too.

<!-- uid=360103:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** Lay it on us.

<!-- uid=360103:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** You're a closed door. Let us in!

<!-- uid=360103:20:1 -->

**Oracle:** Urgh, merciless! Interrogation  
hell! Fine! U-Uh... If I had to  
compare them to Featherman...

<!-- uid=360103:21:1 -->

**Oracle:** Joker's Red, Skull is Yellow,  
Panther is Pink, and Queen is...  
Also Pink. Noir is...Pink?

<!-- uid=360103:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Back up! I've never seen  
Featherman, but...

<!-- uid=360103:23:1 -->

**Leafa:** Why is everyone pink?!

<!-- uid=360103:24:1 -->

<!-- uid=360103:25:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Woohoo!

## Story 360105 · \[VR World Fool\] Kirito Lv.50

Character Story

**Kirito:** I've been thinking, we don't know  
each other that well yet. How about  
we share a little about ourselves?

<!-- uid=360105:1:1 -->

**Mona:** We are the great Phantom Thieves!  
We do not reveal our secrets so  
easily.

<!-- uid=360105:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, I'm guessing we're all  
around the same age. You're high  
school students, right?

<!-- uid=360105:3:1 -->

than us.

<!-- uid=360105:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** And none of you have an odd accent,  
so I'm guessing you're Tokyoites.

<!-- uid=360105:5:1 -->

**Yuuki:** They've got a lot of secrets...but  
I think they're nice people.

<!-- uid=360105:6:1 -->

**Skull:** What are you, amateur detectives?!

<!-- uid=360105:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ah, sorry. But I don't think any of  
us can resist a mystery!

<!-- uid=360105:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** We won't pry if you'd rather us  
not. But we'll tell you about  
ourselves, get the ball rolling.

<!-- uid=360105:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Then again, we're just a bunch of  
ordinary students. Well...one  
of us is a bit of a special case.

<!-- uid=360105:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** Asuna's dad's the CEO of a huge  
corporation.

<!-- uid=360105:11:1 -->

**Noir:** Oh! That's pretty tough, huh?

<!-- uid=360105:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Tough... Yeah, you could say that.

<!-- uid=360105:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** A lot is expected of me, and... I'm  
not totally free to choose my own  
life. It's a pain sometimes.

<!-- uid=360105:14:1 -->

**Noir:** Like...your parents won't let  
you pick who you marry?

<!-- uid=360105:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Urk...

<!-- uid=360105:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Nnnrgh...

<!-- uid=360105:17:1 -->

**Noir:** Bingo?

<!-- uid=360105:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** I can't...deny that...

<!-- uid=360105:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** But...what's the deal? Why the  
sudden burst of curiosity?

<!-- uid=360105:20:1 -->

**Noir:** Because I think you and I have  
a lot in common.

<!-- uid=360105:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** We do?

<!-- uid=360105:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wait a sec, Noir! That means...  
You seem so graceful and refined,  
but you're a berserk healer too?!

<!-- uid=360105:23:1 -->

**Noir:** I'm...not sure I follow?

<!-- uid=360105:24:1 -->

**Oracle:** He's calling you crazy violent.

<!-- uid=360105:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito! Why would you mention  
that?!

<!-- uid=360105:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** If they suddenly saw you transform  
from dainty debutante into violent  
killing machine, they'd freak.

<!-- uid=360105:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** Phrasing, Kirito! Come on!

<!-- uid=360105:28:1 -->

**Mona:** Well, in that case, you should know  
that Noir here is the Beauty Thief!

<!-- uid=360105:29:1 -->

**Noir:** M-Mona! D-Don't tell them that!

<!-- uid=360105:30:1 -->

**Oracle:** Beauty and the Berserker...  
Sounds like a movie.

<!-- uid=360105:31:1 -->


## Story 360107 · \[VR World Fool\] Kirito Lv.70

Character Story

**Leafa:** I had a thought when I saw your  
Persona, Queen. It might just  
help us fight better as a team!

<!-- uid=360107:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Queen's Persona? ...Oh, that!

<!-- uid=360107:2:1 -->

**Queen:** Do you want to get smacked?

'Cause she's all spiky!

<!-- uid=360107:7:1 -->

what I'm talking 'bout, right?

<!-- uid=360107:9:1 -->

me when he was worried about me

<!-- uid=360107:10:1 -->

all sorts of annoying rumors.

<!-- uid=360107:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Rumors? What sort of rumors?

<!-- uid=360107:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** A normal person wouldn't ride up

**Kirito:** Oh...  
Did people get the wrong idea?

<!-- uid=360107:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** You think?

**Sinon:** Gah?!

<!-- uid=360107:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** N-No... We're just friends.

<!-- uid=360107:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** E-Exactly! That's exactly right!

<!-- uid=360107:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** Besides, Kirito already married  
Asuna once!

<!-- uid=360107:20:1 -->

**Panther:** Th-They're married?!  
...Wait, what do you  
mean by "once"?

<!-- uid=360107:21:1 -->

**Joker:** ...They got divorced.

<!-- uid=360107:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** N-No! We got married in-game!

<!-- uid=360107:23:1 -->

**Violet:** Which means you're single in real  
life.

<!-- uid=360107:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey, Sinon? Can we choose our  
words more carefully? We'll give  
people the wrong idea.

<!-- uid=360107:25:1 -->

**Sinon:** Right...

<!-- uid=360107:26:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...Sorry, Queen. Looks like  
Leafa's idea didn't pan out after  
all.

<!-- uid=360107:27:1 -->

just thinking the same thing.

<!-- uid=360107:28:1 -->


## Story 360108 · \[VR World Fool\] Kirito Lv.80

Character Story

**Joker:** I think it's about time we took  
on that boss again.

**Kirito:** Agreed. We've gotten to know each  
other much better. We should be  
able to team up and take it out!

**Kirito:** It's over!

**Violet:** Our strategy to chat and learn

**Asuna:** The masks made me a little scared

## Story 360113 · \[Hero Rises\] Kirito Lv.30

Character Story

**Eugeo:** Elite Disciple Eugeo, of the  
North Centoria Imperial  
Swordcraft Academy.

<!-- uid=360113:1:1 -->

Integrity Knight of the  
Axiom Church in Centoria.

**Eugeo:** Alice...?

<!-- uid=360113:4:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Alice!

<!-- uid=360113:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Eugeo!

<!-- uid=360113:7:1 -->

**Alice:** ...Mind your manners, cur.  
Do not forget, I have the right  
to take up to 70% of your Life.

<!-- uid=360113:8:1 -->

**Alice:** Touch me without permission again,  
and I will cut your hand off where  
you stand.

**Eugeo:** Alice...

<!-- uid=360113:10:1 -->

**Alice:** ...

<!-- uid=360113:11:1 -->

**Alice:** I suppose I can't really call that

<!-- uid=360113:12:1 -->

**Alice:** But it's strange. I am without a  
doubt the same person I was back  
then, and yet...

<!-- uid=360113:13:1 -->

**Alice:** My thoughts and feelings now  
are entirely different from then.

<!-- uid=360113:14:1 -->

**Alice:** Perhaps meeting those two had  
changed me.

**Alice:** That technically wasn't our  
first encounter, though.

<!-- uid=360113:16:1 -->

**Alice:** (Alice Zuberg...)

<!-- uid=360113:17:1 -->

**Alice:** That was the real name of the girl  
who owned this body.

<!-- uid=360113:18:1 -->

**Alice:** But she's already gone from  
this world.

<!-- uid=360113:19:1 -->

**Alice:** My existence has been brief,  
but she had already met Kirito  
and Eugeo long ago.

<!-- uid=360113:20:1 -->

**Alice:** Of course, that girl too...

<!-- uid=360113:21:1 -->

**Alice:** My... Our precious little  
sister, Selka.

<!-- uid=360113:22:1 -->


## Story 360115 · \[Hero Rises\] Kirito Lv.50

Character Story

**Kirito:** Huh...

<!-- uid=360115:1:1 -->

**Alice:** It's about time we returned.

<!-- uid=360115:2:1 -->

**Selka:** Alice!

<!-- uid=360115:3:1 -->

**Selka:** Good morning, Alice!

<!-- uid=360115:4:1 -->

**Selka:** You too, Kirito!

<!-- uid=360115:5:1 -->

**Selka:** ...Good morning, Eugeo.

<!-- uid=360115:6:1 -->

**Alice:** Good morning, Selka. You knew  
just where to find us!

<!-- uid=360115:7:1 -->

**Alice:** (It took me more than a month to  
get used to speaking with her  
naturally...)

<!-- uid=360115:8:1 -->

**Alice:** Selka, Alice Zuberg's younger  
sister.

<!-- uid=360115:9:1 -->

**Alice:** I cherish her more than anything.

<!-- uid=360115:10:1 -->

**Alice:** But sometimes I wonder if I,  
Alice Synthesis Thirty am a mere  
imposter of Alice Zuberg.

<!-- uid=360115:11:1 -->

**Alice:** There's not a day that goes by  
that I question whether I'm worthy  
enough to call Selka my sister.

<!-- uid=360115:12:1 -->

**Alice:** But I know this much is certain,  
the feeling of warmth and love I  
feel when I'm with her is genuine.

<!-- uid=360115:13:1 -->

**Alice:** I must reach the World's End Altar  
for her sake as well.

<!-- uid=360115:14:1 -->

**Alice:** To be honest, I don't know if I'll  
ever be able to see her again...

<!-- uid=360115:15:1 -->

**Alice:** I wonder what will happen once  
I go out into the real world.

<!-- uid=360115:16:1 -->

**Alice:** ...

<!-- uid=360115:17:1 -->

**Alice:** But turning back is not an option.

<!-- uid=360115:18:1 -->

**Alice:** I must avenge Uncle.

<!-- uid=360115:19:1 -->

**Alice:** I need to restore his honor after

duel.

<!-- uid=360115:20:1 -->


## Story 360117 · \[Hero Rises\] Kirito Lv.70

Character Story

**Alice:** ...It's warm.

<!-- uid=360117:1:1 -->

**Alice:** I want to stay here a while  
longer.

<!-- uid=360117:2:1 -->

**Alice:** What is this sense of relief?  
It's like...

<!-- uid=360117:3:1 -->

**Alice:** It's as if I'm being held in  
the arms of my father.

<!-- uid=360117:4:1 -->

**Alice:** The feeling of being completely  
protected, where all is right,  
with nothing to worry about.

<!-- uid=360117:5:1 -->

**Alice:** I'd forgotten this feeling long  
ago. It's such a precious,  
wonderful feeling.

<!-- uid=360117:6:1 -->

**Alice:** But I need to wake up.  
There's something I must do.

<!-- uid=360117:7:1 -->

**Alice:** Ngh...

<!-- uid=360117:8:1 -->

**Alice:** ...Uncle?

<!-- uid=360117:9:1 -->

**Alice:** That's right! I was captured by  
Emperor Vecta and his Wyrm!

<!-- uid=360117:10:1 -->

**Alice:** You saved me, didn't you, Uncle?  
I knew you would.

<!-- uid=360117:11:1 -->

**Bercouli:** ...

<!-- uid=360117:12:1 -->

**Alice:** ...?!

<!-- uid=360117:13:1 -->

**Alice:** Un...cle...

<!-- uid=360117:14:1 -->

**Alice:** (Those aren't just old scars, he's  
covered in wounds and bleeding all  
over...)

<!-- uid=360117:15:1 -->

**Alice:** (And there's a dreadful wound  
inflicted deep into his chest.)

<!-- uid=360117:16:1 -->

**Alice:** U...Uncle!  
Commander Bercouli!

<!-- uid=360117:17:1 -->

**Alice:** His life... His life is...

<!-- uid=360117:18:1 -->

**Alice:** ...already gone.

<!-- uid=360117:19:1 -->


## Story 360118 · \[Hero Rises\] Kirito Lv.80

Character Story

**Alice:** ...

<!-- uid=360118:1:1 -->

**Alice:** The man Uncle risked his life to  
defeat possesses a strange power.

<!-- uid=360118:2:1 -->

**Alice:** The power of Resurrection. It  
really is unfair.

<!-- uid=360118:3:1 -->

**Alice:** One side risks their life while  
the other risks nothing. I will  
never acknowledge such a duel.

<!-- uid=360118:4:1 -->

**Alice:** I won't forgive him for making  
such a mockery of Uncle's death!

<!-- uid=360118:5:1 -->

**Alice:** (I came to an answer after  
reflecting on all my different  
encounters.)

<!-- uid=360118:6:1 -->

**Alice:** (This is a conclusion I reached  
on my own, not the will of Kirito,  
Asuna, Sinon and the others.)

<!-- uid=360118:7:1 -->

**Alice:** If the enemy is immortal in this  
world...

<!-- uid=360118:8:1 -->

**Alice:** Then I will have to cut him down  
in the real one.

<!-- uid=360118:9:1 -->

**Alice:** As long as I reach the World's End  
Altar, I can catch him by  
surprise.

<!-- uid=360118:10:1 -->

**Alice:** I will not tolerate a power like  
Resurrection that scorns my  
Uncle's death!

<!-- uid=360118:11:1 -->

**Alice:** I need to hurry. There isn't much  
time left.

<!-- uid=360118:12:1 -->

**Alice:** I will fight to the end for the  
sake of everyone I love!

<!-- uid=360118:13:1 -->


## Story 360151 · \[THE WORLD\] Kirito Lv.10

Character Story

**Leafa:** C'mon, let's go!

<!-- uid=360151:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** We're gonna beat this quest so I  
can become a great fortuneteller!

<!-- uid=360151:2:1 -->

<!-- uid=360151:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Looks that way. It's like she got  
really into it once the quest  
started in earnest.

<!-- uid=360151:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** Heh heh... That's exactly right!

<!-- uid=360151:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** I've been working pretty hard to

<!-- uid=360151:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...If I'm being honest with you,  
I'm surprised that you're this

<!-- uid=360151:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** I never knew you had a hobby like  
that. It's not an interest you

a girl to be interested in

**Kirito:** I guess it is a pretty common

**Leafa:** She's exactly right!

<!-- uid=360151:11:1 -->

**Leafa:** And I'm pretty sensitive to how my

**Kirito:** W-Wait, really...?

<!-- uid=360151:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** You never looked too interested  
to me when they show horoscopes

<!-- uid=360151:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** Heh heh heh... That's because I'm  
interested in other kinds of  
fortunetelling!

<!-- uid=360151:15:1 -->


## Story 360153 · \[THE WORLD\] Kirito Lv.30

Character Story

**Kirito:** In that case... What kinds are you  
interested in, specifically?

<!-- uid=360153:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** The kinds of horoscopes they show  
on the morning news just tell your  
fortune for the day...

<!-- uid=360153:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** You're right that I'm not too  
interested in that kind of  
thing, Kirito.

<!-- uid=360153:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** I like the kinds of fortunes you  
get at shrines and temples.

<!-- uid=360153:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** You know, where you make an  
offering, bow your head, and pray  
to the heavens for a good result!

<!-- uid=360153:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hmmm...?

<!-- uid=360153:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** You are the type that's into hard  
work... So you prefer your fortune  
to be something more long-term?

<!-- uid=360153:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** That's right Do your best, then  
let the heavens do the rest!

<!-- uid=360153:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Once I've done everything I can,  
it's out of my hands!

<!-- uid=360153:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Is that fortunetelling, though...?

<!-- uid=360153:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** I know what you're talking about,  
but it feels a bit different when  
religion's involved...

<!-- uid=360153:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well... It does feel like it's at  
least related.

<!-- uid=360153:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** You can kind of see a connection  
if you think of it as leaving your  
fate up to the supernatural...

<!-- uid=360153:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh... Yeah, I guess so.

<!-- uid=360153:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** They do say that a lot of people  
who get their fortunes told are

## Story 440015 · \[Raindrops Girl\] Rain Lv.50

like this that add realism.

<!-- uid=440015:8:1 -->

<!-- uid=460043:10:1 -->

**Yui:** I mean... I'm sorry. Actually,  
I would like to tell you.

<!-- uid=460043:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Okay.

<!-- uid=460043:12:1 -->

**Yui:** After you told me those things  
about Rath, and I saw those  
NPCs...

<!-- uid=460043:13:1 -->

**Yui:** I knew for certain that these new  
kinds of NPCs are eventually going  
to surpass top-down AIs.

<!-- uid=460043:14:1 -->

**Yui:** Which means their thoughts and  
feelings are essentially going to  
be the same as real people.

<!-- uid=460043:15:1 -->

**Yui:** And, watching them also made me  
realize they possess a great power  
that I just don't have.

<!-- uid=460043:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** The power of emotions...

<!-- uid=460043:17:1 -->

**Yui:** Right... The power that black  
knight used was really just ALO's  
attempt at recreating that

<!-- uid=460043:18:1 -->

**Yui:** same kind of power--the one that  
real Underworlders use.

<!-- uid=460043:19:1 -->

**Yui:** And I don't think it's possible  
for top-down AIs to ever actually  
use that kind of power.

<!-- uid=460043:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** I think I understand. But that's  
no reason for you to feel bad  
about yourself, Yui.

<!-- uid=460043:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm sure an ability like that  
would be useful in a number of  
different VR situations,

<!-- uid=460043:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** but you have your own great  
abilities, like collecting and  
analyzing information.

<!-- uid=460043:23:1 -->

**Yui:** Thank you, Mommy... That's nice of  
you to say. But, I'm afraid I  
can't bring myself to agree...

<!-- uid=460043:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** Huh...?

<!-- uid=460043:25:1 -->


## Story 460045 · \[Dual Wielding Swordsman\] Rain Lv.50

Character Story

**Yui:** The power of emotions is the most  
fundamental source of power there  
is for living beings to survive.

<!-- uid=460045:1:1 -->

**Yui:** And not in a combative sense.  
Indomitable spirit is a thought  
process that only they have...

<!-- uid=460045:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Indomitable spirit... You mean  
things like tenacity, or the  
adrenaline we get in emergencies?

<!-- uid=460045:3:1 -->

**Yui:** That's right. With an indomitable  
spirit, there are no limits to the  
strength emotions can give you.

<!-- uid=460045:4:1 -->

**Yui:** As I've come to learn more about  
the history of human civilization,  
I've come to think it's humanity's

<!-- uid=460045:5:1 -->

**Yui:** ability to make steady progress  
toward ever higher goals that sets  
them apart from other animals.

<!-- uid=460045:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** You may be right about that...  
But now you think you don't have  
that same quality yourself?

<!-- uid=460045:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Is that why you were sitting outhere by yourself, lost in thought?

<!-- uid=460045:8:1 -->

**Yui:** Yes... When I think about if the  
project that Daddy's involved in  
right now ever succeeds at making

<!-- uid=460045:9:1 -->

**Yui:** bottom-up MHCPs...I can't help but  
wonder if there will still be a  
place for me in this world...

<!-- uid=460045:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yui...! Please don't say things  
like that!

<!-- uid=460045:11:1 -->

**Yui:** Mommy...

<!-- uid=460045:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** I know what you're trying to  
say... But those kinds of  
capabilities have nothing to do

<!-- uid=460045:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** with why Kirito and I decided to  
make you our daughter.

<!-- uid=460045:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** We love you for who you are.  
Things like your kindness, your  
sheer adorableness...

<!-- uid=460045:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** We both feel incredibly blessed to  
have met you in SAO...

<!-- uid=460045:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** And I don't want to spend another  
day in my life without you in it.

<!-- uid=460045:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** So please...please don't say such  
sad things like that anymore...

<!-- uid=460045:18:1 -->

**Yui:** Mommy...  
...Okay, I won't. I'm sorry...

<!-- uid=460045:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** No, you don't have to apologize.  
I'm the one who's sorry for making  
you ever feel that way...

<!-- uid=460045:20:1 -->

**Yui:** ......

<!-- uid=460045:21:1 -->


## Story 460047 · \[Dual Wielding Swordsman\] Rain Lv.70

Character Story

**Asuna:** ......

<!-- uid=460047:1:1 -->

**Chrysheight:** I see. Thank you for the report,  
Asuna.

<!-- uid=460047:2:1 -->

<!-- uid=460047:3:1 -->

worry about.

there may indeed be many things

through study or experience,  
but that applies equally to

at that way of thinking shows that

<!-- uid=460047:19:1 -->

**Chrysheight:** Hmm... It's hard to say for sure,  
but based strictly on what you've  
told me,

<!-- uid=460047:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Here...?

<!-- uid=460047:22:1 -->


## Story 460048 · \[Dual Wielding Swordsman\] Rain Lv.80

Character Story

**Yui:** Huh...?

<!-- uid=460048:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yui, earlier you told us you were  
going into sleep mode,

<!-- uid=460048:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** but you never did, did you?

<!-- uid=460048:3:1 -->

**Yui:** Oh, uh... I'm sorry.

<!-- uid=460048:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh no, I'm not looking for an  
apology. In fact, that's where  
your greatest potential lies.

<!-- uid=460048:5:1 -->

**Yui:** ...What do you mean?

<!-- uid=460048:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** AI can never defy human will,  
no matter what kind it is. That  
goes for Underworld as well.

<!-- uid=460048:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** In fact, one of the purposes of  
Rath's project is to find out why  
that is, which is why they're

<!-- uid=460048:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** trying to find NPCs who will breakthe Taboo Index.When you told us that lie...

<!-- uid=460048:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** You did so because you didn't want  
us to worry about you. Isn't that  
right?

<!-- uid=460048:10:1 -->

**Yui:** That's right...

<!-- uid=460048:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ordinarily, an AI would never be  
capable of that...which means it  
was something only you could do.

<!-- uid=460048:12:1 -->

**Yui:** So that's why it's the key to mypotential...?

<!-- uid=460048:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Uh huh. Honestly, it made me kind  
of happy to hear that...

<!-- uid=460048:14:1 -->

**Yui:** It did?

<!-- uid=460048:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** It sure did. After all, lying to  
your parents is part of every  
child's rebellious phase, right?

<!-- uid=460048:16:1 -->

**Yui:** Huh?

<!-- uid=460048:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, it made me feel like my

<!-- uid=460048:18:1 -->

**Yui:** Um, Mommy? You know I don't age  
the same way you do, right...?

<!-- uid=460048:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** That doesn't matter! Ooh, I can't  
wait to tell Kirito about this.

<!-- uid=460048:20:1 -->

**Yui:** Oh Mommy... Hehe.  
...Thank you for telling me too.

<!-- uid=460048:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, but don't think this means you  
can go around lying all the time,  
even to be nice. Okay?

<!-- uid=460048:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** It would break my heart if  
everyone started thinking my  
daughter wasn't trustworthy!

<!-- uid=460048:23:1 -->

**Yui:** Okay, Mommy! In that case, I'll  
make sure to always talk to you  
about anything that's on my mind!

<!-- uid=460048:24:1 -->


## Story 460051 · \[Photon Sword Dancing in the Wind\] Rain Lv.10

with questions about how those

although I don't think they  
need to be so cagey about it.

<!-- uid=460051:20:1 -->

## Story 460061 · \[Mischievous EternalSummer Warrior\]Yuuki Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** H-Huh.

<!-- uid=460061:1:1 -->

## Story 460093 · \[Shimmering Dancer\] Yuuki Lv.30

Character Story

**Asuna:** Argo, the info broker we're  
talking about is an NPC.

<!-- uid=460093:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** What's there to compete with when

<!-- uid=460093:2:1 -->

**Argo:** Tsk-tsk-tsk! Ya just don't get it,

<!-- uid=460093:3:1 -->

**Argo:** Any good broker procures all the  
intel they can get, even if it's  
from an NPC. It's 'bout pride!

<!-- uid=460093:4:1 -->

**Argo:** We're always lookin' for any legit  
info that helps folks through the  
game, big or small.

<!-- uid=460093:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** R-Right...

<!-- uid=460093:6:1 -->

**Argo:** So, let's make a deal:  
tell me whatcha know!  
I'll be happy to pay ya for it!

<!-- uid=460093:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** What are you looking for? Like,  
info on stuff we've completed  
around here?

<!-- uid=460093:8:1 -->

**Argo:** Yep! And I insist on payin' ya  
for it. I don't wanna be a mooch  
just 'cause we're friends.

<!-- uid=460093:9:1 -->

**Argo:** Once I've confirmed whatever ya  
tell me is true, I'll pay a fair  
price for it. Sound reasonable?

<!-- uid=460093:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** Um...

<!-- uid=460093:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** W-Well...

<!-- uid=460093:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** What should we do?

**Yuuki:** Hmm?

<!-- uid=460093:14:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I don't get it. Why are you guys  
so hesitant? We can at least  
tell her what we--

<!-- uid=460093:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yuuki, no! Stop! Don't say  
another word!

**Argo:** Sure, no prob. Take yer time.  
The more ya remember, the  
more it's worth it fer me too.

<!-- uid=460093:18:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I don't get it. Why don't you guys  
want to say anything to her?

<!-- uid=460093:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** You realize what she does, right?  
She's a merchant who buys and  
sells info to other players.

<!-- uid=460093:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Meaning that whatever we tell  
her about the caravan quests we  
did won't be a secret.

<!-- uid=460093:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** She'll share that information with  
other players if they pay her  
enough for it.

<!-- uid=460093:22:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Yeah, so?

<!-- uid=460093:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** Remember what we talked about at  
the ruins? About that relic we  
found in there?

<!-- uid=460093:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** There's a reason we decided to  
leave that diary behind instead  
of taking it with us.

<!-- uid=460093:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** We thought it was best to let  
it remain in its original home  
since it's so personal.

<!-- uid=460093:26:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Right, of course... Oh, I get  
why you're all so worried now!

<!-- uid=460093:27:1 -->

**Yuuki:** If more people find out about  
those ruins, someone else might  
find that diary and take it.

<!-- uid=460093:28:1 -->

**Leafa:** Mm-hm. It's not that we don't

people to share that info with.

<!-- uid=460093:29:1 -->

**Leafa:** The problem is who THOSE people

out of hand really quickly.

<!-- uid=460093:30:1 -->

**Yuuki:** That's why you think we  
shouldn't talk about it with  
anyone else.

<!-- uid=460093:31:1 -->

**Kirito:** Exactly. I don't think we should  
mention the waterway we took,  
either, just to be safe.

<!-- uid=460093:32:1 -->

**Kirito:** We can tell her about the other

<!-- uid=460093:33:1 -->

**Asuna:** Y-Yeah. Hopefully that'll be enough

so curious.

<!-- uid=460093:34:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's what I'm thinking. Just be  
careful how you word things when  
we speak to her.

<!-- uid=460093:35:1 -->

**Kirito:** She's clever and she'll use every

monsters? But I don't remember  
anything like that in Cinderella.

with conversation there.

Leafa!

**Leafa:** Okay. I'll see you later!

## Story 460133 · \[Rose Bearing Beauty\] Rain Lv.30

Character Story

**Rain:** Hmmm?

**Rain:** I thought I just left the dance  
hall, but now I'm at another  
one...?

<!-- uid=460133:7:1 -->

<!-- uid=460133:8:1 -->

**Rain:** D-Did I need to bring a guy to

skills at a ball?

<!-- uid=460133:10:1 -->

**Rain:** Oh...

<!-- uid=460133:11:1 -->

**Rain:** Yeah, you're right... I guess

women and men dancing together...

<!-- uid=460133:12:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** For this quest, there's not any  
particular requirement for your  
partner to be of the opposite sex.

<!-- uid=460133:14:1 -->

**Rain:** What?!

**Rain:** B-But I've never danced

<!-- uid=460133:16:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** That won't be a problem! For I

for dance!

<!-- uid=460133:17:1 -->

**Rain:** Wh-Why would I have something like

danced before in my life!

<!-- uid=460133:18:1 -->

**Rain:** (Agh! This is NOT good! Why would  
I ever have chosen to raise a  
weird stat like dancing?!)

<!-- uid=460133:19:1 -->

**Rain:** \*pant\*, \*pant\*, \*pant\*...

<!-- uid=460133:20:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** ...

<!-- uid=460133:21:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** You pass! What a talent for  
dance you have!

<!-- uid=460133:22:1 -->

**Rain:** R-Really...? I mean, even I'm

actually dance, but...

<!-- uid=460133:23:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** Would I lie to you? I find it hard

**Dancing Queen:** It seems you've been making sure

<!-- uid=460133:25:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** That, or... Your choice of dress  
was well-suited for this trial.

<!-- uid=460133:26:1 -->

**Rain:** Ah...!

<!-- uid=460133:27:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** Now go, my beautiful princess!

find your prince!

<!-- uid=460133:28:1 -->

**Rain:** Wow! She was right! This dress

<!-- uid=460133:29:1 -->

**Rain:** That's Belle's dress for you!  
I guess the dance scenes are a big  
part of Beauty and the Beast.

<!-- uid=460133:30:1 -->

**Rain:** Anyway, that's one down! I just  
wonder if Asuna and Leafa are  
doing okay...

<!-- uid=460133:31:1 -->


## Story 460135 · \[Rose Bearing Beauty\] Rain Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** ...So this does take place in  
a kitchen.

<!-- uid=460135:1:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** You're late!! Hurry up and get  
to work!!

<!-- uid=460135:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Excuse me...?

<!-- uid=460135:3:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Don't just stand there! All the  
ingredients have already been  
prepared, so make what you want!

<!-- uid=460135:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Y-You want me to cook?

<!-- uid=460135:5:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Hah! What else do you expect to  
do in a kitchen?!

<!-- uid=460135:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, I guess I did kind of  
expect this, but...

<!-- uid=460135:7:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Did you? Then good! So come on  
now, chop chop!

<!-- uid=460135:8:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** But, well... I don't think I'll  
be getting my hopes too high.

<!-- uid=460135:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Grr...

<!-- uid=460135:10:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Oh? You seem displeased. Why don't  
you take a look at your inventory.

<!-- uid=460135:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hm? Okay, sure...  
Let's see what kind of ingredients  
I have... Ah!

<!-- uid=460135:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's...all fish?!

<!-- uid=460135:13:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** That's right! What an unlucky  
turn, my Little Mermaid!

<!-- uid=460135:14:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Seems your choice of dress was  
a poor one. I think you've made  
things quite hard for yourself.

<!-- uid=460135:15:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Well, just hurry it up. Get your  
inevitable failure over and done  
with.

<!-- uid=460135:16:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** I expect many more challengers to  
come after you, after all!

<!-- uid=460135:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...Hmm. Fish, fish, fish...

<!-- uid=460135:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** Fine, then. "Chop chop", you said?  
I'll show you what it means to  
chop!

<!-- uid=460135:19:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Th-This is...!

<!-- uid=460135:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** I was thinking of making something  
simmered, or maybe a bouillabaisse  
if I had time, but...

<!-- uid=460135:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** You wanted me to be fast, so I  
made a simple meuniere.  
How was it?

<!-- uid=460135:22:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Simple...?! Hmph, what false  
modesty!

<!-- uid=460135:23:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Your ability to judge the freshest  
and most suitable fish for your  
meuniere out of the inventory!

<!-- uid=460135:24:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Your brilliant preparation skills  
that allowed you to craft this  
perfectly! It's all incredible!

<!-- uid=460135:25:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** The simplicity of the dish means  
that it's all about the  
fundamentals! This is brilliant!

<!-- uid=460135:26:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Your Little Mermaid dress should  
have debuffed your skills when  
cooking with fish, though...!

<!-- uid=460135:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yes, but I made do. I'm always  
working on my cooking, after all.

<!-- uid=460135:28:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** ...Hm! I've been soundly defeated.  
Cinderella must have the ability  
to cook, after all.

<!-- uid=460135:29:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** It was a wonderful dish. I hope  
you continue to hone your skills  
in the kitchen.

<!-- uid=460135:30:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...Phew. I somehow managed to make  
it through that one...

<!-- uid=460135:31:1 -->

**Asuna:** The Little Mermaid dress's debuff  
to cooking fish was pretty  
severe...

<!-- uid=460135:32:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'd never worried that much while  
sautéing fish before in my life...

<!-- uid=460135:33:1 -->

**Asuna:** I guess I have those ingredients  
to thank. I feel like I've learned  
an important lesson today...

<!-- uid=460135:34:1 -->


## Story 460137 · \[Rose Bearing Beauty\] Rain Lv.70

Character Story

**Leafa:** Um, so this is where this

place...

<!-- uid=460137:1:1 -->

**Sweeping Queen:** You're finally here.

you've got.

**Sweeping Queen:** That's right.

what I've got, so...

**Sweeping Queen:** It seems you're greatly mistaken

**Sweeping Queen:** A dustcloth? Do you see wooden

<!-- uid=460137:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** Aw, man! C'mon...  
Wh-Whoa!

<!-- uid=460137:19:1 -->

**Leafa:** Agh... Rapunzel's hair...

**Leafa:** (Well, I guess it would be long  
enough to at least reach  
the floor...)

<!-- uid=460137:22:1 -->

**Leafa:** (Hm...? W-Wait... When Rapunzel's

<!-- uid=460137:23:1 -->

**Leafa:** (Oh, that's it! Rapunzel has magic

<!-- uid=460137:24:1 -->

**Leafa:** (In other words, if I used  
Rapunzel's hair instead of a mop,  
then this quest would be easy...!)

**Leafa:** ...

<!-- uid=460137:26:1 -->

**Sweeping Queen:** What's the matter? Why are you

<!-- uid=460137:27:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...Sorry! I just got distracted

<!-- uid=460137:28:1 -->

**Leafa:** Um, do you have any hairbands?  
I forgot mine...

<!-- uid=460137:29:1 -->

**Leafa:** I can't let a princess's wonderful  
hair get dirty, even if it is to  
complete a quest, you know!

<!-- uid=460137:30:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...Not that Rapunzel's hair can  
get dirty in the first place, but  
it's the thought that counts!

<!-- uid=460137:31:1 -->

**Leafa:** So... I'm going to tough this out  
and complete this quest!

<!-- uid=460137:32:1 -->

**Sweeping Queen:** Hm... Not bad at all.

<!-- uid=460137:33:1 -->

**Sweeping Queen:** Rather inefficient, but you made  
your way through by sheer force.  
Honestly, I'm surprised.

<!-- uid=460137:34:1 -->

**Sweeping Queen:** A princess must have dignity.  
And...I think I saw a bit of that  
from you today.

<!-- uid=460137:35:1 -->

**Leafa:** Phew... I'm glad that worked.

<!-- uid=460137:36:1 -->

I need to hurry up and meet back

## Story 460138 · \[Rose Bearing Beauty\] Rain Lv.80

Character Story

## Story 460141 · \[Vampire of Nobility\] Alice Lv.10

**Ronie:** Yeah...! Thanks, Tiese!

## Story 460143 · \[Vampire of Nobility\] Alice Lv.30

Character Story

**Tiese:** Still, I have to say that  
Halloween has the strangest  
decorations.

**Ronie:** Yeah. The town was decorated to

but...

**Ronie:** This area's been made to look

**Tiese:** I guess this can be a part of  
Halloween too? There's so  
much depth to this festival.

<!-- uid=460143:5:1 -->

**Ronie:** Hm? What do you mean?

**Tiese:** Like I mentioned, the decorations.

**Ronie:** Oh, you're right...

<!-- uid=460143:8:1 -->

**Ronie:** Ah, what were these again...?

**Ronie:** Yes. Pumpkins used as Halloween

**Ronie:** Oh, that's what it was!

<!-- uid=460143:12:1 -->

**Tiese:** Um... I don't think I've ever

<!-- uid=460143:13:1 -->

**Ronie:** ...

**Ronie:** She... never told me.

**Tiese:** Oh... Well, that's not too

**Tiese:** Does that mean you're wearing one

<!-- uid=460143:18:1 -->

**Ronie:** ...I'm actually not sure.

<!-- uid=460143:19:1 -->

**Tiese:** You don't know anything about  
what's going on here, do you...?

<!-- uid=460143:20:1 -->

**Ronie:** Heh heh...

<!-- uid=460143:21:1 -->

**Tiese:** Sheesh, Ronie... I see you're as

<!-- uid=460143:22:1 -->

**Ronie:** Whaat?! That's so mean, Tiese!

<!-- uid=460143:23:1 -->

**Tiese:** No, it's not! I'm just saying

<!-- uid=460143:24:1 -->

**Ronie:** Hrrmph...!

<!-- uid=460143:25:1 -->


## Story 460145 · \[Vampire of Nobility\] Alice Lv.50

Character Story

**Tiese:** Hmm hmm hmm...!

**Tiese:** Meow, meow!

<!-- uid=460145:2:1 -->

**Ronie:** ?!

<!-- uid=460145:3:1 -->

**Ronie:** Tiese...? What was that just  
now...?!

**Ronie:** You were humming and meowing just

**Tiese:** N-No way! That'd be too

of thing.

**Argo:** Yu, a maiden's heart is never a  
simple thing.

<!-- uid=460168:17:1 -->

**Yuuki:** R-Really? I don't know much about  
that kinda stuff...

<!-- uid=460168:18:1 -->

**Argo:** I wouldn't say that. And it ain't  
nothing ya need to worry 'bout  
neither.

<!-- uid=460168:19:1 -->

**Argo:** Especially during Christmas, okay?  
It'll just cause ya unnecessary  
stress if ya feel that way.

<!-- uid=460168:20:1 -->

**Argo:** I think there're a lotta people  
who feel jealous of ya, Yu.

<!-- uid=460168:21:1 -->

**Yuuki:** ...Is that how it is?

<!-- uid=460168:22:1 -->

**Argo:** That's how it is.

<!-- uid=460168:23:1 -->

**Yuuki:** O-Okay...

<!-- uid=460168:24:1 -->


## Story 460171 · \[Battle-Hardened Pirate Maiden\] Alice Lv.10

Character Story

**Alice:** Eugeo! I swear, have you lost all  
of your pride as an Integrity  
Knight?!

<!-- uid=460171:1:1 -->

**Alice:** Just what are you thinking,  
forgoing your sword training to  
help with a rice harvest?!

<!-- uid=460171:2:1 -->

**Alice:** Truly, you are, as they say,  
getting rather soft!

<!-- uid=460171:3:1 -->

**Alice:** Honestly! The whole thing is quite  
shameful!

<!-- uid=460171:4:1 -->

**Alice:** \*sigh\* This isn't good.

<!-- uid=460171:5:1 -->

**Alice:** (It's been several days since the  
incident, and yet things still  
feel strained between he and I.)

<!-- uid=460171:6:1 -->

**Alice:** All he would have to do is simply  
apologize and then we could put  
the whole thing behind us.

<!-- uid=460171:7:1 -->

**Alice:** So what's stopping him from doing  
so, I wonder?

<!-- uid=460171:8:1 -->

**Alice:** By now, Eugeo must recognize just  
how foolish he's been...right?

<!-- uid=460171:9:1 -->

**Alice:** Perhaps I need to simply give him  
a little more time.

<!-- uid=460171:10:1 -->

**Alice:** Surely he'll come and apologize  
of his own accord... Surely.

<!-- uid=460171:11:1 -->


## Story 460173 · \[Battle-Hardened Pirate Maiden\] Alice Lv.30

Character Story

**Alice:** Ugh, just what in the world is  
going on here?

<!-- uid=460173:1:1 -->

**Alice:** This is the first time we've had  
such a spat since coming over to  
this world.

<!-- uid=460173:2:1 -->

**Alice:** Really, the quarrel itself isn't  
even all that big in the grand  
scheme of things.

<!-- uid=460173:3:1 -->

**Alice:** Is he being stubborn, then?  
Is that what's going on?

<!-- uid=460173:4:1 -->

**Alice:** No matter how one looks at it,  
I feel it isn't an issue worth  
digging in his heels. Hmm...

<!-- uid=460173:5:1 -->

**Alice:** I may be left with no choice.  
Perhaps I must be the one to back  
down in this instance.

<!-- uid=460173:6:1 -->

**Alice:** As an Integrity Knight, I have  
seniority over him. Times such as  
this demand some magnanimity.

<!-- uid=460173:7:1 -->

**Alice:** I suppose I ought to bring him  
a gift of some sort as a sign of  
good faith.

<!-- uid=460173:8:1 -->

**Alice:** But what? Food, perhaps? No,  
there aren't very many good  
options to choose from here.

<!-- uid=460173:9:1 -->

**Alice:** Hm?

<!-- uid=460173:10:1 -->

**Alice:** Come to think of it, unlike my  
Osmanthus Blade, his Blue Rose  
Sword is yet to be found, huh?

<!-- uid=460173:11:1 -->


## Story 460175 · \[Battle-Hardened Pirate Maiden\] Alice Lv.50

Character Story

**Alice:** Hm...

<!-- uid=460175:1:1 -->

**Alice:** It may well be the case that  
without his trusted sword, he  
can't focus well on his training.

<!-- uid=460175:2:1 -->

**Alice:** As knights, our Divine Objects  
through which our sacred power  
flows is of utmost importance.

<!-- uid=460175:3:1 -->

**Alice:** Even if similar things can be  
achieved somewhat with weapons  
here, they remain no substitute.

<!-- uid=460175:4:1 -->

**Alice:** Yes, perhaps his sword indeed lies  
at the heart of the problem.

<!-- uid=460175:5:1 -->

**Alice:** (From what I gather, the sword  
he's using now isn't particularly  
all that outstanding.)

<!-- uid=460175:6:1 -->

**Alice:** It's a shame. If he must go  
without his Blue Rose Sword, he  
deserves another of equal caliber.

<!-- uid=460175:7:1 -->

**Alice:** Mmhm... You know, that gives me  
a rather excellent idea!

<!-- uid=460175:8:1 -->

**Alice:** I shall gift Eugeo a sword. Surely  
that will convince him to invest  
in his training fully again!

<!-- uid=460175:9:1 -->

**Alice:** But in order to do that, I require  
the aid of someone who is well-  
versed in swords.

<!-- uid=460175:10:1 -->


## Story 460177 · \[Battle-Hardened Pirate Maiden\] Alice Lv.70

Character Story

**Liz:** Hm... Hm...

<!-- uid=460177:1:1 -->

**Liz:** I think I get the situation.  
I agree! What you need to set  
things straight is a good sword!

<!-- uid=460177:2:1 -->

**Silica:** But as a gift? Really?

<!-- uid=460177:3:1 -->

**Silica:** If I were in her shoes, I'd try  
giving something like candy to  
smooth things over...

<!-- uid=460177:4:1 -->

**Liz:** Bah, what're you talking about?  
There's nothing better than a  
sword when we're in a VRMMO!

<!-- uid=460177:5:1 -->

**Silica:** I mean, sure, I'm always super  
happy when someone gives me nice  
gear online, too, but still.

<!-- uid=460177:6:1 -->

**Alice:** Having said that, Eugeo is also  
the type of fellow who would be  
happy to receive almost anything.

<!-- uid=460177:7:1 -->

**Silica:** True. He's not the pickiest guy  
around, that's for sure.

<!-- uid=460177:8:1 -->

**Liz:** Yeah, he's a real sweetheart like  
that when you get down to it.

<!-- uid=460177:9:1 -->

**Alice:** Indeed, obstinate and indecisive  
at times though he may be.

<!-- uid=460177:10:1 -->

**Alice:** Still, I feel a sword would make  
for a fine gift. It's what he  
needs most right now.

<!-- uid=460177:11:1 -->

**Liz:** Yeah, I agree! The sword he's got  
now doesn't strike me as a good  
match for his strength.

<!-- uid=460177:12:1 -->

**Liz:** Any replacement sword should be  
ice element to complement his  
combat style. Knowing that...

<!-- uid=460177:13:1 -->

**Liz:** What about giving him an Ice Floe  
Sword? Let me dig up an image  
for you... Here! This bad boy!

<!-- uid=460177:14:1 -->

**Alice:** ...Oh!

<!-- uid=460177:15:1 -->

**Alice:** This sword...its appearance quite  
resembles that of the Blue Rose  
Sword. How intriguing.

<!-- uid=460177:16:1 -->

**Liz:** Really? That's kind of nuts.

<!-- uid=460177:17:1 -->

**Silica:** Maybe it's drawing upon a similar  
source of inspiration.

<!-- uid=460177:18:1 -->

**Liz:** Maybe, yeah. When you look at it  
more closely, the finer details  
are common across most any world.

<!-- uid=460177:19:1 -->

**Liz:** Alright, let's go ahead with  
giving Eugeo this sword, if that  
works for you.

<!-- uid=460177:20:1 -->

**Liz:** Give me just a few moments. I have  
to check the materials I'll need  
to forge it first.

<!-- uid=460177:21:1 -->

**Alice:** Very well. Thank you, Lisbeth.  
I'm counting on you!

<!-- uid=460177:22:1 -->


## Story 460178 · \[Battle-Hardened Pirate Maiden\] Alice Lv.80

Character Story

**Liz:** Er, I think we might have  
a problem.

<!-- uid=460178:1:1 -->

**Alice:** What is it? Do you not have enough  
of the materials that you need?

<!-- uid=460178:2:1 -->

**Liz:** Yeah. My stockpile of the most  
important part's run dry.

<!-- uid=460178:3:1 -->

**Alice:** If you need to gather more,  
please, don't hesitate to dispatch  
me. I don't mind in the least.

<!-- uid=460178:4:1 -->

**Alice:** I'm prepared to do whatever it  
takes, even if I must go forth  
and slay a dragon or some such.

<!-- uid=460178:5:1 -->

**Liz:** Oh no, it's nothing that'll be  
that hard to get our hands on,  
I promise.

<!-- uid=460178:6:1 -->

**Liz:** What I need is a Frozen Gem.

<!-- uid=460178:7:1 -->

**Liz:** It's a quest reward, specifically  
for a quest called "The Seven  
Seaside Treasures."

<!-- uid=460178:8:1 -->

**Liz:** Basically, it's what you get for  
completing a treasure hunting  
quest.

<!-- uid=460178:9:1 -->

**Alice:** Treasure hunting, you say? I see.

<!-- uid=460178:10:1 -->

**Liz:** It's not a particularly hard  
quest, but it's a real pain in the  
butt for two big reasons.

<!-- uid=460178:11:1 -->

**Liz:** First is how there are seven  
potential rewards and the one you  
want isn't guaranteed to drop.

<!-- uid=460178:12:1 -->

**Liz:** But it's also hard to trigger.  
It can occur on any coastline AND  
the timing is a complete mystery!

<!-- uid=460178:13:1 -->

**Silica:** Yeesh! You mean to tell me it's  
basically a random quest? That  
IS a pain.

<!-- uid=460178:14:1 -->

**Liz:** Yep! Between the random reward  
drops and unpredictable timing,  
it's a real stinker for sure!

<!-- uid=460178:15:1 -->

**Silica:** Wow, talk about brutal. I don't  
envy you girls having to do it.

<!-- uid=460178:16:1 -->

**Alice:** Pardon me for interrupting, but  
are these conditions you mention  
really that harsh in practice?

<!-- uid=460178:17:1 -->

**Liz:** Absolutely! The randomness of  
getting it to trigger at all is  
the first major hurdle.

<!-- uid=460178:18:1 -->

**Liz:** You have to visit coastlines  
across the globe in the hope  
you'll get the quest at all.

<!-- uid=460178:19:1 -->

**Liz:** Not to mention, you specifically  
can't leave Midgard, right, Alice?

<!-- uid=460178:20:1 -->

**Alice:** That is true. Otherwise I need not  
have had you two come out here to  
see me today.

<!-- uid=460178:21:1 -->

**Liz:** Exactly. If you could visit other  
regions, then accepting the quest  
would actually be pretty easy.

<!-- uid=460178:22:1 -->

**Liz:** But then even with that out of  
the way, there's still the issue  
of the randomized reward!

<!-- uid=460178:23:1 -->

**Liz:** Each time you beat the quest, you  
only get one of the seven rewards.  
Now do you follow me?

<!-- uid=460178:24:1 -->

**Alice:** Yes... Yes I do. When you put it  
like that, that does sound rather  
arduous.

<!-- uid=460178:25:1 -->

**Liz:** To say the least. Personally, I'd  
rather we go with a different  
sword for Eugeo if it's possible.

<!-- uid=460178:26:1 -->

**Alice:** Hm... Let me ask you this: are  
there any other swords that  
resemble the Blue Rose Sword?

<!-- uid=460178:27:1 -->

**Liz:** Not that I can think of. When it  
comes to high-end weapons, that's  
really the only match for it.

<!-- uid=460178:28:1 -->

**Alice:** Fair enough. In that case, I would  
prefer if we stick to this sword.  
I think it'd be best for him.

<!-- uid=460178:29:1 -->

**Alice:** I believe that having it would  
give him more chances to  
remember our old world.

<!-- uid=460178:30:1 -->

**Alice:** Personally, it also feels like  
fate, in a sense, that this sword  
resembles his old one so much.

<!-- uid=460178:31:1 -->

**Liz:** All right, I hear you. If that's  
how you feel, I'm prepared to do  
what it takes to make it.

<!-- uid=460178:32:1 -->

**Liz:** Not just as a blacksmith, but as a  
friend! You, too, Silica! We're  
grinding this quest together!

<!-- uid=460178:33:1 -->

**Silica:** Say what? Do I really have to?!

<!-- uid=460178:34:1 -->

**Liz:** Yep! If you didn't want to help  
out, you shouldn't have come with  
me to Midgard to kill time!

<!-- uid=460178:35:1 -->

**Silica:** Grr... Oh, all right. I'm in.

<!-- uid=460178:36:1 -->

**Silica:** I want Alice and Eugeo to patch  
things up as much as anyone else  
here. Let's do this!

<!-- uid=460178:37:1 -->

**Alice:** Thank you very much, both of you.  
Your support is truly heartening!

<!-- uid=460178:38:1 -->

**Alice:** (Now I can only pray this will  
indeed lead to Eugeo and I  
mending things at last...)

<!-- uid=460178:39:1 -->


## Story 460191 · \[Diligent Subculture Maid\] Rain Lv.10

Character Story

**Asuna:** Hmm. You know, now that I think  
about it...

<!-- uid=460191:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** We've had a lot more chances to  
wear maid outfits than most  
people, haven't we?

<!-- uid=460191:2:1 -->

**Silica:** Now that you mention it, we really  
have. It almost feels like a  
cosplay staple for us by now.

<!-- uid=460191:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Right? It's starting to seem like  
part of our routine.

<!-- uid=460191:4:1 -->

**Silica:** Yeah. Maybe part of that for me  
is that maid outfits aren't too  
far off from my usual clothes.

<!-- uid=460191:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe. And I like how there's so  
much variety in their designs.

<!-- uid=460191:6:1 -->

**Silica:** Yeah! There are so many variations  
just with color alone. No two  
outfits ever look alike!

<!-- uid=460191:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Maybe they're a staple because we  
never get tired of wearing them.

<!-- uid=460191:8:1 -->

**Rain:** So now you two are maid outfit  
experts without actually being  
maids? What's that all about?

<!-- uid=460191:9:1 -->

**Rain:** As an actual, real-life maid,  
there's a whole lot more I could  
say...but I'll let it go for now.

<!-- uid=460191:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ahaha...

<!-- uid=460191:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, I can understand how you  
feel, but I really do have a lot  
of maid-themed equipment.

<!-- uid=460191:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Though, as you might expect,  
I can't say I have many real-life  
opportunities to wear it.

<!-- uid=460191:13:1 -->

**Silica:** Yeah, maid outfits in games are  
one thing, but I think I'd be too  
embarrassed to wear one for real.

<!-- uid=460191:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Right? There are so many skimpy  
equipment sets in games that we're  
all just kind of used to them...

<!-- uid=460191:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** But wearing an outfit like that in  
real life is a different story,  
you know?

<!-- uid=460191:16:1 -->

**Silica:** I know exactly what you mean.

<!-- uid=460191:17:1 -->

**Rain:** Hey, come on. If you're ashamed  
to wear maid outfits in real life,  
what's that say about me?

<!-- uid=460191:18:1 -->

**Rain:** Personally, I feel like I'm the  
epitome of chastity whenever  
I put on my maid outfit.

<!-- uid=460191:19:1 -->


## Story 460193 · \[Diligent Subculture Maid\] Rain Lv.30

Character Story

**Rain:** And for the record, lots of girls  
apply to work at my cafe just  
for the uniforms!

<!-- uid=460193:1:1 -->

**Silica:** Whoa... R-Really?

<!-- uid=460193:2:1 -->

**Silica:** I always figured it was  
because the pay was good!

<!-- uid=460193:3:1 -->

**Rain:** Th-That's an insult to maids  
everywhere!

<!-- uid=460193:4:1 -->

**Silica:** W-Well, working at a maid  
cafe is a job, after all!

<!-- uid=460193:5:1 -->

**Silica:** The salary is an important  
thing to consider!

<!-- uid=460193:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** True. You really can't ignore  
that side of it.

<!-- uid=460193:7:1 -->

**Rain:** Hmph. Well, I'm not gonna lie.  
The pay's not bad.

<!-- uid=460193:8:1 -->

**Rain:** But you also have to work a lot  
harder than you would at a normal  
cafe.

<!-- uid=460193:9:1 -->

**Rain:** It only makes sense  
that we be appropriately  
compensated.

<!-- uid=460193:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...Wait. Are you having money  
trouble, Silica?

<!-- uid=460193:11:1 -->

**Silica:** Huh?! Wh-Where did that come from,  
Asuna?!

<!-- uid=460193:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** I mean, you latched onto the  
financial side of the issue  
pretty quickly, so...

<!-- uid=460193:13:1 -->

**Silica:** Do you really think I'd be here  
gaming if I was struggling to  
make ends meet in real life?!

<!-- uid=460193:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** I, um, guess you've got a point.

<!-- uid=460193:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sorry for the weird question.  
Although now it's got me  
thinking about jobs...

<!-- uid=460193:16:1 -->


## Story 460195 · \[Diligent Subculture Maid\] Rain Lv.50

Character Story

**Rain:** Hm? Are you thinking of  
getting a part-time job  
of your own, Asuna?

<!-- uid=460195:1:1 -->

**Silica:** Huh?! Asuna, you're going to  
work part-time?!

<!-- uid=460195:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, no, I can't. My parents  
would never let me.

<!-- uid=460195:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** I had to negotiate a whole bunch  
of ground rules with my mom  
just to play VRMMOs.

<!-- uid=460195:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** I don't even want to imagine how  
long it'd take to convince her to  
let me work outside the house.

<!-- uid=460195:5:1 -->

**Silica:** Makes sense...

<!-- uid=460195:6:1 -->

**Rain:** It's a valuable life experience  
though...

<!-- uid=460195:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, I think so too. That's  
why I'd like to try.

<!-- uid=460195:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** I mean, I'm going to have to leave  
home and find a job at some  
point, right?

<!-- uid=460195:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** I figure the more experience I  
can get now, the better.

<!-- uid=460195:10:1 -->

**Rain:** That's a great attitude.

<!-- uid=460195:11:1 -->

**Rain:** Why don't you come work at my

**Asuna:** Huh?! M-Me, work at a maid cafe?

**Asuna:** I-I think I'll have to pass.  
There's no way I could convince  
my parents to go for that!

<!-- uid=460195:14:1 -->

**Rain:** Oh, yeah, probably not, huh.

<!-- uid=460195:15:1 -->

**Rain:** I guess a maid cafe would be a  
pretty tall order for your very  
first part-time job...

<!-- uid=460195:16:1 -->


## Story 460197 · \[Diligent Subculture Maid\] Rain Lv.70

Character Story

**Asuna:** I'm sorry. I really do think it's  
a lovely line of work, though...

<!-- uid=460197:1:1 -->

**Silica:** It's basically a service industry  
job, right?

<!-- uid=460197:2:1 -->

**Rain:** Yup! But the big draw, of course,  
is that the service is provided by  
maids.

<!-- uid=460197:3:1 -->

**Rain:** Honestly, Silica, I don't think  
any of us are there just for  
the paycheck, like you'd be.

<!-- uid=460197:4:1 -->

**Silica:** I-I don't care about the paycheck  
THAT much!

<!-- uid=460197:5:1 -->

**Rain:** Ahaha, I'm just messing with you.

<!-- uid=460197:6:1 -->

**Rain:** But, you know, most of the girls  
who work at my cafe really do have  
big dreams for their futures.

<!-- uid=460197:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** They do?

<!-- uid=460197:8:1 -->

**Rain:** Yup! Take me, for example. I'm  
still working on my dream of  
becoming an idol one day.

<!-- uid=460197:9:1 -->

**Silica:** So most of them are building  
up experience to shoot  
for even bigger goals?

<!-- uid=460197:10:1 -->

**Rain:** Yeah, exactly!

<!-- uid=460197:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...I guess people really do put  
a lot of thought into the  
choices they make.

<!-- uid=460197:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** (Dreams for the future, huh...?)

<!-- uid=460197:13:1 -->

**Rain:** ...Not to mention that in our  
case, we've already lost a lot  
of time we'll never get back.

<!-- uid=460197:14:1 -->

**Asuna & Silica:** ...!

<!-- uid=460197:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...Yeah. All the more reason to  
put serious thought into what  
we want to do with our lives.

<!-- uid=460197:16:1 -->


## Story 460198 · \[Diligent Subculture Maid\] Rain Lv.80

Character Story

**Rain:** Ahaha, sorry about that. I didn't  
mean to bring you guys down.

<!-- uid=460198:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh no, you didn't. This is all  
really important stuff to think  
about.

<!-- uid=460198:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** You're amazing, Rain. You're well  
on your way to your dream, but I'm  
still just thinking about mine...

<!-- uid=460198:3:1 -->

**Silica:** Me too...

<!-- uid=460198:4:1 -->

**Rain:** ...Is that so?

<!-- uid=460198:5:1 -->

**Rain:** Well, I don't see a problem with  
that. Sure, we might have lost a  
lot of time in real life...

<!-- uid=460198:6:1 -->

**Rain:** But we also gained a bunch of  
things from the time we spent  
in Aincrad. Don't you think?

<!-- uid=460198:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Of course! If it wasn't for what  
happened there, I wouldn't be  
here now talking to you two.

<!-- uid=460198:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Like you said, we lost some  
things, but we gained others.

<!-- uid=460198:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** All of that's made me who I am  
now...and I wouldn't change it  
for the world.

<!-- uid=460198:10:1 -->

**Silica:** ...Yeah. Me neither.

<!-- uid=460198:11:1 -->

**Silica:** I want to face up to who I was  
before, who I am now...and  
who I'll be in the future.

<!-- uid=460198:12:1 -->

**Silica:** So, for the time being...let's  
focus on the quest at hand!

<!-- uid=460198:13:1 -->

**Silica:** Especially since we should reach  
the mansion where it starts  
pretty soon!

<!-- uid=460198:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sounds good to me! Let's clear  
this quest in record time!

<!-- uid=460198:15:1 -->

**Rain:** Yeah! The sooner we beat it, the  
sooner we can show off our new  
maid outfits to everyone else!

<!-- uid=460198:16:1 -->

**Silica:** Come on! With the three of us  
working together, we can handle  
anything!

<!-- uid=460198:17:1 -->


## Story 640011 · \[Lightning Flash\] Asuna Lv.10

Character Story

**Asuna:** You wanted to see me, Commander?

<!-- uid=640011:1:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** Ah, yes, Asuna.  
I have something to ask of you.

<!-- uid=640011:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Go ahead.

<!-- uid=640011:3:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** Have a look at this.

<!-- uid=640011:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** What's all of this?  
Some sort of data file?

<!-- uid=640011:5:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** Indeed.  
I hired an info broker to  
look into it.

<!-- uid=640011:6:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** It seems there's been an increase  
in the frequency of claims about  
a loophole in the logout system.

<!-- uid=640011:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** The logout system...?

<!-- uid=640011:8:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** Essentially, it's a baseless  
rumor that players can log out  
through some special means.

<!-- uid=640011:9:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** That some sort of way to  
circumvent the system exists.

<!-- uid=640011:10:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** I, of course, have no  
way of verifying this.

<!-- uid=640011:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** That rumor gets circulated every  
now and again, like clockwork.

<!-- uid=640011:12:1 -->

**Heathcliff:** Indeed it does.  
Just like the rumor that jumping  
from the outer ring of Aincrad

**Asuna:** Understood.

## Story 640015 · \[Lightning Flash\] Asuna Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** This is the street.

## Story 640017 · \[Lightning Flash\] Asuna Lv.70

Character Story

**Kirito:** Morning, Asuna!

<!-- uid=640017:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, uh, morning...

<!-- uid=640017:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** So, did you drink it?

<!-- uid=640017:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** I did. After checking things  
out yesterday, I knew there was no  
way to log out, so I tried it.

<!-- uid=640017:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Rather than "making you dream,"  
it probably just makes it easier  
to achieve REM sleep

<!-- uid=640017:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** and stimulates your brain  
while you're sleeping.

<!-- uid=640017:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Makes sense. Your brain is most  
active during REM sleep, which  
means you'd dream more.

<!-- uid=640017:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Exactly.

<!-- uid=640017:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** But how did a potion that makes  
you dream become rumored to let  
you log out safely?

<!-- uid=640017:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Probably because everyone has  
dreams about the real world.

<!-- uid=640017:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Then why are people dreaming  
about the real world?

<!-- uid=640017:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Because they all want to go home.

<!-- uid=640017:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Dreams can be directly linked to  
strong emotions like resentment  
or sadness, right?

<!-- uid=640017:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Just like a young kid might have  
nightmares after watching a scary  
movie before bed.

<!-- uid=640017:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Phew...  
I guess this was all some sort  
of hoax then.

<!-- uid=640017:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** C'mon, don't say that.

<!-- uid=640017:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Everyone wants to go back  
to the real world, even if  
it's only in their dreams.

<!-- uid=640017:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** I guess you're right.

<!-- uid=640017:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** You dreamt of the real world,  
didn't you?

<!-- uid=640017:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hm?  
W-Well, I mean... Yeah.

<!-- uid=640017:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** I knew it!  
So, what did you see?

<!-- uid=640017:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** Y-You know I can't tell you!  
We're not allowed to talk about  
the real world in here!

<!-- uid=640017:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh yeah, I forgot.

<!-- uid=640017:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** So what kind of dream did YOU  
have, if you're so curious!

<!-- uid=640017:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** Me? I had a dream about  
getting a rare piece of  
equipment I missed on Floor 43!

<!-- uid=640017:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** It was only a dream, but  
it sure put a smile on my face!

<!-- uid=640017:26:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ugh, I don't even know  
what to do with you anymore!

<!-- uid=640017:27:1 -->

**Kirito:** What the heck?!  
What are you so upset about?

<!-- uid=640017:28:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm going home!

<!-- uid=640017:29:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...

<!-- uid=640017:30:1 -->

**Asuna:** There's no way I could tell him  
that I dreamt of us meeting in  
the real world.

<!-- uid=640017:31:1 -->

<!-- uid=640198:17:1 -->

<!-- uid=640198:19:1 -->

<!-- uid=640198:20:1 -->

"thank you, Yui."

<!-- uid=640198:21:1 -->

fairy tale.

<!-- uid=640198:22:1 -->

<!-- uid=640198:23:1 -->

## Story 650047 · \[Reach the Finish Line\] Asuna Lv.70

## Story 650095 · \[Foxy Shrine Maiden\] Asuna Lv.50

phenomena.

## Story 650113 · \[The Queen of Hearts\] Asuna Lv.30

Character Story

**Asuna:** I mean, like Kirito will be the

<!-- uid=650113:7:1 -->

<!-- uid=650113:8:1 -->

<!-- uid=650113:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Pretty much! Each suit and number

<!-- uid=650113:10:1 -->

from the card slot you use to play  
poker in the dungeon, I take it?

**Asuna:** Apparently.

**Asuna:** They've kinda been letting the

and there's a ton to do.

<!-- uid=650113:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** So they delegated responsibility  
for this job to me.

<!-- uid=650113:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** I guess that's the quest  
backstory this time?

<!-- uid=650113:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha, it could be pretty fun to

<!-- uid=650113:17:1 -->


## Story 650115 · \[The Queen of Hearts\] Asuna Lv.50

Character Story

**Sinon:** What sort of bonuses do these  
card titles give?

<!-- uid=650115:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Each suit gives a different buff.  
Clubs raise agility, because wind  
rustles clover, apparently?

<!-- uid=650115:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Diamonds are hard, so they raise  
your defense temporarily.

<!-- uid=650115:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hearts raise your hit points,  
because...yeah. Lastly, spades  
raise your attack.

<!-- uid=650115:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** Why do spades increase attack?  
They look like leaves to me.

<!-- uid=650115:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Originally, spades were swords.  
The design has changed over the  
centuries, though.

<!-- uid=650115:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Oh, interesting.

<!-- uid=650115:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Next, the number on the card  
indicates your rank. Stronger  
cards give better bonuses.

<!-- uid=650115:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Standard card rules.  
Two is the weakest,  
ace is the strongest.

<!-- uid=650115:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** So you can give these titles to  
people from any party, right?

<!-- uid=650115:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah. I guess handing these  
out is one of the rewards for  
finishing the dungeon first.

<!-- uid=650115:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** All of these titles give buffs, so  
I guess I don't have to worry too  
much about who I give what to.

<!-- uid=650115:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** I see this causing a whole lot of  
grief and whining on the forums.

<!-- uid=650115:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha, for sure. But we earned  
the right sorta fair and square,  
so we get to pass them out.

<!-- uid=650115:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Alright, I'm going to think about  
how to distribute these. Do you  
guys have any ideas?

<!-- uid=650115:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hmm... I'd say Klein's worth  
about...the three of spades?

<!-- uid=650115:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** Really? Now that's just mean.  
He's definitely more than a three.

<!-- uid=650115:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Kirito, you're still mad about  
how he beat us in the dungeon  
earlier, aren't you?

<!-- uid=650115:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeaaah...

<!-- uid=650115:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, by the way! I can give us  
titles too!

<!-- uid=650115:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oooh! We all get aces, right?

<!-- uid=650115:21:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hehe, I call dibs on diamonds.

<!-- uid=650115:22:1 -->

**Sinon:** My ranged attacks have been  
earning me a lot of hate lately...

<!-- uid=650115:23:1 -->

**Sinon:** Archers are glass cannons, so I  
need every point of defense I  
can get.

<!-- uid=650115:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** Can I have the ace of spades?  
I'm DPS, and I like to min/max.

<!-- uid=650115:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm a big fan of agility, so I  
guess I'll take the ace of clubs.

<!-- uid=650115:26:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, wait! I should message Yuuki  
and see if she wants it.

<!-- uid=650115:27:1 -->

**Kirito:** You're going to give Yuuki the ace  
of clubs?

<!-- uid=650115:28:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, she'd be able to wring more  
use out of it than I could.

<!-- uid=650115:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** I guess so, but...I'm kinda afraid  
to see her get any faster...

<!-- uid=650115:30:1 -->

**Sinon:** Agreed. She'd break the sound  
barrier. Anyway, you don't have  
to pick now. Think on it.

<!-- uid=650115:31:1 -->

**Asuna:** You're right. I'll take some time,  
and make sure that I give everyone  
the card that suits them most.

<!-- uid=650115:32:1 -->

Character Story

**Patissier NPC:** There are two things you need to

that can stand up to Salamander  
territory heat.

butter, and powdered milk.

to add in some unique flavors.

**Patissier NPC:** You'll have to use the tools

**Asuna:** Yup!
