## Story 650181 · \[Sweet Vocals\] Seven Lv.10

Character Story

**Seven:** \*piano\*

<!-- uid=650181:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** Wow, Seven. You're a great singer  
AND a great pianist.

<!-- uid=650181:2:1 -->

**Seven:** Heh, I definitely am. Thanks.

<!-- uid=650181:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** Do you always write songs on the  
piano?

<!-- uid=650181:4:1 -->

**Seven:** Yup! A lot of musicians write them  
on the guitar too,

<!-- uid=650181:5:1 -->

**Seven:** but recently tons of people have  
gone digital.

<!-- uid=650181:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** But you're still analog?  
That's a bit surprising.

<!-- uid=650181:7:1 -->

**Seven:** I can and often use digital tools,  
but I like the tactile feel of  
using the piano to craft a melody.

<!-- uid=650181:8:1 -->

**Seven:** I don't really know why, but I've  
always enjoyed doing it this way.

<!-- uid=650181:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** Wow... It's like you're living  
in this whole different and  
amazing musical world...

<!-- uid=650181:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah. Listening to this little  
genius play the piano is like  
witnessing a musical miracle.

<!-- uid=650181:11:1 -->

**Seven:** Ahaha, stop it, you two!

<!-- uid=650181:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** Does your sister play piano too,  
Seven?

<!-- uid=650181:13:1 -->

**Seven:** Rain? No idea. Why not ask her?

<!-- uid=650181:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** Okay. And there she is.  
Hey, Rain?

<!-- uid=650181:15:1 -->

**Rain:** Yeah? What's up?

<!-- uid=650181:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** So, we were talking to Seven,  
and...

<!-- uid=650181:17:1 -->


## Story 650183 · \[Sweet Vocals\] Seven Lv.30

Character Story

**Rain:** Nope, I'm all digital. I don't  
even own any instruments.

<!-- uid=650183:1:1 -->

**Rain:** I sometimes play rentals at  
practice studios, but they're  
too expensive for me to buy.

<!-- uid=650183:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** They are pricey.

<!-- uid=650183:3:1 -->

**Seven:** I can buy one for you.

<!-- uid=650183:4:1 -->

**Rain:** No! Don't you dare! You can't just  
throw money at me and...!

<!-- uid=650183:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** Y-Yikes! Relax! Time out, girls!

<!-- uid=650183:6:2 -->

**Sinon:** So anyway, you don't own an  
instrument, but you can play them?

<!-- uid=650183:7:1 -->

**Rain:** A little. I don't practice much,  
so I can't say I'm good at any.

<!-- uid=650183:8:1 -->

**Seven:** Raaain! Let me teach you the  
piano!

<!-- uid=650183:9:1 -->

**Rain:** ...

<!-- uid=650183:10:1 -->

**Rain:** No, I'm good.

<!-- uid=650183:11:1 -->

**Rain:** I'd rather focus on the drums...  
Speaking of which, I need to  
practice. Bye...

<!-- uid=650183:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...

<!-- uid=650183:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** That was weird. But she makes  
a point: we should practice.

<!-- uid=650183:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** I'm going to go play the guitar.

<!-- uid=650183:15:1 -->

**Seven:** So...

<!-- uid=650183:16:1 -->

**Seven:** You're not going to practice your  
bass, Sinon?

<!-- uid=650183:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Maybe in a bit.

<!-- uid=650183:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** But first, can I ask you  
something?

<!-- uid=650183:19:1 -->

**Seven:** What?

<!-- uid=650183:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** Who taught you how to play the  
piano?

<!-- uid=650183:21:1 -->

**Seven:** Huh?

<!-- uid=650183:22:1 -->


## Story 650185 · \[Sweet Vocals\] Seven Lv.50

Character Story

**Seven:** Where'd that come from?

<!-- uid=650185:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** I heard that if you start playing  
when you're young, you learn  
much easier.

<!-- uid=650185:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** Your piano skills are impressive,  
and you made it sound like you've  
played since you were little.

<!-- uid=650185:3:1 -->

**Seven:** Nice insight. Okay, well, I had a  
famous pianist giving me lessons.  
She taught me how to write music.

<!-- uid=650185:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** But you're talking about recently,  
right? Who was your first teacher?

<!-- uid=650185:5:1 -->

**Seven:** Oh... Huh.

<!-- uid=650185:6:1 -->

**Seven:** I've been playing since before  
I could remember...

<!-- uid=650185:7:1 -->

**Seven:** But I can't recall who my first  
teacher was...

<!-- uid=650185:8:1 -->

**Seven:** Daddy said someone taught me  
when I was still living in Russia,  
but I was still so little,

<!-- uid=650185:9:1 -->

**Seven:** so I barely remember anything from  
then. I didn't even remember my  
own sister, after all...

<!-- uid=650185:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** You do speak some Russian, though.

<!-- uid=650185:11:1 -->

**Seven:** Yeah, but to be honest, I speak  
it more out of habit than  
understanding.

<!-- uid=650185:12:1 -->

**Seven:** Seriously. I don't even really  
know if I'm using the words right.

<!-- uid=650185:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** Really? Cool. Well, it's been  
a nice chat, but I have a date  
with my bass.

<!-- uid=650185:14:1 -->

**Seven:** That was sudden... Right, bye...

<!-- uid=650185:15:1 -->


## Story 650187 · \[Sweet Vocals\] Seven Lv.70

Character Story

**Rain:** \*sigh\*...

<!-- uid=650187:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** Rain, sorry to interrupt your  
practice time, but do you have  
a minute?

<!-- uid=650187:2:1 -->

**Rain:** Yeah, sure. What's up?

<!-- uid=650187:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** You were the one who taught Rain  
how to play the piano, weren't  
you?

<!-- uid=650187:4:1 -->

**Rain:** ...

<!-- uid=650187:5:1 -->

**Rain:** Well, yeah. But how did you figure  
that out?

<!-- uid=650187:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Your tone earlier seemed a bit  
unusual for you. It got me  
thinking.

<!-- uid=650187:7:1 -->

**Rain:** Oh...

<!-- uid=650187:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** You really like hiding things from  
people. But at least you're not  
causing any trouble this time.

<!-- uid=650187:9:1 -->

**Rain:** So yeah, I was the one who took  
piano lessons when we were both  
still living in Russia.

<!-- uid=650187:10:1 -->

**Rain:** Seven saw me playing, then started  
shouting that she wanted to play  
too. So, I taught her.

<!-- uid=650187:11:1 -->

**Rain:** I volunteered, but really, I just  
wanted a chance to show off  
what I'd learned.

<!-- uid=650187:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** I see. By the way, Seven told me  
she doesn't remember when she  
first started playing.

<!-- uid=650187:13:1 -->

**Rain:** I'm not surprised. She was still  
practically a baby.

<!-- uid=650187:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** Why don't you just tell her it  
was you who taught her?

<!-- uid=650187:15:1 -->

**Rain:** Why would I? It was just kids  
playing. She got a real teacher  
who helped her get good.

<!-- uid=650187:16:1 -->

**Rain:** She worked hard for her skill.  
It'd be ridiculous for me to say  
I even taught her anything.

<!-- uid=650187:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Ah. If that's what you want,  
I won't spill the beans.

<!-- uid=650187:18:1 -->

**Rain:** Thanks. I appreciate you being  
concerned about us, though.

<!-- uid=650187:19:1 -->


## Story 650188 · \[Sweet Vocals\] Seven Lv.80

Character Story

**Seven:** Hey, Rain?

<!-- uid=650188:1:1 -->

**Rain:** Yeah, Nana? What's up?

<!-- uid=650188:2:1 -->

**Seven:** I was talking to Sinon earlier,  
and I started thinking...

<!-- uid=650188:3:1 -->

**Seven:** Was it you who first taught me how  
to play the piano? Back when we  
were in Russia?

<!-- uid=650188:4:1 -->

**Rain:** ...So, you figured it out.  
Hehe, I should've known you would.  
You've gotten really insightful.

<!-- uid=650188:5:1 -->

**Seven:** Rain! Why didn't you tell me?!  
Now I feel really weird about  
all this!

<!-- uid=650188:6:1 -->

**Seven:** I can't believe I had the nerve to  
suggest teaching you piano when  
it was you who taught me!

<!-- uid=650188:7:1 -->

**Rain:** No need to feel weird. You're way  
better than me now.

<!-- uid=650188:8:1 -->

**Rain:** I've barely touched a piano since  
I came to Japan.

<!-- uid=650188:9:1 -->

**Seven:** But...still, I wish you'd told me.

<!-- uid=650188:10:1 -->

**Rain:** ...Oh. Sorry.

<!-- uid=650188:11:1 -->

**Seven:** And not just about the piano  
thing! About everything!

## Story 650233 · \[Unrestrained Emotion\] Asuna Lv.30

Character Story

<!-- uid=650233:1:1 -->

**Liz:** Hey, Asuna. Oh, looks like it's  
raining outside.

**Asuna:** Yeah. It's rainy this time of year  
in the real world too, so it might  
be by design.

<!-- uid=650233:3:1 -->

**Liz:** There are a lot of little details  
in this game like that, like all  
those Christmas events.

sound pretty romantic.

beat to get the boss to spawn  
or we can't clear the floor.

like the Assault Team has its work

<!-- uid=650233:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Definitely. To get the statue to

gather a bunch of items.

<!-- uid=650233:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** I have almost all of them. The  
only one I haven't found yet is  
the Ring of Vows...

<!-- uid=650233:14:1 -->

**Liz:** The Ring of Vows... That sounds  
like it could be a wedding ring.

<!-- uid=650233:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's my guess too. I've searched  
the dungeon it's supposed to be  
in, but can't find it anywhere.

<!-- uid=650233:16:1 -->

**Liz:** Which dungeon is that?

<!-- uid=650233:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'll open the map and show you.  
Uh... This one.

<!-- uid=650233:18:1 -->


## Story 650235 · \[Unrestrained Emotion\] Asuna Lv.50

Character Story

**Liz:** Aaaah, that dungeon. I gotcha.  
You wouldn't mind if I helped  
you look for it, do you?

<!-- uid=650235:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Uh, of course not, but are you  
sure? I don't want to take you  
away from work.

<!-- uid=650235:2:1 -->

**Liz:** Don't worry about it. That dungeon  
has material drops I could use in  
my shop, so it all works out.

<!-- uid=650235:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ah, that's true. I do feel like I  
saw some old weapons and junk  
scattered around in there.

<!-- uid=650235:4:1 -->

**Liz:** It's not junk to everyone,  
you know!

<!-- uid=650235:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, sorry! I didn't mean to  
imply anything bad!

<!-- uid=650235:6:1 -->

**Liz:** Hehe, it's fine. You know what  
they say: one man's trash is  
another man's treasure.

<!-- uid=650235:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah. Well, I'll be going back in  
two days with some Assault Team  
members if you want to tag along.

<!-- uid=650235:8:1 -->

**Liz:** Okay, let me know where you  
want to meet.

<!-- uid=650235:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sure thing.

<!-- uid=650235:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Liz, over here!

<!-- uid=650235:11:1 -->

**Liz:** Hey, Asuna. Time to have fun, eh?

<!-- uid=650235:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Try not to wander off by yourself,  
okay? There are some pretty tough  
monster spawns in there.

<!-- uid=650235:13:1 -->

**Liz:** Yeah, of course. I'm hardly the  
type of person to do anything  
reckless like that.

<!-- uid=650235:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Good. Okay, let's get to  
work, then.

<!-- uid=650235:15:1 -->

**Liz:** Lead the way.

<!-- uid=650235:16:1 -->


## Story 650237 · \[Unrestrained Emotion\] Asuna Lv.70

Character Story

**Liz:** You weren't wrong. This dungeon's  
littered with all kinds of stuff.

<!-- uid=650237:1:1 -->

**Liz:** All sorts of rusted weapons and  
armor... I can see why you would  
call it junk.

<!-- uid=650237:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** I get the impression this might be

you think so?

over there?

<!-- uid=650237:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, that big thing over there is  
the goddess statue behind this  
whole quest.

<!-- uid=650237:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Once we have all the bridal items

<!-- uid=650237:10:1 -->

**Liz:** Would you mind if I took a look at

<!-- uid=650237:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Of course not. You can find them

<!-- uid=650237:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Here they are.

<!-- uid=650237:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Liz, what are you doing?

**Liz:** I'm checking to see if I can  
reforge any of these pieces  
with my smithing skill.

<!-- uid=650237:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** Huh?

<!-- uid=650237:17:1 -->

**Liz:** Oh, this might do the trick! Let's  
give it a shot!

<!-- uid=650237:18:1 -->

**Liz:** Hyaaaah!

<!-- uid=650237:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** What?!

<!-- uid=650237:20:1 -->

**Liz:** I did it, Asuna! This is the Ring  
of Vows you've been looking for!

<!-- uid=650237:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** Wow, it was right there all along!  
I guess the quest was designed to  
use a player's smithing skill.

<!-- uid=650237:22:1 -->

**Liz:** Hehe, exactly. I'm glad I was able  
to help out today.

<!-- uid=650237:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** Thank you so much, Liz!

<!-- uid=650237:24:1 -->


## Story 650238 · \[Unrestrained Emotion\] Asuna Lv.80

Character Story

back some memories.

could say it was SAO's version

## Story 650298 · \[Goddess of Fertility\] Asuna Lv.80

Character Story

**Asuna:** Girls? I think I have your  
answer...

<!-- uid=650298:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** You do?

<!-- uid=650298:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** True beauty isn't something that  
you can just pick up and learn  
by asking someone.

<!-- uid=650298:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** It comes from the heart. It exists  
inside each and every one of you

<!-- uid=650298:4:1 -->

<!-- uid=650298:5:1 -->

they care about other people.

<!-- uid=650298:6:1 -->

<!-- uid=650298:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Beauty is a state of mind. Anyone  
can be beautiful with the right  
mindset.

<!-- uid=650298:8:1 -->

much from you, Miss Goddess!  
Thank you so much!

<!-- uid=650298:9:1 -->

<!-- uid=650298:13:1 -->

<!-- uid=650298:15:1 -->

true nature of beauty to those  
fairies was perfect. I'm proud.

<!-- uid=650298:17:1 -->

reduced to a mere "scolding."

<!-- uid=650298:19:1 -->

<!-- uid=650298:20:1 -->

## Story 660033 · \[Beautiful Monster\] Alice Lv.30

Character Story

**Liz:** Eh, no use crying over spilled  
milk. It's always tricky trying to  
make equipment in games.

<!-- uid=660033:1:1 -->

**Liz:** You've got to balance so many  
different things so it doesn't  
become industrial waste.

<!-- uid=660033:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Industrial... waste?

<!-- uid=660033:3:1 -->

**Liz:** I don't mean literally. Obviously  
we're not filling up landfills  
in the real world doing this.

<!-- uid=660033:4:1 -->

**Liz:** It's just gamer slang for something  
that doesn't end up being useful.

<!-- uid=660033:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, this thing's been pretty  
useless right from the get-go.

<!-- uid=660033:6:1 -->

**Liz:** What are you talking about? Its  
gorgeous appearance got you  
lots of attention at the party.

<!-- uid=660033:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** I guess so...

<!-- uid=660033:8:1 -->

**Liz:** There are tons of items in VRMMOS  
that are completely useless.

<!-- uid=660033:9:1 -->

**Liz:** At least you had a chance to shine  
in that dress once. In that sense,  
it served its purpose just fine.

<!-- uid=660033:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** I guess that's true. When I think  
about it, there's lots of nice  
equipment with low stats.

<!-- uid=660033:11:1 -->

**Liz:** Exactly. If all equipment looked  
great and had good specs, it's  
all anyone would ever wear.

<!-- uid=660033:12:1 -->

**Liz:** Everybody at a party would look  
the same, and that wouldn't be  
fun, would it?

<!-- uid=660033:13:1 -->

**Liz:** I mean, sure, you could still  
change colors or do whatever  
to personalize it a bit.

<!-- uid=660033:14:1 -->

**Liz:** But I'd rather there be lots of  
different equipment with unique  
traits for us to discover.

<!-- uid=660033:15:1 -->

**Liz:** That way people have more options  
to choose from based on the  
situation and how they play.

<!-- uid=660033:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, but I'd still hate to give  
this up after all the work I put  
into it.

<!-- uid=660033:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** At the end of the day, though, you  
are right that it did exactly what  
I created it to do.

<!-- uid=660033:18:1 -->

**Liz:** That's the spirit! Gotta stay  
positive!

<!-- uid=660033:19:1 -->

**Liz:** There's still plenty of awesome  
equipment out there waiting for  
you!

<!-- uid=660033:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, thanks, Liz.

<!-- uid=660033:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Aha. So that's what you meant.

## Story 660093 · \[Ingenuous Hina Doll\] Alice Lv.30

Character Story

**Kirito:** Pretty nice you get all these

**Leafa:** Hehe, right? I can't even finish

## Story 660095 · \[Ingenuous Hina Doll\] Alice Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to  
be rude.

<!-- uid=660095:1:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** Not at all. It's very kind of you  
to talk to us.

<!-- uid=660095:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** I just couldn't help but notice  
you two seemed a bit lonely.

<!-- uid=660095:3:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** Oh no, was it that obvious?

<!-- uid=660095:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yes. VRMMOs can detect your  
emotions and display them just  
like you do in real life.

<!-- uid=660095:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** So it's pretty hard to cover up  
how you feel. Hehe.

<!-- uid=660095:6:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** I see. That's good to know. I must  
say though, I'm surprised to see a  
child like you playing this game.

<!-- uid=660095:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, I'm sorry. I'm actually--

<!-- uid=660095:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hey Asuna, I think the limit on  
this effect is about to run out.

<!-- uid=660095:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, yeah. In that case, I might as  
well show you...

<!-- uid=660095:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** This is what we really look like.  
We were just using a special  
mechanic to change our appearance.

<!-- uid=660095:11:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** S-So that explains it... I was  
wondering how such a young child  
learned to speak like a grown-up.

<!-- uid=660095:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Um, if you don't mind my asking,

<!-- uid=660095:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** would you mind telling me more  
about your daughter?

<!-- uid=660095:14:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** Huh?

<!-- uid=660095:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm probably about the same age as  
her, and I also fight with my  
mother sometimes...

<!-- uid=660095:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** So I just thought I might be able  
to help somehow.

<!-- uid=660095:17:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** ......

<!-- uid=660095:18:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** Seeing you two in your child forms  
just got us reminiscing about the  
past...

<!-- uid=660095:19:1 -->

**Leafa:** The past?

<!-- uid=660095:20:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** Perhaps it's fate that we ended up  
meeting like this.

<!-- uid=660095:21:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** You see, we have two daughters who  
are close in age to one another...

<!-- uid=660095:22:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** They were adorable when they were  
children, just like you two. But  
after they graduated high school,

<!-- uid=660095:23:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** they started arguing with us to  
the point where they just up  
and ran away...

<!-- uid=660095:24:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** We had never fought with them  
about anything before, so it came  
as something of a shock to us.

<!-- uid=660095:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** I see... What was it you fought  
about with them?

<!-- uid=660095:26:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** Oh, they just wanted to move to  
the city to pursue their dreams,  
and we tried to stop them.

<!-- uid=660095:27:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** You've heard it all before, I'm  
sure. They were such good girls  
growing up that when they

<!-- uid=660095:28:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** started pushing back on us like  
that, we ended up overreacting.  
And that brings us to today...

<!-- uid=660095:29:1 -->

**Asuna:** I see...

<!-- uid=660095:30:1 -->


## Story 660097 · \[Ingenuous Hina Doll\] Alice Lv.70

Character Story

**Asuna:** Speaking as someone in a similar  
position as your daughters,

<!-- uid=660097:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm certain that they're grateful  
to you for everything you did for  
them growing up.

<!-- uid=660097:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** But I also think that as they got  
older, and came to realize what  
they want to do with their lives,

<!-- uid=660097:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** they became hurt that you didn't  
understand, precisely because they  
love you so much.

<!-- uid=660097:4:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** ......

<!-- uid=660097:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** Asuna...

<!-- uid=660097:6:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** I must say, hearing that from a  
girl of your age really makes it  
ring true...

<!-- uid=660097:7:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** All the more so because your child  
forms resembled our girls when  
they were little...

<!-- uid=660097:8:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** Tell me, what would you want us to  
do if you were our daughter?

<!-- uid=660097:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** I think...I'd want you two to be  
patient.

<!-- uid=660097:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** When we get older, it can be hard  
for us children to articulate our  
desires, or prove we're serious

<!-- uid=660097:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** about them... So if I were them,  
I'd want you two to accept my  
determination to live my own life.

<!-- uid=660097:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm certain they'll come back  
someday, even if they don't end up  
accomplishing their goals...

<!-- uid=660097:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** And when they do, I'm sure they'll  
want you to welcome them with open  
arms. Because you're their family.

<!-- uid=660097:14:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** \*sigh\* I knew it. Honey,  
I hope you take all that to heart.

<!-- uid=660097:15:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** Yeah...It wasn't easy to hear, but  
I think I needed to hear it...  
You know, it's funny.

<!-- uid=660097:16:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** I had no intention whatsoever of  
hearing what my daughters had to  
say, but meeting you here,

<!-- uid=660097:17:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** and hearing what YOU had to say,  
really got to me... What a strange  
place this virtual world is.

<!-- uid=660097:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, I know what you mean.  
I think it may be precisely  
because this world is separate

<!-- uid=660097:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** from the real one that we're  
better able to express how we  
really feel.

<!-- uid=660097:20:1 -->

**Leafa:** Your daughters left together,  
right?

<!-- uid=660097:21:1 -->

**Leafa:** In that case, I'm sure they're  
living together right now and  
doing just fine!

<!-- uid=660097:22:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** Thank you. I think so too.

<!-- uid=660097:23:1 -->

## Story 660111 · \[Mellow Love\] Leafa Lv.10

Character Story

**Eugeo:** So, Kirito, now that it's been a  
while since we've come to this  
sleeping-together world...

people to get your STP this

<!-- uid=660111:7:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Huh? What do you mean?

<!-- uid=660111:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Y-You know, on second thought,never mind.

<!-- uid=660111:16:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...?

<!-- uid=660111:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Anyway, where did Alice go?

<!-- uid=660111:18:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Oh, she stepped out. Said she

<!-- uid=660111:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Guess she probably didn't go

together partners then...

**Kirito:** Ha ha, yeah...

<!-- uid=660111:22:1 -->


## Story 660113 · \[Mellow Love\] Leafa Lv.30

Character Story

**Alice:** \*sigh\*... I still cannot quite  
believe this is happening...

<!-- uid=660113:1:1 -->

**Alice:** A world where people are required  
to sleep together? I could never  
imagine something so ridiculous.

<!-- uid=660113:2:1 -->

If only I had not fallen asleep  
beside them in that cavern,

<!-- uid=660113:3:1 -->

**Alice:** none of this would have come to

sleeping so peacefully,

<!-- uid=660113:4:1 -->

**Alice:** I was overcome with feelings

<!-- uid=660113:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...

<!-- uid=660113:7:1 -->

**Alice:** A-Asuna?!

<!-- uid=660113:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh? ...I see you know me too.

<!-- uid=660113:9:1 -->

**Alice:** ...Now I see. This must be one of  
those projections that Kirito told  
me about...

<!-- uid=660113:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** You must be a friend of Kirito's.  
I haven't slept with anyone else  
after my first time with him...

**Alice:** ...!

<!-- uid=660113:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** I realized back then that he was

satisfy me.

**Alice:** I-I see...

<!-- uid=660113:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** My STP went up an amazing amount

<!-- uid=660113:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** I feel like he and I must be  
destined for each other.

<!-- uid=660113:16:1 -->

**Alice:** ...Kirito and Asuna are wedded to  
each other back in Alfheim...

<!-- uid=660113:17:1 -->

**Alice:** So this projection of her must  
have a similarly powerful  
connection to him...

<!-- uid=660113:18:1 -->

**Alice:** And yet... I am not sure why,  
but... something about this  
vexes me.

<!-- uid=660113:19:1 -->

**Alice:** Is it merely the fact that Kirito  
is ahead of me? Or is it...  
No... it could not be that...

<!-- uid=660113:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Is something wrong?

<!-- uid=660113:21:1 -->

**Alice:** Asuna... Come sleep with me.

<!-- uid=660113:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** Huh?

<!-- uid=660113:23:1 -->

**Alice:** Now that I have decided to abide  
by this world's laws, I must do my  
best to excel within their bounds.

<!-- uid=660113:24:1 -->

**Alice:** I shall see for myself if Kirito  
is truly my superior when it  
comes to sleeping together...

<!-- uid=660113:25:1 -->


## Story 660115 · \[Mellow Love\] Leafa Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** Thank you for sleeping with me,

Character Story

## Story 660141 · \[Captured Princess\] Asuna Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** Okay, this is where we're supposed

**Yui:** We're going to explore a new

<!-- uid=660141:3:1 -->

**Yui:** This floor isn't supposed to be  
too difficult, right?

<!-- uid=660141:4:1 -->

**Yui:** So why weren't you able to explore

**Kirito:** Because the boss had set up camp

prevent anyone from entering it.

<!-- uid=660141:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** What's more, this boss was pretty  
much impossible to defeat, so  
nobody could get past it.

<!-- uid=660141:7:1 -->

**Yui:** I see... But now you can go in the  
forest because somebody finally  
figured out how to defeat it?

<!-- uid=660141:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** No, as far as I know, nobody  
defeated it. It sounds like it  
just disappeared at one point.

<!-- uid=660141:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** It could be that the devs deleted  
it and put a new quest in its  
place... Or it could be that its...

<!-- uid=660141:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...disappearance was part of  
something else. Nobody  
knows for sure right now.

<!-- uid=660141:11:1 -->

**Yui:** So that's another reason why you  
want to investigate for yourself?

<!-- uid=660141:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** You bet.

<!-- uid=660141:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sorry I'm late, you two.

**Kirito:** Asuna?! Isn't that...?!

<!-- uid=660141:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, yep. I got it as a bonus

Princess quest.

<!-- uid=660141:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** I see... That makes sense, since  
you were the princess.

<!-- uid=660141:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...Uh, Kirito? Why are you looking

<!-- uid=660141:18:1 -->

surprised.

## Story 660143 · \[Captured Princess\] Asuna Lv.30

Character Story

**Asuna:** This is the avatar I was in while  
I was being kept prisoner in ALO  
right after escaping from SAO.

**Asuna:** But things are different now.  
Maybe it's because I had so much  
fun on the last quest, but...

overwrite those old bad memories  
with new good ones.

**Kirito:** Okay, sounds good.

<!-- uid=660143:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hm...?

**Yui:** What is it, Daddy?

<!-- uid=660143:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** I think we're lost...

<!-- uid=660143:11:2 -->

**Asuna:** Huh? What about the auto-map?

<!-- uid=660143:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Looks like we can't use it in this  
area. And what's more... I think  
the routes here are randomized.

<!-- uid=660143:13:1 -->

**Yui:** That's true... Our location data  
has definitely changed since  
we've been here.

<!-- uid=660143:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** So this really is a forest maze,

time to break out one of my perks.

**Kirito:** You don't?

<!-- uid=660143:16:1 -->

your voice!

<!-- uid=660143:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...!

<!-- uid=660143:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...Uh huh. Okay, now I see.

<!-- uid=660143:19:1 -->

**Yui:** What was that, Mommy?

<!-- uid=660143:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** One of this avatar's unique  
skills. It lets you talk to  
objects and creatures...

<!-- uid=660143:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...you find in the field to receive  
special guidance from them.

<!-- uid=660143:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wow, that's amazing. You really

to the voices of nature.

find rare materials.

**Asuna:** Though it doesn't work on objects

<!-- uid=660143:26:1 -->

**Yui:** Looks like you'll make a better

Princess Titania herself will be  
your guide through the forest.

<!-- uid=660143:28:1 -->

intention to trespass.

leave without any trouble.

bring them back to the village.

<!-- uid=660145:20:1 -->

<!-- uid=660145:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh?! You've got to be kidding me!

<!-- uid=660145:22:1 -->

**Yui:** Daddy, it looks like their stats  
have all been set to extremely  
high parameters.

<!-- uid=660145:23:1 -->

**Yui:** You might be able to fight them  
with a party, but I don't think  
you could beat them solo...

<!-- uid=660145:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** Now that you mention it, that's  
what SAO's forest fairies were  
like too...

<!-- uid=660145:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...Looks like I don't have any

for now.

**Kirito:** Asuna...

<!-- uid=660145:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm back!

<!-- uid=660145:28:1 -->

**Asuna:** Huh? Kirito? Yui?  
Where did you go?

<!-- uid=660145:29:1 -->


## Story 660147 · \[Captured Princess\] Asuna Lv.70

Character Story

<!-- uid=660147:2:1 -->

the ones in the original Aincrad.

**???:** Who goes there?!

<!-- uid=660147:21:1 -->

## Story 660171 · \[Conqueror of Love\] Administrator Lv.10

Character Story

**Cardinal:** What is it, Kirito?

training?

**Kirito:** N-No, of course not.

<!-- uid=660171:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Have you never once left this  
place after escaping here when  
the Administrator defeated you?

<!-- uid=660171:4:1 -->

**Cardinal:** No, not in this body.

**Kirito:** What do you mean by that?

soul of a familiar like Charlotte.

person spying on things.

<!-- uid=660171:8:1 -->

**Cardinal:** It is nothing that boorish.

**Kirito:** I see...

<!-- uid=660171:11:1 -->

**Cardinal:** A-Anyway.  
May I ask you something, Kirito?

<!-- uid=660171:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hm? Why so polite?

<!-- uid=660171:13:1 -->

**Cardinal:** Will you...try eating this?

<!-- uid=660171:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hm, what is it? Something sweet?

<!-- uid=660171:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Cardinal! You know how to make  
crepes?! That's amazing!

<!-- uid=660171:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** How'd you make something from

<!-- uid=660171:17:1 -->

**Cardinal:** Ah... So it is indeed something  
from that world.

<!-- uid=660171:18:1 -->

**Cardinal:** I just happened to learn of it  
during one such observation of the  
Human Empire by way of Charlotte.

<!-- uid=660171:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...?

<!-- uid=660171:20:1 -->


## Story 660173 · \[Conqueror of Love\] Administrator Lv.30

**Cardinal:** My apologies, there was no need

## Story 660175 · \[Conqueror of Love\] Administrator Lv.50

Character Story

**Charlotte:** I'm sorry, I can't keep searching

**Cardinal:** Let's go by one of these stands.  
I'll generate a good amount of  
coin, so eat what you like.

<!-- uid=660177:6:1 -->

**Charlotte:** Thank you.

<!-- uid=660177:7:1 -->

**Administrator:** I can't find her... I thought  
I sensed that pipsqueak's  
familiar in the area.

<!-- uid=660177:8:1 -->

**Administrator:** Just when I planned to come down  
here myself to add her to my  
resources...

<!-- uid=660177:9:1 -->

**Administrator:** Hmph. Seems like today might have  
been a waste of time. How annoying.

<!-- uid=660177:10:1 -->

**Shopkeeper:** Come on by!  
What do you say to some  
baked goods! Take a look!

<!-- uid=660177:11:1 -->

**Administrator:** Baked goods?  
Hmph. None look particularly tasty.

<!-- uid=660177:12:1 -->

**Shopkeeper:** What? O-Of course they are!  
Have a taste and you'll see!

<!-- uid=660177:13:1 -->

**Administrator:** I already know that they will  
simply taste cheap.

<!-- uid=660177:14:1 -->

**Shopkeeper:** Y-You've got a pretty sharp tongue  
behind that pretty face, don't you?

<!-- uid=660177:15:1 -->

**Administrator:** What really looked good was a  
certain something I once found in  
records of this world's creators.

<!-- uid=660177:16:1 -->

**Shopkeeper:** Ma'am?

<!-- uid=660177:17:1 -->

**Administrator:** Try eating this.

<!-- uid=660177:18:1 -->

**Shopkeeper:** Wh-What is this?  
It looks delicious...  
\*munch\*

<!-- uid=660177:19:1 -->

**Administrator:** It's called a crepe.  
They aren't hard to make.

<!-- uid=660177:20:1 -->

**Administrator:** If you like it, try producing them  
in this store.  
That is, if you can.

<!-- uid=660177:21:1 -->

**Shopkeeper:** What? Are you sure?

<!-- uid=660177:22:1 -->

**Administrator:** Fine with me. The more prosperous  
the Human Empire, the greater  
chance of finding

<!-- uid=660177:23:1 -->

**Administrator:** a candidate worthy of synthesis.  
Heh heh heh...

<!-- uid=660177:24:1 -->

**Shopkeeper:** ...?

<!-- uid=660177:25:1 -->

**Charlotte:** Hm? That sweet smell...

<!-- uid=660177:26:1 -->

**Shopkeeper:** Wow. That woman earlier...  
She was so beautiful. But is it  
really okay to copy this recipe?

<!-- uid=660177:27:1 -->

**Shopkeeper:** I'd feel so useless as a pro if  
I started making a product a  
random customer taught me...

<!-- uid=660177:28:1 -->

**Cardinal:** I wonder what this shopkeeper  
could be talking about.

<!-- uid=660177:29:1 -->

**Charlotte:** That treat they're holding looks  
delicious, though. May I eat one?

<!-- uid=660177:30:1 -->

**Cardinal:** Yes, a bite should be fine.  
The taste will be communicated  
to me as well, of course.

<!-- uid=660177:31:1 -->

**Charlotte:** Okay, let's dig in.  
\*chomp\*

<!-- uid=660177:32:1 -->

**Cardinal:** M-M-My goodness...!!

<!-- uid=660177:33:1 -->


## Story 660178 · \[Conqueror of Love\] Administrator Lv.80

Character Story

**Kirito:** Did you ever end up finding  
the Administrator?

<!-- uid=660178:1:1 -->

**Cardinal:** No. I thought I sensed her  
somewhere, but I left empty-handed.

<!-- uid=660178:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh. But that's when you learned  
what crepes taste like, huh?

<!-- uid=660178:3:1 -->

**Cardinal:** Indeed. I've not a clue why  
that stall had something from the  
outside world.

<!-- uid=660178:4:1 -->

**Cardinal:** But the outing bore fruit after  
all, now that I can treat you  
to one of these.

<!-- uid=660178:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Heh, is that so.  
It's really good, you know.

<!-- uid=660178:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Thanks, Cardinal. I haven't had a  
crepe since I was in the real  
world. I really appreciate it.

**Eugeo:** Hm? What's that you're eating,

<!-- uid=660178:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** This is called a crepe.

she visited the Human Empire.

<!-- uid=660178:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** She just tried making one here.

<!-- uid=660178:10:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Huh. It smells so sweet and

reading the whole time.

**Cardinal:** No need to worry.  
I'll treat you to one as well.

<!-- uid=660178:16:1 -->


## Story 660181 · \[Heir to the Sword\] Asuna Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** What the--Are you insane?!

<!-- uid=660181:1:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...It's now or never!

<!-- uid=660181:2:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Enhance Armament!  
Bloom, blue roses!

<!-- uid=660181:3:1 -->

**Thokk:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=660181:4:1 -->

**Makoto:** Are you okay, Thokk?

<!-- uid=660181:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** Oh, it's you, Makoto. Hey...

<!-- uid=660181:6:1 -->

**Makoto:** What's the matter? You looked like  
you were spacing out for a second  
there.

<!-- uid=660181:7:1 -->

**Thokk:** I was just thinking about what  
happened when we got caught up  
in that time stream earlier.

<!-- uid=660181:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh, I see. Yeah, that was...quite  
the adventure, to say the least.

<!-- uid=660181:9:1 -->

**Thokk:** You can say that again, especially  
that battle we saw that Kirito and  
Eugeo were caught up in.

<!-- uid=660181:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** Those two were so coordinated with  
one another even without talking  
to each other. It was amazing.

<!-- uid=660181:11:1 -->

**Makoto:** It really was. I've never seen  
such synchronization.

<!-- uid=660181:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** If I can find a way to recreate  
that sensation in this new VRMMO,  
I feel it could innovate combat.

<!-- uid=660181:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** Really? How do you plan on doing  
that? That sounds impossible.

<!-- uid=660181:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** It's definitely not going to be  
easy to pull off, that's for sure,  
but I think it's necessary.

<!-- uid=660181:15:1 -->

**Thokk:** Otherwise, Nibelungen Purgatory  
just won't be satisfying to play  
for players like Kirito.

<!-- uid=660181:16:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wow, you sound really serious  
about this, Thokk. I'm impressed.

<!-- uid=660181:17:1 -->


## Story 660183 · \[Heir to the Sword\] Asuna Lv.30

Character Story

**Monster:** Grraaagh!

<!-- uid=660183:1:1 -->

**Thokk:** Makoto!

<!-- uid=660183:2:1 -->

**Makoto:** Roger! I'll take it out!

<!-- uid=660183:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hyaaah!

<!-- uid=660183:4:1 -->

**Thokk:** No, don't do that! You have to  
use a smokescreen!

<!-- uid=660183:5:1 -->

**Makoto:** What?! Uh oh!

<!-- uid=660183:6:1 -->

**Monster:** GRAAAAAHHHH!

<!-- uid=660183:7:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oww... That thing got me good.

<!-- uid=660183:8:1 -->

**Thokk:** I warned you before we started.  
Once it starts turning around  
more, it goes berserk.

<!-- uid=660183:9:1 -->

**Thokk:** That's why you have to deploy a  
smokescreen, to block its vision.

<!-- uid=660183:10:1 -->

**Makoto:** Sorry. It's just when you called  
out my name, I thought you wanted  
me to go and finish it off.

<!-- uid=660183:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** That's fair. It's not like I said  
anything more specific.

<!-- uid=660183:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** Times like this are why I'd really  
like to have that synchronization  
system in place between players.

<!-- uid=660183:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's a bit of mouthful to say,  
don't you think? Can't you come up  
with something a bit snappier?

<!-- uid=660183:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** Me? You're the one who called it  
synchronization! But alright.  
Do you have any ideas, then?

<!-- uid=660183:15:1 -->

**Makoto:** Um, well... What about calling it,  
like, the "Seeker System?"

<!-- uid=660183:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** Eh, that doesn't sound too  
great, either.

<!-- uid=660183:17:1 -->

**Makoto:** In any case, if you're going to  
implement a system like that, it  
needs to balanced, right?

<!-- uid=660183:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** It won't be much fun if only the  
players are strong. Will you make  
the enemies tough, too?

<!-- uid=660183:19:1 -->

**Thokk:** Obviously. I wouldn't have it any  
other way. Watching those fights  
gave me a lot of food for thought.

<!-- uid=660183:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** They made me realize I wanna  
make tough enemies be the main  
reason to keep playing my game.

<!-- uid=660183:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** They can't be beaten solo. You  
have to rely on your bond with  
your partner to take them down.

<!-- uid=660183:22:1 -->

**Thokk:** Right now, that's what I think  
is going to be the selling point  
for Nibelungen Purgatory's combat.

<!-- uid=660183:23:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hee hee, sounds like it's going  
to be awesome. I can't wait to  
try it for myself.

<!-- uid=660183:24:1 -->


## Story 660185 · \[Heir to the Sword\] Asuna Lv.50

Character Story

**Makoto:** ...That's the gist of her idea,  
basically.

<!-- uid=660185:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh. A synchronized combat system.  
Interesting...

<!-- uid=660185:2:1 -->

**Makoto:** Do you two have any ideas I could  
share with her? Oh, but we'll have  
to keep this conversation secret.

<!-- uid=660185:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** Like she said before, she doesn't  
want people going into the game  
with any prior knowledge about it.

<!-- uid=660185:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Right, I remember. Don't worry,  
I won't tell her you came to us.

<!-- uid=660185:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yep, our lips are sealed, hee hee.

<!-- uid=660185:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, a lot of games with concepts  
like that rely on something like  
an affinity stat.

<!-- uid=660185:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** And it'll go up the longer you're  
partied with someone, making, say,  
both of your attacks stronger.

<!-- uid=660185:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's pretty common practice to  
see in RPGs and stuff, at least.

<!-- uid=660185:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** But don't you think that's  
a pretty old-fashioned way to do  
it at this point?

<!-- uid=660185:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Plus, if you make it based on  
time, it won't have much use to  
players in the beginning stages.

<!-- uid=660185:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's a good point. It might be  
a bit too old school of an idea  
for a VRMMO nowadays.

<!-- uid=660185:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** I remember how my friends and  
I used to haul our handhelds out  
to play co-op games together.

<!-- uid=660185:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Or how we used to play traditional  
MMOs over voice chat. It was kind  
of the same idea.

<!-- uid=660185:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** But I guess when you get down to  
it, it's still just dishing out  
verbal orders to one another.

<!-- uid=660185:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah. I think Thokk wants to go  
for a system that works at a more  
emotional level.

<!-- uid=660185:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ohhh. Then even players who have just met can still be synchronized if they're compatible.

<!-- uid=660185:17:1 -->

**Makoto:** Ahaha, wow, you two know your  
stuff. I figured Kirito would, but  
I'm impressed you do, too, Asuna.

<!-- uid=660185:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, it's no big deal, really.  
To be honest, I haven't actually  
been gaming for all that long.

<!-- uid=660185:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** But I was surrounded by it  
because of my dad's company.  
My brother played often, too.

<!-- uid=660185:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** I never even used a VR device  
until I borrowed my brother's,  
so...

<!-- uid=660185:21:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh, I see. That's pretty neat.

<!-- uid=660185:22:1 -->


## Story 660187 · \[Heir to the Sword\] Asuna Lv.70

Character Story

**Kirito:** ...Actually, you know, I just  
remembered something else.

<!-- uid=660187:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** The Cardinal System has a way of  
deciphering players' general  
emotions, doesn't it?

<!-- uid=660187:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah! That's what allows our  
avatars to have different facial  
expressions in the first place.

<!-- uid=660187:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh wow, I had no idea that's how  
that all worked.

<!-- uid=660187:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** If you were tap into that system,  
you might be able to transmit to  
friends what you're planning.

<!-- uid=660187:5:1 -->

**Makoto:** Really? That's actually possible?

<!-- uid=660187:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** You can't get too detailed about  
it, but I think it might work for  
at least basic directions.

<!-- uid=660187:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** You could have your basic thought  
process show up on their screen  
and then work from there.

<!-- uid=660187:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wow, that's amazing it allows for  
so much!

<!-- uid=660187:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. What I'd do is track changes  
in expression, status, and even  
each player's line of sight.

<!-- uid=660187:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Because as it is, your character  
already visibly reflects a lot of  
what you do and and experience.

<!-- uid=660187:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** So if you make an AI that monitors  
all that and conveys those changes  
in text, you might get somewhere.

<!-- uid=660187:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** It won't be accurate all the time  
at first, but feed it more data  
and it should improve over time.

<!-- uid=660187:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Once you get used to it, I bet  
you'll be able to pull off some  
big feats with friends in battles.

<!-- uid=660187:14:1 -->

**Makoto:** Whoa, that sounds awesome! Do you  
mind if I share all of that with  
Thokk?

<!-- uid=660187:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Of course not. Go right ahead!

<!-- uid=660187:16:1 -->


## Story 660188 · \[Heir to the Sword\] Asuna Lv.80

Character Story

**Thokk:** Huh. So you're saying I should  
feed the Cardinal System's  
monitoring data to an AI...

<!-- uid=660188:1:1 -->

**Thokk:** And then use that data to transmit  
accurate player orders to their  
partner instantaneously. Hmm...

<!-- uid=660188:2:1 -->

**Thokk:** That should all be doable. I don't  
see any reason it can't work, at  
least in theory.

<!-- uid=660188:3:1 -->

**Thokk:** Having real-time comments like  
that could really improve players'  
ability to coordinate moves.

<!-- uid=660188:4:1 -->

**Makoto:** Pretty good idea once you think  
about it, right?

<!-- uid=660188:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** It really is, but how did you ever  
come up with it? You're not tech  
savvy like that, Makoto.

<!-- uid=660188:6:1 -->

**Makoto:** Ahaha, that's because I didn't.  
I asked Kirito and Asuna for their  
opinions on what might work.

<!-- uid=660188:7:1 -->

**Thokk:** Ah, I should've known. Their ideas  
are always a cut above the rest.

<!-- uid=660188:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** Right? Doesn't that make you think  
you should maybe let them join  
the development team?

<!-- uid=660188:9:1 -->

**Thokk:** No way, I couldn't ask them to do  
that!

<!-- uid=660188:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** They're exactly the kind of  
players I want to go into it fresh  
and unaware of what's in store!

<!-- uid=660188:11:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hee hee, now you're talking.  
I always like seeing you get all  
fired up like that. It's cute!

<!-- uid=660188:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** Anyway, thanks. I appreciate the  
suggestion. I'll see what I can  
do with it!

<!-- uid=660188:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** Glad to hear I could help.  
Good luck with your work!

<!-- uid=660188:14:1 -->


## Story 660221 · \[Feelings Under the Helmet\] Fanatio Lv.10

Character Story

**Soldier:** Your Excellency, our forces are  
advancing to the Eastern Gate in  
good time. No issues to report.

<!-- uid=660221:1:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Great. I knew I had nothing to  
worry about with Fanatio in  
charge of their deployment.

<!-- uid=660221:2:1 -->

**Soldier:** Also, the vice commander should  
be returning to the Central  
Cathedral sometime today.

<!-- uid=660221:3:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Hm? Did she forget something?

<!-- uid=660221:4:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Not that it's too big of a deal,  
I suppose. She does have a dragon,  
after all.

<!-- uid=660221:5:1 -->

**Supply Officer:** Your Excellency! I wish to discuss  
a matter concerning the garrison's  
supply corps.

<!-- uid=660221:6:1 -->

**Bercouli:** What is it?

<!-- uid=660221:7:1 -->

**Priest:** Your Excellency! One of the  
Knights that was in cold sleep is  
showing signs of reawakening!

<!-- uid=660221:8:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Whoa, slow down, people. I can  
only handle so much at once. Let's  
take this one at a time...

<!-- uid=660221:9:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Whew... I think things have  
finally calmed down.

<!-- uid=660221:10:1 -->

**Bercouli:** I was so busy, I lost track of  
time. Looks like the sun's already  
going down.

<!-- uid=660221:11:1 -->

**???:** Your Excellency!

<!-- uid=660221:12:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Hm?

<!-- uid=660221:13:1 -->

**Fanatio:** I have returned, sir.

<!-- uid=660221:14:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Oh, Fanatio. Nice work out there.  
But what brings you back?

<!-- uid=660221:15:1 -->

**Bercouli:** I told you I'd be taking off for  
the front in a few days, didn't I?  
You could've just waited there.

<!-- uid=660221:16:1 -->

<!-- uid=660221:17:1 -->


## Story 660223 · \[Feelings Under the Helmet\] Fanatio Lv.30

Character Story

**Fanatio:** However... I couldn't help but  
feel the need to check in on  
your health.

<!-- uid=660223:1:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Huh? Well, as you can see, I'm  
doing just as fine as always.

<!-- uid=660223:2:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Yes, but you've been so busy  
managing everything in the  
Administrator's absence.

<!-- uid=660223:3:1 -->

**Fanatio:** With so few Integrity Knights at  
our disposal right now, so much  
work is falling to you.

<!-- uid=660223:4:1 -->

**Fanatio:** As the vice commander, I feel it's  
my duty to look after your health.

<!-- uid=660223:5:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Ha ha, fair enough. I appreciate  
you checking in on me, but you  
really don't need to... Hm?

<!-- uid=660223:6:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Is something the matter?

<!-- uid=660223:7:1 -->

**Bercouli:** I just realized I haven't had  
anything to eat all day.

<!-- uid=660223:8:1 -->

**Fanatio:** See? This is exactly what I'm  
talking about. You must eat or you  
won't have the stamina to march.

<!-- uid=660223:9:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Ahaha, I can handle a little  
marching. But I can't fight on an  
empty stomach, that's for sure.

<!-- uid=660223:10:1 -->

**Bercouli:** I guess I should make my way over  
to the dining hall and grab a bite  
to eat.

<!-- uid=660223:11:1 -->

**Fanatio:** I'll... I'll come with you.

<!-- uid=660223:12:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Oh, did you forget to have  
anything all day too?

<!-- uid=660223:13:1 -->

**Fanatio:** No, sir. I've had breakfast and  
lunch. I just haven't had anything  
for dinner yet...

<!-- uid=660223:14:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Wait, is that why you came all the  
way back here? To have dinner  
with me?

<!-- uid=660223:15:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Y-Yes, I realize that.

<!-- uid=660223:16:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Ha ha, well, that's awfully  
considerate of you. Food always  
tastes better with company.

<!-- uid=660223:17:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Y-Yes, I think so too.

<!-- uid=660223:18:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Come on, let's get some food.

<!-- uid=660223:19:1 -->


## Story 660225 · \[Feelings Under the Helmet\] Fanatio Lv.50

Character Story

**Bercouli:** Hm? There are no cooks here...?

<!-- uid=660225:1:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Perhaps they've already gone home  
for the day?

<!-- uid=660225:2:1 -->

**Bercouli:** I don't know. Usually there's  
always someone around... Wait,  
I think I know what's going on.

<!-- uid=660225:3:1 -->

**Bercouli:** A lot of our cooks went along on  
the march, didn't they? That'd  
explain why this place is empty.

<!-- uid=660225:4:1 -->

**Fanatio:** That's... a bit of a problem.

<!-- uid=660225:5:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Yeah. I hope there's at least  
some food left...

<!-- uid=660225:6:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Ugh... It doesn't look like there's  
anything I can eat without  
having someone prepare it.

<!-- uid=660225:7:1 -->

**Fanatio:** ...

<!-- uid=660225:8:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Guess I'll just have to go hungry  
tonight and wait for someone to  
show up tomorrow. Oh well.

<!-- uid=660225:9:1 -->

**Fanatio:** I'll... I'll cook something  
for you.

<!-- uid=660225:10:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Oh, you can cook?

<!-- uid=660225:11:1 -->

**Fanatio:** I... have next to no experience  
working in the kitchen...

<!-- uid=660225:12:1 -->

**Fanatio:** But I feel as if I'd fail you as  
my superior if I were to leave you  
hungry! Please, leave this to me!

<!-- uid=660225:13:1 -->

**Bercouli:** You may be my subordinate, but  
you don't need to feel obliged to  
cook for me...

<!-- uid=660225:14:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Well, if you want to try, I won't  
stop you. Just don't feel like you  
have to make anything fancy.

<!-- uid=660225:15:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Understood. I shall do my best!

<!-- uid=660225:16:1 -->


## Story 660227 · \[Feelings Under the Helmet\] Fanatio Lv.70

Character Story

**Fanatio:** I suppose I should... cut this up?

**Fanatio:** I'm not good with knives, though.  
Maybe I'll just use my sword...  
On second thought, maybe not.

<!-- uid=660227:2:1 -->

**Bercouli:** ...

<!-- uid=660227:3:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Now to add a little seasoning...

work okay.

<!-- uid=660227:4:1 -->

**Bercouli:** U-Uh, shouldn't you at least taste

**Fanatio:** It's... It's sweet!

affect how they taste. Now let's  
take a bite... \*munch munch\*

a unique flavor...

grilled meat, I think? That's  
what it is, right?

<!-- uid=660227:19:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Let's see... \*munch munch\*...  
It... doesn't taste like it's been  
fully cooked...

**Fanatio:** My deepest apologies! Allow me  
to cook it again with my Heaven-  
Piercing Blade!

<!-- uid=660227:21:1 -->

table to a crisp if you do that!

## Story 660228 · \[Feelings Under the Helmet\] Fanatio Lv.80

Character Story

**Fanatio:** \*sigh\*... I'm sorry. Truly sorry,  
Your Excellency...

that counts! It was an interesting  
experience, anyway...

to be desired in other areas...

Administrator's spell over us.

like this that'll help us learn

head out tomorrow?

## Story 660231 · \[Divine Sword of the Guardian\] Asuna Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** Ungh...

<!-- uid=660231:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Not again...

<!-- uid=660231:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** Completely annihilated...

<!-- uid=660231:3:1 -->

**Silica:** How many times has it been now?

<!-- uid=660231:4:2 -->

**Warla:** Five.

<!-- uid=660231:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** \*sigh\*... This game really is  
 putting us through the wringer,  
 huh?

<!-- uid=660231:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Maybe we just got too spoiled from  
 not dying much in the games we  
 usually play.

<!-- uid=660231:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeah, I think that's it. This game  
 is balanced way differently than  
 ALO, GGO, or Asuka Empire.

<!-- uid=660231:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** It's, like, we're good up to this  
 point. But anything beyond that,  
 and we're done for.

<!-- uid=660231:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** It really is unlike anything we've  
 played before...

<!-- uid=660231:10:1 -->

**Silica:** I guess it's par for the course  
 for a game willing to thrash  
 players as soon as they join.

<!-- uid=660231:11:1 -->

**Silica:** I think I've played other  
 games that felt kinda like  
 this, though...

<!-- uid=660231:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** You're not thinking of, like,  
 old arcade games or something,  
 are you?

<!-- uid=660231:13:1 -->

**Silica:** Ah, that's it! This game just  
 reminds me of them by how you get  
 better by losing over and over!

<!-- uid=660231:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** I haven't played a lot of games  
 like that, so I'm sorry if this  
 is a dumb question, but...

<!-- uid=660231:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Do those games not have  
 EXP and leveling systems to make  
 your character stronger?

<!-- uid=660231:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** There are some like that, but the  
 ones we're talking about didn't  
 have any sort of saving at all.

<!-- uid=660231:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** You'd put in 100 yen, see how far  
 you get, and then once you got a  
 game over, that was that.

<!-- uid=660231:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** That's so different from arcades  
 now, where you can save to an IC  
 card to pick things up later.

<!-- uid=660231:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** The old arcade games were maybe  
 a bit more like crane games and  
 other skill-based challenges.

<!-- uid=660231:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** So are you saying they were  
 intended to be enjoyed mostly  
 in short bursts?

<!-- uid=660231:21:1 -->

**Silica:** Yeah, I'd say so!

<!-- uid=660231:22:1 -->


## Story 660233 · \[Divine Sword of the Guardian\] Asuna Lv.30

Character Story

**Warla:** Uh, I hate to butt in, but I don't  
 have the slightest clue what any  
 of you guys are talking about...

<!-- uid=660233:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, sorry about that. Don't worry.  
 It's not important.

<!-- uid=660233:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Warla might be really intelligent,  
 but she's still an NPC in the end.

<!-- uid=660233:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Try not to talk about things  
 that'll leave her feeling left  
 out, okay?

<!-- uid=660233:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** O-Okay. I'll try to remember that.

<!-- uid=660233:5:2 -->

**Warla:** Anyway... \*yawn\*...  
 I'm getting a little sleepy...

<!-- uid=660233:6:1 -->

**Silica:** Th-That came out of nowhere...

<!-- uid=660233:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** She's still a kid. It happens...

<!-- uid=660233:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** That reminds me: I know ALO has  
 shorter days than real life. Is  
 this game like that too?

<!-- uid=660233:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, I think the day and night  
 cycle here is about the same as  
 ALO.

<!-- uid=660233:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** Then that would explain why she's  
 sleepy already.

<!-- uid=660233:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's okay if you need to rest,  
 Warla. We'll keep an eye out  
 to make sure nothing happens.

<!-- uid=660233:12:1 -->

**Warla:** O-Okay... Thanks... Asuna...

<!-- uid=660233:13:1 -->

**Warla:** Zzz... Zzz...

<!-- uid=660233:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** And just like that, she's out.

<!-- uid=660233:15:1 -->

**Silica:** She must've been exhausted.

<!-- uid=660233:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** Silica, if you wanna get some  
 shuteye too, that's okay.

<!-- uid=660233:17:1 -->

**Silica:** D-Don't treat me like a little  
 kid! I'm older than Warla!

<!-- uid=660233:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha, well, while she's resting,  
 we should probably at least get  
 our equipment straightened out.

<!-- uid=660233:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm guessing you're going to head  
 over to that starter weapon  
 storehouse we went to before.

<!-- uid=660233:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. Do you and Silica mind  
 staying here to watch over Warla?

<!-- uid=660233:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Leafa and I will go get the  
 weapons.

<!-- uid=660233:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sounds good. While you're doing  
 that, I'll gather some Drops of  
 Morning Dew around here.

<!-- uid=660233:23:1 -->

**Leafa:** I wonder how many times we're  
 gonna end up visiting that  
 storehouse before this is over...

<!-- uid=660233:24:1 -->

**Silica:** Ahaha...

<!-- uid=660233:25:1 -->


## Story 660235 · \[Divine Sword of the Guardian\] Asuna Lv.50

Character Story

**Leafa:** Hey, Kazuto? This is everything  
 that Asuna and Silica need, right?

<!-- uid=660235:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yep. And our weapons are right  
 here...

<!-- uid=660235:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** Huh?

<!-- uid=660235:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** What's wrong?

<!-- uid=660235:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** The floor feels weirdly uneven...  
 Whoa!

<!-- uid=660235:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Aah! It opened up! Is there some  
 sort of basement?

<!-- uid=660235:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** No, looks more like just a storage  
 space...

<!-- uid=660235:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** Wait, there are weapons and armor  
 here too!

<!-- uid=660235:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Really? Lemme see!  
 ...Hmm?

<!-- uid=660235:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Is it just me or is this all the  
 same stuff that's stocked in  
 the rest of the storehouse?

<!-- uid=660235:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Looks like it... I thought there'd  
 be some stronger stuff stashed  
 here, but... Wait!

<!-- uid=660235:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** It is stronger equipment! They  
 look the same, but their stats are  
 definitely higher!

<!-- uid=660235:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** Seriously?!

<!-- uid=660235:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, there's no reason not to  
 grab this stuff. It's sure to make  
 our lives much easier.

**Leafa:** Wow, that's awesome! If only we  
 knew about this sooner, it  
 could've saved us some trouble.

**Kirito:** It might not have been possible.  
 It could be designed so it only  
 unlocks after multiple visits.

**Leafa:** Huh? Oh, you mean for people who  
 have tried tons of times, but  
 still can't beat the game?

<!-- uid=660235:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha... That's another way of  
 putting it...

<!-- uid=660235:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** I figure if you're developing  
 a hard game like this, you want  
 to give players a lifeline.

<!-- uid=660235:19:1 -->

**Leafa:** Right. It's not like everyone's  
 skills are gonna improve at the  
 same rate.

<!-- uid=660235:20:1 -->

**Leafa:** Plus, if you don't want that  
 handicap, it's not like you have  
 to take advantage of it either.

<!-- uid=660235:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sure thing...

<!-- uid=660235:22:1 -->

**Leafa:** What should we do, Kazuto?

<!-- uid=660235:23:1 -->

**Leafa:** Should we grab our usual  
 equipment? Or go for the  
 upgraded stuff?

<!-- uid=660235:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** Good question...

<!-- uid=660235:25:1 -->


## Story 660237 · \[Divine Sword of the Guardian\] Asuna Lv.70

Character Story

**Asuna:** Wait, so you didn't take any of  
 the better equipment?

<!-- uid=660237:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** U-Uh... yeah.

 those stubborn types who doesn't  
 like to let a game beat him.

 he always goes for the hardest  
 difficulty.

 true...

**Asuna:** \*sigh\*... It's not every day we

 Assault Team members would've

<!-- uid=660237:11:1 -->

## Story 660238 · \[Divine Sword of the Guardian\] Asuna Lv.80

Character Story

**Kirito:** When you look back, this style of  
 game where you're building up a  
 character like in Japanese RPGs...

<!-- uid=660238:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...is something that's really  
 indicative of Japanese tastes.

<!-- uid=660238:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** It is?

<!-- uid=660238:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. Even now, a lot of western  
 games are made to simply be  
 competitions of sheer skill.

<!-- uid=660238:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** You see that in e-sports games  
 especially. Lots of RTSs and  
 fighters are like that too.

<!-- uid=660238:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh yeah, now that you mention  
 it, that is true, huh?

<!-- uid=660238:6:2 -->

**Silica:** I guess that explains why when  
 games like this come out in Japan,  
 opinions tend to be split here.

<!-- uid=660238:7:1 -->

**Silica:** They're quite different from the  
 RPGs everyone's used to,  
 after all.

<!-- uid=660238:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's a good point.

<!-- uid=660238:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** That makes sense. It makes me  
 appreciate what we have to be  
 most careful about here...

<!-- uid=660238:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Seeing as we're playing a game  
 where you lose everything if  
 you get wiped out.

<!-- uid=660238:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, we have to avoid losing  
 any rare items as a death  
 penalty at all costs.

<!-- uid=660238:12:1 -->

**Silica:** What rare items?

<!-- uid=660238:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Right now, the rarest weapon we  
 have is the Heavenhell Weapon we  
 got from the first angel we beat.

<!-- uid=660238:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** The Blade of the Azure Tear, the  
 sword that Makoto's holding  
 onto for us.

<!-- uid=660238:15:1 -->

**Silica:** Oh, I get it. Because if she's  
 not in the party, she can't lose  
 it if we all get defeated.

<!-- uid=660238:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** I guess that's a valid strategy  
 for coping with this game  
 being so hard.

<!-- uid=660238:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, that's part of the fun of  
 new games, isn't it? Learning how  
 they work and strategizing.

<!-- uid=660238:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** For sure. Anyway, we should  
 probably wake up Warla.

<!-- uid=660238:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's time to resume our adventure!

<!-- uid=660238:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Thanks!

<!-- uid=660238:21:1 -->


## Story 660251 · \[Integrity Knight Lightning Flash\] Asuna Lv.10

Character Story

**Yuuki:** Looks like we get to choose how we  
want to face those intruders.

<!-- uid=660251:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah...

<!-- uid=660251:2:1 -->

**Yuuki:** So, how should we do that?

<!-- uid=660251:3:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Not that I have any doubts we  
could take 'em in a battle of  
brains OR brawn.

<!-- uid=660251:4:1 -->

**Yuuki:** You're super smart, AND you're  
a great athlete.

<!-- uid=660251:5:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I might not have your brains,  
but when it comes to sports stuff,  
I'm even better than you!

<!-- uid=660251:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, Yuuki. I know you're confident,  
but you could still lose if you  
don't keep your guard up.

<!-- uid=660251:7:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Ehehe, you're right, sorry.

<!-- uid=660251:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** That said, I did blow them out of  
the water when we played board  
games back on my floor.

<!-- uid=660251:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** So we'd probably beat them easily  
if we did that again... But I  
doubt you'd be happy with that.

<!-- uid=660251:10:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Ha ha, that obvious, huh?  
Yeah, I don't think that kind  
of thing is in my wheelhouse.

<!-- uid=660251:11:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I'd prefer something where I get a  
chance to shine too.

<!-- uid=660251:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yes, yes, I know.

<!-- uid=660251:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** But now we're right back where we  
started.

<!-- uid=660251:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** What could we do where you  
can play a big part, while still  
ensuring our victory?

<!-- uid=660251:15:1 -->


## Story 660253 · \[Integrity Knight Lightning Flash\] Asuna Lv.30

Character Story

**Asuna:** Hey, what about a cook-off?

<!-- uid=660253:1:1 -->

**Yuuki:** C-Cooking? Are you sure I could  
play a real part in that?

<!-- uid=660253:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sure! I'll teach you everything  
I know and put you to work  
as my assistant.

<!-- uid=660253:3:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hmm, I dunno... I think I'd rather  
we went with something that's  
a little more of a workout.

<!-- uid=660253:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, I don't want to run another  
race. I'm still dealing with the  
trauma from the last one...

<!-- uid=660253:5:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Oh, right. When the intruders  
challenged you to a race and then  
pulled a fast one on you.

<!-- uid=660253:6:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I can't believe them, running on  
to the next floor instead of  
turning around like they were--

<!-- uid=660253:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Please, stop! Just hearing  
it recapped is giving me  
flashbacks...

<!-- uid=660253:8:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Then I guess there's only one  
choice left: a real fight.

<!-- uid=660253:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Huh?

<!-- uid=660253:10:1 -->

**Yuuki:** We ARE Integrity Knights,  
after all. We've got swords  
AND the skills to use 'em.

<!-- uid=660253:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** I guess we technically could since  
our opponents have weapons too...

<!-- uid=660253:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** But I think I'd really rather we  
avoid anything rough and violent  
if we can...

<!-- uid=660253:13:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Man, at this rate, I don't know  
if we're EVER gonna agree on  
something.

<!-- uid=660253:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** You prefer combat, and I prefer  
cooking... I guess we could always  
draw lots?

<!-- uid=660253:15:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hmm... Wait, I've got it! I know  
how we can decide!

<!-- uid=660253:16:1 -->

**Yuuki:** The same way we faced off the  
first time we met!

<!-- uid=660253:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** When we first met...?  
If memory serves... didn't we  
fight a sword duel back then?

<!-- uid=660253:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** So we could find out which of us  
was stronger?

<!-- uid=660253:19:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Yup! But since we're both so  
strong, we'd end up killing each  
other if we went at it for real.

<!-- uid=660253:20:1 -->

**Yuuki:** So we settled it with first-strike  
rules instead, right? That way,  
we can settle this in no time too.

<!-- uid=660253:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** I guess that's true... Okay, you  
win. We'll settle this with our  
swords.

<!-- uid=660253:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** If I land the first strike, it'll  
be a cooking match, and if you do,  
it'll be a two-on-two duel. Right?

<!-- uid=660253:23:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Right!

<!-- uid=660253:24:1 -->


## Story 660255 · \[Integrity Knight Lightning Flash\] Asuna Lv.50

Character Story

**Kirito:** Those two sure have been talking  
for a while, haven't they?

<!-- uid=660255:1:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Yeah, they have. I guess they're  
having trouble figuring out what  
sort of contest they want to hold.

<!-- uid=660255:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** MY guess is they're trying to  
come up with one where you can't  
cheat your way to "victory."

<!-- uid=660255:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hahaha, you might be right...  
I can't really blame them.

<!-- uid=660255:4:1 -->

ready for something.

<!-- uid=660255:5:1 -->

other... Wait, now they took  
up their swords?

<!-- uid=660255:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** What's going on? Did they have a  
falling out or something?

<!-- uid=660255:7:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hehe, okay, get ready for me,  
Asuna!

**Asuna:** Ready when you are!

**Yuuki:** Ha!

**Asuna:** Gah!

**Kirito:** So fast!

girl moved just now...

fast runner, but she was moving  
even faster!

<!-- uid=660255:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh man... If they end up going  
with a race again, I don't think  
there's any way we can win.

<!-- uid=660255:16:1 -->

moving so fast that neither one  
can seem to hit the other.

<!-- uid=660255:17:1 -->

can to avoid getting hit, like  
using their sheaths as shields.

<!-- uid=660255:18:1 -->

first strike will be the winner.

<!-- uid=660255:19:1 -->

imagine evading that many combo  
attacks at that speed...

<!-- uid=660255:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...Hmm.

<!-- uid=660255:21:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Something on your mind, Kirito?

<!-- uid=660255:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** I was just thinking about what  
sort of strategy we could use if  
we fought against them ourselves.

<!-- uid=660255:23:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Fight against them?  
You mean, with our swords?

<!-- uid=660255:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yup.

<!-- uid=660255:25:1 -->

**Sinon:** If it came to that, I don't see  
how you'd even stand a chance.

<!-- uid=660255:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** Don't be so sure. Yeah, they're  
fast, but their individual strikes  
don't seem all that heavy.

<!-- uid=660255:27:1 -->

**Kirito:** Which means we would have a chance  
against them, as long as we can  
endure some light attacks.

<!-- uid=660255:28:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Hey, yeah...!

<!-- uid=660255:29:1 -->

Character Story

**Yuuki:** Yah!  
Hiyaaah!

**Asuna:** Hrah!  
Eeyah!

landing a hit, are they?

## Story 660258 · \[Integrity Knight Lightning Flash\] Asuna Lv.80

Character Story

**Kirito:** This is it...!

<!-- uid=660258:1:1 -->

## Story 660261 · \[Plenty of Fortune\] Ronie Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** Phew. It wasn't always easy,  
but I'm glad we got to see the  
sunrise here in Asuka Empire.

it's going to turn out to be  
another great year.

<!-- uid=660261:2:1 -->

**Eugeo:** So, what do we do about food  
now that we're all on board with  
getting breakfast somewhere?

<!-- uid=660261:3:1 -->

**Alice:** What about hunting, since we are  
on a mountain? We could also  
scavenge for edible plants.

**Asuna:** Um, that would work too, but I  
think I'd rather eat somewhere  
a little more...relaxing?

Maybe this is one of those.

<!-- uid=660261:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Now that you mention it, there's  
a place on top of Mount Takao  
that's famous for its soba.

**Eugeo:** Hm? Hey, look at what it is

<!-- uid=660261:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Don't tell me...

## Story 660263 · \[Plenty of Fortune\] Ronie Lv.30

Character Story

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Toshi-koshi soba! Get your toshi-  
koshi soba right here! Can't start  
the new year without it!

<!-- uid=660263:1:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Already had some last night?

<!-- uid=660263:2:1 -->

while you've got the chance!

**Kirito:** That seems kind of unlikely...

<!-- uid=660263:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, it DOES get pretty cold on

<!-- uid=660263:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Having a bowl of hot soba now

scratch...

<!-- uid=660263:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** If we're talking about grinding  
buckwheat flour ourselves...  
that's gonna take a lot of time.

<!-- uid=660263:13:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Excuse me.

<!-- uid=660263:14:1 -->

**Player:** Hm?

<!-- uid=660263:15:1 -->

**Eugeo:** You were just eating there, right?  
Can I ask you how the soba was?

<!-- uid=660263:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Looks like Eugeo's putting his  
social skills to work again.

<!-- uid=660263:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ahaha...

<!-- uid=660263:18:1 -->

**Player:** Uh, s-sure. It was really good.

<!-- uid=660263:19:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...?

<!-- uid=660263:20:1 -->

**Player:** W-Well, you'll see if you go in

the soba is is up to you.

**Eugeo:** Huh?

**Kirito:** Up to us? How does that work?

<!-- uid=660263:23:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Ah, I see you're interested in our  
food! Come on, right this way!

<!-- uid=660263:24:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Party of four, coming through!

<!-- uid=660263:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yikes. Talk about pushy.

<!-- uid=660263:26:1 -->

**Alice:** Does this mean our actions will

<!-- uid=660263:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm not sure either...

**Kirito:** Uh oh...
