## Story 660265 · \[Plenty of Fortune\] Ronie Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** Let's see what's on the menu...

<!-- uid=660265:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh? It's totally blank.

<!-- uid=660265:2:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Okay everyone, let me tell you all  
about our New Year's special!

<!-- uid=660265:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** New Year's special?

<!-- uid=660265:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** That sounds interesting.

<!-- uid=660265:5:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** It is! For this special, the food  
you receive will be determined by  
your answers on a quiz!

<!-- uid=660265:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Q-Quiz?

<!-- uid=660265:7:1 -->

**Alice:** What is a quiz?

<!-- uid=660265:8:2 -->

**Asuna:** Um, basically, it's a game where  
you have to answer riddles.

<!-- uid=660265:9:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Why do we have to do a quiz just  
to eat?

<!-- uid=660265:10:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Simple! It's not New Year's if  
you're not sitting around watching  
TV with your family!

<!-- uid=660265:11:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** And what could be more  
entertaining for the whole family  
than a quiz show?!

<!-- uid=660265:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** A-Are you sure? I don't think  
that's generally how New Year's is  
celebrated these days...

<!-- uid=660265:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, this IS Asuka Empire. They  
may be going for something more  
old-fashioned here on purpose.

<!-- uid=660265:14:1 -->

**Eugeo:** So, let me get this straight...

<!-- uid=660265:15:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Does this mean the quality of our  
food changes depending on how many  
riddles we get right?

<!-- uid=660265:16:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** You got it! Answer all three  
questions correctly, and you'll  
get to enjoy the best soba ever!

<!-- uid=660265:17:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** But be careful! For every question  
you get wrong, the soba's quality  
will drop proportionally!

<!-- uid=660265:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** So this is what that person Eugeo  
talked to meant...

<!-- uid=660265:19:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Now let's get started!  
Question one!

<!-- uid=660265:20:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** How did toshi-koshi soba, the  
custom of eating buckwheat noodles  
on New Year's Eve, originate?

<!-- uid=660265:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Uhh...

<!-- uid=660265:22:1 -->


## Story 660267 · \[Plenty of Fortune\] Ronie Lv.70

Character Story

**Asuna:** I know that one.  
In fact, a lot of people do.

<!-- uid=660267:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's because people used to think  
that eating long foods would in  
turn lead to a long life.

<!-- uid=660267:2:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** That answer is...  
Correct!

<!-- uid=660267:3:1 -->

**Alice:** Well done, Asuna. I am not  
surprised you knew that.

<!-- uid=660267:4:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I see. So that's how it began.

<!-- uid=660267:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Now that you mention it, I think  
I've heard that before, too...

<!-- uid=660267:6:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Question two! Nowadays, people go  
to both temples AND shrines to  
pray on New Year's Day.

<!-- uid=660267:7:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** In which historical period did  
temples and shrines start to be  
treated separately?

<!-- uid=660267:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh?  
Well, uh...

<!-- uid=660267:9:1 -->

**Eugeo:** So this is about Asuka Empire's  
history, huh. There's no way I can  
figure out this one.

<!-- uid=660267:10:1 -->

**Alice:** When was it that the Buddha first  
came to be?

<!-- uid=660267:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Didn't Buddhism get its start in  
Japan during the Asuka period?

<!-- uid=660267:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** True, but that's the wrong line of  
thinking. Temples and shrines  
were only treated separately...

<!-- uid=660267:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...once Shinto was separated from  
Buddhism. And THAT happened in  
the Meiji period!

<!-- uid=660267:14:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** That answer is correct!

<!-- uid=660267:15:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Way to go, Asuna!

<!-- uid=660267:16:1 -->

**Alice:** I do not know how long ago either  
of those periods are. Were they  
close to one another?

<!-- uid=660267:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** No, not at all. They're hundreds  
of years apart. You really know  
your stuff, Asuna...

<!-- uid=660267:18:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Now for the final question! Seeing  
the first sunrise of the year...

<!-- uid=660267:19:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** ...is a custom meant to greet the  
god of the new year.

<!-- uid=660267:20:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** What is the other thing that this  
god of the new year symbolizes?

<!-- uid=660267:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Something it symbolizes?

<!-- uid=660267:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ooh, this is a toughie...

<!-- uid=660267:23:1 -->


## Story 660268 · \[Plenty of Fortune\] Ronie Lv.80

Character Story

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Once again, what does the god of  
the new year symbolize?

<!-- uid=660268:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Err...

<!-- uid=660268:2:1 -->

**Eugeo:** This MUST be tough if Asuna  
doesn't know the answer.

<!-- uid=660268:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** If Asuna doesn't know,  
I definitely don't...

<!-- uid=660268:4:1 -->

**Alice:** There are a number of gods for  
different things in my world, too.

<!-- uid=660268:5:2 -->

**Alice:** Stacia, goddess of creation...  
Solus, goddess of the sun...  
Terraria, goddess of the earth...

<!-- uid=660268:6:1 -->

**Alice:** Creation, sun, and earth, huh...  
I guess those all make sense.

<!-- uid=660268:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** I feel like there's got to be more  
to this question than that,  
though... Can we get a hint?

<!-- uid=660268:8:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** A hint, eh. Alright.  
Traditionally, people decorate  
their homes in order to greet...

<!-- uid=660268:9:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** ...the god of the new year,  
typically using kadomatsu pines  
and thick shimenawa straw ropes.

<!-- uid=660268:10:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Kadomatsu? Shimenawa...?

<!-- uid=660268:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh yeah, there were actually some  
of those decorating the outside of  
this lodge.

<!-- uid=660268:12:1 -->

**Alice:** Ah, is that what those were? Now  
that I think of it, I saw them  
back in Kiyomihara as well.

<!-- uid=660268:13:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** One such decoration is said to be  
closely tied to the god of the new  
year...

<!-- uid=660268:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** A new year's decoration?  
Wh-Which one could it be?

<!-- uid=660268:15:1 -->

**Alice:** Hmm. A traditional New Year's  
decoration that has close ties to  
the god of the new year...?

<!-- uid=660268:16:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...Hey, speaking of decorations,  
what's that white round thing up  
near the ceiling?

<!-- uid=660268:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's... kagami mochi.

<!-- uid=660268:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...Kagami mochi!  
Now I get it!

<!-- uid=660268:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Me too!  
It all makes sense now!

<!-- uid=660268:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yup. Japan has flourished for  
centuries thanks to this!  
The answer is...

<!-- uid=660268:21:1 -->

**Asuna & Kirito:** The god of agriculture!!!

<!-- uid=660268:22:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Correct! Since you got every  
question right...

<!-- uid=660268:23:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** You get to have our premium toshi-  
koshi soba, made with edible wild  
plants grown on this mountain!

<!-- uid=660268:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** We did it!

<!-- uid=660268:25:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Nice job, Asuna! I'm impressed you  
knew the answer too, Kirito.

<!-- uid=660268:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's all thanks to you and Alice  
noticing the kagami mochi.

<!-- uid=660268:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yup! Kagami mochi on New Year's is  
such a common sight for us that we  
didn't even think about it.

<!-- uid=660268:28:1 -->

**Alice:** The god of agriculture, eh...  
So in this world, there is even  
a god for that.

<!-- uid=660268:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yup. They say there's a god that  
inhabits pretty much anything and  
everything here.

<!-- uid=660268:30:1 -->

**Eugeo:** You don't say. Anyway, now Alice  
and I get to find out what GOOD  
soba tastes like!

<!-- uid=660268:31:1 -->

**Asuna:** You know, doing that quiz actually  
helped me work up a little  
appetite. I can't wait to try it!

<!-- uid=660268:32:1 -->


## Story 660271 · \[Divine Flash\] Makoto Lv.10

Character Story

**Yuuki:** Hyah!

**Purgatory Beasts:** Rrragh!

**Yuuki:** Now, Makoto!

**Makoto:** Taaake THIS!

**Purgatory Beasts:** Graaawr!

**Kirito:** Nice job, you two. Man...  
I can't believe this is your

<!-- uid=660271:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Your teamwork is flawless.

## Story 660273 · \[Divine Flash\] Makoto Lv.30

Character Story

**Yuuki:** Hya!

<!-- uid=660273:1:1 -->

**Purgatory Beasts:** Rrragh!

<!-- uid=660273:2:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Now, Makoto!

<!-- uid=660273:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** Kiyaaah!

<!-- uid=660273:4:1 -->

**Purgatory Beasts:** Graaaw...!

<!-- uid=660273:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wow, they just took down another  
one like it was nothing...

<!-- uid=660273:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** That enemy type gave us so much  
trouble when we first started out  
here, too...

<!-- uid=660273:7:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hehehe, how do you like them  
apples?!

<!-- uid=660273:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** Say, real-world experience helps  
a lot in virtual worlds, right? Do  
you do martial arts too, Yuuki?

<!-- uid=660273:9:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Uh, no, I haven't been able to get  
much real-life exercise lately...

<!-- uid=660273:10:1 -->

**Yuuki:** But I don't think anyone can beat  
me when it comes to time in VR.

<!-- uid=660273:11:1 -->

**Yuuki:** So I think my quick reflexes just  
come from being used to VR, after  
all the time I've spent here.

<!-- uid=660273:12:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh yeah, you did say you've been  
to all sorts of different worlds,  
didn't you? What were they like?

<!-- uid=660273:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** I've still only been to ALO and  
this Purgatory world that's still  
in development.

<!-- uid=660273:14:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Well, there was one where you got  
to be a bug.

<!-- uid=660273:15:1 -->

**Yuuki:** And an old-school Japanese one  
that brought Japanese myths and  
monsters to life.

<!-- uid=660273:16:1 -->

**Makoto:** A Japanese one, huh...  
That sounds like fun.

<!-- uid=660273:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Since you like the Shinsengumi,  
I bet you'd feel right at home in  
Asuka Empire, Makoto.

<!-- uid=660273:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh, so she was talking about  
Asuka Empire!

<!-- uid=660273:19:1 -->

**Makoto:** I think I might've told you this  
before, but I'm actually borrowing  
this AmuSphere from my father.

<!-- uid=660273:20:1 -->

**Makoto:** He's always been into Japanese  
period dramas and the Shinsengumi  
and the like, so the whole reason

<!-- uid=660273:21:1 -->

**Makoto:** he bought it in the first place  
was to try Asuka Empire out.

<!-- uid=660273:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Aha, so that's why he had it.  
But, isn't your father kind of...

<!-- uid=660273:23:1 -->

**Makoto:** Yeah, he only likes historically  
accurate representations of old  
Japan, so he didn't care for it.

<!-- uid=660273:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** I can see why. Asuka Empire may be  
based on old Japan, but it's also  
a fantasy game.

<!-- uid=660273:25:1 -->

**Makoto:** That kind of thing wouldn't bother  
me, though. I'd like to try it  
myself sometime.

<!-- uid=660273:26:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Forget sometime! Why don't we just  
go there right now?

<!-- uid=660273:27:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I mean, it's easy to go between

by converting your data.

<!-- uid=660273:28:1 -->

**Makoto:** I'm sure it does, but, uh, that's

permits...

<!-- uid=660273:29:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Ohhh, right. Man, grown-ups sure

<!-- uid=660273:30:1 -->

**Makoto:** \*weary sigh\*

<!-- uid=660273:31:1 -->


## Story 660275 · \[Divine Flash\] Makoto Lv.50

Character Story

**Makoto:** What other sorts of games are  
there?

<!-- uid=660275:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Of the ones currently in service,  
I'd say GGO is pretty popular.

<!-- uid=660275:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, GGO stands for Gun Gale  
Online. It's a shooting game where  
you go around fighting with guns

<!-- uid=660275:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** in a future where the earth has  
been all but destroyed from war.

<!-- uid=660275:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's got monsters too, but I'd say  
its main focus is on PvP gunplay.

<!-- uid=660275:5:1 -->

**Makoto:** That sounds...kind of like a  
Hollywood blockbuster?

<!-- uid=660275:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Pretty much. It IS made and  
operated by an American developer.

<!-- uid=660275:7:1 -->

**Makoto:** I see... I don't think I could be  
much help in that one, since  
I only know how to use swords.

<!-- uid=660275:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ahaha. Well, as it turns out, GGO  
DOES have a sword, and Kirito's  
done some amazing things with it.

<!-- uid=660275:9:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh? Like what?

<!-- uid=660275:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Like cutting down bullets before  
they can hit him.

<!-- uid=660275:11:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wow, really? I mean, these  
bullets are traveling at  
real-world speeds, right?

<!-- uid=660275:12:1 -->

**Makoto:** It really is like a hybrid between  
an action movie and a game...

<!-- uid=660275:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, I should warn you that  
Kirito's pretty much the only one  
who can do that.

<!-- uid=660275:14:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hehe, I see. In that case, as  
something of a swordfighter  
myself, I'll have to see if I can

<!-- uid=660275:15:1 -->

**Makoto:** cut down bullets too if I ever  
decide to dive into GGO.

<!-- uid=660275:16:1 -->

shut-in or something?

<!-- uid=660303:5:3 -->

**Oracle:** I've...been through a lot.

<!-- uid=660303:6:1 -->

**Oracle:** But thanks to the Phantom Thieves,  
I've escaped the darkness! I still  
live my life on the net though.

<!-- uid=660303:7:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Sounds a lot like me!

<!-- uid=660303:8:1 -->

**Oracle:** R-Really?! You were a shut-in too?  
Do you like figures?! DO YOU  
LIKE FEATHERMAN?!

<!-- uid=660303:9:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Er, sorry... Shut-in isn't quite  
right, and I've never heard of  
Featherman. But...

<!-- uid=660303:10:1 -->

**Yuuki:** It's true that this world and my  
friends saved me.

<!-- uid=660303:11:1 -->

**Oracle:** Whoa...

<!-- uid=660303:12:1 -->

**Yuuki:** If it weren't for them, I don't  
know what would've happened to me.

<!-- uid=660303:13:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Like, I can't let Kirito there  
beat me, and Asuna's basically  
family.

<!-- uid=660303:14:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Leafa and I are besties, and Sinon  
is just SO cool. And such a cutie!

<!-- uid=660303:15:1 -->

**Oracle:** Interesting...

<!-- uid=660303:16:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hey, Oracle? How do you feel about  
all your friends?

<!-- uid=660303:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, I want to know too.

<!-- uid=660303:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** Lay it on us.

<!-- uid=660303:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** You're a closed door. Let us in!

<!-- uid=660303:20:1 -->

**Oracle:** Urgh, merciless! Interrogation  
hell! Fine! U-Uh... If I had to  
compare them to Featherman...

<!-- uid=660303:21:1 -->

**Oracle:** Joker's Red, Skull is Yellow,  
Panther is Pink, and Queen is...  
Also Pink. Noir is...Pink?

<!-- uid=660303:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Back up! I've never seen  
Featherman, but...

<!-- uid=660303:23:1 -->

**Leafa:** Why is everyone pink?!

<!-- uid=660303:24:1 -->

**Oracle:** How to explain... Eh, I guess to  
sum it up, I feel the same as  
Yuuki. My friends are the best!

<!-- uid=660303:25:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Woohoo!

<!-- uid=660303:26:1 -->


## Story 660305 · \[VR World Empress\] Asuna Lv.50

Character Story

**Kirito:** I've been thinking, we don't know  
each other that well yet. How about  
we share a little about ourselves?

<!-- uid=660305:1:1 -->

**Mona:** We are the great Phantom Thieves!  
We do not reveal our secrets so  
easily.

<!-- uid=660305:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, I'm guessing we're all  
around the same age. You're high  
school students, right?

<!-- uid=660305:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** I think Oracle's a bit younger  
than us.

<!-- uid=660305:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** And none of you have an odd accent,  
so I'm guessing you're Tokyoites.

<!-- uid=660305:5:1 -->

**Yuuki:** They've got a lot of secrets...but  
I think they're nice people.

<!-- uid=660305:6:1 -->

**Skull:** What are you, amateur detectives?!

<!-- uid=660305:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ah, sorry. But I don't think any of  
us can resist a mystery!

<!-- uid=660305:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** We won't pry if you'd rather us  
not. But we'll tell you about  
ourselves, get the ball rolling.

<!-- uid=660305:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Then again, we're just a bunch of  
ordinary students. Well...one  
of us is a bit of a special case.

<!-- uid=660305:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** Asuna's dad's the CEO of a huge  
corporation.

<!-- uid=660305:11:1 -->

**Noir:** Oh! That's pretty tough, huh?

<!-- uid=660305:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Tough... Yeah, you could say that.

<!-- uid=660305:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** A lot is expected of me, and... I'm  
not totally free to choose my own  
life. It's a pain sometimes.

<!-- uid=660305:14:1 -->

**Noir:** Like...your parents won't let  
you pick who you marry?

<!-- uid=660305:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Urk...

<!-- uid=660305:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Nnnrgh...

<!-- uid=660305:17:1 -->

**Noir:** Bingo?

<!-- uid=660305:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** I can't...deny that...

<!-- uid=660305:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** But...what's the deal? Why the  
sudden burst of curiosity?

<!-- uid=660305:20:1 -->

**Noir:** Because I think you and I have  
a lot in common.

<!-- uid=660305:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** We do?

<!-- uid=660305:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wait a sec, Noir! That means...  
You seem so graceful and refined,  
but you're a berserk healer too?!

<!-- uid=660305:23:1 -->

**Noir:** I'm...not sure I follow?

<!-- uid=660305:24:1 -->

**Oracle:** He's calling you crazy violent.

<!-- uid=660305:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito! Why would you mention  
that?!

<!-- uid=660305:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** If they suddenly saw you transform  
from dainty debutante into violent  
killing machine, they'd freak.

<!-- uid=660305:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** Phrasing, Kirito! Come on!

<!-- uid=660305:28:1 -->

**Mona:** Well, in that case, you should know  
that Noir here is the Beauty Thief!

<!-- uid=660305:29:1 -->

**Noir:** M-Mona! D-Don't tell them that!

<!-- uid=660305:30:1 -->

**Oracle:** Beauty and the Berserker...  
Sounds like a movie.

<!-- uid=660305:31:1 -->


## Story 660307 · \[VR World Empress\] Asuna Lv.70

Character Story

**Leafa:** I had a thought when I saw your  
Persona, Queen. It might just  
help us fight better as a team!

<!-- uid=660307:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Queen's Persona? ...Oh, that!

<!-- uid=660307:2:1 -->

**Skull:** Yeah! She's like a post-apocalyptic  
raider, right?!

<!-- uid=660307:3:1 -->

**Queen:** Do you want to get smacked?

<!-- uid=660307:4:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Ooo, I can see it!  
'Cause she's all spiky!

<!-- uid=660307:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** She reminds me of the wastelands.

<!-- uid=660307:6:1 -->

**Queen:** ...I'll take that as a compliment.

<!-- uid=660307:7:1 -->

**Queen:** Anyway. You said my Persona might  
help us work together. How?

<!-- uid=660307:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Kirito rides a hog like yours  
sometimes too. Sinon knows  
what I'm talking 'bout, right?

<!-- uid=660307:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** Ugh. Yeah. He rode it out to see  
me when he was worried about me  
during that...incident.

<!-- uid=660307:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** Thanks to that, I had to deal with  
all sorts of annoying rumors.

<!-- uid=660307:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Rumors? What sort of rumors?

<!-- uid=660307:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** A normal person wouldn't ride up  
on a motorcycle to pick up just  
a friend.

<!-- uid=660307:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh...  
Did people get the wrong idea?

<!-- uid=660307:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** You think?

<!-- uid=660307:15:1 -->

**Panther:** Hey, so Sinon and Kirito are  
going out, then?

<!-- uid=660307:16:1 -->

**Sinon:** Gah?!

<!-- uid=660307:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** N-No... We're just friends.

<!-- uid=660307:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** E-Exactly! That's exactly right!

<!-- uid=660307:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** Besides, Kirito already married  
Asuna once!

<!-- uid=660307:20:1 -->

**Panther:** Th-They're married?!  
...Wait, what do you  
mean by "once"?

<!-- uid=660307:21:1 -->

**Joker:** ...They got divorced.

<!-- uid=660307:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** N-No! We got married in-game!

<!-- uid=660307:23:1 -->

**Violet:** Which means you're single in real  
life.

<!-- uid=660307:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey, Sinon? Can we choose our  
words more carefully? We'll give  
people the wrong idea.

<!-- uid=660307:25:1 -->

**Sinon:** Right...

<!-- uid=660307:26:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...Sorry, Queen. Looks like  
Leafa's idea didn't pan out after  
all.

<!-- uid=660307:27:1 -->

**Queen:** What a coincidence, Sinon. I was  
just thinking the same thing.

<!-- uid=660307:28:1 -->


## Story 660308 · \[VR World Empress\] Asuna Lv.80

Character Story

**Joker:** I think it's about time we took  
on that boss again.

<!-- uid=660308:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Agreed. We've gotten to know each  
other much better. We should be  
able to team up and take it out!

<!-- uid=660308:2:1 -->

**Skull:** Gngh! This thing's defenses are  
as strong as ever!

<!-- uid=660308:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Don't worry, we got this!

<!-- uid=660308:4:1 -->

**Queen:** Leave it to me!

<!-- uid=660308:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** Go, Queen! I got your back!

<!-- uid=660308:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hyaaah!

<!-- uid=660308:7:1 -->

**Queen:** Thanks, Sinon!

<!-- uid=660308:8:1 -->

**Oracle:** It dropped its guard! Yuuki!  
Now's your chance!

<!-- uid=660308:9:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Here goes!

<!-- uid=660308:10:1 -->

**Mona:** Nice shot, it felt that! Now, time  
for an all-out team attack!

<!-- uid=660308:12:1 -->

**Noir:** Asuna! Switch!

<!-- uid=660308:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Thanks, Noir!

<!-- uid=660308:14:1 -->

**Oracle:** Nice! Now pass the baton and  
give it the kablammo!

<!-- uid=660308:16:1 -->

**Joker:** Let's do it, Kirito!

<!-- uid=660308:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** I've been waiting for you to  
say that, Joker!

<!-- uid=660308:18:1 -->

**Joker:** It's time to finish this!

<!-- uid=660308:20:1 -->

**Oracle:** Go! Get 'em! All-out attack!

<!-- uid=660308:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's over!

<!-- uid=660308:22:1 -->

**Fox:** Yes! Victory is ours!

<!-- uid=660308:24:1 -->

**Leafa:** That was easier than I expected!

<!-- uid=660308:25:1 -->

**Violet:** Our strategy to chat and learn  
about each other to improve our  
teamwork worked like a charm!

<!-- uid=660308:26:1 -->

**Asuna:** The masks made me a little scared  
of you all at first, but now I'm  
glad you're our friends!

<!-- uid=660308:27:1 -->

**Noir:** Hehe, the same goes for us.  
I still can't believe you tried  
to eat Mona.

<!-- uid=660308:28:1 -->

**Sinon:** You're usually so rational and  
collected, Queen, but you get  
pretty heated in battle.

<!-- uid=660308:29:1 -->

**Queen:** I could say the same about you,  
Sinon.

<!-- uid=660308:30:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hey, Oracle! Our teamwork's  
beyond perfect, don't you think?

<!-- uid=660308:31:1 -->

**Oracle:** I think I finally understand what  
Inari was talking about. A  
sympathetic heart goes a long way!

<!-- uid=660308:32:1 -->

**Joker:** We're counting on you in the  
battles ahead too.

<!-- uid=660308:33:1 -->

**Kirito:** Right back at you.

<!-- uid=660308:34:1 -->

**Kirito:** Now... Let's get back to the game!

<!-- uid=660308:35:1 -->


## Story 660341 · \[Starry-Eyed Maiden\] Ronie Lv.10

Character Story

**Alice:** ...!

<!-- uid=660341:1:1 -->

**Alice:** ...I never imagined we'd be  
running around hills and fields  
in these dresses...

<!-- uid=660341:2:1 -->

**Alice:** Though it does seem that they're  
made in a fairly unique way...

<!-- uid=660341:3:1 -->

**Alice:** They're created out of materials  
that can withstand this Bridal  
Contest's rough conditions.

<!-- uid=660341:4:1 -->

**Alice:** I shouldn't waste much time here.  
I need to hurry to the goal...

<!-- uid=660341:5:1 -->

**Ronie:** \*pant\* \*pant\*...  
L-Lady Alice!

<!-- uid=660341:6:1 -->

**Ronie:** Th-Thank goodness...  
I managed to catch up to you.

<!-- uid=660341:7:1 -->

**Alice:** Ronie...

<!-- uid=660341:8:1 -->

**Alice:** (She's still following me...)

<!-- uid=660341:9:1 -->

**Alice:** (Lots of regular country girls are  
taking part in this contest. It  
can't be that dangerous...)

<!-- uid=660341:10:1 -->

**Alice:** (Even as a primary trainee, I  
guess it's actually quite natural  
for her to have a decent showing.)

<!-- uid=660341:11:1 -->

**Alice:** (Still... I have to admit, I'm  
surprised she could keep up  
with a knight like myself.)

<!-- uid=660341:12:1 -->

**Alice:** ...I'm sorry, but I'm not  
interested in playing nice  
with you right now.

<!-- uid=660341:13:1 -->

**Ronie:** Huh?!

<!-- uid=660341:14:1 -->

**Ronie:** Sh-She vanished in the blink of  
an eye...

<!-- uid=660341:15:1 -->

**Ronie:** That's Lady Alice for you...  
What movement, even in a dress...

<!-- uid=660341:16:1 -->

**Ronie:** Ngh...! No, I can't give up!  
I need to do my best too...!

<!-- uid=660341:17:1 -->


## Story 660343 · \[Starry-Eyed Maiden\] Ronie Lv.30

Character Story

**Alice:** ...

<!-- uid=660343:1:1 -->

**Ronie:** \*pant\* \*pant\*...

<!-- uid=660343:2:1 -->

**Alice:** ...What an unexpected turn of  
events.

<!-- uid=660343:3:1 -->

**Alice:** (Unbelievable. I can't shake  
her...)

<!-- uid=660343:4:1 -->

**Alice:** Are my movements dulled because  
I'm wearing this dress...?

<!-- uid=660343:5:1 -->

**Alice:** ...No, that can't be it. I'm  
already quite used to moving  
about in it...

<!-- uid=660343:6:1 -->

**Alice:** So does that mean that it's her  
speed that's increasing...?

<!-- uid=660343:7:1 -->

**Ronie:** \*pant\* \*pant\*... Wh-Wha?!

<!-- uid=660343:8:2 -->

**Alice:** Primary Trainee Ronie.  
I have a question for you.

<!-- uid=660343:9:1 -->

**Ronie:** Um...? Y-Yes?!  
What might that be?!

<!-- uid=660343:10:1 -->

**Alice:** Do you have any prior experience  
marching through mountainous  
terrain?

<!-- uid=660343:11:1 -->

**Ronie:** What...?

<!-- uid=660343:12:1 -->

**Ronie:** ...N-No, almost none. I belong to  
a supply unit positioned at the  
rear. I've barely seen combat...

<!-- uid=660343:13:1 -->

**Alice:** (And yet she can move like this...  
She seems to have far surpassed  
the level of primary trainee...)

<!-- uid=660343:14:1 -->

**Alice:** ...Out of curiosity, has Kirito  
taught you how to march?

<!-- uid=660343:15:1 -->

**Ronie:** Kirito? Um, well...  
Not really...

<!-- uid=660343:16:1 -->

**Ronie:** He's mostly taught me  
swordsmanship... Oh, but...

<!-- uid=660343:17:1 -->

**Ronie:** I do imitate the way he moves...  
So maybe he's influenced me a  
little in that way!

<!-- uid=660343:18:1 -->

**Alice:** ...I see.

<!-- uid=660343:19:1 -->

**Alice:** (She was Kirito's page... So she  
must have received a good bit  
of tutelage from him.)

<!-- uid=660343:20:1 -->

**Alice:** (Still... that doesn't answer my  
question. There seems to be  
something even more to her...)

<!-- uid=660343:21:1 -->

**Alice:** ...Sorry to have taken up your  
time. Why don't we continue  
the Bridal Contest?

<!-- uid=660343:22:1 -->

**Ronie:** Oh... O-Okay!

<!-- uid=660343:23:1 -->

**Ronie:** I'm not losing here...  
even if it's you I'm up  
against, Lady Alice!

<!-- uid=660343:24:1 -->


## Story 660345 · \[Starry-Eyed Maiden\] Ronie Lv.50

Character Story

**Alice:** ...

<!-- uid=660345:1:1 -->

**Alice:** ...Looks like I've finally shaken  
her off my trail.

**Alice:** Perhaps that was a bit childish  
of me... No, but...

<!-- uid=660345:3:1 -->

**Wolf:** Graaar!

<!-- uid=660345:4:1 -->

**Alice:** A pack of wolves...!

<!-- uid=660345:5:1 -->

**Alice:** There aren't too many of them...

<!-- uid=660345:6:1 -->

**Alice:** Very well. I'll just have to...

**Wolf:** Graaar!

<!-- uid=660345:8:1 -->

**Alice:** System Call.  
Generate Thermal Element.

**Alice:** ...Discharge!

**Wolf:** Gruuooooh!

**Wolf:** \*whimper\*

**Alice:** Ugh, I let some get away...!

**Alice:** (Oh no. It's going to be hard to

**Alice:** ...Fine. I'll just have to hurry

other competitors. I doubt the  
wolves could do much harm to...

**Man's Voice:** U-Uaaaagh!

## Story 660347 · \[Starry-Eyed Maiden\] Ronie Lv.70

Character Story

**Wolf:** Graaaoooh!

<!-- uid=660347:1:1 -->

**Merchant:** Aaaaaaaaah!

<!-- uid=660347:2:1 -->

**Alice:** ...!  
Oh no...!

<!-- uid=660347:3:1 -->

**Alice:** You over there! I'll draw that  
wolf's attention!

<!-- uid=660347:4:1 -->

**Alice:** Just do what you can to get away  
from it! Hurry!

<!-- uid=660347:5:1 -->

**Merchant:** Y-You're... um... a b-bride...?

<!-- uid=660347:6:1 -->

**Alice:** Mgh...! What I look like doesn't

I say!

<!-- uid=660347:7:1 -->

**Merchant:** I'd like to, but...  
I-I can't even move...!

<!-- uid=660347:8:1 -->

**Alice:** Wha...?!

<!-- uid=660347:9:1 -->

**Wolf:** GRAAAAR!

<!-- uid=660347:10:1 -->

**Merchant:** Aaaagh!

<!-- uid=660347:11:1 -->

**Alice:** Gah...! System Call!  
Generate...

<!-- uid=660347:12:1 -->

**Alice:** (No...! I won't make it in time

**Ronie:** Heh, heh heh...

## Story 660348 · \[Starry-Eyed Maiden\] Ronie Lv.80

Character Story

**Merchant:** I'll be taking my leave here...  
I owe you one, young lady!

**Ronie:** Please stay safe!

**Alice:** ...Thank you, Ronie.

**Ronie:** What...? Y-You're thanking me,  
Lady Alice?

**Alice:** The wolf attacked that man  
because I failed to finish off  
a pack of them.

<!-- uid=660348:5:1 -->

**Alice:** If you hadn't been nearby,  
he may have lost his life.

<!-- uid=660348:6:1 -->

**Alice:** So... allow me to thank you.

**Ronie:** N-No...! I barely did anything...

**Ronie:** I'm sure you would have figured

<!-- uid=660348:9:1 -->

**Ronie:** I just saw someone being attacked

**Ronie:** ...My body moved on its own.

**Ronie:** Yes! I still have a ways to go...

**Alice:** ...!

<!-- uid=660348:14:1 -->

**Alice:** ...I see now that Kirito exists  
within you.

**Alice:** Yes... I'm starting to  
understand now. That is the  
source of your strength...

<!-- uid=660348:16:1 -->

**Alice:** (...So, I was unable to judge her  
true worth, distracted by her  
appearance and title.)

**Alice:** (She was Kirito's page... and so  
Kirito's existence has taken root  
within her...)

<!-- uid=660348:18:1 -->

**Alice:** (Almost like me...)

<!-- uid=660348:19:1 -->

## Story 660373 · \[Tropical Time\] Asuna Lv.30

Character Story

**Asuna:** So... what kind of quest is it?

<!-- uid=660373:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** The quest itself is simple. Just  
chase a treasure chest swimming  
in the ocean and open it.

<!-- uid=660373:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Swimming treasure chests!  
I've never heard of anything  
like that.

<!-- uid=660373:3:1 -->

## Story 660398 · \[Power to Save\] Asuna Lv.80

## Story 660475 · \[Pure Heart\] Ronie Lv.50

Character Story

<!-- uid=660475:4:1 -->

<!-- uid=660481:22:1 -->

**Shino:** She's easy to remember, but  
everyone else I have to make a  
conscious effort. It's hard.

<!-- uid=660481:23:1 -->

**Suguha:** I get what you mean. It's tricky  
to switch tracks like that  
sometimes for sure!

<!-- uid=660481:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** Is it really that hard? Well,  
I guess I'm used to it in my case  
because of school.

<!-- uid=660481:25:1 -->

**Suguha:** Yeah, I bet there are lots of  
Survivor School students who are  
careful about those distinctions.

<!-- uid=660481:26:1 -->

**Asuna:** Mmhm. When I first started going,  
lots of people had to switch back  
to using real names all the time.

<!-- uid=660481:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** After being trapped for two years  
and not having many chances to  
use those, it can feel weird.

<!-- uid=660481:28:1 -->

**Suguha:** Ah, I can totally imagine that!

<!-- uid=660481:29:1 -->

**Shino:** Anyway, what do you say we all  
head on in to the cafe finally?

<!-- uid=660481:30:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, sounds good. Let's go.

<!-- uid=660481:31:1 -->

**Shino:** Hehe, hope you're prepared to  
get interrogated some more on a  
lot of stuff for a good while.

<!-- uid=660481:32:1 -->

**Asuna:** As long as you two don't get too  
carried away...

<!-- uid=660481:33:1 -->


## Story 660483 · \[Love All-Encompassing\] Asuna Lv.30

**Asuna:** ...Whew.

<!-- uid=660483:5:1 -->

<!-- uid=660483:6:1 -->

<!-- uid=660483:7:1 -->

doubted you. In that case, I'll

chatting an awful lot lately, both

<!-- uid=660483:10:1 -->

<!-- uid=660483:13:1 -->

<!-- uid=660483:19:1 -->


## Story 660485 · \[Love All-Encompassing\] Asuna Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** I guess now that I think about it,  
most of you spent less than a day  
in Underworld, huh?

<!-- uid=660485:1:1 -->

**Suguha:** Yeah, Kazuto was in there for two  
virtual years and you were there  
for just over a month.

<!-- uid=660485:2:1 -->

**Shino:** You know, talking about it like  
this, it feels a little strange.

<!-- uid=660485:3:1 -->

**Shino:** Our world and Underworld have  
their differences, but they've got  
plenty in common, too.

<!-- uid=660485:4:1 -->

**Suguha:** Not only that, there's a lot in  
its setting that has a similar  
vibe to worlds like ALO.

<!-- uid=660485:5:1 -->

**Suguha:** Obviously ALO's filled with fairy  
races, but they both otherwise  
have a wide variety of monsters.

<!-- uid=660485:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's true. On the surface, you  
might say there isn't a lot that  
seems wholly unique to Underworld.

<!-- uid=660485:7:1 -->

**Shino:** When you put it like that, is  
that to say there are more  
differences when you dig deep?

<!-- uid=660485:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Absolutely. Especially when it  
comes to Underworld's culture,  
which is really distinct.

<!-- uid=660485:9:1 -->

**Suguha:** Huh, that's cool to hear. What's  
something that makes it so  
unique in that regard?

<!-- uid=660485:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hmm... I'd say the presence of  
the Sacred Tongue, for one thing.

<!-- uid=660485:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** It might sound roughly like plain  
English to us, but there it's used  
to do stuff not unlike magic.

<!-- uid=660485:12:1 -->

**Suguha:** Oh, I know what you're talking  
about! You mean when people are  
yelling "System Call!" and stuff.

<!-- uid=660485:13:1 -->

**Suguha:** I remember that witch-looking lady  
I fought was chanting that to fire  
off her spells or whatever.

<!-- uid=660485:14:1 -->

**Shino:** It's intriguing stuff. The words  
"System Call" sound like they  
could be a programming language.

<!-- uid=660485:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, it's a computer term. Not  
exactly something you'd expect  
to hear in an incantation.

<!-- uid=660485:16:1 -->

**Suguha:** Guess that's goes to show just  
how much can change when you  
visit different worlds like that.

<!-- uid=660485:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Right. You could say it's one of  
the things that makes Underworld  
stand out as its own thing.

<!-- uid=660485:18:1 -->


## Story 660487 · \[Love All-Encompassing\] Asuna Lv.70

Character Story

**Asuna:** Talking about the Sacred Tongue  
reminds me of something else that  
really sets Underworld apart.

<!-- uid=660487:1:1 -->

**Suguha:** And that is?

<!-- uid=660487:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, you know how ALO's setting  
is so heavily inspired by Norse  
mythology?

<!-- uid=660487:3:1 -->

**Suguha:** Of course! Everything from place  
names to weapons and more is  
dripping with Norse inspiration.

<!-- uid=660487:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** But it's not purely Norse since  
ALO is built by Japanese devs and  
run by a Japanese company.

<!-- uid=660487:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** You see bits of Japanese culture  
in things like the katanas and  
also the food you can craft.

<!-- uid=660487:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Not to mention there's still  
Valentine's Day and Japanese  
school uniforms in the game, too.

<!-- uid=660487:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** When you think about it, ALO's  
really a hodgepodge of cultures  
with different parts mixed in.

<!-- uid=660487:8:1 -->

**Suguha:** That's true. It's not always  
entirely consistent in that way,  
is it?

<!-- uid=660487:9:1 -->

**Shino:** Sure, but there's nothing wrong  
with that, if you ask me.

<!-- uid=660487:10:1 -->

**Shino:** There are lots of foreign-made  
games with Japanese concepts  
like samurai and ninja in them.

<!-- uid=660487:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Exactly. In fact, you just said  
something really important for  
the point I'm trying to make.

<!-- uid=660487:12:1 -->

**Shino:** I did?

<!-- uid=660487:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yep. You just said the word  
"games," didn't you?

<!-- uid=660487:14:1 -->

**Shino:** And...?

<!-- uid=660487:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** The thing you have to remember  
about Underworld is, it's not  
a game.

<!-- uid=660487:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's easy to forget that at times,  
but I'd say that's easily the  
biggest difference about it.

<!-- uid=660487:17:1 -->


## Story 660488 · \[Love All-Encompassing\] Asuna Lv.80

Character Story

**Suguha:** Right, duh! It's so obvious when  
you say that!

<!-- uid=660488:1:1 -->

**Suguha:** You know, seeing as we've all  
spent so much time playing games  
inside these virtual spaces...

<!-- uid=660488:2:1 -->

**Suguha:** We might be more prone to  
mistaking it as just another game  
without even realizing it.

<!-- uid=660488:3:1 -->

**Shino:** Yeah. There were beta test players  
who logged in after word about it  
spread to foreign game forums.

<!-- uid=660488:4:1 -->

**Shino:** We fought a lot of people who  
never stopped thinking Underworld  
was simply another game.

<!-- uid=660488:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Indeed. Games like ALO and GGO  
have some things set in stone, but  
they can be flexibly expanded.

<!-- uid=660488:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's not the case when it comes  
to Underworld. Or rather...Project  
Alicization.

<!-- uid=660488:7:1 -->

**Shino:** Even if it still takes place in a  
virtual space, the way it  
functions is totally different.

<!-- uid=660488:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Exactly. That's how you end up  
with all these cultures in it  
mirroring the real world's.

<!-- uid=660488:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** The people there have souls just  
like us and built their world  
up over many, many years.

<!-- uid=660488:10:1 -->

**Shino:** ...Yeah. I get what you mean now.

<!-- uid=660488:11:1 -->

**Suguha:** This whole discussion's really  
reminded me just how deep that  
whole world really is.

<!-- uid=660488:12:1 -->

**Shino:** For sure. I hope someday we'll  
have the chance to pay another  
visit to Underworld.

<!-- uid=660488:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** I...think that time will come,  
yeah.

<!-- uid=660488:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** In fact, it might not be long  
before our world and Underworld  
grow even closer to each other!

<!-- uid=660488:15:1 -->

## Story 660508 · \[Big Sister Energy\] Lisbeth Lv.80

Character Story

**Silica:** Okay, Asuna. Think back over all  
the different girls in your class  
one more time.

<!-- uid=660508:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Umm...

<!-- uid=660508:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sinonon, Selka...

**Asuna:** Then there's Sortiliena...  
Oh, and Miss Administrator.

<!-- uid=660508:4:3 -->

**Asuna:** ...What about them?

<!-- uid=660508:5:1 -->

**Silica:** If you were to assign them a type,  
they'd all either be "cute" or  
"beautiful," right?

<!-- uid=660508:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well... sure.

<!-- uid=660508:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Cute would include Selka, and the  
rest would be under beautiful,  
I guess?

<!-- uid=660508:8:1 -->

**Silica:** Which would you fall under, then?

**Asuna:** Huh? M-Me?!

**Silica:** Yes, you! Now answer me!

<!-- uid=660508:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Wh-Whaaat...?!

<!-- uid=660508:12:1 -->

<!-- uid=660508:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's kinda... super embarrassing,

<!-- uid=660508:14:1 -->

**Liz:** Silica, Asuna seems honestly  
troubled here. You should offer

<!-- uid=660508:15:1 -->

**Silica:** ...Yes, you're right, Liz.

<!-- uid=660508:16:1 -->

**Silica:** The answer... in my opinion, at

<!-- uid=660508:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** What...?

balanced. You're cute, but  
you're also beautiful...

<!-- uid=660508:19:1 -->

**Silica:** That makes you a valuable asset!

even among idols!

<!-- uid=660508:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Um... But I'm not an idol...

<!-- uid=660508:21:1 -->

**Silica:** Well, that's not what's important

<!-- uid=660508:22:1 -->

**Silica:** Anyway, that's why you're the  
perfect commander for uniting  
all these strong personalities.

<!-- uid=660508:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** I kind of get what you're saying,

<!-- uid=660508:24:1 -->

**Liz:** What? Of course not.

**Asuna:** B-But why?!

**Liz:** Because you're the best cook in

<!-- uid=660508:28:1 -->

**Silica:** You know so much about cooking  
too.

<!-- uid=660508:29:1 -->

**Asuna:** S-So it isn't about balance when

<!-- uid=660508:30:1 -->

**Asuna:** Agh... This is such a deep and

<!-- uid=660508:31:1 -->

**Asuna:** Am I really going to be able to

time...?

<!-- uid=660508:32:1 -->

Character Story

## Story 840018 · \[Dragon Tamer\] Silica Lv.80

Character Story

<!-- uid=840018:1:1 -->

**Pina:** Chirp chirp!

<!-- uid=840018:2:1 -->

<!-- uid=840018:4:1 -->

**Pina:** Chirp chirp chirp!

<!-- uid=840018:6:1 -->

<!-- uid=840018:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, Pina has really leveled up.

<!-- uid=840018:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** But you're the first person to

**Kirito:** so at this point, I feel like  
anything is possible.

<!-- uid=840018:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Larva wrap themselves in cocoons,  
and some animals shed their skin  
as they grow.

<!-- uid=840018:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Pina's appearance didn't change,  
but she was changing somewhere

<!-- uid=840018:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** deep inside. And I feel like this  
might just be the first step.

<!-- uid=840018:17:1 -->

**Silica:** Pina's changing, huh?

<!-- uid=840018:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** And your bond with Pina is  
strengthening. The fact that she  
tried to save you is proof.

<!-- uid=840018:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** For a tamed monster, she's reached  
an incredible level, and she's  
still growing.

<!-- uid=840018:20:1 -->

**Pina:** Chirrrp!

<!-- uid=840018:21:1 -->

**Silica:** What's that?  
You think so too, Pina?

<!-- uid=840018:22:1 -->

**Pina:** Chirp chirp!

<!-- uid=840018:23:1 -->

**Silica:** Hehehe, I guess that's true!

<!-- uid=840018:24:1 -->

**Silica:** And that means you're not gonna  
scare me like that anymore, right?

<!-- uid=840018:25:1 -->

**Pina:** Chirrrrp chirp!

<!-- uid=840018:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha, I guess not!  
At least this ordeal has a  
happy ending.

<!-- uid=840018:27:1 -->

**Silica:** Yeah! I really can't thank you  
enough, Kirito! Thank you, thank  
you, thank you!

<!-- uid=840018:28:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm just glad you and Pina are  
okay!

<!-- uid=840018:29:1 -->

## Story 840053 · \[Pole and Line Fishing\] Sima Lv.30

Character Story

**Agil:** Found it! I give you the Silver  
Hook. What do you think?

<!-- uid=840053:1:1 -->

**Sima:** ...

<!-- uid=840053:2:1 -->

**Agil:** Everything okay, Sima?  
You're staring off into space.

<!-- uid=840053:3:1 -->

**Sima:** Oh, um... Sorry about that.

<!-- uid=840053:4:1 -->

**Sima:** I was just thinking about what you  
were saying earlier and wondering  
what my contribution is.

<!-- uid=840053:5:1 -->

**Sima:** I mean, I'm perfectly happy just  
finding a new fishing spot to try  
every day, you know?

<!-- uid=840053:6:1 -->

**Sima:** Am I just playing around when  
I should be helping out?

<!-- uid=840053:7:1 -->

**Agil:** Ha ha, that sure sounds like play  
to me!

<!-- uid=840053:8:1 -->

**Sima:** Hey, knock it off!  
I'm being serious!

<!-- uid=840053:9:1 -->

**Agil:** Relax, it's okay.  
Your case is slightly different.

<!-- uid=840053:10:1 -->

**Agil:** You're definitely all about  
fishing, but you explore a lot of  
places looking for spots, right?

<!-- uid=840053:11:1 -->

**Agil:** Well, maybe some people will find  
rare materials in those spots,

<!-- uid=840053:12:1 -->

**Agil:** or some of the strange materials  
you use to make fishing tackle  
could be used in a new weapon.

<!-- uid=840053:13:1 -->

**Agil:** Don't worry so much about the  
fishing itself. You might still be  
contributing in small ways.

<!-- uid=840053:14:1 -->

**Sima:** Hehe. That makes me feel a bit  
better, even if you're just saying  
what you think I wanna hear.

<!-- uid=840053:15:1 -->

**Agil:** I wouldn't do that to you, Sima.  
Besides, you've got a pretty high  
level.

<!-- uid=840053:16:1 -->

**Agil:** You may have only joined us for  
a short while, but everyone says  
they're glad you did.

<!-- uid=840053:17:1 -->

**Sima:** Wait, seriously?

<!-- uid=840053:18:1 -->

**Agil:** I mean I think that's what they'd  
say, if I asked them.

<!-- uid=840053:19:1 -->

**Sima:** Ugh, don't joke about stuff like  
that! You got me all excited!

<!-- uid=840053:20:1 -->

**Agil:** I know for a fact that the rest of  
your party was glad to have you,  
though. I'll ask them about you.

<!-- uid=840053:21:1 -->

**Sima:** Eh... I'm not sure I wanna hear  
what they think...

<!-- uid=840053:22:1 -->

**Sima:** But I won't stop you.  
In fact, I want you to.

<!-- uid=840053:23:1 -->

**Agil:** Alright then, I will.

<!-- uid=840053:24:1 -->


## Story 840055 · \[Pole and Line Fishing\] Sima Lv.50

Character Story

**Sima:** Unbelievable! You really know your  
stuff, Agil!

<!-- uid=840055:1:1 -->

**Sima:** This Silver Hook doesn't wear down  
at all!

<!-- uid=840055:2:1 -->

**Sima:** And it's exactly the kind of shiny  
thing all the fish I'm after just  
latch onto immediately!

<!-- uid=840055:3:1 -->

**Sima:** It was definitely expensive,  
but it's more than paid for  
itself!

<!-- uid=840055:4:1 -->

**Liz:** Hello.

**Sima:** Oh, hello.

<!-- uid=840055:6:1 -->

**Liz:** Sorry to bother you while you're  
fishing. Do you have a minute?

<!-- uid=840055:7:1 -->

**Sima:** Sure. What do you need?

**Liz:** I've heard that you can get some  
rare gold dust from the shores  
here. Know anything about that?

<!-- uid=840055:9:1 -->

**Sima:** Oh, yeah! You can find that here.

discovered it in the first place.

<!-- uid=840055:10:1 -->

**Sima:** Yeah. I was sitting here fishing  
when all of a sudden I noticed  
something I could interact with.

**Sima:** It never occurred to me to keep  
it all to myself, though. What does  
an angler want with minerals?

<!-- uid=840055:13:1 -->

**Sima:** So I immediately told an info  
broker about it.

<!-- uid=840055:14:1 -->

**Liz:** That wouldn't happen to have been  
an info broker named Argo, would  
it?

**Sima:** Yeah, that's the one.

<!-- uid=840055:16:1 -->

**Liz:** Aha! Now that I think about it,  
she did say she'd heard about this  
spot from an angler.

**Sima:** Hehe, well, that must've been me!

<!-- uid=840055:18:1 -->

**Liz:** Well, then allow me to thank you!  
I'm Lisbeth, by the way.  
What's your name?

<!-- uid=840055:19:1 -->

**Sima:** I'm Sima. Pleased to meet you!

<!-- uid=840055:20:1 -->

**Liz:** Likewise.

<!-- uid=840055:21:1 -->


## Story 840057 · \[Pole and Line Fishing\] Sima Lv.70

Character Story

**Sima:** Now then, this dungeon's

## Story 840153 · \[Platonic Love\] Silica Lv.30

months since SAO started...

**Silica:** Yay!

<!-- uid=840153:15:1 -->

**Man B:** Silica... I...

**Silica:** Yes?

<!-- uid=840153:17:1 -->

**Man B:** Ah... N-Never mind...

**Silica:** ...?

## Story 840308 · \[Attention Please\] Silica Lv.80

Character Story

**Player A:** Whoa!

## Story 850063 · \[Auspicious Blue Sky\] Silica Lv.30

Character Story

**Yuuki:** Oh yeah! All this reminds me of a  
rumor I heard last time I played  
Asuka Empire.

<!-- uid=850063:1:1 -->

**Silica:** What rumor is that?

<!-- uid=850063:2:1 -->

**Yuuki:** That there's a legendary dragon  
living up in the mountains.

<!-- uid=850063:3:1 -->

**Silica:** Eep! It sounds powerful.

<!-- uid=850063:4:1 -->

**Yuuki:** It is, but it's not like it's the  
king of dragons or anything.  
Its existence itself is legendary.

<!-- uid=850063:5:1 -->

**Silica:** So this dragon is totally  
different from the European style?

<!-- uid=850063:6:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Well, the East Asian dragon was  
originally the physical form of a  
god in the Chinese zodiac.

<!-- uid=850063:7:1 -->

**Yuuki:** But dragons in European fantasy  
were just another evil creature,  
like demons or goblins.

<!-- uid=850063:8:1 -->

**Silica:** Ah, good vs. evil.  
Yeah, that's about as  
opposite as you can get.

<!-- uid=850063:9:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Not to mention most Western  
religions have just one god, so  
dragons were beasts, not gods.

<!-- uid=850063:10:1 -->

**Yuuki:** And if you're still confused,  
just crack open any collection  
of dragon illustrations.

<!-- uid=850063:11:1 -->

**Yuuki:** The differences in how they're  
portrayed will be pretty obvious.

<!-- uid=850063:12:1 -->

**Silica:** So you're saying the dragon in  
the mountains here is probably  
one of the good, sacred ones?

<!-- uid=850063:13:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I guess so, hehe.  
Which just makes me want to see  
it even more than I did before!

<!-- uid=850063:14:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Enough talk! Let's go, Silica!

<!-- uid=850063:15:1 -->

**Silica:** All by ourselves?!  
Are you sure about this?

<!-- uid=850063:16:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Totally! We're just gonna sneak  
a look at it!

<!-- uid=850063:17:1 -->

## Story 850101 · \[Cute Bunny\] Sinon Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** Hey Sinon, can I ask you  
something?

<!-- uid=850101:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** Sure. What's up, Kirito?

<!-- uid=850101:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** So Asuna, Leafa, and I did this  
super hard quest the other day.

<!-- uid=850101:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** It was a three-person quest where  
you had to fight tons of tough  
monsters in a dungeon.

<!-- uid=850101:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** Ah, that one. Everyone's talking  
about it. I heard the monsters are  
too hard for three people.

<!-- uid=850101:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, normally. But with the Cu  
Sith buffs that Leafa and I got,

<!-- uid=850101:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** and with Asuna as a dedicated  
healer, we thought we could do it.

<!-- uid=850101:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** And? Did you beat it?

<!-- uid=850101:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Kinda. We took out the monsters,  
but there was a final twist: we  
had to race for the quest reward.

<!-- uid=850101:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** At first, Leafa and I were in the  
lead because of our Cu Sith  
movement speed buffs...

<!-- uid=850101:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** We thought Asuna had no chance  
to win.

<!-- uid=850101:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** With Cu Sith buffs, that makes  
sense.

<!-- uid=850101:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** But the thing is, Asuna threw a  
stick... Leafa and I instinctively  
reacted and ran after it.

<!-- uid=850101:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** Wait, you what?

<!-- uid=850101:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** It was like we had no control  
over our bodies...

<!-- uid=850101:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** She threw a bunch of sticks, and  
every time we just HAD to chase  
it. It was weird.

<!-- uid=850101:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** So, in the end, Asuna completely  
trounced us.

<!-- uid=850101:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...AHAHAHAHAHAHA!!!

<!-- uid=850101:18:1 -->

## Story 850105 · \[Cute Bunny\] Sinon Lv.50

Character Story

**Sinon:** Hey Kirito, do you have a sec?

<!-- uid=850105:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, what's up?

abilities.

<!-- uid=850135:18:1 -->

## Story 860045 · \[Hot Spring Angel\] Asuna Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** I'm sure you've heard about this,  
but when SAO turned into a death  
game, we were all forced to use...

<!-- uid=860045:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...avatars that looked just like  
us in real life. I spent two years  
there with my own face and body.

<!-- uid=860045:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** Right...

<!-- uid=860045:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** After we were freed, I thought a  
different avatar would help me  
enjoy myself more in these...

<!-- uid=860045:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...new worlds, especially one with  
fairies and magic that was so  
different from SAO.

<!-- uid=860045:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** But as I played ALO...  
I realized something.

<!-- uid=860045:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Having an avatar that looked  
just like me in SAO actually  
helped me get through it.

<!-- uid=860045:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** It did?

<!-- uid=860045:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah. Those two years were really  
hard, but I wouldn't trade them  
for anything.

<!-- uid=860045:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** I realized that the thing that  
helped me turn all those hardships  
into a source of joy...

<!-- uid=860045:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...was seeing my own reflection  
looking back at me in the mirror.

<!-- uid=860045:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** So I think I was able to get  
through it all because...  
it was really me doing it.

<!-- uid=860045:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** So basically, you feel that  
looking like yourself can  
help you get stronger?

<!-- uid=860045:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, I guess so.  
But don't get me wrong;  
I like my ALO avatar a lot too.

<!-- uid=860045:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** I think I might be the same way.  
I knew I had to steel myself to go  
up against the Slashers...

<!-- uid=860045:15:1 -->

**Leafa:** And I thought that looking like  
the me who's worked so hard at  
kendo would help me get there.

<!-- uid=860045:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe. At any rate, let's both be  
careful not to let our real-life  
identities leak, huh?

<!-- uid=860045:17:1 -->

**Leafa:** You know it!

<!-- uid=860045:18:1 -->

## Story 860081 · \[Milky Angel\] Asuna Lv.10

Character Story

**Eugeo:** So, Kirito, now that it's been a  
while since we've come to this  
sleeping-together world...

<!-- uid=860081:1:1 -->

**Eugeo:** How's your STP looking?

<!-- uid=860081:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** STP... That's short for the  
Sleeping Together Points we need  
to leave this world, right?

<!-- uid=860081:3:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Uh, yeah, that's right. You're the  
one who told me about them in  
the first place, remember?

<!-- uid=860081:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Let me open up my window...  
There, that's how much I've got.  
What about you, Eugeo?

<!-- uid=860081:5:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I've still only got this much.  
You really are amazing, Kirito.

<!-- uid=860081:6:1 -->

**Eugeo:** You're sleeping with lots of  
people to get your STP this  
high. Especially girls.

<!-- uid=860081:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** H-Hey, don't say it like that.  
It makes me sound bad.

<!-- uid=860081:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's not like I'm forcing anyone  
to sleep with me. I'm just doing  
what I have to so we can leave...

<!-- uid=860081:9:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Ha ha, I know. I also know that  
you're mostly just sleeping with  
projections of people we know.

<!-- uid=860081:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** True... Oh, I've also slept with  
Alice and one of those girls we  
got to know here, Ronie.

<!-- uid=860081:11:1 -->

**Eugeo:** What about the other girl, Tiese?  
Couldn't you sleep with her too?

<!-- uid=860081:12:1 -->

**Eugeo:** We need to help her raise her STP  
as well, after all.

<!-- uid=860081:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Her? I don't know... In her case,  
I feel like you might be a better  
match than me...

<!-- uid=860081:14:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Huh? What do you mean?

<!-- uid=860081:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Y-You know, on second thought,never mind.

<!-- uid=860081:16:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...?

<!-- uid=860081:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Anyway, where did Alice go?

<!-- uid=860081:18:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Oh, she stepped out. Said she  
wasn't in the mood right now.

<!-- uid=860081:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Guess she probably didn't go  
looking for potential sleeping-  
together partners then...

<!-- uid=860081:20:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I just hope nobody provokes her  
by asking her to sleep with them  
again...

<!-- uid=860081:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha, yeah...

<!-- uid=860081:22:1 -->


## Story 860083 · \[Milky Angel\] Asuna Lv.30

Character Story

**Alice:** \*sigh\*... I still cannot quite  
believe this is happening...

<!-- uid=860083:1:1 -->

**Alice:** A world where people are required  
to sleep together? I could never  
imagine something so ridiculous.

<!-- uid=860083:2:1 -->

**Alice:** And yet, I am partly to blame.  
If only I had not fallen asleep  
beside them in that cavern,

<!-- uid=860083:3:1 -->

**Alice:** none of this would have come to  
pass... Still, as I watched them  
sleeping so peacefully,

<!-- uid=860083:4:1 -->

**Alice:** I was overcome with feelings  
of affection and nostalgia...  
But why?

<!-- uid=860083:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...

<!-- uid=860083:7:1 -->

**Alice:** A-Asuna?!

<!-- uid=860083:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh? ...I see you know me too.

<!-- uid=860083:9:1 -->

**Alice:** ...Now I see. This must be one of  
those projections that Kirito told  
me about...

<!-- uid=860083:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** You must be a friend of Kirito's.  
I haven't slept with anyone else  
after my first time with him...

<!-- uid=860083:11:1 -->

**Alice:** ...!

<!-- uid=860083:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** I realized back then that he was  
probably the only one who could  
satisfy me.

<!-- uid=860083:13:1 -->

**Alice:** I-I see...

<!-- uid=860083:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** My STP went up an amazing amount

<!-- uid=860083:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** I feel like he and I must be  
destined for each other.

<!-- uid=860083:16:1 -->

**Alice:** ...Kirito and Asuna are wedded to  
each other back in Alfheim...

<!-- uid=860083:17:1 -->

**Alice:** So this projection of her must  
have a similarly powerful  
connection to him...

<!-- uid=860083:18:1 -->

**Alice:** And yet... I am not sure why,  
but... something about this  
vexes me.

<!-- uid=860083:19:1 -->

**Alice:** Is it merely the fact that Kirito  
is ahead of me? Or is it...  
No... it could not be that...

<!-- uid=860083:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Is something wrong?

<!-- uid=860083:21:1 -->

**Alice:** Asuna... Come sleep with me.

<!-- uid=860083:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** Huh?

<!-- uid=860083:23:1 -->

**Alice:** Now that I have decided to abide  
by this world's laws, I must do my  
best to excel within their bounds.

<!-- uid=860083:24:1 -->

**Alice:** I shall see for myself if Kirito  
is truly my superior when it  
comes to sleeping together...

<!-- uid=860083:25:1 -->


## Story 860085 · \[Milky Angel\] Asuna Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** Thank you for sleeping with me,

<!-- uid=860085:1:1 -->

end like this.

<!-- uid=860085:16:1 -->

**Alice:** Curses... This number farsurpasses my own...

<!-- uid=860143:2:1 -->

<!-- uid=860143:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Having a bowl of hot soba now  
might just hit the spot.

<!-- uid=860143:6:1 -->

**Alice:** I don't know. I can still taste

<!-- uid=860143:7:2 -->

<!-- uid=860143:8:1 -->

**Eugeo:** So the idea of having more of it

<!-- uid=860143:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Good point. If we're going to have  
more soba, we need to make sure  
it's really good first!

<!-- uid=860143:10:1 -->

<!-- uid=860143:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sure I can. Though it does depend  
on how much I'm making from  
scratch...

<!-- uid=860143:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** If we're talking about grinding  
buckwheat flour ourselves...  
that's gonna take a lot of time.

<!-- uid=860143:13:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Excuse me.

<!-- uid=860143:14:1 -->

**Player:** Hm?

<!-- uid=860143:15:1 -->

**Eugeo:** You were just eating there, right?

<!-- uid=860143:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Looks like Eugeo's putting his  
social skills to work again.

<!-- uid=860143:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ahaha...

<!-- uid=860143:18:1 -->

**Player:** Uh, s-sure. It was really good.  
Although...

<!-- uid=860143:19:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...?

<!-- uid=860143:20:1 -->

**Player:** W-Well, you'll see if you go in

the soba is is up to you.

<!-- uid=860143:21:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Huh?

<!-- uid=860143:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Up to us? How does that work?

<!-- uid=860143:23:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Ah, I see you're interested in our  
food! Come on, right this way!

<!-- uid=860143:24:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Party of four, coming through!

<!-- uid=860143:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yikes. Talk about pushy.

<!-- uid=860143:26:1 -->

**Alice:** Does this mean our actions will  
affect the food's flavor?

<!-- uid=860143:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm not sure either...

<!-- uid=860143:28:1 -->

**Kirito:** Uh oh...

<!-- uid=860143:29:1 -->


## Story 860145 · \[Prayers for Good Heath\] Alice Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** Let's see what's on the menu...

<!-- uid=860145:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh? It's totally blank.

<!-- uid=860145:2:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Okay everyone, let me tell you all  
about our New Year's special!

<!-- uid=860145:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** New Year's special?

<!-- uid=860145:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** That sounds interesting.

<!-- uid=860145:5:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** It is! For this special, the food  
you receive will be determined by  
your answers on a quiz!

<!-- uid=860145:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Q-Quiz?

<!-- uid=860145:7:1 -->

**Alice:** What is a quiz?

<!-- uid=860145:8:2 -->

**Asuna:** Um, basically, it's a game where  
you have to answer riddles.

<!-- uid=860145:9:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Why do we have to do a quiz just  
to eat?

<!-- uid=860145:10:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Simple! It's not New Year's if  
you're not sitting around watching  
TV with your family!

<!-- uid=860145:11:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** And what could be more  
entertaining for the whole family  
than a quiz show?!

<!-- uid=860145:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** A-Are you sure? I don't think  
that's generally how New Year's is  
celebrated these days...

<!-- uid=860145:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, this IS Asuka Empire. They  
may be going for something more  
old-fashioned here on purpose.

<!-- uid=860145:14:1 -->

**Eugeo:** So, let me get this straight...

<!-- uid=860145:15:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Does this mean the quality of our  
food changes depending on how many  
riddles we get right?

<!-- uid=860145:16:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** You got it! Answer all three  
questions correctly, and you'll  
get to enjoy the best soba ever!

<!-- uid=860145:17:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** But be careful! For every question  
you get wrong, the soba's quality  
will drop proportionally!

<!-- uid=860145:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** So this is what that person Eugeo  
talked to meant...

<!-- uid=860145:19:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Now let's get started!  
Question one!

<!-- uid=860145:20:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** How did toshi-koshi soba, the  
custom of eating buckwheat noodles  
on New Year's Eve, originate?

<!-- uid=860145:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Uhh...

<!-- uid=860145:22:1 -->


## Story 860147 · \[Prayers for Good Heath\] Alice Lv.70

Character Story

**Asuna:** I know that one.  
In fact, a lot of people do.

<!-- uid=860147:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's because people used to think  
that eating long foods would in  
turn lead to a long life.

<!-- uid=860147:2:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** That answer is...  
Correct!

<!-- uid=860147:3:1 -->

**Alice:** Well done, Asuna. I am not  
surprised you knew that.

<!-- uid=860147:4:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I see. So that's how it began.

<!-- uid=860147:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Now that you mention it, I think  
I've heard that before, too...

<!-- uid=860147:6:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Question two! Nowadays, people go  
to both temples AND shrines to  
pray on New Year's Day.

<!-- uid=860147:7:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** In which historical period did  
temples and shrines start to be  
treated separately?

<!-- uid=860147:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh?  
Well, uh...

<!-- uid=860147:9:1 -->

**Eugeo:** So this is about Asuka Empire's  
history, huh. There's no way I can  
figure out this one.

<!-- uid=860147:10:1 -->

**Alice:** When was it that the Buddha first  
came to be?

<!-- uid=860147:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Didn't Buddhism get its start in  
Japan during the Asuka period?

<!-- uid=860147:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** True, but that's the wrong line of  
thinking. Temples and shrines  
were only treated separately...

<!-- uid=860147:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...once Shinto was separated from  
Buddhism. And THAT happened in  
the Meiji period!

<!-- uid=860147:14:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** That answer is correct!

<!-- uid=860147:15:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Way to go, Asuna!

<!-- uid=860147:16:1 -->

**Alice:** I do not know how long ago either  
of those periods are. Were they  
close to one another?

<!-- uid=860147:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** No, not at all. They're hundreds  
of years apart. You really know  
your stuff, Asuna...

<!-- uid=860147:18:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Now for the final question! Seeing  
the first sunrise of the year...

<!-- uid=860147:19:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** ...is a custom meant to greet the  
god of the new year.

<!-- uid=860147:20:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** What is the other thing that this  
god of the new year symbolizes?

<!-- uid=860147:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Something it symbolizes?

<!-- uid=860147:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ooh, this is a toughie...

<!-- uid=860147:23:1 -->


## Story 860148 · \[Prayers for Good Heath\] Alice Lv.80

Character Story

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Once again, what does the god of  
the new year symbolize?

<!-- uid=860148:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Err...

<!-- uid=860148:2:1 -->

**Eugeo:** This MUST be tough if Asuna  
doesn't know the answer.

<!-- uid=860148:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** If Asuna doesn't know,  
I definitely don't...

<!-- uid=860148:4:1 -->

**Alice:** There are a number of gods for  
different things in my world, too.

<!-- uid=860148:5:2 -->

**Alice:** Stacia, goddess of creation...  
Solus, goddess of the sun...  
Terraria, goddess of the earth...

<!-- uid=860148:6:1 -->

**Alice:** Creation, sun, and earth, huh...  
I guess those all make sense.

<!-- uid=860148:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** I feel like there's got to be more  
to this question than that,  
though... Can we get a hint?

<!-- uid=860148:8:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** A hint, eh. Alright.  
Traditionally, people decorate  
their homes in order to greet...

<!-- uid=860148:9:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** ...the god of the new year,  
typically using kadomatsu pines  
and thick shimenawa straw ropes.

<!-- uid=860148:10:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Kadomatsu? Shimenawa...?

<!-- uid=860148:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh yeah, there were actually some  
of those decorating the outside of  
this lodge.

<!-- uid=860148:12:1 -->

**Alice:** Ah, is that what those were? Now  
that I think of it, I saw them  
back in Kiyomihara as well.

<!-- uid=860148:13:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** One such decoration is said to be  
closely tied to the god of the new  
year...

<!-- uid=860148:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** A new year's decoration?  
Wh-Which one could it be?

<!-- uid=860148:15:1 -->

**Alice:** Hmm. A traditional New Year's  
decoration that has close ties to  
the god of the new year...?

<!-- uid=860148:16:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...Hey, speaking of decorations,  
what's that white round thing up  
near the ceiling?

<!-- uid=860148:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's... kagami mochi.

<!-- uid=860148:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...Kagami mochi!  
Now I get it!

<!-- uid=860148:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Me too!  
It all makes sense now!

<!-- uid=860148:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yup. Japan has flourished for  
centuries thanks to this!  
The answer is...

<!-- uid=860148:21:1 -->

**Asuna & Kirito:** The god of agriculture!!!

<!-- uid=860148:22:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Correct! Since you got every  
question right...

<!-- uid=860148:23:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** You get to have our premium toshi-  
koshi soba, made with edible wild  
plants grown on this mountain!

<!-- uid=860148:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** We did it!

<!-- uid=860148:25:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Nice job, Asuna! I'm impressed you  
knew the answer too, Kirito.

<!-- uid=860148:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's all thanks to you and Alice  
noticing the kagami mochi.

<!-- uid=860148:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yup! Kagami mochi on New Year's is  
such a common sight for us that we  
didn't even think about it.

<!-- uid=860148:28:1 -->

**Alice:** The god of agriculture, eh...  
So in this world, there is even  
a god for that.

<!-- uid=860148:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yup. They say there's a god that  
inhabits pretty much anything and  
everything here.

<!-- uid=860148:30:1 -->

**Eugeo:** You don't say. Anyway, now Alice  
and I get to find out what GOOD  
soba tastes like!

<!-- uid=860148:31:1 -->

**Asuna:** You know, doing that quiz actually  
helped me work up a little  
appetite. I can't wait to try it!

<!-- uid=860148:32:1 -->


## Story 860151 · \[Cat's Fierce Gaze\] Panther Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** Hyaaah!

<!-- uid=860151:1:1 -->

**Joker:** Eat this!

**Fox:** Blocked?! This foe is quite

<!-- uid=860151:3:1 -->

**Queen:** In that case... we just need to  
make an opening! Back me up!

**Oracle:** Hey, you heard her! Someone back  
up Queen!

**Sinon:** More warning would be nice...  
Grah, I won't make it in time!

**Queen:** Ngh... Its defenses are too  
strong!

**Kirito:** Let's retreat for now!

<!-- uid=860151:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, that didn't work...

than I expected.

**Joker:** I think we could take it if our

<!-- uid=860151:21:1 -->

**Fox:** Well, this is merely my opinion,

<!-- uid=860151:24:1 -->

**Violet:** Kirito, you lead your friends,

<!-- uid=860151:26:1 -->

**Leafa:** Not cool, Kirito. Not cool.

<!-- uid=860151:35:1 -->

**Fox:** Is it just me, or do these ladies

<!-- uid=860151:36:1 -->

## Story 860153 · \[Cat's Fierce Gaze\] Panther Lv.30

Character Story

**Skull:** Oh! I got an awesome idea to build  
up our teamwork! How 'bout  
we shoot the breeze?

<!-- uid=860153:1:1 -->

**Oracle:** Ooo, great idea! It'll work for  
sure, just like it did for me  
last summer!

<!-- uid=860153:2:1 -->

**Oracle:** Alright, let's do this!

<!-- uid=860153:3:1 -->

**Oracle:** Still... this game is crazy fun!  
Not too long ago, I'd have gotten  
totally obsessed!

<!-- uid=860153:4:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Really? Did you used to be a  
shut-in or something?

<!-- uid=860153:5:3 -->

**Oracle:** I've...been through a lot.

<!-- uid=860153:6:1 -->

**Oracle:** But thanks to the Phantom Thieves,  
I've escaped the darkness! I still  
live my life on the net though.

<!-- uid=860153:7:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Sounds a lot like me!

<!-- uid=860153:8:1 -->

**Oracle:** R-Really?! You were a shut-in too?  
Do you like figures?! DO YOU  
LIKE FEATHERMAN?!

<!-- uid=860153:9:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Er, sorry... Shut-in isn't quite  
right, and I've never heard of  
Featherman. But...

<!-- uid=860153:10:1 -->

**Yuuki:** It's true that this world and my  
friends saved me.

<!-- uid=860153:11:1 -->

**Oracle:** Whoa...

<!-- uid=860153:12:1 -->

**Yuuki:** If it weren't for them, I don't  
know what would've happened to me.

<!-- uid=860153:13:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Like, I can't let Kirito there  
beat me, and Asuna's basically  
family.

<!-- uid=860153:14:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Leafa and I are besties, and Sinon  
is just SO cool. And such a cutie!

<!-- uid=860153:15:1 -->

**Oracle:** Interesting...

<!-- uid=860153:16:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hey, Oracle? How do you feel about  
all your friends?

<!-- uid=860153:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, I want to know too.

<!-- uid=860153:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** Lay it on us.

<!-- uid=860153:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** You're a closed door. Let us in!

<!-- uid=860153:20:1 -->

**Oracle:** Urgh, merciless! Interrogation  
hell! Fine! U-Uh... If I had to  
compare them to Featherman...

<!-- uid=860153:21:1 -->

**Oracle:** Joker's Red, Skull is Yellow,  
Panther is Pink, and Queen is...  
Also Pink. Noir is...Pink?

<!-- uid=860153:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Back up! I've never seen  
Featherman, but...

<!-- uid=860153:23:1 -->

**Leafa:** Why is everyone pink?!

<!-- uid=860153:24:1 -->

**Oracle:** How to explain... Eh, I guess to  
sum it up, I feel the same as  
Yuuki. My friends are the best!

<!-- uid=860153:25:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Woohoo!

<!-- uid=860153:26:1 -->


## Story 860155 · \[Cat's Fierce Gaze\] Panther Lv.50

Character Story

**Kirito:** I've been thinking, we don't know  
each other that well yet. How about  
we share a little about ourselves?

<!-- uid=860155:1:1 -->

**Mona:** We are the great Phantom Thieves!  
We do not reveal our secrets so  
easily.

<!-- uid=860155:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, I'm guessing we're all  
around the same age. You're high  
school students, right?

<!-- uid=860155:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** I think Oracle's a bit younger  
than us.

<!-- uid=860155:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** And none of you have an odd accent,  
so I'm guessing you're Tokyoites.

<!-- uid=860155:5:1 -->

**Yuuki:** They've got a lot of secrets...but  
I think they're nice people.

<!-- uid=860155:6:1 -->

**Skull:** What are you, amateur detectives?!

<!-- uid=860155:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ah, sorry. But I don't think any of  
us can resist a mystery!

<!-- uid=860155:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** We won't pry if you'd rather us  
not. But we'll tell you about  
ourselves, get the ball rolling.

<!-- uid=860155:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Then again, we're just a bunch of  
ordinary students. Well...one  
of us is a bit of a special case.

<!-- uid=860155:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** Asuna's dad's the CEO of a huge  
corporation.

<!-- uid=860155:11:1 -->

**Noir:** Oh! That's pretty tough, huh?

<!-- uid=860155:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Tough... Yeah, you could say that.

<!-- uid=860155:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** A lot is expected of me, and... I'm  
not totally free to choose my own  
life. It's a pain sometimes.

<!-- uid=860155:14:1 -->

**Noir:** Like...your parents won't let  
you pick who you marry?

<!-- uid=860155:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Urk...

<!-- uid=860155:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Nnnrgh...

<!-- uid=860155:17:1 -->

**Noir:** Bingo?

<!-- uid=860155:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** I can't...deny that...

<!-- uid=860155:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** But...what's the deal? Why the  
sudden burst of curiosity?

<!-- uid=860155:20:1 -->

**Noir:** Because I think you and I have  
a lot in common.

<!-- uid=860155:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** We do?

<!-- uid=860155:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wait a sec, Noir! That means...  
You seem so graceful and refined,  
but you're a berserk healer too?!

<!-- uid=860155:23:1 -->

**Noir:** I'm...not sure I follow?

<!-- uid=860155:24:1 -->

**Oracle:** He's calling you crazy violent.

<!-- uid=860155:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito! Why would you mention  
that?!

<!-- uid=860155:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** If they suddenly saw you transform  
from dainty debutante into violent  
killing machine, they'd freak.

<!-- uid=860155:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** Phrasing, Kirito! Come on!

<!-- uid=860155:28:1 -->

**Mona:** Well, in that case, you should know  
that Noir here is the Beauty Thief!

<!-- uid=860155:29:1 -->

**Noir:** M-Mona! D-Don't tell them that!

<!-- uid=860155:30:1 -->

**Oracle:** Beauty and the Berserker...  
Sounds like a movie.

<!-- uid=860155:31:1 -->


## Story 860157 · \[Cat's Fierce Gaze\] Panther Lv.70

Character Story

**Leafa:** I had a thought when I saw your  
Persona, Queen. It might just  
help us fight better as a team!

<!-- uid=860157:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Queen's Persona? ...Oh, that!

<!-- uid=860157:2:1 -->

**Skull:** Yeah! She's like a post-apocalyptic  
raider, right?!

<!-- uid=860157:3:1 -->

**Queen:** Do you want to get smacked?

<!-- uid=860157:4:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Ooo, I can see it!  
'Cause she's all spiky!

<!-- uid=860157:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** She reminds me of the wastelands.

<!-- uid=860157:6:1 -->

**Queen:** ...I'll take that as a compliment.

<!-- uid=860157:7:1 -->

**Queen:** Anyway. You said my Persona might  
help us work together. How?

<!-- uid=860157:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Kirito rides a hog like yours  
sometimes too. Sinon knows  
what I'm talking 'bout, right?

<!-- uid=860157:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** Ugh. Yeah. He rode it out to see  
me when he was worried about me  
during that...incident.

<!-- uid=860157:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** Thanks to that, I had to deal with  
all sorts of annoying rumors.

<!-- uid=860157:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Rumors? What sort of rumors?

<!-- uid=860157:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** A normal person wouldn't ride up

a friend.

<!-- uid=860157:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh...  
Did people get the wrong idea?

<!-- uid=860157:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** You think?

<!-- uid=860157:15:1 -->

**Panther:** Hey, so Sinon and Kirito are  
going out, then?

<!-- uid=860157:16:1 -->

**Sinon:** Gah?!

<!-- uid=860157:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** N-No... We're just friends.

<!-- uid=860157:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** E-Exactly! That's exactly right!

<!-- uid=860157:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** Besides, Kirito already married  
Asuna once!

<!-- uid=860157:20:1 -->

...Wait, what do you  
mean by "once"?

<!-- uid=860157:21:1 -->

**Joker:** ...They got divorced.

<!-- uid=860157:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** N-No! We got married in-game!

<!-- uid=860157:23:1 -->

**Violet:** Which means you're single in real  
life.

<!-- uid=860157:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey, Sinon? Can we choose our  
words more carefully? We'll give  
people the wrong idea.

<!-- uid=860157:25:1 -->

**Sinon:** Right...

<!-- uid=860157:26:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...Sorry, Queen. Looks like  
Leafa's idea didn't pan out after  
all.

<!-- uid=860157:27:1 -->

**Queen:** What a coincidence, Sinon. I was  
just thinking the same thing.

<!-- uid=860157:28:1 -->


## Story 860158 · \[Cat's Fierce Gaze\] Panther Lv.80

Character Story

**Joker:** I think it's about time we took  
on that boss again.

able to team up and take it out!

say that, Joker!

<!-- uid=860158:20:1 -->

**Oracle:** Go! Get 'em! All-out attack!

<!-- uid=860158:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's over!

<!-- uid=860158:22:1 -->

**Fox:** Yes! Victory is ours!

<!-- uid=860158:24:1 -->

<!-- uid=860158:25:1 -->

**Violet:** Our strategy to chat and learn  
about each other to improve our  
teamwork worked like a charm!

<!-- uid=860158:26:1 -->

**Asuna:** The masks made me a little scared  
of you all at first, but now I'm  
glad you're our friends!

<!-- uid=860158:27:1 -->

I still can't believe you tried  
to eat Mona.

<!-- uid=860158:28:1 -->

**Sinon:** You're usually so rational and

sympathetic heart goes a long way!

<!-- uid=860158:32:1 -->

battles ahead too.

## Story 860161 · \[Bashful Bunny\] Silica Lv.10

Character Story

**Silica:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=860161:1:1 -->

**Silica:** Looks like bunny girl equipment

## Story 860163 · \[Bashful Bunny\] Silica Lv.30

Character Story

**Silica:** Whaaaaat?!

**Leafa:** ...Did I mishear you just now?

<!-- uid=860163:2:1 -->

<!-- uid=860163:4:1 -->

didn't you? That's what I'm after.

<!-- uid=860163:6:1 -->

She said you two were super cute  
in those bunny girl outfits!

<!-- uid=860163:7:1 -->

**Liz:** And, well... You know.  
Maybe Kirito's a secret lover  
of bunny girls!

<!-- uid=860163:8:1 -->

A blacksmith should never let an  
opportunity escape her.

<!-- uid=860163:9:1 -->

**Leafa & Silica:** ...

**Silica:** Putting aside what you just said  
about Kirito for now...

**Silica:** I'm sorry that you got your hopes  
up like this, but, well...

<!-- uid=860163:12:1 -->

**Silica:** I feel like this bunny girl outfit

Once people started talking  
about you two as bunnies,
