**Liz:** I couldn't join in on the  
conversation unless I'd seen  
it for myself! I can't stand that!

<!-- uid=860163:21:1 -->

**Leafa:** What kind of a reason is that...?

<!-- uid=860163:22:1 -->

**Silica:** I'm personally pretty embarrassed  
by the thought that people are  
talking about those outfits...

<!-- uid=860163:23:1 -->

**Liz:** Oh, it's fine! What do you have  
to lose? Please!

<!-- uid=860163:24:1 -->

**Silica:** ...

<!-- uid=860163:25:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...

<!-- uid=860163:26:1 -->

**Silica:** Wh-What should we do...?

<!-- uid=860163:27:1 -->

**Leafa:** W-Well...

<!-- uid=860163:28:1 -->


## Story 860165 · \[Bashful Bunny\] Silica Lv.50

Character Story

**Silica:** O-Okay. We changed.

<!-- uid=860165:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** Here they are...

<!-- uid=860165:2:1 -->

**Liz:** Whoa!

<!-- uid=860165:3:1 -->

**Liz:** That's...pretty amazing equipment!

<!-- uid=860165:4:1 -->

**Silica:** R-Really...?

<!-- uid=860165:5:1 -->

**Liz:** Yes! I haven't raised my sewing  
skill too high, but even I can  
tell just by looking at it.

<!-- uid=860165:6:1 -->

**Liz:** They were both damaged during your  
fight at the casino, right?

<!-- uid=860165:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yes, that's correct.

<!-- uid=860165:8:1 -->

**Liz:** It must've cost a ton to fix!

<!-- uid=860165:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...Apparently it did, but Asuna  
covered it with her roulette  
winnings...

<!-- uid=860165:10:1 -->

**Liz:** I see. So you don't know the  
exact cost.

<!-- uid=860165:11:1 -->

**Liz:** Well, what I can tell you...  
Is that you should use those  
with care!

<!-- uid=860165:12:1 -->

**Liz:** Plus, you both look great!  
You two are way too modest!

<!-- uid=860165:13:1 -->

**Silica:** Modest? No...

<!-- uid=860165:14:1 -->

**Silica:** ...Unlike Leafa, I really feel  
like these clothes are wearing me,  
I suppose...!

<!-- uid=860165:15:1 -->

**Leafa:** What...?

<!-- uid=860165:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** H-Hold on! What are you on about,  
Silica?! You look super cute!

<!-- uid=860165:17:1 -->

**Leafa:** I'm the one who can't pull it off.  
How do I explain it... Hm.

<!-- uid=860165:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** Oh! It feels...unwholesome!  
Even I get embarrassed wearing it!

<!-- uid=860165:19:1 -->

**Silica:** What...? N-No, I wouldn't  
say that!

<!-- uid=860165:20:1 -->

**Silica:** You look fabulous as a bunny girl!  
You have such a great figure!  
I wish I looked like you!

<!-- uid=860165:21:1 -->

**Silica:** I think you're showing exactly how  
to pull off this outfit. There's  
nothing unwholesome about it!

<!-- uid=860165:22:1 -->

**Liz:** Okay, you two! That's enough!

<!-- uid=860165:23:1 -->

**Liz:** I think I get it now. You didn't  
want to wear it because you  
thought it was a bad look on you?

<!-- uid=860165:24:1 -->

**Silica:** ...Yes.

<!-- uid=860165:25:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...I suppose so.

<!-- uid=860165:26:1 -->

**Liz:** \*sigh\*  
What are you two talking about?!

<!-- uid=860165:27:1 -->

**Liz:** Fine. As an objective third party,  
I shall pass judgment on you two.

<!-- uid=860165:28:1 -->

**Liz:** You are both... Mega cute!!  
Case closed!!

<!-- uid=860165:29:1 -->

## Story 860168 · \[Bashful Bunny\] Silica Lv.80

Character Story

**Silica:** Liz!

<!-- uid=860168:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** Silica... Let's go!

<!-- uid=860168:2:1 -->

**Silica:** Okay!

<!-- uid=860168:3:1 -->

**Kobold:** Graarf...

<!-- uid=860168:4:1 -->

**Liz:** That really surprised me...  
I never knew Kobolds inhabited  
this forest...

<!-- uid=860168:5:1 -->

**Silica:** A-Are you okay, Liz?!

<!-- uid=860168:6:2 -->

**Liz:** Yes, all thanks to you.

<!-- uid=860168:7:1 -->

**Liz:** You two...both seem alright. And  
your bunny girl outfits seem to be  
fine this time as well...

<!-- uid=860168:8:1 -->

**Liz:** I heard they ripped easily last  
time around...but maybe they're  
better in battle than you think?

<!-- uid=860168:9:1 -->

**Silica:** I-I don't know... But I suddenly  
felt a surge of power when I knew  
that I needed to save you.

<!-- uid=860168:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** Me too! And it felt like my  
teamwork with Silica was awfully  
good, too...!

<!-- uid=860168:11:1 -->

**Liz:** Huh! How interesting... Maybe it  
enhances your teamwork abilities  
with others wearing it?

<!-- uid=860168:12:1 -->

**Liz:** ...Now I'm starting to want to  
get one myself.

<!-- uid=860168:13:1 -->

**Silica:** What...? You're going to be a  
bunny girl too, Liz?

<!-- uid=860168:14:1 -->

**Liz:** Well, if I can get the equipment.  
You won it at the casino, right?

<!-- uid=860168:15:1 -->

**Liz:** Oh, but... I don't know.  
When I look at you two, I...

<!-- uid=860168:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** Uhm... What are you trying to  
say...?

<!-- uid=860168:17:1 -->

**Liz:** Oh, well... You know.

<!-- uid=860168:18:1 -->

**Liz:** I don't really want to say this  
out loud, but I doubt I'd make for  
as good of a bunny as you two...

<!-- uid=860168:19:1 -->

**Leafa & Silica:** That's not true at all!!

<!-- uid=860168:20:1 -->

**Liz:** ...

<!-- uid=860168:21:1 -->

**Liz:** Aww... Thank you!!

<!-- uid=860168:22:1 -->

**Liz:** I had a feeling you two would say  
that, but it's moving to hear you  
be so adamant about it...!

<!-- uid=860168:23:1 -->

**Silica:** Of course! I'm convinced you'd  
look great as a bunny, Liz!

<!-- uid=860168:24:1 -->

**Leafa:** Me too! And we're not just saying  
this to be polite, of course!

<!-- uid=860168:25:1 -->

**Liz:** Ah...! I-I can't believe how nice  
you two girls are! I can't wait  
any longer...!

<!-- uid=860168:26:1 -->

**Liz:** Let's go storm the casino!  
Now I need to get my hands on some  
equipment to match you two!

<!-- uid=860168:27:1 -->

**Silica:** Sounds great! Let's go!

<!-- uid=860168:28:1 -->

**Leafa:** Of course...there's no guarantee  
we'll be able to get it if it's a  
casino prize...

<!-- uid=860168:29:1 -->

**Liz:** Don't worry! I'll manage somehow

<!-- uid=860168:30:1 -->


## Story 860171 · \[Undying Love\] Tiese Lv.10

Character Story

**Tiese:** Wow... What a beautiful cave...

<!-- uid=860171:1:1 -->

**Ronie:** I never knew a place like this  
existed.

<!-- uid=860171:2:1 -->

**Tiese:** Yeah. I felt the same way...

<!-- uid=860171:3:1 -->

**Tiese:** (My imagination is pretty  
impressive if it managed to come  
up with a sight like this.)

<!-- uid=860171:4:1 -->

**Tiese:** (Still, this world is awfully  
inflexible for a dream. It seems  
so realistic in ways...)

<!-- uid=860171:5:1 -->

**Tiese:** (...If only Eugeo would show up,  
even for just a bit. Oh, I'm such  
a silly girl...)

<!-- uid=860171:6:1 -->

**Ronie:** ...Are you okay, Tiese?

<!-- uid=860171:7:1 -->

**Tiese:** Huh? Wh-Why do you say that?

<!-- uid=860171:8:1 -->

**Ronie:** Well... Like I said earlier.

<!-- uid=860171:9:1 -->

**Ronie:** You're naturally going to start  
thinking about a partner if you're  
in a Bridal Contest...

<!-- uid=860171:10:1 -->

**Tiese:** ...Yes, that's true.

<!-- uid=860171:11:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I don't know if we should be  
talking about this.

<!-- uid=860171:12:1 -->

**Tiese:** Wha...?!

<!-- uid=860171:13:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** This is a festival, you know.

<!-- uid=860171:14:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** You shouldn't have such a gloomy  
face, don't you think?

<!-- uid=860171:15:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Why don't we use this opportunity  
to talk about something fun  
instead?

<!-- uid=860171:16:1 -->

**Tiese:** Something fun...?  
Like what...?

<!-- uid=860171:17:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Hrm...

<!-- uid=860171:18:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Would you cheer up...if I told you  
stories about Kirito and Eugeo  
when they were students?

<!-- uid=860171:19:1 -->


## Story 860173 · \[Undying Love\] Tiese Lv.30

Character Story

**Tiese:** Stories about my seniors as  
students...?

<!-- uid=860173:1:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Yes. Before they entered the  
Academy, of course...

<!-- uid=860173:2:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Back when they were pages  
and attendants.

<!-- uid=860173:3:1 -->

**Ronie:** Oh...! Y-Yes, I'd like to hear  
about that!

<!-- uid=860173:4:1 -->

**Tiese:** Me too!

<!-- uid=860173:5:1 -->

**Tiese:** Oh, but I thought you weren't so  
close with Eugeo, Lady Sortiliena?

<!-- uid=860173:6:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Hm... Well, yes. You're right.

<!-- uid=860173:7:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Eugeo was Golgorosso's page,  
so it's not as if I had much  
contact with him...

<!-- uid=860173:8:1 -->

**Tiese:** Sir Golgorosso...! I-I've heard  
about him from Eugeo so many times  
before!

<!-- uid=860173:9:1 -->

**Tiese:** How he was a mountain of a man  
whose position as third in class  
was unshakable!

<!-- uid=860173:10:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...Yes, and a straightforward man.  
His Baltio style always gave me  
trouble.

<!-- uid=860173:11:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Eugeo's swordsmanship must be  
strongly influenced by him  
as well.

<!-- uid=860173:12:1 -->

**Ronie:** But doesn't Eugeo use Aincrad  
style...?

<!-- uid=860173:13:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Yes, both he and Kirito had  
already learned impressive skills  
with a sword.

<!-- uid=860173:14:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** They found the best parts of  
varied styles and made them their  
own. The sign of a good swordsman.

<!-- uid=860173:15:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** What about you two? How have you  
trained in swordsmanship?

<!-- uid=860173:16:1 -->

**Ronie:** ...E-Erm.

<!-- uid=860173:17:1 -->

**Tiese:** We practice, but we're still total  
amateurs...

<!-- uid=860173:18:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...Hm, I see. If you don't mind  
me being your instructor, I could  
teach you the basics some time.

<!-- uid=860173:19:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I'd like you to feel even a trace  
of your beloved seniors from my  
own sword, if possible.

<!-- uid=860173:20:1 -->

**Both:** Thank you very much!!

<!-- uid=860173:21:1 -->


## Story 860175 · \[Undying Love\] Tiese Lv.50

Character Story

**Sortiliena:** ...Phew.

<!-- uid=860175:1:1 -->

**Alice:** You're awfully talkative, Lady  
Sortiliena.

<!-- uid=860175:2:1 -->

**Alice:** I was convinced that you were  
more of the quiet type.

<!-- uid=860175:3:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...My apologies, Lady Alice.  
Did I upset you?

<!-- uid=860175:4:1 -->

**Alice:** No, not at all. I don't mean to  
sound disapproving.

<!-- uid=860175:5:1 -->

**Alice:** It's just that you three seemed to  
be having quite a lot of fun on  
your own.

<!-- uid=860175:6:1 -->

**Alice:** So I thought...that maybe a  
warning might be called for.

<!-- uid=860175:7:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...I apologize. I was, after all,  
speaking to my former attendant's  
attendant, as well as her friend.

<!-- uid=860175:8:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** To me, they are in a way like  
my very own grandchildren.

<!-- uid=860175:9:1 -->

**Alice:** Grandchildren, you say...

<!-- uid=860175:10:1 -->

**Alice:** Yes, I've heard that when women  
become mothers, they then dote on  
the children of their children.

<!-- uid=860175:11:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** That's exactly right.

<!-- uid=860175:12:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Of course, I don't have any  
children or grandchildren of my  
own, but juniors are nice to have.

<!-- uid=860175:13:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** When you see them grow, you feel  
as happy as if you'd grown  
yourself.

<!-- uid=860175:14:1 -->

**Alice:** Did you feel that way about  
Kirito, too?

<!-- uid=860175:15:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Yes. I'm very proud of Kirito.

<!-- uid=860175:16:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I was able to be his mentor, teach  
him at least a few things, and be  
a good influence on him...

<!-- uid=860175:17:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** The fact I could do that moves me  
from the bottom of my heart.

<!-- uid=860175:18:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** It may sound strange...but you can  
even say that it's thanks to him  
that I took first seat.

<!-- uid=860175:19:1 -->

**Alice:** ...So you learned Aincrad style  
as well, Lady Sortiliena?

<!-- uid=860175:20:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** No, I wouldn't say that.  
What Kirito gave me...

<!-- uid=860175:21:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...Was the strong heart of one  
who is ready for battle.

<!-- uid=860175:22:1 -->

**Alice:** Your heart...

<!-- uid=860175:23:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Yes. He showed me what that looked  
like through his own actions.

<!-- uid=860175:24:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Grit, bravery...and how to ready  
yourself to face opponents more  
powerful than you.

<!-- uid=860175:25:1 -->


## Story 860177 · \[Undying Love\] Tiese Lv.70

Character Story

**Alice:** ...It seems you have some very  
good memories of Kirito, Lady  
Sortiliena.

<!-- uid=860177:1:1 -->

**Alice:** (They spent a very long time  
together, too... Longer than I  
spent with him, of course...)

<!-- uid=860177:2:1 -->

**Alice:** (Kirito and I spent one night and  
about six months together... They  
were such valuable days, but...)

<!-- uid=860177:3:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Yes, which is why I have such a  
strong interest myself in how  
everyone spent time with him.

<!-- uid=860177:4:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I'm interested in the experiences  
you, Ronie, and Lady Asuna all  
shared with him.

<!-- uid=860177:5:1 -->

**Alice:** Asuna...

<!-- uid=860177:6:1 -->

**Alice:** ...I'm very unhappy that she's  
not here with us.

<!-- uid=860177:7:1 -->

**Alice:** There are so many stories I  
haven't got to hear from her yet,  
after all...

<!-- uid=860177:8:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Yes, that is true... And Lady  
Asuna seems to have quite a lot  
of them...

<!-- uid=860177:9:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...What a mysterious individual.  
Like a god, yet still human at  
the same time...

<!-- uid=860177:10:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** And she came from another world  
in order to save Kirito.

<!-- uid=860177:11:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** It made me feel all over again  
just how much of an influence  
Kirito has...

<!-- uid=860177:12:1 -->

**Alice:** ...I agree with you there.

<!-- uid=860177:13:1 -->

**Alice:** That must be why Asuna bothered  
coming all the way to this world.

<!-- uid=860177:14:1 -->

**Alice:** Kirito's not the kind of man who  
can be allowed to stay asleep  
forever.

<!-- uid=860177:15:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...You're very right about that.

<!-- uid=860177:16:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** We have to figure out a way to  
wake Kirito up...

<!-- uid=860177:17:1 -->


## Story 860178 · \[Undying Love\] Tiese Lv.80

Character Story

**Alice:** Having this conversation with you  
only makes Asuna's absence  
that much more frustrating.

<!-- uid=860178:1:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Oh, speaking of which...

<!-- uid=860178:2:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I understand you fought Lady Asuna  
immediately after she manifested  
herself here?

<!-- uid=860178:3:1 -->

**Alice:** Yes, I did.

<!-- uid=860178:4:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...What did you think of Lady  
Asuna's skills with a sword?

<!-- uid=860178:5:1 -->

**Alice:** ...Something did feel a little  
strange to me.

<!-- uid=860178:6:1 -->

**Alice:** Most notable was her sword's  
frighteningly quick speed.

<!-- uid=860178:7:1 -->

**Alice:** Continuous attacks... Almost as if  
she were attacking me with  
multiple swords at once.

<!-- uid=860178:8:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Multiple swords...?

<!-- uid=860178:9:1 -->

**Alice:** Yes. That's just how fast her  
blade was.

<!-- uid=860178:10:1 -->

**Alice:** Fast enough to make a single slim  
sword feel like a myriad of  
blades...

<!-- uid=860178:11:1 -->

**Alice:** (...I would've been able to settle  
the score with her if she was here  
now...)

<!-- uid=860178:12:1 -->

**Alice:** (That must be why I feel so  
indescribably unfulfilled.)

<!-- uid=860178:13:1 -->

**Alice:** (I don't exactly see Ronie or Lady  
Sortiliena as opponents...)

<!-- uid=860178:14:1 -->

**Alice:** (If anything, I feel a kind of  
closeness to them. But her...  
As far as Asuna is concerned?)

<!-- uid=860178:15:1 -->

**Alice:** (I feel the burning desire to  
never lose to her. A strong sense  
of rivalry...)

<!-- uid=860178:16:1 -->

**Alice:** ...This Bridal Contest would have  
made for the perfect place for a  
battle, too.

<!-- uid=860178:17:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...Lady Alice?

<!-- uid=860178:18:1 -->

**Alice:** Ah...! Excuse me. Please, pay  
no mind to what I just said.

<!-- uid=860178:19:1 -->

**Alice:** (I guess my fight with her comes  
after this dream... In the "real  
world," I suppose...?)

<!-- uid=860178:20:1 -->


## Story 860181 · \[Resort Life\] Yuuki Lv.10

Character Story

**Yui:** Wow...!

<!-- uid=860181:1:1 -->

**Yui:** Look, it's so pretty and  
magnificent!

<!-- uid=860181:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** I can't believe how beautiful the  
sea is in the Human Empire...!

<!-- uid=860181:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ahaha. I think most of ALO's  
oceans are pretty, if you ask me.

<!-- uid=860181:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** If anything... dirty oceans only  
really exist in worlds where  
humans live, right?

<!-- uid=860181:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** That might reflect reality a  
little too well...

<!-- uid=860181:6:1 -->

**Yui:** Midgard's level of civilization  
hasn't reached that of the  
industrial revolution.

<!-- uid=860181:7:1 -->

**Yui:** So the seas here should be pretty,  
even if humans live nearby!

<!-- uid=860181:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, yeah. I guess the ocean won't  
be polluted if you're not in an  
age with factories or machines...

<!-- uid=860181:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** Asunaaa!

<!-- uid=860181:10:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Asuna, come over here!

<!-- uid=860181:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hm? What's up, you two?

<!-- uid=860181:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** Sorry to bother you guys when  
you were enjoying yourselves!  
It's just...

<!-- uid=860181:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** We found a subquest we wanted  
your help with!

<!-- uid=860181:14:1 -->

**Yuuki:** The difficulty level's a bit high,  
so I think players with the new  
swimsuits should give it a try!

<!-- uid=860181:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Why don't you try it out, Asuna?  
I'll stay here with Yui.

<!-- uid=860181:16:1 -->

**Yui:** Go help Leafa and Yuuki, Mommy!

<!-- uid=860181:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Okay, I think I'll do that!

<!-- uid=860181:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Thanks. It might even help us  
figure out how to finish the main  
quest here...

<!-- uid=860181:19:1 -->


## Story 860183 · \[Resort Life\] Yuuki Lv.30

Character Story

**Asuna:** So... what kind of quest is it?

<!-- uid=860183:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** The quest itself is simple. Just  
chase a treasure chest swimming  
in the ocean and open it.

<!-- uid=860183:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Swimming treasure chests!  
I've never heard of anything  
like that.

<!-- uid=860183:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yes, but the way they swim  
provides an extra challenge...

<!-- uid=860183:4:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Apparently they swim super fast,  
and in the worst locations!

<!-- uid=860183:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh! So that's why you wanted  
my help...

<!-- uid=860183:6:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Yup. I think it'd be tough without  
the unique skills of these new  
swimsuits.

<!-- uid=860183:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** Apparently Alice's bathing suit  
has a skill too, but she doesn't  
seem like a very good swimmer...

<!-- uid=860183:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Right. I guess Alice and Eugeo  
come from a world where there's  
no ocean nearby...

<!-- uid=860183:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** Not to mention that you're an  
Undine, Asuna. We know we  
can count on you in the water!

<!-- uid=860183:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** That might be true... but I don't  
want you getting your hopes up.

<!-- uid=860183:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** I haven't put many points into my  
swimming skill, though my race  
bonus is pretty significant...

<!-- uid=860183:12:1 -->

**Yuuki:** It'll be fine! I'm sure you're a  
way better swimmer than us,  
anyway!

<!-- uid=860183:13:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Okay. Now that Asuna's with us,  
let's start looking for that  
treasure chest!

<!-- uid=860183:14:1 -->

**Leafa & Asuna:** Aw yeah!

<!-- uid=860183:15:1 -->


## Story 860185 · \[Resort Life\] Yuuki Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** Um, the quest marker points to  
around this area...

<!-- uid=860185:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh! There you are!

<!-- uid=860185:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** You're not getting away from me!

<!-- uid=860185:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Mmmgh...!

<!-- uid=860185:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** That treasure chest... It swims  
just about as fast as I do!

<!-- uid=860185:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** I think I can catch up to it  
eventually since I swim a  
little faster, but...

<!-- uid=860185:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** The unique Prolonged Diving skill  
on my swimsuit...

<!-- uid=860185:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** It lets me swim for quite a while,  
but I think it still has its  
limits...!

<!-- uid=860185:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Wh-What should I do...? It might  
take another 15 minutes at this  
rate...

<!-- uid=860185:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm pretty sure I won't be able to  
stay underwater for that long...  
Hm?

<!-- uid=860185:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...No way. My diving gauge hasn't  
budged an inch... Even though I've  
been underwater for a while now!

<!-- uid=860185:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Okay... Then I think I might be  
able to turn this into a marathon!

<!-- uid=860185:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Finally... I caught up to it!  
Treasure chest, you're mine!

<!-- uid=860185:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Pheeew... I wonder how long I was  
swimming...

<!-- uid=860185:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** That seemed like a superhuman  
feat. Even I can't help but admit  
that felt unusual...

<!-- uid=860185:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Almost like I've become a fish...  
This feels a little weird. I don't  
need to, but I'll go up for air.

<!-- uid=860185:16:1 -->


## Story 860187 · \[Resort Life\] Yuuki Lv.70

Character Story

**Leafa:** Wait, wait, waaait!

<!-- uid=860187:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** Wow! I'm going so fast, if I do  
say so myself!

<!-- uid=860187:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** I guess this is what the unique  
skill on my swimsuit, Superspeed  
Diving, can do...!

<!-- uid=860187:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** Wow... I'm usually too scared to  
do anything underwater, but it  
doesn't feel that way at all now!

<!-- uid=860187:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** If only I could swim like this in  
real life. Then I wouldn't have to  
be such a burden on Kazuto...!

<!-- uid=860187:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** This speed, though... It might not  
be as fast as flying, but  
it's still pretty incredible.

<!-- uid=860187:6:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...Hm? Actually, I wonder...  
Which one is faster...?

<!-- uid=860187:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** It's hard to compare the two.  
Swimming and flying feel so  
different...

<!-- uid=860187:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** No, but swimming has to be tougher  
if you compare water and air  
resistance. This can't be as fast.

<!-- uid=860187:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** No matter how fast tuna or sharks  
can swim, there's no way it's as  
fast as birds can fly...

<!-- uid=860187:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...Okay, I'm starting to lose my  
confidence. I'll look it up when  
I get home...

<!-- uid=860187:11:1 -->

**Leafa:** Whoa there...! Oh no!  
C'mon, Leafa! Focus!

<!-- uid=860187:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** It'd be no laughing matter if I  
failed this quest because I  
got distracted.

<!-- uid=860187:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** I know Asuna and Yuuki would  
never mess up like that... So  
I need to get it together!

<!-- uid=860187:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** Wait, waaait! Gimme your treasure!

<!-- uid=860187:15:1 -->


## Story 860188 · \[Resort Life\] Yuuki Lv.80

Character Story

**Leafa:** I did it! I got the chest!

<!-- uid=860188:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** Okay, let's see what's inside...

<!-- uid=860188:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** Mm, no... Maybe I should wait  
until we all meet back up?

<!-- uid=860188:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hmm, what should I do? I probably  
should at least check to see  
what's inside.

<!-- uid=860188:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** Guess I'll pop it open.  
Let's see...

<!-- uid=860188:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Leeeafaaa!

<!-- uid=860188:6:1 -->

**Leafa:** Oh, Asuna! Perfect timing!

<!-- uid=860188:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** I just finished! What about you?

**Asuna:** Yep! Me too!

<!-- uid=860188:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Mm-hm... Why don't we bring these

a group later?

<!-- uid=860188:15:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeah, you're right.  
Oh... Speaking of which.

<!-- uid=860188:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** Was Yuuki's chest full of ice  
cream too?

<!-- uid=860188:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hm... I'm not sure.

<!-- uid=860188:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** It seems likely that she'd get the  
same rewards as us. We all did the

<!-- uid=860188:19:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Heeey!

<!-- uid=860188:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, Yuuki!

**Leafa:** How'd it go, Yuuki?

<!-- uid=860188:22:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I managed to beat it! I had to  
chase the chest really deep,  
though.

<!-- uid=860188:23:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Thankfully, my swimsuit's unique

<!-- uid=860188:24:1 -->

**Yuuki:** It was an amazing skill! I could

<!-- uid=860188:25:1 -->

**Leafa:** You must've gone pretty deep into  
this area, then.

<!-- uid=860188:26:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Yep. Probably as deep as it goes!

<!-- uid=860188:27:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I just got ice cream as a reward,  
though. It seems awfully...  
practical, I guess?

<!-- uid=860188:28:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, so the same as us, then.

<!-- uid=860188:29:1 -->

**Yuuki:** What? Your treasure chests had  
ice cream in them too?

<!-- uid=860188:30:1 -->

**Leafa:** They did! Oh, but... your ice  
cream looks like the best one.

<!-- uid=860188:31:1 -->

**Asuna:** You're right! Those are the kinda  
pricey ice cream cups.

<!-- uid=860188:32:1 -->

**Yuuki:** That's great and all, but what're  
we gonna do with all this ice  
cream?

<!-- uid=860188:33:1 -->

**Yuuki:** It didn't give us any ideas about  
how to progress in this quest  
either...

<!-- uid=860188:34:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...That's true.

<!-- uid=860188:35:1 -->

**Asuna:** (Yuuki dove super deep, but there  
wasn't anything there either...)

<!-- uid=860188:36:1 -->

**Asuna:** (Maybe we should go back and  
discuss this quest with the others

<!-- uid=860188:37:1 -->


## Story 860211 · \[Bewitching Sorceress\] Sortiliena Lv.10

Character Story

**Sortiliena:** Sorry, Ronie...

<!-- uid=860211:1:1 -->

**Ronie:** No, it's fine!

<!-- uid=860211:2:1 -->

**Ronie:** This did all start because I went  
too far using the power of those  
candies...

<!-- uid=860211:3:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Well, that may be true...

<!-- uid=860211:4:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** But at the same time, you may have  
been the reason that they were  
able to draw out all that power.

<!-- uid=860211:5:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** You know... I think you can be  
proud of your victory here.

<!-- uid=860211:6:1 -->

**Ronie:** Ah... Thank you!

<!-- uid=860211:7:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** There is a bit of a problem,  
though...

<!-- uid=860211:8:1 -->

**Ronie:** A problem? Like what?

<!-- uid=860211:9:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Well, did you run into any  
monsters on your way here?

<!-- uid=860211:10:1 -->

**Ronie:** Monsters...?

<!-- uid=860211:11:1 -->

**Ronie:** (There are monsters here? Even  
though this is my dream world?)

<!-- uid=860211:12:1 -->

**Ronie:** (What's going on inside of my  
head...?)

<!-- uid=860211:13:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...Your expression is telling  
me no.

<!-- uid=860211:14:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Unfortunately, though, ferocious  
monsters appear here on Halloween  
Avenue...

<!-- uid=860211:15:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** It would be nice if we could get  
through this without encountering  
any of them, but...

<!-- uid=860211:16:1 -->

**Ronie:** ...!

<!-- uid=860211:17:1 -->

**Ronie:** (This is terrible...)

<!-- uid=860211:18:1 -->

**Ronie:** (Sortiliena is hurt and unable  
to fight because of me...)

<!-- uid=860211:19:1 -->

**Ronie:** (I need to do something to get us  
out of this situation...!)

<!-- uid=860211:20:1 -->


## Story 860213 · \[Bewitching Sorceress\] Sortiliena Lv.30

Character Story

**Ronie:** Um, Sortiliena?

<!-- uid=860213:1:1 -->

**Ronie:** What kinds of monsters appear  
around here?

<!-- uid=860213:2:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I've only heard rumors about them  
myself, but...

<!-- uid=860213:3:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** They're apparently Halloween  
themed.

<!-- uid=860213:4:1 -->

**Ronie:** ...And what kinds of monsters  
would those be?

<!-- uid=860213:5:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I'm not sure. I may be wearing  
this outfit, but I don't actually  
know too much about Halloween.

<!-- uid=860213:6:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Why am I dressed up like a witch,  
anyway...? What do witches have  
to do with Halloween?

<!-- uid=860213:7:1 -->

**Ronie:** Um... I-I couldn't say...

<!-- uid=860213:8:1 -->

**Ronie:** (Come to think of it, I did hear  
from Asuna that it's a standard  
Halloween costume...)

<!-- uid=860213:9:1 -->

**Werewolf:** Graaar!

<!-- uid=860213:10:1 -->

**Ronie:** Aahh!

<!-- uid=860213:11:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...A werewolf? Is that Halloween  
themed...?

<!-- uid=860213:12:1 -->

**Ronie:** I think it is...

<!-- uid=860213:13:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** This is a troublesome enemy,  
though. I thought it was a simple  
wolf since it appeared on the road,

<!-- uid=860213:14:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** but werewolves are beasts with  
both human and wolf attributes.  
They're pretty tough opponents...

<!-- uid=860213:15:1 -->

**Ronie:** ...D-Don't worry!

<!-- uid=860213:16:1 -->

**Ronie:** I'll protect you, Sortiliena!

<!-- uid=860213:17:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Ronie...

<!-- uid=860213:18:1 -->

**Ronie:** All my training has been for  
moments like this.

<!-- uid=860213:19:1 -->

**Ronie:** Because what I want... is to  
protect the wounded!

<!-- uid=860213:20:1 -->

**Ronie:** Please relax. I promise you that  
I'll beat this thing...!

<!-- uid=860213:21:1 -->


## Story 860215 · \[Bewitching Sorceress\] Sortiliena Lv.50

Character Story

**Ronie:** \*pant\* \*pant\*...

<!-- uid=860215:1:1 -->

**Werewolf:** Grrr...

<!-- uid=860215:2:1 -->

**Ronie:** Yaaaahhh!

<!-- uid=860215:3:1 -->

**Werewolf:** Grrargh!

<!-- uid=860215:5:1 -->

**Ronie:** I-I did it...!

<!-- uid=860215:6:1 -->

**Ronie:** It took a ton of time... but  
I managed to beat it on my own!

<!-- uid=860215:7:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...Amazing job, Ronie.

<!-- uid=860215:8:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** What a hair-raising battle.  
It was almost like...

<!-- uid=860215:9:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...the way that Kirito fights.  
It reminded me of the past...

<!-- uid=860215:10:1 -->

**Ronie:** Ah...! Th-Thank you! Nothing  
could make me happier than  
hearing those words!

<!-- uid=860215:11:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Heh heh. Well, the same goes  
for me.

<!-- uid=860215:12:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** You're Kirito's junior. In other  
words, you're my junior's junior.  
Almost like a grandchild to me.

<!-- uid=860215:13:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I was able to see how you've grown  
today when you protected me...

<!-- uid=860215:14:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I felt like the things I taught  
Kirito weren't for naught. What  
is this feeling if not joy?

<!-- uid=860215:15:1 -->

**Ronie:** ...!

<!-- uid=860215:16:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** What a wonderful day. I'm sure it  
would have been even more splendid  
if Kirito had joined us...

<!-- uid=860215:17:1 -->


## Story 860217 · \[Bewitching Sorceress\] Sortiliena Lv.70

Character Story

**Ronie:** W-We're here!

<!-- uid=860217:1:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Great work, Ronie.

<!-- uid=860217:2:1 -->

**Ronie:** N-No, not at all. I think I still  
have a lot of room for  
improvement...

<!-- uid=860217:3:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** You did your job more than  
well enough.

<!-- uid=860217:4:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** To the point that I nearly felt  
ashamed that I couldn't fight.

<!-- uid=860217:5:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Allow me to come to your aid in  
battle next time.

<!-- uid=860217:6:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Ah... So you're finally back.

<!-- uid=860217:7:1 -->

**Ronie:** Sir Bercouli!

<!-- uid=860217:8:1 -->

**Ronie:** Um... Thank you for the candy!

<!-- uid=860217:9:1 -->

**Ronie:** I never imagined I'd gain so much  
strength just by eating some  
candy...!

<!-- uid=860217:10:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Well, it seems that candy occupies  
a special place in this festival  
known as Halloween.

<!-- uid=860217:11:1 -->

**Fanatio:** There's no time to dilly-dally,  
Ronie.

<!-- uid=860217:12:1 -->

**Fanatio:** We'll look after her, so you go  
do your duty.

<!-- uid=860217:13:1 -->

**Ronie:** My... duty...?

<!-- uid=860217:14:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Of saving the boy taken away by  
Lady Asuna... no?

<!-- uid=860217:15:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Lady Asuna is a most wicked woman.  
Who knows what she's doing to that  
boy in her castle...

<!-- uid=860217:16:1 -->

**Ronie:** U-Um... I'd like to ask that you  
not speak so negatively about  
Lady Asuna...

<!-- uid=860217:17:1 -->

**Ronie:** (It's all going to end up coming  
back to me in the end, after

occasion. Don't forget it!

<!-- uid=860238:18:1 -->

<!-- uid=860238:19:1 -->


## Story 860241 · \[THE CHARIOT\] Sinon Lv.10

Character Story

**Leafa:** Um, this way, I think?  
Everyone follow me, please!

**Asuna:** Thanks, Leafa. The rest of you,  
too...

<!-- uid=860241:2:1 -->

**Seven:** You're real lifesavers, coming  
to help us get our own  
tarot equipment.

about it!

<!-- uid=860241:5:1 -->

out all your subquests once you're

no reason to feel bad about it.

## Story 860243 · \[THE CHARIOT\] Sinon Lv.30

Character Story

**Leafa:** What pairings were there again...?

<!-- uid=860243:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** First off, I got Justice.  
Kirito got The World.

<!-- uid=860243:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** Though, I'd say that Kirito's The  
World is the most questionable  
pairing out of all of ours.

<!-- uid=860243:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wha...?! Wh-Why's that, Sinon?!

<!-- uid=860243:4:2 -->

**Kirito:** What's wrong with me being  
The World?! Why shouldn't I be  
a perfect, supreme being?!

<!-- uid=860243:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...Are you really sure about that?

<!-- uid=860243:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** I'm not that familiar with tarot  
cards myself, but I do know that  
The World is a very special one.

<!-- uid=860243:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, I've heard that, too.

<!-- uid=860243:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Are you listening, Kirito?

<!-- uid=860243:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** There's room for debate as to how  
fitting The World is for you.  
So, you need to up your game!

<!-- uid=860243:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** Exactly! You need to focus on  
being that "perfect, supreme  
being" you were going on about.

<!-- uid=860243:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Gah... That backfired...

<!-- uid=860243:12:1 -->


## Story 860245 · \[THE CHARIOT\] Sinon Lv.50

Character Story

**Kirito:** F-Fine, I'll admit that possessing  
The World comes with its own  
responsibilities...

<!-- uid=860245:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** But hear me out! All the tarot  
cards you've been given carry a  
heavy meaning of their own too!

<!-- uid=860245:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...Yeah, I guess you're right.

<!-- uid=860245:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yes. Take mine, for example.  
Justice...

<!-- uid=860245:4:2 -->

**Leafa:** It's a great honor to be given  
Justice, but it's also a very  
delicate card.

<!-- uid=860245:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** Tarot cards can come out in both  
upright and reversed positions.  
Did you know that?

<!-- uid=860245:6:1 -->

**Rain:** Umm... S-Sure. I think I know  
what that means.

<!-- uid=860245:7:1 -->

**Rain:** Even a card with a good meaning  
means the reverse if it comes out  
upside-down, right?

<!-- uid=860245:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Not exactly. The meaning isn't  
always reversed.

<!-- uid=860245:9:1 -->

**Rain:** What? Really?

<!-- uid=860245:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's one of the things that  
makes tarot cards so special.

<!-- uid=860245:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's easy to imagine them as  
playing cards, but the direction  
of those don't matter, right?

<!-- uid=860245:12:1 -->

**Rain:** Oh, yeah. Their designs are drawn  
in a way where it doesn't matter  
if the card is upside-down.

<!-- uid=860245:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yup. That's one of the biggest  
differences between playing cards  
and tarot cards.

<!-- uid=860245:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** The direction of a tarot card  
decides its meaning, but these  
are not necessarily opposites.

<!-- uid=860245:15:1 -->

**Leafa:** They have other full meanings.  
For example, a reversed Justice  
casts doubt on your own justice.

<!-- uid=860245:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** Justice is considered one of the  
greatest virtues in a person's  
life. However...

<!-- uid=860245:17:1 -->

**Leafa:** You have to think about whether  
your justice is truly in the  
right.

<!-- uid=860245:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** It's possible to hurt others with  
justice that goes too far.

<!-- uid=860245:19:1 -->

**Leafa:** In other cases, what you might  
believe is justice isn't how  
you truly feel.

<!-- uid=860245:20:1 -->

**Everyone:** ...!

<!-- uid=860245:21:1 -->

**Leafa:** We need to consider this all while  
examining what justice means to  
each of us.

<!-- uid=860245:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...You're amazing, Leafa.

<!-- uid=860245:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah. I can really tell that  
you've been working on your  
fortunetelling skill!

<!-- uid=860245:24:1 -->

**Leafa:** What? O-Oh, no, I'm just...

<!-- uid=860245:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** It really made me feel like you've  
taken your tarot card to heart!

<!-- uid=860245:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** In other words, you've been  
growing as a person yourself as  
you told the fortunes of others!

<!-- uid=860245:27:1 -->


## Story 860247 · \[THE CHARIOT\] Sinon Lv.70

Character Story

**Sinon:** Hey. Sorry to interrupt the  
party, but...

<!-- uid=860247:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** I was just talking to Rain and we  
had a question for Leafa.

<!-- uid=860247:2:1 -->

**Rain:** Yes... Since Leafa knows so much  
about tarot cards, we thought  
you'd be the best person to ask.

<!-- uid=860247:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** Of course, what's up?

<!-- uid=860247:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** I'd be happy to answer any  
questions I can...

<!-- uid=860247:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** Great. We wanted to ask about  
our cards...

<!-- uid=860247:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** In other words, The Chariot and  
Wheel of Fortune.

<!-- uid=860247:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...These seem kinda hard to  
understand, don't they?

<!-- uid=860247:8:1 -->

**Rain:** I just don't get it!

<!-- uid=860247:9:1 -->

**Rain:** Unlike Justice and The World,  
nothing comes to mind when I  
hear "Wheel of Fortune"!

<!-- uid=860247:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** And a Chariot is a plain old  
vehicle! With horses and all!

<!-- uid=860247:11:1 -->

**Leafa:** Oh, um... It doesn't mean a  
literal chariot, you see.

<!-- uid=860247:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** It's not saying you're a carriage  
used in ancient wars by the...  
Um...

<!-- uid=860247:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** The Sumerians? The Hittites?

<!-- uid=860247:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** Oh! Yes, them!  
Thank you!

<!-- uid=860247:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Back when tarot cards were  
invented, they might be examples  
of vehicles used in war.

<!-- uid=860247:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yes, but even then, the Chariot  
has a more symbolic meaning than  
that.

<!-- uid=860247:17:1 -->

**Leafa:** As I explained before, it's saying  
you're someone who can overcome  
hardships and troubles...

<!-- uid=860247:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** And in a cool, tough way at that!

<!-- uid=860247:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** Huh. That's kind of a...hardboiled  
meaning, huh?

<!-- uid=860247:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** But...yes. I guess part of me  
does want to become someone like  
that.

<!-- uid=860247:21:1 -->

**Sinon:** I'll need to be careful, just like  
you, Leafa...

<!-- uid=860247:22:1 -->


## Story 860248 · \[THE CHARIOT\] Sinon Lv.80

Character Story

**Rain:** Hmm. Okay, then what about mine?

<!-- uid=860248:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** Wheel of Fortune is a very  
interesting tarot card!

<!-- uid=860248:2:1 -->

**Rain:** Really? I heard not long ago that  
it basically just means "CHANGE!!"

<!-- uid=860248:3:1 -->

**Rain:** Am I that good at creating change?

<!-- uid=860248:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** To put it as the tarot might,  
things won't necessarily always be  
the way they are today.

<!-- uid=860248:5:1 -->

**Rain:** What?

<!-- uid=860248:6:1 -->

**Leafa:** When Wheel of Fortune appears in  
a reading, it's an omen of change.

<!-- uid=860248:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** Of course, it could either be good  
or bad. Things don't always  
change for the better, after all.

<!-- uid=860248:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** However... A moment of change is  
undeniably awaiting you, Rain.

<!-- uid=860248:9:1 -->

**Rain:** ...!!

<!-- uid=860248:10:1 -->

**Seven:** So does that mean she's taking the  
next step towards her future  
right now?

<!-- uid=860248:11:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...Perhaps. Fortunetellers aren't  
magicians, though. We can only  
guide, I suppose...

<!-- uid=860248:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** I don't really know what's going  
to happen in the future.

<!-- uid=860248:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** That's why I think Rain needs to  
think about her future and take  
action herself.

<!-- uid=860248:14:1 -->

**Rain:** ...I see.

<!-- uid=860248:15:1 -->

**Rain:** You're amazing, Leafa...  
You really are like a full-fledged  
fortuneteller...

<!-- uid=860248:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** I guess today's lesson is that the  
fortunetelling skill has had a  
good influence on Sugu, too.

<!-- uid=860248:17:1 -->

**Leafa:** R-Really...?

<!-- uid=860248:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yep. It's not always bad to let  
your intuition guide you, but it's  
good to see this side of you too.

<!-- uid=860248:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Fortunes can't change the world.  
What's important is how you  
reflect the fortune you're given.

<!-- uid=860248:20:1 -->

## Story 940011 · \[Brawny Axeman\] Agil Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** Hey, Agil.

<!-- uid=940011:1:1 -->

**Agil:** Welcome!  
Oh, hey there, Kirito!

<!-- uid=940011:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** I need to restock my potions.  
Can I get the usual?

<!-- uid=940011:3:1 -->

**Agil:** Coming right up.

<!-- uid=940011:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** How're things with the shop going?

<!-- uid=940011:5:1 -->

**Agil:** Oh, you know... Not terrible.

<!-- uid=940011:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=940011:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Did something happen?

<!-- uid=940011:8:1 -->

**Agil:** Er, well...  
It's nothing, really, but...

<!-- uid=940011:9:1 -->

**Agil:** It seems someone's selling  
items they buy from me  
on the black market.

<!-- uid=940011:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's awful!

<!-- uid=940011:11:1 -->

**Agil:** Well, 'black market' isn't exactly  
right. It's not like what they're  
doing is illegal or anything...

<!-- uid=940011:12:1 -->

**Agil:** It wouldn't be so bad if the items  
were getting to players who  
can't come to the shop, but...

<!-- uid=940011:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** They aren't?

<!-- uid=940011:14:1 -->

**Agil:** I don't know why, but someone  
is definitely buying items here  
and immediately reselling them.

<!-- uid=940011:15:1 -->

**Agil:** And what's more is they're  
totally undercutting me.

<!-- uid=940011:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** But then they aren't making  
any profit!

<!-- uid=940011:17:1 -->

**Agil:** Exactly.

<!-- uid=940011:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Why would they purposefully  
lose money?

<!-- uid=940011:19:1 -->

**Agil:** Beats me.

<!-- uid=940011:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** That is really odd.

<!-- uid=940011:21:1 -->

**Agil:** Yeah. And it's not like it's  
hurting me or anything.

<!-- uid=940011:22:1 -->

**Agil:** I'm not in any sort of trouble,  
but I just have this uneasy  
feeling.

<!-- uid=940011:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** But couldn't it hurt you?  
If they're underselling you,  
won't they steal your customers?

<!-- uid=940011:24:1 -->

**Agil:** It hasn't gotten that bad yet,  
thankfully.

<!-- uid=940011:25:1 -->

**Agil:** But there are items you can only  
buy here that people are getting  
for cheap.

<!-- uid=940011:26:1 -->

**Agil:** That's what one of my regulars  
told me, anyway.

<!-- uid=940011:27:1 -->

**Kirito:** I see...

<!-- uid=940011:28:1 -->

**Agil:** It's nothing you need to worry  
about. Just forget it.

<!-- uid=940011:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** No, this is really shady.  
If I hear any other rumors,  
I'll be sure to let you know.

<!-- uid=940011:30:1 -->

**Agil:** Thanks, that'd be a big help.

<!-- uid=940011:31:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...So that's what's going on.

**Asuna:** then they should definitely be

there must be a criminal, right?

## Story 940015 · \[Brawny Axeman\] Agil Lv.50

Character Story

**Agil:** Back already, Kirito?

...Hahaha, I appreciate your  
concern.

<!-- uid=940015:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** I just-

**Agil:** So, what did you want to ask me?

you about the rumor.

<!-- uid=940015:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** I definitely believe a player, or

is reselling your items.

<!-- uid=940015:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** But we won't know the truth unless

<!-- uid=940015:15:1 -->

<!-- uid=940015:16:1 -->

**Agil:** Huh...

**Kirito:** What is it?

<!-- uid=940015:19:1 -->

**Agil:** Now that I think about it,

**Kirito:** Ah...!

<!-- uid=940015:21:1 -->


## Story 940017 · \[Brawny Axeman\] Agil Lv.70

Character Story

**Kirito:** This must be it.

<!-- uid=940017:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** According to what we were told,

<!-- uid=940017:15:1 -->

**Agil:** They're about to find out what  
happens when you mess with  
an Assault Team player.

<!-- uid=940017:16:1 -->

**Agil:** You with me, Kirito?

<!-- uid=940017:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, I've got your back.

<!-- uid=940017:18:1 -->


## Story 940018 · \[Brawny Axeman\] Agil Lv.80

Character Story

<!-- uid=940018:1:1 -->

about it too.

<!-- uid=940018:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah.

<!-- uid=940018:3:1 -->

<!-- uid=940018:4:1 -->

**Agil:** It takes a special kind of

get found out in the end.

luring my customers away from me.

<!-- uid=940018:7:1 -->

**Agil:** My items ARE the best around,

<!-- uid=940018:8:1 -->

**Agil:** if I do say so myself. Bahaha!

<!-- uid=940018:11:1 -->

**Agil:** It's because all you can do is

<!-- uid=940018:12:1 -->

<!-- uid=940018:13:1 -->

<!-- uid=940018:15:1 -->

<!-- uid=940018:16:1 -->

**Agil:** and as a merchant, I want to do

<!-- uid=940018:18:1 -->

<!-- uid=940018:19:1 -->


## Story 950011 · \[Band Together\] Agil Lv.10

Character Story

**Rain:** Agil!

<!-- uid=950011:1:1 -->

**Agil:** Oh, hey there, Rain. I've got  
tons of goodies on sale today.  
Why not buy a few for the road?

<!-- uid=950011:2:1 -->

**Rain:** I'll pass! I'm not here to shop!  
I'm here to ask you a question.

<!-- uid=950011:3:1 -->

**Agil:** Not buying anything, huh?

<!-- uid=950011:4:1 -->

**Klein:** Heh, watch your wallet there,  
Rain.

<!-- uid=950011:5:1 -->

**Klein:** Agil here's a real fast talker.  
It doesn't matter if you're here  
to buy or not.

<!-- uid=950011:6:1 -->

**Klein:** He'll wheedle you out of your  
purse, your sword, and your house  
in the blink of an eye.

<!-- uid=950011:7:1 -->

**Rain:** Ahaha, thanks for the warning.

<!-- uid=950011:8:1 -->

**Agil:** I let you hang out in my place,  
and this is how you repay me?  
I should charge you rent.

<!-- uid=950011:9:1 -->

**Klein:** Hah! You owe me for all the weird  
junk you made me buy from you  
back in SAO!

<!-- uid=950011:10:1 -->

**Agil:** Junk?! Why I oughta...!

<!-- uid=950011:11:1 -->

**Klein:** You wanna throw down?!  
Bring it on!

<!-- uid=950011:12:1 -->

**Rain:** Excuse me? If you're going to  
fight, can you do it after I've  
asked my question?

<!-- uid=950011:13:1 -->

**Agil:** So that's what you're after...  
Well, it's not a monster drop,  
and you can't mine for it.

<!-- uid=950011:14:1 -->

**Agil:** So if you want to get your hands  
on that material, you'll have to  
craft it.

<!-- uid=950011:15:1 -->

**Rain:** So that's why I can't find it...

<!-- uid=950011:16:1 -->

**Agil:** Hey, you're in luck. I'm after it  
myself. The items we need are the  
reward for a newly added quest.

<!-- uid=950011:17:1 -->

**Agil:** So how about you and me party up  
and give it a go?

<!-- uid=950011:18:1 -->

**Rain:** Sure, I'd love to!  
Do you mind?

<!-- uid=950011:19:1 -->

**Agil:** Not at all. Hey, Klein. You've got  
nothing better to do. Back us up.

<!-- uid=950011:20:1 -->

**Klein:** H-Hey, I resent that!  
I'm popular! I have parties  
to go to! People to see!

<!-- uid=950011:21:1 -->

**Agil:** Right, sure. Have fun with that.

<!-- uid=950011:22:1 -->

**Klein:** HEY! I never said I wasn't coming!

<!-- uid=950011:23:1 -->

**Agil:** Then stop talking and come on.

<!-- uid=950011:24:1 -->


## Story 950013 · \[Band Together\] Agil Lv.30

Character Story

**Rain:** Agil, I'm really impressed by how  
knowledgeable you are about items  
and materials.

<!-- uid=950013:1:1 -->

**Agil:** Really? I wouldn't say I know more  
than most people...

<!-- uid=950013:2:1 -->

**Agil:** I think you're more of an outlier  
than I am. You're a pretty poor  
excuse for a Leprechaun.

<!-- uid=950013:3:1 -->

**Rain:** Ouch... I can't deny that.

<!-- uid=950013:4:1 -->

**Klein:** Agil's been running item shops  
since SAO day one, so he's racked  
up tons of experience with items.

<!-- uid=950013:5:1 -->

**Agil:** Well, you're not wrong...

<!-- uid=950013:6:1 -->

**Rain:** I wasn't very sociable in SAO, so  
I didn't have many opportunities  
to gossip about items.

<!-- uid=950013:7:1 -->

**Rain:** I only really started learning  
about them after I picked a  
Leprechaun here in ALO.

<!-- uid=950013:8:1 -->

**Agil:** I see... Hey, I've got an idea.  
Want to be my apprentice?

<!-- uid=950013:9:1 -->

**Rain:** You'll take me under your wing?!  
Really?!

<!-- uid=950013:10:1 -->

**Agil:** Yeah, sure. You need to know the  
ins and outs of items and mats if  
you want to be a good Leprechaun.

<!-- uid=950013:11:1 -->

**Agil:** You're representing the crafting  
class. There's a lot to learn, but  
I'm happy to share what I can.

<!-- uid=950013:12:1 -->

**Rain:** Oh my gosh! Thank you!

<!-- uid=950013:13:1 -->

**Klein:** Man, Agil, look who's trying to  
act all cool. Rain, don't fall  
for it! It's an act!

<!-- uid=950013:14:1 -->

**Agil:** Yeah, right. Don't put me on the  
same level as you, Klein.

<!-- uid=950013:15:1 -->


## Story 950015 · \[Band Together\] Agil Lv.50

Character Story

**Klein:** You know, I've been thinking...  
We helped Seven out with her Pooka  
stuff the other day, right?

<!-- uid=950015:1:1 -->

**Klein:** Why weren't you there, Rain?

<!-- uid=950015:2:1 -->

**Rain:** Oh yeah, my sister said you guys  
helped her do some testing.

<!-- uid=950015:3:1 -->

**Rain:** I wasn't there because I'm not a  
Pooka, remember? It's not like  
I needed to test song buffs.

<!-- uid=950015:4:1 -->

**Rain:** I could've been Seven's bodyguard,  
but she had already asked you,  
so I sat this one out.

<!-- uid=950015:5:1 -->

**Agil:** Yeah, she told me you were busy.

<!-- uid=950015:6:1 -->

**Klein:** So why aren't you a Pooka, Rain?  
You like singing and stuff, right?

<!-- uid=950015:7:1 -->

**Rain:** I was planning on picking Pooka...

<!-- uid=950015:8:1 -->

**Rain:** But when I found out Seven was a  
Pooka, I changed my mind.

<!-- uid=950015:9:1 -->

**Rain:** There's no way I could compete  
against her, so I decided to  
carve out my own ALO niche.

<!-- uid=950015:10:1 -->

**Rain:** And I've told Kirito this before,  
but back in SAO, an NPC blacksmith  
sort of took me under her wing.

<!-- uid=950015:11:1 -->

**Rain:** So when I was picking my race,  
I thought I'd honor her memory,  
so to speak.

<!-- uid=950015:12:1 -->

**Agil:** What do you mean?

<!-- uid=950015:13:1 -->

**Rain:** Yeah... She got sick, and she...  
She died.

<!-- uid=950015:14:1 -->

**Rain:** It was part of the story. Once her  
apprentice—me—got good enough,  
she was programmed to die.

<!-- uid=950015:15:1 -->

**Rain:** You know, she was around the same  
age as my mom, but they were  
nothing alike...

<!-- uid=950015:16:1 -->

**Rain:** My mom was a really timid person.  
She never stood up for herself.

<!-- uid=950015:17:1 -->

**Rain:** But my master, she was really  
confident and strong...  
I looked up to her.

<!-- uid=950015:18:1 -->

**Agil:** I understand. We all met people  
we cared for in SAO, people who  
changed our lives.

<!-- uid=950015:19:1 -->

**Klein:** Can we PLEASE change the subject  
now? This whole conversation's  
gotten disgustingly sappy.

<!-- uid=950015:20:1 -->

**Agil:** You were the one who brought it  
up in the first place!

<!-- uid=950015:21:1 -->

**Rain:** Hehe, it's okay. The short of the  
matter is, I've dealt with my loss  
in my own way. Now let's move on!

<!-- uid=950015:22:1 -->


## Story 950017 · \[Band Together\] Agil Lv.70

Character Story

**Agil:** So yeah, changing the subject...  
How's your real-life singing  
career shaping up?

<!-- uid=950017:1:1 -->

**Rain:** Not great. I've had a couple of  
auditions so far,

<!-- uid=950017:2:1 -->

**Rain:** but none of them have  
led to anything.

<!-- uid=950017:3:1 -->

**Klein:** Hey, Agil. Smooth, man.  
Smooth.

<!-- uid=950017:4:1 -->

**Agil:** Oh quiet, you! You're one to talk!

<!-- uid=950017:5:1 -->

**Agil:** Oh... Oh yeah!

<!-- uid=950017:6:1 -->

**Rain:** What's up?

<!-- uid=950017:7:1 -->

**Agil:** Why not come sing at my place?  
The cafe's got all the audio  
equipment you need for a concert.

patrons in spontaneous acts of  
karaoke cruelty.

**Klein:** Karaoke? In your place?

**Agil:** You do! Every week!

<!-- uid=950017:11:1 -->

**Klein:** Dude, seriously?!

<!-- uid=950017:12:1 -->

**Rain:** Agil, are you sure about this?  
I don't want to impose...

<!-- uid=950017:13:1 -->

**Agil:** Nah. Put on regular shows, and  
maybe word will start to spread.  
It's worth a shot, right?

<!-- uid=950017:14:1 -->

**Agil:** Besides, most artists don't just  
make a sudden break. You have  
to start small and build up.

<!-- uid=950017:15:1 -->

**Rain:** Agil... Thank you so much!  
I really appreciate it!

<!-- uid=950017:16:1 -->

**Agil:** Glad to have you on board.  
Let's meet up IRL soon and hammer  
out the details.

<!-- uid=950017:17:1 -->

**Rain:** For sure!

<!-- uid=950017:18:1 -->

**Rain:** Hehe, Agil... You know...

<!-- uid=950017:19:1 -->

**Agil:** Yeah? What is it?

<!-- uid=950017:20:1 -->

**Rain:** Hehe, never mind...

<!-- uid=950017:21:1 -->


## Story 950018 · \[Band Together\] Agil Lv.80

**Klein:** Alright! That's the last material

<!-- uid=950018:2:1 -->

**Rain:** But... My father left when I was

what it's like to have a dad...

**Rain:** So when Agil started worrying  
about me, I thought that maybe  
this is what it feels like...

<!-- uid=950018:18:1 -->

**Klein:** O-Oh... Yeah, that makes sense...  
Hey, sorry for laughing just now.  
That wasn't cool.

<!-- uid=950018:20:1 -->

**Yuuki:** It's true that this world and my  
friends saved me.

<!-- uid=960013:11:1 -->

**Oracle:** Whoa...

<!-- uid=960013:12:1 -->

**Yuuki:** If it weren't for them, I don't  
know what would've happened to me.

<!-- uid=960013:13:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Like, I can't let Kirito there  
beat me, and Asuna's basically  
family.

<!-- uid=960013:14:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Leafa and I are besties, and Sinon  
is just SO cool. And such a cutie!

<!-- uid=960013:15:1 -->

**Oracle:** Interesting...

<!-- uid=960013:16:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hey, Oracle? How do you feel about  
all your friends?

<!-- uid=960013:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, I want to know too.

<!-- uid=960013:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** Lay it on us.

<!-- uid=960013:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** You're a closed door. Let us in!

<!-- uid=960013:20:1 -->

**Oracle:** Urgh, merciless! Interrogation  
hell! Fine! U-Uh... If I had to  
compare them to Featherman...

<!-- uid=960013:21:1 -->

**Oracle:** Joker's Red, Skull is Yellow,  
Panther is Pink, and Queen is...  
Also Pink. Noir is...Pink?

<!-- uid=960013:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Back up! I've never seen  
Featherman, but...

<!-- uid=960013:23:1 -->

**Leafa:** Why is everyone pink?!

<!-- uid=960013:24:1 -->

**Oracle:** How to explain... Eh, I guess to  
sum it up, I feel the same as  
Yuuki. My friends are the best!

<!-- uid=960013:25:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Woohoo!

<!-- uid=960013:26:1 -->


## Story 960015 · \[Lightning Emblem\] Skull Lv.50

Character Story

**Kirito:** I've been thinking, we don't know  
each other that well yet. How about  
we share a little about ourselves?

<!-- uid=960015:1:1 -->

**Mona:** We are the great Phantom Thieves!  
We do not reveal our secrets so  
easily.

<!-- uid=960015:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, I'm guessing we're all  
around the same age. You're high  
school students, right?

<!-- uid=960015:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** I think Oracle's a bit younger  
than us.

<!-- uid=960015:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** And none of you have an odd accent,  
so I'm guessing you're Tokyoites.

<!-- uid=960015:5:1 -->

**Yuuki:** They've got a lot of secrets...but  
I think they're nice people.

<!-- uid=960015:6:1 -->

**Skull:** What are you, amateur detectives?!

<!-- uid=960015:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ah, sorry. But I don't think any of  
us can resist a mystery!

<!-- uid=960015:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** We won't pry if you'd rather us  
not. But we'll tell you about  
ourselves, get the ball rolling.

<!-- uid=960015:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Then again, we're just a bunch of  
ordinary students. Well...one  
of us is a bit of a special case.

<!-- uid=960015:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** Asuna's dad's the CEO of a huge  
corporation.

<!-- uid=960015:11:1 -->

**Noir:** Oh! That's pretty tough, huh?

<!-- uid=960015:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Tough... Yeah, you could say that.

<!-- uid=960015:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** A lot is expected of me, and... I'm  
not totally free to choose my own  
life. It's a pain sometimes.

<!-- uid=960015:14:1 -->

**Noir:** Like...your parents won't let  
you pick who you marry?

<!-- uid=960015:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Urk...

<!-- uid=960015:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Nnnrgh...

<!-- uid=960015:17:1 -->

**Noir:** Bingo?

<!-- uid=960015:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** I can't...deny that...

<!-- uid=960015:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** But...what's the deal? Why the  
sudden burst of curiosity?

<!-- uid=960015:20:1 -->

**Noir:** Because I think you and I have  
a lot in common.

<!-- uid=960015:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** We do?

<!-- uid=960015:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wait a sec, Noir! That means...  
You seem so graceful and refined,  
but you're a berserk healer too?!

<!-- uid=960015:23:1 -->

**Noir:** I'm...not sure I follow?

<!-- uid=960015:24:1 -->

**Oracle:** He's calling you crazy violent.

<!-- uid=960015:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito! Why would you mention  
that?!

<!-- uid=960015:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** If they suddenly saw you transform  
from dainty debutante into violent  
killing machine, they'd freak.

<!-- uid=960015:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** Phrasing, Kirito! Come on!

<!-- uid=960015:28:1 -->

**Mona:** Well, in that case, you should know  
that Noir here is the Beauty Thief!

<!-- uid=960015:29:1 -->

**Noir:** M-Mona! D-Don't tell them that!

<!-- uid=960015:30:1 -->

**Oracle:** Beauty and the Berserker...  
Sounds like a movie.

<!-- uid=960015:31:1 -->


## Story 960017 · \[Lightning Emblem\] Skull Lv.70

Character Story

**Leafa:** I had a thought when I saw your  
Persona, Queen. It might just  
help us fight better as a team!

<!-- uid=960017:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Queen's Persona? ...Oh, that!

<!-- uid=960017:2:1 -->

**Skull:** Yeah! She's like a post-apocalyptic  
raider, right?!

<!-- uid=960017:3:1 -->

**Queen:** Do you want to get smacked?

<!-- uid=960017:4:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Ooo, I can see it!  
'Cause she's all spiky!

<!-- uid=960017:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** She reminds me of the wastelands.

<!-- uid=960017:6:1 -->

**Queen:** ...I'll take that as a compliment.

<!-- uid=960017:7:1 -->

**Queen:** Anyway. You said my Persona might  
help us work together. How?

<!-- uid=960017:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Kirito rides a hog like yours  
sometimes too. Sinon knows  
what I'm talking 'bout, right?

<!-- uid=960017:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** Ugh. Yeah. He rode it out to see  
me when he was worried about me  
during that...incident.

<!-- uid=960017:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** Thanks to that, I had to deal with  
all sorts of annoying rumors.

<!-- uid=960017:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Rumors? What sort of rumors?

<!-- uid=960017:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** A normal person wouldn't ride up  
on a motorcycle to pick up just  
a friend.

<!-- uid=960017:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh...  
Did people get the wrong idea?

<!-- uid=960017:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** You think?

<!-- uid=960017:15:1 -->

**Panther:** Hey, so Sinon and Kirito are  
going out, then?

<!-- uid=960017:16:1 -->

**Sinon:** Gah?!

<!-- uid=960017:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** N-No... We're just friends.

<!-- uid=960017:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** E-Exactly! That's exactly right!

<!-- uid=960017:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** Besides, Kirito already married  
Asuna once!

<!-- uid=960017:20:1 -->

**Panther:** Th-They're married?!  
...Wait, what do you  
mean by "once"?

<!-- uid=960017:21:1 -->

**Joker:** ...They got divorced.

<!-- uid=960017:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** N-No! We got married in-game!

<!-- uid=960017:23:1 -->

**Violet:** Which means you're single in real  
life.

<!-- uid=960017:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey, Sinon? Can we choose our  
words more carefully? We'll give  
people the wrong idea.

<!-- uid=960017:25:1 -->

**Sinon:** Right...

<!-- uid=960017:26:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...Sorry, Queen. Looks like  
Leafa's idea didn't pan out after  
all.

<!-- uid=960017:27:1 -->

**Queen:** What a coincidence, Sinon. I was  
just thinking the same thing.

<!-- uid=960017:28:1 -->


## Story 960018 · \[Lightning Emblem\] Skull Lv.80

Character Story

**Joker:** I think it's about time we took  
on that boss again.

<!-- uid=960018:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Agreed. We've gotten to know each  
other much better. We should be  
able to team up and take it out!

<!-- uid=960018:2:1 -->

**Skull:** Gngh! This thing's defenses are  
as strong as ever!

<!-- uid=960018:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Don't worry, we got this!

<!-- uid=960018:4:1 -->

**Queen:** Leave it to me!

<!-- uid=960018:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** Go, Queen! I got your back!

<!-- uid=960018:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hyaaah!

<!-- uid=960018:7:1 -->

**Queen:** Thanks, Sinon!

<!-- uid=960018:8:1 -->

**Oracle:** It dropped its guard! Yuuki!  
Now's your chance!

<!-- uid=960018:9:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Here goes!

<!-- uid=960018:10:1 -->

**Mona:** Nice shot, it felt that! Now, time  
for an all-out team attack!

<!-- uid=960018:12:1 -->

**Noir:** Asuna! Switch!

<!-- uid=960018:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Thanks, Noir!

<!-- uid=960018:14:1 -->

**Oracle:** Nice! Now pass the baton and  
give it the kablammo!

<!-- uid=960018:16:1 -->

**Joker:** Let's do it, Kirito!

<!-- uid=960018:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** I've been waiting for you to  
say that, Joker!

<!-- uid=960018:18:1 -->

**Joker:** It's time to finish this!

<!-- uid=960018:20:1 -->

**Oracle:** Go! Get 'em! All-out attack!

<!-- uid=960018:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's over!

<!-- uid=960018:22:1 -->

**Fox:** Yes! Victory is ours!

<!-- uid=960018:24:1 -->

**Leafa:** That was easier than I expected!

<!-- uid=960018:25:1 -->

**Violet:** Our strategy to chat and learn  
about each other to improve our  
teamwork worked like a charm!

<!-- uid=960018:26:1 -->

**Asuna:** The masks made me a little scared  
of you all at first, but now I'm  
glad you're our friends!

<!-- uid=960018:27:1 -->

**Noir:** Hehe, the same goes for us.  
I still can't believe you tried  
to eat Mona.

<!-- uid=960018:28:1 -->

**Sinon:** You're usually so rational and  
collected, Queen, but you get  
pretty heated in battle.

<!-- uid=960018:29:1 -->

**Queen:** I could say the same about you,  
Sinon.

<!-- uid=960018:30:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hey, Oracle! Our teamwork's  
beyond perfect, don't you think?

<!-- uid=960018:31:1 -->

**Oracle:** I think I finally understand what  
Inari was talking about. A  
sympathetic heart goes a long way!

<!-- uid=960018:32:1 -->

**Joker:** We're counting on you in the  
battles ahead too.

<!-- uid=960018:33:1 -->

**Kirito:** Right back at you.

<!-- uid=960018:34:1 -->

**Kirito:** Now... Let's get back to the game!

<!-- uid=960018:35:1 -->


## Story 1040011 · \[Mace Master\] Lisbeth Lv.10

Character Story

**Liz:** Alright, world, say hello  
to Lisbeth's Smithy!

<!-- uid=1040011:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...

<!-- uid=1040011:2:1 -->

**Liz:** Welcome, welcome!

<!-- uid=1040011:3:1 -->

**Liz:** Oh-Hey, Asuna!  
What's up?

<!-- uid=1040011:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hi, Liz. I need a favor...

<!-- uid=1040011:5:1 -->

**Liz:** What is it?

<!-- uid=1040011:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Um...

<!-- uid=1040011:7:1 -->

**Liz:** What's with the face?  
Go on, spit it out!

<!-- uid=1040011:8:1 -->

**Liz:** Where's the fearless vice  
commander we all know and  
love, hm?

<!-- uid=1040011:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** W-Well, you see...  
My armor's been damaged, and  
I was hoping you could fix it...

<!-- uid=1040011:10:1 -->

**Liz:** You got it.  
Let me take a look!

<!-- uid=1040011:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hold on one second.  
I need to take it out of my  
inventory.

<!-- uid=1040011:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** H-Here it is.

<!-- uid=1040011:13:1 -->

**Liz:** It's pretty lightweight.

<!-- uid=1040011:14:1 -->

**Liz:** Huh.  
It's kind of...  
well, spartan.

<!-- uid=1040011:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ehehe...

<!-- uid=1040011:16:1 -->

**Liz:** Let's see here...  
Yeah, it's pretty beat up.

<!-- uid=1040011:17:1 -->

**Liz:** It's just barely this side of  
functional, so in theory, I should  
be able to fix it...

<!-- uid=1040011:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** Really?  
Oh, that's such a relief!

<!-- uid=1040011:19:1 -->

**Liz:** Buuuuut...

<!-- uid=1040011:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** What? What's wrong?

<!-- uid=1040011:21:1 -->

**Liz:** With the shape this is in, I'm  
going to need some special  
crafting ore.

<!-- uid=1040011:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** What kind of ore?

<!-- uid=1040011:23:1 -->

**Liz:** Why?  
You thinking of going to get it?

<!-- uid=1040011:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** Of course!

<!-- uid=1040011:25:1 -->

**Liz:** Mining it is no easy task, y'know?  
Maybe you should take some Knights  
of the Blood Oath with you.

<!-- uid=1040011:26:1 -->

**Asuna:** N-No, I'm going to go by myself.

<!-- uid=1040011:27:1 -->

**Liz:** Are you serious?  
Why?!

<!-- uid=1040011:28:1 -->

**Asuna:** I...  
I just have to do this alone.

<!-- uid=1040011:29:1 -->

**Liz:** Because "reasons," right?  
Alright then, I'm coming with you.

<!-- uid=1040011:30:1 -->

**Asuna:** What?!  
No, you can't!

<!-- uid=1040011:31:1 -->

**Liz:** What are you talking about? There's  
no way I'm gonna let my best friend  
wander off into danger by herself!

<!-- uid=1040011:32:1 -->

**Liz:** Come on, I'll lead the way.  
Better get ready!

<!-- uid=1040011:33:1 -->

**Asuna:** A-Alright...  
Thanks, Liz.

<!-- uid=1040011:34:1 -->


## Story 1040013 · \[Mace Master\] Lisbeth Lv.30

Character Story

**Liz:** \*sigh\*...

<!-- uid=1040013:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** What's wrong, Liz?

<!-- uid=1040013:2:1 -->

**Liz:** Asuna,  
you really are amazing,  
you know that?

<!-- uid=1040013:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Huh? Where's this coming from  
all of a sudden?

<!-- uid=1040013:4:1 -->

**Liz:** You're just such a sweet person,  
I thought I had to look out for  
you, like a big sister would...

<!-- uid=1040013:5:1 -->

**Liz:** I should have known elite players  
were a cut above the rest.

<!-- uid=1040013:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** What?  
That's not true...

<!-- uid=1040013:7:1 -->

**Liz:** I used to think that  
I was a pretty decent fighter,  
but now...

<!-- uid=1040013:8:1 -->

**Liz:** Now I realize my skill and resolve  
is nothing compared to the players  
putting their lives on the line.

<!-- uid=1040013:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...

<!-- uid=1040013:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Even if you do think of me that  
way, that doesn't mean I'm  
"amazing" or anything.

<!-- uid=1040013:11:1 -->

**Liz:** Asuna...?

<!-- uid=1040013:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's the people who have  
fought with me this far  
who are really amazing.

<!-- uid=1040013:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** When I first got trapped in SAO,  
I didn't know a single thing  
about VRMMOs.

<!-- uid=1040013:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** I was just a clueless child.

<!-- uid=1040013:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** But there were people who taught  
me what I needed to know to fight,  
to survive in this world.

<!-- uid=1040013:16:1 -->

**Liz:** Asuna...

<!-- uid=1040013:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Some of those people  
didn't make it...

<!-- uid=1040013:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's why I keep fighting.  
So their deaths won't have been  
in vain.

<!-- uid=1040013:19:1 -->

**Liz:** I see...

<!-- uid=1040013:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ah-I'm sorry,  
that was kind of a sad thing  
to bring up...

<!-- uid=1040013:21:1 -->

**Liz:** Don't worry about it. I feel like  
I understand where your strength  
comes from a little better now.

<!-- uid=1040013:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** Huh?

<!-- uid=1040013:23:1 -->

**Liz:** I mean, you're a really high-level,  
and your skill and experience  
are way beyond mine...

<!-- uid=1040013:24:1 -->

**Liz:** But that strength  
comes from your heart.

<!-- uid=1040013:25:1 -->

**Liz:** It's because you have such intense  
willpower that you're able  
to grow so strong.

<!-- uid=1040013:26:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ehehe... I'm not nearly as  
impressive as you think.

<!-- uid=1040013:27:1 -->

**Liz:** Of course you are!  
Have a little more faith in  
yourself, Vice Commander!

<!-- uid=1040013:28:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, stop already!

<!-- uid=1040013:29:1 -->


## Story 1040015 · \[Mace Master\] Lisbeth Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** Liz...?  
What is it?

<!-- uid=1040015:1:1 -->

**Liz:** Ah, sorry! Asuna, can you hold  
on one second?

<!-- uid=1040015:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** What's the matter? Are you tired?

<!-- uid=1040015:3:1 -->

**Liz:** Nope,  
I just spotted some rare ore!

<!-- uid=1040015:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Really? What kind?

<!-- uid=1040015:5:1 -->

**Liz:** The kind that costs  
an arm and a leg!

<!-- uid=1040015:6:1 -->

**Liz:** It's really resistant, so you can  
use it to make buffed armor! But  
it's so pricey hardly anyone does.

<!-- uid=1040015:7:1 -->

**Liz:** I had no idea you  
could mine it here, though!

<!-- uid=1040015:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Really...?

<!-- uid=1040015:9:1 -->

**Liz:** If people knew  
you could find it here,

<!-- uid=1040015:10:1 -->

**Liz:** I bet its price would plummet!

<!-- uid=1040015:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** But resources are limited, right?

<!-- uid=1040015:12:1 -->

**Liz:** They are, but I bet this would get  
enough supply into circulation  
to help balance demand!

<!-- uid=1040015:13:1 -->

**Liz:** And if this makes high-quality  
armor more readily available,

<!-- uid=1040015:14:1 -->

**Liz:** fewer people will be  
at risk of dying, right?

<!-- uid=1040015:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...

<!-- uid=1040015:16:1 -->

**Liz:** I gotta tell this to the info  
broker as soon as we get back!

<!-- uid=1040015:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Liz...

<!-- uid=1040015:18:1 -->

**Liz:** What is it? You have that  
look on your face again...

<!-- uid=1040015:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** You said I'm strong, but...  
I don't think that's right at all.

<!-- uid=1040015:20:1 -->

**Liz:** Wh-What do you mean?

<!-- uid=1040015:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's thanks to hard-working people  
like you that the Assault Team  
is able to keep fighting.

<!-- uid=1040015:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's thanks to the support  
of people like you

<!-- uid=1040015:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** that we're able to clear each  
floor... I feel like I should've  
realized that a long time ago.

<!-- uid=1040015:24:1 -->

**Liz:** Asuna...

<!-- uid=1040015:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** Thank you for everything  
you've done, Liz.  
And for everything you will do.

<!-- uid=1040015:26:1 -->

**Liz:** I-I don't do it for the thanks!

<!-- uid=1040015:27:1 -->

**Liz:** Ehehehe... Don't think buttering  
me up like that will get you  
a discount or anything!

<!-- uid=1040015:28:1 -->

**Asuna:** I wouldn't dream of it.

<!-- uid=1040015:29:1 -->


## Story 1040017 · \[Mace Master\] Lisbeth Lv.70

Character Story

**Liz:** Alright, well, just a little  
farther and we'll be there!

<!-- uid=1040017:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sure.

<!-- uid=1040017:2:1 -->

**Liz:** Don't let your guard down, Asuna.  
The mobs around here are tough.

<!-- uid=1040017:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** R-Right.

<!-- uid=1040017:4:1 -->

**Liz:** We're so close to fixing that  
armor! Hang in there!

<!-- uid=1040017:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Got it.

<!-- uid=1040017:6:1 -->

**Liz:** We have to make sure it gets  
back to Kirito safe and sound!

<!-- uid=1040017:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** S-Sure... Wait-

<!-- uid=1040017:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Huh?!

<!-- uid=1040017:9:1 -->

**Liz:** Hehehe!

<!-- uid=1040017:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** But, Liz-  
How-?!  
How long have you known?!

<!-- uid=1040017:11:1 -->

**Liz:** Oh, y'know, just from the get-go.

<!-- uid=1040017:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Th-Then why didn't you say  
anything?!

<!-- uid=1040017:13:1 -->

**Liz:** Hehe, you're beet red!  
You're so cute when you blush!

<!-- uid=1040017:14:1 -->

**Liz:** Anyway, I knew that armor wasn't  
right for the vice commander of  
the Knights of the Blood Oath.

<!-- uid=1040017:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** S-So...you've seen Kirito  
wearing that armor before?!

<!-- uid=1040017:16:1 -->

**Liz:** Nope.

<!-- uid=1040017:17:1 -->

**Liz:** When you came to me with  
that flustered look on your face,

<!-- uid=1040017:18:1 -->

**Liz:** I just knew it had to be for him.

<!-- uid=1040017:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...\*sigh\*  
You saw right through me, huh?

<!-- uid=1040017:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito hardly ever  
equips that armor...

<!-- uid=1040017:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** But when it was damaged,  
Kirito had said it was special.  
He looked so down about it.

<!-- uid=1040017:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** Then I told him to give it to me,  
and he did.

<!-- uid=1040017:23:1 -->

**Liz:** So you pretended you wanted it,  
but really you were going to  
fix it for him...

<!-- uid=1040017:24:1 -->

**Liz:** Oh-em-gee, Asuna,  
could you be any more adorable?!

<!-- uid=1040017:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** See, I knew you'd tease me!  
That's why I didn't say anything  
in the first place!

<!-- uid=1040017:26:1 -->

**Liz:** Hehehe.

<!-- uid=1040017:27:1 -->

**Liz:** Now that I know,  
I'm never going to let you  
live it down!

<!-- uid=1040017:28:1 -->

**Asuna:** L-Liz!

<!-- uid=1040017:29:1 -->

**Liz:** Ahaha!

<!-- uid=1040017:30:1 -->

**Liz:** Well, we're almost finished,  
so hang in there!  
For his sake!

<!-- uid=1040017:31:1 -->

**Asuna:** Y-Yeah!

<!-- uid=1040017:32:1 -->


## Story 1040018 · \[Mace Master\] Lisbeth Lv.80

Character Story

**Asuna:** We did it!

<!-- uid=1040018:1:1 -->

**Liz:** Now we've got everything we need!

<!-- uid=1040018:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Great! Thanks! I couldn't have  
done it without you, Liz.

<!-- uid=1040018:3:1 -->

**Liz:** Don't thank me just yet.

<!-- uid=1040018:4:1 -->

**Liz:** We still gotta fight our way back.  
And just 'cause I'm a blacksmith  
doesn't mean I'm perfect.

<!-- uid=1040018:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** What?!  
Are you saying you might  
make a mistake?!

<!-- uid=1040018:6:1 -->

**Liz:** Don't look at me like I just said  
there's no such thing as Santa!  
I'm not trying to be mean.

<!-- uid=1040018:7:1 -->

**Liz:** Don't worry.  
In all likelihood, it'll go fine.

<!-- uid=1040018:8:1 -->
