<!-- uid=1040131:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Still, making all of this had to  
take a fair amount of work!

<!-- uid=1040131:4:1 -->

**Rechka:** Hah! I have a shop in the real  
world, dear. This is nothing.

<!-- uid=1040131:5:1 -->

**Rechka:** I can still put my professional  
skills to work here just as well.

<!-- uid=1040131:6:1 -->

**Leafa:** Well, I'll dig in if no one else  
will!

<!-- uid=1040131:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey, Sug-er, Leafa!  
Don't be rude!

<!-- uid=1040131:8:1 -->

**Rechka:** Hahaha, she's fine!  
Please, enjoy yourselves.

<!-- uid=1040131:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sorry to come barging in here with  
all these hungry mouths. I hope  
we're not too much trouble.

<!-- uid=1040131:10:1 -->

**Rechka:** Oh, don't be silly! I invited you!

<!-- uid=1040131:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Thanks so much, Rechka!

<!-- uid=1040131:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'd love to try your cooking in  
the real world someday.

<!-- uid=1040131:13:1 -->

**Rechka:** Stop by anytime you like.

<!-- uid=1040131:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** You didn't have a shop while you  
were in SAO, did you?

<!-- uid=1040131:15:1 -->

**Rechka:** No, I didn't.

<!-- uid=1040131:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** What made you decide to open one  
after you got out?

<!-- uid=1040131:17:1 -->

**Rechka:** Well, meeting Asuna certainly  
inspired me, but that's not the  
whole story.

<!-- uid=1040131:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** Would you mind sharing the whole  
story with us?

<!-- uid=1040131:19:1 -->

**Rechka:** I'd be glad to.

<!-- uid=1040131:20:1 -->


## Story 1040133 · \[Queen of chef\] Rechka Lv.30

Character Story

**Rechka:** Well, I haven't been here in a  
while...

<!-- uid=1040133:1:1 -->

**Rechka:** It seems...emptier than I recall.  
Where is everyone?

<!-- uid=1040133:2:1 -->

**Rechka:** Now now, Rechka. Focus.  
You've got shopping to do!

<!-- uid=1040133:3:1 -->

**???:** Pardon me...

<!-- uid=1040133:4:1 -->

**Rechka:** Hm? What do you want?

<!-- uid=1040133:5:1 -->

**???:** You haven't seen a child of about  
ten years old running around  
here, have you?

<!-- uid=1040133:6:1 -->

**Rechka:** A child? No...  
Say, you're a player, aren't you?

<!-- uid=1040133:7:1 -->

**Rechka:** Is this child also a player?

<!-- uid=1040133:8:1 -->

**???:** Oh, um, yes. We're both players.

<!-- uid=1040133:9:1 -->

**Rechka:** There are small children in a  
place like this...?

<!-- uid=1040133:10:1 -->

**???:** Yes, there are a number of  
children who dived in for one  
reason or another.

<!-- uid=1040133:11:1 -->

**???:** I'm doing my best to gather them  
into the nearby church for  
protection.

<!-- uid=1040133:12:1 -->

**Rechka:** That's no small feat. I've heard  
about your efforts, believe it  
or not.

<!-- uid=1040133:13:1 -->

**Rechka:** Kind souls like yours don't  
readily adapt to places like this.  
It must be hard on you.

<!-- uid=1040133:14:1 -->

**???:** Ah, no, it's not so bad...

<!-- uid=1040133:15:1 -->

**Rechka:** I was sent here to help you.  
I can feel it. I am at your  
service.

<!-- uid=1040133:16:1 -->

**???:** Th-Thank you so, so much!  
I know we've only just met, but I  
am so glad to hear you say that.

<!-- uid=1040133:17:1 -->

**Rechka:** The name's Rechka. And you are?

<!-- uid=1040133:18:1 -->

**Sasha:** Sasha.

<!-- uid=1040133:19:1 -->


## Story 1040135 · \[Queen of chef\] Rechka Lv.50

Character Story

**Kirito:** Wait, Sasha?

<!-- uid=1040135:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** The same Sasha that we met when we  
were with Yui? She wears glasses,  
right?

<!-- uid=1040135:2:1 -->

**Rechka:** Oh, so you two know her!  
What a small world.

<!-- uid=1040135:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Indeed!

<!-- uid=1040135:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** It sounds like you met her before  
we did, though.

<!-- uid=1040135:5:1 -->

**Rechka:** I think you're right. It'd been  
about a year and a half or so  
when I met her.

<!-- uid=1040135:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Did you find the missing child?

<!-- uid=1040135:7:1 -->

**Rechka:** Yeah, and in almost no time too,  
once we both started searching  
the town.

<!-- uid=1040135:8:1 -->

**Rechka:** The poor babe got lost and  
couldn't find the way back to  
the church.

<!-- uid=1040135:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm not surprised.  
The town was pretty large.

<!-- uid=1040135:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah. I'm glad that ended well.

<!-- uid=1040135:11:1 -->

**Rechka:** There were two of them, actually.  
And there were nearly twenty  
in the church when I arrived.

<!-- uid=1040135:12:1 -->

**Rechka:** Sasha had kept their spirits up,

<!-- uid=1040135:13:1 -->

**Rechka:** though I couldn't help but feel  
that everyone was just trying to  
hide their fear and unease...

<!-- uid=1040135:14:1 -->

**Rechka:** I was put in charge of cooking  
for the children.

<!-- uid=1040135:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's great!

<!-- uid=1040135:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha, the kids must have loved  
your cooking.

<!-- uid=1040135:17:1 -->

**Rechka:** That they did.

<!-- uid=1040135:18:1 -->

**Rechka:** And the smiles on their faces  
lifted me up, as well.

<!-- uid=1040135:19:1 -->

**Rechka:** There's nothing quite like seeing  
the joy on someone's face after  
you've served them a meal.

<!-- uid=1040135:20:1 -->

**Rechka:** Especially children's faces.  
Their smiles are magical.

<!-- uid=1040135:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, you don't see many of them  
here in VR.

<!-- uid=1040135:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Very true.

<!-- uid=1040135:23:1 -->

**Rechka:** Anyway, I talked to Sasha after  
we finished eating.

<!-- uid=1040135:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh?

<!-- uid=1040135:25:1 -->


## Story 1040137 · \[Queen of chef\] Rechka Lv.70

Character Story

**Child:** Thank you, Ms. Rechka!  
That was yummy!

<!-- uid=1040137:1:1 -->

**Child:** Thank you, Ms. Rechka!  
What a nice old lady!

<!-- uid=1040137:2:1 -->

**Rechka:** Hey! I'm still in my twenties!  
I'm not THAT old!

<!-- uid=1040137:3:1 -->

**Child:** Twenties! She-she's twenties!

<!-- uid=1040137:4:1 -->

**Child:** That's so many!  
I don't EVER want to be twenties!

<!-- uid=1040137:5:1 -->

**Sasha:** Sorry about that, Rechka.

<!-- uid=1040137:6:1 -->

**Sasha:** Hey! I told you to cut that out!

<!-- uid=1040137:7:1 -->

**Rechka:** Ha ha, don't worry about it,  
Sasha. I love their innocent  
little faces too much to be hurt.

<!-- uid=1040137:8:1 -->

**Sasha:** Me too. This is the first time  
I've ever seen them smile like  
this.

<!-- uid=1040137:9:1 -->

**Sasha:** They're so honest. If they eat  
something tasty, you can see  
it on their faces.

<!-- uid=1040137:10:1 -->

**Rechka:** Sasha...?

<!-- uid=1040137:11:1 -->

**Sasha:** You seem to be quite powerful,  
Rechka.

<!-- uid=1040137:12:1 -->

**Sasha:** You're not part of the Assault  
Team, are you?

<!-- uid=1040137:13:1 -->

**Rechka:** No, I'm not. Why?

<!-- uid=1040137:14:1 -->

**Sasha:** Would you mind staying on to look  
after the children?

<!-- uid=1040137:15:1 -->

**Rechka:** Really? I...

<!-- uid=1040137:16:1 -->

**Sasha:** The children love your cooking,

<!-- uid=1040137:17:1 -->

**Sasha:** and they've really taken to you  
in a such a short period of time.

<!-- uid=1040137:18:1 -->

**Rechka:** ...

<!-- uid=1040137:19:1 -->


## Story 1040138 · \[Queen of chef\] Rechka Lv.80

Character Story

**Rechka:** I'm terribly sorry, but I can't  
do that.

<!-- uid=1040138:1:1 -->

**Sasha:** But...!

<!-- uid=1040138:2:1 -->

**Rechka:** Don't get me wrong. I would love  
to ride out this death game with  
all of you.

<!-- uid=1040138:3:1 -->

**Rechka:** Looking at the children's faces  
has really shown me the true power  
of providing a meal for someone.

<!-- uid=1040138:4:1 -->

**Rechka:** I want to spread that joy to as  
many people as possible.  
I'm done looking back.

<!-- uid=1040138:5:1 -->

**Rechka:** Food will move me forward!

<!-- uid=1040138:6:1 -->

**Sasha:** Um...?

<!-- uid=1040138:7:1 -->

**Rechka:** Ha ha! Sorry, I've confused you,  
haven't I?

<!-- uid=1040138:8:1 -->

**Sasha:** No, it's just... Well...

<!-- uid=1040138:9:1 -->

**Rechka:** All I mean to say is that I want  
to cook for as many people

<!-- uid=1040138:10:1 -->

**Rechka:** as I can until this death game  
is over, and I can't do that if  
I stay here.

<!-- uid=1040138:11:1 -->

**Sasha:** Ah, I see. I'm sorry to have held  
you up on your journey.

<!-- uid=1040138:12:1 -->

**Rechka:** Oh, no, it's not like that.  
I'm glad you understand, though.

<!-- uid=1040138:13:1 -->

**Sasha:** But with skills like yours, surely  
you could open a restaurant  
here in SAO or something?

<!-- uid=1040138:14:1 -->

**Rechka:** You know, I've thought about that.

<!-- uid=1040138:15:1 -->

**Rechka:** But I think I want my flagship  
location to exist in the real  
world.

<!-- uid=1040138:16:1 -->

**Sasha:** Ah, I see. Maybe that's for the  
best.

<!-- uid=1040138:17:1 -->

**Sasha:** That'll give you reason enough to  
survive.

<!-- uid=1040138:18:1 -->

**Rechka:** Precisely. So if we ever get to  
log out of here, I expect to see you  
all at my shop!

<!-- uid=1040138:19:1 -->

**Sasha:** Absolutely!

<!-- uid=1040138:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Wow...

<!-- uid=1040138:21:1 -->

**Rechka:** Meeting you and Sasha gave me the  
kick in the pants I needed to  
start my own business.

<!-- uid=1040138:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** So what will you do now that your  
shop is open?

<!-- uid=1040138:23:1 -->

**Rechka:** Good question. I think I'd like to  
do something I never got around  
to in SAO.

<!-- uid=1040138:24:1 -->

**Rechka:** I want to open a branch of my shop  
in VR.

<!-- uid=1040138:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ooh, that's so exciting! Let me  
know if there's anything I can  
do to help!

<!-- uid=1040138:26:1 -->

**Rechka:** Ha ha, thanks. I figure it'll be  
easier to open a store in VR than  
it is in real life,

<!-- uid=1040138:27:1 -->

**Rechka:** so I might go it alone for now.

<!-- uid=1040138:28:1 -->

**Kirito:** I know it'll be your second store,  
but you might think about changing  
the name anyway.

<!-- uid=1040138:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** It might break peoples' immersion  
if your store has the same name  
in the real world and VR.

<!-- uid=1040138:30:1 -->

**Kirito:** Though it'd be good for brand  
recognition, so...

<!-- uid=1040138:31:1 -->

**Rechka:** Ha ha, yes, that's something I'll  
have to consider. Thank you.

<!-- uid=1040138:32:1 -->


## Story 1040161 · \[Dark Dancer\] Lisbeth Lv.10

Character Story

**Liz:** Welcome!

<!-- uid=1040161:1:1 -->

**Agil:** Yo.

<!-- uid=1040161:2:1 -->

**Liz:** Oh, hey, Agil!

<!-- uid=1040161:3:1 -->

**Agil:** How've things been lately?

<!-- uid=1040161:4:1 -->

**Liz:** Pretty busy, with all the people  
asking me to make them the items  
from that new collab quest.

<!-- uid=1040161:5:1 -->

**Liz:** Some are thoughtful enough to give  
me the materials, but then some  
forget I need the instructions...

<!-- uid=1040161:6:1 -->

**Liz:** Then I have to go out and look for  
them on my own. Makes me feel like  
a chicken with its head cut off.

<!-- uid=1040161:7:1 -->

**Agil:** Yeah, sounds crazy. You get anyone  
bringing you the wrong materials  
at all?

<!-- uid=1040161:8:1 -->

**Liz:** Oh, totally. All the time.

<!-- uid=1040161:9:1 -->

**Agil:** What do you do when that happens?  
If you got anything you don't  
need, I'll buy it off you.

<!-- uid=1040161:10:1 -->

**Liz:** ...

<!-- uid=1040161:11:1 -->

**Agil:** H-Hey now, what's that suspicious  
stare for?

<!-- uid=1040161:12:1 -->

**Liz:** That kind of offer just sounds  
fishy to me, is all...

<!-- uid=1040161:13:1 -->

**Agil:** Wh-What? Like I'd try to con you!  
I bet Kirito's been flapping his  
trap again about back in SAO!

<!-- uid=1040161:14:1 -->

**Agil:** You can't believe anything he told  
you! He blows everything WAY out  
of proportion!

<!-- uid=1040161:15:1 -->

**Liz:** Hehe, I was kiddiiing. I am kind  
of stockpiling spare materials,  
though.

<!-- uid=1040161:16:1 -->

**Liz:** I mean, you never know when you  
might need them. Especially ore.

<!-- uid=1040161:17:1 -->

**Liz:** That's why whenever I get a chance  
to buy them for cheap, I take it.

<!-- uid=1040161:18:1 -->

**Agil:** Ahh, gotcha. Well, you know where  
to find me if you ever feel like  
selling any of your reserves.

<!-- uid=1040161:19:1 -->

**Liz:** Sure thing.

<!-- uid=1040161:20:1 -->

**Agil:** Hey, I don't suppose you've been  
able to make one of those new  
items for yourself, huh?

<!-- uid=1040161:21:1 -->

**Liz:** What do you mean?

<!-- uid=1040161:22:1 -->

**Agil:** You've been too busy to go on  
quests, but you've been collecting  
plenty of spare materials, right?

<!-- uid=1040161:23:1 -->

**Agil:** Being a blacksmith puts you in a  
good position to skip questing and  
simply make whatever you want.

<!-- uid=1040161:24:1 -->

**Liz:** Oh, uh... I guess...

<!-- uid=1040161:25:1 -->


## Story 1040163 · \[Dark Dancer\] Lisbeth Lv.30

Character Story

**Philia:** Really? Agil said that?

<!-- uid=1040163:1:1 -->

**Liz:** Yeah. I took stock of what I had...

<!-- uid=1040163:2:1 -->

**Liz:** and it turns out I have enough to  
make one of the new items. One  
called Kunoichi.

<!-- uid=1040163:3:1 -->

**Philia:** Ooh, I've heard of that! It buffs  
your hiding ability!

<!-- uid=1040163:4:1 -->

**Philia:** It requires a whole lot of  
rare materials,

<!-- uid=1040163:5:1 -->

**Philia:** but I'm not surprised a superstar  
blacksmith like you was able to  
get them all no sweat!

<!-- uid=1040163:6:1 -->

**Liz:** Hehe, thanks.

<!-- uid=1040163:7:1 -->

**Philia:** So what are you gonna do?  
You gonna make it?

<!-- uid=1040163:8:1 -->

**Liz:** Well, I thought about it a lot...  
And I decided not to.

<!-- uid=1040163:9:1 -->

**Philia:** What? But why?! It'd be a waste  
not to!

<!-- uid=1040163:10:1 -->

**Liz:** I mean, that kind of item would  
be way better suited to someone  
like you.

<!-- uid=1040163:11:1 -->

**Liz:** Someone who's always hunting for  
treasure in places crawling with  
super strong monsters...

<!-- uid=1040163:12:1 -->

**Liz:** Or someone who could put it to  
use in battle like Kirito or Asuna  
or Leafa...

<!-- uid=1040163:13:1 -->

**Liz:** Hehe, the only thing that'd be a  
waste would be me using the  
Kunoichi instead of one of you.

<!-- uid=1040163:14:1 -->

**Philia:** But...

<!-- uid=1040163:15:1 -->

**Liz:** Oh! I could totally make it for  
you, Philia! You'd really put it  
to good use.

<!-- uid=1040163:16:1 -->

**Liz:** Of course I'd still have to charge  
you for it, but I'd give you a  
good discount!

<!-- uid=1040163:17:1 -->

**Philia:** Um... Well...

<!-- uid=1040163:18:1 -->

**Philia:** It's not that I don't want it,  
but...I think I'll pass this time.

<!-- uid=1040163:19:1 -->

**Liz:** Huh? Why? Are you low on Yuld?

<!-- uid=1040163:20:1 -->

**Philia:** Uh... Not exactly...

<!-- uid=1040163:21:1 -->

**Liz:** Then what is it?

<!-- uid=1040163:22:1 -->


## Story 1040165 · \[Dark Dancer\] Lisbeth Lv.50

Character Story

**Liz:** ...

<!-- uid=1040165:1:1 -->

**Liz:** I wonder what it was Philia  
was holding back from me...

<!-- uid=1040165:2:1 -->

**???:** Heya!

<!-- uid=1040165:3:1 -->

**Liz:** Ah, hey Rain! Come on in!

<!-- uid=1040165:4:1 -->

**Rain:** Hehe, look what I got, Liz!

<!-- uid=1040165:5:1 -->

**Rain:** Ta-da! The luck-buffing,  
Leprechaun-only Volundr's Ring!

<!-- uid=1040165:6:1 -->

**Liz:** Whoa! That's awesome! I can't  
believe you finally got it!

<!-- uid=1040165:7:1 -->

**Liz:** What I wouldn't give to have one  
too...

<!-- uid=1040165:8:1 -->

**Rain:** Hehehe, it's nice, isn't it? And  
it doesn't just increase your  
skill success rate in battle.

<!-- uid=1040165:9:1 -->

**Rain:** It also increases your dodge rate  
and smith success rate too! It's  
an all-in-one lucky charm!

<!-- uid=1040165:10:1 -->

**Liz:** I know! Where did you even find  
it, Rain?

<!-- uid=1040165:11:1 -->

**Rain:** The ruins of an ancient temple in  
a valley in the southern region of  
the Leprechaun's territory.

<!-- uid=1040165:12:1 -->

**Liz:** Seriously? That place is swarming  
with Evil Deities!

<!-- uid=1040165:13:1 -->

**Rain:** Yep. Not to mention you can't get  
it unless you go solo.

<!-- uid=1040165:14:1 -->

**Liz:** Wow, you are seriously  
impressive...

<!-- uid=1040165:15:1 -->

**Rain:** Hahaha, my specialty is hiding,  
remember?

<!-- uid=1040165:16:1 -->

**Rain:** I could never have fought my way  
through solo, so I just snuck past  
all the mobs.

<!-- uid=1040165:17:1 -->

**Liz:** What!

<!-- uid=1040165:18:1 -->

**Rain:** Wh-What is it, Liz?

<!-- uid=1040165:19:1 -->

**Liz:** N-Nothing...

<!-- uid=1040165:20:1 -->

**Rain:** Um... Hey, how about I give this  
to you?

<!-- uid=1040165:21:1 -->

**Liz:** Huh? Why would you do that?

<!-- uid=1040165:22:1 -->

**Rain:** Well, I can tell you really  
want it...

<!-- uid=1040165:23:1 -->

**Rain:** Plus I can always go back and  
get another one for myself.

<!-- uid=1040165:24:1 -->

**Liz:** B-But you worked really hard  
for this...

<!-- uid=1040165:25:1 -->

**Rain:** I guess it was kind of miraculous  
I even managed to get one... But  
I did it once! I can do it again!

<!-- uid=1040165:26:1 -->

**Liz:** Rain...

<!-- uid=1040165:27:1 -->


## Story 1040167 · \[Dark Dancer\] Lisbeth Lv.70

Character Story

**Liz:** That's really sweet of you...

<!-- uid=1040167:1:1 -->

**Liz:** But I can't take it. You earned  
it, you keep it.

<!-- uid=1040167:2:1 -->

**Rain:** Huh...?

<!-- uid=1040167:3:1 -->

**Liz:** I'm going to get my own on my  
own merit.

<!-- uid=1040167:4:1 -->

**Rain:** D-Did you hear the part where  
I said how hard it was?!

<!-- uid=1040167:5:1 -->

**Liz:** Hehe, yes, you made it very clear.  
I know I'm not a trained fighter  
like you or Kirito,

<!-- uid=1040167:6:1 -->

**Liz:** and I'm not a clever treasure  
hunter like Philia either...

<!-- uid=1040167:7:1 -->

**Liz:** But I'll never be able to stand on  
my own two feet if I keep leaning  
on the rest of you for support.

<!-- uid=1040167:8:1 -->

**Liz:** Oh... That must have been what  
Philia was trying to get at...  
She must have known...

<!-- uid=1040167:9:1 -->

**Rain:** Huh?

<!-- uid=1040167:10:1 -->

**Liz:** You know that Kunoichi everyone's  
talking about? Well, I have enough  
materials to make one.

<!-- uid=1040167:11:1 -->

**Rain:** That's the item that makes you  
really good at hiding, right?

<!-- uid=1040167:12:1 -->

**Liz:** Yep! So I'm gonna equip it and  
see if I can't sneak my way  
into that temple too!

<!-- uid=1040167:13:1 -->

**Rain:** Ahh, okay. That just might work!

<!-- uid=1040167:14:1 -->

**Rain:** Good luck, Liz!

<!-- uid=1040167:15:1 -->

**Liz:** Thanks!

<!-- uid=1040167:16:1 -->


## Story 1040168 · \[Dark Dancer\] Lisbeth Lv.80

Character Story

**Philia:** What's up, Liz?

<!-- uid=1040168:1:1 -->

**Liz:** Sorry to make you come all the way  
here, but I wanted to thank you.

<!-- uid=1040168:2:1 -->

**Philia:** For what?

<!-- uid=1040168:3:1 -->

**Liz:** You know how you didn't buy the  
Kunoichi from me when I offered?

<!-- uid=1040168:4:1 -->

**Liz:** That really saved me.

<!-- uid=1040168:5:1 -->

**Philia:** I'm sorry?

<!-- uid=1040168:6:1 -->

**Liz:** Well, I made it for myself and  
used it to sneak through a  
really hard quest.

<!-- uid=1040168:7:1 -->

**Liz:** One where I had to go solo...

<!-- uid=1040168:8:1 -->

**Philia:** You did?! That's amazing!

<!-- uid=1040168:9:1 -->

**Liz:** I guess... You know, I think I was  
in a rut or something, like I had  
stopped myself from growing.

<!-- uid=1040168:10:1 -->

**Liz:** Now I finally know you realized  
that and tried to snap me out of  
it. So thank you.

<!-- uid=1040168:11:1 -->

**Philia:** Liz...

<!-- uid=1040168:12:1 -->

**Philia:** Hehe, you're giving me way too  
much credit.

<!-- uid=1040168:13:1 -->

**Philia:** You're just such an open, honest  
person, and you're never afraid  
to speak your mind...

<!-- uid=1040168:14:1 -->

**Philia:** But I could tell you were holding  
back, in battle and during quests.

<!-- uid=1040168:15:1 -->

**Philia:** Like maybe you were forcing  
yourself to be in the background...

<!-- uid=1040168:16:1 -->

**Liz:** Philia...

<!-- uid=1040168:17:1 -->

**Philia:** I got that same feeling the other  
day, but I couldn't bring myself  
to say anything...

<!-- uid=1040168:18:1 -->

**Liz:** Yeah, I can see that now...

<!-- uid=1040168:19:1 -->

**Liz:** I always thought if I could just  
focus on being the best blacksmith  
I could be, that'd be enough...

<!-- uid=1040168:20:1 -->

**Liz:** Maybe I was trying too hard to  
force myself into that mold...

<!-- uid=1040168:21:1 -->

**Philia:** Liz...

<!-- uid=1040168:22:1 -->

**Liz:** But now I'm gonna fight with  
everything I got!

<!-- uid=1040168:23:1 -->

**Liz:** I mean, not as an attacker or  
anything, but like for my dreams  
and goals and life-stuff, y'know?

<!-- uid=1040168:24:1 -->

## Story 1040183 · \[Efficient Smith\] Lizbeth Lv.30

## Story 1040185 · \[Efficient Smith\] Lizbeth Lv.50

## Story 1040203 · \[Shouting Cheers\] Silica Lv.30

## Story 1040207 · \[Shouting Cheers\] Silica Lv.70

Character Story

**Silica:** I found one too!

<!-- uid=1040207:2:1 -->

**Strea:** Yeah! We're making great progress!

**Strea:** ...

## Story 1040247 · \[Born in Sakura Season\] Yui Lv.70

Character Story

**Liz:** Yeah, I got just the spell.

**Strea:** Oh...

**Liz:** So the sailor uniform will go back  
to its original size.

<!-- uid=1040247:10:1 -->

spell too, it might just solve  
our problem.

like that one come chock full of  
weird side effects.

<!-- uid=1040247:18:1 -->

with powerful magic. It bends all  
sorts of rules.

<!-- uid=1040247:19:1 -->

**Liz:** There's all sorts of restrictions  
in place to prevent it from being  
overpowered, too.

<!-- uid=1040247:20:1 -->

**Strea:** Hmm, I see...

<!-- uid=1040247:21:1 -->

**Strea:** But who cares! This is for Yui!  
I'm willing to give it a shot!

<!-- uid=1040247:22:1 -->

I'll teach you how to learn the  
spell.

<!-- uid=1040247:24:1 -->

**Liz:** Nope.  
Well...

**Liz:** Just...be careful with it, okay?

<!-- uid=1040247:26:1 -->

**Strea:** Sure! Thanks, Liz!

<!-- uid=1040257:7:1 -->

**Sylph Player B:** A rare item?  
What kind of rare item?

<!-- uid=1040257:8:1 -->

**Lisbeth:** Ta-dah. This. I made it completely  
by accident when I was doing some  
smithing experimentation.

<!-- uid=1040257:9:1 -->

super-duper buff exponentially  
better than regular ol' buffs.

**Sylph Player B:** Dude...really?

<!-- uid=1040257:11:1 -->

**Sylph Player B:** You're not trying to trick us,

<!-- uid=1040257:12:1 -->

**Lisbeth:** Ahaha, no way! Not me!  
But if you insist, here.

be so generous? These guys are

<!-- uid=1040257:15:1 -->

<!-- uid=1040257:17:1 -->

**Sylph Player B:** Heh, fine. We'll try your item!

<!-- uid=1040257:19:1 -->

<!-- uid=1040257:20:1 -->

**Sylph Player B:** O-Oh... Yeah. Forgot about that.

<!-- uid=1040257:21:1 -->

**Lisbeth:** Just go and try it already.  
I'm a busy lady.

<!-- uid=1040257:22:1 -->

**Sylph Player B:** R-Right...

<!-- uid=1040257:23:1 -->

**Sylph Player B:** So I just drink this, and...

<!-- uid=1040257:24:1 -->

**Sylph Player B:** Oh... OOOH!!

<!-- uid=1040257:25:1 -->

**Silica:** Oh?

<!-- uid=1040257:26:1 -->


## Story 1040258 · \[Smile on Waterfront\] Lisbeth Lv.80

## Story 1040261 · \[Bouquet Toss\] Yuuki Lv.10

Character Story

**Imp:** They held a race-wide information  
session for us Imps today.

<!-- uid=1040261:1:1 -->

**Imp:** They told us about the discovery  
of a legendary fairy race called  
"Dwarfs."

<!-- uid=1040261:2:1 -->

**Yuuki:** "Dwarfs," huh? Like the ones in  
mythology that live underground?

<!-- uid=1040261:3:1 -->

**Imp:** Yeah. So in that sense, they're  
not too different from us Imps.

<!-- uid=1040261:4:1 -->

**Imp:** And you've heard the theory  
that they live under the Imp  
territory, right?

<!-- uid=1040261:5:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hehe, sorry!  
Not really my area of expertise.

<!-- uid=1040261:6:1 -->

**Imp:** Oh well... Whatever. I guess a lot  
of players thought it was just an  
urban myth, after all.

<!-- uid=1040261:7:1 -->

**Imp:** But it seems there's been an  
uptick in sightings lately.

<!-- uid=1040261:8:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Interesting...

<!-- uid=1040261:9:1 -->

**Imp:** So they've started up a new  
race-wide quest to try to  
find those Dwarfs.

<!-- uid=1040261:10:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Ooo, neat... Thanks for keeping  
me in the loop!

<!-- uid=1040261:11:1 -->

**Imp:** I bet they could use a famous  
sword-master like you, Zekken!

<!-- uid=1040261:12:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I dunno about that... I don't join  
the race-wide quests that often.

<!-- uid=1040261:13:1 -->

**Yuuki:** And even if there is a race in  
hiding, it'd probably be better  
to just leave them in peace.

<!-- uid=1040261:14:1 -->

**Imp:** Aww, c'mon! Where's your sense  
of adventure? The game's set up  
for us to go find 'em!

<!-- uid=1040261:15:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hehe, I guess you have a point...  
Okay, I'll think about it!

<!-- uid=1040261:16:1 -->


## Story 1040263 · \[Bouquet Toss\] Yuuki Lv.30

Character Story

**Yuuki:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=1040263:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey, Yuuki.

<!-- uid=1040263:2:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Oh, Kirito.

<!-- uid=1040263:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** What are you doing out here?  
Looking for something?

<!-- uid=1040263:4:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Yep, that's the idea! I wanted  
to get a sense of the terrain  
around here.

<!-- uid=1040263:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** When I think of "Imps," I usually  
think of "rocky mountaintops."

<!-- uid=1040263:6:1 -->

**Yuuki:** You're not wrong, but think lower.  
There's supposed to be a race of  
Dwarfs living underground.

<!-- uid=1040263:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** huh, I also heard about finding a race of Dwarfs quest.

<!-- uid=1040263:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** That reminds me of the Dark Dwarf  
Miners back in SAO...

<!-- uid=1040263:9:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Huh? What's that?

<!-- uid=1040263:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, just generic enemies. But they  
were based on a kind of fairy.

<!-- uid=1040263:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Nothing to do with ALO, though.

<!-- uid=1040263:12:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hmm... I guess when I think of  
dwarfs, I think of short burly  
dudes

<!-- uid=1040263:13:1 -->

**Yuuki:** with big bushy beards who mine  
gems and stuff underground.

<!-- uid=1040263:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's the idea! I've seen them  
looking like that in movies too.

<!-- uid=1040263:15:1 -->

**Yuuki:** So I thought to myself, "What are  
the kinds of places they would go?"

<!-- uid=1040263:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wow, Yuuki! For someone who  
never plays race-specific quests,  
you're really getting into this.

<!-- uid=1040263:17:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Eh... It's not so much that.

<!-- uid=1040263:18:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Everyone's searching for  
them, but the Dwarfs just  
wanna be left alone.

<!-- uid=1040263:19:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Even if they're NPCs, I still  
feel sorry for them.

<!-- uid=1040263:20:1 -->

**Yuuki:** If I find them first, I can warn  
them about the other Imps  
that are looking for them.

<!-- uid=1040263:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha! That's pretty  
kind of you, Yuuki.

<!-- uid=1040263:22:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I-It's no big deal...

<!-- uid=1040263:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm on board with that! I can't  
join the race-specific quest,  
but I could help you out.

<!-- uid=1040263:24:1 -->

**Yuuki:** You'd do that? Yay!

<!-- uid=1040263:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah! Let's go find those  
Dwarfs before anyone else!

<!-- uid=1040263:26:1 -->

## Story 1040267 · \[Bouquet Toss\] Yuuki Lv.70

Character Story

**Dwarf:** Dare ye raise yer swords  
against the Dwarven folk  
of the deep earth?

<!-- uid=1040267:1:1 -->

**Yuuki:** N-No, you got it all wrong!  
We're here to protect you!

<!-- uid=1040267:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** They're NPCs, Yuuki. Better  
break things down simply so  
they'll understand.

<!-- uid=1040267:3:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Oh, right...

<!-- uid=1040267:4:1 -->

a danger from the surface.

<!-- uid=1040267:5:1 -->

**Dwarf:** So, ye surface-folk came  
to warn us of danger?

<!-- uid=1040267:6:1 -->

**Dwarf:** Ach, so we cannae go to the  
top-lands this day, then...

<!-- uid=1040267:7:1 -->

**Dwarf:** More's the pity. We only come  
up top to get the sunshine  
on our wedding days...

<!-- uid=1040267:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** You've got a wedding?

<!-- uid=1040267:9:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Psst, Kirito! Check that  
Dwarf couple out!

<!-- uid=1040267:10:1 -->

**Yuuki:** They're dressed up super fancy!

<!-- uid=1040267:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Whoa, you're right...

<!-- uid=1040267:12:1 -->

**Dwarf:** Whene'er a Dwarven lass and laddie  
join in marriage, we hold 'em a  
bonnie party up top.

<!-- uid=1040267:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** I see... I guess it is nice to have  
a wedding when the sun is shining.

<!-- uid=1040267:14:1 -->

**Dwarf:** We Dwarven folk live outside  
the ken of yer bright sun...

<!-- uid=1040267:15:1 -->

**Dwarf:** Fairy folk, only one thing do  
we ask of ye. Cannae ye just  
let us be?

<!-- uid=1040267:16:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Yep! You got it!

<!-- uid=1040267:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Are you sure this is okay, Yuuki?

**Kirito:** It goes right against the

**Yuuki:** Of course! This was my plan

<!-- uid=1040267:20:1 -->

**Yuuki:** We won't tell a soul! You guys  
just enjoy your wedding day,  
alright?

<!-- uid=1040267:21:1 -->

**Dwarf:** Ye swear it on your soul?  
Ah, many thanks!

<!-- uid=1040267:22:1 -->

**Dwarf:** How 'bout ye sit tight and watch  
the celebration, then? Our thanks  
to ye both.

<!-- uid=1040267:23:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Whoa, really? Thanks! Guess we'll  
take you up on that offer!

## Story 1040275 · \[Genius Creator\] Yuuki Lv.50

## Story 1040277 · \[Genius Creator\] Yuuki Lv.70

a 30-foot long crocodile...

**Yuuki:** Megalodon:

## Story 1040278 · \[Genius Creator\] Yuuki Lv.80

Character Story

**Kirito:** You mean those monsters—I mean  
megafauna—all just died off on  
their own?

<!-- uid=1040278:1:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I didn't believe it at first  
either, but it looks like they  
all died of different causes.

<!-- uid=1040278:2:1 -->

**Yuuki:** They didn't have enough food,  
or they couldn't cope with  
the climate...

<!-- uid=1040278:3:1 -->

**Yuuki:** So pretty much all of them passed  
away before we could fight them.

<!-- uid=1040278:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** How could this happen?

<!-- uid=1040278:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Actually, I did think it was a  
possibility.

<!-- uid=1040278:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Those megafauna all went extinct  
on Earth a long, long time ago.

<!-- uid=1040278:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** There are some theories that they  
died out because they were  
too big and too strong.

<!-- uid=1040278:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** How can being too awesome be  
a problem?

<!-- uid=1040278:9:1 -->

**Siune:** I've heard this theory before too.  
Essentially, the key factor to  
long-term survival...

<!-- uid=1040278:10:1 -->

**Siune:** Isn't strength or size, but the  
ability to adapt to one's  
environment.

<!-- uid=1040278:11:1 -->

**Siune:** In that sense, those animals might  
have been too strong for their  
own good.

<!-- uid=1040278:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** I...think I understand.

<!-- uid=1040278:13:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I kinda feel bad for them. I tried  
to make the environment as  
realistic as possible,

<!-- uid=1040278:14:1 -->

**Yuuki:** but they couldn't cope with it.

<!-- uid=1040278:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** So too much power can lead to your  
own ruin... Humanity should keep  
that in mind.

<!-- uid=1040278:16:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Yeah, I guess...

<!-- uid=1040278:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey, fun fact! If the climate goes  
haywire and we die, cockroaches  
are still guaranteed to survive!

<!-- uid=1040278:18:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Ugh... I know. I don't want  
to know, but I know.

<!-- uid=1040278:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito, seriously not the time for  
your random factoids!

<!-- uid=1040278:20:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Random inspiration or not, this  
whole safari park was a great  
learning experience for me.

<!-- uid=1040278:21:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Now it's up to me to use the  
lessons I learned to make an  
even better place next time!

<!-- uid=1040278:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, that's the spirit!  
We've got your back, Yuuki!

<!-- uid=1040278:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, we're always happy to help!!

<!-- uid=1040278:24:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Thanks, guys!

<!-- uid=1040278:25:1 -->

whole thing turned into a mess.

<!-- uid=1050037:20:1 -->

the technique, it'll deal massive  
damage, which is what counts!

<!-- uid=1050037:21:1 -->

## Story 1050051 · \[Fly a Shuttlecock with My Heart\] Lisbeth Lv.10

Character Story

head there for a bit?

<!-- uid=1050051:1:1 -->

<!-- uid=1050051:2:1 -->

furnace a little ways up this  
mountain.

**Sinon:** A tatara furnace? Is that some  
sort of specialized thing for  
blacksmithing?

<!-- uid=1050051:4:1 -->

**Liz:** You got it! It's this traditional  
Japanese design they used  
waaay back in the day.

<!-- uid=1050051:5:1 -->

**Liz:** I'm a Bladesmith here, so I just

<!-- uid=1050051:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Sounds interesting. Wasn't there  
something like that in Leprechaun  
territory in ALO, though?

<!-- uid=1050051:7:1 -->

<!-- uid=1050051:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** Heh, I can see you  
hyperventilating over the  
chance to play with it.

<!-- uid=1050051:9:1 -->

**Liz:** Oh, totally. They make katanas  
there! Katanas aren't just  
weapons, they're art!

<!-- uid=1050051:10:1 -->

**Liz:** In the real world, good katanas

collectors all over the globe.

<!-- uid=1050051:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** Well, I'm happy to keep you  
company. Let's go.

**Liz:** Thanks!

<!-- uid=1050051:13:1 -->


## Story 1050053 · \[Fly a Shuttlecock with My Heart\] Lisbeth Lv.30

Character Story

**Sinon:** It's hot in here...

**Liz:** For sure! Heat sensitivity is  
turned way down in VR, so for  
us to be feeling it like this...

<!-- uid=1050053:2:1 -->

**Liz:** Means it's solar flare-level  
hot in here!

**Sinon:** Hello there. And you are?

<!-- uid=1050053:9:1 -->

the stuff we use to make katanas.

<!-- uid=1050053:10:1 -->

**Master Bladesmith:** It's bearable because this is VR,  
but in the real world it gets to

just put you at risk of burns,  
but also a searing, melty death...

works, but I never realized just  
how dangerous it was...

**Sinon:** I'm glad to see it recreated so  
accurately. Traditional crafts are  
disappearing in the real world.

<!-- uid=1050053:15:1 -->

**Master Bladesmith:** Well, girls, it's still too early

<!-- uid=1050053:16:1 -->

**Master Bladesmith:** We've only just brushed the

an intricate and amazing process!

<!-- uid=1050053:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** O-Okay, I'll hold my applause.

<!-- uid=1050053:18:1 -->

**Liz:** Is it all right if we moved on to

<!-- uid=1050053:20:1 -->

of swing! Pay close attention!

<!-- uid=1050057:7:1 -->

**Liz:** Understood!

<!-- uid=1050057:8:1 -->

<!-- uid=1050057:9:1 -->

**Liz:** Y-Yes, sir!

<!-- uid=1050057:10:1 -->

<!-- uid=1050057:11:1 -->

**Liz:** It's WAY harder work than  
I thought, and requires a  
meticulous eye for detail.

<!-- uid=1050057:12:1 -->

**Liz:** I'm amazed that this sort of  
technique was passed down in  
Japan for over a thousand years.

<!-- uid=1050057:13:1 -->

**Liz:** I made a name for myself as a  
smith in SAO and ALO, so I have  
some confidence in my skill...

<!-- uid=1050057:14:1 -->

**Liz:** But a real swordsmith's on a whole  
different level!

<!-- uid=1050057:15:1 -->

<!-- uid=1050057:16:1 -->

**Liz:** In most VRMMOs, smithing is just  
raising your levels, getting mats,  
and smacking them with a hammer.

<!-- uid=1050057:17:1 -->

**Liz:** The rest is just watching the  
chance of success and hoping  
for the best.

<!-- uid=1050057:18:1 -->

**Liz:** I think I let that go to my head.  
I'm so embarrassed with myself...

<!-- uid=1050057:19:1 -->

it's all simplified and easy.  
That makes it more fun.

<!-- uid=1050057:20:1 -->

**Liz:** Yeah, I guess...

<!-- uid=1050057:21:1 -->


## Story 1050058 · \[Fly a Shuttlecock with My Heart\] Lisbeth Lv.80

gave you some sort of hidden buff.

<!-- uid=1050058:18:1 -->

<!-- uid=1050058:19:1 -->

<!-- uid=1050058:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** Heh, looks like all your years of

## Story 1050073 · \[Pure Hearted Chocolatier\] Lisbeth Lv.30

Character Story

**Asuna:** This may sound totally obvious,  
but this town's made of candy  
and chocolate, right?

<!-- uid=1050073:1:1 -->

<!-- uid=1050073:2:1 -->

an eye on them. It's a trial.

the idea.

<!-- uid=1050073:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, they better appreciate all  
the effort we put in for them!

<!-- uid=1050073:11:1 -->

**Liz:** Okay, I get the picture. So, does  
this have something to do with why  
you look so stressed right now?

<!-- uid=1050073:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yes! The first group's already  
here, and it's terrible!

<!-- uid=1050073:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** The second they saw all the  
chocolate, they lost control!  
It's madness out there, madness!

<!-- uid=1050073:14:1 -->

**Liz:** Okay, chill. They're just kids,  
right? How bad can it be?

<!-- uid=1050073:15:1 -->

## Story 1050128 · \[Shine Parasol\] Lisbeth Lv.80

Character Story

**Liz:** I need to figure out what to do  
with all this rare ore.

<!-- uid=1050128:1:1 -->

**Liz:** I could use it to make strong  
weapons for everyone. Or I could  
sell them off for extra funds.

<!-- uid=1050128:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Between the two, I'd figure you  
might get more by selling them  
at the flea market or auction.

<!-- uid=1050128:3:1 -->

**Liz:** Hehe, definitely. Or I could put  
it towards enhancing some existing  
weapons. It's so hard to decide.

<!-- uid=1050128:4:1 -->

**Silica:** Um, I hate to interrupt, but could  
I make a suggestion?

<!-- uid=1050128:5:1 -->

**Liz:** Sure. What is it, Silica?

<!-- uid=1050128:6:1 -->

**Silica:** I don't know if you'll like it  
since it won't necessarily make  
you any money directly, but...

<!-- uid=1050128:7:1 -->

**Silica:** What if you took that ore and  
used it to decorate the front of  
your store?

**Liz:** Huh? Decorate my store?

<!-- uid=1050128:9:1 -->

**Silica:** Well, it's something you see in  
all kinds of shops, both in VR  
and in the real world.

<!-- uid=1050128:10:1 -->

**Silica:** Shopkeepers will decorate stores  
with items that aren't for sale to  
try to draw customers' attention.

<!-- uid=1050128:11:1 -->

**Silica:** I figure you might get more  
traffic that way.

<!-- uid=1050128:12:1 -->

**Silica:** Oooh, now there's an idea, using  
the ore to draw more customers  
to my shop.

<!-- uid=1050128:13:1 -->

**Liz:** You're right that it won't  
directly lead to me making  
any money in and of itself.

<!-- uid=1050128:14:1 -->

**Liz:** But if I can use it to rope  
people in, then they might be  
in more of a spending mood.

<!-- uid=1050128:15:1 -->

**Liz:** That's a great idea! Thanks,  
Silica! I think that's what I'll  
go with.

<!-- uid=1050128:16:1 -->

**Silica:** I'm just happy I could help!

<!-- uid=1050128:17:1 -->

**Liz:** Well, you did great. That sort of  
thinking is just what the doctor  
ordered!

<!-- uid=1050128:18:1 -->

**Liz:** When all I think about is profit,  
it's easy for me to have a  
one-track mind, I guess.

Character Story

**Kirito:** Hmm...

**Eugeo:** You're telling me...

**Silica:** Does no one have any ideas?

**Kirito:** It'd make sense if our experiences

fake Yuuki as well, but...

**Asuna:** Hmph. You know what, I'll just

<!-- uid=1060143:6:1 -->

## Story 1060145 · \[Vivacious Girl\] Yuuki Lv.50

Character Story

right about that!

## Story 1060147 · \[Vivacious Girl\] Yuuki Lv.70

Character Story

**Asuna:** I... don't imagine those two have  
ever lived under the same roof...

<!-- uid=1060147:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** But I see what you mean. I guess  
Selka would top the cute list for  
our class...

<!-- uid=1060147:2:1 -->

**Liz:** That's not all! You've got the  
cool and beautiful Sinon and the  
older sister type in Sortiliena!

<!-- uid=1060147:3:1 -->

**Liz:** On top of that, you have the

<!-- uid=1060147:4:1 -->

perfect lineup...?! What's your

<!-- uid=1060147:5:1 -->

**Silica:** Hey...! C-Could you not toss out  
my real name out of nowhere,  
Miss Shinozaki?!

<!-- uid=1060147:6:1 -->

**Silica:** But... you're right! It is quite

<!-- uid=1060147:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Whaat?!

<!-- uid=1060147:9:1 -->

<!-- uid=1060147:11:1 -->

**Silica:** Looking over your roster...  
it's like everyone has their

<!-- uid=1060147:18:1 -->


## Story 1060148 · \[Vivacious Girl\] Yuuki Lv.80

Character Story

**Silica:** Okay, Asuna. Think back over all  
the different girls in your class  
one more time.

<!-- uid=1060148:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Umm...

<!-- uid=1060148:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sinonon, Selka...

<!-- uid=1060148:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Then there's Sortiliena...  
Oh, and Miss Administrator.

<!-- uid=1060148:4:3 -->

**Asuna:** ...What about them?

<!-- uid=1060148:5:1 -->

**Silica:** If you were to assign them a type,  
they'd all either be "cute" or  
"beautiful," right?

<!-- uid=1060148:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well... sure.

<!-- uid=1060148:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Cute would include Selka, and the  
rest would be under beautiful,  
I guess?

<!-- uid=1060148:8:1 -->

**Silica:** Which would you fall under, then?

<!-- uid=1060148:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Huh? M-Me?!

<!-- uid=1060148:10:1 -->

**Silica:** Yes, you! Now answer me!

<!-- uid=1060148:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Wh-Whaaat...?!

<!-- uid=1060148:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** D-Do I really have to say that  
about myself...?

<!-- uid=1060148:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's kinda... super embarrassing,  
you know...!

<!-- uid=1060148:14:1 -->

**Liz:** Silica, Asuna seems honestly  
troubled here. You should offer  
her a helping hand.

<!-- uid=1060148:15:1 -->

**Silica:** ...Yes, you're right, Liz.

<!-- uid=1060148:16:1 -->

**Silica:** The answer... in my opinion, at  
least, is that you're both.

<!-- uid=1060148:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** What...?

<!-- uid=1060148:18:1 -->

**Silica:** In other words, you're well  
balanced. You're cute, but  
you're also beautiful...

<!-- uid=1060148:19:1 -->

**Silica:** That makes you a valuable asset!  
It's rare to see someone like that  
even among idols!

<!-- uid=1060148:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Um... But I'm not an idol...

<!-- uid=1060148:21:1 -->

**Silica:** Well, that's not what's important  
here.

<!-- uid=1060148:22:1 -->

**Silica:** Anyway, that's why you're the  
perfect commander for uniting  
all these strong personalities.

<!-- uid=1060148:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** I kind of get what you're saying,  
but not really...?

<!-- uid=1060148:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** B-But in that case... couldn't  
I at least be spared the job of  
head chef, then?!

<!-- uid=1060148:25:1 -->

**Liz:** What? Of course not.

<!-- uid=1060148:26:1 -->

**Asuna:** B-But why?!

<!-- uid=1060148:27:1 -->

**Liz:** Because you're the best cook in  
the class, why else?

<!-- uid=1060148:28:1 -->

**Silica:** You know so much about cooking  
too.

<!-- uid=1060148:29:1 -->

**Asuna:** S-So it isn't about balance when  
it comes to that job?!

<!-- uid=1060148:30:1 -->

**Asuna:** Agh... This is such a deep and  
complicated topic...

<!-- uid=1060148:31:1 -->

**Asuna:** Am I really going to be able to  
handle two jobs at the same  
time...?

<!-- uid=1060148:32:1 -->


## Story 1240011 · \[Goddess of Death\] Sinon Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** Hey, Sinon.

<!-- uid=1240011:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...

<!-- uid=1240011:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hm?  
Uh, Sinon?

<!-- uid=1240011:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** What.

<!-- uid=1240011:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Are you upset?

<!-- uid=1240011:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** No. I'm just taking it all in.  
It's been a while since my last  
dive. It feels pretty good.

<!-- uid=1240011:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Really? I guess you've been  
logging into ALO more often  
these days.

<!-- uid=1240011:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** I'm fine! Let me be!

<!-- uid=1240011:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** O-Okay!

<!-- uid=1240011:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** True, I've been playing  
a lot more ALO

<!-- uid=1240011:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** ever since I got to know  
you and Asuna...

<!-- uid=1240011:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** But these are my old stomping  
grounds. Lots of memories here.  
Good and bad. So give me a sec.

<!-- uid=1240011:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Gotcha.  
Will you wait here while I go  
check out the shop?

<!-- uid=1240011:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** Knock yourself out.

<!-- uid=1240011:14:1 -->


## Story 1240013 · \[Goddess of Death\] Sinon Lv.30

Character Story

**Kirito:** Have you had enough time to  
reflect, Sinon?

<!-- uid=1240013:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah. And don't talk to me like  
I'm some sort of robot.  
You sound weird.

<!-- uid=1240013:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, okay, got it.

<!-- uid=1240013:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** So how about you tell me why you  
brought me to GGO?

<!-- uid=1240013:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...

<!-- uid=1240013:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** ALO's the one where we  
can fly, right?

<!-- uid=1240013:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Erm, yeah. Yeah, it is.

<!-- uid=1240013:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** Didn't you ever find the flying  
to be way too fast?

<!-- uid=1240013:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** Trying to shoot arrows while I  
was moving that fast was next  
to impossible.

<!-- uid=1240013:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Uh, yeah, I guess that would be  
pretty tough for an archer.

<!-- uid=1240013:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** Snipers like me are used  
to lying in wait.

<!-- uid=1240013:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** I can drop a target from two  
kilometers out before they even  
know what hit them.

<!-- uid=1240013:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** But when I'm trying to  
hit a moving target

<!-- uid=1240013:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** while flying through the air,  
myself, I feel like I'm performing  
some sort of acrobatic show.

<!-- uid=1240013:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Didn't ALO have a little  
bit of aim assist?

<!-- uid=1240013:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** Within a certain range, yeah, but  
it doesn't do anything to help  
you hit distant targets.

<!-- uid=1240013:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh...

<!-- uid=1240013:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** So I figured I'd come back to the  
game I know and practice until I  
can do it.

<!-- uid=1240013:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Do what?

<!-- uid=1240013:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hit distant targets while moving  
at high speed?

<!-- uid=1240013:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** Bingo.

<!-- uid=1240013:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** But GGO avatars move at superhuman  
speeds! You'll never adapt!

<!-- uid=1240013:22:1 -->

**Sinon:** Which is why we're going to use  
a buggy. You've driven one  
of these before, haven't you?

<!-- uid=1240013:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah...  
When Death Gun was chasing us...

<!-- uid=1240013:24:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah, so buckle up.  
I need you to drive again.

<!-- uid=1240013:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** So let me guess...

<!-- uid=1240013:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** You brought me here to drive you  
around in this buggy for high-  
speed target practice?

<!-- uid=1240013:27:1 -->

**Sinon:** Exactly.

<!-- uid=1240013:28:1 -->


## Story 1240015 · \[Goddess of Death\] Sinon Lv.50

Character Story

**Kirito:** Well then, we'd better  
find a rental shop.

<!-- uid=1240015:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** That's the plan.

<!-- uid=1240015:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** But what will you use for targets?  
Do you want to head out of  
town and find some mobs?

<!-- uid=1240015:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** But at that point we're pretty  
much off-roading. That'll make  
driving tricky...

<!-- uid=1240015:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** Don't worry about it. Just drive  
over easy terrain, and I'll shoot  
at whatever's around.

<!-- uid=1240015:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** So, like, barrels and scrap metal?

<!-- uid=1240015:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yup.

<!-- uid=1240015:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** A lot of the objects in GGO  
explode, so I'll know when I've  
hit my target.

<!-- uid=1240015:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Whoa.  
Sounds like this could turn into  
an action movie!

<!-- uid=1240015:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** I'll be aiming at distant targets,

<!-- uid=1240015:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** but the explosions might kick  
some sparks and ash our way,  
so watch yourself.

<!-- uid=1240015:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey, how am I supposed to  
watch myself?! I've got to keep my  
eyes on the road!

<!-- uid=1240015:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Besides, hits in GGO hurt worse  
than in ALO!

<!-- uid=1240015:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** Well, you got wounded pretty  
badly in the fight against Death  
Gun and didn't whine at all,

<!-- uid=1240015:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** so I figured you  
were tough enough.

<!-- uid=1240015:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Tough enough?!  
That really hurt, y'know!

<!-- uid=1240015:16:1 -->

**Sinon:** You are just...

<!-- uid=1240015:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Just what?

<!-- uid=1240015:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** Forget it.  
Just drive.

<!-- uid=1240015:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh?

<!-- uid=1240015:20:1 -->


## Story 1240017 · \[Goddess of Death\] Sinon Lv.70

Character Story

**Sinon:** There are some decommissioned  
vehicles off to the right here.  
They're my next target!

<!-- uid=1240017:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Want me to get closer?

<!-- uid=1240017:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** No, just circle around them so I  
can eyeball how far away they are!

<!-- uid=1240017:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** I-Is this too far away?

<!-- uid=1240017:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** No, it's perfect! If I can't hit  
one from this far out,

<!-- uid=1240017:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** I've got no business using a bow  
in ALO!

<!-- uid=1240017:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Roger that!

<!-- uid=1240017:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...

<!-- uid=1240017:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Want me to maintain this distance?

<!-- uid=1240017:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah, this'll work.

<!-- uid=1240017:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** Here goes.

<!-- uid=1240017:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Whoa! I can feel the  
shockwaves from here!

<!-- uid=1240017:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** They're filled with gasoline.  
The effects are pretty over  
the top.

<!-- uid=1240017:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** It's a shame you can't get a good  
look at them while you're driving.

<!-- uid=1240017:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Heh, I can take a little peek.

<!-- uid=1240017:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** No way! No distracted  
driving on my watch!

<!-- uid=1240017:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** C'mon, it's fine!

<!-- uid=1240017:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Kirito, look out!

<!-- uid=1240017:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Say what?!

<!-- uid=1240017:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** There's rubble all over the road!

<!-- uid=1240017:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ahhhhhhh!

<!-- uid=1240017:21:1 -->


## Story 1240018 · \[Goddess of Death\] Sinon Lv.80

Character Story

**Kirito:** Phew...

<!-- uid=1240018:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** I can't believe you...

<!-- uid=1240018:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sinon, I'm so sorry!

<!-- uid=1240018:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** It's fine. The buggy wasn't  
damaged, and neither was I.

<!-- uid=1240018:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** What about you, Kirito?  
Are YOU okay?

<!-- uid=1240018:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** You might as well have been  
playing ALO, the way you flew out  
of the driver's seat!

<!-- uid=1240018:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah... That really hurt...

<!-- uid=1240018:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** You know, I was just thinking...

<!-- uid=1240018:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** I don't know how you managed to  
keep fighting against Death Gun.  
You should've been dead.

<!-- uid=1240018:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** I told you it hurt, didn't I?

<!-- uid=1240018:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** It sure didn't look like it  
from what I saw.

<!-- uid=1240018:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** I started to wonder if you  
had any sense of pain at all.

<!-- uid=1240018:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** It actually hurts a ton.  
GGO's Pain Absorber is  
set pretty low.

<!-- uid=1240018:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** So you're saying you just fought  
through it?

<!-- uid=1240018:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Pretty much.  
My determination won out.

<!-- uid=1240018:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** It definitely hurt, but I was focused   
so I guess I didn't think about it.

<!-- uid=1240018:16:1 -->

**Sinon:** Kirito...

<!-- uid=1240018:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** What're you looking at me like  
that for, Sinon?

<!-- uid=1240018:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** Like what?  
I wasn't looking at anything!

<!-- uid=1240018:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** Besides, we've wasted enough time!  
Let's get back to practicing!

<!-- uid=1240018:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** I'm still not comfortable with my  
mobile sniping abilities.

<!-- uid=1240018:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** R-Right. Sure.

<!-- uid=1240018:22:1 -->


## Story 1240091 · \[Progressive Gunner\] Sinon Lv.10

Character Story

**Asuna:** Nice job, Kirito.  
You too, Sinonon!

<!-- uid=1240091:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Right back at you, Asuna.

<!-- uid=1240091:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** Whew. Those were some pretty  
tough mobs!

<!-- uid=1240091:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sure was. We couldn't have beat  
them without your shooting!

<!-- uid=1240091:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, our melee and magic attacks  
wouldn't have dealt enough damage.

<!-- uid=1240091:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Not to mention the nasty combos  
they unleashed as soon as we  
got close...

<!-- uid=1240091:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** You definitely get the MVP award  
for today's battle, Sinon.

<!-- uid=1240091:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** Oh, stop, we all made contributions  
this time around.

<!-- uid=1240091:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** This seems like a good stopping  
point. Shall we log off and  
continue this tomorrow?

<!-- uid=1240091:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, that works for me.

<!-- uid=1240091:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** Actually, about that...

<!-- uid=1240091:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** I'm scheduled to work tomorrow.  
I don't think I'll get a chance  
to log on.

<!-- uid=1240091:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, okay.

<!-- uid=1240091:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** You're really getting involved,  
aren't you?

<!-- uid=1240091:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** Pfft, you say that as if I like  
my job.

<!-- uid=1240091:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Er, okay, sorry to assume.

<!-- uid=1240091:16:1 -->

**Sinon:** I, uh...

<!-- uid=1240091:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hm?

<!-- uid=1240091:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** S-So what if I am! Don't go prying  
into my business, okay?!

<!-- uid=1240091:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeow!

<!-- uid=1240091:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hahaha! She's not going to tell  
you EVERYTHING just because  
we're friends, Kirito.

<!-- uid=1240091:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** Let's respect her privacy.

<!-- uid=1240091:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, got it...

<!-- uid=1240091:23:1 -->


## Story 1240093 · \[Progressive Gunner\] Sinon Lv.30

Character Story

here?

**Asuna:** Hm?

**Asuna:** she said she was sticking to VR.

**Asuna:** So why would she start playing

**Asuna:** Maybe I shouldn't bring it up.

<!-- uid=1240093:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** No. I can't sit here and worry

<!-- uid=1240093:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'll just say hello.

## Story 1240103 · \[Dangerous Kiss\] Sinon Lv.30

## Story 1240105 · \[Dangerous Kiss\] Sinon Lv.50

Character Story

**Sinon:** Hey, look. There's a tiny hut  
out here in the forest.

<!-- uid=1240105:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** Come to think of it, isn't this  
where Snow White meets the  
Seven Dwarfs?

<!-- uid=1240105:2:1 -->

**???:** Heigh-ho, heigh-ho!

<!-- uid=1240105:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** Wait, is that a happy-go-lucky  
tune my ears hear?

<!-- uid=1240105:4:1 -->

**Dwarf A:** Hey there, ho there! Do my eyes  
deceive me? A lady it is, indeed!

<!-- uid=1240105:5:1 -->

**Dwarf B:** You're right! A fair forest  
damsel, say I!

<!-- uid=1240105:6:1 -->

**Dwarf C:** I haven't laid eyes upon a lady  
in years!

<!-- uid=1240105:7:1 -->

**Dwarf D:** No no, I must protest! 'Tis a  
mirage! An illusion! No girl  
would be here, I say!

<!-- uid=1240105:8:1 -->

**Dwarf E:** But if that's true, isn't it odd  
for us all to see the same?

<!-- uid=1240105:9:1 -->

**Dwarf F:** Of course, why not! We are all  
friends, this is true. Friends  
share many things, even illusions!

<!-- uid=1240105:10:1 -->

**Dwarf G:** Friends! True friends!  
A lovely thing!

<!-- uid=1240105:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** These dwarfs...are something else.  
I don't think I can match their  
weird excitement here...

<!-- uid=1240105:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** But if I remember the story right,  
I have to beg them for help. Ick.

<!-- uid=1240105:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** Excuse me. I have fled here, for  
my wicked mother is after my head.

<!-- uid=1240105:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** Please, I beg of you.  
May I shelter here for a time?

<!-- uid=1240105:15:1 -->

**Dwarf A:** Your mother seeks your head?!

<!-- uid=1240105:16:1 -->

**Dwarf B:** Horrible! Horrendous! Dreadful!  
Let her stay, say I!

<!-- uid=1240105:17:1 -->

**Dwarf C:** Hear hear! Sanctuary for the  
poor girl!

<!-- uid=1240105:18:1 -->

**Dwarf D:** No no no, I must protest! You are  
all being deceived, I say!  
She lies to take advantage of us!

<!-- uid=1240105:19:1 -->

**Dwarf E:** She lies? The fiend! Are all girls  
this villainous?!

<!-- uid=1240105:20:1 -->

**Dwarf F:** Bah, hogwash! You would spin  
demons out of dandelions! She is  
what she says she is, no more!

<!-- uid=1240105:21:1 -->

**Dwarf G:** Ha ha ha! Friends, let us keep  
things friendly now!

<!-- uid=1240105:22:1 -->

**Sinon:** Gah, these idiots need to shut up.  
I've never met anyone so  
irritating before...

<!-- uid=1240105:23:1 -->

## Story 1240127 · \[Fiery Morning Glory\] Sinon  Lv.70

Character Story

**Seven:** ... Aha! I think I understand!

<!-- uid=1240127:1:1 -->

**Seven:** Allow Professor Nanairo  
Arshavin to solve this  
predicament...with SCIENCE!

<!-- uid=1240127:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Calm down, Seven.  
We're not in the  
mood for jokes.

<!-- uid=1240127:3:1 -->

**Seven:** Who said anything about jokes?  
Sinon! You're having trouble  
hitting close range targets

<!-- uid=1240127:4:1 -->

**Seven:** because you're used to  
working at a distance.  
Am I correct?

<!-- uid=1240127:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** Right... But I wield a  
spear from time to time in  
ALO without any trouble.

<!-- uid=1240127:6:1 -->

**Seven:** Hmmm... I think I'd still  
class that as a mid- to  
long-range weapon.

<!-- uid=1240127:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** Right...

<!-- uid=1240127:8:1 -->

**Seven:** And do you have anything  
like a hand tremor when  
you try to take aim?

<!-- uid=1240127:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** N-No, not really.

<!-- uid=1240127:10:1 -->

**Seven:** So if it's not your  
technique...

<!-- uid=1240127:11:1 -->

**Seven:** ...I hypothesize that your  
eyes are too good!

<!-- uid=1240127:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh...?

<!-- uid=1240127:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** Well, my glasses are  
accessories, but my eyes  
aren't that keen or--

<!-- uid=1240127:14:1 -->

**Seven:** That's not what I mean, silly!  
VRMMOs compensate for  
nearsighted players anyway.

<!-- uid=1240127:15:1 -->

**Seven:** What I mean is you've got  
a good sense of kinetic  
vision!

<!-- uid=1240127:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Kinetic vision...?

<!-- uid=1240127:17:1 -->

**Seven:** Think about a sniper aiming  
for a moving target.

<!-- uid=1240127:18:1 -->

**Seven:** Landing a hit depends on  
sensing where the target is  
going to be, not where it is.

<!-- uid=1240127:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** So if you've got good kinetic  
vision, you can't hit a  
bull's-eye? I don't get it...

<!-- uid=1240127:20:1 -->

**Seven:** Think of it like this! Good  
kinetic vision means your  
brain makes a prediction

<!-- uid=1240127:21:1 -->

**Seven:** based on the current  
position, and aiming there. A  
still target throws you off!

<!-- uid=1240127:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...!

<!-- uid=1240127:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** Makes sense! Like a built-in  
version of the Bullet Line  
Prediction system in GGO!

<!-- uid=1240127:24:1 -->

**Sinon:** You were pretty handy with  
Bullet Line, Kirito...

<!-- uid=1240127:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** But you've got something  
like that just by instinct!  
That's incredible, Sinon!

<!-- uid=1240127:26:1 -->

**Sinon:** I-I don't know about that...

<!-- uid=1240127:27:1 -->

**Seven:** Bullet Line Prediction...?  
Ha ha! That sounds silly, but  
I guess it sums up the idea.

<!-- uid=1240127:28:1 -->

**Seven:** That's my hypothesis!  
Now to test it out...  
Excuse me, mister!

<!-- uid=1240127:29:1 -->

**Shooting Gallery Attendant:** Hmm?  
What can I do for you?

<!-- uid=1240127:30:1 -->

**Seven:** I'd like to try a little  
experiment...

<!-- uid=1240127:31:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...

## Story 1250013 · \[Spider Witch\] Sinon  Lv.30

Character Story

**Kirito:** You wanna study magic?

<!-- uid=1250013:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yes. I want to be able to  
cast spells properly.

<!-- uid=1250013:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hold on, I thought you already  
knew how to do that.

<!-- uid=1250013:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** To a certain extent, yes, but I  
still can't quite get the hang of  
higher level magic...

<!-- uid=1250013:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** Silica can attest to that, since  
I totally botched a new spell  
during battle.

<!-- uid=1250013:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** I see...

<!-- uid=1250013:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Which is why I'm asking you  
to teach me, Kirito.

<!-- uid=1250013:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, I'm not exactly the best at  
magic either. I'm more of a  
physical weapons type of guy...

<!-- uid=1250013:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** You'd be better off asking Leafa.  
Everyone knows she's a kickass  
cleric.

<!-- uid=1250013:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah, you're right...  
Okay, I'll go find her.

<!-- uid=1250013:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wait, sorry. I forgot she's super  
busy right now working on one  
of the Dread Bastion quests...

<!-- uid=1250013:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** Oh... Right, I should probably  
wait until she's finished before  
asking for help.

<!-- uid=1250013:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** I bet she'd appreciate that...  
Oh! Hey!

<!-- uid=1250013:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** I just thought of the perfect  
person to teach you magic!

<!-- uid=1250013:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** Really? Who?

<!-- uid=1250013:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, it's an NPC, actually, who  
will take on any player who wants  
to learn magic as an apprentice.

<!-- uid=1250013:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** And then that player can undertake  
a quest to enhance their skills.

<!-- uid=1250013:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** I never knew an NPC like that  
existed... Where do I need to go?

<!-- uid=1250013:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** The Dread Bastion in the  
Halloween event area. The NPC is a  
witch who lives deep in the woods.

<!-- uid=1250013:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** Well, that's fitting. Sounds like  
she'll be able to help me improve.

<!-- uid=1250013:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** You wouldn't mind coming with me  
to meet her, would you?

<!-- uid=1250013:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** No, not at all.

<!-- uid=1250013:22:1 -->


## Story 1250015 · \[Spider Witch\] Sinon  Lv.50

Character Story

**Witch:** Hee hee hee... So you want to be  
my apprentice, dearie?

<!-- uid=1250015:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** Y-Yeah, so what if I do?

<!-- uid=1250015:2:1 -->

**Witch:** The cheek of you! Were you raised  
in a barn? Did no one teach you  
to respect your elders?!

<!-- uid=1250015:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** M-My apologies.

<!-- uid=1250015:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sinon, I think this NPC is able to  
hold some degree of improvised  
dialog.

<!-- uid=1250015:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** She is going to be your teacher,  
so maybe you better be a little  
more polite...

<!-- uid=1250015:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah, okay.

<!-- uid=1250015:7:1 -->

**Witch:** Very well then. I think I'll have  
you start by cleaning my house.

<!-- uid=1250015:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** What?! I came here to learn magic,  
not to clean some witch's house!  
I mean-some nice witch's...

<!-- uid=1250015:9:1 -->

**Witch:** Hrmph...  
I won't abide any back talk!

<!-- uid=1250015:10:1 -->

**Witch:** Enough. You've put me in a foul  
mood. I don't believe I can be  
bothered taking you as my student.

<!-- uid=1250015:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** I-I'm sorry! Look, I'll start  
cleaning right now!

<!-- uid=1250015:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ahaha... Good luck with this one.

<!-- uid=1250015:13:1 -->

**Silica:** Sinoooon!

<!-- uid=1250015:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hey, Silica.

<!-- uid=1250015:15:1 -->

**Silica:** How are your magic studies going?  
I came to see how you were...  
doing... Huh?

<!-- uid=1250015:16:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...

<!-- uid=1250015:17:1 -->

**Silica:** Sinon, are you okay? I barely  
recognize you, you look so  
worn out...

<!-- uid=1250015:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** No... I'm fine...

<!-- uid=1250015:19:1 -->

**Witch:** Do the laundry next, Sinon!  
And don't forget, you still have  
to prepare my meal!

<!-- uid=1250015:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** Y-Yes, ma'am!  
Right away!

<!-- uid=1250015:21:1 -->

**Silica:** Um, what's going on?

<!-- uid=1250015:22:1 -->

**Sinon:** Sorry, Silica, but I'm a little  
preoccupied at the moment...  
Could you hold on a second?

<!-- uid=1250015:23:1 -->

**Silica:** O-Of course...

<!-- uid=1250015:24:1 -->


## Story 1250017 · \[Spider Witch\] Sinon  Lv.70

Character Story

**Sinon:** Sorry that took so long, Silica.

<!-- uid=1250017:1:1 -->

**Silica:** Is the witch really okay with you  
talking to me now?

<!-- uid=1250017:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah, she's eating the lunch  
I made her.

<!-- uid=1250017:3:1 -->

**Silica:** Don't tell me it's been like this  
every day...

<!-- uid=1250017:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** Just about.

<!-- uid=1250017:5:1 -->

**Silica:** Oh my gosh, that's terrible!

<!-- uid=1250017:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah, it kinda sucks... But I  
decided I'd try to see it through  
to the end anyway.

<!-- uid=1250017:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** Though that witch hasn't taught  
me a single thing since I  
started...

<!-- uid=1250017:8:1 -->

**Silica:** Ahaha...

<!-- uid=1250017:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** Anyway, you know I'm more used to  
games like GGO, right?

<!-- uid=1250017:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** Maybe that's why I've gotten  
so fed up with this world. It  
just reeks of fantasy cliche...

<!-- uid=1250017:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** And maybe that's why I just  
couldn't find the motivation  
to work on my magic.

<!-- uid=1250017:12:1 -->

**Silica:** What about now?

<!-- uid=1250017:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** Earlier, the witch sent me out on  
an errand to pick some medicinal  
herbs in the forest.

<!-- uid=1250017:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** And while I was looking for them,  
I remembered something.

<!-- uid=1250017:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** The women they called "witches"  
in medieval Europe were actually  
doctors, right?

<!-- uid=1250017:16:1 -->

**Sinon:** By today's standards, they are,  
anyway, since they made medicine  
to help people get better.

<!-- uid=1250017:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Once I realized that, I realized  
something about witches...

<!-- uid=1250017:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** They aren't just fairy tales, but  
people skilled at a craft based  
in science.

<!-- uid=1250017:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** Once I started thinking of it that  
way, I stopped feeling so fed  
up with this place.

<!-- uid=1250017:20:1 -->

**Silica:** That makes sense. It's easier for  
you to be satisfied with something  
once you figure out how it works.

<!-- uid=1250017:21:1 -->

**Sinon:** Heh heh, exactly.

<!-- uid=1250017:22:1 -->

**Witch:** Sinon! I'm done eating!  
Come rub my shoulders!

<!-- uid=1250017:23:1 -->

**Sinon:** Alright, alright.  
I should get going.

<!-- uid=1250017:24:1 -->

**Silica:** Hahaha, hang in there...

<!-- uid=1250017:25:1 -->

## Story 1250053 · \[Perfect Play\] Sinon Lv.30

<!-- uid=1250053:11:1 -->

## Story 1250055 · \[Perfect Play\] Sinon Lv.50

Character Story

**Seven:** Imagine listening to a romantic  
love song, then finding out it's  
sung by Demon Murderzone X000.

<!-- uid=1250055:1:1 -->

**Seven:** It'll spoil the experience, right?  
Even if you don't have visuals  
on an audio track,

<!-- uid=1250055:2:1 -->

**Seven:** the artist's image sticks with you  
and affects how you react to the  
song.

<!-- uid=1250055:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** That's a rather extreme example,  
but I won't deny that a lot of  
people get popular on image alone.

<!-- uid=1250055:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** Still, I don't get why I'm popular  
now all of a sudden. This is just  
a game.

<!-- uid=1250055:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** It's not like I'm a real musician  
or a great performer. I just stand  
there and play.

<!-- uid=1250055:6:1 -->

**Leafa:** I don't know how she can explain  
it any better...

<!-- uid=1250055:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** It's like you're adding something  
extra to the performance just by  
being you.

<!-- uid=1250055:8:1 -->

**Seven:** Grr... How do I get it through  
your thick skull that you look  
awesome so people like you?!

<!-- uid=1250055:9:1 -->

**Seven:** Hmph!  
I'm leaving, but I'll be back!  
And I'll prove my point!

<!-- uid=1250055:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** Oh...kay? I'm confused.  
What's she getting so angry about?

<!-- uid=1250055:11:1 -->

**Leafa:** Aha. Ha. Ha...

<!-- uid=1250055:12:1 -->

## Story 1250075 · \[Leaning on My Fellow Soldier\] Sinon Lv.50

## Story 1250077 · \[Leaning on My Fellow Soldier\] Sinon Lv.70

Character Story

**Sinon:** Sorry, Orchis. It's my fault we  
both fell.

<!-- uid=1250077:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** I got upset and stomped off  
without thinking. You must've been  
close by when the floor collapsed.

<!-- uid=1250077:2:1 -->

**Orchis:** Don't worry about it. You're  
friends with my master, so that  
makes you my friend too.

<!-- uid=1250077:3:1 -->

I can help you navigate out of  
here.

<!-- uid=1250077:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** Oh yeah, good point...

<!-- uid=1250077:5:1 -->

**Orchis:** Take a left here.

<!-- uid=1250077:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Are you sure? The path leads down.

<!-- uid=1250077:7:1 -->

**Orchis:** The path to the right is littered  
with thousands of old, frayed  
electric cables.

<!-- uid=1250077:8:1 -->

**Orchis:** They still have power, though, so  
you'll take shock damage with  
every step.

<!-- uid=1250077:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** That doesn't sound like fun.  
But dangerous spots like that tend  
to have rares. Anything there?

<!-- uid=1250077:10:1 -->

**Orchis:** The chances we'll find anything  
are extremely low. This whole  
pitfall trap area is barren.

<!-- uid=1250077:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** Got it.

<!-- uid=1250077:12:1 -->

**Orchis:** We're almost back up top.

<!-- uid=1250077:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** Thanks, Orchis. It would've taken  
me ages to get out of there alone.

<!-- uid=1250077:14:1 -->

**Orchis:** I'm glad I was able to guide you.  
However...

<!-- uid=1250077:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yes?

<!-- uid=1250077:16:1 -->

**Orchis:** Princess has complained to me  
recently that I am too good at  
navigating areas for her liking.

<!-- uid=1250077:17:1 -->

**Orchis:** "This is so boring. I have nothing  
to do! And it's lame having a  
little brother that shows me up!"

<!-- uid=1250077:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** Heh, that's a surprising  
complaint.

<!-- uid=1250077:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hold on!

<!-- uid=1250077:20:1 -->

**Orchis:** What's the matter, Sinon?

<!-- uid=1250077:21:1 -->


## Story 1250078 · \[Leaning on My Fellow Soldier\] Sinon Lv.80

Character Story

**Sinon:** "Little brother"?  
What's the story with that?

<!-- uid=1250078:1:1 -->

**Orchis:** Ah, yes. She doesn't mean it  
literally. It's because she thinks  
of herself as my guardian.

<!-- uid=1250078:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...Right.

<!-- uid=1250078:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** You know, when I was a kid, my mom  
took me to an amusement park.  
But I didn't like it.

<!-- uid=1250078:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** I guess she noticed, because at  
some point during the trip, we  
stopped talking to each other.

<!-- uid=1250078:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** I was also always mature for my  
age. I could do house chores  
better than Mom most of the time.

<!-- uid=1250078:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Maybe my refusal to rely on her is  
part of why we've grown apart...

<!-- uid=1250078:7:1 -->

**Orchis:** Sorry, Sinon. I can't comprehend

<!-- uid=1250078:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** No, it's okay. I shouldn't have

thing like that with you.

<!-- uid=1250078:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** But still... Maybe talking about  
it helped me sort out my feelings.

<!-- uid=1250078:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** If we manage to find out something  
about how you were built...

<!-- uid=1250078:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** I think I'll give my mom a call.  
I haven't talked to her in  
forever.

<!-- uid=1250078:12:1 -->

**Orchis:** Sinon, I see a light up ahead.  
I believe that's our exit.

<!-- uid=1250078:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** Great. Let's get out of here.

<!-- uid=1250078:14:1 -->
