**Sinon:** Why don't you show a little  
gratitude?

<!-- uid=1250095:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** D-Don't just force things on  
people like that!

<!-- uid=1250095:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** W-Wait, Kirito!

<!-- uid=1250095:15:1 -->


## Story 1250097 · \[Sparkling Gunner\] Sinon Lv.70

Character Story

**Sinon:** Hey! I said wait!

<!-- uid=1250097:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** I already told you I don't want  
it!

<!-- uid=1250097:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** You don't need to get so up in  
arms about it...

<!-- uid=1250097:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, I'm not exactly in the habit  
of holding onto trash.

<!-- uid=1250097:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Not to mention, that kind of item  
activates an effect as soon as you  
take it out of your inventory...

<!-- uid=1250097:5:1 -->

**Monster:** Graaaauuugh!

<!-- uid=1250097:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Whoa?! Another sludge monster?!

<!-- uid=1250097:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** See? I told you! Even if a few of  
them have no effect, removing them  
from your inventory can be risky!

<!-- uid=1250097:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** I never imagined I'd end up  
fighting this thing again...

<!-- uid=1250097:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** Kirito, help me beat it!  
It's your punishment!

<!-- uid=1250097:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** My "punishment"? For what?

<!-- uid=1250097:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** For not accepting my "trash"!

<!-- uid=1250097:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** It wouldn't have made a  
difference!

<!-- uid=1250097:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** Stop your complaining, and  
help me out!

<!-- uid=1250097:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** Phew... We did it.

<!-- uid=1250097:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sinon, quick. Put that crystal  
back in your inventory.

<!-- uid=1250097:16:1 -->

**Sinon:** G-Got it... I don't want to ever  
see one of those things again...

<!-- uid=1250097:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wait, no... Actually...  
Can I keep one?

<!-- uid=1250097:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** Huh? Why?

<!-- uid=1250097:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Heh, us hardcore gamers are the  
worst kind of hoarders!

<!-- uid=1250097:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** Oh, come on... Hehe... Well, lucky  
for you, I'm feeling generous.

<!-- uid=1250097:21:1 -->

**Sinon:** Here you go.

<!-- uid=1250097:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Thanks.

<!-- uid=1250097:23:1 -->


## Story 1250098 · \[Sparkling Gunner\] Sinon Lv.80

Character Story

**Sinon:** All I wanted to do was relax, but  
I keep getting caught up in all  
this nonsense...

<!-- uid=1250098:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey, that was your own fault,  
you know?

<!-- uid=1250098:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** Sh-Shut up! Look, we'd be able to  
relax if this were a real beach,  
right?

<!-- uid=1250098:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Not really. Japanese beaches are  
just as crowded as this, if not  
more so.

<!-- uid=1250098:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Admittedly, it probably wouldn't  
be like this at a classy beach  
resort.

<!-- uid=1250098:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** Why don't you take me to one  
as an apology, then?

<!-- uid=1250098:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh?! What am I even apologizing  
for?

<!-- uid=1250098:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** You left us to fend for ourselves  
when we had to fight all those  
monsters on the beach!

<!-- uid=1250098:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** \*sigh\*... Okay, sure... Sometime.

<!-- uid=1250098:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** !

<!-- uid=1250098:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** Really?!

<!-- uid=1250098:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wh-What are you looking so  
surprised for?

<!-- uid=1250098:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** A-Ah... I mean... No reason...

<!-- uid=1250098:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** If you say so...  
Anyway, let's head back.

<!-- uid=1250098:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** R-Right...

<!-- uid=1250098:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...

<!-- uid=1250098:16:1 -->

**Sinon:** S-Sometime...?  
Did he... actually mean that?

<!-- uid=1250098:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** J-Just him and me?  
But I was only kidding...

<!-- uid=1250098:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** Heh, well, whatever. Don't mind if  
I do take him up on his offer.

<!-- uid=1250098:19:1 -->


## Story 1260011 · \[Twinkle Hearts\] Silica Lv.10

Character Story

**Asuna:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=1260011:1:1 -->

**Silica:** What's up, Asuna?

<!-- uid=1260011:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Look at the prices at this item  
shop, Silica...

<!-- uid=1260011:3:1 -->

**Silica:** Oh? Let's see...  
Yikes! They're so expensive!

<!-- uid=1260011:4:1 -->

**Silica:** And they even have a limit on how  
many one player can buy!

<!-- uid=1260011:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yup... And it's the same story  
at second-hand and player-run  
shops too.

<!-- uid=1260011:6:1 -->

**Silica:** What's going on?

<!-- uid=1260011:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** It looks like it's a dev team  
decision. I don't know what  
we're going to do now.

<!-- uid=1260011:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** This hits healers and buffers like  
you and me especially hard...

<!-- uid=1260011:9:1 -->

**Silica:** I know. We'll never be able to  
help everyone else out like this.

<!-- uid=1260011:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** And it's not just items. People  
who rely on gadgets are in the  
same predicament.

<!-- uid=1260011:11:1 -->

**Silica:** Oh, Asuna, look. It's an update  
message from the dev team.

<!-- uid=1260011:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Let's see... "In regards to the  
recent support item shortage..."

<!-- uid=1260011:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** We plan to release an update that  
will improve resource availability.  
Thank you for your patience.

<!-- uid=1260011:14:1 -->

**Silica:** Does that mean the NPC-run  
shops are going to go back to  
their usual prices?

<!-- uid=1260011:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Maybe. Or maybe they're planning  
on giving away lots of support  
items at an event or something?

<!-- uid=1260011:16:1 -->

**Silica:** Either way, I guess we have no  
choice but to make do with things  
as they are now.

<!-- uid=1260011:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah. We'll just have to conserve  
what we have and keep fighting.

<!-- uid=1260011:18:1 -->


## Story 1260013 · \[Twinkle Hearts\] Silica Lv.30

Character Story

**Sinon:** Asuna! Silica!

<!-- uid=1260013:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hi Sinonon. I didn't know you were  
here too. Are you doing some kind  
of event?

<!-- uid=1260013:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** Uh huh. There's a big chaotic  
firefight going on in this dungeon  
between monsters and players.

<!-- uid=1260013:3:1 -->

**Silica:** A chaotic firefight, huh... It  
MUST be chaotic if we can come in  
here without taking part in it.

<!-- uid=1260013:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** Well, it's lucky for me that you  
did. Can you heal me up? We're  
allowed to get help from other...

<!-- uid=1260013:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...players, and I can easily make  
it up to you if I win the reward  
they're offering.

<!-- uid=1260013:6:1 -->

**Silica:** Well, uh, as it turns out...

<!-- uid=1260013:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** This one healing item is all  
we've got right now.

<!-- uid=1260013:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** Huh? What do you mean?

<!-- uid=1260013:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Haven't you heard how there's a  
major shortage of support and  
healing items right now?

<!-- uid=1260013:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** Oh, now that you mention it...

<!-- uid=1260013:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Silica and I actually came  
here hoping we might find  
a drop or two.

<!-- uid=1260013:12:1 -->

**Silica:** But so far, nothing... And now  
we've wandered into the  
battlefield for this firefight.

<!-- uid=1260013:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** I see. I'd heard rumors about the  
shortage, but I didn't realize  
things were this bad.

<!-- uid=1260013:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Anyway, I can still heal you,  
but I'm afraid I won't be able  
to max you out.

<!-- uid=1260013:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** But that's your last one, right?  
Are you sure about this?

<!-- uid=1260013:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** Of course. Now that we've come  
this far, there's practically no  
difference between one and none.

<!-- uid=1260013:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Asuna...

<!-- uid=1260013:18:1 -->


## Story 1260015 · \[Twinkle Hearts\] Silica Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** Okay, that's all we can do for you  
right now.

<!-- uid=1260015:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** Well, thank you. I appreciate it.  
Okay, I'm going to head back  
to the frontline now.

<!-- uid=1260015:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** You two make sure you don't get  
caught up in a battle yourself.

<!-- uid=1260015:3:1 -->

**Silica:** We will! Good luck, Sinon!

<!-- uid=1260015:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** Thanks. If I do get that reward,  
I promise to make this up to you!

<!-- uid=1260015:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Okay, let's get going. It looks  
like there's another floor below  
us, so let's find the staircase.

<!-- uid=1260015:6:1 -->

**Silica:** Oh, okay. And, one more thing...

<!-- uid=1260015:7:1 -->

**Pina:** Chirrrp...

<!-- uid=1260015:8:1 -->

**Silica:** Pina's pretty thirsty. If there's  
a place where we can get a drink  
of water, can we stop there?

<!-- uid=1260015:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Of course. This IS an underground  
dungeon,

<!-- uid=1260015:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** so there's bound to be an  
underground spring if we  
just keep delving down.

<!-- uid=1260015:11:1 -->

**Silica:** Okay, great! Hang on just a little  
longer, Pina!

<!-- uid=1260015:12:1 -->

**Pina:** Chirp!

<!-- uid=1260015:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hey, Silica, Pina, look!  
Over there!

<!-- uid=1260015:14:1 -->

**Silica:** Yay, it's spring water!  
And it's so clean, too!

<!-- uid=1260015:15:1 -->

**Pina:** Chirrrp!

<!-- uid=1260015:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, looks like we should have  
no problem with this water. Why  
don't we all take a little break?

<!-- uid=1260015:17:1 -->

**Silica:** Sounds good!

<!-- uid=1260015:18:1 -->


## Story 1260017 · \[Twinkle Hearts\] Silica Lv.70

Character Story

**Silica:** ...Ah.

<!-- uid=1260017:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** What's up, Silica?

<!-- uid=1260017:2:1 -->

**Silica:** Well, it just occurred to me...

<!-- uid=1260017:3:1 -->

**Silica:** I know we're all out of healing  
items right now, but...

<!-- uid=1260017:4:1 -->

**Silica:** We still have some powder we could  
use to make our own, right...?

<!-- uid=1260017:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, sure. We found a lot of that  
in this dungeon alone. But we  
don't have any other materials,

<!-- uid=1260017:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** and I'm afraid it would be pretty  
hard to make healing items from  
this alone...

<!-- uid=1260017:7:1 -->

**Silica:** What if we dropped the powder into  
this underground stream?

<!-- uid=1260017:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** What would tha... Wait...!

<!-- uid=1260017:9:1 -->

**Silica:** A lot of these springs appear as  
healing spots in the game,

<!-- uid=1260017:10:1 -->

**Silica:** so maybe we could use this  
one as a substitute for the  
other item materials.

<!-- uid=1260017:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah... This water DID taste  
really good. We might just be able  
to make it into potions that way!

<!-- uid=1260017:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** I think the firefight going on  
here is an official event...

<!-- uid=1260017:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** And in that case, given the  
current healing item shortage,  
it would be really strange...

<!-- uid=1260017:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...if the dev team didn't offer  
any way at all for players to  
heal themselves!

<!-- uid=1260017:15:1 -->

**Silica:** I think it's worth a shot!

<!-- uid=1260017:16:1 -->


## Story 1260018 · \[Twinkle Hearts\] Silica Lv.80

Character Story

**Sinon:** Damn...!

<!-- uid=1260018:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** Don't know where I get off telling  
Asuna and Silica to be careful,  
given the state I'm in now...

<!-- uid=1260018:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** This isn't looking good at all...

<!-- uid=1260018:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sinonon!

<!-- uid=1260018:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** Asuna? Silica? What are you  
doing here?! It's too dangerous!

<!-- uid=1260018:5:1 -->

**Silica:** It's okay! We found a way to  
make lots of healing items!

<!-- uid=1260018:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Wait, really?

<!-- uid=1260018:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Here, drink this! It'll max out  
your HP in no time!

<!-- uid=1260018:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** We've still got plenty left, so  
don't hold back! Here, I'll give  
you some extras as backup.

<!-- uid=1260018:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** Asuna... Silica... Thank you!

<!-- uid=1260018:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** That's the stuff! Now I'm going to  
win this thing for sure!

<!-- uid=1260018:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, good luck!

<!-- uid=1260018:12:1 -->

**Silica:** ...I hope she wins.

<!-- uid=1260018:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Me too... Still, that spring water  
is going to dry up at some point.

<!-- uid=1260018:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** So it doesn't change the fact that  
we're suffering from a shortage...

<!-- uid=1260018:15:1 -->

**Silica:** I hope the developers manage to  
get that update out soon!

<!-- uid=1260018:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah. In the meantime, we'll just  
have to make do with what we have.

<!-- uid=1260018:17:1 -->


## Story 1260031 · \[Tie the Knot\] Asuna Lv.10

Character Story

**Asuna:** Alice, Eugeo! Look out! We've got  
a rifle team approaching from the  
right!

<!-- uid=1260031:1:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Got it! We'll handle this.  
Let's go, Alice!

<!-- uid=1260031:2:1 -->

**Alice:** Indeed we shall! Just try not to  
fall behind as we make our way  
over!

<!-- uid=1260031:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Alright. That takes care of all  
the enemy players around here.

<!-- uid=1260031:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah. Let's keep moving.

<!-- uid=1260031:5:1 -->

**Girl:** Urgh... Wait!

<!-- uid=1260031:6:1 -->

**Alice:** That girl! She can still move!

<!-- uid=1260031:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hold on, Alice. She can't fight  
anymore. Just give it a little  
time and the death pena--

<!-- uid=1260031:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sorry. I mean, she'll be  
transported to a nearby  
city automatically.

<!-- uid=1260031:9:1 -->

**Alice:** I see... That is the work of the  
great power unique to this  
world as I recall, yes?

<!-- uid=1260031:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's right.

<!-- uid=1260031:11:1 -->

**Girl:** You guys should know it's really  
dangerous up ahead. I'm not  
trying to trick you.

<!-- uid=1260031:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Why? What's up ahead?

<!-- uid=1260031:13:1 -->

**Girl:** I know this sounds crazy, but  
there's a giant white whale flying  
across the sky.

<!-- uid=1260031:14:1 -->

**Girl:** I heard the other players who  
partook in the event talking  
about it earlier.

<!-- uid=1260031:15:1 -->

**Girl:** They said it attacks all  
players in the event that it  
sees indiscriminately.

<!-- uid=1260031:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** A white whale? Really...?

<!-- uid=1260031:17:1 -->

**Alice:** Whales... If I'm not mistaken,  
I believe they are normally found  
in the "oceans" of this world.

<!-- uid=1260031:18:1 -->

**Eugeo:** We saw one in the  
sea back at Alfheim.

<!-- uid=1260031:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** You mentioned that it attacks any  
players that it sees. Is it  
that dangerously strong?

<!-- uid=1260031:20:1 -->

**Girl:** It's not just strong. It also  
wears a...wedding dress.

<!-- uid=1260031:21:1 -->

**Girl:** It likes to steal the white  
from...girls' dresses.

<!-- uid=1260031:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** White? As in the color itself?

<!-- uid=1260031:23:1 -->


## Story 1260033 · \[Tie the Knot\] Asuna Lv.30

Character Story

**Kirito:** From what the girl said,  
that whale appeared  
somewhere around here.

<!-- uid=1260033:1:1 -->

**Alice:** Can we trust her? I find it hard  
to believe Asuna's dress could  
darken from a mere attack.

<!-- uid=1260033:2:1 -->

**Eugeo:** That's what she said...that girls'  
clothes lose their whiteness and  
turn black or gray.

<!-- uid=1260033:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Plus, this dress will apparently  
lose its buffs and not qualify  
for the festivities if I get hit.

<!-- uid=1260033:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's probably a special enemy made  
just for this event, and a pretty  
serious one.

<!-- uid=1260033:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Who knows what it's after, but one  
thing's for sure: something has  
to be done about it.

<!-- uid=1260033:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** If we can, we should exterminate  
it. It's too much of a danger to  
women players not to.

<!-- uid=1260033:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, I agree.

<!-- uid=1260033:8:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Still, it's rather funny when you  
take a step back and think about  
it.

<!-- uid=1260033:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Funny? Eugeo, this is a dangerous  
enemy we're talking about here.

<!-- uid=1260033:10:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I know that. It's just interesting  
that it's a giant whale flying  
around like some kind of bird.

<!-- uid=1260033:11:1 -->

**Eugeo:** It must be quite a  
sight seeing a whale  
roam freely in the sky.

<!-- uid=1260033:12:1 -->

**Alice:** Very true. A white whale flying  
in a dark, ashen sky over a land  
of ruin bereft of white itself.

<!-- uid=1260033:13:1 -->

**Alice:** It sounds like the sort of scene  
one would only see depicted  
in a painting.

<!-- uid=1260033:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ahaha, that's surprisingly poetic  
coming from you.

<!-- uid=1260033:15:1 -->

**Alice:** E-Excuse me? What do you mean  
"surprisingly"?!

<!-- uid=1260033:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, I get what you mean, Alice.  
There is something beautiful about  
it all when you think about it.

<!-- uid=1260033:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Who knows if we'll actually beat  
that whale, but I hope we get to  
at least see it once.

<!-- uid=1260033:18:1 -->


## Story 1260035 · \[Tie the Knot\] Asuna Lv.50

Character Story

**Girl:** Fire! FIRE!

<!-- uid=1260035:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Looks like more girls are shooting  
at each other over there.

<!-- uid=1260035:2:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I'd say there are about  
ten girls fighting in each group.

<!-- uid=1260035:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** They don't seem to have noticed  
us, so it might be best  
to stay out of it.

<!-- uid=1260035:4:1 -->

**Alice:** Are you certain it's wise to leave  
them be like this without  
fighting them?

<!-- uid=1260035:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** In this instance, there are so  
many of them, it'd be really tough  
to take them all on at once.

<!-- uid=1260035:6:1 -->

**Girl:** Aaah! What's that thing over  
there?!

<!-- uid=1260035:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** What's happening? Wait, is that--?

<!-- uid=1260035:8:1 -->

**Alice:** It's...an enormous...

<!-- uid=1260035:9:1 -->

**Eugeo:** An enormous white creature in the  
sky. Could that be the whale  
that we heard about?!

<!-- uid=1260035:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ahaha, It's definitely a humongous  
whale flying around.

<!-- uid=1260035:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Guys, be quiet! That whale's  
heading straight for that group  
of girls over there!

<!-- uid=1260035:12:1 -->

**White Whale:** Graaaaaaoooooh!

<!-- uid=1260035:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's attacking the players that  
were fighting each other earlier!

<!-- uid=1260035:14:1 -->

**Eugeo:** As much as I hate to say this,  
it's probably in our best  
interests to remain hidden.

<!-- uid=1260035:15:1 -->

**Alice:** Look at the flash of light that  
the whale is emitting from its  
body!

<!-- uid=1260035:16:1 -->

**Alice:** It's just as we were told! The  
white on those girls' clothes is  
turning to black!

<!-- uid=1260035:17:1 -->

**Female Player A:** What the heck is happening?!

<!-- uid=1260035:18:1 -->

**Female Player B:** No!! My wedding dress is all black now!

<!-- uid=1260035:19:1 -->

**Female Player C:** Me, too! And the buffs on mine  
disappeared!

<!-- uid=1260035:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** I guess everything that girl told  
us was true, then.

<!-- uid=1260035:21:1 -->

**Alice:** Even so, I must admit, that whale  
is rather beautiful to witness in  
person.

<!-- uid=1260035:22:1 -->

**Eugeo:** It is. I know this is no time to  
be admiring it, but I can't help  
but be captivated by it.

<!-- uid=1260035:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** I get what you mean. It's like  
we're watching something ripped  
out of a blockbuster movie.

<!-- uid=1260035:24:1 -->

**White Whale:** Graaawr!

<!-- uid=1260035:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** It looks like it takes off as soon  
as it's done turning everyone's  
dresses black.

<!-- uid=1260035:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** What do we do now, then?

<!-- uid=1260035:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** We go after it! We might find  
where that thing rests when  
it's not attacking anyone.

<!-- uid=1260035:28:1 -->

**Asuna:** Plus, if we attack it while it's  
asleep, we might have a shot at  
taking it down.

<!-- uid=1260035:29:1 -->

**Alice:** Asuna, do we have to defeat that beautiful character?

<!-- uid=1260035:30:1 -->

**Asuna:** Um... We have to. If we don't do  
something about, it's going to  
impact the festivities.

<!-- uid=1260035:31:1 -->

**Alice:** Yes, you're right...  
As beautiful as it is, it's a  
wicked creature nonetheless. Let's go.

<!-- uid=1260035:32:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I think so, too. I have no problem  
with fighting it.

<!-- uid=1260035:33:1 -->

**Asuna:** Thanks, you two. I appreciate you  
being so understanding.

<!-- uid=1260035:34:1 -->

**Kirito:** We might stand out if we follow  
it in one group. I think we should  
split up and keep our distance.

<!-- uid=1260035:35:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's a smart idea.

<!-- uid=1260035:36:1 -->


## Story 1260037 · \[Tie the Knot\] Asuna Lv.70

Character Story

**Liz:** That's weird. I heard there was  
a battle between players  
doing the wedding event.

<!-- uid=1260037:1:1 -->

**Liz:** I came here to check it out, but  
I don't see anything going on.

**Agil:** That is weird. But I see bullet holes,  
so they probably were  
fighting here, don't you think?

<!-- uid=1260037:3:1 -->

**Liz:** Hey, you're right. And judging  
from the number of them, it seems  
like there were lots of people.

<!-- uid=1260037:4:1 -->

**Klein:** Huh? Look! I see a  
player standing  
over there!

## Story 1260038 · \[Tie the Knot\] Asuna Lv.80

Character Story

**White Whale:** Groaaah!

<!-- uid=1260038:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Just how far does it intend to  
go?

<!-- uid=1260038:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Look! I see someone! If I  
don't do something, that whale is  
going to get to her!

<!-- uid=1260038:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Look out! It's not safe here!

<!-- uid=1260038:4:1 -->

**White Whale:** Grooowrgh...

<!-- uid=1260038:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** What? Is that...?! Huh?!  
The whale! It vanished into thin  
air!

<!-- uid=1260038:6:1 -->

**Zeliska:** Whew. Now I can rest easy  
a little.

<!-- uid=1260038:7:1 -->

**Zeliska:** Oh hey there, Asuna.  
What brings you here?

<!-- uid=1260038:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Zeliska! I should be asking you  
that! And what just happened with  
that white whale?

<!-- uid=1260038:9:1 -->

**Zeliska:** Hehe, oh, I simply used my  
developer's powers. That's it.

<!-- uid=1260038:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Wait, then does that mean you're  
the one that unleashed that  
white whale into the game?

<!-- uid=1260038:11:1 -->

**Zeliska:** Yeah. I'm sure you've noticed what  
a big hit this whole event is.  
I'm glad players like it, but...

<!-- uid=1260038:12:1 -->

**Zeliska:** People have gotten so into it,  
they're accumulating way more EXP  
and points than we anticipated.

<!-- uid=1260038:13:1 -->

**Zeliska:** As a result, the company we're  
working with for this event asked  
us to curb the influx of players.

<!-- uid=1260038:14:1 -->

**Zeliska:** And the best way to do that on  
short notice was to whip up a  
common enemy for all players.

<!-- uid=1260038:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** That explains a lot. So that's why  
that whale was so ruthless, then.

<!-- uid=1260038:16:1 -->

**Zeliska:** There's a myth for it, too. It was  
once a rare albino whale that  
lived in the sea.

<!-- uid=1260038:17:1 -->

**Zeliska:** Once the seas became too polluted  
for it to live in, it  
then took to the skies.

<!-- uid=1260038:18:1 -->

**Zeliska:** We were going to put it in at some  
point and it just worked out to  
be now since we needed an enemy.

<!-- uid=1260038:19:1 -->

**Zeliska:** All we did was add the part about  
it stealing the white out of wedding  
dresses and then let it loose.

<!-- uid=1260038:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Wow, the stuff that goes on behind  
the scenes. Still, should you be  
sharing all of this with me?

<!-- uid=1260038:21:1 -->

**Zeliska:** I mean, you saw me get rid of it.  
I couldn't lie to you after that.  
But keep it to yourself, okay?

<!-- uid=1260038:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sure, no problem. But just so you  
know, next time I see it, I'm  
definitely taking it down.

<!-- uid=1260038:23:1 -->

**Zeliska:** Hehe, I'd love to see you try.  
It's going to be tough. It'll be  
like fighting a natural disaster.

<!-- uid=1260038:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** Now the question is how to defeat  
those retreating enemies...

<!-- uid=1260038:25:1 -->

**Zeliska:** I came up with a plan when I heard  
about them.

<!-- uid=1260038:26:1 -->


## Story 1260041 · \[Hidden Passion\] Sinon Lv.10

 over ornaments, though.

## Story 1260043 · \[Hidden Passion\] Sinon Lv.30

push yourselves too hard.

## Story 1260051 · \[Winning Procedure\] Sinon Lv.10

Character Story

**Sinon:** ...

<!-- uid=1260051:1:1 -->

**Silica:** What's wrong, Sinon?

**Silica:** It should be pretty hard to walk

**Sinon:** We're at a disadvantage in this

<!-- uid=1260051:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** from BoB and only leaked the

**Silica:** Hey, that's not fair!

**Silica:** Oh, well I guess it's still fair

**Sinon:** Hehe, yep.

**Silica:** If they're lying in wait for

## Story 1260055 · \[Winning Procedure\] Sinon Lv.50

Character Story

**Silica:** We're still a long way from town,

**Silica:** L-Look! The trees are all falling

**Sinon:** No way, is the Death Gun squadron

**Silica:** Are they doing this so that we  
can't use the grapples?

## Story 1260063 · \[Strength to Change Oneself\] Sinon Lv.30

Character Story

**Thokk:** Oh, Sinon. Hi.

<!-- uid=1260063:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hey, Thokk. I came to check in  
things. Anything unusual happen  
recently?

<!-- uid=1260063:2:1 -->

**Thokk:** Nope. All quiet on the home front.  
Hellfire Urdr's ring hasn't done  
anything weird, either.

<!-- uid=1260063:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** Well, that's good to hear. I know  
Kirito was concerned about that,  
too.

<!-- uid=1260063:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** He figures she won't stay sealed  
too long, so the sooner we get  
things set up, the better.

<!-- uid=1260063:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** Don't worry. I know what I'm  
doing here. Hellfire Urdr will be  
taken care of in my VRMMO.

<!-- uid=1260063:6:1 -->

**Thokk:** I'll be giving her a good place  
so she can be safely reborn and  
given a new lease on life.

<!-- uid=1260063:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** That's reassuring. I'm not so  
worried now.

<!-- uid=1260063:8:1 -->

**Thokk:** Oh, while you're here, Sinon,  
there's something I wanted to  
ask you. About Kirito, I mean.

<!-- uid=1260063:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** Kirito? What is it?

<!-- uid=1260063:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** I already knew that Kirito was  
famous here in ALO for being  
a top-tier player and all that.

<!-- uid=1260063:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** And I know that he also runs  
around GGO fighting with that  
Photon Sword of his.

<!-- uid=1260063:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** But I get the feeling there's more  
to him than that. Something else  
that makes him so different...

<!-- uid=1260063:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...

<!-- uid=1260063:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** Just what kind of person is he,

<!-- uid=1260063:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** I don't think that's for me to  
tell you. We're talking about his  
personal life. You should ask him.

<!-- uid=1260063:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** N-No way. I can't do that!

<!-- uid=1260063:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Why not?

<!-- uid=1260063:18:1 -->

**Thokk:** I mean, 'cause...he's s'posed to  
be my nemesis! Maybe not so much  
lately, but he IS a fairy!

<!-- uid=1260063:19:1 -->

**Thokk:** Makoto's cozying up to him, y'see,  
what with their history. I need  
to keep him at arm's length!

<!-- uid=1260063:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** It might feel a bit obvious, but  
then why don't you ask Makoto  
since you and she are so close?

<!-- uid=1260063:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** I would, but the problem with that  
is she didn't hang out with him  
and Leafa back then.

<!-- uid=1260063:22:1 -->

**Thokk:** So I'm wondering if something  
happened with him during that  
time she wouldn't know about.

<!-- uid=1260063:23:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...Wow, you're real sharp, Thokk.

<!-- uid=1260063:24:1 -->

**Thokk:** What was that?

<!-- uid=1260063:25:1 -->

**Sinon:** Uh, nothing. Nothing at all.

<!-- uid=1260063:26:1 -->


## Story 1260065 · \[Strength to Change Oneself\] Sinon Lv.50

Character Story

**Thokk:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=1260065:1:1 -->

**Makoto:** What are you up to, Thokk?  
Working on Nibelungen Purgatory  
some more?

<!-- uid=1260065:2:1 -->

**Thokk:** Kinda. I'm surfing the web while  
I tell the programmers what they  
need to work on.

<!-- uid=1260065:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** C'mon, Thokk. You're supposed to  
be working here. Concentrate.

<!-- uid=1260065:4:1 -->

**Thokk:** I'm not doing it to slack off.  
It actually helps me relax so  
I can work better.

<!-- uid=1260065:5:1 -->

**Makoto:** Yeah, like I haven't heard that  
one before. Of course you'd say  
that.

<!-- uid=1260065:6:1 -->

**Thokk:** Interesting...

<!-- uid=1260065:7:1 -->

**Makoto:** Anyway, are you looking something  
up? You sure have a lot of windows  
open.

<!-- uid=1260065:8:1 -->

**Thokk:** The SAO Record Collection...

<!-- uid=1260065:9:1 -->

**Makoto:** SAO? You mean that old VRMMO that  
used to be online before ALO where  
all those deaths happened?

<!-- uid=1260065:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yep. SAO was built to run on the  
NerveGear, which was a predecessor  
to the AmuSphere.

<!-- uid=1260065:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** They were rigged to kill. People  
literally had to fight for their  
lives for two whole years.

<!-- uid=1260065:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** And this book here assembles bits  
and pieces of records to try  
and tell the bigger story.

<!-- uid=1260065:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** Okay, but why are you reading  
such a thing in the first place?

<!-- uid=1260065:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** We saw a glimpse of what that sort  
of fighting is like in GGO, but in  
SAO, it was part of everyday life.

<!-- uid=1260065:15:1 -->

**Thokk:** Not many people could come out of  
an ordeal like that without at  
least a few scars haunting them.

<!-- uid=1260065:16:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wait, you don't think that  
Kirito...that Kazu was caught up  
in that mess, do you?

<!-- uid=1260065:17:1 -->

**Thokk:** ...

<!-- uid=1260065:18:1 -->


## Story 1260067 · \[Strength to Change Oneself\] Sinon Lv.70

Character Story

**Thokk:** Like you've said before, it took  
experience to stay so calm during  
that fight with Death Gun.

<!-- uid=1260067:1:1 -->

**Thokk:** And I can't think of a "better"  
place to get it than SAO, where  
every fight could be your last.

<!-- uid=1260067:2:1 -->

**Makoto:** B-But Kazu's never said a word  
about it. How can you be so sure  
he was involved in it?

<!-- uid=1260067:3:1 -->

**Thokk:** Of course he hasn't. What survivor  
is gonna feel like talking about  
it after what they went through?

<!-- uid=1260067:4:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's fair. It's probably not the  
easiest thing for them to discuss  
when it was so traumatic.

<!-- uid=1260067:5:1 -->

**Makoto:** But then why is Kazu still hanging  
out in virtual worlds? Why doesn't  
he stay away from them?

<!-- uid=1260067:6:1 -->

**Thokk:** There are parts of this book  
that reference someone known as  
the "Black Swordsman."

<!-- uid=1260067:7:1 -->

**Thokk:** And the details surrounding this  
swordsman remind me of our own  
Spriggan, Kirito.

<!-- uid=1260067:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** What makes you say that? What sort  
of player was this Black  
Swordsman in SAO?

<!-- uid=1260067:9:1 -->

**Thokk:** At first they weren't well liked  
because they'd played the beta and  
knew some of what lay ahead.

<!-- uid=1260067:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** They got called “beaters" and got  
shunned for it, so they kept  
progressing on their own.

<!-- uid=1260067:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** But in the end, their actions  
exposed Akihiko Kayaba, who was  
secretly inside the game, too.

<!-- uid=1260067:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** And that helped lead to everyone  
finally escaping from SAO. At  
least, that's what's written here.

<!-- uid=1260067:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** ...

<!-- uid=1260067:14:1 -->

**Makoto:** But I don't have the guts to walk  
up and ask him, either. I'm scared  
what the answer might be.

<!-- uid=1260067:15:1 -->

**Thokk:** But it would make sense if he was  
there. It'd explain why he was  
able to fight Death Gun so well.

<!-- uid=1260067:16:1 -->

**Makoto:** Yeah, you're not wrong about that,  
I guess.

<!-- uid=1260067:17:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hmm... Hey, speak of the devil.  
Kirito just messaged me!

<!-- uid=1260067:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** He wants to know if we want to  
hunt monsters with him in Alfheim  
to blow some steam and stuff.

<!-- uid=1260067:19:1 -->

**Makoto:** He realizes we're both busy, so  
we don't have to go, but what  
do you think?

<!-- uid=1260067:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** I am getting pretty tired of how  
still the air is down here.  
I say we go!

<!-- uid=1260067:21:1 -->

**Makoto:** Okay. Then I'll let him know  
we're on our way.

<!-- uid=1260067:22:1 -->


## Story 1260068 · \[Strength to Change Oneself\] Sinon Lv.80

Character Story

**Kirito:** Hey, look. Check this out,

## Story 1260075 · \[VR World High Priestess\] Sinon Lv.50

Character Story

**Kirito:** I've been thinking, we don't know  
each other that well yet. How about  
we share a little about ourselves?

<!-- uid=1260075:1:1 -->

**Mona:** We are the great Phantom Thieves!

school students, right?

than us.

<!-- uid=1260075:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** We won't pry if you'd rather us

ourselves, get the ball rolling.

<!-- uid=1260075:9:1 -->

ordinary students. Well...one  
of us is a bit of a special case.

corporation.

<!-- uid=1260075:12:1 -->

<!-- uid=1260075:13:1 -->

not totally free to choose my own  
life. It's a pain sometimes.

<!-- uid=1260075:14:1 -->

you pick who you marry?

<!-- uid=1260075:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Urk...

<!-- uid=1260075:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Nnnrgh...

<!-- uid=1260075:17:1 -->

**Noir:** Bingo?

<!-- uid=1260075:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** I can't...deny that...

<!-- uid=1260075:19:1 -->

sudden burst of curiosity?

<!-- uid=1260075:20:1 -->

**Noir:** Because I think you and I have  
a lot in common.

<!-- uid=1260075:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** We do?

<!-- uid=1260075:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wait a sec, Noir! That means...

but you're a berserk healer too?!

<!-- uid=1260075:23:1 -->

**Noir:** I'm...not sure I follow?

<!-- uid=1260075:24:1 -->

<!-- uid=1260075:25:1 -->

<!-- uid=1260075:26:1 -->

from dainty debutante into violent  
killing machine, they'd freak.

<!-- uid=1260075:27:1 -->

<!-- uid=1260075:29:1 -->

<!-- uid=1260075:30:1 -->

<!-- uid=1260075:31:1 -->


## Story 1260077 · \[VR World High Priestess\] Sinon Lv.70

Character Story

**Leafa:** I had a thought when I saw your

people the wrong idea.

<!-- uid=1260077:25:1 -->

<!-- uid=1260077:26:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...Sorry, Queen. Looks like

<!-- uid=1260077:27:1 -->

## Story 1260078 · \[VR World High Priestess\] Sinon Lv.80

## Story 1260127 · \[Sweet School Beauty\] Asuna Lv.70

Character Story

**Liz:** Wait... You're double-teaming  
this?!

<!-- uid=1260127:1:1 -->

**Silica:** That's very reassuring, but...

<!-- uid=1260127:2:1 -->

**Silica:** Um... You'll be gentle on us,

**Asuna:** Hmmm?

**Silica:** Whaat?!

**Asuna:** That's why I think proper study is

<!-- uid=1260127:23:1 -->

**Liz:** I hate to admit it, but yeah...  
We're just good at the wrong  
subjects.

## Story 1440011 · \[Cool-Headed Sniper\] Sinon Lv.10

Character Story

**Silica:** Good afternoon, Sinon.

<!-- uid=1440011:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** Silica... Hello.

<!-- uid=1440011:2:1 -->

**Silica:** It's been a bit since you  
converted your GGO avatar to ALO.

<!-- uid=1440011:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah, I guess...

<!-- uid=1440011:4:1 -->

**Silica:** Um... Sinon? Are you okay?

**Sinon:** Well...the truth is, I just  
respawned. I got killed.

<!-- uid=1440011:6:1 -->

**Silica:** What?!

<!-- uid=1440011:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** I tried soloing that new mountain  
quest, but it was way too hard.

<!-- uid=1440011:8:1 -->

**Silica:** You tried doing that quest solo?!

<!-- uid=1440011:9:1 -->

**Silica:** Hold up! Everyone's saying that

whole raid party!

<!-- uid=1440011:10:1 -->

**Silica:** Why in the world did you try  
to solo it?!

<!-- uid=1440011:11:1 -->

you're far too reckless...

<!-- uid=1440011:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** Well, I'm still pretty new here

<!-- uid=1440011:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** So the death penalty doesn't  
really sting me that much.

<!-- uid=1440011:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** Besides, none of the items I

never do that...

<!-- uid=1440011:17:1 -->


## Story 1440013 · \[Cool-Headed Sniper\] Sinon Lv.30

Character Story

**Sinon:** It's not like I went in without a  
plan. All the quest mobs are  
demi-humans, right?

<!-- uid=1440013:1:1 -->

**Silica:** Demi-humans...  
Like goblins and orcs, right?

<!-- uid=1440013:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** Exactly. I had this image that  
those sorts of monsters were  
primarily melee fighters.

<!-- uid=1440013:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** Even if there were ranged mobs,  
they'd have bows. No bow can  
compete with my range.

<!-- uid=1440013:4:1 -->

**Silica:** In other words...  
You planned on whittling all of  
them down from a distance?

<!-- uid=1440013:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** That's right. In parlance, I was  
going to kite the whole war camp.

<!-- uid=1440013:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** I would keep my distance, stay out  
of their attack range, and shoot  
'em all 'till they were dead.

<!-- uid=1440013:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** It might have taken forever,  
but I should've been able to  
solo the whole thing like that...

<!-- uid=1440013:8:1 -->

**Silica:** That sounds like it could work...

<!-- uid=1440013:9:1 -->

**Silica:** But then, what happened?

<!-- uid=1440013:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** They had a ballista.

<!-- uid=1440013:11:1 -->

**Silica:** Oh...

<!-- uid=1440013:12:1 -->

**Silica:** I guess a ballista does have way  
longer range than any bow, huh?

<!-- uid=1440013:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** You said it. And Cait Sith are  
terrible with ballistae, so using  
one to fight back was out.

<!-- uid=1440013:14:1 -->

**Silica:** Yeah. You'd need the strength of  
a Gnome to handle one.

<!-- uid=1440013:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** So I went in with zero research  
and got gunned down by a hail of  
giant arrows. Yay me.

<!-- uid=1440013:16:1 -->

**Sinon:** I guess trying to game the system  
was a bad idea.

<!-- uid=1440013:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Heh. I underestimated ALO's  
admins.

<!-- uid=1440013:18:1 -->


## Story 1440015 · \[Cool-Headed Sniper\] Sinon Lv.50

Character Story

**Silica:** Hehe, I can see it in your eyes!  
You haven't given up at all,  
have you?

**Sinon:** H-Huh? I haven't...?

<!-- uid=1440015:2:1 -->

**Silica:** I know exactly what you're  
thinking. 'If I could only deal  
with that ballista...'

<!-- uid=1440015:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** Okay, busted...but I'm fresh out

**Silica:** Well, you don't have to take out  
the ballista, right? Just make it  
so it can't bother you...

<!-- uid=1440015:5:1 -->

**Silica:** If only you could disrupt the  
ballista engineers long enough  
to take out the other mobs...

<!-- uid=1440015:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** If only...

<!-- uid=1440015:7:1 -->

**Silica:** Hmmm...  
If I could get close to it...

<!-- uid=1440015:8:1 -->

**Silica:** Pina and I could distract them  
so they couldn't fire...

<!-- uid=1440015:9:1 -->

**Silica:** But there's no way I could get  
in there alone...

<!-- uid=1440015:10:1 -->

**Silica:** Ahaha...  
I guess it IS impossible.

<!-- uid=1440015:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** Perhaps...

<!-- uid=1440015:12:1 -->

**Silica:** I thought about flying in from  
above too...

<!-- uid=1440015:13:1 -->

**Silica:** But the whole thing takes place

<!-- uid=1440015:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah. It's a pretty big cave, but

<!-- uid=1440015:15:1 -->

**Silica:** I guess we're out of options...

<!-- uid=1440015:16:1 -->

**Alicia:** Hey hey! Look at you two kitties!  
What's with the gloom and doom?

<!-- uid=1440015:17:1 -->

**Silica:** Oh! Hi, Alicia!

<!-- uid=1440015:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...Wh-?!

<!-- uid=1440015:19:1 -->

**Alicia:** Something troubling you, huh?  
Give me the lowdown!

<!-- uid=1440015:20:1 -->

**Alicia:** I'm the Cait Sith boss!  
It's my job to help a fellow cat!

<!-- uid=1440015:21:1 -->

**Silica:** A-Actually...

<!-- uid=1440015:22:1 -->


## Story 1440017 · \[Cool-Headed Sniper\] Sinon Lv.70

Character Story

**Alicia:** Silica! I'm going to descend here!  
Get ready for drop off!

<!-- uid=1440017:1:1 -->

**Silica:** Got it, Alicia! Thank you very  
much for giving me a ride on  
your dragon!

<!-- uid=1440017:2:1 -->

**Alicia:** Nahaha! Come on, it was nothing!  
I'm just happy we're not PvPing!

<!-- uid=1440017:3:1 -->

**Silica:** Alicia! I'm good!  
Fall back for now!

<!-- uid=1440017:4:1 -->

**Alicia:** Got it! Just signal me when you  
need to be picked up!

<!-- uid=1440017:5:1 -->

**Silica:** Okay! Thanks again!

<!-- uid=1440017:6:1 -->

**Silica:** Now it's my time to shine!

<!-- uid=1440017:7:1 -->

**Pina:** Chirrrp!

<!-- uid=1440017:8:1 -->

**Silica:** Pina, remember! We don't have to  
defeat them.

<!-- uid=1440017:9:1 -->

**Silica:** We just need to distract the  
ballista team while Sinon attacks!

<!-- uid=1440017:10:1 -->

**Pina:** Chirp chirp!

<!-- uid=1440017:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** The ballista's stopped...

<!-- uid=1440017:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** Heh. Silica... Nicely done.  
Now this quest is all but mine.

<!-- uid=1440017:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** Sorry, monsters, but today's your  
unlucky day. You will fall before  
my overwhelming power!

<!-- uid=1440017:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** Now get ready to die!

## Story 1440018 · \[Cool-Headed Sniper\] Sinon Lv.80

Character Story

**Silica:** I never imagined we could beat  
this quest with only three people!

<!-- uid=1440018:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hehe, I second that.

<!-- uid=1440018:2:1 -->

**Alicia:** You say three, but I didn't do

**Sinon:** She's right, you know.  
Thanks, Alicia-  
Ack, I mean "boss."

<!-- uid=1440018:6:1 -->

**Alicia:** Happy to hear it. But seriously,

<!-- uid=1440018:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** Alright then... Thanks, Alicia.

**Alicia:** Nah, don't mention it. Besides,  
I earned bragging rights today!  
We're amazing!

<!-- uid=1440018:10:1 -->

**Alicia:** Let me know if you ever need my  
help again! I've got your backs!

<!-- uid=1440018:11:1 -->

**Silica:** We will! Thank you again, Alicia!

<!-- uid=1440018:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** I'll remember that.  
See you again soon.

## Story 1440041 · \[Flowering Valkyrie\] Sinon Lv.10

Character Story

**Asuna:** Aaah!

<!-- uid=1440041:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** My foot got caught in the mud...

<!-- uid=1440041:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...

<!-- uid=1440041:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ow! It's hard to walk around here  
when I keep running into branches.

<!-- uid=1440041:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** None of the races other than  
Cait Sith are really made to  
traverse this forest.

<!-- uid=1440041:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** It's an outdoor dungeon that's  
practically built for our eyesight  
and nimble abilities.

<!-- uid=1440041:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** Should've listened to me when  
you had the chance.

<!-- uid=1440041:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** I-I'm sorry. I don't mean to be

are you?

**Asuna:** But it's so thick with branches,

here with me?

<!-- uid=1440041:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...

<!-- uid=1440041:15:1 -->


## Story 1440043 · \[Flowering Valkyrie\] Sinon Lv.30

Character Story

**Asuna:** I don't necessarily like that this  
game has a race system, or at  
least how hard the devs push it.

<!-- uid=1440043:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** When you get down to it, it mostly  
serves to emphasize PvP in ALO.  
Wouldn't you agree?

<!-- uid=1440043:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah, sure.

<!-- uid=1440043:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, I think deep down, part of  
me wants to... rebel against that  
whole aspect, if that makes sense.

<!-- uid=1440043:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** I don't follow. Are you saying you  
don't like the system because you  
don't want to fight other players?

<!-- uid=1440043:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Right. PvP in these games only  
reminds me of SAO. I'm sure you  
can imagine why...

<!-- uid=1440043:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** But it's more than that. I think  
I also don't want to let this  
world "beat" me, in a sense.

<!-- uid=1440043:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** What do you mean?

<!-- uid=1440043:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** I want to challenge what's  
possible in this game, even if my  
race puts me at a disadvantage.

<!-- uid=1440043:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Just because something might be  
harder as a different race doesn't  
mean it's outright impossible.

<!-- uid=1440043:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** I remember when I first got stuck  
in SAO, I didn't leave town for  
a while.

<!-- uid=1440043:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** After some things happened, I felt  
determined to not let myself be  
done in by that world.

<!-- uid=1440043:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** And I think that feeling still  
lives on inside me even after  
all this time.

<!-- uid=1440043:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** Wow. I think I get what you're  
saying, but I never pegged you  
as the rebellious type.

<!-- uid=1440043:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ahaha, I know, right? Tell me  
about it.

<!-- uid=1440043:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** That said, while I admire your  
drive, don't think I'm going to  
make it any easier for you.

<!-- uid=1440043:16:1 -->

**Sinon:** If you want to follow me, you're  
going to have to use everything  
you can to keep up!

<!-- uid=1440043:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Right!

<!-- uid=1440043:18:1 -->


## Story 1440045 · \[Flowering Valkyrie\] Sinon Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** This sure is a thick forest,  
though...

<!-- uid=1440045:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** I can see why people call it  
a sea of trees.

<!-- uid=1440045:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah, the nature here is no joke.

<!-- uid=1440045:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** Neither is our target that we're  
after in the depths of this  
above-ground dungeon.

<!-- uid=1440045:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Uh... It was called the "Phantom  
Tiger," right?

<!-- uid=1440045:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** Right. It's an extremely rare  
monster that hardly ever shows  
its face.

<!-- uid=1440045:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Even if you do run into it, it's  
supposed to be really tough to  
take down.

<!-- uid=1440045:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Maybe, but in this kind of  
terrain, I wouldn't say it's at  
a complete advantage, either.

<!-- uid=1440045:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** You have to figure that between  
all these trees and the mud that  
it can't move around easily.

<!-- uid=1440045:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** That's true, but it's also worth  
mentioning that this monster's  
good at climbing trees.

<!-- uid=1440045:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** It might try to use the trees  
to get around so it can avoid  
having to be on the ground.

<!-- uid=1440045:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh yeah... I hadn't thought of  
that.

<!-- uid=1440045:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** But wait, doesn't that mean if  
it runs away, we won't get  
another chance to capture it?

<!-- uid=1440045:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** Heh, yep.

<!-- uid=1440045:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** It's all going to come down to  
our first move once we find it.

<!-- uid=1440045:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** If we don't manage to bring it  
down in one hit before it sees  
us, this hunt'll be a wash.

<!-- uid=1440045:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** Gotcha. So that means our only  
option is for you to hit one of  
its vitals with your bow, then?

<!-- uid=1440045:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yep. You've got it.

<!-- uid=1440045:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...

<!-- uid=1440045:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hehe, you're not ready to give  
up on fighting it despite the odds  
being stacked against you, huh?

<!-- uid=1440045:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** Are you thinking of trying to beat  
it with your sword?

<!-- uid=1440045:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** N-No, not really.

<!-- uid=1440045:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** Like I said before, I don't want  
to give up hunting it just because  
my race isn't ideal.

<!-- uid=1440045:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** I just wish I could also use a bow  
like you, seeing as weapons aren't  
bound by race in ALO, at least.

<!-- uid=1440045:24:1 -->

**Sinon:** Ah, I hear you. You really are  
determined to do things your  
own way.

<!-- uid=1440045:25:1 -->

**Sinon:** Guess you're not just full of  
hot air after all.

<!-- uid=1440045:26:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sinonon, give me a break! You

<!-- uid=1440045:27:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hehe, sorry. Couldn't help it.

<!-- uid=1440045:28:1 -->


## Story 1440047 · \[Flowering Valkyrie\] Sinon Lv.70

Character Story

**Sinon:** There it is!

<!-- uid=1440047:1:1 -->

<!-- uid=1440047:2:1 -->

okay?

<!-- uid=1440047:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Asuna, you're not thinking of

<!-- uid=1440047:18:1 -->

<!-- uid=1440047:20:1 -->

<!-- uid=1440047:21:1 -->

## Story 1440087 · \[Cheer of Love\] Asuna Lv.70

Character Story

**Kirito:** Oh, Asuna, Yui...

**Asuna:** What's up, Kirito?

## Story 1440097 · \[Free Style Artist\] Sinon Lv.70

Character Story

**Shino:** Ah, the band. Yeah, about that...

<!-- uid=1440097:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** You're not quitting, are you?

<!-- uid=1440097:2:1 -->

**Shino:** Relax, Asuna. I never intended to

**Asuna:** You didn't?

<!-- uid=1440097:4:1 -->

**Kazuto:** So what's been on your mind  
lately?

<!-- uid=1440097:5:1 -->

**Shino:** Well, I think it's pretty obvious  
that pop songs and dances aren't  
really my thing.

<!-- uid=1440097:6:1 -->

**Shino:** But I figured that was because  
we were locked in to the in-game  
song selection.

<!-- uid=1440097:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, there's a pretty big  
selection of original and pre-made  
songs in there,

<!-- uid=1440097:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** and a lot of them are really  
bright and poppy, since it's all  
about being a pop star.

<!-- uid=1440097:9:1 -->

**Shino:** But the game also says it's  
possible to arrange your own  
songs.

<!-- uid=1440097:10:1 -->

**Kazuto:** It is?

<!-- uid=1440097:11:1 -->

**Shino:** Yeah, through an extra piece of  
software. So I figured I'd give  
it a try.

<!-- uid=1440097:12:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Huh. I didn't know that.

<!-- uid=1440097:13:1 -->

**Shino:** Yeah, it's pretty crazy. But if  
they can auto-generate quests,  
a music editor must be a cakewalk.

<!-- uid=1440097:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** What kind of song were you  
thinking of making?

<!-- uid=1440097:15:1 -->

**Shino:** I've been turning the in-game  
songs into rock numbers or  
ballads.

<!-- uid=1440097:16:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Okay then. But you know...  
You could have told us that  
you wanted to sing rock songs.

<!-- uid=1440097:17:1 -->

**Shino:** I was still getting used to the  
game myself, though. And I wasn't  
sure I could use the software.

<!-- uid=1440097:18:1 -->

**Shino:** I didn't want to share anything  
with the group until I had some  
songs I was happy with.

<!-- uid=1440097:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** I can understand that.

<!-- uid=1440097:20:1 -->

**Kazuto:** So, how's it going?

<!-- uid=1440097:21:1 -->

**Shino:** It'll take me a few more days to  
have more than one song ready.  
I hope that's okay.

<!-- uid=1440097:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** Of course!  
We can't wait to hear them.

<!-- uid=1440097:23:1 -->

**Shino:** Okay, great.

<!-- uid=1440097:24:1 -->

## Story 1440118 · \[blossom of youth\] Philia Lv.80

Character Story

**Kirito:** Well, I figured that Philia didn't  
like sailor uniforms because she  
had to wear them for school.

**Strea:** Yay, woohoo!

<!-- uid=1440118:30:1 -->

**Philia:** Heh... Well, Strea's Strea.

Character Story

## Story 1450011 · \[The Archer - overcoming the past\] Sinon Lv.10

Character Story

**Leafa:** Hey Sinon! Thanks so much  
for everything.

<!-- uid=1450011:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** I owe you big time for helping me  
master that new technique.

<!-- uid=1450011:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** You don't owe me a thing. Your  
hard work made it happen. Besides,  
I like partnering with you.

<!-- uid=1450011:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hehe, thanks!  
But actually...

<!-- uid=1450011:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yes?

<!-- uid=1450011:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** I'm wondering. We got it with me  
taking the lead, but what about  
the other way around?

<!-- uid=1450011:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** You're...not serious, are you?

<!-- uid=1450011:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** You want me to be the main for  
this one?

<!-- uid=1450011:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeah. You hit with an arrow first,  
then I follow with my sword...

<!-- uid=1450011:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** And then you hit with a second  
arrow right as my sword connects.  
So...sound good?

<!-- uid=1450011:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hold up. You're saying you want me  
to take the lead. In other words,  
parry...with an arrow?

<!-- uid=1450011:11:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeah, that about sums it up.  
So, can you do it?

<!-- uid=1450011:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** I...don't know. I've never even  
considered it before.

<!-- uid=1450011:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** Arrows are much lighter than most  
melee weapons, so it's likely I  
won't be able to stop a blade.

<!-- uid=1450011:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeah, I suppose so. Arrows and  
other ranged weapons lack the  
weight and power of melee weapons.

<!-- uid=1450011:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** Kirito did something similar in  
GGO, but it was literally cutting  
bullets in half in midair.

<!-- uid=1450011:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** Y-Yeah, when you put it like that,  
it does sound kinda impossible...

<!-- uid=1450011:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=1450011:18:1 -->


## Story 1450013 · \[The Archer - overcoming the past\] Sinon Lv.30

Character Story

**Sinon:** Leafa, take a quick look at this.

<!-- uid=1450013:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** An arrow? Hmm... I've never seen  
one like this before. Is it a new  
item?

<!-- uid=1450013:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** Nope, they've been around forever.  
They're just not too well-known  
because barely anyone uses them.

<!-- uid=1450013:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** Really? Why's that?

<!-- uid=1450013:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** Here, hold out your hand.

<!-- uid=1450013:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** Okay, but wh-AH! Wh-Whoa,  
this is HEAVY!!

<!-- uid=1450013:6:1 -->

**Leafa:** It's way heavier than a rapier!

<!-- uid=1450013:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** Heh, and now you know why no one

<!-- uid=1450013:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** I can see why. An arrow this heavy

<!-- uid=1450013:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah, but the extra weight might

<!-- uid=1450013:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** Huh, what are you talking about?

<!-- uid=1450013:11:1 -->

**Leafa:** An arrow this heavy has a much  
better chance of knocking an  
enemy's weapon aside!

<!-- uid=1450013:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** Exactly. At the very least, this  
arrow is the best chance I have  
with ALO's selection.

<!-- uid=1450013:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** Want to go test it out?

<!-- uid=1450013:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** Of course. You have some time?

<!-- uid=1450013:15:1 -->

**Leafa:** For this? You bet I do! I can't  
wait to see you pull it off!

<!-- uid=1450013:16:1 -->

**Sinon:** Heh, neither can I.

<!-- uid=1450013:17:1 -->


## Story 1450015 · \[The Archer - overcoming the past\] Sinon Lv.50

Character Story

**Monster:** Grrr...

<!-- uid=1450015:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** Sinon! A monster just spawned!

<!-- uid=1450015:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** It's got a sword, so it's perfect  
for testing your arrow parry!

<!-- uid=1450015:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** Got it. Let's give this a shot.

<!-- uid=1450015:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** Now!

<!-- uid=1450015:5:1 -->

**Monster:** Grrk?!

<!-- uid=1450015:6:1 -->

**Leafa:** Huh? It died before it even had  
a chance to swing...

<!-- uid=1450015:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** Lame...

<!-- uid=1450015:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Ahaha, well, I guess that's what

something in the head.

why I expected it to pull a Kirito

<!-- uid=1450015:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** Normally, nothing's fast enough to  
even see an arrow, much less guard

here could dodge arrows. But  
we can't practice like this...

<!-- uid=1450015:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=1450015:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** Oh, I have an idea! Let's ask

**Sinon:** He is...

<!-- uid=1450015:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** We shouldn't be counting on our

with its weapon.

<!-- uid=1450015:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeah...

<!-- uid=1450015:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Even if we can pull this off  
against Kirito, what's the point  
if we can't use it normally?

<!-- uid=1450015:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** Honestly, I'm starting to have  
second thoughts.

<!-- uid=1450015:19:1 -->

**Leafa:** So...are we out of options?

<!-- uid=1450015:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** No, we still have one left.

<!-- uid=1450015:21:1 -->

**Leafa:** We do?!

<!-- uid=1450015:22:1 -->

**Sinon:** But it'll be even harder to  
pull off...

<!-- uid=1450015:23:1 -->


## Story 1450017 · \[The Archer - overcoming the past\] Sinon Lv.70

Character Story

**Sinon:** ...

<!-- uid=1450017:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** Oh, there you are!

<!-- uid=1450017:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hey! Sinon!

<!-- uid=1450017:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** Oops, she's focusing...  
I should leave her be...

<!-- uid=1450017:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** Sinon...

<!-- uid=1450017:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** The only way to parry an attack  
with an arrow is to anticipate and  
hit the enemy weapon as it moves.

<!-- uid=1450017:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Being that accurate with an  
extra heavy arrow... Well,  
it seems impossible.

<!-- uid=1450017:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** But Kirito... He showed me that  
it's possible to go one step  
beyond. To predict predictions.

<!-- uid=1450017:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** Without a sword prediction system,  
my only option is to picture where  
the attack will go.

<!-- uid=1450017:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** So that's what I'm going to try  
to do.

<!-- uid=1450017:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** Is that even possible?

<!-- uid=1450017:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** Kirito said something to me once.  
He can sense things here that  
weren't programmed into the game.

<!-- uid=1450017:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** Subtle movements, the smell of  
the air, the feel of the wind...

<!-- uid=1450017:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** If I can feel those things too,  
then maybe I'll be able to sense  
my enemy's movements as well.

<!-- uid=1450017:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** Sinon...

<!-- uid=1450017:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** Sssh!

<!-- uid=1450017:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** Sinon? What is it...?

<!-- uid=1450017:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...There!

<!-- uid=1450017:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** Huh?! What are you shooting at?

<!-- uid=1450017:19:1 -->

**???:** Grrooonk?!

<!-- uid=1450017:20:1 -->

**Leafa:** Whoa! There was a boar monster  
hiding in that bush?!

<!-- uid=1450017:21:1 -->

**Sinon:** Oh, hello Leafa. I didn't  
notice you were there.

<!-- uid=1450017:22:1 -->

**Leafa:** S-Sinon! You just took out that  
monster...without even opening  
your eyes!

<!-- uid=1450017:23:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yes, that's right. One of the  
benefits of my training to  
improve my senses here.

<!-- uid=1450017:24:1 -->

**Leafa:** That's...AMAZING!! You're like  
some super-powered ninja master!  
You can see with your mind's eye!

<!-- uid=1450017:25:1 -->

**Sinon:** Heh heh heh... It's nothing that  
impressive.

<!-- uid=1450017:26:1 -->

**Leafa:** It totally is! I bet you'll be  
able to parry with an arrow

## Story 1450033 · \[Swing a Battledore with Love\] Sinon Lv.30

Character Story

**Dry Goods Shopkeep:** We're deeply sorry, but we don't  
have any more kimonos available  
for rental...

<!-- uid=1450033:1:1 -->

**Liz:** What?!

<!-- uid=1450033:2:1 -->

<!-- uid=1450033:3:1 -->

**Liz:** Yeah! It's like a digital library  
running out of books! I'm gonna  
call management!

<!-- uid=1450033:4:1 -->

**Dry Goods Shopkeep:** Actually, we did this on purpose.  
You see, we're aiming to keep  
stock down and rarity up!

<!-- uid=1450033:5:1 -->

**Dry Goods Shopkeep:** Rare outfits make headlines, start  
fads, and bring in customers!  
We hope to start a kimono craze!

<!-- uid=1450033:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** A kimono craze. In a Japanese  
VRMMO. Surprise.

<!-- uid=1450033:7:1 -->

**Dry Goods Shopkeep:** Exactly! We rented kimonos to two  
girls the other day, and they  
really caused a stir!

<!-- uid=1450033:8:1 -->

**Dry Goods Shopkeep:** They looked so good, people posted  
about them in forums, and they  
even made it onto MMO Today!

<!-- uid=1450033:9:1 -->

this ridiculous idea of stock and  
limiting rental numbers?

<!-- uid=1450033:10:1 -->

**Dry Goods Shopkeep:** Well, not me, personally. It was  
the developers. They made us do

<!-- uid=1450033:11:1 -->

limiting supply? I know why they  
do it, but I hate them for it.

<!-- uid=1450033:12:1 -->

**Liz:** Still, you got to hand it to Asuna  
and Alice. It only took them a day  
to become fashion celebrities.

<!-- uid=1450033:13:1 -->

<!-- uid=1450033:14:1 -->

## Story 1450071 · \[Youthful Days\] Asuna Lv.10

<!-- uid=1450071:5:1 -->

Running this virtual school  
is a lot of work.

<!-- uid=1450071:6:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Yikes, sounds tough...

<!-- uid=1450071:7:1 -->

**Yuuki:** But it's because of your hard work

## Story 1450073 · \[Youthful Days\] Asuna Lv.30

Character Story

**Yuuki:** So, what's the hardest part of  
being a superintendent?

<!-- uid=1450073:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** There's been a lot of interest in  
the school from educational  
organizations and companies.

<!-- uid=1450073:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** A few online schools want to  
collaborate, and some childcare  
associations want to work with us.

<!-- uid=1450073:3:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Wow... This school is really  
taking off, huh?

<!-- uid=1450073:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah... I'm happy, but still...

<!-- uid=1450073:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** We built this school big, but  
there are only so many students  
it can handle.

<!-- uid=1450073:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** The more offers we accept,  
the more students we'll get...

<!-- uid=1450073:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's going to end up causing  
a lot of problems.

<!-- uid=1450073:8:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Problems? Oh, yeah...

<!-- uid=1450073:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Exactly. Students and teachers  
here run the risk of having their  
real identities revealed.

<!-- uid=1450073:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Right now, everyone's promised to  
respect each other's privacy, but  
promises can be broken.

<!-- uid=1450073:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** The more people we have involved  
here, the higher the chance that  
someone will cause a problem.

<!-- uid=1450073:12:1 -->

**Yuuki:** You're saying some bad apples will  
enroll?

<!-- uid=1450073:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm not going that far, but I'm  
sure we'll have people join on  
a whim or to troll us.

<!-- uid=1450073:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Whichever way you look at it,  
that'll be trouble.

<!-- uid=1450073:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** And it's not like we can demand  
people hand over their real world  
info to enroll here.

<!-- uid=1450073:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** So there's no way we can say for  
sure what sort of people they are  
until they show up.

<!-- uid=1450073:17:1 -->

**Yuuki:** There's a simple solution for all  
that.

<!-- uid=1450073:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** There is?

<!-- uid=1450073:19:1 -->

## Story 1450078 · \[Youthful Days\] Asuna Lv.80

Character Story

**Arianrhod:** there have been no negative rumors

**Asuna:** Thank you, Arianrhod. That's what

it sounds like we're safe so far.

<!-- uid=1450078:3:1 -->

<!-- uid=1450078:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** I agree. Yuuki's insight into  
people's hearts and minds  
is incredible.

<!-- uid=1450078:5:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** She's got so much love for VR,  
and such drive and optimism.

<!-- uid=1450078:6:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** She really is a treasure.

<!-- uid=1450078:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah...

**Asuna:** I just need to make sure she

<!-- uid=1450078:15:1 -->

<!-- uid=1450078:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** If her health starts suffering,

<!-- uid=1450078:17:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** Ha ha, that's true. You should

<!-- uid=1450078:18:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** She's in the garden behind school

<!-- uid=1450078:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Thank you! I'll go talk to her

<!-- uid=1450078:20:1 -->

## Story 1450081 · \[Sky Bow\] Sinon Lv.10

Character Story

**Sinon:** Stop...

<!-- uid=1450081:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** What's up?

<!-- uid=1450081:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** See those rocks? Someone could  
be hiding in them.

<!-- uid=1450081:3:1 -->

aren't we far enough away to be  
safe?

<!-- uid=1450081:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh... I forgot.

<!-- uid=1450081:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** That's right, Asuna. ALO's Squad

<!-- uid=1450081:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** And if this were GGO, it'd be easy

pick us off.

<!-- uid=1450081:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Right...

<!-- uid=1450081:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** So, what do we do? Circle around?

<!-- uid=1450081:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** That's the right move.

<!-- uid=1450081:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Having you on our team is a

experience is carrying us!

<!-- uid=1450081:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** I second Asuna.  
We owe you, Sinon.

<!-- uid=1450081:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** H-Hey, lay off. We're squadmates.

<!-- uid=1450081:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** And I should add that I didn't  
take part in GGO's Squad Jam.

<!-- uid=1450081:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** So I'm still not fully used to  
this tournament's rules.

<!-- uid=1450081:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Speaking of which, what are the  
Squad Jam's special rules again?

<!-- uid=1450081:16:1 -->


## Story 1450083 · \[Sky Bow\] Sinon Lv.30

Character Story

**Sinon:** This is a team battle, so a team  
leader has to be picked ahead  
of time.

<!-- uid=1450083:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** If the leader is taken out, the  
role passes on to the next person  
down the command chain, and so on.

<!-- uid=1450083:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** This matters mostly because of  
the satellite scan.

<!-- uid=1450083:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** We're in ALO, Sinon, so it's not  
a satellite scan. It's an...uh...  
Oh yeah! A "Spirit Mirror."

<!-- uid=1450083:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's the thing that lets you  
see the location of other enemy  
party leaders on the map, right?

<!-- uid=1450083:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah. And that's the part that  
makes this tournament so hard  
to read.

<!-- uid=1450083:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** What do you mean?

<!-- uid=1450083:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** We tend to think of parties as  
single units, but in GGO, each  
person can operate separately.

<!-- uid=1450083:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** That's the power of wireless  
communication. The leader  
might just be alone.

<!-- uid=1450083:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ah. So you're worried that enemy  
squads might split up to set  
ambushes.

<!-- uid=1450083:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** Exactly.

<!-- uid=1450083:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** I see...

<!-- uid=1450083:12:1 -->


## Story 1450085 · \[Sky Bow\] Sinon Lv.50

Character Story

**Sinon:** It's time for a satellite scan...  
Or Spirit Mirror. Whatever.

<!-- uid=1450085:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** There we go... Looks like the  
enemy positions are... Hmm...

<!-- uid=1450085:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** There's another team leader near  
us. What are they doing over  
there?

<!-- uid=1450085:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** They're surrounded by cliffs.  
A perfect target.

<!-- uid=1450085:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** I smell a trap. It's like they're  
trying to lure us in.

<!-- uid=1450085:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** I recognize the team name. I saw  
them at the opening ceremony.  
They're all Salamanders.

<!-- uid=1450085:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** They're powerful players, and  
the guy leading them is known  
for his skill.

<!-- uid=1450085:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Those guys... I saw them too.  
I hear they're General Eugene's  
crack team of commandos.

<!-- uid=1450085:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** This has got to be a trap.  
But what do you say about  
springing it?

<!-- uid=1450085:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** You're not serious.

<!-- uid=1450085:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** I am. It's a risky play, but so is  
their strategy. Let's attack, beat  
them, and glory in our win.

<!-- uid=1450085:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** Besides, it won't be too dangerous  
if I just snipe that guy from  
the cliffs. I'll go alone.

<!-- uid=1450085:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** You two hold here and wait for  
Leafa to get back from her  
recon run.

<!-- uid=1450085:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sinonon... Are you sure you'll  
be all right?

<!-- uid=1450085:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** I'll be fine. See you after I take  
out that enemy leader.

<!-- uid=1450085:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=1450085:16:1 -->


## Story 1450087 · \[Sky Bow\] Sinon Lv.70

Character Story

**Sinon:** Down below the cliffs...

**Sinon:** Looks like a Salamander, anyway.

in the open for all to see.

<!-- uid=1460013:15:1 -->

## Story 1460021 · \[Red Flash Divine Archer\] Sinon Lv.10

well-made.

almost scary how realistic their  
graphics and movements were!

<!-- uid=1460021:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** I guess what I heard was true,

<!-- uid=1460021:18:1 -->

<!-- uid=1460021:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** This is a world where gods

<!-- uid=1460021:21:1 -->

**Liz:** Hehe, yup!

<!-- uid=1460021:22:1 -->


## Story 1460023 · \[Red Flash Divine Archer\] Sinon Lv.30

Character Story

a quest you can accept in Ayakashi  
Alley involving a yokai parade.

<!-- uid=1460023:1:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Oh, you must be talking about the

**Yuuki:** I'll use my speed and flight to  
get it nice and dizzy!

<!-- uid=1460023:17:1 -->

**Liz:** Got it! Let's get into our

show it what we're made of!

<!-- uid=1460023:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** Look! Over there!

<!-- uid=1460028:7:1 -->

<!-- uid=1460028:8:1 -->

That's got to be the one we're  
not supposed to attack!

<!-- uid=1460028:9:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Right! Be careful to make sure  
it doesn't get caught in the  
crossfire!

<!-- uid=1460028:10:1 -->

**Yokai:** Gr-Graaaaugh! This... This can't

<!-- uid=1460028:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** W-Well, how'd we do this time?

<!-- uid=1460028:12:1 -->

**Receptionist NPC:** Congratulations. You've completed  
the quest.

<!-- uid=1460028:13:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Woohoo!

that little yokai this whole time!

<!-- uid=1460028:15:1 -->

<!-- uid=1460028:16:1 -->

**Little Yokai:** Th-Thank you...

<!-- uid=1460028:17:1 -->

**Yuuki:** It disappeared.

<!-- uid=1460028:18:1 -->

**Liz:** Hehe, it probably only wanted  
to play. Poor thing.

<!-- uid=1460028:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** I'm just glad we finally beat that  
quest.

<!-- uid=1460028:20:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I liked it! That was a fun way to  
mix up a hack-and-slash quest!

<!-- uid=1460028:21:1 -->

**Liz:** Sure was!

<!-- uid=1460028:22:1 -->


## Story 1460031 · \[Tsukuyomi\] Sinon Lv.10

Character Story

**Sinon:** Whew... That takes care of that.

<!-- uid=1460031:1:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Nice job! So is this the last  
quest you guys are taking  
on this year?

<!-- uid=1460031:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** I think so. The end of the year  
is pretty busy for me.

<!-- uid=1460031:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** What's Kirito up to?

<!-- uid=1460031:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** He's been talking about how  
he's busy with real-life problems  
and his part-time job.

<!-- uid=1460031:5:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Asuna's been kind of stressed out  
lately too. She said her relatives  
are all coming for the holidays.

<!-- uid=1460031:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Sounds rough. It's times like  
this I'm especially grateful I  
live alone.

<!-- uid=1460031:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** You could always come hang out  
at our place.

<!-- uid=1460031:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** Thanks, but that's okay.  
You should spend New Year's  
with your family.

<!-- uid=1460031:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** Besides, I have a feeling the  
three of us will end up right back  
here after the countdown...

<!-- uid=1460031:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** Ha ha, you might just be right.

<!-- uid=1460031:11:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hehe, personally, that sounds  
awesome to me.

<!-- uid=1460031:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** What about the Sleeping  
Knights? What are they doing  
for New Year's?

<!-- uid=1460031:13:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Some of the ones with less severe  
symptoms spend it in real life.

<!-- uid=1460031:14:1 -->

**Yuuki:** It really depends on the  
circumstances at the time.

<!-- uid=1460031:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** I see... I guess that's true for  
VRMMOs too, when you think  
about it.

<!-- uid=1460031:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** What do you mean?

<!-- uid=1460031:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** In real life, New Year's is a  
holiday where people get time off  
from work and school, right?

<!-- uid=1460031:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** Which means the admins are  
sure to have some kind of event  
ready to go.

<!-- uid=1460031:19:1 -->

**Leafa:** Gotcha. In other words, this is  
like their peak season.

<!-- uid=1460031:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** Heh, right.

<!-- uid=1460031:21:1 -->


## Story 1460033 · \[Tsukuyomi\] Sinon Lv.30

Character Story

**Yuuki:** Anyway, I wonder what world  
we should check out first once  
it's officially New Year's.

<!-- uid=1460033:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hmm... There's ALO and  
GGO, of course... and also  
Asuka Empire.

<!-- uid=1460033:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** I guess it all comes down to what  
kind of events they've got.

<!-- uid=1460033:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** Sometimes they tell you about them  
ahead of time; others they spring  
on you without any warning.

<!-- uid=1460033:4:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hehe, it all comes down to the  
info, doesn't it? The real battle  
begins even before the event.

<!-- uid=1460033:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** For sure. In fact, I think I'll do  
some searching once I get back  
to reality.

<!-- uid=1460033:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** If you two happen to have time,  
let's meet up again later.

<!-- uid=1460033:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** In the new year.

<!-- uid=1460033:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Sounds good. Okay,  
happy new year!

<!-- uid=1460033:9:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Happy new year!

<!-- uid=1460033:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** Alright, that takes care of my  
shopping. Now to--

<!-- uid=1460033:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hey, Sinonon.

<!-- uid=1460033:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hey Asuna. I didn't know you were  
diving too. Yuuki said you've been  
kind of busy lately.

<!-- uid=1460033:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, yeah, that's true. But there  
was a quest here I just had to  
take care of before the new year.

<!-- uid=1460033:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** Is that 'cause it ends when  
the year does?

<!-- uid=1460033:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, you got it.

<!-- uid=1460033:16:1 -->


## Story 1460035 · \[Tsukuyomi\] Sinon Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** Honestly, I'd love to come here  
right after the new year begins.

<!-- uid=1460035:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** You're going to see relatives,  
right?

<!-- uid=1460035:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah. So I don't think I'll be  
able to dive again for a while.

<!-- uid=1460035:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** Too bad... Is there a certain  
quest in particular you wanted to  
do once the new year is here?

<!-- uid=1460035:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, in Asuka Empire. I heard  
there's going to be a quest based  
on gods from Japanese mythology.

<!-- uid=1460035:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=1460035:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Rumor has it you can even get  
new jobs based on the gods.

<!-- uid=1460035:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** Did you hear which gods  
will be there?

<!-- uid=1460035:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** No, it doesn't look like they've  
announced that yet.

<!-- uid=1460035:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** But since it's Japanese mythology,  
I'd have to guess Amaterasu  
Omikami will make an appearance.

<!-- uid=1460035:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** The sun goddess? True, she's  
certainly the most famous  
Japanese god around...

<!-- uid=1460035:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** I bet a job based on her  
would suit you well.

<!-- uid=1460035:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** R-Really?

<!-- uid=1460035:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** You're already our guiding light.  
Even in SAO, you led the Assault  
Team as the Lightning Flash.

<!-- uid=1460035:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Y-You're giving me too much  
credit. I'm sure that job would  
suit you just as well.

<!-- uid=1460035:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** I don't know... I feel like I'm  
more like the moon goddess  
who hides quietly behind the sun.

<!-- uid=1460035:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** You mean Tsukuyomi? True, she's  
got a mystical charm that would  
definitely suit you.

<!-- uid=1460035:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hehe, thanks.

<!-- uid=1460035:18:1 -->


## Story 1460037 · \[Tsukuyomi\] Sinon Lv.70

Character Story

**Asuna:** In Yuuki's case... Hmm...  
Maybe Susano'o-no-Mikoto?  
He seems pretty strong.

<!-- uid=1460037:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah. I can easily see her  
saying she wants to wield  
his sword, the Kusanagi.

<!-- uid=1460037:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** And I guess for Leafa...  
maybe a wind god?

<!-- uid=1460037:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** WAS there a wind god in  
Japanese mythology?

<!-- uid=1460037:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Maybe Fujin, of Fujin and Raijin?  
Then again, maybe not... Hmm,  
nothing much comes to mind.

<!-- uid=1460037:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** You could say the sun goddess  
would fit her too, since all the  
Sylphs love her.

<!-- uid=1460037:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Um, Sinonon? I apologize in

about this, but...

<!-- uid=1460037:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** I really do think you have a lot  
going for you.

<!-- uid=1460037:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** And that Amaterasu Omikami's  
job would suit you just as well  
as it would any other girl.

<!-- uid=1460037:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** So if hers is the job you want  
for yourself,

<!-- uid=1460037:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** I don't think you should be afraid  
to go after it. I mean, it's free  
for anyone who wants it, right?

<!-- uid=1460037:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** I don't know... If we're all  
partied up, it just makes sense  
for me to have a different job.

<!-- uid=1460037:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** But thanks, Asuna. Just hearing  
you say that was more than enough.

<!-- uid=1460037:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** If you say so... Anyway, I'd  
better go ahead and log out.

<!-- uid=1460037:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** You too, Sinonon.
