## Story 1460038 · \[Tsukuyomi\] Sinon Lv.80

Character Story

**Kirito:** Hey, Sinon.

<!-- uid=1460038:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hey Kirito. You're here too, huh?

<!-- uid=1460038:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** Leafa told me you've been pretty  
busy with real-world stuff lately.

<!-- uid=1460038:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, yeah, I am, but I wanted to  
take another look around here  
before the new year comes.

<!-- uid=1460038:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...I see.

<!-- uid=1460038:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sinon...? Is everything okay?

<!-- uid=1460038:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Kirito, between the sun and the  
moon... which do you think's  
more attractive?

<!-- uid=1460038:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Where's this coming from?  
Is this like some kind of  
symbolism or something?

<!-- uid=1460038:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** Just answer the question.  
Between the bright shining sun  
and the moon that reflects it...

<!-- uid=1460038:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** which is more attractive?

<!-- uid=1460038:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well... Hmm... This is hard.  
I guess I'd go with... the moon?

<!-- uid=1460038:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** Really?

<!-- uid=1460038:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** The moon's a satellite. It doesn't  
shine on its own or orbit the sun  
like a planet can...

<!-- uid=1460038:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** But even though the moon  
may be small compared to  
other heavenly bodies,

<!-- uid=1460038:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** it's also a really special one  
that people have told stories  
about since ancient times.

<!-- uid=1460038:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah... I guess that's true.

<!-- uid=1460038:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** It doesn't have to shine bright  
for all. As long as it's there for  
those who need it, that's enough.

<!-- uid=1460038:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Now I see...  
Interesting take on it.

<!-- uid=1460038:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** I guess it's also got more  
ambition? Like it's determined  
to outshine the sun someday.

<!-- uid=1460038:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hehe, as if a satellite could ever  
evolve into a star.

<!-- uid=1460038:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha, you've got me there.

<!-- uid=1460038:21:1 -->

**Sinon:** Amaterasu Omikami, the sun, huh...  
I'm pretty sure I'm not cut out  
for that.

<!-- uid=1460038:22:1 -->

**Sinon:** But the sun goddess...

<!-- uid=1460038:23:1 -->

**Sinon:** I bet that one day, I'll be able  
to be like the sun too...

<!-- uid=1460038:24:1 -->

**Sinon:** Or maybe not... Heh.

<!-- uid=1460038:25:1 -->


## Story 1460041 · \[Magical Archer\] Sinon Lv.10

Character Story

**Asuna:** That Valentine's event battle  
where we all picked angel and  
demon sides sure was a lot of fun!

<!-- uid=1460041:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. Usually we're always  
fighting against other fairy races  
or the Helheim demons,

<!-- uid=1460041:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** so it's nice to compete in a  
different way like this sometimes.

<!-- uid=1460041:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** My favorite part was how Silica  
and I got to transform into demon  
avatars.

<!-- uid=1460041:4:1 -->

**Silica:** Mine too! The stat buff we got  
from those forms was nice,

<!-- uid=1460041:5:1 -->

**Silica:** but even just looking like that  
made me feel stronger.

<!-- uid=1460041:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Demons, huh...

<!-- uid=1460041:7:2 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito?

<!-- uid=1460041:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...Are you still jealous about how  
only we got to turn into demons  
because we got most of the kills?

<!-- uid=1460041:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** I told you, that's not it.  
Can you two still change into your  
demon forms?

<!-- uid=1460041:10:1 -->

**Silica:** Uh... I don't think so. I mean,  
the Valentine's event is already  
over...

<!-- uid=1460041:11:1 -->

**Silica:** Wait... Actually, I think I can!  
I still have that demon icon on my  
stats screen!

<!-- uid=1460041:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** And there's a note about it...  
Looks like we can still transform  
until the next patch.

<!-- uid=1460041:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Great! In that case, there's  
something I'd like you two to try!

<!-- uid=1460041:14:1 -->

**Silica:** What is it?

<!-- uid=1460041:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** Gulp. I've got a bad feeling about  
this...

<!-- uid=1460041:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Let's see, first I've got to  
message Makoto or Thokk...

<!-- uid=1460041:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** I don't think you can message them  
with ALO's system, since they're  
demons and we're fairies...

<!-- uid=1460041:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, right... In that case, I'm  
going to log out quickly and go  
tell Seiko directly!

<!-- uid=1460041:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Be right back!

<!-- uid=1460041:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** I wonder what he's up to.

<!-- uid=1460041:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, I think I might already know  
what it is...

<!-- uid=1460041:22:1 -->


## Story 1460043 · \[Magical Archer\] Sinon Lv.30

Character Story

**Makoto:** Hi everyone.

<!-- uid=1460043:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hello, Makoto.

<!-- uid=1460043:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Okay, I'm back. But, wait...  
Makoto, where's Thokk?

<!-- uid=1460043:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** She said the light world doesn't  
suit her, so she's waiting for us  
in Helheim.

<!-- uid=1460043:4:1 -->

**Silica:** Waiting in...Helheim?

<!-- uid=1460043:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hold up. I thought it was  
impossible for fairies to get to  
Helheim.

<!-- uid=1460043:6:1 -->

**Silica:** Yeah, we just bounced off that  
black void thing when we tried...

<!-- uid=1460043:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's exactly what I want to try  
out: to see if you two can go  
there in your demon forms.

<!-- uid=1460043:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** Oh, yeah...

<!-- uid=1460043:9:1 -->

**Silica:** Now I see... It IS set so that  
demons can pass through.

<!-- uid=1460043:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, I knew it.

<!-- uid=1460043:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** As long as the system thinks  
you're demons, it ought to be  
possible.

<!-- uid=1460043:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'd love to try going there  
myself... But since I can't, I was  
hoping you two could try it

<!-- uid=1460043:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** and tell me what it's like there  
after you get back.

<!-- uid=1460043:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** \*sigh\*... You're never short on  
these wild ideas, are you.

<!-- uid=1460043:15:1 -->

**Silica:** I-I don't mind! I'd be glad to  
visit Helheim and report back to  
you, Kirito!

<!-- uid=1460043:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Really?! Thanks, Silica!

<!-- uid=1460043:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Oh, alright... I can't have Silica  
going there all alone.

<!-- uid=1460043:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Thanks, Sinon!

<!-- uid=1460043:19:1 -->

**Makoto:** Okay, now that that's settled,  
I'll go ahead and open the gate.

<!-- uid=1460043:20:1 -->

**Makoto:** Follow me, you two.

<!-- uid=1460043:21:1 -->

**Sinon:** Right.

<!-- uid=1460043:22:1 -->

**Silica:** Be back soon!

<!-- uid=1460043:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** Thanks again!

<!-- uid=1460043:24:1 -->


## Story 1460045 · \[Magical Archer\] Sinon Lv.50

Character Story

**Sinon:** Whoa...!

<!-- uid=1460045:1:1 -->

**Silica:** So this is Helheim...the land of  
demons. We actually made it...

<!-- uid=1460045:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** Y-Yeah... So far, it certainly  
seems about as hellish as I'd  
imagined...

<!-- uid=1460045:3:1 -->

**Skull:** Oh? New recruits, Makoto?

<!-- uid=1460045:5:1 -->

**Makoto:** H-Haha... We just got back from  
killing fairies in the light  
world. That must be what it is.

<!-- uid=1460045:6:1 -->

**Skull:** Aww, why didn't you invite us,  
Makoto! You know we're always up

**Skull:** Oh, right! Okay everyone,

<!-- uid=1460045:9:1 -->

**Makoto:** Haha, anyway, that's more or less

**Sinon:** You know, those two demons just  
now... I only ever saw them as  
scary creatures to be defeated,

**Sinon:** but talking to them like this,  
they seem different from what  
I expected...

<!-- uid=1460045:13:1 -->

**Silica:** S-Same here. It was downright nice

because we're new here...

<!-- uid=1460045:14:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hehe, that's because they ARE  
really nice.

<!-- uid=1460045:15:1 -->


## Story 1460047 · \[Magical Archer\] Sinon Lv.70

Character Story

**Skull:** Go on, eat up!

<!-- uid=1460047:1:1 -->

**Grimm:** We've got plenty to drink right  
over here too.

**Sinon:** Um, just out of curiosity, is this  
meat...you know...

**Makoto:** Haha, don't worry, it's not made

<!-- uid=1460047:4:1 -->

**Skull:** I don't know how it gets like  
that, but whatever it is,  
it ain't water...

**Sinon:** C-Come on Silica, they'll think

**Sinon:** Besides, those are just graphics,

<!-- uid=1460048:6:1 -->

**Makoto:** What the...!

**Sinon:** Whew... We ought to be okay now.

<!-- uid=1460048:24:1 -->

**Silica:** Yeah. I was kind of worried for a  
while there, but fortunately we  
made it out.

<!-- uid=1460048:25:1 -->

**Sinon:** You know... Those demon NPCs were  
actually pretty nice, weren't  
they.

<!-- uid=1460048:26:1 -->

**Silica:** Yeah, especially ones like Skull  
and Grimm with advanced  
conversation modules.

<!-- uid=1460048:27:1 -->

**Silica:** I had as much fun talking to them  
as I do with Yui.

<!-- uid=1460048:28:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah... It's going to be harder to  
face them now the next time we  
fight, isn't it.

<!-- uid=1460048:29:1 -->

**Silica:** Heh, yeah... But think about it  
this way: the demons don't have to  
be enemies to us fairies.

<!-- uid=1460048:30:1 -->

**Silica:** They can just be more like  
friendly rivals. So the next time  
we do fight them,

<!-- uid=1460048:31:1 -->

**Silica:** we don't have to hold back,  
because that's not what rivals do,  
right?

<!-- uid=1460048:32:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hehe, good idea. I'll keep that in  
mind the next time they attack.  
Thanks, Silica.

<!-- uid=1460048:33:1 -->

**Silica:** No problem! Let's go tell Kirito  
about this too.

<!-- uid=1460048:34:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah!

<!-- uid=1460048:35:1 -->


## Story 1460051 · \[Pure Princess\] Asuna Lv.10

Character Story

**Leafa:** Look Asuna, there's a new store  
over there!

<!-- uid=1460051:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hey, yeah! And it's got treats  
I've never seen before!

<!-- uid=1460051:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** Ooh, look. This pastry is made  
with sweet potatoes!

<!-- uid=1460051:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Huh... Say, this wouldn't be from  
Kawagoe, would it?

<!-- uid=1460051:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** It sure is. Kawagoe is actually  
known as Little Edo, and has lots  
of different Japanese sweets.

<!-- uid=1460051:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, I should've known a Japanese  
VRMMO like Asuka Empire would have  
lots of treats for Girls' Day.

<!-- uid=1460051:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey. Sorry I'm late.

<!-- uid=1460051:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hi Kirito.

<!-- uid=1460051:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Looks like you're both making the  
most of this Girls' Day event.

<!-- uid=1460051:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yup! Now that the quest is over,  
it'd be a waste not to enjoy it!

<!-- uid=1460051:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** So how come you're still little  
kids? Don't you want to grow back  
up now that the incident's over?

<!-- uid=1460051:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, silly Kirito. The Girls' Day  
festival is for girls, remember?

<!-- uid=1460051:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** So don't you think it'd be more  
fun if we stay little girls too?

<!-- uid=1460051:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, yeah, that's a good point...

<!-- uid=1460051:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** Not to mention this form comes  
with other perks...

<!-- uid=1460051:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Perks?

<!-- uid=1460051:16:1 -->

**Townsman NPC:** Here girls, have a treat. Don't  
worry, they're on the house.

<!-- uid=1460051:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Wow, thank you!

<!-- uid=1460051:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** Are you sure you don't need money?

<!-- uid=1460051:19:1 -->

**Townsman NPC:** Of course. It's Girls' Day! All  
you two have to worry about is  
enjoying yourselves.

<!-- uid=1460051:20:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yay!

<!-- uid=1460051:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Aha. So that's what you meant.

<!-- uid=1460051:22:1 -->


## Story 1460053 · \[Pure Princess\] Asuna Lv.30

Character Story

**Kirito:** Pretty nice you get all these  
things for free just for being  
little girls.

<!-- uid=1460053:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hehe, right? I can't even finish  
all these treats myself.

<!-- uid=1460053:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Here Kirito, you can share mine.

<!-- uid=1460053:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ooh, thanks. I was just feeling  
a little hungry.

<!-- uid=1460053:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** Too bad you can't get in on this  
free stuff action even if you  
drink the Water of Youth, Kirito.

<!-- uid=1460053:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, nothing I can do about that,  
since it's Girls' Day and all.  
...Hm?

<!-- uid=1460053:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito? What's up?

<!-- uid=1460053:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** There's an older couple over there  
staring at us...

<!-- uid=1460053:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hm? Oh yeah, so there is.

<!-- uid=1460053:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** If they want to give us a treat,  
they should just come talk to us.

<!-- uid=1460053:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...I don't think those two are  
NPCs. I'm pretty sure they're  
players.

<!-- uid=1460053:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** They look like they're a bit older  
than most players, but yeah,  
I think so too.

<!-- uid=1460053:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** I guess it's true that Asuka  
Empire's traditional Japan theme  
appeals to older age brackets too.

<!-- uid=1460053:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** If they're players, I guess that  
also means they're not going to  
give us any treats.

<!-- uid=1460053:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** I thought you said you couldn't  
finish what you have already...

<!-- uid=1460053:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** They look kind of lonely...  
I'm going to go talk to them!

<!-- uid=1460053:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh? Asuna?

<!-- uid=1460053:17:1 -->

**Leafa:** ......

<!-- uid=1460053:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hm? Aren't you going to go after  
her, Kirito?

<!-- uid=1460053:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** No... I feel like I should stay  
out of this. Would you go instead,  
Leafa?

<!-- uid=1460053:20:1 -->

**Leafa:** Me? Uh, okay...

<!-- uid=1460053:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** Um, excuse me.

<!-- uid=1460053:22:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** Huh?

<!-- uid=1460053:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** If you'd like to take part in the  
Girls' Day festival, you're  
welcome to do so.

<!-- uid=1460053:24:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** Oh, no, thank you. We're just--

<!-- uid=1460053:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** There's no reason you can't have  
fun just because you're grown-ups,  
after all.

<!-- uid=1460053:26:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** Haha... You sound very mature for  
your age, young lady.

<!-- uid=1460053:27:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** Hehe, you sure do. Doesn't she  
remind you of our eldest, honey?

<!-- uid=1460053:28:1 -->


## Story 1460055 · \[Pure Princess\] Asuna Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to  
be rude.

<!-- uid=1460055:1:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** Not at all. It's very kind of you  
to talk to us.

<!-- uid=1460055:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** I just couldn't help but notice  
you two seemed a bit lonely.

<!-- uid=1460055:3:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** Oh no, was it that obvious?

<!-- uid=1460055:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yes. VRMMOs can detect your  
emotions and display them just  
like you do in real life.

<!-- uid=1460055:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** So it's pretty hard to cover up  
how you feel. Hehe.

<!-- uid=1460055:6:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** I see. That's good to know. I must  
say though, I'm surprised to see a  
child like you playing this game.

<!-- uid=1460055:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, I'm sorry. I'm actually--

<!-- uid=1460055:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hey Asuna, I think the limit on  
this effect is about to run out.

<!-- uid=1460055:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, yeah. In that case, I might as  
well show you...

<!-- uid=1460055:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** This is what we really look like.  
We were just using a special  
mechanic to change our appearance.

<!-- uid=1460055:11:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** S-So that explains it... I was  
wondering how such a young child  
learned to speak like a grown-up.

<!-- uid=1460055:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Um, if you don't mind my asking,

<!-- uid=1460055:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** would you mind telling me more  
about your daughter?

<!-- uid=1460055:14:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** Huh?

<!-- uid=1460055:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm probably about the same age as  
her, and I also fight with my  
mother sometimes...

<!-- uid=1460055:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** So I just thought I might be able  
to help somehow.

<!-- uid=1460055:17:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** ......

<!-- uid=1460055:18:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** Seeing you two in your child forms  
just got us reminiscing about the  
past...

<!-- uid=1460055:19:1 -->

**Leafa:** The past?

<!-- uid=1460055:20:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** Perhaps it's fate that we ended up  
meeting like this.

<!-- uid=1460055:21:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** You see, we have two daughters who  
are close in age to one another...

<!-- uid=1460055:22:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** They were adorable when they were  
children, just like you two. But  
after they graduated high school,

<!-- uid=1460055:23:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** they started arguing with us to  
the point where they just up  
and ran away...

<!-- uid=1460055:24:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** We had never fought with them  
about anything before, so it came  
as something of a shock to us.

<!-- uid=1460055:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** I see... What was it you fought  
about with them?

<!-- uid=1460055:26:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** Oh, they just wanted to move to  
the city to pursue their dreams,  
and we tried to stop them.

<!-- uid=1460055:27:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** You've heard it all before, I'm  
sure. They were such good girls  
growing up that when they

<!-- uid=1460055:28:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** started pushing back on us like  
that, we ended up overreacting.  
And that brings us to today...

<!-- uid=1460055:29:1 -->

**Asuna:** I see...

<!-- uid=1460055:30:1 -->


## Story 1460057 · \[Pure Princess\] Asuna Lv.70

Character Story

**Asuna:** Speaking as someone in a similar  
position as your daughters,

<!-- uid=1460057:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm certain that they're grateful  
to you for everything you did for  
them growing up.

<!-- uid=1460057:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** But I also think that as they got  
older, and came to realize what  
they want to do with their lives,

<!-- uid=1460057:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** they became hurt that you didn't  
understand, precisely because they  
love you so much.

<!-- uid=1460057:4:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** ......

<!-- uid=1460057:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** Asuna...

<!-- uid=1460057:6:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** I must say, hearing that from a  
girl of your age really makes it  
ring true...

<!-- uid=1460057:7:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** All the more so because your child  
forms resembled our girls when  
they were little...

<!-- uid=1460057:8:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** Tell me, what would you want us to  
do if you were our daughter?

<!-- uid=1460057:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** I think...I'd want you two to be  
patient.

<!-- uid=1460057:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** When we get older, it can be hard  
for us children to articulate our  
desires, or prove we're serious

<!-- uid=1460057:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** about them... So if I were them,  
I'd want you two to accept my  
determination to live my own life.

<!-- uid=1460057:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm certain they'll come back  
someday, even if they don't end up  
accomplishing their goals...

<!-- uid=1460057:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** And when they do, I'm sure they'll  
want you to welcome them with open  
arms. Because you're their family.

<!-- uid=1460057:14:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** \*sigh\* I knew it. Honey,  
I hope you take all that to heart.

<!-- uid=1460057:15:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** Yeah...It wasn't easy to hear, but  
I think I needed to hear it...  
You know, it's funny.

<!-- uid=1460057:16:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** I had no intention whatsoever of  
hearing what my daughters had to  
say, but meeting you here,

<!-- uid=1460057:17:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** and hearing what YOU had to say,  
really got to me... What a strange  
place this virtual world is.

<!-- uid=1460057:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, I know what you mean.  
I think it may be precisely  
because this world is separate

<!-- uid=1460057:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** from the real one that we're  
better able to express how we  
really feel.

<!-- uid=1460057:20:1 -->

**Leafa:** Your daughters left together,  
right?

<!-- uid=1460057:21:1 -->

**Leafa:** In that case, I'm sure they're  
living together right now and  
doing just fine!

<!-- uid=1460057:22:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** Thank you. I think so too.

<!-- uid=1460057:23:1 -->


## Story 1460058 · \[Pure Princess\] Asuna Lv.80

Character Story

**Kirito:** All done?

<!-- uid=1460058:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah. Thanks for waiting for us,  
Kirito.

<!-- uid=1460058:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** That couple sure looks like they  
feel a lot better now, don't they.

<!-- uid=1460058:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah... You know, when I first saw  
them, I thought of my mother  
whenever we have a fight.

<!-- uid=1460058:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** After that, I just felt like I had  
to do something...

<!-- uid=1460058:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** Were you aware of that all along,  
Kirito?

<!-- uid=1460058:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hardly. I just remembered that  
Asuna thought the dolls on the

<!-- uid=1460058:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Girls' Day stand looked sad, and  
it turned out there was something  
to that.

<!-- uid=1460058:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** So I just decided to trust her  
instincts here too.

<!-- uid=1460058:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, thanks, Kirito.  
I'm glad I trusted mine and talked  
to them too.

<!-- uid=1460058:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** I guess every parent and child has  
arguments like this eventually.

<!-- uid=1460058:11:1 -->

**Leafa:** Lucky for our family that my  
brother got his rebellious phase  
out of the way early on.

<!-- uid=1460058:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** Of course, he also ran away for  
like two years, so...

<!-- uid=1460058:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** You know as well as I do I wasn't  
rebelling against anything OR  
running away during that time...

<!-- uid=1460058:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** In my case, I ended up fighting  
with my parents even after I'd been  
away for two years.

<!-- uid=1460058:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** But these days we get along really  
well, so maybe that was a good  
thing.

<!-- uid=1460058:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hehe, that's great! I guess it's  
true what they say: after rain  
comes fair weather!

<!-- uid=1460058:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah!

<!-- uid=1460058:18:1 -->


## Story 1460061 · \[Freezing Magic Bow\] Asuna Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=1460061:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** And that's what Yuuki and I  
experienced the last time we  
were in Helheim.

<!-- uid=1460061:2:1 -->

**Yuuki:** The dark, fire giantess Urdr is  
still frozen.

<!-- uid=1460061:3:1 -->

**Yuuki:** There's a lot we don't know...  
Like, where'd the frost come  
from? But things seem stable.

<!-- uid=1460061:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah. Hopefully we can come up  
with something good.

<!-- uid=1460061:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** So, we need to find a way to save  
Urdr, with the demons still being  
able to come to Alfheim,

<!-- uid=1460061:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** all without destroying the Divine  
Object, Chronos Zone.

<!-- uid=1460061:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah.

<!-- uid=1460061:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** But, you know,  
I'm a little relieved.

<!-- uid=1460061:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Actually, me too.

<!-- uid=1460061:10:1 -->

**Yuuki:** What?! Do you have any idea how  
much crap we're in right now?

<!-- uid=1460061:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** We have hope now. The dark Urdr  
that we thought disappeared still  
exists somewhere,

<!-- uid=1460061:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** and she wants to be saved.  
I bet that's why she used the  
Divine Object to revive herself.

<!-- uid=1460061:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah. I didn't think there was  
anything we could do back then,

<!-- uid=1460061:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** but I think Cardinal wants  
to save her too.

<!-- uid=1460061:15:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Maybe. But we still have to do  
the work, you know?

<!-- uid=1460061:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yep. Alright, I'm all fired up!

<!-- uid=1460061:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's the Kirito I know! Makoto  
and Thokk will be right there  
with us too.

<!-- uid=1460061:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** We're all in this together.  
Let's do this.

<!-- uid=1460061:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah! So, what's the plan?

<!-- uid=1460061:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** First, we should confirm that  
Urdr is safe.

<!-- uid=1460061:21:1 -->

**Yuuki:** You're right. Let's go back to  
Jotunheimr.

<!-- uid=1460061:22:1 -->


## Story 1460063 · \[Freezing Magic Bow\] Asuna Lv.30

Character Story

**Kirito:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=1460063:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** What is it, Kirito?

<!-- uid=1460063:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, this might be irrelevant,  
but...

<!-- uid=1460063:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** The resurrection of Dark Urdr  
reminded me of the app I'm  
working on in the real world.

<!-- uid=1460063:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** I've been struggling with all  
these unexpected errors.

<!-- uid=1460063:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, I heard from Yui. You fix  
a bug and it's still there, right?  
Or another one pops up?

<!-- uid=1460063:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, and after hearing about  
Dark Urdr, it got me thinking.

<!-- uid=1460063:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** There's always a reason behind  
errors and bugs...

<!-- uid=1460063:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Trying to fix the symptoms just  
messes up the source code. We'll  
have to determine the cause...

<!-- uid=1460063:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...and be mindful of the fact that  
we're the ones disturbing the  
natural flow of their world.

<!-- uid=1460063:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Otherwise we won't be able to find  
a real solution where everyone  
ends up happy.

<!-- uid=1460063:11:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Then maybe Cardinal resurrected  
Dark Urdr to introduce a cycle  
of goodness into Helheim.

<!-- uid=1460063:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. So instead of feeling  
dissatisfied with the errors  
in my app,

<!-- uid=1460063:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** I should think of it as a call  
for help that I can do something  
about.

<!-- uid=1460063:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, you might be right.

<!-- uid=1460063:15:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Still, Dark Urdr was eliminated  
from the system once before...

<!-- uid=1460063:16:1 -->

**Yuuki:** And the game still used Norse  
mythology to create a story to  
resurrect and even save her...

<!-- uid=1460063:17:1 -->

**Yuuki:** It really is scary just how  
flexible the auto-quest  
generator is...

<!-- uid=1460063:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** I wonder how Urdr's going to be  
saved... and how this whole thing's  
going to end.

<!-- uid=1460063:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** I hope we find out soon...

<!-- uid=1460063:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** So, what kinds of things was Dark  
Urdr saying?

<!-- uid=1460063:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hmm... It was mostly shouting and  
screaming. I don't think she had  
any dialogue.

<!-- uid=1460063:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** I see... If only we knew the  
cause of her pain, it would help  
us come up with a better plan.

<!-- uid=1460063:23:1 -->


## Story 1460065 · \[Freezing Magic Bow\] Asuna Lv.50

Character Story

**Urdr:** Fairy warriors... I see you find  
yourselves in our land once  
more.

<!-- uid=1460065:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Urdr...

<!-- uid=1460065:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** H-Hello... It's good to  
see you again.

<!-- uid=1460065:3:1 -->

**Yuuki:** It's the normal Urdr. This means  
two Urdrs exist right now...

<!-- uid=1460065:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** I thought she'd have changed a  
bit, but nope. Looks and sounds  
the same.

<!-- uid=1460065:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** What should we do? Should we just  
go straight to Helheim?

<!-- uid=1460065:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** First... I want to know how Thokk  
found the Divine Object in  
Nibelheim.

<!-- uid=1460065:7:1 -->

**Yuuki:** She said it was lying at the  
entrance of Nibelheim, right  
under the spring.

<!-- uid=1460065:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hmm... So it could have actually  
dropped from this spring.

<!-- uid=1460065:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** I wonder if Urdr knows anything...

<!-- uid=1460065:10:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Maybe you should ask her?

<!-- uid=1460065:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Would she understand? I know her  
AI's capable, but this might be  
a bit too complicated...

<!-- uid=1460065:12:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I think it's worth a try. She's a  
super advanced AI with a  
language module, after all.

<!-- uid=1460065:13:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Okay. Urdr, do you know anything  
about a lump of black metal?

<!-- uid=1460065:14:1 -->

**Urdr:** ...Please take care not to  
disturb us while you are  
in our land.

<!-- uid=1460065:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Is she ignoring you? Maybe the  
question's too complicated,  
after all.

<!-- uid=1460065:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wait. That wasn't even a  
difficult question.

<!-- uid=1460065:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** She'd usually respond a little  
more flexibly...

<!-- uid=1460065:18:1 -->

**Yuuki:** ...! These flames!

<!-- uid=1460065:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's the same fire we saw in  
Helheim!

<!-- uid=1460065:20:1 -->

**Fire Mob:** AAAAHHHH!

<!-- uid=1460065:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Who are these guys?

<!-- uid=1460065:22:1 -->

**Yuuki:** They're Dark Urdr's minions from  
Helheim!

<!-- uid=1460065:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** What are they doing here?!

<!-- uid=1460065:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** Come on, we have no choice but  
to defeat them!

<!-- uid=1460065:25:1 -->


## Story 1460067 · \[Freezing Magic Bow\] Asuna Lv.70

Character Story

**Kirito:** Well, that takes care of that...

<!-- uid=1460067:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** You know, I wouldn't be surprised  
if this hellfire is what's melting  
the ice in Nibelheim.

<!-- uid=1460067:2:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I mean, yeah... It's hellfire...

<!-- uid=1460067:3:1 -->

**Yuuki:** And if the ice world of Nibelheim  
is the same as the hellscape of  
Helheim...

<!-- uid=1460067:4:1 -->

**Yuuki:** ...then it's as if Dark Urdr is a  
messenger straight from hell.

<!-- uid=1460067:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's definitely plausible...

<!-- uid=1460067:6:1 -->

**Urdr:** Greetings... What can I do for  
you today?

<!-- uid=1460067:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** What?!

## Story 1460075 · \[Long Range Archer\] Sinon Lv.50

Character Story

**Yui:** The power of emotions is the most  
fundamental source of power there  
is for living beings to survive.

<!-- uid=1460075:1:1 -->

**Yui:** And not in a combative sense.  
Indomitable spirit is a thought  
process that only they have...

<!-- uid=1460075:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Indomitable spirit... You mean  
things like tenacity, or the  
adrenaline we get in emergencies?

<!-- uid=1460075:3:1 -->

**Yui:** That's right. With an indomitable  
spirit, there are no limits to the  
strength emotions can give you.

<!-- uid=1460075:4:1 -->

**Yui:** As I've come to learn more about  
the history of human civilization,  
I've come to think it's humanity's

<!-- uid=1460075:5:1 -->

**Yui:** ability to make steady progress  
toward ever higher goals that sets  
them apart from other animals.

<!-- uid=1460075:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** You may be right about that...  
But now you think you don't have  
that same quality yourself?

<!-- uid=1460075:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Is that why you were sitting outhere by yourself, lost in thought?

<!-- uid=1460075:8:1 -->

**Yui:** Yes... When I think about if the  
project that Daddy's involved in  
right now ever succeeds at making

<!-- uid=1460075:9:1 -->

**Yui:** bottom-up MHCPs...I can't help but  
wonder if there will still be a  
place for me in this world...

<!-- uid=1460075:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yui...! Please don't say things  
like that!

<!-- uid=1460075:11:1 -->

**Yui:** Mommy...

<!-- uid=1460075:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** I know what you're trying to  
say... But those kinds of  
capabilities have nothing to do

<!-- uid=1460075:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** with why Kirito and I decided to  
make you our daughter.

<!-- uid=1460075:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** We love you for who you are.  
Things like your kindness, your  
sheer adorableness...

<!-- uid=1460075:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** We both feel incredibly blessed to  
have met you in SAO...

<!-- uid=1460075:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** And I don't want to spend another  
day in my life without you in it.

<!-- uid=1460075:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** So please...please don't say such  
sad things like that anymore...

<!-- uid=1460075:18:1 -->

**Yui:** Mommy...  
...Okay, I won't. I'm sorry...

<!-- uid=1460075:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** No, you don't have to apologize.  
I'm the one who's sorry for making  
you ever feel that way...

<!-- uid=1460075:20:1 -->

**Yui:** ......

<!-- uid=1460075:21:1 -->


## Story 1460077 · \[Long Range Archer\] Sinon Lv.70

Character Story

**Asuna:** ......

<!-- uid=1460077:1:1 -->

**Chrysheight:** I see. Thank you for the report,  
Asuna.

<!-- uid=1460077:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Don't misunderstand. I didn't do  
this to help with your experiment.

<!-- uid=1460077:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm only asking your opinion for  
Kirito's sake...and for Yui's.

<!-- uid=1460077:4:1 -->

**Chrysheight:** Haha, I'm well aware.  
Rest assured, you have nothing to  
worry about.

<!-- uid=1460077:5:1 -->

**Chrysheight:** Please tell that top-down AI--  
I mean, your daughter, this:  
there may indeed be many things

<!-- uid=1460077:6:1 -->

**Chrysheight:** that can only best be learned  
through study or experience,  
but that applies equally to

<!-- uid=1460077:7:1 -->

**Chrysheight:** top-down AIs as well. The very  
fact that she was able to arrive  
at that way of thinking shows that

<!-- uid=1460077:8:1 -->

**Chrysheight:** she is practically human herself.  
I've never seen another top-down  
AI with such mental faculties.

<!-- uid=1460077:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Wait. Does that mean...?!

<!-- uid=1460077:10:1 -->

**Chrysheight:** Haha, don't worry. I'm not  
planning to experiment on her or  
anything like that.

<!-- uid=1460077:11:1 -->

**Chrysheight:** I know what you and Kirito would  
do to me if I tried...

<!-- uid=1460077:12:1 -->

**Chrysheight:** Besides, in my estimation,  
she's also going through a  
transitional phrase.

<!-- uid=1460077:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Transitional phase...?

<!-- uid=1460077:14:1 -->

**Chrysheight:** I believe that in the process of  
repeating various introspective  
thought patterns,

<!-- uid=1460077:15:1 -->

**Chrysheight:** she is unconsciously working  
towards becoming an even more  
advanced top-down AI.

<!-- uid=1460077:16:1 -->

**Chrysheight:** Of course, even I don't know what  
lies beyond that...but I do think  
that neither bottom-up nor

<!-- uid=1460077:17:1 -->

**Chrysheight:** top-down AIs are inherently  
superior. Rather, I believe both  
will lead to exciting new paths.

<!-- uid=1460077:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...Do you really believe that?  
And...will hearing that help my  
daughter feel better?

<!-- uid=1460077:19:1 -->

**Chrysheight:** Hmm... It's hard to say for sure,  
but based strictly on what you've  
told me,

<!-- uid=1460077:20:1 -->

**Chrysheight:** I'd say I felt that Yui's  
potential really lies here.

<!-- uid=1460077:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** Here...?

<!-- uid=1460077:22:1 -->


## Story 1460078 · \[Long Range Archer\] Sinon Lv.80

Character Story

**Yui:** Huh...?

<!-- uid=1460078:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yui, earlier you told us you were  
going into sleep mode,

<!-- uid=1460078:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** but you never did, did you?

<!-- uid=1460078:3:1 -->

**Yui:** Oh, uh... I'm sorry.

<!-- uid=1460078:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh no, I'm not looking for an  
apology. In fact, that's where  
your greatest potential lies.

<!-- uid=1460078:5:1 -->

**Yui:** ...What do you mean?

<!-- uid=1460078:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** AI can never defy human will,  
no matter what kind it is. That  
goes for Underworld as well.

<!-- uid=1460078:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** In fact, one of the purposes of  
Rath's project is to find out why  
that is, which is why they're

<!-- uid=1460078:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** trying to find NPCs who will breakthe Taboo Index.When you told us that lie...

<!-- uid=1460078:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** You did so because you didn't want  
us to worry about you. Isn't that  
right?

<!-- uid=1460078:10:1 -->

**Yui:** That's right...

<!-- uid=1460078:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ordinarily, an AI would never be  
capable of that...which means it  
was something only you could do.

<!-- uid=1460078:12:1 -->

**Yui:** So that's why it's the key to mypotential...?

<!-- uid=1460078:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Uh huh. Honestly, it made me kind  
of happy to hear that...

<!-- uid=1460078:14:1 -->

**Yui:** It did?

<!-- uid=1460078:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** It sure did. After all, lying to  
your parents is part of every  
child's rebellious phase, right?

<!-- uid=1460078:16:1 -->

**Yui:** Huh?

<!-- uid=1460078:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, it made me feel like my  
little Yui was really growing up!

<!-- uid=1460078:18:1 -->

**Yui:** Um, Mommy? You know I don't age  
the same way you do, right...?

<!-- uid=1460078:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** That doesn't matter! Ooh, I can't  
wait to tell Kirito about this.

<!-- uid=1460078:20:1 -->

**Yui:** Oh Mommy... Hehe.  
...Thank you for telling me too.

<!-- uid=1460078:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, but don't think this means you  
can go around lying all the time,  
even to be nice. Okay?

<!-- uid=1460078:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** It would break my heart if  
everyone started thinking my  
daughter wasn't trustworthy!

<!-- uid=1460078:23:1 -->

**Yui:** Okay, Mommy! In that case, I'll  
make sure to always talk to you  
about anything that's on my mind!

<!-- uid=1460078:24:1 -->

take it from you so long as we're  
there on time.

friends might.

Okay, let's go.

**Kirito:** You got it!

<!-- uid=1460087:16:1 -->

same as ever, weren't they?

selves just now, only in the past.

## Story 1460091 · \[Divine Bow of Benevolence\] Silica Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** Ungh...

<!-- uid=1460091:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Not again...

<!-- uid=1460091:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** Completely annihilated...

<!-- uid=1460091:3:1 -->

**Silica:** How many times has it been now?

<!-- uid=1460091:4:2 -->

**Warla:** Five.

<!-- uid=1460091:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** \*sigh\*... This game really is  
 putting us through the wringer,  
 huh?

<!-- uid=1460091:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Maybe we just got too spoiled from  
 not dying much in the games we  
 usually play.

<!-- uid=1460091:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeah, I think that's it. This game  
 is balanced way differently than  
 ALO, GGO, or Asuka Empire.

<!-- uid=1460091:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** It's, like, we're good up to this  
 point. But anything beyond that,  
 and we're done for.

<!-- uid=1460091:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** It really is unlike anything we've  
 played before...

<!-- uid=1460091:10:1 -->

**Silica:** I guess it's par for the course  
 for a game willing to thrash  
 players as soon as they join.

<!-- uid=1460091:11:1 -->

**Silica:** I think I've played other  
 games that felt kinda like  
 this, though...

<!-- uid=1460091:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** You're not thinking of, like,  
 old arcade games or something,  
 are you?

<!-- uid=1460091:13:1 -->

**Silica:** Ah, that's it! This game just  
 reminds me of them by how you get  
 better by losing over and over!

<!-- uid=1460091:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** I haven't played a lot of games  
 like that, so I'm sorry if this  
 is a dumb question, but...

<!-- uid=1460091:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Do those games not have  
 EXP and leveling systems to make  
 your character stronger?

<!-- uid=1460091:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** There are some like that, but the  
 ones we're talking about didn't  
 have any sort of saving at all.

<!-- uid=1460091:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** You'd put in 100 yen, see how far  
 you get, and then once you got a  
 game over, that was that.

<!-- uid=1460091:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** That's so different from arcades  
 now, where you can save to an IC  
 card to pick things up later.

<!-- uid=1460091:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** The old arcade games were maybe  
 a bit more like crane games and  
 other skill-based challenges.

<!-- uid=1460091:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** So are you saying they were  
 intended to be enjoyed mostly  
 in short bursts?

<!-- uid=1460091:21:1 -->

**Silica:** Yeah, I'd say so!

<!-- uid=1460091:22:1 -->


## Story 1460093 · \[Divine Bow of Benevolence\] Silica Lv.30

Character Story

**Warla:** Uh, I hate to butt in, but I don't  
 have the slightest clue what any  
 of you guys are talking about...

<!-- uid=1460093:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, sorry about that. Don't worry.  
 It's not important.

<!-- uid=1460093:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Warla might be really intelligent,  
 but she's still an NPC in the end.

<!-- uid=1460093:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Try not to talk about things  
 that'll leave her feeling left  
 out, okay?

<!-- uid=1460093:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** O-Okay. I'll try to remember that.

<!-- uid=1460093:5:2 -->

**Warla:** Anyway... \*yawn\*...  
 I'm getting a little sleepy...

<!-- uid=1460093:6:1 -->

**Silica:** Th-That came out of nowhere...

<!-- uid=1460093:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** She's still a kid. It happens...

<!-- uid=1460093:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** That reminds me: I know ALO has  
 shorter days than real life. Is  
 this game like that too?

<!-- uid=1460093:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, I think the day and night  
 cycle here is about the same as  
 ALO.

<!-- uid=1460093:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** Then that would explain why she's  
 sleepy already.

<!-- uid=1460093:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's okay if you need to rest,  
 Warla. We'll keep an eye out  
 to make sure nothing happens.

<!-- uid=1460093:12:1 -->

**Warla:** O-Okay... Thanks... Asuna...

<!-- uid=1460093:13:1 -->

**Warla:** Zzz... Zzz...

<!-- uid=1460093:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** And just like that, she's out.

<!-- uid=1460093:15:1 -->

**Silica:** She must've been exhausted.

<!-- uid=1460093:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** Silica, if you wanna get some  
 shuteye too, that's okay.

<!-- uid=1460093:17:1 -->

**Silica:** D-Don't treat me like a little  
 kid! I'm older than Warla!

<!-- uid=1460093:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha, well, while she's resting,  
 we should probably at least get  
 our equipment straightened out.

<!-- uid=1460093:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm guessing you're going to head  
 over to that starter weapon  
 storehouse we went to before.

<!-- uid=1460093:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. Do you and Silica mind  
 staying here to watch over Warla?

<!-- uid=1460093:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Leafa and I will go get the  
 weapons.

<!-- uid=1460093:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sounds good. While you're doing  
 that, I'll gather some Drops of  
 Morning Dew around here.

<!-- uid=1460093:23:1 -->

**Leafa:** I wonder how many times we're  
 gonna end up visiting that  
 storehouse before this is over...

<!-- uid=1460093:24:1 -->

**Silica:** Ahaha...

<!-- uid=1460093:25:1 -->


## Story 1460095 · \[Divine Bow of Benevolence\] Silica Lv.50

Character Story

**Leafa:** Hey, Kazuto? This is everything  
 that Asuna and Silica need, right?

<!-- uid=1460095:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yep. And our weapons are right  
 here...

<!-- uid=1460095:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** Huh?

<!-- uid=1460095:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** What's wrong?

<!-- uid=1460095:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** The floor feels weirdly uneven...  
 Whoa!

<!-- uid=1460095:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Aah! It opened up! Is there some  
 sort of basement?

<!-- uid=1460095:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** No, looks more like just a storage  
 space...

<!-- uid=1460095:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** Wait, there are weapons and armor  
 here too!

<!-- uid=1460095:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Really? Lemme see!  
 ...Hmm?

<!-- uid=1460095:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Is it just me or is this all the  
 same stuff that's stocked in  
 the rest of the storehouse?

<!-- uid=1460095:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Looks like it... I thought there'd  
 be some stronger stuff stashed  
 here, but... Wait!

<!-- uid=1460095:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** It is stronger equipment! They  
 look the same, but their stats are  
 definitely higher!

<!-- uid=1460095:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** Seriously?!

<!-- uid=1460095:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, there's no reason not to  
 grab this stuff. It's sure to make  
 our lives much easier.

<!-- uid=1460095:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** Wow, that's awesome! If only we  
 knew about this sooner, it  
 could've saved us some trouble.

<!-- uid=1460095:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** It might not have been possible.  
 It could be designed so it only  
 unlocks after multiple visits.

<!-- uid=1460095:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** Huh? Oh, you mean for people who  
 have tried tons of times, but  
 still can't beat the game?

<!-- uid=1460095:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha... That's another way of  
 putting it...

<!-- uid=1460095:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** I figure if you're developing  
 a hard game like this, you want  
 to give players a lifeline.

<!-- uid=1460095:19:1 -->

**Leafa:** Right. It's not like everyone's  
 skills are gonna improve at the  
 same rate.

<!-- uid=1460095:20:1 -->

**Leafa:** Plus, if you don't want that  
 handicap, it's not like you have  
 to take advantage of it either.

<!-- uid=1460095:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sure thing...

<!-- uid=1460095:22:1 -->

**Leafa:** What should we do, Kazuto?

<!-- uid=1460095:23:1 -->

**Leafa:** Should we grab our usual  
 equipment? Or go for the  
 upgraded stuff?

<!-- uid=1460095:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** Good question...

<!-- uid=1460095:25:1 -->


## Story 1460097 · \[Divine Bow of Benevolence\] Silica Lv.70

Character Story

**Asuna:** Wait, so you didn't take any of  
 the better equipment?

**Kirito:** U-Uh... yeah.

 those stubborn types who doesn't  
 like to let a game beat him.

<!-- uid=1460097:3:1 -->

**Silica:** Hehe, that sounds just like him.

 he always goes for the hardest  
 difficulty.

<!-- uid=1460097:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Th-That's... actually pretty  
 true...

<!-- uid=1460097:6:2 -->

**Kirito:** I just hate the idea of losing to  
 the developers...

<!-- uid=1460097:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** \*sigh\*... It's not every day we  
 come across such good equipment,  
 and you just passed it up.

<!-- uid=1460097:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** If you'd done that in SAO, other  
 Assault Team members would've  
 given you a tongue-lashing.

<!-- uid=1460097:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, I know. I'm sorry...

<!-- uid=1460097:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** At any rate, this game is really  
 brutal...

<!-- uid=1460097:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** If it is ever officially released,  
 I can't help but wonder how  
 players will react.

<!-- uid=1460097:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** I have to imagine a lot of them

<!-- uid=1460097:13:1 -->

## Story 1460098 · \[Divine Bow of Benevolence\] Silica Lv.80

Character Story

**Kirito:** When you look back, this style of  
 game where you're building up a  
 character like in Japanese RPGs...

<!-- uid=1460098:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...is something that's really  
 indicative of Japanese tastes.

<!-- uid=1460098:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** It is?

<!-- uid=1460098:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. Even now, a lot of western  
 games are made to simply be  
 competitions of sheer skill.

<!-- uid=1460098:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** You see that in e-sports games  
 especially. Lots of RTSs and  
 fighters are like that too.

<!-- uid=1460098:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh yeah, now that you mention  
 it, that is true, huh?

<!-- uid=1460098:6:2 -->

**Silica:** I guess that explains why when  
 games like this come out in Japan,  
 opinions tend to be split here.

<!-- uid=1460098:7:1 -->

**Silica:** They're quite different from the  
 RPGs everyone's used to,  
 after all.

<!-- uid=1460098:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's a good point.

<!-- uid=1460098:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** That makes sense. It makes me  
 appreciate what we have to be  
 most careful about here...

<!-- uid=1460098:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Seeing as we're playing a game  
 where you lose everything if  
 you get wiped out.

<!-- uid=1460098:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, we have to avoid losing  
 any rare items as a death  
 penalty at all costs.

<!-- uid=1460098:12:1 -->

**Silica:** What rare items?

<!-- uid=1460098:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Right now, the rarest weapon we  
 have is the Heavenhell Weapon we  
 got from the first angel we beat.

<!-- uid=1460098:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** The Blade of the Azure Tear, the  
 sword that Makoto's holding  
 onto for us.

<!-- uid=1460098:15:1 -->

**Silica:** Oh, I get it. Because if she's  
 not in the party, she can't lose  
 it if we all get defeated.

<!-- uid=1460098:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** I guess that's a valid strategy  
 for coping with this game  
 being so hard.

<!-- uid=1460098:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, that's part of the fun of  
 new games, isn't it? Learning how  
 they work and strategizing.

<!-- uid=1460098:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** For sure. Anyway, we should  
 probably wake up Warla.

<!-- uid=1460098:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's time to resume our adventure!

<!-- uid=1460098:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Thanks!

<!-- uid=1460098:21:1 -->

any intruders they see, right?

monsters here! That alone makes

Slant!

attacks! The only thing you've  
been hitting is the pillar!

## Story 1460108 · \[Clairvoyant Integrity Knight\] Sinon Lv.80

**Sinon:** Looks like you're done too, Eugeo.

considering that you only  
just met.

any powerful enemies that might be  
waiting for us up ahead.

<!-- uid=1460108:16:1 -->

Okay, let's keep moving.

<!-- uid=1460108:17:1 -->

<!-- uid=1460108:18:1 -->


## Story 1460131 · \[Welcoming the New Year\] Asuna Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** Phew. It wasn't always easy,  
but I'm glad we got to see the  
sunrise here in Asuka Empire.

<!-- uid=1460131:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Me too. You know, I have a feeling  
it's going to turn out to be  
another great year.

<!-- uid=1460131:2:1 -->

**Eugeo:** So, what do we do about food  
now that we're all on board with  
getting breakfast somewhere?

<!-- uid=1460131:3:1 -->

**Alice:** What about hunting, since we are  
on a mountain? We could also  
scavenge for edible plants.

<!-- uid=1460131:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Um, that would work too, but I  
think I'd rather eat somewhere  
a little more...relaxing?

<!-- uid=1460131:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Haha, I'm glad to see we've had  
such a positive effect on you  
since you met us, Alice.

<!-- uid=1460131:6:1 -->

**Alice:** Wh-What do you mean? I have not  
changed at all... At any rate,  
shall we find a restaurant then?

<!-- uid=1460131:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, I guess we should.  
But where...?

<!-- uid=1460131:8:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Hey, look, over there. Doesn't it  
look like that mountain cottage  
serves food?

<!-- uid=1460131:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's the lodge we saw along the  
way.

<!-- uid=1460131:10:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Looks like I was right. I can see  
people eating inside.

<!-- uid=1460131:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** It IS pretty common for lodges at  
tourist spots to have restaurants.  
Maybe this is one of those.

<!-- uid=1460131:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Now that you mention it, there's  
a place on top of Mount Takao  
that's famous for its soba.

<!-- uid=1460131:13:1 -->

**Alice:** More talk of soba...?

<!-- uid=1460131:14:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Hm? Hey, look at what it is  
they're eating.

<!-- uid=1460131:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Don't tell me...

<!-- uid=1460131:16:1 -->


## Story 1460133 · \[Welcoming the New Year\] Asuna Lv.30

Character Story

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Toshi-koshi soba! Get your toshi-  
koshi soba right here! Can't start  
the new year without it!

<!-- uid=1460133:1:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Already had some last night?  
Not a problem!

<!-- uid=1460133:2:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** The more you eat, the better luck  
you'll have! Better stock up on it  
while you've got the chance!

<!-- uid=1460133:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** That seems kind of unlikely...

<!-- uid=1460133:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, it DOES get pretty cold on  
top of mountains like this.

<!-- uid=1460133:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Having a bowl of hot soba now  
might just hit the spot.

<!-- uid=1460133:6:1 -->

**Alice:** I don't know. I can still taste  
the bad soba we had last night...

<!-- uid=1460133:7:2 -->

**Eugeo:** S-Same here. Neither Alice nor me  
have had any good soba so far.

<!-- uid=1460133:8:1 -->

**Eugeo:** So the idea of having more of it  
isn't really that enticing...

<!-- uid=1460133:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Good point. If we're going to have  
more soba, we need to make sure  
it's really good first!

<!-- uid=1460133:10:1 -->

**Alice:** Asuna, you are a talented cook.  
Could you not make soba yourself?

<!-- uid=1460133:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sure I can. Though it does depend  
on how much I'm making from  
scratch...

<!-- uid=1460133:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** If we're talking about grinding  
buckwheat flour ourselves...  
that's gonna take a lot of time.

<!-- uid=1460133:13:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Excuse me.

<!-- uid=1460133:14:1 -->

**Player:** Hm?

<!-- uid=1460133:15:1 -->

**Eugeo:** You were just eating there, right?  
Can I ask you how the soba was?

<!-- uid=1460133:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Looks like Eugeo's putting his  
social skills to work again.

<!-- uid=1460133:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ahaha...

<!-- uid=1460133:18:1 -->

**Player:** Uh, s-sure. It was really good.  
Although...

<!-- uid=1460133:19:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...?

<!-- uid=1460133:20:1 -->

**Player:** W-Well, you'll see if you go in  
yourselves. Basically, how good  
the soba is is up to you.

<!-- uid=1460133:21:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Huh?

<!-- uid=1460133:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Up to us? How does that work?

<!-- uid=1460133:23:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Ah, I see you're interested in our  
food! Come on, right this way!

<!-- uid=1460133:24:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Party of four, coming through!

<!-- uid=1460133:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yikes. Talk about pushy.

<!-- uid=1460133:26:1 -->

**Alice:** Does this mean our actions will  
affect the food's flavor?

<!-- uid=1460133:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm not sure either...

<!-- uid=1460133:28:1 -->

**Kirito:** Uh oh...

<!-- uid=1460133:29:1 -->


## Story 1460135 · \[Welcoming the New Year\] Asuna Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** Let's see what's on the menu...

<!-- uid=1460135:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh? It's totally blank.

<!-- uid=1460135:2:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Okay everyone, let me tell you all  
about our New Year's special!

<!-- uid=1460135:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** New Year's special?

<!-- uid=1460135:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** That sounds interesting.

<!-- uid=1460135:5:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** It is! For this special, the food  
you receive will be determined by  
your answers on a quiz!

<!-- uid=1460135:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Q-Quiz?

<!-- uid=1460135:7:1 -->

**Alice:** What is a quiz?

<!-- uid=1460135:8:2 -->

**Asuna:** Um, basically, it's a game where  
you have to answer riddles.

<!-- uid=1460135:9:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Why do we have to do a quiz just  
to eat?

<!-- uid=1460135:10:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Simple! It's not New Year's if  
you're not sitting around watching  
TV with your family!

<!-- uid=1460135:11:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** And what could be more  
entertaining for the whole family  
than a quiz show?!

<!-- uid=1460135:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** A-Are you sure? I don't think  
that's generally how New Year's is  
celebrated these days...

<!-- uid=1460135:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, this IS Asuka Empire. They  
may be going for something more  
old-fashioned here on purpose.

<!-- uid=1460135:14:1 -->

**Eugeo:** So, let me get this straight...

<!-- uid=1460135:15:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Does this mean the quality of our  
food changes depending on how many  
riddles we get right?

<!-- uid=1460135:16:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** You got it! Answer all three  
questions correctly, and you'll  
get to enjoy the best soba ever!

<!-- uid=1460135:17:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** But be careful! For every question  
you get wrong, the soba's quality  
will drop proportionally!

<!-- uid=1460135:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** So this is what that person Eugeo  
talked to meant...

<!-- uid=1460135:19:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Now let's get started!  
Question one!

<!-- uid=1460135:20:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** How did toshi-koshi soba, the  
custom of eating buckwheat noodles  
on New Year's Eve, originate?

<!-- uid=1460135:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Uhh...

<!-- uid=1460135:22:1 -->


## Story 1460137 · \[Welcoming the New Year\] Asuna Lv.70

Character Story

**Asuna:** I know that one.  
In fact, a lot of people do.

<!-- uid=1460137:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's because people used to think  
that eating long foods would in  
turn lead to a long life.

<!-- uid=1460137:2:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** That answer is...  
Correct!

<!-- uid=1460137:3:1 -->

**Alice:** Well done, Asuna. I am not  
surprised you knew that.

<!-- uid=1460137:4:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I see. So that's how it began.

<!-- uid=1460137:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Now that you mention it, I think  
I've heard that before, too...

<!-- uid=1460137:6:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Question two! Nowadays, people go  
to both temples AND shrines to  
pray on New Year's Day.

<!-- uid=1460137:7:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** In which historical period did  
temples and shrines start to be  
treated separately?

<!-- uid=1460137:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh?  
Well, uh...

<!-- uid=1460137:9:1 -->

**Eugeo:** So this is about Asuka Empire's  
history, huh. There's no way I can  
figure out this one.

<!-- uid=1460137:10:1 -->

**Alice:** When was it that the Buddha first  
came to be?

<!-- uid=1460137:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Didn't Buddhism get its start in  
Japan during the Asuka period?

<!-- uid=1460137:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** True, but that's the wrong line of  
thinking. Temples and shrines  
were only treated separately...

<!-- uid=1460137:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...once Shinto was separated from  
Buddhism. And THAT happened in  
the Meiji period!

<!-- uid=1460137:14:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** That answer is correct!

<!-- uid=1460137:15:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Way to go, Asuna!

<!-- uid=1460137:16:1 -->

**Alice:** I do not know how long ago either  
of those periods are. Were they  
close to one another?

<!-- uid=1460137:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** No, not at all. They're hundreds  
of years apart. You really know  
your stuff, Asuna...

<!-- uid=1460137:18:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Now for the final question! Seeing  
the first sunrise of the year...

<!-- uid=1460137:19:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** ...is a custom meant to greet the  
god of the new year.

<!-- uid=1460137:20:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** What is the other thing that this  
god of the new year symbolizes?

<!-- uid=1460137:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Something it symbolizes?

<!-- uid=1460137:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ooh, this is a toughie...

<!-- uid=1460137:23:1 -->


## Story 1460138 · \[Welcoming the New Year\] Asuna Lv.80

Character Story

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Once again, what does the god of  
the new year symbolize?

<!-- uid=1460138:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Err...

<!-- uid=1460138:2:1 -->

**Eugeo:** This MUST be tough if Asuna  
doesn't know the answer.

<!-- uid=1460138:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** If Asuna doesn't know,  
I definitely don't...

<!-- uid=1460138:4:1 -->

**Alice:** There are a number of gods for  
different things in my world, too.

<!-- uid=1460138:5:2 -->

**Alice:** Stacia, goddess of creation...  
Solus, goddess of the sun...  
Terraria, goddess of the earth...

<!-- uid=1460138:6:1 -->

**Alice:** Creation, sun, and earth, huh...  
I guess those all make sense.

<!-- uid=1460138:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** I feel like there's got to be more  
to this question than that,  
though... Can we get a hint?

<!-- uid=1460138:8:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** A hint, eh. Alright.  
Traditionally, people decorate  
their homes in order to greet...

<!-- uid=1460138:9:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** ...the god of the new year,  
typically using kadomatsu pines  
and thick shimenawa straw ropes.

<!-- uid=1460138:10:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Kadomatsu? Shimenawa...?

<!-- uid=1460138:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh yeah, there were actually some  
of those decorating the outside of  
this lodge.

<!-- uid=1460138:12:1 -->

**Alice:** Ah, is that what those were? Now  
that I think of it, I saw them  
back in Kiyomihara as well.

<!-- uid=1460138:13:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** One such decoration is said to be  
closely tied to the god of the new  
year...

<!-- uid=1460138:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** A new year's decoration?  
Wh-Which one could it be?

<!-- uid=1460138:15:1 -->

**Alice:** Hmm. A traditional New Year's  
decoration that has close ties to  
the god of the new year...?

<!-- uid=1460138:16:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...Hey, speaking of decorations,  
what's that white round thing up  
near the ceiling?

<!-- uid=1460138:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's... kagami mochi.

<!-- uid=1460138:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...Kagami mochi!  
Now I get it!

<!-- uid=1460138:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Me too!  
It all makes sense now!

<!-- uid=1460138:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yup. Japan has flourished for  
centuries thanks to this!  
The answer is...

<!-- uid=1460138:21:1 -->

**Asuna & Kirito:** The god of agriculture!!!

<!-- uid=1460138:22:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Correct! Since you got every  
question right...

<!-- uid=1460138:23:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** You get to have our premium toshi-  
koshi soba, made with edible wild  
plants grown on this mountain!

<!-- uid=1460138:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** We did it!

<!-- uid=1460138:25:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Nice job, Asuna! I'm impressed you  
knew the answer too, Kirito.

<!-- uid=1460138:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's all thanks to you and Alice  
noticing the kagami mochi.

<!-- uid=1460138:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yup! Kagami mochi on New Year's is  
such a common sight for us that we  
didn't even think about it.

<!-- uid=1460138:28:1 -->

**Alice:** The god of agriculture, eh...  
So in this world, there is even  
a god for that.

<!-- uid=1460138:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yup. They say there's a god that  
inhabits pretty much anything and  
everything here.

<!-- uid=1460138:30:1 -->

**Eugeo:** You don't say. Anyway, now Alice  
and I get to find out what GOOD  
soba tastes like!

<!-- uid=1460138:31:1 -->

**Asuna:** You know, doing that quiz actually  
helped me work up a little  
appetite. I can't wait to try it!

<!-- uid=1460138:32:1 -->

**Silica:** I'm personally pretty embarrassed

**Silica:** ...

<!-- uid=1460143:25:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...

## Story 1460145 · \[Win Big Bunny\] Suguha Lv.50

Character Story

## Story 1460153 · \[Fiery Arrow Cadaver\] Alice Lv.30

Character Story

**Kirito:** Phew...

<!-- uid=1460153:1:1 -->

**Eugeo:** We barely made it out of there  
alive...

<!-- uid=1460153:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. It could be that she just  
let us get away.

<!-- uid=1460153:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Or rather, that she's probably  
programmed to not follow  
retreating players too far.

<!-- uid=1460153:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** The devs must want us to figure  
out how to defeat her by facing  
her multiple times.

<!-- uid=1460153:5:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Which means there's a definite way  
to deal with her...?

<!-- uid=1460153:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's what I think. The problem  
is figuring out what that is...

<!-- uid=1460153:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** How do you feel about this, Eugeo?

<!-- uid=1460153:8:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Me? Well...

<!-- uid=1460153:9:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I don't know Asuna as well as you,  
and I've only fought alongside her  
a handful of times, but...

<!-- uid=1460153:10:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Something about the way that fake  
Asuna fought seemed different from  
the real Asuna.

<!-- uid=1460153:11:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...It was the same with Alice.  
She may have looked the same, but  
the general way she moved was off.

<!-- uid=1460153:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** So even though her appearance is  
identical, her fighting style  
is quite different...

<!-- uid=1460153:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...I could see that being another  
design choice.

<!-- uid=1460153:14:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Really?

<!-- uid=1460153:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. The appearance of this  
dungeon's boss depends on who's  
facing it, right?

<!-- uid=1460153:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Appearance alone is one thing,  
but going so far as to imitate a  
fighting style is pretty tough.

<!-- uid=1460153:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** In fact, the fake Alice couldn't  
use Alice's special move. Her  
imitation didn't stretch that far.

<!-- uid=1460153:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** This is just a guess, but I think  
each of these fakes has their own  
basic ways of acting.

<!-- uid=1460153:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Like they act one way with a  
sword, another with a lance,  
and yet another with a rapier.

<!-- uid=1460153:20:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...I see. That's an interesting  
hypothesis.

<!-- uid=1460153:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Right? Next time let's pay close  
attention to how the fake Asuna  
moves.

<!-- uid=1460153:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** If she resembles Asuna only in  
appearance...that's likely to  
lead to a breakthrough.

<!-- uid=1460153:23:1 -->


## Story 1460155 · \[Fiery Arrow Cadaver\] Alice Lv.50

**Kirito:** Of course, the devs tried to cover

**Eugeo:** So if we can figure out this

## Story 1460225 · \[Piercing Eye\] Sinon Lv.50

## Story 1460255 · \[Charming Heart\] Alice Lv.50

Character Story

**Ronie:** F-For ourselves?

**Tiese:** Yep! I mean, when do we ever get

<!-- uid=1460255:2:1 -->

**Tiese:** Most people make them to give to  
other people, and we're not often  
on the receiving end.

**Ronie:** I guess that's true...

<!-- uid=1460255:4:1 -->

**Ronie:** But it just seems like a weird  
thing to do, you know?

<!-- uid=1460255:5:1 -->

<!-- uid=1460255:6:1 -->

**Tiese:** We worked hard today, so we should  
allow ourselves a little tasty  
treat to celebrate!

<!-- uid=1460255:7:1 -->

**Ronie:** O-Oh, right...

<!-- uid=1460255:8:1 -->

**Ronie:** This feels like such a luxury...

<!-- uid=1460255:9:1 -->

fun with it.

<!-- uid=1460255:16:1 -->

**Tiese:** Exactly! We can feel free to mess

<!-- uid=1460255:17:1 -->

<!-- uid=1460255:18:1 -->

**Tiese:** Y-Yeah, I know that! It's not like

<!-- uid=1460255:19:1 -->

<!-- uid=1460255:20:1 -->

**Tiese:** I-I could say the same about you

<!-- uid=1460255:21:1 -->

**Ronie:** Eep!

<!-- uid=1460255:22:1 -->

## Story 1460257 · \[Charming Heart\] Alice Lv.70

## Story 1460258 · \[Charming Heart\] Alice Lv.80

chocolate don't go together well.

<!-- uid=1460258:16:1 -->

**Tiese:** ...Oh yeah, right. But they were  
cheap, so I kind of went  
overboard...

<!-- uid=1460258:17:1 -->

**Ronie:** Hehehehe... Anyway, why don't we  
dig in?

<!-- uid=1460258:18:1 -->

**Tiese:** Funny to think we used up the  
ingredients the other person  
didn't get to use.

<!-- uid=1460258:19:1 -->

**Tiese:** Yeah, I wish we'd been able to  
show this much consideration  
for Kirito and Eugeo...

<!-- uid=1460258:20:1 -->

**Ronie:** Aw, Tiese, don't bring down the  
mood like that...

<!-- uid=1460258:21:1 -->

**Tiese:** Well, I guess we can focus on  
doing better next time.

<!-- uid=1460258:22:1 -->

**Ronie:** Y-Yeah... That's true!

<!-- uid=1460258:23:1 -->

**Tiese:** But first, time to eat! We can't  
forget to show our gratitude  
to each other!

<!-- uid=1460258:24:1 -->


## Story 1460261 · \[WHEEL OF FORTUNE\] Rain Lv.10

Character Story

**Leafa:** Um, this way, I think?  
Everyone follow me, please!

<!-- uid=1460261:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Thanks, Leafa. The rest of you,  
too...

<!-- uid=1460261:2:1 -->

**Seven:** You're real lifesavers, coming  
to help us get our own  
tarot equipment.

<!-- uid=1460261:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** Oh, it's nothing!

<!-- uid=1460261:4:2 -->

**Rain:** That's right! Really, don't worry  
about it!

<!-- uid=1460261:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's only natural to want to clear  
out all your subquests once you're  
done with the main quest.

<!-- uid=1460261:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** So while we're doing this to get  
you two your equipment...there's  
no reason to feel bad about it.

<!-- uid=1460261:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah. We're more than happy to do  
this kind of stuff.

<!-- uid=1460261:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** Anyway... Things panned out in a  
more fitting way than I  
expected. Wouldn't you agree?

<!-- uid=1460261:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** What? Fitting? How?

<!-- uid=1460261:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** The tarot cards we each got. There  
weren't any strange pairings,  
were there?

<!-- uid=1460261:11:1 -->


## Story 1460263 · \[WHEEL OF FORTUNE\] Rain Lv.30

Character Story

**Leafa:** What pairings were there again...?

<!-- uid=1460263:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** First off, I got Justice.  
Kirito got The World.

<!-- uid=1460263:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** Though, I'd say that Kirito's The  
World is the most questionable  
pairing out of all of ours.

<!-- uid=1460263:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wha...?! Wh-Why's that, Sinon?!

<!-- uid=1460263:4:2 -->

**Kirito:** What's wrong with me being  
The World?! Why shouldn't I be  
a perfect, supreme being?!

<!-- uid=1460263:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...Are you really sure about that?

<!-- uid=1460263:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** I'm not that familiar with tarot  
cards myself, but I do know that  
The World is a very special one.

<!-- uid=1460263:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, I've heard that, too.

<!-- uid=1460263:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Are you listening, Kirito?

<!-- uid=1460263:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** There's room for debate as to how  
fitting The World is for you.  
So, you need to up your game!

<!-- uid=1460263:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** Exactly! You need to focus on  
being that "perfect, supreme  
being" you were going on about.

<!-- uid=1460263:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Gah... That backfired...

<!-- uid=1460263:12:1 -->


## Story 1460265 · \[WHEEL OF FORTUNE\] Rain Lv.50

Character Story

**Kirito:** F-Fine, I'll admit that possessing  
The World comes with its own  
responsibilities...

<!-- uid=1460265:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** But hear me out! All the tarot  
cards you've been given carry a  
heavy meaning of their own too!

<!-- uid=1460265:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...Yeah, I guess you're right.

<!-- uid=1460265:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yes. Take mine, for example.  
Justice...

<!-- uid=1460265:4:2 -->

**Leafa:** It's a great honor to be given  
Justice, but it's also a very  
delicate card.

<!-- uid=1460265:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** Tarot cards can come out in both  
upright and reversed positions.  
Did you know that?

<!-- uid=1460265:6:1 -->

**Rain:** Umm... S-Sure. I think I know  
what that means.

<!-- uid=1460265:7:1 -->

**Rain:** Even a card with a good meaning  
means the reverse if it comes out  
upside-down, right?

<!-- uid=1460265:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Not exactly. The meaning isn't  
always reversed.

<!-- uid=1460265:9:1 -->

**Rain:** What? Really?

<!-- uid=1460265:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's one of the things that  
makes tarot cards so special.

<!-- uid=1460265:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's easy to imagine them as  
playing cards, but the direction  
of those don't matter, right?

<!-- uid=1460265:12:1 -->

**Rain:** Oh, yeah. Their designs are drawn  
in a way where it doesn't matter  
if the card is upside-down.

<!-- uid=1460265:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yup. That's one of the biggest  
differences between playing cards  
and tarot cards.

<!-- uid=1460265:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** The direction of a tarot card  
decides its meaning, but these  
are not necessarily opposites.

<!-- uid=1460265:15:1 -->

**Leafa:** They have other full meanings.  
For example, a reversed Justice  
casts doubt on your own justice.

<!-- uid=1460265:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** Justice is considered one of the  
greatest virtues in a person's  
life. However...

<!-- uid=1460265:17:1 -->

**Leafa:** You have to think about whether  
your justice is truly in the  
right.

<!-- uid=1460265:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** It's possible to hurt others with  
justice that goes too far.

<!-- uid=1460265:19:1 -->

**Leafa:** In other cases, what you might  
believe is justice isn't how  
you truly feel.

<!-- uid=1460265:20:1 -->

**Everyone:** ...!

<!-- uid=1460265:21:1 -->

**Leafa:** We need to consider this all while  
examining what justice means to  
each of us.

<!-- uid=1460265:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...You're amazing, Leafa.

<!-- uid=1460265:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah. I can really tell that  
you've been working on your  
fortunetelling skill!

<!-- uid=1460265:24:1 -->

**Leafa:** What? O-Oh, no, I'm just...

<!-- uid=1460265:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** It really made me feel like you've  
taken your tarot card to heart!

<!-- uid=1460265:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** In other words, you've been  
growing as a person yourself as  
you told the fortunes of others!

<!-- uid=1460265:27:1 -->


## Story 1460267 · \[WHEEL OF FORTUNE\] Rain Lv.70

Character Story

**Sinon:** Hey. Sorry to interrupt the  
party, but...

<!-- uid=1460267:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** I was just talking to Rain and we  
had a question for Leafa.

<!-- uid=1460267:2:1 -->

**Rain:** Yes... Since Leafa knows so much  
about tarot cards, we thought  
you'd be the best person to ask.

<!-- uid=1460267:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** Of course, what's up?

<!-- uid=1460267:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** I'd be happy to answer any  
questions I can...

<!-- uid=1460267:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** Great. We wanted to ask about  
our cards...

<!-- uid=1460267:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** In other words, The Chariot and  
Wheel of Fortune.

<!-- uid=1460267:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...These seem kinda hard to  
understand, don't they?

<!-- uid=1460267:8:1 -->

**Rain:** I just don't get it!

<!-- uid=1460267:9:1 -->

**Rain:** Unlike Justice and The World,  
nothing comes to mind when I  
hear "Wheel of Fortune"!

<!-- uid=1460267:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** And a Chariot is a plain old  
vehicle! With horses and all!

<!-- uid=1460267:11:1 -->

**Leafa:** Oh, um... It doesn't mean a  
literal chariot, you see.

<!-- uid=1460267:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** It's not saying you're a carriage  
used in ancient wars by the...  
Um...

<!-- uid=1460267:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** The Sumerians? The Hittites?

<!-- uid=1460267:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** Oh! Yes, them!  
Thank you!

<!-- uid=1460267:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Back when tarot cards were  
invented, they might be examples  
of vehicles used in war.

<!-- uid=1460267:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yes, but even then, the Chariot  
has a more symbolic meaning than  
that.

<!-- uid=1460267:17:1 -->

**Leafa:** As I explained before, it's saying  
you're someone who can overcome  
hardships and troubles...

<!-- uid=1460267:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** And in a cool, tough way at that!

<!-- uid=1460267:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** Huh. That's kind of a...hardboiled  
meaning, huh?

<!-- uid=1460267:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** But...yes. I guess part of me  
does want to become someone like  
that.

<!-- uid=1460267:21:1 -->

**Sinon:** I'll need to be careful, just like  
you, Leafa...

<!-- uid=1460267:22:1 -->


## Story 1460268 · \[WHEEL OF FORTUNE\] Rain Lv.80

Character Story

**Rain:** Hmm. Okay, then what about mine?

<!-- uid=1460268:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** Wheel of Fortune is a very  
interesting tarot card!

<!-- uid=1460268:2:1 -->

**Rain:** Really? I heard not long ago that  
it basically just means "CHANGE!!"

<!-- uid=1460268:3:1 -->

**Rain:** Am I that good at creating change?

<!-- uid=1460268:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** To put it as the tarot might,  
things won't necessarily always be  
the way they are today.

<!-- uid=1460268:5:1 -->

**Rain:** What?

<!-- uid=1460268:6:1 -->

**Leafa:** When Wheel of Fortune appears in  
a reading, it's an omen of change.

<!-- uid=1460268:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** Of course, it could either be good  
or bad. Things don't always  
change for the better, after all.

<!-- uid=1460268:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** However... A moment of change is  
undeniably awaiting you, Rain.

<!-- uid=1460268:9:1 -->

**Rain:** ...!!

<!-- uid=1460268:10:1 -->

**Seven:** So does that mean she's taking the  
next step towards her future  
right now?

<!-- uid=1460268:11:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...Perhaps. Fortunetellers aren't  
magicians, though. We can only  
guide, I suppose...

<!-- uid=1460268:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** I don't really know what's going  
to happen in the future.

<!-- uid=1460268:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** That's why I think Rain needs to  
think about her future and take  
action herself.

<!-- uid=1460268:14:1 -->

**Rain:** ...I see.

<!-- uid=1460268:15:1 -->

**Rain:** You're amazing, Leafa...  
You really are like a full-fledged  
fortuneteller...

<!-- uid=1460268:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** I guess today's lesson is that the  
fortunetelling skill has had a  
good influence on Sugu, too.

<!-- uid=1460268:17:1 -->

**Leafa:** R-Really...?

<!-- uid=1460268:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yep. It's not always bad to let  
your intuition guide you, but it's  
good to see this side of you too.

<!-- uid=1460268:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Fortunes can't change the world.  
What's important is how you  
reflect the fortune you're given.

<!-- uid=1460268:20:1 -->


## Story 1460271 · \[Precious Moment\] Asuna Lv.10

Character Story

**Asuna:** This is the place, Yuuki.

<!-- uid=1460271:1:1 -->

**Yuuki:** O-Oh...?

<!-- uid=1460271:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's a famous cafe even here in  
ALO, but I haven't had the chance  
to go until now.

**Yuuki:** Not even with Kirito?

even if he was with you, then...

<!-- uid=1460271:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...Exactly. Neither of us are

<!-- uid=1460271:7:1 -->

until now!

<!-- uid=1460271:8:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Huh! Well, I might like dungeons,  
but I like places like this too!

<!-- uid=1460271:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Great! I think you'll have a good  
time.

**Asuna:** A lot of shops in ALO serve fancy

**Asuna:** Pancakes tend to be big, so you  
usually share them with a group...

<!-- uid=1460271:14:1 -->

<!-- uid=1460271:15:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Yeah...

**Asuna:** You still want to look around

<!-- uid=1460271:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's why I thought it'd be best  
to start with a place that serves

<!-- uid=1460271:18:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Yeah. I think that's a good idea!

<!-- uid=1460271:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Great! Well, I got a reservation,  
so let's go in and enjoy the food!

<!-- uid=1460271:20:1 -->


## Story 1460273 · \[Precious Moment\] Asuna Lv.30

Character Story

**Yuuki:** Mmm, that was tasty!

**Asuna:** ...!

**Yuuki:** Ooh...!

<!-- uid=1460273:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehehe, oh, Yuuki. Don't get too

<!-- uid=1460273:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** (Great... I guess she likes the

<!-- uid=1460273:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** (I thought she might say she'd had

<!-- uid=1460273:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hm...?

**Asuna:** These clothes... They're new

**Asuna:** The stats are so-so, but they're

**Asuna:** I bet this would look good on

**Asuna:** Mmgh...! If I'm being honest with

**Asuna:** No, no... I need to calm down...

<!-- uid=1460273:31:1 -->

**Asuna:** I shouldn't be using too much  
money, and am I really going to

<!-- uid=1460273:32:1 -->

**Asuna:** Buying her thing after thing on

<!-- uid=1460273:33:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hrrm... I'm so conflicted...!

## Story 1460275 · \[Precious Moment\] Asuna Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** H-Hmmm...

**Asuna:** Well, I'm never going to come to

**Asuna:** They do let you try on clothes

**Asuna:** Ngh...?!

**Suguha:** I get what you mean. It's tricky

<!-- uid=1460281:27:1 -->

**Suguha:** Ah, I can totally imagine that!

<!-- uid=1460283:5:1 -->

<!-- uid=1460283:6:1 -->

<!-- uid=1460283:7:1 -->

doubted you. In that case, I'll

chatting an awful lot lately, both

<!-- uid=1460283:10:1 -->

<!-- uid=1460283:11:1 -->

<!-- uid=1460283:12:1 -->

**Shino:** Definitely. After having so much
