## Story 1460285 · \[Stroke of Heaven's Light\] Sinon Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** I guess now that I think about it,  
most of you spent less than a day  
in Underworld, huh?

<!-- uid=1460285:1:1 -->

**Suguha:** Yeah, Kazuto was in there for two  
virtual years and you were there  
for just over a month.

<!-- uid=1460285:2:1 -->

**Shino:** You know, talking about it like  
this, it feels a little strange.

<!-- uid=1460285:3:1 -->

**Shino:** Our world and Underworld have  
their differences, but they've got  
plenty in common, too.

<!-- uid=1460285:4:1 -->

**Suguha:** Not only that, there's a lot in  
its setting that has a similar  
vibe to worlds like ALO.

<!-- uid=1460285:5:1 -->

**Suguha:** Obviously ALO's filled with fairy  
races, but they both otherwise  
have a wide variety of monsters.

<!-- uid=1460285:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's true. On the surface, you  
might say there isn't a lot that  
seems wholly unique to Underworld.

<!-- uid=1460285:7:1 -->

**Shino:** When you put it like that, is  
that to say there are more  
differences when you dig deep?

<!-- uid=1460285:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Absolutely. Especially when it  
comes to Underworld's culture,  
which is really distinct.

<!-- uid=1460285:9:1 -->

**Suguha:** Huh, that's cool to hear. What's  
something that makes it so  
unique in that regard?

<!-- uid=1460285:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hmm... I'd say the presence of  
the Sacred Tongue, for one thing.

<!-- uid=1460285:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** It might sound roughly like plain  
English to us, but there it's used  
to do stuff not unlike magic.

<!-- uid=1460285:12:1 -->

**Suguha:** Oh, I know what you're talking  
about! You mean when people are  
yelling "System Call!" and stuff.

<!-- uid=1460285:13:1 -->

**Suguha:** I remember that witch-looking lady  
I fought was chanting that to fire  
off her spells or whatever.

<!-- uid=1460285:14:1 -->

**Shino:** It's intriguing stuff. The words  
"System Call" sound like they  
could be a programming language.

<!-- uid=1460285:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, it's a computer term. Not  
exactly something you'd expect  
to hear in an incantation.

<!-- uid=1460285:16:1 -->

**Suguha:** Guess that's goes to show just  
how much can change when you  
visit different worlds like that.

<!-- uid=1460285:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Right. You could say it's one of  
the things that makes Underworld  
stand out as its own thing.

<!-- uid=1460285:18:1 -->


## Story 1460287 · \[Stroke of Heaven's Light\] Sinon Lv.70

Character Story

**Asuna:** Talking about the Sacred Tongue  
reminds me of something else that  
really sets Underworld apart.

<!-- uid=1460287:1:1 -->

**Suguha:** And that is?

<!-- uid=1460287:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, you know how ALO's setting  
is so heavily inspired by Norse  
mythology?

<!-- uid=1460287:3:1 -->

**Suguha:** Of course! Everything from place  
names to weapons and more is  
dripping with Norse inspiration.

<!-- uid=1460287:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** But it's not purely Norse since  
ALO is built by Japanese devs and  
run by a Japanese company.

<!-- uid=1460287:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** You see bits of Japanese culture  
in things like the katanas and  
also the food you can craft.

<!-- uid=1460287:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Not to mention there's still  
Valentine's Day and Japanese  
school uniforms in the game, too.

<!-- uid=1460287:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** When you think about it, ALO's  
really a hodgepodge of cultures  
with different parts mixed in.

<!-- uid=1460287:8:1 -->

**Suguha:** That's true. It's not always  
entirely consistent in that way,  
is it?

<!-- uid=1460287:9:1 -->

**Shino:** Sure, but there's nothing wrong  
with that, if you ask me.

<!-- uid=1460287:10:1 -->

**Shino:** There are lots of foreign-made  
games with Japanese concepts  
like samurai and ninja in them.

<!-- uid=1460287:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Exactly. In fact, you just said  
something really important for  
the point I'm trying to make.

<!-- uid=1460287:12:1 -->

**Shino:** I did?

<!-- uid=1460287:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yep. You just said the word  
"games," didn't you?

<!-- uid=1460287:14:1 -->

**Shino:** And...?

<!-- uid=1460287:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** The thing you have to remember  
about Underworld is, it's not  
a game.

<!-- uid=1460287:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's easy to forget that at times,  
but I'd say that's easily the  
biggest difference about it.

<!-- uid=1460287:17:1 -->


## Story 1460288 · \[Stroke of Heaven's Light\] Sinon Lv.80

Character Story

**Suguha:** Right, duh! It's so obvious when  
you say that!

<!-- uid=1460288:1:1 -->

**Suguha:** You know, seeing as we've all  
spent so much time playing games  
inside these virtual spaces...

<!-- uid=1460288:2:1 -->

**Suguha:** We might be more prone to  
mistaking it as just another game  
without even realizing it.

<!-- uid=1460288:3:1 -->

**Shino:** Yeah. There were beta test players  
who logged in after word about it  
spread to foreign game forums.

<!-- uid=1460288:4:1 -->

**Shino:** We fought a lot of people who  
never stopped thinking Underworld  
was simply another game.

<!-- uid=1460288:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Indeed. Games like ALO and GGO  
have some things set in stone, but  
they can be flexibly expanded.

<!-- uid=1460288:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's not the case when it comes  
to Underworld. Or rather...Project  
Alicization.

<!-- uid=1460288:7:1 -->

**Shino:** Even if it still takes place in a  
virtual space, the way it  
functions is totally different.

<!-- uid=1460288:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Exactly. That's how you end up  
with all these cultures in it  
mirroring the real world's.

<!-- uid=1460288:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** The people there have souls just  
like us and built their world  
up over many, many years.

<!-- uid=1460288:10:1 -->

**Shino:** ...Yeah. I get what you mean now.

<!-- uid=1460288:11:1 -->

**Suguha:** This whole discussion's really  
reminded me just how deep that  
whole world really is.

<!-- uid=1460288:12:1 -->

**Shino:** For sure. I hope someday we'll  
have the chance to pay another  
visit to Underworld.

<!-- uid=1460288:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** I...think that time will come,  
yeah.

<!-- uid=1460288:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** In fact, it might not be long  
before our world and Underworld  
grow even closer to each other!

<!-- uid=1460288:15:1 -->

## Story 1640015 · \[Star Scientist\] Seven Lv.50

Character Story

**Rain:** Seven, if you want to start  
singing again, I'm not going  
to stop you.

<!-- uid=1640015:1:2 -->

**Rain:** You did kind of use it  
as a means to an end

<!-- uid=1640015:2:1 -->

**Rain:** since your goal was to collect  
data on the audience's emotions  
for your research, but...

<!-- uid=1640015:3:1 -->

**Rain:** You also told me you liked singing  
in and of itself.

<!-- uid=1640015:4:1 -->

**Rain:** So even if you aren't researching  
anything now, that doesn't mean  
you have to give up singing too.

<!-- uid=1640015:5:1 -->

**Seven:** Yeah... You're right. But...  
I'm not even sure myself.

<!-- uid=1640015:6:1 -->

**Rain:** What do you mean?

<!-- uid=1640015:7:1 -->

**Seven:** Do I truly want to sing?

<!-- uid=1640015:8:1 -->

**Seven:** Do I truly want to bathe in the  
admiration of thousands, as I did  
as a Pooka songstress?

<!-- uid=1640015:9:1 -->

**Seven:** Do I truly want to return to the  
life of an ALO idol, even if that  
means less time for research?

<!-- uid=1640015:10:1 -->

**Rain:** Seven...

<!-- uid=1640015:11:1 -->

**Seven:** Heh, sorry, Rain...  
As much as I'd like to say  
I've retired as an idol,

<!-- uid=1640015:12:1 -->

**Seven:** I think I really do want  
to become one again.  
Maybe.

<!-- uid=1640015:13:1 -->

**Seven:** Oh, why can't I make up my mind...

<!-- uid=1640015:14:1 -->

**Rain:** Seven... Rainbow, maybe it's better  
if you keep thinking it over until  
you reach a solid conclusion.

<!-- uid=1640015:15:1 -->

**Rain:** Though I don't think staging  
pretend concerts like this will  
help you figure out your feelings.

<!-- uid=1640015:16:1 -->

**Seven:** No? Then what should I do?

<!-- uid=1640015:17:1 -->

**Rain:** You should sing in front of a live  
audience again. If that makes you  
happy, then be an idol.

<!-- uid=1640015:18:1 -->

**Rain:** If it doesn't feel right,  
then don't.

<!-- uid=1640015:19:1 -->

**Seven:** B-But I'm still too nervous  
to do anything like that...

<!-- uid=1640015:20:1 -->

**Rain:** Don't be. This is an imaginary  
world where dreams come true,  
after all.

<!-- uid=1640015:21:1 -->

**Rain:** You won't know until you try.

<!-- uid=1640015:22:1 -->

**Seven:** Rain...

<!-- uid=1640015:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sounds like you've settled things.

<!-- uid=1640015:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** Evening, you two.

<!-- uid=1640015:25:1 -->

**Seven:** Kirito...

<!-- uid=1640015:26:1 -->

**Rain:** Asuna...

<!-- uid=1640015:27:1 -->

## Story 1640018 · \[Star Scientist\] Seven Lv.80

Character Story

**Seven:** My, how time flies! We've  
already come to my last song  
of the evening...

<!-- uid=1640018:1:1 -->

**Seven:** Nooooo!

<!-- uid=1640018:2:1 -->

**Seven:** It can't be over yeeet!

<!-- uid=1640018:3:1 -->

**Seven:** We just got heeeere!

<!-- uid=1640018:4:1 -->

**Seven:** I know, I feel the same! But all  
good things must come to an end.  
I hope you enjoy this final song!

<!-- uid=1640018:5:1 -->

**Rain:** At it again, I see...

<!-- uid=1640018:6:1 -->

**Seven:** R-Rain! Quit sneaking up on me  
like that!

<!-- uid=1640018:7:1 -->

**Rain:** It's easy when you're lost in your  
world of idol make-believe.

<!-- uid=1640018:8:1 -->

**Seven:** It's not make-believe!  
Well, I guess it is...

<!-- uid=1640018:9:1 -->

**Rain:** You said you felt great after that  
one-night-only concert, right?

<!-- uid=1640018:10:1 -->

**Seven:** Ehehe... After a while I just  
felt like singing like this again  
for some reason.

<!-- uid=1640018:11:1 -->

**Rain:** Geez...

<!-- uid=1640018:12:1 -->

**Seven:** But that's why I was thinking that  
whenever I get the urge to sing,

<!-- uid=1640018:13:1 -->

**Seven:** I should just put on another  
one-night-only concert like before.

<!-- uid=1640018:14:1 -->

**Rain:** Huh?

<!-- uid=1640018:15:1 -->

**Seven:** I know it's kind of a slight to  
people who do perform with  
all their heart and soul,

<!-- uid=1640018:16:1 -->

**Seven:** and that my popularity will suffer  
the less I perform...

<!-- uid=1640018:17:1 -->

**Seven:** But, even though science  
is my true calling,

<!-- uid=1640018:18:1 -->

**Seven:** I still want to be able to appease  
the part of me that loves to sing.

<!-- uid=1640018:19:1 -->

**Rain:** I understand, Seven. If that's  
what you want to do, then  
I'll support you however I can.

<!-- uid=1640018:20:1 -->

**Seven:** Rain...

<!-- uid=1640018:21:1 -->

**Rain:** But you're right! Using your  
former popularity as a crutch is  
totally unfair to true performers!

<!-- uid=1640018:22:1 -->

**Rain:** Don't you dare forget it,  
especially with one standing  
right in front of you!

<!-- uid=1640018:23:1 -->

**Rain:** I'm not going to lose to some  
little girl who only sings  
whenever the mood strikes her!

<!-- uid=1640018:24:1 -->

**Seven:** Hehe. Good luck with that,  
big sister.

<!-- uid=1640018:25:1 -->

**Rain:** You won't be so haughty  
once I knock you down from  
that high horse of yours!

<!-- uid=1640018:26:1 -->

**Seven:** It's a pretty high horse.  
I doubt you'll be able to reach!

<!-- uid=1640018:27:1 -->

## Story 1650013 · \[Midnight Temptation\] Asuna Lv.30

Character Story

**Alice:** So this is her village...

<!-- uid=1650013:2:1 -->

**Fairy NPC:** Let me explain. Recently, our  
village has been beset by a  
string of strange events...

<!-- uid=1650013:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Such as?

<!-- uid=1650013:4:1 -->

**Fairy NPC:** Our fields have been torn up,

<!-- uid=1650013:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** That sounds like the work of  
monsters, or some wild beast.

<!-- uid=1650013:6:1 -->

<!-- uid=1650013:7:1 -->

**Fairy NPC:** We found piles of fruit ripped

no signs any were eaten.

<!-- uid=1650013:8:1 -->

<!-- uid=1650013:9:1 -->

<!-- uid=1650013:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** What?! This is actually   
really mean-spirited...

<!-- uid=1650013:11:1 -->

**Alice:** Hmm... This sounds like the work  
of a true villain, a scoundrel who  
delights in causing misfortune.

<!-- uid=1650013:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hmm... Actually, it sounds like  
the work of a mischievous kid.

<!-- uid=1650013:13:1 -->

**Fairy NPC:** After seeing your skill in battle,  
I knew you'd have the courage and  
wisdom to find who's responsible.

<!-- uid=1650013:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Really? That's a logical leap...  
But sure, I guess.

<!-- uid=1650013:15:1 -->

**Alice:** This ne'er-do-well sows chaos and  
discord. Rarely have I heard of  
deeds so nefarious.

<!-- uid=1650013:16:1 -->

**Alice:** Asuna! Let us track down and  
expose this scoundrel!

<!-- uid=1650013:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah!

<!-- uid=1650013:18:1 -->


## Story 1650015 · \[Midnight Temptation\] Asuna Lv.50

**Asuna:** ...Over there! Follow my tracking

<!-- uid=1650015:22:1 -->

**Alice:** Your beacon is leading us to

**Asuna:** So that's their hideout...

## Story 1650031 · \[Visitor in Snow\] Leafa Lv.10

Character Story

**Leafa:** What is it, Sakuya?!  
What's the problem?!

<!-- uid=1650031:1:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Ah, you're here. Sorry for calling  
you on such short notice.

<!-- uid=1650031:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** It's totally fine! I dived as soon  
as you messaged me. It's urgent,  
right?

<!-- uid=1650031:3:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Yes... In a way.

<!-- uid=1650031:4:1 -->

**Sakuya:** You know about the giant Christmas  
tree we put up in the center of  
Sylvain every year, right?

<!-- uid=1650031:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeah! The one all of us decorate,  
and then we illuminate it at night  
and everything?

<!-- uid=1650031:6:1 -->

**Leafa:** It's totally beautiful, and I'm SO  
looking forward to it this year!

<!-- uid=1650031:7:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Well, the giant fir tree we put  
in the center of Sylvain...has  
been split in twain.

<!-- uid=1650031:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** WHAT?! B-But...my Christmas...  
Whyyyyyy?!

<!-- uid=1650031:9:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Massive objects can't be placed in  
personal inventories, so I had it  
stored in my private vault...

<!-- uid=1650031:10:1 -->

**Sakuya:** But it seems my vault wasn't  
suited for tree storage. The fir  
rotted and its durability dropped.

<!-- uid=1650031:11:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Then, when we were transporting  
it to the central plaza, it  
just...poof.

<!-- uid=1650031:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** Wh-What do we do now, Sakuya?!

<!-- uid=1650031:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** It's not a Sylph Christmas unless  
we've got that giant tree!

<!-- uid=1650031:14:1 -->

**Sakuya:** And so, we come to my request.  
Can you find us a new Christmas  
tree?

<!-- uid=1650031:15:1 -->

**Leafa:** Oh, so that's why you called me!  
Of course, I'd love to help!

<!-- uid=1650031:16:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Thank you, Leafa.

## Story 1650035 · \[Visitor in Snow\] Leafa Lv.50

<!-- uid=1650035:13:1 -->

<!-- uid=1650035:15:1 -->

## Story 1650048 · \[Sacred Dance\] Yui Lv.80

Character Story

**Girl:** It's based on my childhood  
experiences.

<!-- uid=1650048:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh?

<!-- uid=1650048:2:1 -->

**Girl:** Mmhmm. I spent a lot of time  
playing at the shrine near my  
house.

<!-- uid=1650048:3:1 -->

**Girl:** One day a kid we'd never met  
before joined our group.

<!-- uid=1650048:4:1 -->

**Girl:** We all assumed this kid was a  
friend of a friend and carried  
on as usual...

<!-- uid=1650048:5:1 -->

**Girl:** I remember the kid being pretty  
nice to all of us, until one day  
the kid was just...gone.

<!-- uid=1650048:6:1 -->

**Girl:** I asked all my friends what had  
happened, but they had no memory  
of the kid.

<!-- uid=1650048:7:1 -->

**Girl:** I started to wonder if I'd been  
dreaming. After a while, I started  
playing at the shrine again.

<!-- uid=1650048:8:1 -->

**Girl:** That's when I got lost.

<!-- uid=1650048:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh no, really?

<!-- uid=1650048:10:1 -->

**Girl:** Yes, and the shrine was quite  
large. I was walking down a stone  
path all by myself.

<!-- uid=1650048:11:1 -->

**Girl:** Suddenly I realized that I was  
on a path lined with torii as  
far as the eye could see.

<!-- uid=1650048:12:1 -->

**Girl:** There wasn't another soul in  
sight, but I wasn't afraid. I kept  
walking.

<!-- uid=1650048:13:1 -->

**Girl:** That's when I heard the voice.  
"Wrong way," it said.  
It was the voice of a child.

<!-- uid=1650048:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** You don't mean...?

<!-- uid=1650048:15:1 -->

**Girl:** Yes. It was the forgotten child.  
I kept following the child's  
instructions and made my way out.

<!-- uid=1650048:16:1 -->

**Girl:** That's when it said, "Thank you  
for playing with me."

<!-- uid=1650048:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Which brings us to this quest.

<!-- uid=1650048:18:1 -->

**Girl:** Exactly. I made this quest based  
on that memory. To create some  
sort of closure for it.

<!-- uid=1650048:19:1 -->

**Yui:** And what of the zashiki-warashi?

<!-- uid=1650048:20:1 -->

**Girl:** That helped with the child motif.  
The avatar design looks nothing  
like the child, though.

<!-- uid=1650048:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** What a fantastic story and a  
wonderful memory. I feel all  
warm and fuzzy inside.

<!-- uid=1650048:22:1 -->

**Girl:** It means a lot to me to hear  
you say that.

<!-- uid=1650048:23:1 -->

**Girl:** Lots of people in Asuka Empire  
are creating quests based on their  
memories and experiences.

<!-- uid=1650048:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** It sure sounds that way. It's  
wonderful that players can share  
so much with one another.

<!-- uid=1650048:25:1 -->

**Girl:** It is. I hope you will play all  
the player-made quests you  
come across.

<!-- uid=1650048:26:1 -->

<!-- uid=1650057:1:1 -->

**Challenger:** Who's in charge here?! I'll take  
him down and claim this dumpy  
dojo for myself!

<!-- uid=1650057:2:1 -->

<!-- uid=1650057:3:1 -->

**Kendo Player:** A player. We get these kinds of  
challengers every once in a while.

<!-- uid=1650057:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** Is this a PvP thing?

<!-- uid=1650057:5:1 -->

<!-- uid=1650057:6:1 -->

<!-- uid=1650057:8:1 -->

<!-- uid=1650057:9:1 -->

<!-- uid=1650057:10:1 -->

**Kendo Player:** Of course we can fight someone who

we still break rules when we do.

<!-- uid=1650057:11:1 -->

stat for budo knowledge that  
decreases each time we do that.

<!-- uid=1650057:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** What effect does that stat have?

<!-- uid=1650057:13:1 -->

**Kendo Player:** It influences your luck and  
various abilities, which in turn  
slightly affects your level.

<!-- uid=1650057:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Do all players have this stat?

<!-- uid=1650057:15:1 -->

**Kendo Player:** No, only the players in this guild  
have it as far as I know.

<!-- uid=1650057:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** Wow...

<!-- uid=1650057:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sounds like we need to step up,  
Leafa.

<!-- uid=1650057:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** Are you serious?! Kirito, wait!

<!-- uid=1650057:19:1 -->


## Story 1650058 · \[Realization of Big Wishes\] Leafa Lv.80

**Challenger:** What's your deal? You belong to

## Story 1650077 · \[Accompanied By Animals\] Sinon  Lv.70

Character Story

**Leafa:** Hi, Sinon! I heard you could use

<!-- uid=1650077:6:1 -->

trouble with, anyway?

<!-- uid=1650077:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** I was hoping to perform with the  
trained animals, but...they all  
hate me.

<!-- uid=1650077:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** As soon as I step near them, they  
get frightened and start yowling.

<!-- uid=1650077:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** Have you tried giving them treats?

<!-- uid=1650077:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah, but it didn't work.

<!-- uid=1650077:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** What about petting them?

<!-- uid=1650077:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** One of them tried to bite me and  
I slapped them away on instinct...

<!-- uid=1650077:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yikes! Lucky for us, this is

<!-- uid=1650077:15:1 -->

**Leafa:** Remember how fast you hit it off  
with the horse you rode in that  
real-world archery performance?

<!-- uid=1650077:16:1 -->

**Sinon:** Oh! That's right... I even joked  
that it must have been because  
I'm a Cait Sith.

<!-- uid=1650077:17:1 -->

**Leafa:** The animals might be scared,  
but...I doubt it's personal,  
Sinon.

<!-- uid=1650077:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** Let me try and talk to them!  
If they freak out at me too,  
then we'll know for sure!

<!-- uid=1650077:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** Are you implying that this could  
all have something to do with a  
simple story flag?

<!-- uid=1650077:20:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeah! That's got to be it!

<!-- uid=1650077:21:1 -->

**Sinon:** I see... And if that's the case,  
we'll be a lot closer to finding  
a solution.

<!-- uid=1650077:22:1 -->

## Story 1660051 · \[Another Master Priest\] Cardinal Lv.10

**Cardinal:** No, not in this body.

<!-- uid=1660051:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** What do you mean by that?

<!-- uid=1660051:6:1 -->

**Cardinal:** I can observe the Human Empire by  
linking my consciousness to the  
soul of a familiar like Charlotte.

<!-- uid=1660051:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** So it's like you're an invisible  
person spying on things.

<!-- uid=1660051:8:1 -->

**Cardinal:** It is nothing that boorish.

<!-- uid=1660051:9:1 -->

**Cardinal:** Still, it requires a great deal of  
strength. I cannot do it too often.

<!-- uid=1660051:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** I see...

<!-- uid=1660051:11:1 -->

**Cardinal:** A-Anyway.  
May I ask you something, Kirito?

<!-- uid=1660051:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hm? Why so polite?

<!-- uid=1660051:13:1 -->

**Cardinal:** Will you...try eating this?

<!-- uid=1660051:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hm, what is it? Something sweet?  
Wait, what?!  
Is this...a crepe?!

<!-- uid=1660051:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Cardinal! You know how to make  
crepes?! That's amazing!

<!-- uid=1660051:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** How'd you make something from  
the real world like this?!

<!-- uid=1660051:17:1 -->

**Cardinal:** Ah... So it is indeed something  
from that world.

<!-- uid=1660051:18:1 -->

**Cardinal:** I just happened to learn of it  
during one such observation of the  
Human Empire by way of Charlotte.

<!-- uid=1660051:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...?

<!-- uid=1660051:20:1 -->


## Story 1660053 · \[Another Master Priest\] Cardinal Lv.30

Character Story

**Cardinal:** What...? Are such rumors  
really circulating?

<!-- uid=1660053:1:1 -->

**Charlotte:** Yes, I heard it from the priests  
of the Central Cathedral.

<!-- uid=1660053:2:1 -->

**Charlotte:** The Axiom Church's High Priest  
will soon visit the streets of  
Centoria in secret.

<!-- uid=1660053:3:1 -->

**Cardinal:** In secret, you say...  
I suppose that's to be expected.

<!-- uid=1660053:4:1 -->

**Cardinal:** It will be the perfect opportunity  
to learn more about what she's  
up to...

<!-- uid=1660053:5:1 -->

**Charlotte:** I'll go to observe, then.

<!-- uid=1660053:6:1 -->

**Cardinal:** I shall project my consciousness  
and travel with you.

<!-- uid=1660053:7:1 -->

**Charlotte:** Are you sure you won't be detected?

<!-- uid=1660053:8:1 -->

**Cardinal:** No need to worry. My physical body  
will not be leaving this room.

<!-- uid=1660053:9:1 -->

**Cardinal:** I'll just be watching a  
"live stream," as they would say  
in the other world.

<!-- uid=1660053:10:1 -->

**Charlotte:** ...?

<!-- uid=1660053:11:1 -->

**Cardinal:** My apologies, there was no need  
for me to say that...  
Now let us go.

<!-- uid=1660053:12:1 -->

**Cardinal:** Ready? I'll be projecting my  
consciousness now!

<!-- uid=1660053:13:1 -->

**Charlotte:** I'm ready!

<!-- uid=1660053:14:1 -->


## Story 1660055 · \[Another Master Priest\] Cardinal Lv.50

Character Story

**Chudelkin:** Y-Your Eminence!  
Are you really going out alone?!

<!-- uid=1660055:1:1 -->

**Administrator:** Is there a problem?  
What's so strange about going to  
see the state of a city I govern?

<!-- uid=1660055:2:1 -->

**Chudelkin:** N-Nothing at all! It's only, I...  
I worry about your safety,  
Your Eminence!

<!-- uid=1660055:3:1 -->

**Chudelkin:** Some may even see your beauty and  
give in to impure thoughts!

<!-- uid=1660055:4:1 -->

**Administrator:** Shut up, Chudelkin.  
Just move out of my way.

<!-- uid=1660055:5:1 -->

**Chudelkin:** I-I will not move!  
Not until you return to your room!

<!-- uid=1660055:6:1 -->

**Administrator:** Hmph... How irritating.  
Then what if I do...this?

<!-- uid=1660055:7:1 -->

**Chudelkin:** Huh? What?  
You've...taken the form of  
another woman?

<!-- uid=1660055:8:1 -->

**Administrator:** Yes. It's a cognition altering  
command. I look different to those  
who see me. Happy now?

<!-- uid=1660055:9:1 -->

**Chudelkin:** I-I see... But!  
That does not change your  
incomparable beauty!

<!-- uid=1660055:10:1 -->

**Chudelkin:** I will serve as your guardian  
knight!

<!-- uid=1660055:11:1 -->

**Administrator:** Hmph... So you just wanted to  
tag along? Fine, then. Maybe this  
will convince you to stay put.

<!-- uid=1660055:12:1 -->

**Chudelkin:** I-I can't move...?!  
Your Eminence!  
I cannot move!

<!-- uid=1660055:13:1 -->

**Administrator:** Of course you can't, I petrified  
your legs. Don't worry, it won't  
last for too long.

<!-- uid=1660055:14:1 -->

**Administrator:** Let's go, then...  
Time for the High Priest to hunt  
for some object resources herself.

<!-- uid=1660055:15:1 -->

**Chudelkin:** Y-Your Emineeeence!!

<!-- uid=1660055:16:1 -->

**Cardinal:** ...

<!-- uid=1660055:17:1 -->

**Stallholder:** Come take a look!  
We've got some game hunted in  
the western empire in today!

<!-- uid=1660055:18:1 -->

**Woman:** There's a sword fighting tournament  
being held today!  
I need to hurry and get seats!

<!-- uid=1660055:19:1 -->

**Cardinal:** I quite enjoy the people's energy.  
Ah, if only I could interact  
with them.

<!-- uid=1660055:20:1 -->

**Cardinal:** Now then, where are you...?

<!-- uid=1660055:21:1 -->

**Charlotte:** Let's search the area.

<!-- uid=1660055:22:1 -->


## Story 1660057 · \[Another Master Priest\] Cardinal Lv.70

Character Story

**Cardinal:** What's going on? I would never  
fail to recognize her. Yet I can't  
find her...

<!-- uid=1660057:1:1 -->

**Charlotte:** I'm sorry, I can't keep searching  
with this small body of mine.  
Why don't I...

<!-- uid=1660057:2:1 -->

**Cardinal:** N-No, Charlotte!  
Don't return to your true form!  
You'll make the people panic!

<!-- uid=1660057:3:1 -->

**Charlotte:** O-Oh... I'm sorry.  
It's just that...  
I'm a little hungry.

<!-- uid=1660057:4:1 -->

**Cardinal:** I cannot blame you.  
You've gone all around with that  
tiny body of yours.

<!-- uid=1660057:5:1 -->

**Cardinal:** Let's go by one of these stands.  
I'll generate a good amount of  
coin, so eat what you like.

<!-- uid=1660057:6:1 -->

**Charlotte:** Thank you.

<!-- uid=1660057:7:1 -->

**Administrator:** I can't find her... I thought  
I sensed that pipsqueak's  
familiar in the area.

<!-- uid=1660057:8:1 -->

**Administrator:** Just when I planned to come down  
here myself to add her to my  
resources...

<!-- uid=1660057:9:1 -->

**Administrator:** Hmph. Seems like today might have  
been a waste of time. How annoying.

<!-- uid=1660057:10:1 -->

**Shopkeeper:** Come on by!  
What do you say to some  
baked goods! Take a look!

<!-- uid=1660057:11:1 -->

**Administrator:** Baked goods?  
Hmph. None look particularly tasty.

<!-- uid=1660057:12:1 -->

**Shopkeeper:** What? O-Of course they are!  
Have a taste and you'll see!

<!-- uid=1660057:13:1 -->

**Administrator:** I already know that they will  
simply taste cheap.

<!-- uid=1660057:14:1 -->

**Shopkeeper:** Y-You've got a pretty sharp tongue  
behind that pretty face, don't you?

<!-- uid=1660057:15:1 -->

**Administrator:** What really looked good was a  
certain something I once found in  
records of this world's creators.

<!-- uid=1660057:16:1 -->

**Shopkeeper:** Ma'am?

<!-- uid=1660057:17:1 -->

**Administrator:** Try eating this.

<!-- uid=1660057:18:1 -->

**Shopkeeper:** Wh-What is this?  
It looks delicious...  
\*munch\*

<!-- uid=1660057:19:1 -->

**Administrator:** It's called a crepe.  
They aren't hard to make.

<!-- uid=1660057:20:1 -->

**Administrator:** If you like it, try producing them  
in this store.  
That is, if you can.

<!-- uid=1660057:21:1 -->

**Shopkeeper:** What? Are you sure?

<!-- uid=1660057:22:1 -->

**Administrator:** Fine with me. The more prosperous  
the Human Empire, the greater  
chance of finding

<!-- uid=1660057:23:1 -->

**Administrator:** a candidate worthy of synthesis.  
Heh heh heh...

<!-- uid=1660057:24:1 -->

**Shopkeeper:** ...?

<!-- uid=1660057:25:1 -->

**Charlotte:** Hm? That sweet smell...

<!-- uid=1660057:26:1 -->

**Shopkeeper:** Wow. That woman earlier...  
She was so beautiful. But is it  
really okay to copy this recipe?

<!-- uid=1660057:27:1 -->

**Shopkeeper:** I'd feel so useless as a pro if  
I started making a product a  
random customer taught me...

<!-- uid=1660057:28:1 -->

**Cardinal:** I wonder what this shopkeeper  
could be talking about.

<!-- uid=1660057:29:1 -->

**Charlotte:** That treat they're holding looks  
delicious, though. May I eat one?

<!-- uid=1660057:30:1 -->

**Cardinal:** Yes, a bite should be fine.  
The taste will be communicated  
to me as well, of course.

<!-- uid=1660057:31:1 -->

**Charlotte:** Okay, let's dig in.  
\*chomp\*

<!-- uid=1660057:32:1 -->

**Cardinal:** M-M-My goodness...!!

<!-- uid=1660057:33:1 -->


## Story 1660058 · \[Another Master Priest\] Cardinal Lv.80

Character Story

**Kirito:** Did you ever end up finding  
the Administrator?

<!-- uid=1660058:1:1 -->

**Cardinal:** No. I thought I sensed her  
somewhere, but I left empty-handed.

<!-- uid=1660058:2:1 -->

what crepes taste like, huh?

<!-- uid=1660058:3:1 -->

that stall had something from the  
outside world.

<!-- uid=1660058:4:1 -->

**Cardinal:** But the outing bore fruit after

to one of these.

<!-- uid=1660058:6:1 -->

world. I really appreciate it.

<!-- uid=1660058:12:1 -->

**Eugeo:** W-Well, true...

<!-- uid=1660058:13:1 -->

**Cardinal:** No need to worry.  
I'll treat you to one as well.

<!-- uid=1660058:14:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Th-Thank you!

<!-- uid=1660058:15:1 -->

**Cardinal:** Hehe. Just sit back and wait.

## Story 1660071 · \[Apprentice Nun\] Selka Lv.10

**Selka:** Hmm... What should I do?

<!-- uid=1660071:2:1 -->

Azariya asked me to do  
some shopping for her.

**Alice:** Meaning you have to go outside of  
the village?

**Selka:** Mm-hm.

there.

ask one of the guards to come  
with me.

<!-- uid=1660071:7:1 -->

**Selka:** They should say yes, especially  
since I'm, uh... the village  
chief's daughter and all.

<!-- uid=1660071:8:1 -->

**Alice:** I see... In that case, I'm not so  
concerned.

<!-- uid=1660071:9:1 -->

**Selka:** But it doesn't feel right.

<!-- uid=1660071:10:1 -->

**Selka:** I don't like taking advantage of

<!-- uid=1660071:11:1 -->

**Alice:** Selka... I'm glad that you're being

<!-- uid=1660071:12:1 -->

**Alice:** But you needn't feel guilty.

**Alice:** You're simply asking for help as

Sister Azariya, yes?

<!-- uid=1660071:14:1 -->

**Selka:** Yeah, but... I still don't feel  
good about it.

<!-- uid=1660071:15:1 -->

**Alice:** I'm sorry, Selka... But I can't

<!-- uid=1660071:16:1 -->

**Alice:** I can't leave Kirito alone here,  
and bringing him along in this  
state is out of the question.

<!-- uid=1660071:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=1660071:18:1 -->

**Selka:** I-I know. I wasn't going to ask  
you to tag along anyway!

<!-- uid=1660071:19:1 -->

**Alice:** I-I see...

<!-- uid=1660071:20:1 -->


## Story 1660073 · \[Apprentice Nun\] Selka Lv.30

Character Story

**Alice:** Er, Selka, about that shopping  
you were asked to do...

<!-- uid=1660073:1:1 -->

**Selka:** It's fine, sis. I shouldn't have  
bothered you about it.

<!-- uid=1660073:2:1 -->

**Selka:** I've decided I'll probably just  
put my pride aside and ask Zink or  
another guard to come with me.

<!-- uid=1660073:3:1 -->

**Alice:** I see...

<!-- uid=1660073:4:1 -->

**Selka:** Huh? What's wrong?

<!-- uid=1660073:5:1 -->

**Alice:** Uh, it's... nothing. Really.

<!-- uid=1660073:6:1 -->

**Selka:** It sure doesn't sound like it.  
Is there something you want  
me to get for you?

<!-- uid=1660073:7:1 -->

**Alice:** Well, part of Amayori's saddle is  
about to break, and I was hoping to  
fashion together a replacement.

<!-- uid=1660073:8:1 -->

**Selka:** Amayori's that flying dragon of  
yours, right? Do they sell anything  
like that in the city?

<!-- uid=1660073:9:1 -->

**Alice:** As long as you buy me the  
materials, I can build it myself.  
But...

<!-- uid=1660073:10:1 -->

**Selka:** Would I even know what  
to get without you there?

<!-- uid=1660073:11:1 -->

**Alice:** Right... I apologize.  
Forget I mentioned it.

<!-- uid=1660073:12:1 -->

**Selka:** Wait, I have an idea! What if you  
went into the city in my place?

<!-- uid=1660073:13:1 -->

**Alice:** Huh?

<!-- uid=1660073:14:1 -->

**Selka:** Oh, it's not like I'm trying to  
force you or anything.

<!-- uid=1660073:15:1 -->

**Selka:** But it must be boring staying here  
all the time. I'm sure you could  
use a break, right?

<!-- uid=1660073:16:1 -->

**Alice:** But I mustn't leave Kirito al--

<!-- uid=1660073:17:1 -->

**Selka:** Don't worry. I'd look after him  
while you're gone.

<!-- uid=1660073:18:1 -->

**Selka:** It's just the next town over.  
I'm sure with that dragon,  
it's an even shorter trip.

<!-- uid=1660073:19:1 -->

**Alice:** Yes, but...

<!-- uid=1660073:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ah...

<!-- uid=1660073:21:1 -->

**Selka:** Did you hear that? Even Kirito's  
telling you to go!

<!-- uid=1660073:22:1 -->

**Selka:** It'll be okay. I'll take good care  
of him.

<!-- uid=1660073:23:1 -->

**Selka:** But I won't make you go if you  
really don't want to, sis. I'll let  
you decide what to do.

<!-- uid=1660073:24:1 -->

**Alice:** ...

<!-- uid=1660073:25:1 -->

**Alice:** Very well... I accept your offer.  
You really don't mind watching  
Kirito for a little while?

<!-- uid=1660073:26:1 -->

**Selka:** Not at all! Just don't forget to  
get the stuff I need to give  
Sister Azariya too, okay?

<!-- uid=1660073:27:1 -->

**Alice:** Of course.

<!-- uid=1660073:28:1 -->

## Story 1660077 · \[Apprentice Nun\] Selka Lv.70

Character Story

**Stallholder:** What's wrong? You look spaced out.

<!-- uid=1660077:1:1 -->

**Alice:** Oh, it's nothing. It was just,  
when I saw that book there with  
the red design on the cover...

<!-- uid=1660077:2:1 -->

**Alice:** I felt the oddest sensation inside  
me and I'm not certain what  
it was exactly...

<!-- uid=1660077:3:1 -->

**Stallholder:** Ha ha, I've never heard that one  
before. You're a peculiar one,  
miss.

<!-- uid=1660077:4:1 -->

**Stallholder:** Maybe it's trying to tell you that  
you should buy it and take it  
home.

<!-- uid=1660077:5:1 -->

**Stallholder:** That book offers a unique take  
on the northern empire's history.

<!-- uid=1660077:6:1 -->

**Alice:** ...

<!-- uid=1660077:7:1 -->

**Alice:** I'm back.

**Selka:** Hey! There you are!

**Alice:** It is.

<!-- uid=1660077:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

**Alice:** And you as well, Kirito.

with him while I was away?

**Selka:** Yep! He's just fine!

**Alice:** N-No... they haven't. I'm sorry

<!-- uid=1660077:23:1 -->

**Selka:** O-Oh... That's okay.

<!-- uid=1660077:24:1 -->

**Alice:** But if this is something that  
Gasupht... that Father wants,  
you should take it to him.

**Selka:** Are you sure?

<!-- uid=1660077:26:1 -->

**Alice:** Yes. I feel as though that book

## Story 1660078 · \[Apprentice Nun\] Selka Lv.80

Character Story

**Alice:** ...

<!-- uid=1660078:1:1 -->

**Alice:** Kirito... I still have no  
memories of my life as

**Alice:** I even have my doubts that they'll

<!-- uid=1660091:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** You're telling me... I hope there  
won't be anything too gruesome...

<!-- uid=1660091:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** I guess there might be undead  
monsters? But I don't remember  
anything like that in Cinderella.

<!-- uid=1660091:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh! Sorry, got a bit sidetracked  
with conversation there.

<!-- uid=1660091:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** Okay. I'll see you later!

<!-- uid=1660091:18:1 -->


## Story 1660093 · \[Long-Haired Songstress\] Leafa Lv.30

Character Story

**Rain:** Hmmm?

<!-- uid=1660093:1:1 -->

**Rain:** I thought I just left the dance  
hall, but now I'm at another  
one...?

<!-- uid=1660093:2:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** There are a number of halls here.  
Are you a new princess?

<!-- uid=1660093:3:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** You'll be showing me just how good  
of a dancer you are.

<!-- uid=1660093:4:1 -->

**Rain:** I-I need to dance...?!

<!-- uid=1660093:5:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** Indeed. You've arrived at the  
ball. Do you intend on leaving  
without dancing?

<!-- uid=1660093:6:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** ...Oh? But where is your partner?  
Did you come here without one?

<!-- uid=1660093:7:1 -->

**Rain:** ...

<!-- uid=1660093:8:1 -->

**Rain:** D-Did I need to bring a guy to  
this quest?

<!-- uid=1660093:9:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** ...Did you really think a princess  
would show off her solo dance  
skills at a ball?

<!-- uid=1660093:10:1 -->

**Rain:** Oh...

<!-- uid=1660093:11:1 -->

**Rain:** Yeah, you're right... I guess  
traditional balls usually have  
women and men dancing together...

<!-- uid=1660093:12:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** For this quest, there's not any  
particular requirement for your  
partner to be of the opposite sex.

<!-- uid=1660093:13:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** You simply require someone to  
dance with, so allow me to fill  
the role.

<!-- uid=1660093:14:1 -->

**Rain:** What?!

<!-- uid=1660093:15:1 -->

**Rain:** B-But I've never danced  
properly in my life before...

<!-- uid=1660093:16:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** That won't be a problem! For I  
will draw out your natural talent  
for dance!

<!-- uid=1660093:17:1 -->

**Rain:** Wh-Why would I have something like  
that?! I told you, I've never even  
danced before in my life!

<!-- uid=1660093:18:1 -->

**Rain:** (Agh! This is NOT good! Why would  
I ever have chosen to raise a  
weird stat like dancing?!)

<!-- uid=1660093:19:1 -->

**Rain:** \*pant\*, \*pant\*, \*pant\*...

<!-- uid=1660093:20:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** ...

<!-- uid=1660093:21:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** You pass! What a talent for  
dance you have!

<!-- uid=1660093:22:1 -->

**Rain:** R-Really...? I mean, even I'm  
surprised by how I was able to  
actually dance, but...

<!-- uid=1660093:23:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** Would I lie to you? I find it hard  
to believe you have no experience  
given your fantastic footwork.

<!-- uid=1660093:24:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** It seems you've been making sure  
to work on your dancing skills.  
I'm impressed.

<!-- uid=1660093:25:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** That, or... Your choice of dress  
was well-suited for this trial.

<!-- uid=1660093:26:1 -->

**Rain:** Ah...!

<!-- uid=1660093:27:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** Now go, my beautiful princess!  
Overcome the other challenges and  
find your prince!

<!-- uid=1660093:28:1 -->

**Rain:** Wow! She was right! This dress  
buffs your dancing skills!

<!-- uid=1660093:29:1 -->

**Rain:** That's Belle's dress for you!  
I guess the dance scenes are a big  
part of Beauty and the Beast.

<!-- uid=1660093:30:1 -->

**Rain:** Anyway, that's one down! I just  
wonder if Asuna and Leafa are  
doing okay...

<!-- uid=1660093:31:1 -->


## Story 1660095 · \[Long-Haired Songstress\] Leafa Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** ...So this does take place in  
a kitchen.

<!-- uid=1660095:1:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** You're late!! Hurry up and get  
to work!!

<!-- uid=1660095:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Excuse me...?

<!-- uid=1660095:3:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Don't just stand there! All the  
ingredients have already been  
prepared, so make what you want!

<!-- uid=1660095:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Y-You want me to cook?

<!-- uid=1660095:5:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Hah! What else do you expect to  
do in a kitchen?!

<!-- uid=1660095:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, I guess I did kind of  
expect this, but...

<!-- uid=1660095:7:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Did you? Then good! So come on  
now, chop chop!

<!-- uid=1660095:8:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** But, well... I don't think I'll  
be getting my hopes too high.

<!-- uid=1660095:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Grr...

<!-- uid=1660095:10:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Oh? You seem displeased. Why don't  
you take a look at your inventory.

<!-- uid=1660095:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hm? Okay, sure...  
Let's see what kind of ingredients  
I have... Ah!

<!-- uid=1660095:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's...all fish?!

<!-- uid=1660095:13:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** That's right! What an unlucky  
turn, my Little Mermaid!

<!-- uid=1660095:14:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Seems your choice of dress was  
a poor one. I think you've made  
things quite hard for yourself.

<!-- uid=1660095:15:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Well, just hurry it up. Get your  
inevitable failure over and done  
with.

<!-- uid=1660095:16:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** I expect many more challengers to  
come after you, after all!

<!-- uid=1660095:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...Hmm. Fish, fish, fish...

<!-- uid=1660095:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** Fine, then. "Chop chop", you said?  
I'll show you what it means to  
chop!

<!-- uid=1660095:19:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Th-This is...!

<!-- uid=1660095:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** I was thinking of making something  
simmered, or maybe a bouillabaisse  
if I had time, but...

<!-- uid=1660095:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** You wanted me to be fast, so I  
made a simple meuniere.  
How was it?

<!-- uid=1660095:22:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Simple...?! Hmph, what false  
modesty!

<!-- uid=1660095:23:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Your ability to judge the freshest  
and most suitable fish for your  
meuniere out of the inventory!

<!-- uid=1660095:24:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Your brilliant preparation skills  
that allowed you to craft this  
perfectly! It's all incredible!

<!-- uid=1660095:25:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** The simplicity of the dish means  
that it's all about the  
fundamentals! This is brilliant!

<!-- uid=1660095:26:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Your Little Mermaid dress should  
have debuffed your skills when  
cooking with fish, though...!

<!-- uid=1660095:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yes, but I made do. I'm always  
working on my cooking, after all.

<!-- uid=1660095:28:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** ...Hm! I've been soundly defeated.  
Cinderella must have the ability  
to cook, after all.

<!-- uid=1660095:29:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** It was a wonderful dish. I hope  
you continue to hone your skills  
in the kitchen.

<!-- uid=1660095:30:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...Phew. I somehow managed to make  
it through that one...

<!-- uid=1660095:31:1 -->

**Asuna:** The Little Mermaid dress's debuff  
to cooking fish was pretty  
severe...

<!-- uid=1660095:32:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'd never worried that much while  
sautéing fish before in my life...

<!-- uid=1660095:33:1 -->

**Asuna:** I guess I have those ingredients  
to thank. I feel like I've learned  
an important lesson today...

<!-- uid=1660095:34:1 -->


## Story 1660097 · \[Long-Haired Songstress\] Leafa Lv.70

Character Story

**Leafa:** Um, so this is where this  
Corridor-Crawler quest takes  
place...

<!-- uid=1660097:1:1 -->

**Sweeping Queen:** You're finally here.  
Time for you to show me what  
you've got.

<!-- uid=1660097:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** Um... What I've got?

<!-- uid=1660097:3:1 -->

**Sweeping Queen:** That's right.

<!-- uid=1660097:4:1 -->

battle started!

<!-- uid=1660097:5:1 -->

**Sweeping Queen:** ...What exactly do you intend on  
doing with that sword?

<!-- uid=1660097:6:1 -->

**Leafa:** Huh?

<!-- uid=1660097:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** W-Well... You told me to show you  
what I've got, so...

<!-- uid=1660097:8:1 -->

**Sweeping Queen:** It seems you're greatly mistaken  
here.

<!-- uid=1660097:9:1 -->

**Sweeping Queen:** I don't wish to see what kinds of  
sword skills you have.

<!-- uid=1660097:10:1 -->

**Sweeping Queen:** It will be your sweeping skills  
that determine your fate here...!

<!-- uid=1660097:11:1 -->

**Leafa:** Aaaagh!

<!-- uid=1660097:12:1 -->

**Sweeping Queen:** You're slow! How can anyone be so  
clumsy with a mop?!

<!-- uid=1660097:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** I-I'm doing the best I can!

<!-- uid=1660097:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** I'm sorry, but I don't have that  
much mopping experience!

<!-- uid=1660097:15:1 -->

**Sweeping Queen:** Then what CAN you do?!

<!-- uid=1660097:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** I-I'm good at wiping floors down  
with a dustcloth! I do it all the  
time when I clean the dojo!

<!-- uid=1660097:17:1 -->

**Sweeping Queen:** A dustcloth? Do you see wooden  
floors here?! No! Think of the  
time! Think of the place!

<!-- uid=1660097:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** Aw, man! C'mon...  
Wh-Whoa!

<!-- uid=1660097:19:1 -->

**Leafa:** Agh... Rapunzel's hair...  
I-It's so long...

<!-- uid=1660097:21:1 -->

**Leafa:** (Well, I guess it would be long  
enough to at least reach  
the floor...)

<!-- uid=1660097:22:1 -->

**Leafa:** (Hm...? W-Wait... When Rapunzel's  
hair passes over a place, it's  
left sparkling...?)

<!-- uid=1660097:23:1 -->

**Leafa:** (Oh, that's it! Rapunzel has magic  
hair! And that extends to  
cleaning!)

<!-- uid=1660097:24:1 -->

**Leafa:** (In other words, if I used  
Rapunzel's hair instead of a mop,  
then this quest would be easy...!)

<!-- uid=1660097:25:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...

<!-- uid=1660097:26:1 -->

**Sweeping Queen:** What's the matter? Why are you  
staring at your hair?!

<!-- uid=1660097:27:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...Sorry! I just got distracted  
for a second!

<!-- uid=1660097:28:1 -->

**Leafa:** Um, do you have any hairbands?  
I forgot mine...

<!-- uid=1660097:29:1 -->

**Leafa:** I can't let a princess's wonderful  
hair get dirty, even if it is to  
complete a quest, you know!

<!-- uid=1660097:30:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...Not that Rapunzel's hair can  
get dirty in the first place, but  
it's the thought that counts!

<!-- uid=1660097:31:1 -->

**Leafa:** So... I'm going to tough this out  
and complete this quest!

<!-- uid=1660097:32:1 -->

**Sweeping Queen:** Hm... Not bad at all.

<!-- uid=1660097:33:1 -->

**Sweeping Queen:** Rather inefficient, but you made  
your way through by sheer force.  
Honestly, I'm surprised.

<!-- uid=1660097:34:1 -->

**Sweeping Queen:** A princess must have dignity.  
And...I think I saw a bit of that  
from you today.

<!-- uid=1660097:35:1 -->

**Leafa:** Phew... I'm glad that worked.

<!-- uid=1660097:36:1 -->

**Leafa:** That took a while...!  
I need to hurry up and meet back  
with Asuna and Rain...!

<!-- uid=1660097:37:1 -->


## Story 1660098 · \[Long-Haired Songstress\] Leafa Lv.80

Character Story

**Leafa:** Asuna! Rain! I'm sorry I'm late!

<!-- uid=1660098:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Were you okay, Leafa?!

<!-- uid=1660098:2:1 -->

**Rain:** Asuna and I were just thinking  
about going to help you!

<!-- uid=1660098:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** I-I'm sorry! I didn't mean to make  
you worry...

cleaning, which I guess wasn't the  
best fit for me...

quests set to be pretty hard too?

the people who came after us

**Asuna:** So I'm fine with it! I got to

and had a lot of fun doing it!

personally. I'm fine just watching  
people dance!

**Leafa:** I feel like I'm not going to want

too, right?

**Asuna:** Good. Alright, then...  
Let's get to the main event!

Character Story

**Alice:** ...

events.

about in it...

## Story 1850043 · \[Snow Blessings\] Sachi Lv.30

her back.

## Story 1850045 · \[Snow Blessings\] Sachi Lv.50

Character Story

## Story 1850047 · \[Snow Blessings\] Sachi Lv.70

Character Story

**Keita:** So, uh...  
Sorry about that.

to help out.

back to that quest you're working  
on.

**Keita:** No worries! Good luck with your  
training!

<!-- uid=1850047:8:1 -->

<!-- uid=1850047:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=1850047:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** When terror's about to overwhelm

keep moving, you know?

<!-- uid=1850047:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** I want to live to see tomorrow;  
and to do that, I've got to fight.  
So, I fight.

<!-- uid=1850047:19:1 -->

**Sachi:** ...

<!-- uid=1850047:20:1 -->

<!-- uid=1850047:21:1 -->

<!-- uid=1850047:22:1 -->


## Story 1850048 · \[Snow Blessings\] Sachi Lv.80

the other day, so I'm going in  
for extra lessons today.

<!-- uid=1850075:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ouch, sounds tough.

<!-- uid=1850075:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, I wanted to ask you about  
that new dungeon in Imp territory.

<!-- uid=1850075:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** How do you access it?

<!-- uid=1850075:14:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hmm... Let's see...

<!-- uid=1850075:15:1 -->

**Yuuki:** You need to get twelve Iron Coral  
and five Scarlet Wing Feathers,

<!-- uid=1850075:16:1 -->

**Yuuki:** then head to this 323-meter high  
mountain in Imp territory. There  
was a place covered in snow,

<!-- uid=1850075:17:1 -->

**Yuuki:** and you have to recite ten spells  
there back-to-back. It's a pretty  
tough set of requirements.

<!-- uid=1850075:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Correct! Next question.

<!-- uid=1850075:19:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Huh?

<!-- uid=1850075:20:1 -->


## Story 1850077 · \[The Coveted Life\] Yuuki Lv.70

Character Story

**Kirito:** Do you know why that dungeon  
has that particular set of  
requirements to unlock?

<!-- uid=1850077:1:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Umm, I think so.

<!-- uid=1850077:2:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Legend has it the God of Darkness  
befriended a Salamander and an  
Undine when the world was young.

<!-- uid=1850077:3:1 -->

**Yuuki:** That Undine used the coral as a  
focus to enhance her magic,

<!-- uid=1850077:4:1 -->

**Yuuki:** and it's said the Scarlet Wing and  
its feathers were relics of that  
Salamander.

<!-- uid=1850077:5:1 -->

**Yuuki:** The legend is based on this ten-  
verse Skaldic poem, so all ten  
spells start with quotes from it.

<!-- uid=1850077:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha, nice. You've perfectly  
memorized quest requirements  
and all the background lore.

<!-- uid=1850077:7:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hehe, thanks for the compliment!

<!-- uid=1850077:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** You know, I think memorizing  
game info like this is a lot like  
studying for school.

<!-- uid=1850077:9:1 -->

**Yuuki:** It is?

<!-- uid=1850077:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yup! See? You can remember stuff.  
You're just having trouble because  
it's "school" and not "fun."

<!-- uid=1850077:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** If you just think of your classes  
as a way to prepare for gaming,  
won't they be easier to remember?

<!-- uid=1850077:12:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Huh... That's an interesting idea.

<!-- uid=1850077:13:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I definitely never have trouble  
remembering game info.

<!-- uid=1850077:14:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Ha ha ha, don't tell me all that  
was just a roundabout way of  
trying to cheer me on?

<!-- uid=1850077:15:1 -->

**Yuuki:** But I don't think treating my  
lessons as something I need  
for the game will work.

<!-- uid=1850077:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** No, think about it! Math will help  
when you're trying to calculate  
stats,

<!-- uid=1850077:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** and learning about history and  
myths will help when it comes  
to all of ALO's themed quests.

<!-- uid=1850077:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** And studying grammar and language  
will definitely help with all the  
ancient languages in ALO.

<!-- uid=1850077:19:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Ahh, I get it!  
That just might work!

<!-- uid=1850077:20:1 -->


## Story 1850078 · \[The Coveted Life\] Yuuki Lv.80

## Story 1850091 · \[Funky Play\] Yuuki Lv.10

Character Story

**Yuuki:** Here goes! How do you like...THIS!

<!-- uid=1850091:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Awesome solo, Yuuki! You've gotten  
really good at the bass.

<!-- uid=1850091:2:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Thanks! I've barely ever even  
touched an instrument before,

<!-- uid=1850091:3:1 -->

**Yuuki:** so I'm super excited about all of  
this! I might not be able to stop!

<!-- uid=1850091:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** I know! It feels so good when you  
manage to play well and it  
actually sounds nice.

<!-- uid=1850091:5:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Exactly! And you can totally tell  
when you have the right answer!

<!-- uid=1850091:6:1 -->

**Yuuki:** It's so much fun!

<!-- uid=1850091:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Huh? What do you mean by  
"right answer"?

<!-- uid=1850091:8:1 -->

**Yuuki:** How do I explain it...? Know how  
when you're fighting, you might  
hit your opponent,

<!-- uid=1850091:9:1 -->

**Yuuki:** but you never know if you've won  
until your opponent goes down  
for good?

<!-- uid=1850091:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Okay, I'm following so far. You  
mean you can't celebrate until  
your opponent is defeated?

<!-- uid=1850091:11:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Yeah. Well, with music, you know  
the second you play a note whether  
or not it's the right answer.

<!-- uid=1850091:12:1 -->

**Yuuki:** So it feels great when you get a  
lot of notes right in a row.

<!-- uid=1850091:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, I see. That's a fun way of  
looking at it!

<!-- uid=1850091:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** So every correct strum is its own  
burst of accomplishment and  
satisfaction.

<!-- uid=1850091:15:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Yeah, exactly!  
I love it! It's such a rush!

<!-- uid=1850091:16:1 -->


## Story 1850093 · \[Funky Play\] Yuuki Lv.30

Character Story

**Yuuki:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=1850093:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yuuki? Aren't you practicing?

<!-- uid=1850093:2:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I started thinking about the bass  
player's role in a band... And I'm  
kinda sad now.

<!-- uid=1850093:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** What? Why?

<!-- uid=1850093:4:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Bass is a really low sound.  
It doesn't stand out like  
vocals or guitar.

<!-- uid=1850093:5:1 -->

**Yuuki:** It's generally there to support  
all the other instruments...

<!-- uid=1850093:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh... Yuuki, do you want to play  
another instrument?

<!-- uid=1850093:7:1 -->

**Yuuki:** No, that's not it. It's not that  
I want to be the center of  
attention or anything...

<!-- uid=1850093:8:1 -->

**Yuuki:** But what we were talking about  
the other day got me thinking.  
About comparing music to battle.

<!-- uid=1850093:9:1 -->

**Yuuki:** The bass player's gotta be solid  
and trustworthy to support the  
band as a whole, right?

<!-- uid=1850093:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** What do you mean?

<!-- uid=1850093:11:1 -->

**Yuuki:** When we party, I'm DPS, right?  
So, what's the equivalent of DPS  
in a band?

<!-- uid=1850093:12:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I figure it's vocals, guitar,  
or piano. An instrument  
that stands out a bit.

<!-- uid=1850093:13:1 -->

**Yuuki:** A bassist is support, like a  
healer: without them the DPS can't  
really DPS. I never realized that.

<!-- uid=1850093:14:1 -->

**Yuuki:** And I think that deep down, I  
looked down on support classes.  
Does...that make me a bad person?

<!-- uid=1850093:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yuuki...  
I think you're worrying too much.

<!-- uid=1850093:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** And I think that realizing the  
value of support roles is a really  
good thing.

<!-- uid=1850093:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** So! Why not use this newfound  
knowledge and change up your  
playstyle?

<!-- uid=1850093:18:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Well... I guess I could...

<!-- uid=1850093:19:1 -->

**Yuuki:** But... I kinda like the way I  
play games. I don't know if  
I want to change...

<!-- uid=1850093:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, if that's how you feel,  
why not try experimenting?!

<!-- uid=1850093:21:1 -->

**Yuuki:** What do you mean?

<!-- uid=1850093:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** Try battling as a back-row support  
class, and not a front-line fighter!

<!-- uid=1850093:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** I think you'll learn a lot from  
the experience!

<!-- uid=1850093:24:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I'll...think about it.

<!-- uid=1850093:25:1 -->

role in ALO!

<!-- uid=1850098:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** You did? Why?

<!-- uid=1850098:4:1 -->

**Yuuki:** You said it'd be good to get  
experience trying different  
things, so I did! I was support!

<!-- uid=1850098:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** And how'd it go?

<!-- uid=1850098:6:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Terribly! Ahahaha! I messed  
everything up and we had a lot  
of trouble with an easy boss!

<!-- uid=1850098:7:1 -->

**Yuuki:** But I think I get how support  
players feel now.

<!-- uid=1850098:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** You do? And?

<!-- uid=1850098:9:1 -->

**Yuuki:** You've got to be calm and aware

then pick the best action.

<!-- uid=1850098:10:1 -->

**Yuuki:** And more importantly, you can't  
just think about yourself. You  
have to think about the team.

<!-- uid=1850098:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, that's right. Now, are those

the bass better?

<!-- uid=1850098:12:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Yeah! Working it out in a fight

<!-- uid=1850098:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Good to hear! I guess that's why

<!-- uid=1850098:14:1 -->

with everyone else's sound.

<!-- uid=1850098:15:1 -->

<!-- uid=1850098:16:1 -->


## Story 1850121 · \[The Death Queen\] Sinon Lv.10

<!-- uid=1850121:10:1 -->

<!-- uid=1850121:12:1 -->

## Story 1850123 · \[The Death Queen\] Sinon Lv.30

Character Story

**Hel:** The people of Helheim are made up  
of the souls of the departed from  
this world after they die.

<!-- uid=1850123:1:1 -->

**Hel:** I'm their ruler. Essentially, I'm  
the lord of the dead, you could  
say.

<!-- uid=1850123:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** When you say the "souls of the  
departed," does that happen to  
include monsters, too?

<!-- uid=1850123:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** It seems like it does. I can only  
imagine how many there are knowing  
how often players kill them.

<!-- uid=1850123:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** You have a good point. When I  
think about it, being the lord of  
the dead sounds like a scary job.

<!-- uid=1850123:5:1 -->

**Hel:** Oh, it's not so bad. They listen  
to absolutely anything I say. Why,  
I could even summon them here.

<!-- uid=1850123:6:1 -->

**Leafa:** Eeek! No thanks! I'll take your  
word for it, Hel!

<!-- uid=1850123:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=1850123:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** Say, Hel. Just out of curiosity,  
what would happen if you did  
summon your minions here?

<!-- uid=1850123:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** Uh, Sinon, why do you want to know  
that? You're not thinking of doing  
something scary, are you?!

<!-- uid=1850123:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** I'm not. I'm just curious.  
That's all.

<!-- uid=1850123:11:1 -->

**Hel:** You could use them for practice,  
if you like. I can summon as  
many replacements as you need.

<!-- uid=1850123:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** Interesting. So basically you  
could turn it into like a hack-  
and-slash or marathon quest, then.

<!-- uid=1850123:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** Huh? Oh, you mean like the quests  
where you fight countless waves of  
enemies forever in an arena?

<!-- uid=1850123:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** The kind where the enemies get  
stronger and you compete to see  
who can beat the most?

<!-- uid=1850123:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yep. Bingo. I'm thinking I just  
might give it a shot.

<!-- uid=1850123:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** That sounds less scary than  
what I imagined when you said you  
wanted to summon the dead, haha.

<!-- uid=1850123:17:1 -->


## Story 1850125 · \[The Death Queen\] Sinon Lv.50

Character Story

**Sinon:** Okay, I'm all set over here.  
Ready when you are, Hel.

<!-- uid=1850125:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** Good luck, Sinon! I'm sure you'll  
do great!

<!-- uid=1850125:2:1 -->

**Hel:** Hehe, alright, then. Time to  
summon my adorable servants. Come  
on out, boys and girls!

<!-- uid=1850125:3:1 -->

**Monsters:** GLUGHAAAH!

<!-- uid=1850125:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** Here they come. Let's do this!

<!-- uid=1850125:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** Sinon's keeping her distance while  
she picks them off one at a time  
with her bow.

<!-- uid=1850125:6:2 -->

**Leafa:** Not that I'm surprised. It's a  
common tactic when soloing lots  
of enemies as an archer.

<!-- uid=1850125:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hmm? What's going on? This kind of  
situation could be really tough  
for her if she's not careful.

<!-- uid=1850125:8:1 -->

**Beast:** Grawrrr!

<!-- uid=1850125:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** Crap! I can't believe it got so  
close to me so quickly!

<!-- uid=1850125:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** I've got to get some distance  
between me and the frontline  
somehow.

<!-- uid=1850125:11:1 -->

**Magic-Using Monster:** Graaaaaagh!

<!-- uid=1850125:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** Ugh, so they've got long-range  
attacks, too. Now I'm not safe no  
matter how close or far I am.

<!-- uid=1850125:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** Any good sniper worth their salt  
will take cover when attacking and  
fire at their targets from afar.

<!-- uid=1850125:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** Ideally, with large crowds, you  
should focus on landing headshots  
and moving as little as possible.

<!-- uid=1850125:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** But there's nowhere for me to hide  
here. It's forcing me into a free-  
for-all, which isn't good...

<!-- uid=1850125:16:1 -->


## Story 1850127 · \[The Death Queen\] Sinon Lv.70

Character Story

**Hel:** Sorry, Sinon! You lose!

<!-- uid=1850127:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** Oh, shut it. You don't think I  
realize that?

<!-- uid=1850127:2:1 -->

**Hel:** You beat a total of 52 monsters  
out there. A big number, but  
nothing to write home about.

<!-- uid=1850127:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** Poor Sinon...

<!-- uid=1850127:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah, I know. Archers aren't  
exactly suited for endless waves  
of combat in an enclosed arena.

<!-- uid=1850127:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** It's easy to get surrounded if  
there are too many enemies and by  
then you can't react fast enough.

<!-- uid=1850127:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah. You can keep your equipment  
load light and raise your AGI, but  
you still need good DEF.

<!-- uid=1850127:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** Maybe I should switch to a close-  
range weapon like a spear.  
Hmm...

<!-- uid=1850127:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** But will that really help much? At  
the end of the day, you still  
fight best as a sniper.

<!-- uid=1850127:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah. I'd like to apply those  
skills still, but I can't think of  
how I can in this situation.

<!-- uid=1850127:10:1 -->

**Hel:** What'll you do? You're welcome  
to try again as many times as  
you like. I don't mind, ehehe.

<!-- uid=1850127:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** You seem to be enjoy watching  
me be miserable over there,  
Hel.

<!-- uid=1850127:12:1 -->

**Hel:** Hehe, well, if there's one thing I  
love more than a strong fighter,  
it's seeing them lose badly.

<!-- uid=1850127:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeesh. Hel's got a few screws  
loose, but I guess that's normal  
when you rule the underworld.

<!-- uid=1850127:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** Augh, screw you, Hel! I'll make  
you eat those words if it's the  
last thing I do!

<!-- uid=1850127:15:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hey, Sinon! I have an idea for  
what you could do in your next  
fight.

<!-- uid=1850127:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** It should let you put your sniper  
skills to good use. Want to hear  
it?

<!-- uid=1850127:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Huh? Yeah, of course. What do  
you have in mind?

<!-- uid=1850127:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** So obviously, when you're sniping  
it's obvious best to shoot from  
behind cover when you can, right?

<!-- uid=1850127:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah, but there's nothing but flat  
ground in that arena. There's  
nothing for me to hide behind.

<!-- uid=1850127:20:1 -->

**Leafa:** So? Just make some cover, then!  
This is ALO, a world of magic!  
You can whip some up no problem!

<!-- uid=1850127:21:1 -->


## Story 1850128 · \[The Death Queen\] Sinon Lv.80

Character Story

**Monster:** Grrraaaagh!

<!-- uid=1850128:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** If I use earth magic here, that  
should do the trick!

<!-- uid=1850128:2:1 -->

**Hel:** What? Is she doing what I think  
she is?!

<!-- uid=1850128:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yay, she did it! She managed to  
use magic to manipulate the  
terrain to her advantage!

<!-- uid=1850128:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** Using earth magic, she can conjure  
up cover and obstacles to fight  
those monsters like a real sniper!

<!-- uid=1850128:5:1 -->

**Monster:** Gragh?!

<!-- uid=1850128:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** You're not going anywhere,  
buster!

<!-- uid=1850128:7:1 -->

**Monster:** Grrraaaagh!

<!-- uid=1850128:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** I should be able to manage a lot

magic in ALO.

<!-- uid=1850128:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** Unlike GGO, if there's no good

didn't I think of that sooner?!

<!-- uid=1850128:13:1 -->

don't want me to summon any more

<!-- uid=1850128:15:2 -->

## Story 1850131 · \[Beach Lancer\] Leafa Lv.10

finished work early today.

<!-- uid=1850131:15:1 -->

**Leafa:** I see...

<!-- uid=1850131:16:1 -->

## Story 1860011 · \[Moonlit Lark\] Asuna Lv.10

Character Story

**Asuna:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=1860011:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** What's up, Asuna? Is that the  
costume you made for the  
Halloween party?

<!-- uid=1860011:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah...

<!-- uid=1860011:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Looks like you've patched it up  
since the run-in with those demons.

<!-- uid=1860011:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito... You better not be  
thinking of telling me that  
I shouldn't have patched it up...

<!-- uid=1860011:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wh-What? I'd never say anything  
like that... Ahaha...

<!-- uid=1860011:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** But, uh, why do you look so  
down, by the way?

<!-- uid=1860011:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Because, despite how hard Liz and  
I worked on it, this outfit doesn't  
have any real use.

<!-- uid=1860011:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, it's a dress you made for  
a Halloween party. Isn't that  
its use?

<!-- uid=1860011:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** But in a VRMMO, it's important  
for equipment to be useful in  
quests or combat, you know?

<!-- uid=1860011:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, what are its stats like?

<!-- uid=1860011:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Its DEF is practically nonexistent,  
and it doesn't have any bonus

## Story 1860013 · \[Moonlit Lark\] Asuna Lv.30

Character Story

**Liz:** Eh, no use crying over spilled  
milk. It's always tricky trying to  
make equipment in games.

<!-- uid=1860013:1:1 -->

**Liz:** You've got to balance so many  
different things so it doesn't  
become industrial waste.

<!-- uid=1860013:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Industrial... waste?

<!-- uid=1860013:3:1 -->

**Liz:** I don't mean literally. Obviously  
we're not filling up landfills  
in the real world doing this.

<!-- uid=1860013:4:1 -->

**Liz:** It's just gamer slang for something  
that doesn't end up being useful.

<!-- uid=1860013:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, this thing's been pretty  
useless right from the get-go.

<!-- uid=1860013:6:1 -->

**Liz:** What are you talking about? Its  
gorgeous appearance got you  
lots of attention at the party.

<!-- uid=1860013:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** I guess so...

<!-- uid=1860013:8:1 -->

**Liz:** There are tons of items in VRMMOS  
that are completely useless.

<!-- uid=1860013:9:1 -->

**Liz:** At least you had a chance to shine  
in that dress once. In that sense,  
it served its purpose just fine.

<!-- uid=1860013:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** I guess that's true. When I think  
about it, there's lots of nice  
equipment with low stats.

<!-- uid=1860013:11:1 -->

**Liz:** Exactly. If all equipment looked  
great and had good specs, it's  
all anyone would ever wear.

<!-- uid=1860013:12:1 -->

**Liz:** Everybody at a party would look  
the same, and that wouldn't be  
fun, would it?

<!-- uid=1860013:13:1 -->

**Liz:** I mean, sure, you could still  
change colors or do whatever  
to personalize it a bit.

<!-- uid=1860013:14:1 -->

**Liz:** But I'd rather there be lots of  
different equipment with unique  
traits for us to discover.

<!-- uid=1860013:15:1 -->

**Liz:** That way people have more options  
to choose from based on the  
situation and how they play.

<!-- uid=1860013:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, but I'd still hate to give  
this up after all the work I put  
into it.

<!-- uid=1860013:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** At the end of the day, though, you  
are right that it did exactly what  
I created it to do.

<!-- uid=1860013:18:1 -->

**Liz:** That's the spirit! Gotta stay  
positive!

<!-- uid=1860013:19:1 -->

**Liz:** There's still plenty of awesome  
equipment out there waiting for  
you!

<!-- uid=1860013:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, thanks, Liz.

<!-- uid=1860013:21:1 -->
