**Asuna:** Of course, I use my real name AND  
an avatar that looks like me, so I  
guess I'm not one to talk...

<!-- uid=1860033:17:1 -->

**Leafa:** Now that you mention it, you don't  
really resemble your real-life self  
in ALO that much,

<!-- uid=1860033:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** but here, you obviously chose to  
model your avatar after yourself.  
Is there any special reason why?

<!-- uid=1860033:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** As a matter of fact...

<!-- uid=1860033:20:1 -->


## Story 1860035 · \[Moonlight Maiden\] Suguha Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** I'm sure you've heard about this,  
but when SAO turned into a death  
game, we were all forced to use...

<!-- uid=1860035:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...avatars that looked just like  
us in real life. I spent two years  
there with my own face and body.

<!-- uid=1860035:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** Right...

<!-- uid=1860035:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** After we were freed, I thought a  
different avatar would help me  
enjoy myself more in these...

<!-- uid=1860035:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...new worlds, especially one with  
fairies and magic that was so  
different from SAO.

<!-- uid=1860035:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** But as I played ALO...  
I realized something.

<!-- uid=1860035:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Having an avatar that looked  
just like me in SAO actually  
helped me get through it.

<!-- uid=1860035:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** It did?

<!-- uid=1860035:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah. Those two years were really  
hard, but I wouldn't trade them  
for anything.

<!-- uid=1860035:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** I realized that the thing that  
helped me turn all those hardships  
into a source of joy...

<!-- uid=1860035:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...was seeing my own reflection  
looking back at me in the mirror.

<!-- uid=1860035:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** So I think I was able to get  
through it all because...  
it was really me doing it.

<!-- uid=1860035:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** So basically, you feel that  
looking like yourself can  
help you get stronger?

<!-- uid=1860035:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, I guess so.  
But don't get me wrong;  
I like my ALO avatar a lot too.

<!-- uid=1860035:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** I think I might be the same way.  
I knew I had to steel myself to go  
up against the Slashers...

<!-- uid=1860035:15:1 -->

**Leafa:** And I thought that looking like  
the me who's worked so hard at  
kendo would help me get there.

<!-- uid=1860035:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe. At any rate, let's both be  
careful not to let our real-life  
identities leak, huh?

<!-- uid=1860035:17:1 -->

**Leafa:** You know it!

<!-- uid=1860035:18:1 -->


## Story 1860037 · \[Moonlight Maiden\] Suguha Lv.70

Character Story

**Leafa:** Oh man, what am I gonna do...?

<!-- uid=1860037:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Leafa? Is something wrong?

<!-- uid=1860037:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** Oh, hi Asuna. Remember how we  
talked about making avatars closer  
to our real-life selves?

<!-- uid=1860037:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Y-Yeah...

<!-- uid=1860037:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** Well, today Recon...

<!-- uid=1860037:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** Er, a guy in my class told me some  
kids from our school are also  
playing Asuka Empire.

<!-- uid=1860037:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Really? So, if any of them see  
you, they might recognize you  
as Suguha?

<!-- uid=1860037:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeah...

<!-- uid=1860037:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Then I guess you really do need  
to be careful about when and  
where you use that avatar...

<!-- uid=1860037:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** I guess so...

<!-- uid=1860037:10:1 -->

**Player A:** Dude, our soccer team's the best.  
I still can't believe they won the  
district tournament.

<!-- uid=1860037:11:1 -->

**Player B:** Have you seen the coach? It's no  
wonder they're so good with a  
bruiser like him yelling orders.

<!-- uid=1860037:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...!

<!-- uid=1860037:13:1 -->

**Player C:** Yeah, he looks scary, but did you  
know he's actually a total  
pushover with his daughters?

<!-- uid=1860037:14:1 -->

**Player C:** One of my friends told me he saw  
the coach at a festival with his  
whole family!

<!-- uid=1860037:15:1 -->

**Players:** Whoa, really?! Ahaha!

<!-- uid=1860037:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...

<!-- uid=1860037:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Leafa...? Is something wrong?

<!-- uid=1860037:18:1 -->

**Player A:** Hey, dude, check out that girl  
with the short black hair.  
Isn't that...?

<!-- uid=1860037:19:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...!

<!-- uid=1860037:20:1 -->


## Story 1860038 · \[Moonlight Maiden\] Suguha Lv.80

Character Story

**Player A:** Um, excuse me!

<!-- uid=1860038:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** Uh oh...!

<!-- uid=1860038:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Are these the people you were...?

<!-- uid=1860038:3:1 -->

**Player B:** Whoa, it's really her!  
You're that awesome newb  
everyone's talking about, right?

<!-- uid=1860038:4:1 -->

**Player C:** The expert sword fighter who  
hasn't lost a single duel!

<!-- uid=1860038:5:1 -->

**Player A:** Dude, we're so rooting for you.  
Keep on kicking everyone's butts!

<!-- uid=1860038:6:1 -->

**Leafa:** Huh?  
Uh... Sure.

<!-- uid=1860038:7:1 -->

**Player B:** Anyway, we're gonna get going.  
Hope to see you around again  
sometime.

<!-- uid=1860038:8:1 -->

**Player C:** Man, I can't believe we got to  
meet her! Talk about lucky!

<!-- uid=1860038:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** Wh-What just happened...?

<!-- uid=1860038:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Leafa, aren't those the kids from  
your class you were just telling  
me about?

<!-- uid=1860038:11:1 -->

**Leafa:** Y-Yeah, that was them. I could  
tell from their conversation.

<!-- uid=1860038:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** I also heard the same story about  
seeing the coach at the Kawagoe  
Festival with his family...

<!-- uid=1860038:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** And our soccer team recently won  
the district tournament too...

<!-- uid=1860038:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** But they didn't seem to recognize  
you at all.

<!-- uid=1860038:15:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeah... I guess even if we do  
model our avatars after ourselves,  
in the end, they're just CGI...

<!-- uid=1860038:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** There must be some kind of  
intangible difference between them  
and what we really look like.

<!-- uid=1860038:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** I think you're right. Anyway,  
you must be so relieved!

<!-- uid=1860038:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** Definitely. And if my own  
classmates couldn't tell it  
was me,

<!-- uid=1860038:19:1 -->

**Leafa:** maybe I don't need to worry  
about my identity leaking too  
much after all!

<!-- uid=1860038:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** You said it.

<!-- uid=1860038:21:1 -->


## Story 1860051 · \[Innocent Hina Doll\] Suguha Lv.10

Character Story

**Leafa:** Look Asuna, there's a new store  
over there!

<!-- uid=1860051:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hey, yeah! And it's got treats  
I've never seen before!

<!-- uid=1860051:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** Ooh, look. This pastry is made  
with sweet potatoes!

<!-- uid=1860051:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Huh... Say, this wouldn't be from  
Kawagoe, would it?

<!-- uid=1860051:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** It sure is. Kawagoe is actually  
known as Little Edo, and has lots  
of different Japanese sweets.

<!-- uid=1860051:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, I should've known a Japanese  
VRMMO like Asuka Empire would have  
lots of treats for Girls' Day.

<!-- uid=1860051:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey. Sorry I'm late.

<!-- uid=1860051:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hi Kirito.

<!-- uid=1860051:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Looks like you're both making the  
most of this Girls' Day event.

<!-- uid=1860051:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yup! Now that the quest is over,  
it'd be a waste not to enjoy it!

<!-- uid=1860051:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** So how come you're still little  
kids? Don't you want to grow back  
up now that the incident's over?

<!-- uid=1860051:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, silly Kirito. The Girls' Day  
festival is for girls, remember?

<!-- uid=1860051:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** So don't you think it'd be more  
fun if we stay little girls too?

<!-- uid=1860051:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, yeah, that's a good point...

<!-- uid=1860051:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** Not to mention this form comes  
with other perks...

<!-- uid=1860051:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Perks?

<!-- uid=1860051:16:1 -->

**Townsman NPC:** Here girls, have a treat. Don't  
worry, they're on the house.

<!-- uid=1860051:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Wow, thank you!

<!-- uid=1860051:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** Are you sure you don't need money?

<!-- uid=1860051:19:1 -->

**Townsman NPC:** Of course. It's Girls' Day! All  
you two have to worry about is  
enjoying yourselves.

<!-- uid=1860051:20:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yay!

<!-- uid=1860051:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Aha. So that's what you meant.

<!-- uid=1860051:22:1 -->


## Story 1860053 · \[Innocent Hina Doll\] Suguha Lv.30

Character Story

**Kirito:** Pretty nice you get all these  
things for free just for being  
little girls.

<!-- uid=1860053:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hehe, right? I can't even finish  
all these treats myself.

<!-- uid=1860053:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Here Kirito, you can share mine.

<!-- uid=1860053:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ooh, thanks. I was just feeling  
a little hungry.

<!-- uid=1860053:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** Too bad you can't get in on this  
free stuff action even if you  
drink the Water of Youth, Kirito.

<!-- uid=1860053:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, nothing I can do about that,  
since it's Girls' Day and all.  
...Hm?

<!-- uid=1860053:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito? What's up?

<!-- uid=1860053:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** There's an older couple over there  
staring at us...

<!-- uid=1860053:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hm? Oh yeah, so there is.

<!-- uid=1860053:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** If they want to give us a treat,  
they should just come talk to us.

<!-- uid=1860053:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...I don't think those two are  
NPCs. I'm pretty sure they're  
players.

<!-- uid=1860053:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** They look like they're a bit older  
than most players, but yeah,  
I think so too.

<!-- uid=1860053:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** I guess it's true that Asuka  
Empire's traditional Japan theme  
appeals to older age brackets too.

<!-- uid=1860053:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** If they're players, I guess that  
also means they're not going to  
give us any treats.

<!-- uid=1860053:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** I thought you said you couldn't  
finish what you have already...

<!-- uid=1860053:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** They look kind of lonely...  
I'm going to go talk to them!

<!-- uid=1860053:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh? Asuna?

<!-- uid=1860053:17:1 -->

**Leafa:** ......

<!-- uid=1860053:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hm? Aren't you going to go after  
her, Kirito?

<!-- uid=1860053:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** No... I feel like I should stay  
out of this. Would you go instead,  
Leafa?

<!-- uid=1860053:20:1 -->

**Leafa:** Me? Uh, okay...

<!-- uid=1860053:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** Um, excuse me.

<!-- uid=1860053:22:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** Huh?

<!-- uid=1860053:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** If you'd like to take part in the  
Girls' Day festival, you're  
welcome to do so.

<!-- uid=1860053:24:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** Oh, no, thank you. We're just--

<!-- uid=1860053:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** There's no reason you can't have  
fun just because you're grown-ups,  
after all.

<!-- uid=1860053:26:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** Haha... You sound very mature for  
your age, young lady.

<!-- uid=1860053:27:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** Hehe, you sure do. Doesn't she  
remind you of our eldest, honey?

<!-- uid=1860053:28:1 -->


## Story 1860055 · \[Innocent Hina Doll\] Suguha Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to  
be rude.

<!-- uid=1860055:1:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** Not at all. It's very kind of you  
to talk to us.

<!-- uid=1860055:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** I just couldn't help but notice  
you two seemed a bit lonely.

<!-- uid=1860055:3:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** Oh no, was it that obvious?

<!-- uid=1860055:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yes. VRMMOs can detect your  
emotions and display them just  
like you do in real life.

<!-- uid=1860055:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** So it's pretty hard to cover up  
how you feel. Hehe.

<!-- uid=1860055:6:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** I see. That's good to know. I must  
say though, I'm surprised to see a  
child like you playing this game.

<!-- uid=1860055:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, I'm sorry. I'm actually--

<!-- uid=1860055:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hey Asuna, I think the limit on  
this effect is about to run out.

<!-- uid=1860055:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, yeah. In that case, I might as  
well show you...

<!-- uid=1860055:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** This is what we really look like.  
We were just using a special  
mechanic to change our appearance.

<!-- uid=1860055:11:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** S-So that explains it... I was  
wondering how such a young child  
learned to speak like a grown-up.

<!-- uid=1860055:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Um, if you don't mind my asking,

<!-- uid=1860055:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** would you mind telling me more  
about your daughter?

<!-- uid=1860055:14:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** Huh?

<!-- uid=1860055:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm probably about the same age as  
her, and I also fight with my  
mother sometimes...

<!-- uid=1860055:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** So I just thought I might be able  
to help somehow.

<!-- uid=1860055:17:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** ......

<!-- uid=1860055:18:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** Seeing you two in your child forms  
just got us reminiscing about the  
past...

<!-- uid=1860055:19:1 -->

**Leafa:** The past?

<!-- uid=1860055:20:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** Perhaps it's fate that we ended up  
meeting like this.

<!-- uid=1860055:21:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** You see, we have two daughters who  
are close in age to one another...

<!-- uid=1860055:22:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** They were adorable when they were  
children, just like you two. But  
after they graduated high school,

<!-- uid=1860055:23:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** they started arguing with us to  
the point where they just up  
and ran away...

<!-- uid=1860055:24:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** We had never fought with them  
about anything before, so it came  
as something of a shock to us.

<!-- uid=1860055:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** I see... What was it you fought  
about with them?

<!-- uid=1860055:26:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** Oh, they just wanted to move to  
the city to pursue their dreams,  
and we tried to stop them.

<!-- uid=1860055:27:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** You've heard it all before, I'm  
sure. They were such good girls  
growing up that when they

<!-- uid=1860055:28:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** started pushing back on us like  
that, we ended up overreacting.  
And that brings us to today...

<!-- uid=1860055:29:1 -->

**Asuna:** I see...

<!-- uid=1860055:30:1 -->


## Story 1860057 · \[Innocent Hina Doll\] Suguha Lv.70

Character Story

**Asuna:** Speaking as someone in a similar  
position as your daughters,

<!-- uid=1860057:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm certain that they're grateful  
to you for everything you did for  
them growing up.

<!-- uid=1860057:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** But I also think that as they got  
older, and came to realize what  
they want to do with their lives,

<!-- uid=1860057:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** they became hurt that you didn't  
understand, precisely because they  
love you so much.

<!-- uid=1860057:4:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** ......

<!-- uid=1860057:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** Asuna...

<!-- uid=1860057:6:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** I must say, hearing that from a  
girl of your age really makes it  
ring true...

<!-- uid=1860057:7:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** All the more so because your child  
forms resembled our girls when  
they were little...

<!-- uid=1860057:8:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** Tell me, what would you want us to  
do if you were our daughter?

<!-- uid=1860057:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** I think...I'd want you two to be  
patient.

<!-- uid=1860057:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** When we get older, it can be hard  
for us children to articulate our  
desires, or prove we're serious

<!-- uid=1860057:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** about them... So if I were them,  
I'd want you two to accept my  
determination to live my own life.

<!-- uid=1860057:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm certain they'll come back  
someday, even if they don't end up  
accomplishing their goals...

<!-- uid=1860057:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** And when they do, I'm sure they'll  
want you to welcome them with open  
arms. Because you're their family.

<!-- uid=1860057:14:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** \*sigh\* I knew it. Honey,  
I hope you take all that to heart.

<!-- uid=1860057:15:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** Yeah...It wasn't easy to hear, but  
I think I needed to hear it...  
You know, it's funny.

<!-- uid=1860057:16:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** I had no intention whatsoever of  
hearing what my daughters had to  
say, but meeting you here,

<!-- uid=1860057:17:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Man:** and hearing what YOU had to say,  
really got to me... What a strange  
place this virtual world is.

<!-- uid=1860057:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, I know what you mean.  
I think it may be precisely  
because this world is separate

<!-- uid=1860057:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** from the real one that we're  
better able to express how we  
really feel.

<!-- uid=1860057:20:1 -->

**Leafa:** Your daughters left together,  
right?

<!-- uid=1860057:21:1 -->

**Leafa:** In that case, I'm sure they're  
living together right now and  
doing just fine!

<!-- uid=1860057:22:1 -->

**Middle-Aged Woman:** Thank you. I think so too.

<!-- uid=1860057:23:1 -->


## Story 1860058 · \[Innocent Hina Doll\] Suguha Lv.80

Character Story

**Kirito:** All done?

<!-- uid=1860058:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah. Thanks for waiting for us,  
Kirito.

<!-- uid=1860058:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** That couple sure looks like they  
feel a lot better now, don't they.

<!-- uid=1860058:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah... You know, when I first saw  
them, I thought of my mother  
whenever we have a fight.

<!-- uid=1860058:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** After that, I just felt like I had  
to do something...

<!-- uid=1860058:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** Were you aware of that all along,  
Kirito?

<!-- uid=1860058:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hardly. I just remembered that  
Asuna thought the dolls on the

<!-- uid=1860058:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Girls' Day stand looked sad, and  
it turned out there was something  
to that.

<!-- uid=1860058:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** So I just decided to trust her  
instincts here too.

<!-- uid=1860058:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, thanks, Kirito.  
I'm glad I trusted mine and talked  
to them too.

<!-- uid=1860058:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** I guess every parent and child has  
arguments like this eventually.

<!-- uid=1860058:11:1 -->

**Leafa:** Lucky for our family that my  
brother got his rebellious phase  
out of the way early on.

<!-- uid=1860058:12:1 -->

**Leafa:** Of course, he also ran away for  
like two years, so...

<!-- uid=1860058:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** You know as well as I do I wasn't  
rebelling against anything OR  
running away during that time...

<!-- uid=1860058:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** In my case, I ended up fighting  
with my parents even after I'd been  
away for two years.

<!-- uid=1860058:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** But these days we get along really  
well, so maybe that was a good  
thing.

<!-- uid=1860058:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hehe, that's great! I guess it's  
true what they say: after rain  
comes fair weather!

<!-- uid=1860058:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah!

<!-- uid=1860058:18:1 -->


## Story 1860061 · \[Twilight Kiss\] Alice Lv.10

Character Story

**Eugeo:** So, Kirito, now that it's been a  
while since we've come to this  
sleeping-together world...

<!-- uid=1860061:1:1 -->

**Eugeo:** How's your STP looking?

<!-- uid=1860061:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** STP... That's short for the  
Sleeping Together Points we need  
to leave this world, right?

<!-- uid=1860061:3:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Uh, yeah, that's right. You're the  
one who told me about them in  
the first place, remember?

<!-- uid=1860061:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Let me open up my window...  
There, that's how much I've got.  
What about you, Eugeo?

<!-- uid=1860061:5:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I've still only got this much.  
You really are amazing, Kirito.

<!-- uid=1860061:6:1 -->

**Eugeo:** You're sleeping with lots of  
people to get your STP this  
high. Especially girls.

<!-- uid=1860061:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** H-Hey, don't say it like that.  
It makes me sound bad.

<!-- uid=1860061:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's not like I'm forcing anyone  
to sleep with me. I'm just doing  
what I have to so we can leave...

<!-- uid=1860061:9:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Ha ha, I know. I also know that  
you're mostly just sleeping with  
projections of people we know.

<!-- uid=1860061:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** True... Oh, I've also slept with  
Alice and one of those girls we  
got to know here, Ronie.

<!-- uid=1860061:11:1 -->

**Eugeo:** What about the other girl, Tiese?  
Couldn't you sleep with her too?

<!-- uid=1860061:12:1 -->

**Eugeo:** We need to help her raise her STP  
as well, after all.

<!-- uid=1860061:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Her? I don't know... In her case,  
I feel like you might be a better  
match than me...

<!-- uid=1860061:14:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Huh? What do you mean?

<!-- uid=1860061:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Y-You know, on second thought,never mind.

<!-- uid=1860061:16:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...?

<!-- uid=1860061:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Anyway, where did Alice go?

<!-- uid=1860061:18:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Oh, she stepped out. Said she  
wasn't in the mood right now.

<!-- uid=1860061:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Guess she probably didn't go  
looking for potential sleeping-  
together partners then...

<!-- uid=1860061:20:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I just hope nobody provokes her  
by asking her to sleep with them  
again...

<!-- uid=1860061:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha, yeah...

<!-- uid=1860061:22:1 -->


## Story 1860063 · \[Twilight Kiss\] Alice Lv.30

Character Story

**Alice:** \*sigh\*... I still cannot quite  
believe this is happening...

<!-- uid=1860063:1:1 -->

## Story 1860081 · \[Photon Voice Fluttering in the Wind\] Seven Lv.10

**Silica:** Yeah, they kept getting badgered  
with questions about how those

<!-- uid=1860081:18:1 -->

although I don't think they

<!-- uid=1860081:20:1 -->

else could copy what they did.

**Silica:** Hehe, that's true.

<!-- uid=1860081:22:1 -->

<!-- uid=1860128:11:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Nghh, this aroma... I'm so full,

stop myself from having more!

<!-- uid=1860128:12:1 -->

**Alice:** Nor I... This one is delicious as

<!-- uid=1860128:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** This is like watching a huge ramen

different places in one go...

**Asuna:** Hehe, it just goes to show how

## Story 1860133 · \[Red-Winged Goddess\] Yuuki Lv.30

Character Story

**Yuuki:** Hya!

<!-- uid=1860133:1:1 -->

**Purgatory Beasts:** Rrragh!

<!-- uid=1860133:2:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Now, Makoto!

<!-- uid=1860133:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** Kiyaaah!

<!-- uid=1860133:4:1 -->

**Purgatory Beasts:** Graaaw...!

<!-- uid=1860133:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wow, they just took down another  
one like it was nothing...

<!-- uid=1860133:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** That enemy type gave us so much  
trouble when we first started out  
here, too...

<!-- uid=1860133:7:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hehehe, how do you like them  
apples?!

<!-- uid=1860133:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** Say, real-world experience helps

you do martial arts too, Yuuki?

<!-- uid=1860133:9:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Uh, no, I haven't been able to get

<!-- uid=1860133:10:1 -->

**Yuuki:** But I don't think anyone can beat

<!-- uid=1860133:11:1 -->

**Yuuki:** So I think my quick reflexes just  
come from being used to VR, after  
all the time I've spent here.

<!-- uid=1860133:12:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh yeah, you did say you've been  
to all sorts of different worlds,

<!-- uid=1860133:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** I've still only been to ALO and  
this Purgatory world that's still  
in development.

<!-- uid=1860133:14:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Well, there was one where you got  
to be a bug.

<!-- uid=1860133:15:1 -->

**Yuuki:** And an old-school Japanese one  
that brought Japanese myths and  
monsters to life.

<!-- uid=1860133:16:1 -->

**Makoto:** A Japanese one, huh...  
That sounds like fun.

<!-- uid=1860133:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Since you like the Shinsengumi,  
I bet you'd feel right at home in  
Asuka Empire, Makoto.

<!-- uid=1860133:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh, so she was talking about  
Asuka Empire!

<!-- uid=1860133:19:1 -->

**Makoto:** I think I might've told you this  
before, but I'm actually borrowing  
this AmuSphere from my father.

<!-- uid=1860133:20:1 -->

**Makoto:** He's always been into Japanese  
period dramas and the Shinsengumi  
and the like, so the whole reason

<!-- uid=1860133:21:1 -->

**Makoto:** he bought it in the first place  
was to try Asuka Empire out.

<!-- uid=1860133:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Aha, so that's why he had it.  
But, isn't your father kind of...

<!-- uid=1860133:23:1 -->

**Makoto:** Yeah, he only likes historically  
accurate representations of old  
Japan, so he didn't care for it.

<!-- uid=1860133:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** I can see why. Asuka Empire may be  
based on old Japan, but it's also  
a fantasy game.

<!-- uid=1860133:25:1 -->

**Makoto:** That kind of thing wouldn't bother  
me, though. I'd like to try it  
myself sometime.

<!-- uid=1860133:26:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Forget sometime! Why don't we just  
go there right now?

<!-- uid=1860133:27:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I mean, it's easy to go between  
different Seed Nexus games just  
by converting your data.

<!-- uid=1860133:28:1 -->

**Makoto:** I'm sure it does, but, uh, that's  
only true if your schedule  
permits...

<!-- uid=1860133:29:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Ohhh, right. Man, grown-ups sure  
have it rough, huh?

<!-- uid=1860133:30:1 -->

**Makoto:** \*weary sigh\*

<!-- uid=1860133:31:1 -->


## Story 1860135 · \[Red-Winged Goddess\] Yuuki Lv.50

Character Story

**Makoto:** What other sorts of games are  
there?

<!-- uid=1860135:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Of the ones currently in service,  
I'd say GGO is pretty popular.

<!-- uid=1860135:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, GGO stands for Gun Gale  
Online. It's a shooting game where  
you go around fighting with guns

<!-- uid=1860135:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** in a future where the earth has  
been all but destroyed from war.

<!-- uid=1860135:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's got monsters too, but I'd say  
its main focus is on PvP gunplay.

<!-- uid=1860135:5:1 -->

**Makoto:** That sounds...kind of like a  
Hollywood blockbuster?

<!-- uid=1860135:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Pretty much. It IS made and  
operated by an American developer.

<!-- uid=1860135:7:1 -->

**Makoto:** I see... I don't think I could be  
much help in that one, since  
I only know how to use swords.

<!-- uid=1860135:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ahaha. Well, as it turns out, GGO  
DOES have a sword, and Kirito's  
done some amazing things with it.

<!-- uid=1860135:9:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh? Like what?

<!-- uid=1860135:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Like cutting down bullets before  
they can hit him.

<!-- uid=1860135:11:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wow, really? I mean, these  
bullets are traveling at  
real-world speeds, right?

<!-- uid=1860135:12:1 -->

**Makoto:** It really is like a hybrid between  
an action movie and a game...

<!-- uid=1860135:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, I should warn you that  
Kirito's pretty much the only one  
who can do that.

<!-- uid=1860135:14:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hehe, I see. In that case, as  
something of a swordfighter  
myself, I'll have to see if I can

<!-- uid=1860135:15:1 -->

**Makoto:** cut down bullets too if I ever  
decide to dive into GGO.

<!-- uid=1860135:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** You bet. I'd be glad to teach you  
how to do it.

<!-- uid=1860135:17:1 -->

**Makoto:** Thanks, Kirito.

<!-- uid=1860135:18:1 -->


## Story 1860137 · \[Red-Winged Goddess\] Yuuki Lv.70

Character Story

**Makoto:** Hyaaah!

<!-- uid=1860137:1:1 -->

**Purgatory Beasts:** Screee!

<!-- uid=1860137:2:1 -->

**Makoto:** Yuuki! Finish it!

<!-- uid=1860137:3:1 -->

**Yuuki:** On it!

<!-- uid=1860137:4:1 -->

**Purgatory Beasts:** Graaawr!

<!-- uid=1860137:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** I-I can't believe they got another  
tough enemy all by themselves...

<!-- uid=1860137:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Maybe it's time to admit when  
you're beat, Kirito. They're just  
more...intuitive about this.

<!-- uid=1860137:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** But that's not us. We're more the  
analytical, trial-and-error,  
blood-sweat-and-tears types.

<!-- uid=1860137:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** And that's the type of person who  
comes out on top in the end,  
in my opinion.

<!-- uid=1860137:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Haha... Guess I'll take that as  
a compliment.

<!-- uid=1860137:10:1 -->

**Makoto:** Anyway, getting back on track,  
I had no idea there were so many  
kinds of games out there.

<!-- uid=1860137:11:1 -->

**Makoto:** And not just VRMMOs. There's  
also a bunch that you play on an  
old-fashioned TV...

<!-- uid=1860137:12:1 -->

**Makoto:** Honestly, I don't know how you  
keep them all straight when you're  
switching between so many.

<!-- uid=1860137:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Haha, true, it's not always easy,  
especially since there's a lot of  
muscle memory involved.

<!-- uid=1860137:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** I still sometimes get the urge to  
literally spread my wings even  
when I'm not playing ALO.

<!-- uid=1860137:15:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hehe, that goes for me too.

<!-- uid=1860137:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Me, I sometimes find myself trying  
to use dual-wielding even when  
I don't have help from the system.

<!-- uid=1860137:17:1 -->

**Makoto:** Dual-wielding?

<!-- uid=1860137:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, uh... That was a skill I used  
to have in a game I played even  
before ALO.

<!-- uid=1860137:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sometimes I'll still try to use it  
automatically before remembering  
it isn't treated as a skill now.

<!-- uid=1860137:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** So then I have to resort to trying  
to replicate it manually.

<!-- uid=1860137:21:1 -->

**Makoto:** So the way a game controls, and  
the things you can do, differ  
based on skills and systems, huh?

<!-- uid=1860137:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Right. And in that sense, this  
world's actions feel close to the  
scope of normal human abilities.

<!-- uid=1860137:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** In fact, if anything... I'd say  
we're pretty limited in what this  
world lets us do.

<!-- uid=1860137:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** I agree. There's definitely a hard  
limit on superhuman movements  
and actions here.

<!-- uid=1860137:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** And that makes me feel like  
I can't run as fast or jump as  
high as I should be able to.

<!-- uid=1860137:26:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Not just that, the hack and slash  
and permadeath elements all add up  
to really make you feel boxed in.

<!-- uid=1860137:27:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Humans are frail creatures.  
But that is why they will stand up  
to the angels, and defeat them.

<!-- uid=1860137:28:1 -->

**Yuuki:** That's the set-up for this place,  
and everything here adds to that  
tension... Least, I think it does?

<!-- uid=1860137:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** Haha, I'd agree with that.

<!-- uid=1860137:30:1 -->


## Story 1860138 · \[Red-Winged Goddess\] Yuuki Lv.80

Character Story

**Kirito:** You know, when you think about it,  
it's striking just how different  
VRMMOs can be from each other.

<!-- uid=1860138:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yuuki, you've played more of them  
than anyone. Do you ever find  
yourself getting them mixed up?

<!-- uid=1860138:2:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hmm, I don't really have a problem  
with trying to do things in one  
game that I used to do in another.

<!-- uid=1860138:3:1 -->

**Yuuki:** If anything, I think I might  
forget how I used to play other  
games a little too easily?

<!-- uid=1860138:4:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Then again, I guess that helps me  
to pick up new ones pretty quickly  
too. Ahaha.

<!-- uid=1860138:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, by that logic, I don't think  
there's anyone out there more  
amazing than Kirito.

<!-- uid=1860138:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh?

<!-- uid=1860138:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well sure. I mean, you know all  
about VRMMOs AND pretty much  
every other game under the sun.

<!-- uid=1860138:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** I've got my hands full just  
keeping up with ALO, but you're  
always trying new games and

<!-- uid=1860138:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** usually playing several at once,  
right? And yet, you never get the  
controls mixed up or anything.

<!-- uid=1860138:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ahaha... Well, I do try to keep  
them separate, but maybe I'm  
working my head a bit too much.

<!-- uid=1860138:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** And since I'm always overthinking  
things, I can't play intuitively,  
like Makoto and Yuuki can.

<!-- uid=1860138:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Maybe that's why I always seem to  
be one step behind them...

<!-- uid=1860138:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** You're still sore about that,  
huh?

<!-- uid=1860138:14:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hehe, either way, I'm still just  
starting out compared to the three  
of you, so I fall short in pretty

<!-- uid=1860138:15:1 -->

**Makoto:** much every way possible.  
Hopefully I can be useful as sheer  
firepower if nothing else.

<!-- uid=1860138:16:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Yeah! I'm the same type as you,  
so I know just how you feel.

<!-- uid=1860138:17:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Asuna, Kirito, if you guys keep  
calling the tactical shots, we'll  
be happy to do the grunt work!

<!-- uid=1860138:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** R-Right. I'll keep that in mind.

<!-- uid=1860138:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Okay, now seems as good a time  
as any to head to the next area.

<!-- uid=1860138:20:1 -->


## Story 1860141 · \[Innocent Mermaid\] Asuna Lv.10

Character Story

**Rain:** Okay, then I'll go first!  
I pick...this one!

<!-- uid=1860141:1:1 -->

**Rain:** It says the quest's called  
"The Cindered Dance"!  
Ooh, now I'm getting excited!

<!-- uid=1860141:2:1 -->

**Rain:** The quest to get our princess  
equipment was pretty dull, so I  
really want to have some fun here!

<!-- uid=1860141:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** If that's what you're picking...  
Hmm, which do you like better,  
Leafa?

<!-- uid=1860141:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** The quests are called  
"The Spiteful Kitchen" and  
"The Corridor-Crawlers"...

<!-- uid=1860141:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** They both seem kinda creepy in  
their own way... Hmm, which should  
I pick?

<!-- uid=1860141:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Would you mind if I took  
The Spiteful Kitchen?

<!-- uid=1860141:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** I think this is all based on the  
story of Cinderella. So this  
quest is probably...

<!-- uid=1860141:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** Well, judging by the "kitchen" in  
its title...it might require  
cooking skills?

<!-- uid=1860141:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, I think it's possible.  
That's why I thought I might be  
better suited for it.

<!-- uid=1860141:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** Okay. Then you handle that one!

<!-- uid=1860141:11:1 -->

**Leafa:** So I get... The Corridor-Crawlers?  
Alright, that works for me!

<!-- uid=1860141:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** What do you think the name means?  
The "crawling" part makes it seem  
extra-creepy...

<!-- uid=1860141:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** You're telling me... I hope there  
won't be anything too gruesome...

<!-- uid=1860141:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** I guess there might be undead  
monsters? But I don't remember  
anything like that in Cinderella.

<!-- uid=1860141:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh! Sorry, got a bit sidetracked  
with conversation there.

<!-- uid=1860141:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** Let's split up for now! Good luck,  
Leafa!

<!-- uid=1860141:17:1 -->

**Leafa:** Okay. I'll see you later!

<!-- uid=1860141:18:1 -->


## Story 1860143 · \[Innocent Mermaid\] Asuna Lv.30

Character Story

**Rain:** Hmmm?

<!-- uid=1860143:1:1 -->

**Rain:** I thought I just left the dance  
hall, but now I'm at another  
one...?

<!-- uid=1860143:2:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** There are a number of halls here.  
Are you a new princess?

<!-- uid=1860143:3:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** You'll be showing me just how good  
of a dancer you are.

<!-- uid=1860143:4:1 -->

**Rain:** I-I need to dance...?!

<!-- uid=1860143:5:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** Indeed. You've arrived at the  
ball. Do you intend on leaving  
without dancing?

<!-- uid=1860143:6:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** ...Oh? But where is your partner?  
Did you come here without one?

<!-- uid=1860143:7:1 -->

**Rain:** ...

<!-- uid=1860143:8:1 -->

**Rain:** D-Did I need to bring a guy to  
this quest?

<!-- uid=1860143:9:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** ...Did you really think a princess  
would show off her solo dance  
skills at a ball?

<!-- uid=1860143:10:1 -->

**Rain:** Oh...

<!-- uid=1860143:11:1 -->

**Rain:** Yeah, you're right... I guess  
traditional balls usually have  
women and men dancing together...

<!-- uid=1860143:12:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** For this quest, there's not any  
particular requirement for your  
partner to be of the opposite sex.

<!-- uid=1860143:13:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** You simply require someone to  
dance with, so allow me to fill  
the role.

<!-- uid=1860143:14:1 -->

**Rain:** What?!

<!-- uid=1860143:15:1 -->

**Rain:** B-But I've never danced  
properly in my life before...

<!-- uid=1860143:16:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** That won't be a problem! For I  
will draw out your natural talent  
for dance!

<!-- uid=1860143:17:1 -->

**Rain:** Wh-Why would I have something like  
that?! I told you, I've never even  
danced before in my life!

<!-- uid=1860143:18:1 -->

**Rain:** (Agh! This is NOT good! Why would  
I ever have chosen to raise a  
weird stat like dancing?!)

<!-- uid=1860143:19:1 -->

**Rain:** \*pant\*, \*pant\*, \*pant\*...

<!-- uid=1860143:20:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** ...

<!-- uid=1860143:21:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** You pass! What a talent for  
dance you have!

<!-- uid=1860143:22:1 -->

**Rain:** R-Really...? I mean, even I'm  
surprised by how I was able to  
actually dance, but...

<!-- uid=1860143:23:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** Would I lie to you? I find it hard  
to believe you have no experience  
given your fantastic footwork.

<!-- uid=1860143:24:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** It seems you've been making sure  
to work on your dancing skills.  
I'm impressed.

<!-- uid=1860143:25:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** That, or... Your choice of dress  
was well-suited for this trial.

<!-- uid=1860143:26:1 -->

**Rain:** Ah...!

<!-- uid=1860143:27:1 -->

**Dancing Queen:** Now go, my beautiful princess!  
Overcome the other challenges and  
find your prince!

<!-- uid=1860143:28:1 -->

**Rain:** Wow! She was right! This dress  
buffs your dancing skills!

<!-- uid=1860143:29:1 -->

**Rain:** That's Belle's dress for you!  
I guess the dance scenes are a big  
part of Beauty and the Beast.

<!-- uid=1860143:30:1 -->

**Rain:** Anyway, that's one down! I just  
wonder if Asuna and Leafa are  
doing okay...

<!-- uid=1860143:31:1 -->


## Story 1860145 · \[Innocent Mermaid\] Asuna Lv.50

Character Story

**Asuna:** ...So this does take place in  
a kitchen.

<!-- uid=1860145:1:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** You're late!! Hurry up and get  
to work!!

<!-- uid=1860145:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Excuse me...?

<!-- uid=1860145:3:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Don't just stand there! All the  
ingredients have already been  
prepared, so make what you want!

<!-- uid=1860145:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Y-You want me to cook?

<!-- uid=1860145:5:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Hah! What else do you expect to  
do in a kitchen?!

<!-- uid=1860145:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, I guess I did kind of  
expect this, but...

<!-- uid=1860145:7:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Did you? Then good! So come on  
now, chop chop!

<!-- uid=1860145:8:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** But, well... I don't think I'll  
be getting my hopes too high.

<!-- uid=1860145:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Grr...

<!-- uid=1860145:10:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Oh? You seem displeased. Why don't

<!-- uid=1860145:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hm? Okay, sure...  
Let's see what kind of ingredients  
I have... Ah!

<!-- uid=1860145:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's...all fish?!

<!-- uid=1860145:13:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** That's right! What an unlucky  
turn, my Little Mermaid!

<!-- uid=1860145:14:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Seems your choice of dress was  
a poor one. I think you've made  
things quite hard for yourself.

<!-- uid=1860145:15:1 -->

**Kitchen Queen:** Well, just hurry it up. Get your  
inevitable failure over and done

## Story 1860163 · \[Is This Love\] Sortiliena Lv.30

Character Story

**Tiese:** Oh, but I thought you weren't so

as well.

<!-- uid=1860163:14:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** They found the best parts of  
varied styles and made them their  
own. The sign of a good swordsman.

<!-- uid=1860163:15:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** What about you two? How have you  
trained in swordsmanship?

<!-- uid=1860163:16:1 -->

**Ronie:** ...E-Erm.

<!-- uid=1860163:17:1 -->

**Tiese:** We practice, but we're still total  
amateurs...

<!-- uid=1860163:18:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...Hm, I see. If you don't mind  
me being your instructor, I could  
teach you the basics some time.

<!-- uid=1860163:19:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I'd like you to feel even a trace  
of your beloved seniors from my  
own sword, if possible.

<!-- uid=1860163:20:1 -->

<!-- uid=1860163:21:1 -->


## Story 1860165 · \[Is This Love\] Sortiliena Lv.50

Character Story

**Sortiliena:** ...Phew.

<!-- uid=1860165:1:1 -->

**Alice:** You're awfully talkative, Lady  
Sortiliena.

<!-- uid=1860165:2:1 -->

**Alice:** I was convinced that you were  
more of the quiet type.

<!-- uid=1860165:3:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...My apologies, Lady Alice.  
Did I upset you?

<!-- uid=1860165:4:1 -->

**Alice:** No, not at all. I don't mean to  
sound disapproving.

<!-- uid=1860165:5:1 -->

**Alice:** It's just that you three seemed to  
be having quite a lot of fun on  
your own.

<!-- uid=1860165:6:1 -->

**Alice:** So I thought...that maybe a  
warning might be called for.

<!-- uid=1860165:7:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...I apologize. I was, after all,  
speaking to my former attendant's  
attendant, as well as her friend.

<!-- uid=1860165:8:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** To me, they are in a way like  
my very own grandchildren.

<!-- uid=1860165:9:1 -->

**Alice:** Grandchildren, you say...

<!-- uid=1860165:10:1 -->

**Alice:** Yes, I've heard that when women  
become mothers, they then dote on  
the children of their children.

<!-- uid=1860165:11:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** That's exactly right.

<!-- uid=1860165:12:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Of course, I don't have any  
children or grandchildren of my  
own, but juniors are nice to have.

<!-- uid=1860165:13:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** When you see them grow, you feel  
as happy as if you'd grown  
yourself.

<!-- uid=1860165:14:1 -->

**Alice:** Did you feel that way about  
Kirito, too?

<!-- uid=1860165:15:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Yes. I'm very proud of Kirito.

<!-- uid=1860165:16:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I was able to be his mentor, teach  
him at least a few things, and be  
a good influence on him...

<!-- uid=1860165:17:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** The fact I could do that moves me  
from the bottom of my heart.

<!-- uid=1860165:18:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** It may sound strange...but you can  
even say that it's thanks to him  
that I took first seat.

<!-- uid=1860165:19:1 -->

**Alice:** ...So you learned Aincrad style  
as well, Lady Sortiliena?

<!-- uid=1860165:20:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** No, I wouldn't say that.  
What Kirito gave me...

<!-- uid=1860165:21:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...Was the strong heart of one  
who is ready for battle.

<!-- uid=1860165:22:1 -->

**Alice:** Your heart...

<!-- uid=1860165:23:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Yes. He showed me what that looked  
like through his own actions.

<!-- uid=1860165:24:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Grit, bravery...and how to ready  
yourself to face opponents more  
powerful than you.

<!-- uid=1860165:25:1 -->


## Story 1860167 · \[Is This Love\] Sortiliena Lv.70

Character Story

**Alice:** ...It seems you have some very  
good memories of Kirito, Lady  
Sortiliena.

<!-- uid=1860167:1:1 -->

**Alice:** (They spent a very long time  
together, too... Longer than I  
spent with him, of course...)

<!-- uid=1860167:2:1 -->

**Alice:** (Kirito and I spent one night and  
about six months together... They  
were such valuable days, but...)

<!-- uid=1860167:3:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Yes, which is why I have such a  
strong interest myself in how  
everyone spent time with him.

<!-- uid=1860167:4:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I'm interested in the experiences  
you, Ronie, and Lady Asuna all  
shared with him.

**Alice:** Asuna...

<!-- uid=1860167:6:1 -->

**Alice:** ...I'm very unhappy that she's  
not here with us.

<!-- uid=1860167:7:1 -->

**Alice:** There are so many stories I  
haven't got to hear from her yet,  
after all...

<!-- uid=1860167:8:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Yes, that is true... And Lady  
Asuna seems to have quite a lot  
of them...

<!-- uid=1860167:9:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...What a mysterious individual.

the same time...

<!-- uid=1860167:10:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** And she came from another world  
in order to save Kirito.

<!-- uid=1860167:11:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** It made me feel all over again  
just how much of an influence  
Kirito has...

<!-- uid=1860167:12:1 -->

**Alice:** ...I agree with you there.

<!-- uid=1860167:13:1 -->

**Alice:** That must be why Asuna bothered  
coming all the way to this world.

<!-- uid=1860167:14:1 -->

**Alice:** Kirito's not the kind of man who  
can be allowed to stay asleep  
forever.

<!-- uid=1860167:15:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...You're very right about that.

<!-- uid=1860167:16:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** We have to figure out a way to

<!-- uid=1860167:17:1 -->


## Story 1860168 · \[Is This Love\] Sortiliena Lv.80

Character Story

**Alice:** Having this conversation with you  
only makes Asuna's absence  
that much more frustrating.

<!-- uid=1860168:1:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Oh, speaking of which...

<!-- uid=1860168:2:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I understand you fought Lady Asuna  
immediately after she manifested  
herself here?

**Alice:** Yes, I did.

<!-- uid=1860168:4:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...What did you think of Lady  
Asuna's skills with a sword?

<!-- uid=1860168:5:1 -->

**Alice:** ...Something did feel a little  
strange to me.

<!-- uid=1860168:6:1 -->

**Alice:** Most notable was her sword's  
frighteningly quick speed.

<!-- uid=1860168:7:1 -->

**Alice:** Continuous attacks... Almost as if  
she were attacking me with  
multiple swords at once.

<!-- uid=1860168:8:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Multiple swords...?

<!-- uid=1860168:9:1 -->

**Alice:** Yes. That's just how fast her

<!-- uid=1860168:10:1 -->

**Alice:** Fast enough to make a single slim

blades...

<!-- uid=1860168:11:1 -->

**Alice:** (...I would've been able to settle  
the score with her if she was here  
now...)

<!-- uid=1860168:12:1 -->

**Alice:** (That must be why I feel so  
indescribably unfulfilled.)

<!-- uid=1860168:13:1 -->

**Alice:** (I don't exactly see Ronie or Lady

<!-- uid=1860168:14:1 -->

**Alice:** (If anything, I feel a kind of  
closeness to them. But her...  
As far as Asuna is concerned?)

<!-- uid=1860168:15:1 -->

**Alice:** (I feel the burning desire to  
never lose to her. A strong sense  
of rivalry...)

<!-- uid=1860168:16:1 -->

**Alice:** ...This Bridal Contest would have

battle, too.

<!-- uid=1860168:17:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...Lady Alice?

<!-- uid=1860168:18:1 -->

**Alice:** Ah...! Excuse me. Please, pay

<!-- uid=1860168:19:1 -->

**Alice:** (I guess my fight with her comes

world," I suppose...?)

## Story 1860171 · \[Beach Beauty\] Alice Lv.10

Character Story

**Kirito:** Okay, everyone. Get on the raft.

<!-- uid=1860171:1:1 -->

as we fight off the bats...

nearly bothered by it.

**Kirito:** I kind of know what you mean.

**Kirito:** I know we failed on our first try,  
but we've been able to breeze  
through ever since our second.

interesting if it'd been a little  
harder.

**Liz:** You two are absolutely right...

## Story 1860173 · \[Beach Beauty\] Alice Lv.30

Character Story

**Alice:** Hold on, Lisbeth. There's an

morbid or something?

Although "morbid" might be going a  
bit too far...

**Alice:** Yes, but that isn't the problem.  
What I want to say...is that I'm  
unsure if we'll have the time.

**Liz:** How so?

<!-- uid=1860173:5:3 -->

**Alice:** We'll need to go straight to  
opening the treasure chest at the  
second beach once we arrive.

<!-- uid=1860173:6:1 -->

**Alice:** There's even a time limit at play  
there as well, is there not?

<!-- uid=1860173:7:1 -->

**Liz:** Gah! A flaw in my plan...!

<!-- uid=1860173:8:1 -->

**Alice:** With the combination of these two  
parts, there is not much time to

<!-- uid=1860173:9:1 -->

**Silica:** Y-You're right...! We'd have to  
remember how many bats we took out  
until the very end!

<!-- uid=1860173:10:1 -->

**Silica:** If we had to play beach flags and  
run to the treasure chest as soon  
as the raft ride is over...

<!-- uid=1860173:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...It feels like it'd be too much  
to keep track of.

<!-- uid=1860173:12:1 -->

<!-- uid=1860173:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Isn't that kind of thing your  
specialty, Yui?

<!-- uid=1860173:14:1 -->

<!-- uid=1860173:15:1 -->

**Yui:** Yes, of course I could do that!

<!-- uid=1860173:16:1 -->

**Yui:** Running a simple program will be

<!-- uid=1860173:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** That seems like the most fair and

<!-- uid=1860173:18:1 -->

**Yui:** Yes! I won't even play favorites

<!-- uid=1860173:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...That's my daughter, honest

<!-- uid=1860173:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** You heard her. Yui can do all

<!-- uid=1860173:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** All we have to do is focus on  
our bat targets!  
Thoughts, Alice?

<!-- uid=1860173:22:1 -->

**Alice:** Ah...!

<!-- uid=1860173:23:1 -->

**Alice:** Alright, then. In that case...

<!-- uid=1860173:24:1 -->


## Story 1860175 · \[Beach Beauty\] Alice Lv.50

Character Story

## Story 1860177 · \[Beach Beauty\] Alice Lv.70

## Story 1860178 · \[Beach Beauty\] Alice Lv.80

Character Story

**Kirito:** Tch...!

**Kirito:** Ah, great... My numbers are still

**Kirito:** Argh...!

fault for not being around at an  
important time like this.

**Kirito:** ...Wait, were you listening to

**Yui:** I told you I'd be running a

**Kirito:** ...You'll keep quiet about this,

## Story 1860203 · \[Bringing Joyful Info\] Argo Lv.30

Character Story

**Asuna:** That said, it's nothing too big.

<!-- uid=1860203:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** It was actually December 24th when  
we bought a log cabin again in the  
new Aincrad.

<!-- uid=1860203:2:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Wow! I didn't know that!

<!-- uid=1860203:3:1 -->

**Argo:** Oh...?

<!-- uid=1860203:4:1 -->

**Argo:** We're talkin' the infamous log  
cabin, right?

<!-- uid=1860203:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...Argo, why are you making it

being so ridiculous? I'm honestly

<!-- uid=1860203:12:1 -->

**Argo:** ?!

<!-- uid=1860203:15:1 -->

## Story 1860205 · \[Bringing Joyful Info\] Argo Lv.50

Character Story

**Yuuki:** A-A tornado! Those exist here?!

<!-- uid=1860205:21:1 -->

## Story 1860218 · \[Lucky Fortune\] Asuna Lv.80

Character Story

**Asuna:** Leafa, Liz, and Silica's outfits

<!-- uid=1860218:9:1 -->

## Story 1860231 · \[Melty Heart\] Tiese Lv.10

Character Story

**Ronie:** We made it back to Sortiliena's

all...

**Ronie:** \*sigh\*... And I never got to tell

**Tiese:** That's odd... I'd imagine she's

<!-- uid=1860231:8:1 -->

**Tiese:** Still, we're finally back and we

<!-- uid=1860231:9:1 -->

**Tiese:** Tidying up the mess we made!

<!-- uid=1860231:11:1 -->

**Ronie:** Ugh...

<!-- uid=1860231:12:1 -->

**Ronie:** I love cooking, but hate the

**Ronie:** I guess so...

<!-- uid=1860231:17:1 -->


## Story 1860233 · \[Melty Heart\] Tiese Lv.30

Character Story

**Ronie:** And that takes care of that...

<!-- uid=1860233:1:1 -->

**Ronie:** Hey, Tiese!

<!-- uid=1860233:2:1 -->

**Ronie:** We bought ingredients for how  
many people?

<!-- uid=1860233:3:1 -->

**Tiese:** Uh...

<!-- uid=1860233:4:1 -->

**Tiese:** Enough for two people with  
a little to spare. Why?

<!-- uid=1860233:5:1 -->

**Ronie:** Well, there seems to be a lot left  
over...

<!-- uid=1860233:6:1 -->

**Tiese:** No way! But Sortiliena made some  
chocolates too.

<!-- uid=1860233:7:1 -->

**Tiese:** So there really shouldn't be  
anything left.

<!-- uid=1860233:8:1 -->

**Ronie:** Oh, I think I know why.

<!-- uid=1860233:9:1 -->

**Ronie:** Sortiliena must've already had  
some ingredients for making  
chocolate in her kitchen.

<!-- uid=1860233:10:1 -->

**Ronie:** I think she used her own  
ingredients today, which explains  
why we have some left over.

<!-- uid=1860233:11:1 -->

**Tiese:** I see. We didn't waste anything,  
so I guess that's the extra stuff  
we bought.

<!-- uid=1860233:12:1 -->

**Tiese:** Hmm, what to do...? We can't take  
it back to the academy, but  
throwing it away would be a waste.

<!-- uid=1860233:13:1 -->

**Ronie:** You said it...

<!-- uid=1860233:14:1 -->

**Tiese:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=1860233:15:1 -->

**Tiese:** I know! How about we use them up  
and try making something else?

<!-- uid=1860233:16:1 -->

**Ronie:** You want to cook again? For who?

<!-- uid=1860233:17:1 -->

**Tiese:** Isn't it obvious?

<!-- uid=1860233:18:1 -->

**Tiese:** For ourselves!

<!-- uid=1860233:19:1 -->


## Story 1860235 · \[Melty Heart\] Tiese Lv.50

Character Story

**Ronie:** F-For ourselves?

<!-- uid=1860235:1:1 -->

**Tiese:** Yep! I mean, when do we ever get  
to eat homemade sweets?

<!-- uid=1860235:2:1 -->

**Tiese:** Most people make them to give to  
other people, and we're not often  
on the receiving end.

<!-- uid=1860235:3:1 -->

**Ronie:** I guess that's true...

<!-- uid=1860235:4:1 -->

**Ronie:** But it just seems like a weird  
thing to do, you know?

<!-- uid=1860235:5:1 -->

**Tiese:** Yeah, and that's exactly why it  
will be fun!

<!-- uid=1860235:6:1 -->

**Tiese:** We worked hard today, so we should  
allow ourselves a little tasty  
treat to celebrate!

<!-- uid=1860235:7:1 -->

**Ronie:** O-Oh, right...

<!-- uid=1860235:8:1 -->

**Ronie:** This feels like such a luxury...

<!-- uid=1860235:9:1 -->

**Tiese:** Because it's so rare that we  
get to do this, after all...

<!-- uid=1860235:10:1 -->

**Tiese:** But think about it this way. You  
know how stressful it was to cook  
for Kirito and Eugeo, right?

<!-- uid=1860235:11:1 -->

**Ronie:** I mean, it was fun and I'd happily  
do it again, but...

<!-- uid=1860235:12:1 -->

**Ronie:** I constantly felt under pressure  
to not mess up...

<!-- uid=1860235:13:1 -->

**Tiese:** It was serious cooking, after all.

<!-- uid=1860235:14:1 -->

**Ronie:** Right! We couldn't afford to just  
play around!

<!-- uid=1860235:15:1 -->

**Ronie:** But if we're making sweets for  
ourselves... then we can have  
fun with it.

<!-- uid=1860235:16:1 -->

**Tiese:** Exactly! We can feel free to mess  
up with no consequences.

<!-- uid=1860235:17:1 -->

**Ronie:** Well... I'd rather eat something  
that tastes good, so I guess we  
can't mess it up too much.

<!-- uid=1860235:18:1 -->

**Tiese:** Y-Yeah, I know that! It's not like  
I was intending to!

<!-- uid=1860235:19:1 -->

**Ronie:** Hee hee, really? I can imagine you  
losing motivation as soon as Eugeo  
is out of the picture.

<!-- uid=1860235:20:1 -->

**Tiese:** I-I could say the same about you  
and Kirito!

<!-- uid=1860235:21:1 -->

**Ronie:** Eep!

<!-- uid=1860235:22:1 -->

**Ronie:** A-Anyway, we're doing this, right?  
What to make, what to make...?

<!-- uid=1860235:23:1 -->

**Tiese:** It's pretty obvious how hard  
you're trying to change the  
subject...

<!-- uid=1860235:24:1 -->

**Ronie:** Ugh, wh-who cares?! Forget the  
conversation, let's cook!

<!-- uid=1860235:25:1 -->


## Story 1860237 · \[Melty Heart\] Tiese Lv.70

Character Story

**Tiese:** ...

**Tiese:** I've just about finished too!

<!-- uid=1860238:2:1 -->

**Ronie:** Right, on the count of three,  
we show each other, okay?

<!-- uid=1860238:3:1 -->

**Tiese:** Sounds good to me! Hehe, prepare  
to be surprised!

<!-- uid=1860238:4:1 -->

**Ronie:** You sure sound confident, Tiese.

<!-- uid=1860238:5:1 -->

**Tiese:** Of course! It went really well  
thanks to the pressure being off!

<!-- uid=1860238:6:1 -->

**Ronie:** Mine did too! It was really fun to  
get a chance to make something  
for you without any stress.

<!-- uid=1860238:7:1 -->

**Tiese:** Ronie, don't talk as if this is  
over!

<!-- uid=1860238:8:1 -->

**Tiese:** We've yet to eat our creations!  
They're sweets, not paintings!

<!-- uid=1860238:9:1 -->

**Ronie:** Oh yeah, right. Okay, here we go.  
Three, two, one...

<!-- uid=1860238:10:1 -->

**Ronie:** Ta-da! I made you an apple pie!  
We had lots of apples left over,  
after all.

<!-- uid=1860238:11:1 -->

**Tiese:** And I made you a walnut cake!  
Since a certain someone bought  
walnuts and didn't even use them!

<!-- uid=1860238:12:1 -->

**Ronie:** Ah... I-I completely forgot.  
Did I even buy walnuts?

<!-- uid=1860238:13:1 -->

**Tiese:** How have you forgotten already...?  
Hm? How many apples did you use  
to make that pie?

<!-- uid=1860238:14:1 -->

**Tiese:** I mean, that's a ton. The pie's  
packed full of them...

<!-- uid=1860238:15:1 -->

**Ronie:** I told you not to buy so many,  
but you still did... Apples and  
chocolate don't go together well.

<!-- uid=1860238:16:1 -->

**Tiese:** ...Oh yeah, right. But they were  
cheap, so I kind of went  
overboard...

<!-- uid=1860238:17:1 -->

**Ronie:** Hehehehe... Anyway, why don't we  
dig in?

<!-- uid=1860238:18:1 -->

**Tiese:** Funny to think we used up the  
ingredients the other person  
didn't get to use.

<!-- uid=1860238:19:1 -->

**Tiese:** Yeah, I wish we'd been able to  
show this much consideration  
for Kirito and Eugeo...

<!-- uid=1860238:20:1 -->

**Ronie:** Aw, Tiese, don't bring down the  
mood like that...

<!-- uid=1860238:21:1 -->

**Tiese:** Well, I guess we can focus on  
doing better next time.

<!-- uid=1860238:22:1 -->

**Ronie:** Y-Yeah... That's true!

<!-- uid=1860238:23:1 -->

**Tiese:** But first, time to eat! We can't  
forget to show our gratitude  
to each other!

<!-- uid=1860238:24:1 -->

## Story 1860251 · \[Healing Caretaker Maid\] Asuna Lv.10

Character Story

**Asuna:** Hmm. You know, now that I think  
about it...

<!-- uid=1860251:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** We've had a lot more chances to  
wear maid outfits than most  
people, haven't we?

<!-- uid=1860251:2:1 -->

**Silica:** Now that you mention it, we really  
have. It almost feels like a  
cosplay staple for us by now.

<!-- uid=1860251:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Right? It's starting to seem like  
part of our routine.

<!-- uid=1860251:4:1 -->

**Silica:** Yeah. Maybe part of that for me  
is that maid outfits aren't too  
far off from my usual clothes.

<!-- uid=1860251:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe. And I like how there's so  
much variety in their designs.

<!-- uid=1860251:6:1 -->

**Silica:** Yeah! There are so many variations  
just with color alone. No two  
outfits ever look alike!

<!-- uid=1860251:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Maybe they're a staple because we  
never get tired of wearing them.

<!-- uid=1860251:8:1 -->

**Rain:** So now you two are maid outfit  
experts without actually being  
maids? What's that all about?

<!-- uid=1860251:9:1 -->

**Rain:** As an actual, real-life maid,  
there's a whole lot more I could  
say...but I'll let it go for now.

<!-- uid=1860251:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ahaha...

<!-- uid=1860251:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, I can understand how you  
feel, but I really do have a lot  
of maid-themed equipment.

<!-- uid=1860251:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Though, as you might expect,  
I can't say I have many real-life  
opportunities to wear it.

<!-- uid=1860251:13:1 -->

**Silica:** Yeah, maid outfits in games are  
one thing, but I think I'd be too  
embarrassed to wear one for real.

<!-- uid=1860251:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Right? There are so many skimpy  
equipment sets in games that we're  
all just kind of used to them...

<!-- uid=1860251:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** But wearing an outfit like that in  
real life is a different story,  
you know?

<!-- uid=1860251:16:1 -->

**Silica:** I know exactly what you mean.

<!-- uid=1860251:17:1 -->

**Rain:** Hey, come on. If you're ashamed  
to wear maid outfits in real life,  
what's that say about me?

<!-- uid=1860251:18:1 -->

**Rain:** Personally, I feel like I'm the  
epitome of chastity whenever  
I put on my maid outfit.

<!-- uid=1860251:19:1 -->


## Story 1860253 · \[Healing Caretaker Maid\] Asuna Lv.30

Character Story

**Rain:** And for the record, lots of girls  
apply to work at my cafe just  
for the uniforms!

<!-- uid=1860253:1:1 -->

**Silica:** Whoa... R-Really?

<!-- uid=1860253:2:1 -->

**Silica:** I always figured it was  
because the pay was good!

<!-- uid=1860253:3:1 -->

**Rain:** Th-That's an insult to maids  
everywhere!

<!-- uid=1860253:4:1 -->

**Silica:** W-Well, working at a maid  
cafe is a job, after all!

<!-- uid=1860253:5:1 -->

**Silica:** The salary is an important  
thing to consider!

<!-- uid=1860253:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** True. You really can't ignore  
that side of it.

<!-- uid=1860253:7:1 -->

**Rain:** Hmph. Well, I'm not gonna lie.

<!-- uid=1860253:8:1 -->

harder than you would at a normal  
cafe.

<!-- uid=1860253:9:1 -->

**Rain:** It only makes sense  
that we be appropriately  
compensated.

<!-- uid=1860253:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...Wait. Are you having money

<!-- uid=1860253:11:1 -->

**Silica:** Huh?! Wh-Where did that come from,

<!-- uid=1860253:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** I mean, you latched onto the  
financial side of the issue  
pretty quickly, so...

<!-- uid=1860253:13:1 -->

**Silica:** Do you really think I'd be here

make ends meet in real life?!

<!-- uid=1860253:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** I, um, guess you've got a point.

<!-- uid=1860253:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sorry for the weird question.  
Although now it's got me  
thinking about jobs...

<!-- uid=1860253:16:1 -->


## Story 1860255 · \[Healing Caretaker Maid\] Asuna Lv.50

Character Story

**Rain:** Hm? Are you thinking of  
getting a part-time job  
of your own, Asuna?

<!-- uid=1860255:16:1 -->


## Story 1860257 · \[Healing Caretaker Maid\] Asuna Lv.70

Character Story

**Asuna:** I'm sorry. I really do think it's  
a lovely line of work, though...

<!-- uid=1860257:1:1 -->

**Silica:** It's basically a service industry  
job, right?

<!-- uid=1860257:2:1 -->

maids.

<!-- uid=1860257:3:1 -->

any of us are there just for

<!-- uid=1860257:4:1 -->

<!-- uid=1860257:5:1 -->

up experience to shoot  
for even bigger goals?

<!-- uid=1860257:10:1 -->

<!-- uid=1860257:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...I guess people really do put  
a lot of thought into the  
choices they make.

<!-- uid=1860257:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** (Dreams for the future, huh...?)

<!-- uid=1860257:13:1 -->

**Rain:** ...Not to mention that in our  
case, we've already lost a lot  
of time we'll never get back.

<!-- uid=1860257:14:1 -->

**Asuna & Silica:** ...!

<!-- uid=1860257:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...Yeah. All the more reason to  
put serious thought into what  
we want to do with our lives.

<!-- uid=1860257:16:1 -->


## Story 1860258 · \[Healing Caretaker Maid\] Asuna Lv.80

Character Story

**Rain:** Ahaha, sorry about that. I didn't  
mean to bring you guys down.

<!-- uid=1860258:1:1 -->

## Story 1960055 · \[Treasure-Hungry Pirate Knight\] Eugeo Lv.50

Character Story

without his trusted sword, he

<!-- uid=1960055:2:1 -->

achieved somewhat with weapons

## Story 1960057 · \[Treasure-Hungry Pirate Knight\] Eugeo Lv.70

Character Story

**Liz:** Hm... Hm...

<!-- uid=1960057:1:1 -->

things straight is a good sword!

<!-- uid=1960057:3:1 -->

<!-- uid=1960057:10:1 -->

<!-- uid=1960057:12:1 -->

ice element to complement his

<!-- uid=1960057:19:1 -->

**Liz:** Alright, let's go ahead with  
giving Eugeo this sword, if that

<!-- uid=1960057:22:1 -->


## Story 1960058 · \[Treasure-Hungry Pirate Knight\] Eugeo Lv.80

Character Story

**Liz:** Er, I think we might have  
a problem.

<!-- uid=1960058:1:1 -->

**Alice:** What is it? Do you not have enough  
of the materials that you need?

<!-- uid=1960058:2:1 -->

**Liz:** Yeah. My stockpile of the most  
important part's run dry.

<!-- uid=1960058:3:1 -->

**Alice:** If you need to gather more,  
please, don't hesitate to dispatch  
me. I don't mind in the least.

<!-- uid=1960058:4:1 -->

**Alice:** I'm prepared to do whatever it  
takes, even if I must go forth  
and slay a dragon or some such.

<!-- uid=1960058:5:1 -->

**Liz:** Oh no, it's nothing that'll be  
that hard to get our hands on,  
I promise.

<!-- uid=1960058:6:1 -->

**Liz:** What I need is a Frozen Gem.

<!-- uid=1960058:7:1 -->

**Liz:** It's a quest reward, specifically  
for a quest called "The Seven  
Seaside Treasures."

<!-- uid=1960058:8:1 -->

**Liz:** Basically, it's what you get for  
completing a treasure hunting  
quest.

<!-- uid=1960058:9:1 -->

**Alice:** Treasure hunting, you say? I see.

<!-- uid=1960058:10:1 -->

**Liz:** It's not a particularly hard  
quest, but it's a real pain in the  
butt for two big reasons.

<!-- uid=1960058:11:1 -->

**Liz:** First is how there are seven  
potential rewards and the one you  
want isn't guaranteed to drop.

<!-- uid=1960058:12:1 -->

**Liz:** But it's also hard to trigger.  
It can occur on any coastline AND  
the timing is a complete mystery!

<!-- uid=1960058:13:1 -->

**Silica:** Yeesh! You mean to tell me it's  
basically a random quest? That  
IS a pain.

<!-- uid=1960058:14:1 -->

**Liz:** Yep! Between the random reward  
drops and unpredictable timing,  
it's a real stinker for sure!

<!-- uid=1960058:15:1 -->

**Silica:** Wow, talk about brutal. I don't  
envy you girls having to do it.

<!-- uid=1960058:16:1 -->

**Alice:** Pardon me for interrupting, but  
are these conditions you mention  
really that harsh in practice?

<!-- uid=1960058:17:1 -->

**Liz:** Absolutely! The randomness of  
getting it to trigger at all is  
the first major hurdle.

<!-- uid=1960058:18:1 -->

**Liz:** You have to visit coastlines  
across the globe in the hope  
you'll get the quest at all.

<!-- uid=1960058:19:1 -->

**Liz:** Not to mention, you specifically  
can't leave Midgard, right, Alice?

<!-- uid=1960058:20:1 -->

**Alice:** That is true. Otherwise I need not  
have had you two come out here to  
see me today.

<!-- uid=1960058:21:1 -->

**Liz:** Exactly. If you could visit other  
regions, then accepting the quest  
would actually be pretty easy.

<!-- uid=1960058:22:1 -->

**Liz:** But then even with that out of  
the way, there's still the issue  
of the randomized reward!

<!-- uid=1960058:23:1 -->

**Liz:** Each time you beat the quest, you  
only get one of the seven rewards.  
Now do you follow me?

<!-- uid=1960058:24:1 -->

**Alice:** Yes... Yes I do. When you put it  
like that, that does sound rather  
arduous.

<!-- uid=1960058:25:1 -->

**Liz:** To say the least. Personally, I'd  
rather we go with a different  
sword for Eugeo if it's possible.

<!-- uid=1960058:26:1 -->

**Alice:** Hm... Let me ask you this: are  
there any other swords that  
resemble the Blue Rose Sword?

<!-- uid=1960058:27:1 -->

**Liz:** Not that I can think of. When it  
comes to high-end weapons, that's  
really the only match for it.

<!-- uid=1960058:28:1 -->

**Alice:** Fair enough. In that case, I would  
prefer if we stick to this sword.  
I think it'd be best for him.

<!-- uid=1960058:29:1 -->

**Alice:** I believe that having it would  
give him more chances to  
remember our old world.

<!-- uid=1960058:30:1 -->

**Alice:** Personally, it also feels like  
fate, in a sense, that this sword  
resembles his old one so much.

<!-- uid=1960058:31:1 -->

**Liz:** All right, I hear you. If that's  
how you feel, I'm prepared to do  
what it takes to make it.

<!-- uid=1960058:32:1 -->

**Liz:** Not just as a blacksmith, but as a  
friend! You, too, Silica! We're  
grinding this quest together!

<!-- uid=1960058:33:1 -->

**Silica:** Say what? Do I really have to?!

<!-- uid=1960058:34:1 -->

**Liz:** Yep! If you didn't want to help  
out, you shouldn't have come with  
me to Midgard to kill time!

<!-- uid=1960058:35:1 -->

**Silica:** Grr... Oh, all right. I'm in.

<!-- uid=1960058:36:1 -->

**Silica:** I want Alice and Eugeo to patch  
things up as much as anyone else  
here. Let's do this!

<!-- uid=1960058:37:1 -->

**Alice:** Thank you very much, both of you.  
Your support is truly heartening!

<!-- uid=1960058:38:1 -->

**Alice:** (Now I can only pray this will  
indeed lead to Eugeo and I  
mending things at last...)

<!-- uid=1960058:39:1 -->

## Story 2260011 · \[Luminous Ornaments\] Asuna Lv.10

Character Story

**Asuna:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=2260011:1:1 -->

**Silica:** What's up, Asuna?

<!-- uid=2260011:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Look at the prices at this item  
shop, Silica...

<!-- uid=2260011:3:1 -->

**Silica:** Oh? Let's see...  
Yikes! They're so expensive!

<!-- uid=2260011:4:1 -->

**Silica:** And they even have a limit on how  
many one player can buy!

<!-- uid=2260011:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yup... And it's the same story  
at second-hand and player-run  
shops too.

<!-- uid=2260011:6:1 -->

**Silica:** What's going on?

<!-- uid=2260011:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** It looks like it's a dev team  
decision. I don't know what  
we're going to do now.

<!-- uid=2260011:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** This hits healers and buffers like  
you and me especially hard...

<!-- uid=2260011:9:1 -->

**Silica:** I know. We'll never be able to  
help everyone else out like this.

<!-- uid=2260011:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** And it's not just items. People  
who rely on gadgets are in the  
same predicament.

<!-- uid=2260011:11:1 -->

**Silica:** Oh, Asuna, look. It's an update  
message from the dev team.

<!-- uid=2260011:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Let's see... "In regards to the  
recent support item shortage..."

<!-- uid=2260011:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** We plan to release an update that  
will improve resource availability.  
Thank you for your patience.

<!-- uid=2260011:14:1 -->

**Silica:** Does that mean the NPC-run  
shops are going to go back to  
their usual prices?

<!-- uid=2260011:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Maybe. Or maybe they're planning  
on giving away lots of support  
items at an event or something?

<!-- uid=2260011:16:1 -->

**Silica:** Either way, I guess we have no  
choice but to make do with things  
as they are now.

<!-- uid=2260011:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah. We'll just have to conserve  
what we have and keep fighting.

<!-- uid=2260011:18:1 -->

between monsters and players.

MUST be chaotic if we can come in

<!-- uid=2260013:4:1 -->

did. Can you heal me up? We're  
allowed to get help from other...

<!-- uid=2260013:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...players, and I can easily make  
it up to you if I win the reward  
they're offering.

<!-- uid=2260013:6:1 -->

**Silica:** Well, uh, as it turns out...

<!-- uid=2260013:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** This one healing item is all  
we've got right now.

<!-- uid=2260013:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** Huh? What do you mean?

<!-- uid=2260013:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Haven't you heard how there's a  
major shortage of support and  
healing items right now?

<!-- uid=2260013:10:1 -->

<!-- uid=2260013:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Silica and I actually came

<!-- uid=2260013:12:1 -->

**Silica:** But so far, nothing... And now  
we've wandered into the  
battlefield for this firefight.

<!-- uid=2260013:13:1 -->

shortage, but I didn't realize  
things were this bad.

<!-- uid=2260013:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Anyway, I can still heal you,

to max you out.

<!-- uid=2260013:15:1 -->

Are you sure about this?

<!-- uid=2260013:16:1 -->

this far, there's practically no  
difference between one and none.

<!-- uid=2260013:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Asuna...

<!-- uid=2260013:18:1 -->

## Story 2260017 · \[Luminous Ornaments\] Asuna Lv.70

## Story 2260051 · \[Noble Gunner in the Wild\] Alice Lv.10

Character Story

**Alice:** Hiya!

<!-- uid=2260051:1:1 -->

**Alice:** Phew... You know, I think I  
really am more cut out  
for this.

<!-- uid=2260051:2:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Oh, were you just using a  
Photon Sword, Alice?

<!-- uid=2260051:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** I guess swords are more your  
style after all.

<!-- uid=2260051:4:1 -->

**Alice:** Y-Yes...  
Agh, were you watching me?

<!-- uid=2260051:5:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Remember what Sinon told us?  
We're too quick to rely on  
Photon Swords in a situation.

<!-- uid=2260051:6:1 -->

**Eugeo:** That's why we should focus on  
using guns and not Photon Swords  
for the time being.

<!-- uid=2260051:7:1 -->

**Alice:** My body moved on its own  
just now.

<!-- uid=2260051:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, the enemies were close.  
I think you made the right choice.

<!-- uid=2260051:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sinon really is brutal, though.  
She's putting limits on you so you  
get used to fighting in Gun Gale?

<!-- uid=2260051:10:1 -->

**Eugeo:** She's a very thorough teacher,  
though. We've learned all kinds of  
things thanks to her instruction.

<!-- uid=2260051:11:1 -->

**Alice:** Yes. I always saw her as an  
exceptional marksman in Alfheim,

<!-- uid=2260051:12:1 -->

**Alice:** and I'm sure that aim like hers  
would carry over to a mostly  
long-range-combat world like this.

<!-- uid=2260051:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Heh. Well actually, Sinon's first  
VRMMO--er, world experience  
was here in Gun Gale.

<!-- uid=2260051:14:1 -->

**Alice:** Is that so?

<!-- uid=2260051:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, she learned how to use a  
bow in Alfheim after that, which  
is why it was so easy for her.

<!-- uid=2260051:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Of course, she'd tell you that  
bows are too short-range compared  
to sniper rifles.

<!-- uid=2260051:17:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I see...

<!-- uid=2260051:18:1 -->


## Story 2260053 · \[Noble Gunner in the Wild\] Alice Lv.30

Character Story

**Alice:** If we had our swords, we'd be able  
to be more effective at  
somewhat longer ranges.

<!-- uid=2260053:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, I guess you're right.  
What was it, again...?

<!-- uid=2260053:2:1 -->

**Alice:** Release Recollection and  
Enhance Armament.

<!-- uid=2260053:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Those abilities are amazing...  
Even my Sword Skills don't  
have that kind of reach.

<!-- uid=2260053:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's like your sword turns into  
another weapon entirely.

<!-- uid=2260053:5:1 -->

**Eugeo:** But could you use those arts in  
this world...?

<!-- uid=2260053:6:1 -->

**Eugeo:** My vague impression is that they  
would be forbidden by the  
rules in this world...

<!-- uid=2260053:7:1 -->

**Alice:** Oh, well...

<!-- uid=2260053:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, I agree. There aren't any  
of what you'd call Sacred Arts  
here.

<!-- uid=2260053:9:1 -->

**Eugeo:** True... None of the magic used by  
fairies in Alfheim, either.

<!-- uid=2260053:10:1 -->

**Alice:** Yes, the only way to be healed is  
to use consumable items,  
if I recall correctly...

<!-- uid=2260053:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's right. So swords can only  
be used as swords...  
So in close combat only.

<!-- uid=2260053:12:1 -->

**Alice:** So I'll have to go back to basics  
if I want to use a sword  
in this world.

<!-- uid=2260053:13:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I'd actually like to try it out  
when you put it that way.

<!-- uid=2260053:14:1 -->

**Eugeo:** It's true that we were quick to  
rely on those big moves in Alfheim  
whenever we got in trouble.

<!-- uid=2260053:15:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Using a sword as a sword...  
It seems so obvious, but I wonder  
how I'd fare.

<!-- uid=2260053:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Why don't we give it a try, then?  
Let's do some straight-up  
sword sparring.

<!-- uid=2260053:17:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Okay! I don't know how useful  
it will be in this world,  
of course.

<!-- uid=2260053:18:1 -->

**Alice:** I'm more concerned about Sinon  
scolding us... She did tell us to  
not use swords.

<!-- uid=2260053:19:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Weren't you just doing something  
that she'd yell at you for  
anyway, Alice?

<!-- uid=2260053:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ack... I don't want her to get mad  
at me, either.

<!-- uid=2260053:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** We should come up with some kind  
of excuse to give her.

<!-- uid=2260053:22:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Y-Yes, I agree.

<!-- uid=2260053:23:1 -->

**Alice:** As do I.

<!-- uid=2260053:24:1 -->


## Story 2260055 · \[Noble Gunner in the Wild\] Alice Lv.50

Character Story

**Kirito:** No, both of you have got it wrong.

<!-- uid=2260055:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** You'll get taken out in one shot  
if they go for your forearm  
while you're in that stance.

<!-- uid=2260055:2:1 -->

**Alice:** You're saying there's something  
wrong with our grip?

<!-- uid=2260055:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. It's called "kote-uchi"  
in kendo. How you hold the sword  
is super important.

<!-- uid=2260055:4:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I see... You're right.

<!-- uid=2260055:5:1 -->

**Alice:** .........

<!-- uid=2260055:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Focus on a single point.  
Like you're aiming for a precise  
spot with the tip of your blade.

<!-- uid=2260055:7:1 -->

**Alice:** What should we do if the enemy  
tries to hide their forearms?

<!-- uid=2260055:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** You can try using a kick to create  
a diversion. Your sword isn't  
your only weapon, you know.

<!-- uid=2260055:9:1 -->

**Eugeo:** A kick...

<!-- uid=2260055:10:1 -->

**Alice:** Your explanations seem to mix  
formal swordsmanship with  
unconventional martial arts.

<!-- uid=2260055:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Er, yeah...  
I guess so?

<!-- uid=2260055:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** The formal part is kendo...  
And the freestyle part is, well...  
Aincrad-style, I guess.

<!-- uid=2260055:13:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I don't know why, but both styles  
of swordsmanship seem to come  
so easily to me.

<!-- uid=2260055:14:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Perhaps I learned them somewhere  
before I lost my memories...

<!-- uid=2260055:15:1 -->

**Alice:** While I have to say this still  
feels unnatural to me... Not being able to use Divine  
Object skills on this Photon Sword.

<!-- uid=2260055:16:1 -->

**Alice:** emulating your techniques does  
seem to be the best course of  
action.

<!-- uid=2260055:17:1 -->

they're accumulating way more EXP

<!-- uid=2260068:17:1 -->

## Story 2260077 · \[Frontline Methods\] Silica Lv.70

Character Story

**Death Gun Lookalike:** Perfect, at this rate we'll have

<!-- uid=2260077:14:1 -->
