## Story 400200101 · A Strange Campaign Quest

Event Story  
Return of the Beast Lord

**Argo:** Kii-boy. Hey, Kii-boy!

<!-- uid=400200101:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Argo? What's up?

<!-- uid=400200101:2:1 -->

**Argo:** I heard 'bout this weird campaign  
quest. Wanna check it out fer me?

<!-- uid=400200101:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** What sort of quest?  
Actually, wait.  
Why do I have to do it?

<!-- uid=400200101:4:1 -->

**Argo:** Well the thing is, this quest's  
made fer two.

<!-- uid=400200101:5:1 -->

**Argo:** And as ya know, I'm an info  
broker. I don't play well with  
others.

<!-- uid=400200101:6:1 -->

**Argo:** I'd rather not have ta party up.  
Ya get me?

<!-- uid=400200101:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** You do realize that I'm a solo  
player too, right?

<!-- uid=400200101:8:1 -->

**Argo:** Wow, lookie here! Yer still tryin'  
ta play it cool, huh?  
Why not just ask Asu, eh?

<!-- uid=400200101:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** O-Oh, uh...we did party once or  
twice, but she's the Knights of the  
Blood Oath's vice commander now.

<!-- uid=400200101:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** She doesn't have time for anything  
except beating the game.

<!-- uid=400200101:11:1 -->

**Argo:** Ya really believe that?

<!-- uid=400200101:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh...? What are you getting at?

<!-- uid=400200101:13:1 -->

**Argo:** I'm sayin' that she'll do any  
quest or anythin', period. Long as  
yer doin' the askin', anyway.

<!-- uid=400200101:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** No way, where'd you get that idea?

<!-- uid=400200101:15:1 -->

**Argo:** Forget it, clueless. I've got a  
better reason fer ya. The quest's  
boss is Floor 1's biggest baddie.

<!-- uid=400200101:16:1 -->

**Argo:** Yup, that's right. None other than  
an uber-buffed Illfang the Kobold  
Lord.

<!-- uid=400200101:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Illfang, huh...?

<!-- uid=400200101:18:1 -->

**Argo:** Asu and ya were there when he went  
down, so I thought ya'd be perfect  
fer this particular quest.

<!-- uid=400200101:19:1 -->

**Argo:** Ya get why I asked ya now?

<!-- uid=400200101:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, now it's making more sense.  
Well, I assume Asuna will say no,  
but I'll ask anyway.

<!-- uid=400200101:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** But first, give me some more info  
on this quest, okay?

<!-- uid=400200101:22:1 -->

**Argo:** Kii-boy, yer the best!  
I could kiss ya!

<!-- uid=400200101:23:1 -->


## Story 400200201 · Gathering Boar Skins

Event Story  
Return of the Beast Lord

**Kirito:** Whoa... You actually came!

<!-- uid=400200201:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** You invited me!

<!-- uid=400200201:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Y-Yeah, but I assumed you were  
too busy with your guild...

<!-- uid=400200201:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, I am, but... Um, if Argo's  
asking, I can't say no!

<!-- uid=400200201:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** So anyway, what's this quest you  
want me to help out on?

<!-- uid=400200201:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** The quest, right...  
It's a multi-stage affair.  
Looks to be fairly bulky.

<!-- uid=400200201:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's actually pretty similar to  
what we have to do to unlock a  
floor's boss.

<!-- uid=400200201:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** We'll have to do a bunch of  
smaller events first.

<!-- uid=400200201:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** That'll cause the Floor 66 event  
boss to appear.

<!-- uid=400200201:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Okay, sure. But why are we  
bothering with this quest at all?

<!-- uid=400200201:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Argo wouldn't have us doing some  
pointless side quest, right?  
There's got to be more to this.

<!-- uid=400200201:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, about that... Apparently,  
this quest just appeared on a  
floor we've already beaten.

<!-- uid=400200201:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Wait, that's it?  
A new quest on a finished floor?  
Isn't that pretty normal?

<!-- uid=400200201:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's not uncommon for quests to  
trigger events on other floors,  
but this is different.

<!-- uid=400200201:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's likely that it's a completely  
new quest. According to Argo,

<!-- uid=400200201:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** having a totally new quest pop up  
on a finished floor is almost  
unprecedented.

<!-- uid=400200201:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** If SAO's GM, Kayaba,   
is still tinkering with things,

<!-- uid=400200201:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** then I'm sure Argo's dying for  
intel about it. Why would he  
release new content now?

<!-- uid=400200201:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hmm, good point... You're right.  
It does sound suspicious.

<!-- uid=400200201:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Okay then!  
Let's go check it out.

<!-- uid=400200201:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, let's do it.

<!-- uid=400200201:21:1 -->


## Story 400200202 · Gathering Boar Skins

Event Story  
Return of the Beast Lord

**Asuna:** That was an easy one.

## Story 400300801 · A Father's Worry

**Leafa:** Yeah? What's up, Kazuto?

<!-- uid=400300801:2:1 -->

<!-- uid=400300801:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** What is it?

<!-- uid=400300801:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Didn't you think Yui was acting  
a bit weird today?

<!-- uid=400300801:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** Huh?

<!-- uid=400300801:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** O-Oh... Okay...

<!-- uid=400300801:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** Why? Did something happen?

<!-- uid=400300801:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, kinda. I can't really put  
my finger on it, but something  
about her felt...off.

<!-- uid=400300801:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** Thank you, that's very helpful.  
Yes, of course. "Something."

<!-- uid=400300801:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sarcasm noted. Sorry, I'll try  
to be more specific...

<!-- uid=400300801:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Back in SAO, Yui just kind of  
appeared in front of me and Asuna.

<!-- uid=400300801:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Then, after we helped her recover  
her memories, she disappeared...

<!-- uid=400300801:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Something about her today reminded  
me of when...when she went away.

<!-- uid=400300801:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Maybe I'm worrying over nothing,  
but I feel this icy hand gripping  
my chest when I look at her...

<!-- uid=400300801:15:1 -->

**Leafa:** Kazuto, your everyday AI doesn't  
have a shred of emotion in it.

<!-- uid=400300801:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** But Yui's different, right?

<!-- uid=400300801:17:1 -->

**Leafa:** If you think she's acting odd,

<!-- uid=400300801:19:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yui's your daughter, right?

<!-- uid=400300801:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Y-Yeah, you're right.  
Thanks, Sugu.  
I'll ask her myself.

<!-- uid=400300801:21:1 -->


## Story 400300901 · A Daughter's Feelings

Event Story  
The Fairy Daughter

**Yui:** Hi, Daddy!  
Let's have tons of fun today!

<!-- uid=400300901:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yui, can I ask you something?

<!-- uid=400300901:2:1 -->

**Yui:** Yes! What is it?

<!-- uid=400300901:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm probably just worrying too  
much, but I'm concerned about you.  
You've been acting strange lately.

<!-- uid=400300901:4:1 -->

**Yui:** Huh...?

<!-- uid=400300901:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Especially around everyone.  
Maybe I'm imagining it,  
but you seem really sad.

<!-- uid=400300901:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** If something's troubling you,  
you can tell me. Okay?

<!-- uid=400300901:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm...I'm worried that you'll go  
away again. Like when Cardinal  
thought you were a foreign object.

<!-- uid=400300901:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm...scared for you.

<!-- uid=400300901:9:1 -->

**Yui:** Hehe... Oh Daddy!  
I'm an ALO navigation pixie now!

<!-- uid=400300901:10:1 -->

**Yui:** And Daddy's private pixie, too!

<!-- uid=400300901:11:1 -->

**Yui:** I guarantee you the system won't  
delete me. And as long as you're  
in VR, I'll be by your side.

<!-- uid=400300901:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yui...

<!-- uid=400300901:13:1 -->

**Yui:** However, my ability to simulate  
emotions has remained unchanged  
from SAO.

<!-- uid=400300901:14:1 -->

**Yui:** This is...just a theory I have,  
but perhaps...

<!-- uid=400300901:15:1 -->

**Yui:** When I see everyone having fun  
together, I feel a little bit sad.

<!-- uid=400300901:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sad...?

<!-- uid=400300901:17:1 -->

**Yui:** Yes. I feel a great gap between  
me, an AI, and everyone else.  
You exist in the real world...

<!-- uid=400300901:18:1 -->

**Yui:** I think that's why I sometimes  
feel sad when I'm with all of you.

<!-- uid=400300901:19:1 -->

**Yui:** I'm sorry, Daddy...  
I didn't mean to upset you...

<!-- uid=400300901:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** No, you didn't upset me...  
Don't worry about that...

<!-- uid=400300901:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Rather, I'm sorry I didn't notice  
earlier. I'm so sorry, Yui...

<!-- uid=400300901:22:1 -->

**Yui:** Daddy...

<!-- uid=400300901:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yui, can you...turn back into a  
human right now?  
I think we both need a hug...

<!-- uid=400300901:24:1 -->

**Yui:** May I, Daddy?

<!-- uid=400300901:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yup, go ahead!

<!-- uid=400300901:27:1 -->

## Story 400600401 · Breaking the Seal: 2

Event Story  
Grand Quest of the Top Ranked

**Asuna:** But we need a plan.

<!-- uid=400600401:1:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Correct. In order to get inside

**Sakuya:** To do that, we'll have to trigger

<!-- uid=400600401:5:1 -->

<!-- uid=400600401:6:1 -->

there's a little wing-

<!-- uid=400600401:10:1 -->

leaders, and Leafa's one of the  
Top 5 Sylphs...

<!-- uid=400600401:11:1 -->

<!-- uid=400600401:14:1 -->

number of items...

<!-- uid=400600401:15:1 -->

<!-- uid=400600401:16:1 -->

**Yui:** Does that make sense?

<!-- uid=400600401:17:1 -->

**Alicia:** Sure does! Which is why I bet this  
time, ranks were assigned based on  
raw power...

<!-- uid=400600401:18:1 -->

impression on the admins.

<!-- uid=400600401:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh. Okay...

<!-- uid=400600401:20:1 -->

**Yui:** Cardinal may have also

**Kirito:** Yeah, that makes sense.

<!-- uid=400600401:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** Good point.

<!-- uid=400600401:23:1 -->

Shimmering Secret

<!-- uid=401000901:22:1 -->

<!-- uid=401000901:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well then...

## Story 401200101 · Weapons for Every Distance

To Each Their Own

**Sinon:** ...

<!-- uid=401200101:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** \*sigh\*...

**Sinon:** Easy for you to say. I was ecstatic  
when I heard the devs finally  
added new Cait Sith armor.

<!-- uid=401200101:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** But it's only for close-combat  
players. Couldn't they throw a  
bone to people like me too?

<!-- uid=401200101:5:1 -->

might be a little biased towards  
close-range weapons in ALO.

<!-- uid=401200101:6:1 -->

**Silica:** Your only options when it comes to  
ranged weapons are, what, bows  
and ballistae, right?

<!-- uid=401200101:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** Mm-hm. Although, come to think of  
it, GGO falls on the opposite end  
of that spectrum.

<!-- uid=401200101:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** Maybe it's natural for games to  
lean one way or the other based  
on how they're designed.

<!-- uid=401200101:9:1 -->

**Silica:** I remember SAO had some thrown  
weapons like knives and chakrams,  
too.

<!-- uid=401200101:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah, but that game was still  
mostly about swords. It WAS  
in the title, after all.

<!-- uid=401200101:11:1 -->

**Silica:** R-Right. You've got a point there.  
Everyone and their grandma had  
a sword.

<!-- uid=401200101:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah...

<!-- uid=401200101:13:1 -->

**Silica:** Maybe there's a silver lining. Why  
not use this as a chance to try  
out some close-range weapons?

<!-- uid=401200101:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** What?!

<!-- uid=401200101:15:1 -->

**Silica:** It's fun fighting up close and  
personal! And it feels different  
from ranged combat.

<!-- uid=401200101:16:1 -->

**Silica:** You have to constantly switch  
between attacking, defending, and  
evading. Keeps you on your toes.

<!-- uid=401200101:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** But I've only ever played ranged  
classes. I might just be a burden.

<!-- uid=401200101:18:1 -->

**Silica:** Sinon, you're worrying too much.

<!-- uid=401200101:19:1 -->

**Silica:** What's the harm in giving them  
a shot and seeing how they feel?

<!-- uid=401200101:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** I guess that's true...  
Alright, I'm in. Let's see how  
this goes.

<!-- uid=401200101:21:1 -->

## Story 401200301 · Range and Reach

Event Story  
To Each Their Own

**Sinon:** Whew...

<!-- uid=401200301:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, what do you think? I've  
taught you all the basics.

**Kirito:** But...?

Sith isn't that high, so they

<!-- uid=401200301:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** What you're looking for is  
something that can match a  
ranged weapon, isn't it?

you're not cut out for swords.

making you teach me all that.

**Sinon:** Wish I had more to show for it.

Memories of Christmas

past. As much as I hate myself for  
it, I have to live with that.

<!-- uid=401501301:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** But still, I think about it now  
and then... I had so many  
opportunities to change things...

<!-- uid=401501301:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** What if I'd convinced Keita not to  
make Sachi switch weapons? Or  
didn't back the guild house idea?

<!-- uid=401501301:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** What if I never found that stupid  
event mob? Or asked Argo to help  
bring it to half health?

<!-- uid=401501301:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** I knew Sachi never wanted to  
fight, yet I never said anything.  
I never let her know how I felt...

<!-- uid=401501301:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** I should have told Keita the  
truth, even if it hurt...  
I should have—

<!-- uid=401501301:7:1 -->

**Klein:** Kirito...

<!-- uid=401501301:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sorry, Klein. Ha ha, I guess  
I'm not over it after all...

<!-- uid=401501301:9:1 -->

**Klein:** I get it, Kirito. Those scars you  
got: you think they're healed, but  
they still hurt from time to time.

<!-- uid=401501301:10:1 -->

**Klein:** But listen... There's one thing  
I want you to know...

<!-- uid=401501301:11:1 -->

**Klein:** The way you looked after you beat  
Nicholas the Renegade... I never  
want to see you like that again.

<!-- uid=401501301:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Klein...

<!-- uid=401501301:13:1 -->

**Klein:** I don't know what your friends  
would say if they were here,  
or what they'd think of you...

<!-- uid=401501301:14:1 -->

**Klein:** But I'm gonna say this. They got  
no right to make you look like  
you did back then, got it?!

<!-- uid=401501301:15:1 -->

**Klein:** You're my friend.  
I want you to be happy.

<!-- uid=401501301:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=401501301:17:1 -->

**Klein:** And K-dawg...  
They were your friends too, right?

<!-- uid=401501301:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** They...were once, at least...

<!-- uid=401501301:19:1 -->

**Klein:** Then I'm sure they feel the same  
way I do. They don't want to see  
you like that ever again.

<!-- uid=401501301:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=401501301:21:1 -->

**Klein:** They died on this day, that's  
true. But you're not just here to  
lay flowers on their graves...

<!-- uid=401501301:22:1 -->

**Klein:** You're here to make a break from  
your past, aren't you?

<!-- uid=401501301:23:1 -->

**Klein:** A part of you died with them,  
and you're here to acknowledge  
that, and move on.

<!-- uid=401501301:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** Klein...  
Yeah, you might just be right...

<!-- uid=401501301:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** Thanks. I feel like a weight's  
been lifted off my chest here,  
ha ha...

<!-- uid=401501301:26:1 -->

**Klein:** Heh, good. Now if you've gotta  
weep, I'm here for you, man.  
I won't tell Asuna, promise.

<!-- uid=401501301:27:1 -->

**Kirito:** Nah, I think I'm good. I won't  
mope about anymore or let it  
drag me down.

<!-- uid=401501301:28:1 -->

**Klein:** Great! Heh, you look much happier  
than you did a minute ago, know  
that?

<!-- uid=401501301:29:1 -->

**Klein:** So go on! Have a jolly Christmas!  
Just do me a favor and don't try  
to slide down any chimneys.

<!-- uid=401501301:30:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha, leave off Klein. I can't  
imagine I'd make a very merry  
Santa right now.

<!-- uid=401501301:31:1 -->

**Klein:** Ha ha, I guess not.

<!-- uid=401501301:32:1 -->

Made With Love

**Rechka:** You don't look like you

**Asuna:** A-Actually, I'm a member of the  
Kni-

<!-- uid=401600501:8:1 -->

**Rechka:** So what do you want me to make for

down to this little bit of nowhere

<!-- uid=401600501:9:1 -->

**Rechka:** just to see me, there must be

**Rechka:** I've mastered every stat-buffing

**Asuna:** I wanted to see what kind of

**Rechka:** ...

## Story 401600601 · Cooking Together

Event Story  
Made With Love

**Asuna:** And now you mix in just a bit of  
sealtree extract...

**Rechka:** Ooh... I know that method.

**Rechka:** ...

## Story 401600701 · Why I Cook: Rechka's Story

Event Story  
Made With Love

**Rechka:** My husband...helped to develop  
this game...

<!-- uid=401600701:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** You mean...he works for Argus?

<!-- uid=401600701:2:1 -->

**Rechka:** No, he worked for a tiny graphics  
company they subcontracted. There  
were only a few people on staff.

<!-- uid=401600701:3:1 -->

**Rechka:** He was thrilled when they got  
the request to work on something  
as major as SAO.

<!-- uid=401600701:4:1 -->

**Rechka:** He thought their brand would  
take off if they worked on  
such an innovative title...

<!-- uid=401600701:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...

<!-- uid=401600701:6:1 -->

**Rechka:** But a few years after that, he...  
He went where I couldn't follow.

<!-- uid=401600701:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** You don't mean...?

<!-- uid=401600701:8:1 -->

**Rechka:** No, not in this death game. He  
died several months before the  
closed beta even started.

<!-- uid=401600701:9:1 -->

**Rechka:** There really were so few of them  
working on this. He must've taken  
on too much, worked too hard...

<!-- uid=401600701:10:1 -->

**Rechka:** By the time I noticed the  
strain on him, it had already  
taken its toll.

<!-- uid=401600701:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Rechka...

<!-- uid=401600701:12:1 -->

**Rechka:** Hehe, do you think me odd?  
Diving into the very game that  
stole my husband from me?

<!-- uid=401600701:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** I...

<!-- uid=401600701:14:1 -->

**Rechka:** I do. Sometimes I wonder  
what the hell I'm doing.

<!-- uid=401600701:15:1 -->

**Rechka:** But the only memories  
I have left of him...

<!-- uid=401600701:16:1 -->

**Rechka:** Are of him coming home late,  
eating the food I'd made him,  
and telling me it was delicious.

<!-- uid=401600701:17:1 -->

**Rechka:** He looked exhausted,  
but as he ate, he'd smile.  
I loved seeing that...

<!-- uid=401600701:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...

<!-- uid=401600701:19:1 -->

**Rechka:** Apparently, the part that my  
husband was in charge of was  
all the ingredients.

<!-- uid=401600701:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Making all their graphics?

<!-- uid=401600701:21:1 -->

**Rechka:** Yes. And I... I wanted to see  
everything that he made,

<!-- uid=401600701:22:1 -->

**Rechka:** everything he left behind in this  
world. That's why I dove in.

<!-- uid=401600701:23:1 -->

**Rechka:** Now that I'm gathering those  
ingredients and using them to  
cook for other players,

<!-- uid=401600701:24:1 -->

**Rechka:** it's like...I can still feel him  
near me...

<!-- uid=401600701:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** I-I'm sorry...

<!-- uid=401600701:26:1 -->

**Asuna:** I didn't mean to pry into  
something so private...

<!-- uid=401600701:27:1 -->

**Rechka:** Not at all. I didn't tell you  
anything I didn't want to.

<!-- uid=401600701:28:1 -->

**Rechka:** Hehe, but you're really the only  
one I've ever told...

<!-- uid=401600701:29:1 -->

**Asuna:** What?  
Why would you confide in me...?

<!-- uid=401600701:30:1 -->

**Rechka:** Earlier you said a friend got you  
thinking that it's important to  
put effort into cooking...

<!-- uid=401600701:31:1 -->

**Rechka:** The person who said that...  
is very dear to you, right?

<!-- uid=401600701:32:1 -->

**Asuna:** Wh-What?!

<!-- uid=401600701:33:1 -->

**Asuna:** They... I...!

<!-- uid=401600701:34:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...

<!-- uid=401600701:35:1 -->

**Rechka:** Ha ha, you don't have to hide it.  
I know straight away about that  
kind of thing. It comes with age.

<!-- uid=401600701:36:1 -->

**Asuna:** \*sigh\*...

<!-- uid=401600701:37:1 -->

**Rechka:** I think I could open up to you

## Story 403200601 · Tips to get better

Event Story  
Pop Star Online part 1

**Kirito:** Gather 'round, guys.

**Kazuto:** Is Sphica—?!

<!-- uid=403800701:3:1 -->

<!-- uid=403800701:4:1 -->

having problems communicating.

<!-- uid=403800701:5:1 -->

**Kikuoka:** Eventually, she stopped going  
to school and now barely ever  
speaks to anyone.

<!-- uid=403800701:6:1 -->

**Kikuoka:** The Medicuboid was originally  
developed to help patients with  
serious physical illnesses

<!-- uid=403800701:7:1 -->

**Kikuoka:** spend their final days in some  
modicum of comfort. However,  
it's been theorized that life in a

<!-- uid=403800701:8:1 -->

**Kikuoka:** virtual world can help patients  
with mental illnesses overcome  
psychological trauma.

<!-- uid=403800701:9:1 -->

**Kazuto:** So you set her up with the  
Medicuboid to see if it could  
help treat her.

<!-- uid=403800701:10:1 -->

**Kikuoka:** Exactly. The Medicuboid is still  
quite experimental, so we need  
as much clinical data as possible.

<!-- uid=403800701:11:1 -->

outgoing in ALO. She doesn't have  
any problems communicating.

<!-- uid=403800701:12:1 -->

**Kikuoka:** That's her original personality.  
She likely feels she can be her  
true self in the virtual world.

<!-- uid=403800701:13:1 -->

**Kikuoka:** But recently, the doctors have  
noticed a change in her condition.

<!-- uid=403800701:14:1 -->

**Kazuto:** A change?!

<!-- uid=403800701:15:1 -->

**Kikuoka:** For the better. She's slowly  
re-learning how to communicate  
in the real world.

**Kazuto:** Really?

<!-- uid=404301101:1:1 -->

reward. But after fighting them,

**Asuna:** I realized they had a passion,

couldn't back down. Just like me.

<!-- uid=404301101:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** I really couldn't let myself lose.

fights so seriously.

<!-- uid=404301101:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Because...I really, really wanted

<!-- uid=404301101:8:1 -->

<!-- uid=404301101:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** This place is just another form

<!-- uid=404301101:12:1 -->

<!-- uid=404301101:13:1 -->

you two!

<!-- uid=404301101:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yes! Of course, Yui!

<!-- uid=404301101:15:1 -->


## Story 404301201 · Oath

Event Story  
Bridal Competition

<!-- uid=404301201:1:1 -->

hold from this day forward,

hold from this day forward,

sickness and in health, until  
death do you part?

## Story 404400101 · The Rainy Season in VR

Event Story  
A rainbow after the rain

**Sakuya:** Wow... It's really coming  
down again today, huh?

<!-- uid=404400101:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** You can say that again.

the Sylph event tomorrow?

the participants.

<!-- uid=404400101:5:1 -->

using real-world data.

<!-- uid=404400101:6:1 -->

hot and humid compared to the  
other areas. It's like Japan.

<!-- uid=404400101:7:1 -->

**Sakuya:** With weather this hot, you really  
notice the difference when the  
seasons change.

<!-- uid=404400101:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** \*sigh\*... I'm not sure if I should  
be happy or sad about that...

<!-- uid=404400101:9:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Hold that thought.

<!-- uid=404400101:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** Why? What do you mean?

<!-- uid=404400101:11:1 -->

**Sakuya:** We Sylphs are the only race that  
can control the weather.

<!-- uid=404400101:12:1 -->

**Sakuya:** At least, I've heard there is  
weather-related magic that  
only Sylphs can use.

<!-- uid=404400101:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** Well, I know there's magic that any

day's weather.

<!-- uid=404400101:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** Is that what you're talking about?

<!-- uid=404400101:15:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Not quite. This magic actually  
allows you to CONTROL the weather.

<!-- uid=404400101:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** Are you kidding me?!  
That kind of magic exists?!

<!-- uid=404400101:17:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Indeed. Which is why it's been  
written that Sylphs hid it-even  
from themselves-for many years.

<!-- uid=404400101:18:1 -->

**Sakuya:** I have even heard of magic that  
allows one to reverse night  
and day.

<!-- uid=404400101:19:1 -->

**Leafa:** Holy crap...  
That's literally godlike.

<!-- uid=404400101:20:1 -->

**Leafa:** But if we used it, we'd be able  
to turn this rainy mess into  
screaming blue skies!

<!-- uid=404400101:21:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Correct. I understand that they  
want the seasons to be realistic,  
but this is getting ridiculous.

<!-- uid=404400101:22:1 -->

**Sakuya:** We'll end up canceling a lot more  
than just tomorrow's event if it  
keeps up.

<!-- uid=404400101:23:1 -->

**Sakuya:** I think it'd be worth our while to  
try and track that magic down.

<!-- uid=404400101:24:1 -->

**Leafa:** You got it!  
I'll give you a hand.

<!-- uid=404400101:25:1 -->

**Sakuya:** That would be great, thanks.

<!-- uid=404400101:26:1 -->

## Story 404500901 · Temptation

Event Story  
No rules! Battle royale of AR newbies

**Girl:** Hey, guys. Listen. I'm reaaally  
hurting for points.

<!-- uid=404500901:1:1 -->

**Girl:** I know this is asking a lot,  
but...could you let me win  
in a PvP fight?

<!-- uid=404500901:2:1 -->

**Girl:** I'm still really weak and my rank  
is crap...

<!-- uid=404500901:3:1 -->

**Boy A:** Aw, I feel for you there. Hey,  
dude, what do you think?

<!-- uid=404500901:4:1 -->

**Boy B:** Well, she IS pretty low-ranked,  
and I just saw some monsters  
beating her up...

<!-- uid=404500901:5:1 -->

**Boy A:** Yeah, I feel sorry for her. We're  
doing okay, so I guess a few  
losses wouldn't matter that much.

<!-- uid=404500901:6:1 -->

**Boy B:** Yeah! And a big part of MMOs is  
helping other people out!

<!-- uid=404500901:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sorry to butt in...

<!-- uid=404500901:8:1 -->

**Boy A:** Huh?

<!-- uid=404500901:9:1 -->

**Boy B:** Who the hell are you?

<!-- uid=404500901:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's just, I heard her say the  
same thing to other people  
somewhere else.

<!-- uid=404500901:11:1 -->

**Boy A:** WHAT?!

<!-- uid=404500901:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's up to you whether you want  
to believe me or not. I just  
thought you should know.

<!-- uid=404500901:13:1 -->

**Girl:** Geez! Thanks a lot, buddy!

<!-- uid=404500901:14:1 -->

**Boy B:** W-Wait! So he was telling  
the truth?!

<!-- uid=404500901:15:1 -->

**Boy A:** Whoa, we almost got robbed!

<!-- uid=404500901:16:1 -->

**Boy B:** Yeah...that was a close one.  
Thanks for telling us, man.  
Let's get out of here...

<!-- uid=404500901:17:1 -->

**Boy A:** Thanks again!

<!-- uid=404500901:18:1 -->

**Girl:** Hey! What do you think you're  
doing?!

<!-- uid=404500901:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** I wouldn't have said anything if  
those were just blind idiots  
eager to do your bidding.

<!-- uid=404500901:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** But they listened, and were nice  
to you...so I felt bad.

<!-- uid=404500901:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm not against what you're  
doing, mind you. I think it's just  
another way to play this game.

<!-- uid=404500901:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** In fact, it might be interesting  
to see how far you can go with  
that strategy, ha ha.

<!-- uid=404500901:23:1 -->

**Girl:** Hmph! I didn't ask for any advice!

<!-- uid=404500901:24:1 -->

**Girl:** It's just with how this game is  
designed, it's really hard for  
weaker players to get stronger.

<!-- uid=404500901:25:1 -->

**Girl:** So I have to do whatever it takes  
to climb the rankings!

<!-- uid=404500901:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** Alright. Then I'll teach you a  
little trick for winning battles.  
Even beginners can do it.

<!-- uid=404500901:27:1 -->

**Girl:** R-Really?!

<!-- uid=404500901:28:1 -->

**Yui:** Daddy, I'm glad that girl's  
started playing with the  
method you taught her.

<!-- uid=404500901:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** Again, I don't think her strategy  
itself was bad.

<!-- uid=404500901:30:1 -->

**Kirito:** If it's not breaking any rules,  
then it's just another way of  
playing.

<!-- uid=404500901:31:1 -->

**Kirito:** Plus, younger players getting  
passionate and hot-headed isn't  
inherently a bad thing.

<!-- uid=404500901:32:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's that same passion that  
creates the buzz and hype  
around a game, after all.

<!-- uid=404500901:33:1 -->

**Yui:** You might be right, Daddy.

<!-- uid=404500901:34:1 -->

**Kirito:** And there are a lot of good kids  
out there. Sometimes all you  
need to do is talk to them.

<!-- uid=404500901:35:1 -->

**Yui:** Hehe, Mommy's gonna make fun  
of you again if you keep talking  
like that!

<!-- uid=404500901:36:1 -->

**Kirito:** Heh, you mean she'll think I'm  
really cool and mature!

<!-- uid=404500901:37:1 -->


## Story 404501001 · Life in MMO

Event Story  
No rules! Battle royale of AR newbies

**Asuna:** Kirito, I'm sure you've heard  
this already...

<!-- uid=404501001:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hm? What's up?

<!-- uid=404501001:2:1 -->

trouble between younger players  
lately.

<!-- uid=404501001:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, seems that way.

<!-- uid=404501001:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** I thought maybe you had  
something to do with it...

<!-- uid=404501001:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha, no way. Like I said before,  
it's not something I could tackle  
on my own.

<!-- uid=404501001:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** I was paying attention, though.

<!-- uid=404501001:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Teenagers tend to be competitive,  
so sometimes scuffles are  
unavoidable.

<!-- uid=404501001:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** But this is a game, and that's  
okay. Forcing them into  
submission isn't the answer.

<!-- uid=404501001:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** So you wanna leave it up to  
them to figure it out?

<!-- uid=404501001:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah... A big part of MMOs is  
learning how to deal with other  
people.

<!-- uid=404501001:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** I want to believe that they'll  
eventually learn to cooperate  
by playing together.

<!-- uid=404501001:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, someone's been thinking  
long and hard about this.

<!-- uid=404501001:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, it's based on personal  
experience.

<!-- uid=404501001:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** I think the reason I went from  
being a staunch solo player to  
having a lot of friends...

<!-- uid=404501001:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...is because I learned how to  
get along with others.

<!-- uid=404501001:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito...

<!-- uid=404501001:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** I actually don't dislike  
underhanded strategies and  
exploiting loopholes, though.

<!-- uid=404501001:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** In fact, I respect people who  
can think of them first. It takes  
creativity.

<!-- uid=404501001:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Aw, come on!

<!-- uid=404501001:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** I thought we were gonna end this  
conversation on a feel-good note!

<!-- uid=404501001:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hahaha!

<!-- uid=404501001:22:1 -->

## Story 404600101 · Holding a Contest

Event Story  
Lives drawn in the virtual world

**Kazuto:** Hmmm...

<!-- uid=404600101:1:1 -->

**Yui:** What is it, Daddy?

<!-- uid=404600101:2:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Oh, I was just thinking about  
giving this thing a shot...

<!-- uid=404600101:3:1 -->

**Yui:** Is it a quest?

<!-- uid=404600101:4:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Well, not exactly, but I guess  
technically you could call it a  
quest of sorts...

<!-- uid=404600101:5:1 -->

**Yui:** ...?

<!-- uid=404600101:6:1 -->

**Kazuto:** It's a contest they're holding  
in ALO pretty soon.

<!-- uid=404600101:7:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Players can submit quests they  
created themselves using the Seed.

<!-- uid=404600101:8:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Then the devs will select a few  
outstanding entries to actually  
implement in the game.

<!-- uid=404600101:9:1 -->

**Yui:** Oh, interesting! The Seed does  
let anyone with basic programming  
skills

<!-- uid=404600101:10:1 -->

**Yui:** create their very own quests,  
doesn't it?

<!-- uid=404600101:11:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Yeah...

<!-- uid=404600101:12:1 -->

**Yui:** Then what's troubling you? Someone  
with your abilities should have no  
problem with this sort of thing!

<!-- uid=404600101:13:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Well, it's not the programming  
part that's the problem...

<!-- uid=404600101:14:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Here, look at this.

<!-- uid=404600101:15:1 -->

**Yui:** Ahem. Let's see...  
Regarding quest submissions...

<!-- uid=404600101:16:1 -->

**Yui:** Players must include an  
original monster that they have  
created themselves... That part?

<!-- uid=404600101:17:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Yeah... You need to be good at  
designing and monster creation for  
this, in addition to programming.

<!-- uid=404600101:18:1 -->

**Yui:** Designing would be sketching out  
a new monster and then creating  
it in 3D,

<!-- uid=404600101:19:1 -->

**Yui:** and monster creation would be  
devising a behavioral model for  
your creature, right?

<!-- uid=404600101:20:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Yeah. You're allowed to base your  
monster's movements off of  
existing data, but...

<!-- uid=404600101:21:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I'm not sure what I'm going to  
do about the design...

<!-- uid=404600101:22:1 -->

**Yui:** Can't you draw, Daddy?

<!-- uid=404600101:23:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I mean, I CAN, but nothing I'd  
feel comfortable putting out  
for other people to see...

<!-- uid=404600101:24:1 -->

**Yui:** I'm...not sure what you mean,  
Daddy...

<!-- uid=404600101:25:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Creating something is fun  
when it's JUST for you.

<!-- uid=404600101:26:1 -->

**Kazuto:** But when you think about showing  
it to other people, it just gets  
embarrassing,

<!-- uid=404600101:27:1 -->

**Kazuto:** and you get even more reluctant  
to show something off when you  
don't think it's that good...

<!-- uid=404600101:28:1 -->

**Yui:** Then how do artists in the real  
world ever exhibit the things  
they've created?

<!-- uid=404600101:29:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Ha ha, probably by suppressing the  
embarrassment, or maybe they have  
actual confidence in their work.

<!-- uid=404600101:30:1 -->

**Yui:** It sounds like you would fall in  
the former category, Daddy.

<!-- uid=404600101:31:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Heh, you're exactly right.  
That's what makes this  
so difficult for me.

<!-- uid=404600101:32:1 -->

## Story 405800301 · Memories of the Past

Event Story  
Assault! Proof of Strong Bonds

**Asuna:** Looks like we made it back in one  
piece, Commander.

<!-- uid=405800301:1:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** That we did. Good work out there  
today, Asuna. Your quick thinking  
saved the lot of us.

<!-- uid=405800301:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** No, we owe our victory to you.  
Your party held off that wave of  
reinforcements that spawned.

<!-- uid=405800301:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** If your Divine Blade hadn't been  
there today to bail us out...

<!-- uid=405800301:4:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** Ha ha, think nothing of it.  
We're the Knights of the Blood  
Oath. We look after our own.

<!-- uid=405800301:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** I guess you're right...

<!-- uid=405800301:6:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** You don't sound very happy.  
What's wrong?

<!-- uid=405800301:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well... It's nothing, it's just...

<!-- uid=405800301:8:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** Yes?

<!-- uid=405800301:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Do you think I'll ever be able to  
learn a unique skill like you,  
Commander?

<!-- uid=405800301:10:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** Why do you ask that?

<!-- uid=405800301:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** I was just thinking that having  
an ace up my sleeve, like your  
Divine Blade,

<!-- uid=405800301:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** would make a huge difference  
against tough enemies like those  
we faced today.

<!-- uid=405800301:13:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** Ah, I see. You wish to become  
stronger to protect your comrades  
and conquer Aincrad. Correct?

<!-- uid=405800301:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** I guess you're right...

<!-- uid=405800301:15:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** I cannot deny that my Divine Blade  
is one of the few unique skills  
that exist in SAO.

<!-- uid=405800301:16:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** Unique skills are powerful.  
But remember: they are not the  
only path to strength, Asuna.

<!-- uid=405800301:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Are you talking about extra  
skills?

<!-- uid=405800301:18:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** Correct. Extra skills like katana  
mastery can only be earned through  
experience and hard work.

<!-- uid=405800301:19:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** Many of them are much more  
powerful than your average  
sword skill.

<!-- uid=405800301:20:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** However, I don't believe extra  
skills are stronger than unique  
skills, or vice versa.

<!-- uid=405800301:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** The only difference is that we  
know how to gain extra skills,  
but not unique skills. Right?

<!-- uid=405800301:22:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** Exactly. So if you truly wish to  
grow stronger...

<!-- uid=405800301:23:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** I would recommend that you search  
for an extra skill that suits you.

<!-- uid=405800301:24:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** Asking someone to teach you how  
to master it would be the shortest  
route to greater power.

<!-- uid=405800301:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's a good point. Thank you  
for the advice, Commander.

<!-- uid=405800301:26:1 -->

## Story 406200101 · Visitor

Event Story

<!-- uid=406200101:22:1 -->


## Story 406200201 · The Reason for the Likeness

Event Story  
Arianrhod in the Past

**Kirito:** Did any of the other members  
object to disbanding the guild?

<!-- uid=406200201:1:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** There were some disappointed  
faces, but most were  
understanding.

<!-- uid=406200201:2:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** The guild was hastily formed and  
did what it set out to do. I saw  
no reason to keep it running.

<!-- uid=406200201:3:1 -->

their own friends before I found  
them,

<!-- uid=406200201:4:1 -->

responsibility and stress on SAO  
survivors.

made the right call.

<!-- uid=406200201:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...

<!-- uid=406200201:7:1 -->

Arianrhod?

<!-- uid=406200201:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Your fighting style, your armor,  
your avatar... It's all modeled  
on the former commander.

<!-- uid=406200201:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** You look a lot like Heathcliff.

<!-- uid=406200201:11:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** Oh!

<!-- uid=406200201:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Aside from the fact that you're  
a woman, of course! I just...

<!-- uid=406200201:13:1 -->

and I'd like to know what they  
are.

<!-- uid=406200201:14:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** ...

**Kirito:** I've been wondering that myself.

first time, I thought he'd come  
back from the dead.

<!-- uid=406200201:17:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** I see. You two had a rather  
complicated relationship with  
him, didn't you?

<!-- uid=406200201:18:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** Allow me to start from the  
beginning.

<!-- uid=406200201:19:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** It was just a few days after we  
all knew we'd been trapped inside  
SAO.

<!-- uid=406200201:20:1 -->

<!-- uid=406200601:27:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** That is how I came to train under  
Heathcliff.

## Story 406200901 · Tank for Two

Event Story  
Arianrhod in the Past

**Asuna:** Commander, this mini-quest may not  
appear related to completing the  
game, but it cannot be ignored.

<!-- uid=406200901:1:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** So it would seem. Defeating these  
monsters weakens the boss.

<!-- uid=406200901:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** But the party size is capped at  
two players.

<!-- uid=406200901:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** I think that leaves us no choice  
but to complete this quest  
together. What do you say?

<!-- uid=406200901:4:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** No. This area will spawn a lot of  
fast-moving monsters.

<!-- uid=406200901:5:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** Taking them out one by one would  
be a risky and life-threatening  
task. They'll chip away at our HP.

<!-- uid=406200901:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** But with my high agility...

<!-- uid=406200901:7:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** I think this would be best suited  
for two tanks with high defense.

<!-- uid=406200901:8:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** They wouldn't take any damage from  
the monsters' quick-but-weak  
attacks.

<!-- uid=406200901:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Tanks? Hmm... Meaning you with  
the power of the Divine Blade,  
and...who else?

<!-- uid=406200901:10:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** I have someone in mind.  
Leave this quest to me, Asuna.

<!-- uid=406200901:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Are you sure? I certainly don't  
mind, but...

<!-- uid=406200901:12:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** It shall be completed by tomorrow  
afternoon. Don't you worry.

<!-- uid=406200901:13:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** ...

<!-- uid=406200901:14:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** And I take it you want me to join  
you on this quest?

<!-- uid=406200901:15:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** Yes.

<!-- uid=406200901:16:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** Look, I thank you for all the  
training and guidance...

<!-- uid=406200901:17:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** Thanks to you, I've learned how  
to fight through my fear

<!-- uid=406200901:18:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** and gained the tools necessary  
to make it out of here alive.

<!-- uid=406200901:19:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** But the fear hasn't gone away.  
It's just changed.

<!-- uid=406200901:20:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** How so?

<!-- uid=406200901:21:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** You're not asking me to fight for  
myself anymore. You want my help.

<!-- uid=406200901:22:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** Which means any failure of mine  
would endanger you too.

<!-- uid=406200901:23:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** How could I ever forgive myself if  
I was the reason we lost you?  
Could I even face the others?

<!-- uid=406200901:24:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** Ha ha. That won't be a problem.  
I guarantee it.

<!-- uid=406200901:25:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** How can you be so sure?!

<!-- uid=406200901:26:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** Whether you believe it or not,  
I wouldn't lie to you.

<!-- uid=406200901:27:1 -->

**Heathcliff :** And I know this quest is not the  
end for me.

<!-- uid=406200901:28:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** ...

<!-- uid=406200901:29:1 -->


## Story 406201001 · Growth

Event Story  
Arianrhod in the Past

## Story 406201101 · Heathcliff's Intentions

Event Story  
Arianrhod in the Past

**Arianrhod:** That was the last time I saw him.

<!-- uid=406201101:1:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** I was off completing quests on my  
own when I got the message that  
the game had been beaten.

<!-- uid=406201101:2:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** I returned to the real world only  
to be shocked by the revelation  
that Kayaba was Heathcliff.

<!-- uid=406201101:3:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** That the one person I trusted  
in that world was the same one  
who imprisoned me in it.

<!-- uid=406201101:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm so sorry...

<!-- uid=406201101:5:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** But it's more complicated than  
that, too.

<!-- uid=406201101:6:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** He built me up so I could have  
a hand in ending that death game.

<!-- uid=406201101:7:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** Some part of him wanted out.  
Wanted to end the world he'd  
created.

<!-- uid=406201101:8:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** I'll never know whether that was  
true, of course, but it helps me  
sleep at night.

<!-- uid=406201101:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** I feel the same way about Kayaba.

<!-- uid=406201101:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** That...he wasn't just the mad  
scientist most of the world  
thinks he was.

<!-- uid=406201101:11:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** Thank you, Kirito.

<!-- uid=406201101:12:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** I'd like to ask you something  
about that battle the other day.

<!-- uid=406201101:13:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** You said it seemed like Heathcliff  
possessed me, or something?

<!-- uid=406201101:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's certainly what it felt  
like to me.

<!-- uid=406201101:15:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** Would you mind telling me what  
he said to you?

<!-- uid=406201101:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Of course not.

<!-- uid=406201101:17:1 -->


## Story 406201201 · Arianrhod's Wish

Event Story  
Arianrhod in the Past

**Arianrhod:** Ah, I see...

<!-- uid=406201201:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** He sounded rather satisfied  
in the end.

<!-- uid=406201201:2:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** He's right, though. The stakes  
aren't as high in ALO.

<!-- uid=406201201:3:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** And players are kind of in a rut  
at the moment.

<!-- uid=406201201:4:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** Nobody's really aiming as high  
as they could.

<!-- uid=406201201:5:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** On the one hand, that's obviously  
because it's not a battle between  
life and death anymore.

<!-- uid=406201201:6:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** Maybe that's why he felt he had  
to come back. To push people to  
the next level.

<!-- uid=406201201:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Come to think of it, the admins  
never made an announcement about  
SAO monsters appearing, did they?

<!-- uid=406201201:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** You don't think he whipped that  
whole quest up for us, do you?

<!-- uid=406201201:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** As a way to jolt us out of the  
stupor all the easy quests had  
lulled us into?

<!-- uid=406201201:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ha ha, it's not a bad idea, but I  
think you're getting into  
conspiracy theory territory.

<!-- uid=406201201:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** That was pretty standard SAO  
difficulty, though, wasn't it?

<!-- uid=406201201:12:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** Heh, you're right about that.  
But if you think about it...

<!-- uid=406201201:13:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** Isn't it possible he chose my  
avatar to possess because it's  
closest to what he played?

<!-- uid=406201201:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's possible. Not to mention  
you were his pupil.

<!-- uid=406201201:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** It would've been incredibly easy  
for him to slip into an avatar he  
helped train.

<!-- uid=406201201:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** I think you're selling Arianrhod  
a bit short here, Kirito.

<!-- uid=406201201:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Isn't it equally possible he  
wanted to see how strong his  
student had become? Hmm?

<!-- uid=406201201:18:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** Ha ha! I don't mind either way.

came before.

<!-- uid=406201201:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm so sorry...

<!-- uid=406201201:20:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** And it wouldn't deter me from  
doing what I feel I must.

<!-- uid=406201201:21:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** As long as people are enjoying  
themselves in the world Kayaba  
created...

<!-- uid=406201201:22:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** The world that literally grew  
from the seed he provided...  
That's enough for me.

<!-- uid=406201201:23:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** He trained me and gave me courage.  
I feel I should carry on the positive  
aspects of his legacy.

<!-- uid=406201201:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** I see what you mean. Let us  
know if there's anything we  
can do to help with that.

<!-- uid=406201201:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm here for you.

<!-- uid=406201201:26:1 -->

**Asuna:** So am I!

<!-- uid=406201201:27:1 -->

**Arianrhod:** Thank you both. That means a lot.

<!-- uid=406201201:28:1 -->


## Story 406300101 · City Development

Event Story  
In quest of secluded hot springs

**Asuna:** There's a player-run event to

those mountains between

not many people go out that way...

build a town up there, see what

real world...

<!-- uid=406300101:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** I have heard about small towns

even if we clear the land and  
put up buildings,

<!-- uid=406300101:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** it may look like a town, but the

safe zone.

and hurt people. Are you still  
okay with this idea?

about that! Guess I'll sleep with  
one eye open there! Hahaha!

**Asuna:** Hehe, you're even more excited

the thrills.

<!-- uid=406300101:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** I knew it! But I'm still happy to

**Asuna:** If we've got a player-run event  
going down in the land between  
our territories,

<!-- uid=406300101:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** you and me just have to  
participate! Isn't that right?

<!-- uid=406300101:17:1 -->

**Yuuki:** You betcha!

<!-- uid=406300101:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'll message everyone and see if  
they're interested too. This is  
going to be a big job!

<!-- uid=406300101:19:1 -->

**Yuuki:** It'll be a breeze compared to  
doing this stuff in the real  
world. But the more the merrier!

<!-- uid=406300101:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** You said it!

<!-- uid=406300101:21:1 -->

The Malefic Star of the Magic Citadel

<!-- uid=406400601:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, that's what we thought,

**Asuna:** Hey, that's a good point!

<!-- uid=406400601:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Our working theory right now is  
that people from Alice's world  
stressed the system when they

<!-- uid=406400601:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** came here, and Cardinal tried to  
cope by creating the Divine  
Objects.

**Kirito:** So isn't it strange that one is

**Asuna:** But if one of them is a public  
event's reward, that shoots a big

## Story 406400701 · Urdr's Answer

Event Story  
The Malefic Star of the Magic Citadel

**Alice:** Kirito! Asuna!  
I demand an explanation!

<!-- uid=406400701:1:1 -->

**Alice:** Why have we left the Dread Bastion

<!-- uid=406400701:2:1 -->

and they were pushing hard.

<!-- uid=406400701:4:1 -->

<!-- uid=406400701:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm sorry... It's not that I don't

<!-- uid=406400701:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's just... I can't really find

<!-- uid=406400701:7:1 -->

<!-- uid=406400701:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito...

<!-- uid=406400701:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** I need to know more about the  
Divine Objects, and the lady who  
knows the most about them...

<!-- uid=406400701:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Is right over there.

<!-- uid=406400701:11:1 -->

**Alice:** Huh...?

<!-- uid=406400701:12:1 -->

**Urdr:** Brave warriors, I am happy to see  
you here once more.

<!-- uid=406400701:13:1 -->

**Eugeo:** The goddess...

<!-- uid=406400701:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** There is still so much we don't  
know about the Divine Objects.

<!-- uid=406400701:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** So Kirito thought we should ask  
Urdr here to fill us in.

<!-- uid=406400701:16:1 -->

**Alice:** I see... Truth be told, I too am  
curious to learn why so much was  
left unsaid. The curse, for one.

<!-- uid=406400701:17:1 -->

**Alice:** Urdr, I beseech you. Tell us: why  
did you not reveal the nature of  
the Divine Objects' powers to us?

<!-- uid=406400701:18:1 -->

**Urdr:** I apologize for keeping silent.  
However, the curse you speak of  
was a surprise even to us gods.

<!-- uid=406400701:19:1 -->

**Urdr:** The seven Divine Objects are holy  
vessels, forged to imprison dark  
and malevolent forces.

<!-- uid=406400701:20:1 -->

**Urdr:** Enshrined within the Hill Giants'  
ancient temple, their power united  
to form an unbreakable seal.

<!-- uid=406400701:21:1 -->

**Urdr:** However, thieves snuck into the  
temple and stole them, scattering  
them to the four winds.

<!-- uid=406400701:22:1 -->

**Urdr:** No longer linked, the power of the  
seals began to fade, and the evil  
within began to break free.

<!-- uid=406400701:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** So in other words, it's not really  
a curse?

<!-- uid=406400701:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** Wait, it isn't? But powerful  
monsters did appear around them,

<!-- uid=406400701:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** and Liz's magic evil-repelling  
amulet did seem to work...  
At least a little bit.

<!-- uid=406400701:26:1 -->

**Urdr:** The beasts you encountered were  
servants of the dark beings still  
trapped within the Divine Objects.

<!-- uid=406400701:27:1 -->

**Urdr:** They were summoned to destroy the  
Divine Objects, to release the  
true power of the darkness inside.

<!-- uid=406400701:28:1 -->

**Alice:** Which means the more Divine  
Objects we find, the greater  
danger we're in.

<!-- uid=406400701:29:1 -->

**Urdr:** That is correct.  
I have put you in great peril...

<!-- uid=406400701:30:1 -->

**Alice:** The danger is negligible. I'm more  
concerned that weaker warriors  
than we may find them first.

<!-- uid=406400701:31:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I second Alice here. We know what  
we have to do now, and we need to  
double-time it.

<!-- uid=406400701:32:1 -->

**Eugeo:** We have to find all seven Divine  
Objects, then seal these evil  
beings back inside-for good.

<!-- uid=406400701:33:1 -->

**Kirito:** You got it. Thank you, Urdr.  
Hold on just a little longer.  
We only need four more.

<!-- uid=406400701:34:1 -->

**Asuna:** We can't risk monsters showing up  
in Jotunheimr, so we'll hold onto  
the ones we have for now.

<!-- uid=406400701:35:1 -->

**Urdr:** Thank you, warriors, fairy and  
human... The fate of the world  
rests in your hands.

## Story 406800201 · In Search of Rare Find

Event Story

**Dyne:** Alright, we're here. This is that

<!-- uid=406800201:1:1 -->

so long.

<!-- uid=406800201:8:1 -->

**Dyne:** Hey, Kirito? You know, your voice

<!-- uid=406800201:9:1 -->

<!-- uid=406800201:13:1 -->

sense, right?

<!-- uid=406800201:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Cool... Oh, hey. Looks like we're  
not the only ones here.

<!-- uid=406800201:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** I see them... A lot of people must  
be dying to plunder this place.

<!-- uid=406800201:21:1 -->

rare loot, and who can blame  
them? Besides...

<!-- uid=406800201:22:1 -->

## Story 407700801 · Accidental Coincidence

Event Story  
Inherited Tradition - A priests will

**Head Priest:** Ah, so that's what this is about!  
You two are the girls who helped  
out at the real shrine!

<!-- uid=407700801:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** Heh heh, what a coincidence!

<!-- uid=407700801:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** This is incredible! You manage  
two different shrines in two  
different worlds?

<!-- uid=407700801:3:1 -->

**Head Priest:** Hah! Well, I suppose it just comes  
naturally to me.

<!-- uid=407700801:4:1 -->

**Head Priest:** I was once very much into design,  
you see. I thought that was where  
I would make my living.

<!-- uid=407700801:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** That's why you put your mark on  
all the goods you sell at the  
shrine.

<!-- uid=407700801:6:1 -->

**Head Priest:** Precisely. But I found myself  
unable to go against generations  
of family history.

<!-- uid=407700801:7:1 -->

**Head Priest:** I was designing something on my  
computer when I first heard of  
VRMMOs, so I looked for one.

<!-- uid=407700801:8:1 -->

**Head Priest:** And wouldn't you know it, that's  
when I found Asuka Empire!

<!-- uid=407700801:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** So it was the Japanese theme that  
drew you in?

<!-- uid=407700801:10:1 -->

**Head Priest:** For starters, yes.  
But it was more than that.

<!-- uid=407700801:11:1 -->

**Head Priest:** There are rumors of an old man who  
wanted to connect with his dearly  
departed grandson.

<!-- uid=407700801:12:1 -->

**Head Priest:** And would you believe it? With the  
help of the other players in AE,

<!-- uid=407700801:13:1 -->

**Head Priest:** he was able to find logs of  
what his grandson had done in  
the game. He died a happy man.

<!-- uid=407700801:14:1 -->

**Head Priest:** Upon hearing that, I thought  
AE might be a game even an  
old man like me could enjoy.

<!-- uid=407700801:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Wow, that's incredible.

<!-- uid=407700801:16:1 -->

**Head Priest:** And I have a little experience  
with computer games myself,  
so I thought it might be fun.

<!-- uid=407700801:17:1 -->

**Head Priest:** Heh heh heh!

<!-- uid=407700801:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** A little experience? You've played  
enough to earn a shrine! Something  
tells me you've got skill.

<!-- uid=407700801:19:1 -->

**Leafa:** The job type you selected...  
You basically serve the deities,  
right?

<!-- uid=407700801:20:1 -->

**Head Priest:** Yes, and in battle I'm best as  
a healer or support unit. I'm a  
little old for combat, you see.

<!-- uid=407700801:21:1 -->

**Head Priest:** You know, I don't think it's  
coincidence that brought  
you here.

<!-- uid=407700801:22:1 -->

**Head Priest:** May I ask something of you three?

PSO LIVE BATTLE Part 1

## Story 408801001 · A Secret Plan

Event Story  
Awesome Newbie

**Sinon:** I'll ask you one last time, Waals:  
you plan on sticking to your guns  
and keeping the rocket launcher?

<!-- uid=408801001:1:1 -->

**Waals:** ...Sorry.

<!-- uid=408801001:2:1 -->

**Waals:** But yes. I refuse to budge.

<!-- uid=408801001:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** Okay. That's all I needed to hear.

<!-- uid=408801001:4:1 -->

**Liz:** Sinon, please, can you let us all  
in on your big plan already?

<!-- uid=408801001:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** Sure. It's skills.

<!-- uid=408801001:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's not very specific...

<!-- uid=408801001:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** Rocket launchers are heavy, hard  
to use, and their Bullet Circles  
are unsteady.

<!-- uid=408801001:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** Not to mention rockets often curve  
in mid-air, so they're especially  
hard to aim.

<!-- uid=408801001:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** Still, they pack a huge punch and  
are great at destroying enemy  
cover, which helps increase DPS.

<!-- uid=408801001:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** You mean the rubble from the  
explosion will deal extra damage?

<!-- uid=408801001:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** Bingo. Now, rocket launchers have  
a lot of recoil. What happens when  
you fire one, Waals?

<!-- uid=408801001:12:1 -->

**Waals:** If I'm standing, I get flung back  
maybe two, three meters.

<!-- uid=408801001:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** Great. There's a skill I think you  
might be interested in, Waals.  
It's called "Recoil Leap."

<!-- uid=408801001:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** What's that do?

<!-- uid=408801001:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** Usually, recoil from a big gun  
just knocks you down. This skill  
lets you use that recoil to move.

<!-- uid=408801001:16:1 -->

**Liz:** Wait, you mean you use the rocket  
launcher to rocket YOU away?!  
Crazy!

<!-- uid=408801001:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Heh, I like the way you put that.

<!-- uid=408801001:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** It's a physically impossible trick  
in real life, but this is VR.

<!-- uid=408801001:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** If you learn that skill, the  
system assists you when you use  
this technique, making it doable.

<!-- uid=408801001:20:1 -->

**Waals:** Recoil Leap, huh? Sounds fun.

<!-- uid=408801001:21:1 -->

## Story 409100201 · A Tall Girl's Dream

Event Story  
Hello New Me

**Karen:** Oof, my head... This store's sign  
is too low...

<!-- uid=409100201:1:1 -->

**Shopkeeper:** Are you all right, miss?

<!-- uid=409100201:2:1 -->

**Karen:** Oh, uh... Yeah. I'm fine.  
No worries. It happens  
all the time.

<!-- uid=409100201:3:1 -->

**Karen:** This is the real me.  
Karen Kohiruimaki.

<!-- uid=409100201:4:1 -->

**Karen:** In my third year of elementary  
school, I started growing like a  
weed. Now I'm 19, and 183 cm.

<!-- uid=409100201:5:1 -->

**Karen:** I've been teased about my height  
for so long, I've had a complex  
about it since middle school.

<!-- uid=409100201:6:1 -->

**Karen:** It's been three months now since  
I left my hometown in Hokkaido  
and came to Tokyo for college...

<!-- uid=409100201:7:1 -->

**Karen:** I thought being in the city would  
change me... But I'm still the  
same person I've always been.

<!-- uid=409100201:8:1 -->

**Karen:** And, of course, it's not like I'm  
getting any shorter.

<!-- uid=409100201:9:1 -->

**Karen:** I didn't expect to get into this  
fancy private women's college and  
was excited for my Tokyo debut!

<!-- uid=409100201:10:1 -->

**Karen:** But this is an escalator school,  
so almost everyone's known each  
other since junior high...

<!-- uid=409100201:11:1 -->

**Karen:** Plus, I'm an introvert, so it's  
really hard for me to go out  
and make friends.

<!-- uid=409100201:12:1 -->

**Karen:** So, I ended up a loner. I didn't  
join any clubs, and my parents  
forbid me from working too.

<!-- uid=409100201:13:1 -->

**Karen:** My life was classes, home,  
classes, home. Ad infinitum.

<!-- uid=409100201:14:1 -->

**Karen:** \*sigh\*... It'd be nice to be back  
in middle school, like those girls  
over there...

<!-- uid=409100201:15:1 -->

**Karen:** They get to be young and little  
and cute. Unlike tall, gangly,  
awkward me. If I was shorter...

<!-- uid=409100201:16:1 -->


## Story 409100301 · Becoming Somebody Else

Hello New Me

**Karen:** Maybe if I can become someone

## Story 409300101 · A Sudden Call

Event Story  
Fairy Squad Jam

**Sakuya:** You've arrived. Good.

<!-- uid=409300101:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sorry to keep you waiting, Sakuya.

<!-- uid=409300101:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** So, what's the deal? Why call  
us out to neutral ground?

<!-- uid=409300101:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, Alicia's here? And General  
Eugene too?

<!-- uid=409300101:4:1 -->

**Eugene:** You're late.

<!-- uid=409300101:5:3 -->

**Alicia:** Kirito! Have you decided to join  
the Cait Sith as my own personal  
bodyguard yet?!

<!-- uid=409300101:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Do what now?!

<!-- uid=409300101:7:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Alicia, down. Don't muddy the  
waters before we've even begun.

<!-- uid=409300101:8:1 -->

**Alicia:** Ehehe, sorry. My bad!

<!-- uid=409300101:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Can we have an explanation yet?

<!-- uid=409300101:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** I second that. This can't be a  
Sylph-only event, otherwise  
you'd just call us to Sylvain.

<!-- uid=409300101:11:1 -->

**Sakuya:** That's correct. The truth is,  
we plan on holding an event  
for all fairies in Alfheim.

<!-- uid=409300101:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ahh, so that's why all the fairy  
leaders are gathering here.

<!-- uid=409300101:13:1 -->

**Alicia:** Yup. We had to meet here on  
neutral ground to plan. Too high a  
chance for shenanigans otherwise.

<!-- uid=409300101:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** So, what sort of event are you  
planning?

<!-- uid=409300101:15:1 -->

**Sakuya:** I'm sure you've all heard of that  
event they're holding in GGO  
right now. The Squad Jam.

<!-- uid=409300101:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeah. It's a team tournament  
held in a special arena.

<!-- uid=409300101:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** So basically like the ALO system  
of fairy races fighting for  
dominance.

<!-- uid=409300101:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Mostly, but on a much smaller  
scale. Don't forget that there are  
time limits and other rules too.

<!-- uid=409300101:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'd say it's closer to a team  
version of that BoB tournament  
I competed in a while back.

<!-- uid=409300101:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ah, good point. Well, either way,  
you're planning one of them here  
in ALO? Hehe, sounds fun!

<!-- uid=409300101:21:1 -->

**Eugene:** That's right. However...

<!-- uid=409300101:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's a foreboding "however."

<!-- uid=409300101:23:1 -->

**Sakuya:** It's much harder to organize than  
we thought it'd be.

<!-- uid=409300101:24:1 -->


## Story 409300201 · Squad Jam

Event Story  
Fairy Squad Jam

**Alicia:** Let me give you the rundown.  
First, we need to apply special  
rules to a designated area for it.

<!-- uid=409300201:1:1 -->

**Alicia:** In other words, we need to tinker  
with the game itself to set it up.

<!-- uid=409300201:2:1 -->

**Alicia:** From what I hear, GGO's Squad Jam  
wasn't set up by Zaskar. That's  
GGO's developer, by the way.

<!-- uid=409300201:3:1 -->

**Alicia:** It was actually all funded by a  
single, very wealthy player.

<!-- uid=409300201:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** One player paid for the whole  
thing? Wow...

<!-- uid=409300201:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** So I assume this player went to  
Zaskar and convinced them to help?  
Maybe with some cash payments?

<!-- uid=409300201:6:1 -->

**Leafa:** So... Do we have anyone who can  
fund the project here in ALO?

<!-- uid=409300201:7:1 -->

**Sakuya:** We leaders and our aides should  
be able to handle that part,  
but...

<!-- uid=409300201:8:1 -->

**Sakuya:** The true problem lies instead in  
the motivation for the event.

<!-- uid=409300201:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Really? Didn't you guys just want  
to hold the event for the fun  
of it?

<!-- uid=409300201:10:1 -->

**Eugene:** In a way. Truth is, ALO is buzzing  
with talk about the Squad Jam.  
Everyone wants to have one here.

<!-- uid=409300201:11:1 -->

**Eugene:** With so many voices raised in  
appeal, we had to try to please  
the masses.

<!-- uid=409300201:12:1 -->

**Sakuya:** But they all want it to be just  
like GGO. That means mainly  
ranged combat, no flight...

<!-- uid=409300201:13:1 -->

**Sakuya:** There are even people demanding  
we add satellite scans, just like  
in GGO.

<!-- uid=409300201:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** People are asking for that level  
of fidelity to the original?  
That's kinda...crazy.

<!-- uid=409300201:15:1 -->

**Sakuya:** It's doable, we think. As long as  
we can create a special area for  
it.

<!-- uid=409300201:16:1 -->

**Sakuya:** However, these requested rules  
don't mesh with the fundamental  
theme of ALO.

<!-- uid=409300201:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's for sure. I'm guessing the  
admins rejected the idea?

<!-- uid=409300201:18:1 -->

**Alicia:** Yup. They said they could make  
a special area and set up a party  
system.

<!-- uid=409300201:19:1 -->

**Alicia:** They even okayed the satellite  
stuff. But everything else wasn't  
ALO enough to pass muster.

<!-- uid=409300201:20:1 -->

**Leafa:** Well, yeah, of course not.  
Flying's the heart of ALO,  
and I'd want to include it!

<!-- uid=409300201:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** I can't believe they agreed to  
satellite scans. Isn't that way  
beyond ALO-level tech?

<!-- uid=409300201:22:1 -->

**Alicia:** They said they'd justify it as  
a sort of specialized tracking  
magic.

<!-- uid=409300201:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** That makes sense. Same effect,  
different wrapping...

<!-- uid=409300201:24:1 -->

**Eugene:** We've also already set out a day  
to hold the tournament.

<!-- uid=409300201:25:1 -->

**Eugene:** And we've already paid out cash to  
RECT Progress to make it happen.

<!-- uid=409300201:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=409300201:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...

<!-- uid=409300201:28:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey Asuna... Any way you can,  
you know, use your connections...?

<!-- uid=409300201:29:1 -->

**Asuna:** Nuh-uh, not going to happen.  
I've told you before I refuse to  
play that card.

<!-- uid=409300201:30:1 -->

**Alicia:** Hey, what're you two whispering  
'bout over there?

<!-- uid=409300201:31:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ah, ha ha... Nothing.

<!-- uid=409300201:32:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hey, question! We get the problem  
now, but why call us? What do you  
expect us to do about it?

<!-- uid=409300201:33:1 -->

**Sakuya:** We'd like to ask you to look for  
a way to justify all these unique  
rules in ALO.

<!-- uid=409300201:34:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ah. Simply put, since the admins  
won't help, you want us to figure  
something out on the player side.

<!-- uid=409300201:35:1 -->

**Eugene:** Exactly.

<!-- uid=409300201:36:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ah... Well, it's not going to be  
easy, that's for sure.

<!-- uid=409300201:37:1 -->


## Story 409300301 · Big Assignment

Event Story  
Fairy Squad Jam

**Sinon:** I don't know how much help I'll  
be. I wasn't in the Squad Jam,  
so I'm not that familiar with it.

<!-- uid=409300301:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Familiar or not, you're the GGO  
veteran here. I'd love it if you  
had our back on this.

<!-- uid=409300301:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** W-Well, if you put it that way...

<!-- uid=409300301:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** This'll be fun! It's not every day  
you get to plan the rules for a  
tournament!

<!-- uid=409300301:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha, I'm with you there.

<!-- uid=409300301:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** So to summarize all of this, we  
need to find a way to justify  
Squad Jam rules in ALO, right?

<!-- uid=409300301:6:2 -->

**Kirito:** Yup, that's the deal.

<!-- uid=409300301:7:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hmm... Didn't the Squad Jam spawn  
vehicles in the arena after enough  
time passed?

<!-- uid=409300301:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** I heard you could use them to get  
around.

<!-- uid=409300301:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's right. Alicia said they  
figured out a way to work them in.

<!-- uid=409300301:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** You're kidding me. Really?

<!-- uid=409300301:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yup. They're taming giant monsters  
ahead of time and releasing them  
into the arena at intervals.

<!-- uid=409300301:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** Heh. Nice. Riding monsters sounds  
fun and fits in well with ALO's  
theme.

<!-- uid=409300301:13:1 -->

**Leafa:** And as long as they're tamed  
right, they'll obey their riders'  
orders.

<!-- uid=409300301:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hmm... So our biggest problems  
are still justifying ranged combat  
and no flight rules.

<!-- uid=409300301:15:1 -->

**Sinon:** For the flight thing, why not just  
make the arena a dungeon or  
where the sun doesn't shine?

<!-- uid=409300301:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** The admins already built a  
special floating island for the  
tournament, so that option's out.

<!-- uid=409300301:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Ah. Hmm. I guess holding a big  
tournament in a gloomy, dark  
place isn't fun either.

<!-- uid=409300301:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeah, well, I think letting people  
fly would make the whole thing  
pretty darn fun!

<!-- uid=409300301:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** And I'm pretty annoyed that they  
want to add rules that heavily  
favor ranged combat...

<!-- uid=409300301:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** You are a sword specialist,  
after all!

<!-- uid=409300301:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** At least this isn't SAO. There's  
no way you'd be able to ban  
melee combat there.

<!-- uid=409300301:22:1 -->

**Leafa:** Nope! Luckily, ALO has bows,  
crossbows, ballistae, combat  
magic, and so on!

<!-- uid=409300301:23:1 -->

**Sinon:** Well, what about requiring  
contestants to use weapons we  
provide for the tournament?

<!-- uid=409300301:24:1 -->

**Sinon:** Then we can just skew things so  
that the ranged options are much  
better.

<!-- uid=409300301:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** I think that's the only realistic  
option we have.

<!-- uid=409300301:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** Good idea. We can also mix in a  
bunch of items that buff offensive  
magic.

<!-- uid=409300301:27:1 -->

**Leafa:** Sounds good to me.

<!-- uid=409300301:28:1 -->


## Story 409300401 · Collecting Weapons

Event Story  
Fairy Squad Jam

**Kirito:** Alright! We've gotten all the bows

Mommy!

## Story 409500401 · Underground Lake

Event Story  
One Day in the Battlefield - Girls and GGO

**Fukaziroh:** Take THIS!

<!-- uid=409500401:1:1 -->

**Monster:** GRAAAAAWWWGGHHH!

<!-- uid=409500401:2:1 -->

**LLENN:** Yes! We totally owned that thing!  
You and I are unstoppable!

<!-- uid=409500401:3:1 -->

**Fukaziroh:** Now, for the moment we've all been  
waiting for! Let's see what it  
dropped...

<!-- uid=409500401:4:1 -->

**Fukaziroh:** What in the world...? How's anyone

outfit?

**LLENN:** Seriously... I've never seen  
anything like it. Wonder what  
it's for...

<!-- uid=409500401:6:1 -->

**Fukaziroh:** Oh! I bet it's a diving suit!

<!-- uid=409500401:7:1 -->

it on and dive into the lake?

<!-- uid=409500401:8:1 -->

**Fukaziroh:** There might be even rarer items  
waiting for us at the bottom!  
Let's do it!

<!-- uid=409500401:9:1 -->

**LLENN:** You're serious? But...this thing  
doesn't look like it leaves much  
to the imagination...

<!-- uid=409500401:10:1 -->

**Fukaziroh:** Honestly. Real world diving suits

designed so skin tight...

<!-- uid=409500401:12:1 -->

**LLENN:** It looks almost like Pito's  
outfit...

<!-- uid=409500401:13:1 -->

**Fukaziroh:** Well, whatever. It's not like

right? We're the only two here.

**LLENN:** I guess you've got a point...  
Okay then, let's see what  
this lake is hiding.

**Fukaziroh:** Hell yeah!

<!-- uid=409500401:16:1 -->

**Fukaziroh:** There is literally nothing here...

<!-- uid=409500401:17:1 -->

**LLENN:** W-Well, stuff like this happens  
sometimes.

<!-- uid=409500401:18:1 -->

**LLENN:** Rumors about rare items

<!-- uid=409500401:19:1 -->

<!-- uid=409500401:20:1 -->

they probably fixed the items  
that drop in this area.

the chances of getting a rare item

<!-- uid=409500401:23:1 -->

**LLENN:** Something like that.

<!-- uid=409500401:24:1 -->

**Fukaziroh:** Then these diving suits are

<!-- uid=409500401:25:1 -->

**LLENN:** Ha ha, yep. But they're rare items

make a killing selling them.

<!-- uid=409500401:27:1 -->

**LLENN:** Although, we've already got

<!-- uid=409500401:28:1 -->

**Fukaziroh:** Who cares! Let's sell 'em and

## Story 409500501 · Internet Auction

Event Story  
One Day in the Battlefield - Girls and GGO

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Welcome!

<!-- uid=409500501:1:1 -->

**LLENN:** I've got something I'd like to  
sell.

<!-- uid=409500501:2:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** Let me see... Okay...  
Here's my offer.

<!-- uid=409500501:3:1 -->

**Fukaziroh:** That's it?! That's barely enough  
for an appetizer, let alone a  
full-course buffet dinner...

<!-- uid=409500501:4:1 -->

**Fukaziroh:** Come on, you gotta cough up more  
than that for such rare gear!

<!-- uid=409500501:5:1 -->

**NPC Shopkeeper:** ...

<!-- uid=409500501:6:1 -->

**LLENN:** Don't bother, Fuka. NPCs can't  
respond outside of their set  
replies.

<!-- uid=409500501:7:1 -->

**Fukaziroh:** Grrrr... Guess it's the same  
as in ALO.

<!-- uid=409500501:8:1 -->

**Fukaziroh:** No point wasting our time here.  
Let's go find a player-run shop.

<!-- uid=409500501:9:1 -->

**Fukaziroh:** In ALO, players ran all sorts of  
shops! Item hawkers, smithies...

<!-- uid=409500501:10:1 -->

**LLENN:** Ooh, cool! Yeah, you can actually  
barter with other players.

<!-- uid=409500501:11:1 -->

**LLENN:** Hey, what about putting it up on  
a net auction or something?

<!-- uid=409500501:12:1 -->

**Fukaziroh:** Like a real life one, you mean?

<!-- uid=409500501:13:1 -->

**LLENN:** Nope! Players have set one up  
right here in GGO.

<!-- uid=409500501:14:1 -->

**LLENN:** You bid in-game with credits  
or RMT, and sometimes you  
can even negotiate the price!

<!-- uid=409500501:15:1 -->

**Fukaziroh:** Ooh, I like the sound of that!  
I've got credits, so let's do it!  
Maybe we'll nab a rare find!

<!-- uid=409500501:16:1 -->

**LLENN:** What about the buffet dinner?

<!-- uid=409500501:17:1 -->

**Fukaziroh:** Hehe, that's for celebrating after  
the tournament!

<!-- uid=409500501:18:1 -->

**LLENN:** The rules say you can only trade  
stuff of equal rank, and those  
ranks are based on rarity...

<!-- uid=409500501:19:1 -->

**LLENN:** But there's this weird thing where  
if the seller chooses not to pick  
an item...

<!-- uid=409500501:20:1 -->

**LLENN:** ...and unconditionally accepts the  
buyer's item, then the buyer's  
item can be one rank higher.

<!-- uid=409500501:21:1 -->

**Fukaziroh:** So by not picking what you want,  
you actually end up getting an item  
more valuable than if you had!

<!-- uid=409500501:22:1 -->

**LLENN:** Exactly!

<!-- uid=409500501:23:1 -->

**Fukaziroh:** That sounds awesome!  
Let's give it a shot!

<!-- uid=409500501:24:1 -->

**LLENN:** Hehe, sure thing!

<!-- uid=409500501:25:1 -->

**Fukaziroh:** I wonder what kinda fish we can  
reel in with this diving suit  
as bait...

<!-- uid=409500501:26:1 -->

## Story 409500701 · Still Not Enough

Event Story  
One Day in the Battlefield - Girls and GGO

**Pitohui:** Last one there's a rotten--

<!-- uid=409500701:1:1 -->

**M:** Wait.

<!-- uid=409500701:2:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Whaaat? We're almost to the nest!

<!-- uid=409500701:3:1 -->

**M:** That's not a nest; it's a lake.

<!-- uid=409500701:4:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Yeah, I got eyes. I can see that.  
Hope you brought your swimsuit, M.  
We're going for a dip!

<!-- uid=409500701:5:1 -->

**M:** I...can't right now. I've got too  
much heavy equipment in my  
inventory.

<!-- uid=409500701:6:1 -->

**M:** And in GGO, inventory items count  
towards your AGI and weight  
calculations.

<!-- uid=409500701:7:1 -->

**M:** I'd just sink right to the bottom.

<!-- uid=409500701:8:1 -->

**Pitohui:** What do I even keep you around  
for? Fine, I can do it by myself.  
Wait right here!

<!-- uid=409500701:9:1 -->

**M:** Oh, no you don't.  
You made a promise.

<!-- uid=409500701:10:1 -->

**M:** You swore you'd stay by my side  
and stay out of trouble.

<!-- uid=409500701:11:1 -->

**Pitohui:** You are such a pain in the ass  
sometimes, you know that?

<!-- uid=409500701:12:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Then what do you suggest we do?  
And do not say "go back," because  
I am NOT losing all this progress.

<!-- uid=409500701:13:1 -->

**M:** Well, we certainly can't keep  
going. Not if we have to swim.

<!-- uid=409500701:14:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Ugh... So let's figure out how to  
get you water-ready...

<!-- uid=409500701:15:1 -->

**M:** What are you doing? Why'd you pull  
up your HoloWindow?

<!-- uid=409500701:16:1 -->

**Pitohui:** The auctions. Duh. I figure there  
must be something here that'll  
let you swim...

<!-- uid=409500701:17:1 -->

**Pitohui:** And this way, we don't have to  
find an item shop. Once you buy an  
auction item, poof! There it is.

<!-- uid=409500701:18:1 -->

**M:** That's all fine and dandy, but you  
do realize the chances of you  
actually finding an item...

<!-- uid=409500701:19:1 -->

**M:** ...that lets an overweight avatar  
swim are close to ze--

<!-- uid=409500701:20:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Found it! See? Look: diving suits!  
TWO diving suits, to be exact!

<!-- uid=409500701:21:1 -->

**Pitohui:** And they look just like what  
I already have on! Hehe, this  
has got to be destiny!

<!-- uid=409500701:22:1 -->

**M:** Are you serious?

<!-- uid=409500701:23:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Now to bid so ridiculously high  
that no one else can come close  
to matching... Wait, what?

<!-- uid=409500701:24:1 -->

**M:** This isn't up for auction, but for  
barter. And the seller wants  
something even rarer for it...

<!-- uid=409500701:25:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Hmph, they aren't even trying  
to hide their greed!

<!-- uid=409500701:26:1 -->

**M:** Well, the deal automatically goes  
through as long as you offer  
something of appropriate value.

<!-- uid=409500701:27:1 -->

**M:** The item itself can be anything. I  
don't think they're being greedy,  
more like just fooling around.

<!-- uid=409500701:28:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Hehe... Well, in that case...  
They can have this.

<!-- uid=409500701:29:1 -->

**M:** H-Hold on!

<!-- uid=409500701:30:1 -->

## Story 409800801 · Challengers

**Kirito:** Eugeo!

<!-- uid=410401801:186:1 -->

**Leafa:** H-How can this be happening?

**Fenrir:** Grrraaaaaahhh!!!

<!-- uid=410401801:195:1 -->

<!-- uid=410401801:196:1 -->

**Alice:** We refuse to be a burden to you

<!-- uid=410401801:202:1 -->

<!-- uid=410401801:203:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...!

<!-- uid=410401801:204:1 -->

**Alice:** I am sure you too have noticed how

<!-- uid=410401801:205:1 -->

**Alice:** It is only a matter of time before

<!-- uid=410401801:206:1 -->

**Alice:** If you're going to forget us no

no reason to hesitate.

<!-- uid=410401801:207:1 -->

**Asuna:** I-I...

<!-- uid=410401801:208:1 -->

**Eugeo:** There you have it...  
Now, please. Hurry and kill us...

<!-- uid=410401801:209:1 -->

**Asuna:** We can't do that! And we're NOT

<!-- uid=410401801:210:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=410401801:211:1 -->

**Kirito:** You two are both terrible liars.

losing your memories.

<!-- uid=410401801:212:1 -->

**Kirito:** Or rather, that you were  
PRETENDING to lose them.

<!-- uid=410401801:213:1 -->

**Alice:** ...!

<!-- uid=410401801:214:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...!

<!-- uid=410401801:215:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito...?

<!-- uid=410401801:216:1 -->

**Kirito:** It was all just an act so we  
wouldn't feel bad about killing  
you two, right?

<!-- uid=410401801:217:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha, I've really got to hand it

<!-- uid=410401801:218:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Kirito...

<!-- uid=410401801:219:1 -->

**Kirito:** Eugeo... On the way here, you
