Silica's. I'm guessing you were...

<!-- uid=410401801:220:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...trying to show how bad your  
memory had become,

<!-- uid=410401801:221:1 -->

**Kirito:** but I'm afraid it had  
the opposite effect.

<!-- uid=410401801:222:1 -->

**Kirito:** We couldn't have mentioned Silica

remembered her name perfectly.

<!-- uid=410401801:223:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Ha ha... I guess I didn't think it

<!-- uid=410401801:224:1 -->

**Alice:** Eugeo!

<!-- uid=410401801:225:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Sorry, Alice... Looks like I'm  
done for anyway, whether  
they kill me or not...

<!-- uid=410401801:226:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I'm sorry I can't do the same

<!-- uid=410401801:227:1 -->

**Alice:** ...No matter. I shall end my own  
life, with the honor and dignity  
befitting an Integrity Knight.

<!-- uid=410401801:228:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wait, wait! Don't give up yet!

<!-- uid=410401801:229:1 -->

**Alice:** Then let us battle to the death.

<!-- uid=410401801:230:1 -->

**Kirito:** What? No, I'm not going to do

<!-- uid=410401801:231:1 -->

**Alice:** Please, Kirito. We can't bear to  
see you all so sad... to see this  
world fall apart because of us!

<!-- uid=410401801:232:1 -->

**Alice:** You must understand! This is  
the only solution left to us! We  
simply don't have any more time!

<!-- uid=410401801:233:1 -->

**Asuna:** No... It's too awful!  
Things can't end like this...

<!-- uid=410401801:234:1 -->

**Kirito:** Damn it...!

<!-- uid=410401801:235:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Isn't there anything we can do?

<!-- uid=410401801:236:1 -->

**Sinon:** I feel totally powerless...

<!-- uid=410401801:237:1 -->

**Leafa:** If only we knew how to get them  
back home...

<!-- uid=410401801:238:1 -->

**Urdr:** ...

<!-- uid=410401801:239:1 -->

**Urdr:** Fairy warriors and foreign  
elements who lead this world  
to destruction...

<!-- uid=410401801:240:1 -->

**Urdr:** The world has learned much from  
your journey and has continued to  
search for new power and methods.

<!-- uid=410401801:241:1 -->

**Urdr:** Now it has learned of something  
else. Foreign elements like you  
were once considered anathema.

<!-- uid=410401801:242:1 -->

**Urdr:** But, with enough time, it seems  
that even you can be accommodated.

<!-- uid=410401801:243:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wh-What are you saying?

<!-- uid=410401801:244:1 -->

**Urdr:** Through the connection you have  
forged with the fairies, the world  
has managed to trace...

<!-- uid=410401801:245:1 -->

**Urdr:** ...the path of quantum circuits  
you used to come here and to  
find your original time stream.

<!-- uid=410401801:246:1 -->

**Kirito:** What?! Then, you mean... you've  
found a way for them to go home?!

<!-- uid=410401801:247:1 -->

**Leafa:** Um, Urdr... I'm not sure that part  
about quantum circuits actually  
makes sense...

<!-- uid=410401801:248:1 -->

**Sinon:** Don't ruin the moment, Leafa. I'm  
pretty sure she's speaking on  
behalf of Cardinal now.

<!-- uid=410401801:249:1 -->

**Urdr:** This would not have happened  
without you and the fairies  
reaching an understanding...

<!-- uid=410401801:250:1 -->

**Kirito:** So then... during the defrag,  
Cardinal came to understand  
Alice and Eugeo as people?

<!-- uid=410401801:251:1 -->

**Asuna:** And that must have helped it find  
a way back to their world!

<!-- uid=410401801:252:1 -->

**Eugeo:** So... does this mean we can go  
home?

<!-- uid=410401801:253:1 -->

**Alice:** Can we really trust you, Urdr?

<!-- uid=410401801:254:1 -->

**Urdr:** Yes, foreign elements... Now that  
the world understands you, you  
are no longer foreign.

<!-- uid=410401801:255:1 -->

**Urdr:** Now, come. There's no time to  
waste. Both of you, take my hands.

<!-- uid=410401801:256:1 -->

**Kirito:** Eugeo, Alice...

<!-- uid=410401801:257:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Kirito... Everyone... Thank you.  
I guess this is goodbye...

<!-- uid=410401801:258:1 -->

**Kirito:** I guess so... Oh, here, take this  
Divine Object with you. It should  
help you recover.

<!-- uid=410401801:259:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Ha ha, good idea. Okay, I'll take  
Fenrir's Divine Object with me.

<!-- uid=410401801:260:1 -->

**Alice:** Thank you for all your help.  
I know that we said we would  
never forget one another...

<!-- uid=410401801:261:1 -->

**Alice:** But there's no telling what may  
happen once we return to our  
own world.

<!-- uid=410401801:262:1 -->

**Alice:** However... even if we do happen  
to forget you, I swear to you  
now...

<!-- uid=410401801:263:1 -->

**Alice:** Should we see each other again,  
I shall be honored to greet you  
as comrades in arms.

<!-- uid=410401801:264:1 -->

**Asuna:** Alice... The same goes for me too!

<!-- uid=410401801:265:1 -->

**Kirito:** Absolutely. This isn't  
farewell forever.

<!-- uid=410401801:266:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm sure that someday  
we'll see each other again...  
Take care, you two.

<!-- uid=410401801:267:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Thank you, Kirito, Asuna...  
All of you... Thank you!

<!-- uid=410401801:268:1 -->

**Alice:** I promise that someday,  
when our worlds cross paths...  
We shall meet again.

<!-- uid=410401801:269:1 -->

**Kirito:** You bet!

<!-- uid=410401801:270:1 -->

## Story 410500201 · To the 1F

Event Story  
Fairyland Saga -Tales of ALO-

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=410500201:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito! Over there!

<!-- uid=410500201:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** That tall man in blue clothing,  
huh...?

<!-- uid=410500201:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Whoa, look at that! The Town of

<!-- uid=410500201:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** How's that possible? Those  
buildings are immortal objects,  
and the whole town's a safe zone...

<!-- uid=410500201:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** He's clearly operating well  
beyond the bounds of a  
normal enemy NPC...

thing Klein mentioned?!

<!-- uid=410500201:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** It must be crazy strong to reach  
us all the way out here...

<!-- uid=410500201:9:1 -->

to him...

<!-- uid=410500201:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** I-Isn't that dangerous, Kirito?!

<!-- uid=410500201:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Maybe, but if he can talk like  
they say he can, I have to try.

<!-- uid=410500201:12:1 -->

**???:** So you've come flying here too.

<!-- uid=410500201:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh? What are you talking about?

<!-- uid=410500201:14:1 -->

**???:** Well, no matter. Aetherians,  
Erthers... All I want is a foe who  
will challenge and delight me.

**Kirito:** Who are you, anyway? What did

<!-- uid=410500201:16:1 -->

<!-- uid=410500201:18:1 -->

<!-- uid=410500201:20:1 -->

I travel the world in search  
of formidable opponents.

<!-- uid=410500201:21:1 -->

**Barbatos:** At times I fight for the Erthers,  
at other times for the Aetherians.  
For ages I have slain heroes.

<!-- uid=410500201:22:1 -->

**Barbatos:** Before I knew it,  
I found myself here...

<!-- uid=410500201:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh?

<!-- uid=410500201:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. That has nothing to do with  
ALO, and he can't be an NPC...  
He must be a time stream visitor.

<!-- uid=410500201:26:1 -->

when two warriors cross swords can  
true understanding be reached!

<!-- uid=410500201:27:1 -->

**Barbatos:** Now,  
let's see what you can do!

<!-- uid=410500201:28:1 -->

**Kirito:** What's with this guy?!

<!-- uid=410500201:29:1 -->

**Barbatos:** Go on! Show me a good time!

<!-- uid=410500201:30:1 -->

**Kirito:** Damn. No wonder he was able to

<!-- uid=410500201:31:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...I'm Kirito, of the Spriggans.

**Barbatos:** That name...

**Kirito:** Huh?!

cameras been getting you down?

<!-- uid=410800201:23:1 -->

case was a shut-in!

## Story 410800301 · The Real Meaning of the Activity

Event Story  
Halheim’s Invasion ~Release~

**Kazuto:** Who was it that taught you about  
OSSs and hiding your identity  
online?

<!-- uid=410800301:1:1 -->

**Seiko:** Oh, that was just our army's  
navigation gremlin.

<!-- uid=410800301:2:1 -->

**Seiko:** You fairies get a navigation pixie  
upon your first login if you're  
lucky, right?

<!-- uid=410800301:3:1 -->

**Kazuto:** We do... What's the gremlin's  
name?

<!-- uid=410800301:4:1 -->

**Seiko:** Thokk. She's usually about the  
size of my hand, but she can also  
grow to the size of a little girl.

<!-- uid=410800301:5:1 -->

**Kazuto:** And what does she say that she is?

<!-- uid=410800301:6:1 -->

**Seiko:** An NPC with high int...  
Uh, with high-level AI.

<!-- uid=410800301:7:1 -->

**Seiko:** I chat with the other demon NPCs  
too, but she's been my main partner,  
fighting and conversation-wise.

<!-- uid=410800301:8:1 -->

**Seiko:** Why do you ask?

<!-- uid=410800301:9:1 -->

**Suguha:** Hey, Kazuto, Thokk's the name of  
the giantess who appears in  
Helheim in Norse mythology.

<!-- uid=410800301:10:1 -->

**Seiko:** Huh... I didn't know that.

<!-- uid=410800301:11:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I think it was her who stalled  
the Sleeping Knights.

<!-- uid=410800301:12:1 -->

**Seiko:** Oh, I met them. The leader's  
a black-haired girl named Yuuki,  
right?

<!-- uid=410800301:13:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Apparently Thokk transformed from  
a little girl into a giantess right  
before they fought.

<!-- uid=410800301:14:1 -->

**Seiko:** A giantess? Really?! Wow, she never  
told me she had that kind of  
power.

<!-- uid=410800301:15:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Seiko, you're still a newbie to  
VRMMOs and haven't really chatted  
with many other players...

<!-- uid=410800301:16:1 -->

**Kazuto:** So I don't blame you for not  
noticing, but...

<!-- uid=410800301:17:1 -->

**Seiko:** But what?

<!-- uid=410800301:18:1 -->

**Kazuto:** That Thokk's not an NPC.  
She's a player.

<!-- uid=410800301:19:1 -->

**Seiko:** What? No way! Really?!

<!-- uid=410800301:20:1 -->

**Seiko:** B-But she told me she's an NPC!

<!-- uid=410800301:21:1 -->

**Kazuto:** And she might be. I can't say for  
sure right now, but I'd know if  
I talked to her.

<!-- uid=410800301:22:1 -->

**Seiko:** R-Right... But why would Thokk  
lie to me...?

<!-- uid=410800301:23:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Again, this is only speculation  
from what limited evidence  
I have, but...

<!-- uid=410800301:24:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I'd say Thokk is the creator of  
this Helheim's Invasion quest.

<!-- uid=410800301:25:1 -->

**Seiko:** Creator? Oh yeah, you asked me  
whether I came up with the quest  
back in ALO.

<!-- uid=410800301:26:1 -->

**Kazuto:** You're the only other player on  
the Helheim side. The creator  
isn't you, so I'd say it's her.

<!-- uid=410800301:27:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Is this girl pretty familiar with  
Helheim?

<!-- uid=410800301:28:1 -->

**Seiko:** Yeah, she really is. But I thought  
that was just because she's a  
navigation character.

<!-- uid=410800301:29:1 -->

**Kazuto:** And on top of that knowledge, she  
also has a bunch of strange  
abilities, right?

<!-- uid=410800301:30:1 -->

**Seiko:** She can detect things and open  
her HoloWindow to give orders  
to other demon NPCs...

<!-- uid=410800301:31:1 -->

**Suguha:** Sounds like she can do a lot.  
But it's weird how she's so  
obvious about it.

<!-- uid=410800301:32:1 -->

**Suguha:** She was chatting about herself to  
the Sleeping Knights too.

<!-- uid=410800301:33:1 -->

know right away that she's a  
player!

<!-- uid=410800301:34:1 -->

don't try hard to hide something  
usually want someone to notice.

<!-- uid=410800301:35:1 -->

and the creator of this quest?

<!-- uid=410800301:36:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Maybe... Or maybe something else.

## Story 410801001 · Thokk's Real Intention

Event Story  
Halheim’s Invasion ~Release~

**Kirito:** You've been working really closely

<!-- uid=410801001:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** You've seen her strength. She's a

<!-- uid=410801001:6:1 -->

<!-- uid=410801001:7:1 -->

<!-- uid=410801001:8:1 -->

**Thokk:** Did you... realize I was a player?!

<!-- uid=410801001:9:1 -->

**Makoto:** I'm really sorry, Thokk...  
I couldn't confront you about it.

<!-- uid=410801001:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** \*sigh\* I guess the jig is up...

<!-- uid=410801001:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** Plus, you didn't have any friends  
that were players. But info always  
leaks somehow...

<!-- uid=410801001:12:1 -->

**Makoto:** B-But, Thokk, this doesn't change

<!-- uid=410801001:13:1 -->

**Thokk:** I don't care about that kind of  
stuff... It's just a hassle.

<!-- uid=410801001:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** I only pretended to be an NPC and  
had someone else be the leader

<!-- uid=410801001:15:1 -->

**Makoto:** Thokk...

<!-- uid=410801001:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** But wow... I'm pretty shocked you

<!-- uid=410801001:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** So the reason you kept quiet about

keep it a secret?

<!-- uid=410801001:18:1 -->

**Thokk:** Hey, I'm not blaming Makoto.  
I just couldn't let things keep  
going the way they have.

<!-- uid=410801001:19:1 -->

**Thokk:** I didn't want people to know that  
I was a player at all. It always  
leads to trouble.

<!-- uid=410801001:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** I've had enough troubles like  
that in real life... At home and  
at school...

<!-- uid=410801001:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** Everything just exists to hurt me!  
Which is why... Which is why I  
made Halheim in this world!

<!-- uid=410801001:22:1 -->

<!-- uid=410801001:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...?!

<!-- uid=410801001:24:1 -->

<!-- uid=410801001:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** Was that on purpose?!

<!-- uid=410801001:26:1 -->

**Makoto:** Halheim... Halheim...  
Hal... Haru...?  
Haru-heim...?

<!-- uid=410801001:27:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wait a second... Thokk...  
Are you Haru?

<!-- uid=410801001:28:1 -->

**Thokk:** ...?!

## Story 410801101 · Real Thokk

Event Story  
Halheim’s Invasion ~Release~

**Thokk:** H-How... How do you know that?

<!-- uid=410801101:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Makoto... Who's Haru?

<!-- uid=410801101:2:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hey, I mentioned her in real life,  
remember? She's the girl in  
Hokkaido who became a shut-in.

<!-- uid=410801101:3:1 -->

**Thokk:** H-How...? How?!

<!-- uid=410801101:4:1 -->

**Thokk:** How do you know who I am, Makoto?!

<!-- uid=410801101:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** AAAAAAHHH!

<!-- uid=410801101:6:1 -->

**Makoto:** Haru, calm down! We've met before.

<!-- uid=410801101:7:1 -->

**Makoto:** I came to your house many times  
when you were being neglected...  
I was that police officer!

<!-- uid=410801101:8:1 -->

**Thokk:** Ah...

<!-- uid=410801101:9:1 -->

**Makoto:** Afterwards, I had to move away

about you again recently.

<!-- uid=410801101:10:1 -->

**Makoto:** I heard that you'd shut yourself  
indoors and had been hacking into  
computer networks...

<!-- uid=410801101:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** Ah... AHHHH!

<!-- uid=410801101:12:1 -->

**Makoto:** Haru... So it was you...

<!-- uid=410801101:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** In this game, you spelled your  
name as "Hal" in a take-off of the  
Norse for "Hel's Domain." Halheim.

<!-- uid=410801101:14:1 -->

**Makoto:** You wanted to create your own  
world. That's why you made this  
quest.

<!-- uid=410801101:15:1 -->

**Makoto:** You wanted to create a world so  
that people would recognize what  
you can do, didn't you?

<!-- uid=410801101:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** Stop it! Just stop talking!  
I can't take it anymore!

<!-- uid=410801101:17:1 -->

**Thokk:** Y-You're humiliating me! Stop!  
Stop analyzing me!

<!-- uid=410801101:18:1 -->

**Giantess Thokk:** Graaaoooh!

<!-- uid=410801101:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Whoa... So this is Thokk's true  
form... The one she used to wipe  
out the Sleeping Knights.

<!-- uid=410801101:20:1 -->

**Makoto:** Thokk, what are you doing?!

<!-- uid=410801101:21:1 -->

**Giantess Thokk:** Stop looking at me! Just leave me  
alone! You adults are all the same!

<!-- uid=410801101:22:1 -->

**Giantess Thokk:** You, my parents, everyone in the

<!-- uid=410801101:23:1 -->

**Giantess Thokk:** real world! You all ruin  
everything!

<!-- uid=410801101:24:1 -->

**Giantess Thokk:** Why did you have to destroy the  
world I worked so hard to make  
for myself?!

<!-- uid=410801101:25:1 -->

**Giantess Thokk:** I hate you all! Get out! Get out  
of my world! If you don't...

<!-- uid=410801101:26:1 -->

**Giantess Thokk:** I'll kill all of you!

<!-- uid=410801101:27:1 -->

**Makoto:** ...!

<!-- uid=410801101:27:2 -->

**Kirito:** Makoto... I think everything you  
just said about her was true.

<!-- uid=410801101:28:1 -->

**Kirito:** But I also think the neglect she  
received was pretty traumatic. It's  
a real sensitive topic for her.

<!-- uid=410801101:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** Right now, she's no different from  
a kid throwing a tantrum. 

<!-- uid=410801101:30:1 -->

**Kirito:** Maybe we  
should just back off and...

<!-- uid=410801101:31:1 -->

**Makoto:** ...No.

<!-- uid=410801101:32:1 -->

**Kirito:** Makoto...

**Makoto:** I realize that what I said might've

**Makoto:** The thing is, in the real world  
I've come across countless  
situations like this.

<!-- uid=410801101:35:1 -->

**Makoto:** Trying to tiptoe around issues,  
watching every word I say... It's  
stressful in many ways.

<!-- uid=410801101:36:1 -->

**Makoto:** But this is a virtual world!

another version of ourselves.

<!-- uid=410801101:37:1 -->

**Makoto:** Which is why... to hell with the

<!-- uid=410801101:38:1 -->

**Giantess Thokk:** Hah... Ha ha ha! Ever the police

<!-- uid=410801101:50:1 -->

**Giantess Thokk:** ...!

**Makoto:** Get ready, Giantess Thokk...

## Story 411400701 · A Clue

Event Story  
Moonlight Tsujigiri Hunt Part 2

**Yuuki:** Hello.

<!-- uid=411400701:1:1 -->

**Girl:** Huh?  
...Ran?! Is that you?!

<!-- uid=411400701:11:1 -->

...Oh, I remember now.

<!-- uid=411400701:12:1 -->

something fierce.

<!-- uid=411400701:13:1 -->

ground she walked on.

**Yuuki:** ...

## Story 411400801 · Relation with the Sleeping Knights

Event Story  
Moonlight Tsujigiri Hunt Part 2

**Yui:** One rumor says you can become a  
Swordmaster if you defeat 1,000

Event Story  
Party Crashers

**Kirito:** We're finally here.

Event Story  
Party Crashers

<!-- uid=411900101:8:1 -->

why not do something special?

<!-- uid=411900101:14:1 -->

I know pages have to obey them,

<!-- uid=411900101:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** but that also means that if they

<!-- uid=411900101:16:1 -->

<!-- uid=411900101:17:1 -->

Come on, let's go ask! You go

forgetting you don't always

## Story 411900201 · Permission

## Story 411900301 · Preparation

Event Story  
New Year's at the Swordcraft Academy

**Eugeo:** Golgorosso said it should be fine.

**Kirito:** That's great.

<!-- uid=411900301:2:1 -->

<!-- uid=411900301:22:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** On the contrary, Eugeo, I believe

<!-- uid=411900301:23:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Our inner strength and imagination  
help us to become stronger with  
our swords as well.

<!-- uid=411900301:24:1 -->

## Story 411900401 · Required Ingredients

New Year's at the Swordcraft Academy

## Story 411900501 · Where is mochi rice?

Event Story  
New Year's at the Swordcraft Academy

**Eugeo:** I've never heard of mochi rice  
before either.

<!-- uid=411900501:1:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I asked Golgorosso about it, and  
he didn't have the slightest clue.

<!-- uid=411900501:2:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I thought as much.

<!-- uid=411900501:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** We do have rice, at least.

<!-- uid=411900501:4:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Apparently it is grown in parts of  
the eastern empire, though it  
hardly constitutes a staple.

<!-- uid=411900501:5:1 -->

**Eugeo:** So mochi rice is a kind of rice?

<!-- uid=411900501:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Y-Yeah, basically. And we need it  
to make something essential for  
this osechi.

<!-- uid=411900501:7:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Osechi?

<!-- uid=411900501:8:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Kirito says it's the catch-all  
name for special foods made  
to celebrate the new year.

<!-- uid=411900501:9:1 -->

**Eugeo:** He has a habit of spouting off  
strange sacred words sometimes...

<!-- uid=411900501:10:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Now I see. So what is the name of  
this particular dish?

<!-- uid=411900501:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Zoni.

<!-- uid=411900501:12:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Zoni... I've definitely never  
heard that name before.  
What kind of dish is it?

<!-- uid=411900501:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, um... It's basically a soup  
with all sorts of ingredients,

<!-- uid=411900501:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** and the kinds of vegetables, meat,  
and fish added to it differ across  
regions and families.

<!-- uid=411900501:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Even the flavor of the soup itself  
can be completely different.

<!-- uid=411900501:16:1 -->

**Eugeo:** How can something that differs so  
much from place to place still be  
called the same thing?

<!-- uid=411900501:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** The one thing all zoni has in  
common is mochi, which is  
made by boiling mochi rice.

<!-- uid=411900501:18:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I see...

<!-- uid=411900501:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Basically, zoni is like the star  
player of the osechi lineup.

<!-- uid=411900501:20:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I understand. I'll try asking my  
family sometime to see if anyone  
there has heard of it.

<!-- uid=411900501:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Thank you, Liena.

<!-- uid=411900501:22:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Alright, I'm off to my lecture.  
Let's discuss this more later.

<!-- uid=411900501:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sounds good.

<!-- uid=411900501:24:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...

<!-- uid=411900501:25:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Kirito, are you sure you haven't  
got your memory back?

<!-- uid=411900501:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** Y-Yeah, I'm sure.

<!-- uid=411900501:27:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Because you seem to know an awful  
lot about dishes that nobody else  
has ever even heard of...

<!-- uid=411900501:28:1 -->

**Kirito:** I-It's just like my Aincrad-style  
swordplay. My body remembers,  
even if my conscious mind doesn't.

<!-- uid=411900501:29:1 -->

have been keenly interested in  
food and ingredients and stuff.

<!-- uid=411900501:30:1 -->

dig so deeply into food matters.  
Not even nobles care that much.

<!-- uid=411900501:31:1 -->

**Kirito:** W-Well, you know... Sometimes, I  
just get homesick for the taste of  
real food... \*mumble mumble\*

<!-- uid=411900501:32:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Did you say something?

<!-- uid=411900501:33:1 -->

**Kirito:** U-Uh, no, nothing.

## Story 412400101 · Dive Into AR Again

Restart! Ordinal Scale Part 1

<!-- uid=412400101:1:1 -->

**Kazuto:** A new kind of MMORPG that uses  
augmented reality technology  
instead of virtual reality.

<!-- uid=412400101:2:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Played with multi-wearable devices  
called Augmas, this game attracted  
a huge player base thanks to

<!-- uid=412400101:3:1 -->

**Kazuto:** the innovative new kind of  
experience it provided, but its  
popularity didn't last long

<!-- uid=412400101:4:1 -->

**Kazuto:** thanks to a strange event that  
caused OS players to suffer from  
a mysterious form of memory loss.

<!-- uid=412400101:5:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Despite never being publicized,  
most of its player base still left,  
probably due to bad word of mouth.

<!-- uid=412400101:6:1 -->

**Kazuto:** After seeing what happened to  
Asuna and Klein, I never thought  
I'd use my Augma again either.

<!-- uid=412400101:7:1 -->

**Kazuto:** However, it's now been some time  
since then, and both OS and the  
Augmas have been proven to be

<!-- uid=412400101:8:1 -->

**Kazuto:** completely safe by an impartial  
committee. Reports said that the  
malicious effects the game was

<!-- uid=412400101:9:1 -->

**Kazuto:** rumored to initially have had on  
people's minds have been patched,  
and could never happen again...

**Kazuto:** Of course, we weren't much  
inclined to try OS again right  
away after hearing those reports,

<!-- uid=412400101:11:1 -->

**Kazuto:** but we ended up deciding to give

## Story 413000801 · Searching for Spring Water

Event Story

<!-- uid=413000801:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** ALO was made directly from a copy  
of SAO's Cardinal System...but  
Asuka Empire was based off of

<!-- uid=413000801:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** the Seed...so most of its quests

<!-- uid=413000801:8:1 -->

than on being easy to play.

<!-- uid=413000801:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** Kind of like how young girls like  
to share secrets with friends but  
then hide them from everyone else?

<!-- uid=413000801:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Exactly. So if a spring related  
quest were to be realistic...it  
would take geology into account.

<!-- uid=413000801:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Things like where water comes from  
depending on the slope, the soil,  
and groundwater flow, or how

<!-- uid=413000801:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** rainwater passes through volcanic  
ash and rocky areas, and becomes a  
spring when it's stopped by clay.

<!-- uid=413000801:14:1 -->

**Leafa:** I see. So then our hint would be

## Story 413600101 · Captured Princess

Event Story  
Save Fairy Princess Titania

**Kirito:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=413600101:1:1 -->

**Yui:** What is it, Daddy?

<!-- uid=413600101:3:1 -->

**Yui:** You mean the one called  
"The Imprisoned Princess"?

<!-- uid=413600101:4:1 -->

choose someone from your party to  
be, well, an imprisoned princess.

<!-- uid=413600101:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** The princess is then imprisoned  
at the top of a tall tower, and  
everyone else has to rescue her.

<!-- uid=413600101:6:1 -->

**Yui:** Sounds like a very archetypical  
damsel in distress scenario.

<!-- uid=413600101:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Pretty much. Anyway, I was just  
wondering who I should ask to be  
the princess.

<!-- uid=413600101:8:1 -->

**Yui:** Well, since all the player playing  
the princess has to do is sit  
around the tower and wait,

<!-- uid=413600101:9:1 -->

**Yui:** theoretically it could be anyone,  
right?

<!-- uid=413600101:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Not in this case. There was also  
an addendum that said...

<!-- uid=413600101:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** The princess must in turn take  
proactive measures to escape  
the tower on her own.

<!-- uid=413600101:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** If she simply waits around to be  
rescued, this quest will be  
impossible to complete.

<!-- uid=413600101:13:1 -->

anything about what sort of  
abilities the princess would need.

<!-- uid=413600101:14:1 -->

<!-- uid=413600101:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Since we can choose any female  
party member we like, that makes  
it even harder to narrow it down.

<!-- uid=413600101:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** But I think it's the princess's  
skill and abilities that will be  
key to beating this quest.

<!-- uid=413600101:17:1 -->

**Yui:** I see... But if we don't know what  
the quest will entail, then the  
answer is obvious, isn't it?

<!-- uid=413600101:18:1 -->

<!-- uid=413600101:19:1 -->

**Yui:** Right!

<!-- uid=413600101:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** You've got a point. Asuna's a  
healer and a skilled damage dealer  
with a real head for strategy.

<!-- uid=413600101:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** She's also a great solo player  
who knows how to adapt to all  
sorts of different situations.

<!-- uid=413600101:22:1 -->

obvious choice for a solo role.

<!-- uid=413600101:23:1 -->

<!-- uid=413600101:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** You don't?

<!-- uid=413600101:25:1 -->

<!-- uid=413600101:26:1 -->

than anyone else!

<!-- uid=413600101:27:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...Ha ha, now I see!

<!-- uid=413600101:28:1 -->

**Kirito:** Thanks, Yui. You make an excellent

<!-- uid=413600101:29:1 -->

**Yui:** Hehe! Well, of course I do, Daddy!

for nothing!

<!-- uid=413600101:30:1 -->

Splashing Swordswomen

**Ronie:** Yes! We'll just consider this

## Story 414600601 · Dual Wielding Photon Sword

Event Story  
New Start in the World of Mixed Steel

**Rain:** What? Why are you giving me two  
Photon Swords? Are you asking me  
to dual wield them?

<!-- uid=414600601:1:1 -->

**Liz:** For now, we just want to see  
how well you can handle them  
and we'll take it from there.

<!-- uid=414600601:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Not even Philia or I dual wield  
swords here in GGO.

<!-- uid=414600601:3:1 -->

only one capable of doing it in  
such a gun-heavy world.

<!-- uid=414600601:4:1 -->

**Rain:** Hmm... The action itself feels  
more or less like SAO or ALO,  
so I guess I can use them.

<!-- uid=414600601:5:1 -->

**Rain:** But how do you expect me to deal  
with bullets? I doubt I can just  
deflect them like you, Kirito.

<!-- uid=414600601:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's fine. You don't have to  
learn anything tricky like that  
since it'll be such a big battle.

<!-- uid=414600601:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** We'll be bringing in tank-class  
players to shore up our defense,  
so I want you to focus on offense.

<!-- uid=414600601:8:1 -->

**Rain:** I can do that, but I'm still not  
sure how much help I'm going to  
be with these Photon Swords.

<!-- uid=414600601:9:1 -->

**Liz:** Well, first, let's see how fast  
you can cut with them. I made  
equipment that can measure you.

<!-- uid=414600601:10:1 -->

**Rain:** So basically, you want to see how  
big of a combo I can do with them  
in the shortest length of time?

<!-- uid=414600601:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Right. There are no sword skills  
in GGO, so you'll have to control  
them manually.

<!-- uid=414600601:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** We just want to see how far you  
can go with your raw abilities  
alone.

<!-- uid=414600601:13:1 -->

**Rain:** Uh, alright. I get the feeling my  
swords are way trickier to use  
than what you gave Seven, though.

<!-- uid=414600601:14:1 -->

**Rain:** Hyaaah!

<!-- uid=414600601:15:1 -->

**Liz:** Time's up! Stop swinging!

<!-- uid=414600601:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Based on the number of slashes,  
I'd say... she should be able to  
handle ten.

<!-- uid=414600601:17:1 -->

**Liz:** Got it! Ten guns, coming right up!  
I'll be back with them in a sec!

<!-- uid=414600601:18:1 -->

**Rain:** Guns? Hold on a sec. Are you  
planning to give that many guns?

<!-- uid=414600601:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Of course. Why do you sound so  
surprised?

<!-- uid=414600601:20:1 -->

**Rain:** A-Are you crazy? You expect me to  
hold ten different guns at the  
same time? I can't do that!

<!-- uid=414600601:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** What are you talking about? In  
ALO, you can control a thousand  
weapons at once, can't you?

<!-- uid=414600601:22:1 -->

**Rain:** You mean with Thousand Rain? That  
name's an exaggeration. I can't  
literally control that many!

<!-- uid=414600601:23:1 -->

**Rain:** Seriously, how am I supposed to  
carry that many guns? It's not  
like I have ten hands.

<!-- uid=414600601:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** You won't have to. You'll switch  
them out while you make it look  
like you're using two swords.

<!-- uid=414600601:25:1 -->

**Rain:** So your plan is for me to distract  
them with my Photon Swords while  
I use guns to shoot them?

<!-- uid=414600601:26:1 -->

**Rain:** I don't think I have it in me to  
pull off an illusion like that. I  
think the enemy will figure it out.

<!-- uid=414600601:27:1 -->

**Kirito:** Here's the catch: the guns Liz is  
getting all look like swords.  
They just shoot from the tip.

<!-- uid=414600601:28:1 -->

**Rain:** What?

<!-- uid=414600601:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** Basically, as you're swinging them  
around, you'll be firing them  
off one after another.

<!-- uid=414600601:30:1 -->

**Kirito:** You're so good with your hands,  
it'll look like you're switching  
between them in an instant.

<!-- uid=414600601:31:1 -->

**Kirito:** All of this will be happening so  
fast that most players' eyes won't  
even be able to keep up.

<!-- uid=414600601:32:1 -->

**Kirito:** To them, it'll look like you're  
shooting a thousand bullets from  
two Photon Swords!

<!-- uid=414600601:33:1 -->

**Rain:** What?! That's insane! You really  
expect me to pull that off?!

<!-- uid=414600601:34:1 -->

## Story 414600901 · No Shame

Event Story  
New Start in the World of Mixed Steel

**Death Gun Lookalike:** Huh?!

<!-- uid=414600901:1:1 -->

**Death Gun Lookalike:** What the hell's happening out on  
the frontlines?

<!-- uid=414600901:2:1 -->

**American Player:** Chief, we've got a problem! Things  
are getting crazy out here!

<!-- uid=414600901:3:1 -->

**Death Gun Lookalike:** What is it? What could be worse  
than them taking out our tanks?!

<!-- uid=414600901:4:1 -->

**American Player:** There's a lone girl running around  
popping off shot after shot like  
it's a freaking fireworks show!

<!-- uid=414600901:5:1 -->

**Death Gun Lookalike:** Shots? Not beams?

<!-- uid=414600901:6:1 -->

**American Player:** No, sir! This girl is different  
from the one before. She's firing  
bullets out of her Photon Swords!

<!-- uid=414600901:7:1 -->

**American Player:** We figured we could take her out  
if we closed in, but she's wiped  
out everyone we've thrown at her!

<!-- uid=414600901:8:1 -->

**Death Gun Lookalike:** What the hell? Just what kind of  
person are we dealing with here?!

<!-- uid=414600901:9:1 -->

**American Player:** I don't know, but she's bad news!  
At first, we thought she was just  
swinging her swords fast.

<!-- uid=414600901:10:1 -->

**American Player:** But then, out of nowhere, everyone  
got riddled with bullets!

<!-- uid=414600901:11:1 -->

**Death Gun Lookalike:** I don't get it. This is GGO we're  
talking about here.

<!-- uid=414600901:12:1 -->

**Death Gun Lookalike:** There's not supposed to be any  
magic or sword skills like in  
other games!

<!-- uid=414600901:13:1 -->

**American Player:** But it's true! We've lost a lot of  
good men to her! She'll put us on  
the defensive if we don't act!

<!-- uid=414600901:14:1 -->

**Death Gun Lookalike:** You don't think I know that?  
Guess that leaves me with no  
other choice.

<!-- uid=414600901:15:1 -->

**Death Gun Lookalike:** Take half of our remaining forces  
and redeploy them to the  
southeastern edge of these fields.

<!-- uid=414600901:16:1 -->

**American Player:** The southeast? But that's where  
you said the ground was brittle  
because of that cave, right?

<!-- uid=414600901:17:1 -->

**American Player:** What do you plan to do by bringing  
our troops out there?

<!-- uid=414600901:18:1 -->

**Death Gun Lookalike:** We'll use them to lure the enemy.  
When the time's just right,  
we'll blast open the ground.

<!-- uid=414600901:19:1 -->

**American Player:** What? But people will get killed  
on our side too! You're just  
going to sacrifice them?!

<!-- uid=414600901:20:1 -->

**Death Gun Lookalike:** Our orders from the top are to  
inflict death penalties on as many  
Japanese players as we can.

<!-- uid=414600901:21:1 -->

**Death Gun Lookalike:** That and destroy their equipment  
if possible. It doesn't matter how  
we get the job done.

<!-- uid=414600901:22:1 -->

**Death Gun Lookalike:** Besides, there are naturally more  
American GGO players than Japanese  
ones.

<!-- uid=414600901:23:1 -->

**Death Gun Lookalike:** We might as well use those numbers  
to our advantage to bring down as  
many of them as we can.

<!-- uid=414600901:24:1 -->

**American Player:** ...

<!-- uid=414600901:25:1 -->

**Death Gun Lookalike:** This isn't a real battle. As long  
as we get our reward, what does  
it matter how we do it?

<!-- uid=414600901:26:1 -->

**American Player:** Roger that...

<!-- uid=414600901:27:1 -->


## Story 414601001 · A Invitation to Join

Event Story  
New Start in the World of Mixed Steel

**Rain:** Thousand Burst!

<!-- uid=414601001:1:1 -->

**American Player A:** Aaaaaaugh!

<!-- uid=414601001:3:1 -->

**Liz:** Great! I knew you could do it,

<!-- uid=414601001:6:1 -->

<!-- uid=414601001:13:1 -->

<!-- uid=414601001:17:1 -->

not like it's actual war anyway.

resorting to it.

<!-- uid=414601001:19:1 -->

case, it'd be dangerous to follow

<!-- uid=414601001:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Wait... Let's go after them.

thinking the same thing.

**Asuna:** Actually, it's more like I just

<!-- uid=414601001:26:1 -->

<!-- uid=414601001:27:1 -->

be anything to hold up the ground  
above it in the first place.

<!-- uid=414601001:29:1 -->

**Sinon:** If we can latch onto a pillar  
right when the ground gives,  
only the enemy will fall in!

<!-- uid=414601001:30:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's a really smart plan. Only  
problem is that not everyone can  
use the wire action.

<!-- uid=414601001:31:1 -->

**Kirito:** They might get suspicious if we  
only send a few people, but let's  
try it and see what happens!

<!-- uid=414601001:32:1 -->

**Sinon:** Okay!

<!-- uid=414601001:33:1 -->

Midgard Maiden Warriors ~First Summer~

**Asuna:** Kirito! They're coming  
from behind you too!

## Story 414900401 · Place of Origin

Event Story  
Midgard Maiden Warriors ~First Summer~

though...?

though.

**Yui:** I see. I understand now.

been any real updates lately.

## Story 415200101 · Hell Fire Urdr

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Rising~

**Kirito:** Hey, Makoto. Sorry to drag you out  
here today.

<!-- uid=415200101:1:1 -->

**Makoto:** It's fine. These are serious  
problems that concern me, too,  
so I'm happy to talk.

<!-- uid=415200101:2:1 -->

**Makoto:** I'm guessing you two want to  
discuss what to do about  
Hellfire Urdr, right?

<!-- uid=415200101:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Mmhm. This whole thing started  
because of a unique quest that  
we'd been working on.

<!-- uid=415200101:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** As part of a story involving a  
Divine Object, another personality  
emerged out of Urdr.

<!-- uid=415200101:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** That became Hellfire Urdr.  
Her spirit was split off  
completely from the real one.

<!-- uid=415200101:6:1 -->

**Makoto:** Right. She was revived as a new  
enemy in that realm Thokk  
created, Helheim, as I remember.

<!-- uid=415200101:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. We reckon she might've  
reacted to Thokk's Divine Object,  
Chronos Zone.

<!-- uid=415200101:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** The quest name referenced a Divine  
Object, so it probably wasn't  
a coincidence, to say the least.

<!-- uid=415200101:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** It seems that Hellfire Urdr is  
trapped by her anger.

<!-- uid=415200101:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** If we have to, we could dispel  
that anger by defeating her, but  
I don't want it to come to that.

<!-- uid=415200101:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Me neither. At the end of the day,  
she's a victim of ALO and the  
effects from our quest.

<!-- uid=415200101:12:1 -->

**Makoto:** I know Thokk feels responsible  
for what happened, too.

<!-- uid=415200101:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** Like if she hadn't created  
Helheim, maybe Hellfire Urdr  
wouldn't have come back.

<!-- uid=415200101:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Honestly, I think it was going to  
happen one way or another.  
Her anger is relentless.

<!-- uid=415200101:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** If it wasn't this, something else  
would've just riled her up one way  
or another.

<!-- uid=415200101:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's my theory, at least.

<!-- uid=415200101:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** I agree. That's why I think we  
need to focus on what we're going  
to do about it moving forward.

<!-- uid=415200101:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** Makes sense. Do you two have any  
concrete ideas about what you want  
to do, though?

<!-- uid=415200101:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** We do. The problem is Hellfire  
Urdr exists in the same plane as  
Urdr the Queen of the Lake.

<!-- uid=415200101:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** As long as they have to coexist,  
there's a risk some unforeseen  
trouble could crop up eventually.

<!-- uid=415200101:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** So we were thinking maybe we could  
convert her into another game  
entirely to avoid that.

<!-- uid=415200101:22:1 -->

**Makoto:** Meaning...you two want to transfer  
her out of ALO and into something  
else, basically?

<!-- uid=415200101:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah. She might be an NPC, but Yui  
and Strea have been able to convert  
between games before.

<!-- uid=415200101:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** As long as she has a proper AI,  
it should be possible.

<!-- uid=415200101:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** We have experience with this.  
We've saved NPCs right before they  
were about to disappear.

<!-- uid=415200101:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** We just had to extract their data  
from the system, save it locally,  
and then make the transfer.

<!-- uid=415200101:27:1 -->

**Makoto:** Interesting. I didn't know that.  
Sounds like a good idea to me,  
then.

<!-- uid=415200101:28:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm glad you think so. In that  
case, there's something we'd like  
to ask you to do.

**Makoto:** Huh? What is it...?

since Hellfire Urdr will still be  
angry even after converting.

<!-- uid=415200201:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** That means we probably have to  
send her to a new world made from  
scratch or it won't work.

<!-- uid=415200201:14:1 -->

she can safely release that anger  
as part of a new story.

<!-- uid=415200201:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's where you come in, Thokk.  
We were hoping you could maybe  
create that new world for her.

<!-- uid=415200201:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** I know. That's what Makoto said.  
I'm telling you, you're crazy!  
That's impossible!

<!-- uid=415200201:17:1 -->

**Thokk:** I'm just a middle schooler who  
tinkers with programs. There's no  
way I can build a whole VRMMO!

<!-- uid=415200201:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** But according to Kirito, your  
game design skills with Helheim  
are really, really good.

<!-- uid=415200201:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Surely, if anyone knows how to  
use the Seed well enough to pull  
it off, he figures it's you.

<!-- uid=415200201:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** Wh-What did you just say?!

<!-- uid=415200201:21:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hey, I think she's excited. I just  
saw her eyes light up!

<!-- uid=415200201:22:1 -->

**Thokk:** N-No, I'm not! I was just curious,  
that's all!

<!-- uid=415200201:23:1 -->


## Story 415200301 · Thokk's Distress

Nibelungen Purgatory ~Rising~

## Story 415200401 · A Reawakened Omen

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Rising~

**Makoto:** What's the harm in trying at  
least? There are some things you  
can only know by doing.

<!-- uid=415200401:1:1 -->

**Makoto:** Kirito and Asuna said they'd be  
there to support you, too. You  
won't have to do it all alone.

<!-- uid=415200401:2:1 -->

**Makoto:** And that Pooka girl... You know,  
the one you beat before.

<!-- uid=415200401:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** She said her team in the real  
world would also be there to  
help. That's reassuring.

<!-- uid=415200401:4:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yeah, Seven...that American genius  
who's researching emotions and  
sociology within VRMMOs.

<!-- uid=415200401:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** But her team is made up of real  
technicians who are way better at  
what they do than me.

<!-- uid=415200401:6:1 -->

**Thokk:** I'd feel so bad ordering a bunch  
of pros like that around. I can't  
ask them for help.

<!-- uid=415200401:7:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hmm... I get where you're coming  
from, but here's the thing.

<!-- uid=415200401:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** It's not like you're going to be  
building some game that'll be  
released to the public, right?

<!-- uid=415200401:9:1 -->

**Makoto:** Your main goal is just to make a  
safe place to save Hellfire  
Urdr before it's too late.

<!-- uid=415200401:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** And I get that! Really!

<!-- uid=415200401:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** But people like Kirito, Asuna,  
Leafa, Yuuki, and more will still  
end up visiting it, right?

<!-- uid=415200401:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** Thinking about that makes me  
really nervous, you know?

<!-- uid=415200401:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** I guess they'll come check it out,  
yeah. They're like family. It's  
only natural they'd be interested.

<!-- uid=415200401:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** Exactly! I can't put any old VRMMO  
together, not when I know there'll  
be such talented players in it!

<!-- uid=415200401:15:1 -->

**Thokk:** I know I'm still just an amateur,  
but we're talking about my pride  
as a game developer here!

<!-- uid=415200401:16:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wow, I didn't realize you were  
thinking from that perspective.  
Color me impressed.

<!-- uid=415200401:17:1 -->

**Thokk:** Well, I am. Like, I'm sure if they  
played it, they wouldn't say  
anything mean to my face.

<!-- uid=415200401:18:1 -->

**Thokk:** But I'm scared they'd really feel  
there wasn't much to play or it'd  
be rough around the edges.

<!-- uid=415200401:19:1 -->

**Thokk:** Argh, I can't stand it!  
I'm heckin' anxious right now!

<!-- uid=415200401:20:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wait, what was that word you--  
OH, I get it. The slang you kids  
use is so cute. I love it.

<!-- uid=415200401:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** I'm serious! This is a big deal to  
me!

<!-- uid=415200401:22:1 -->

**Makoto:** I hear you, I promise.  
But still...

<!-- uid=415200401:23:1 -->

**Thokk:** But nothing! I'm scared and this  
isn't going away anytime soon!

<!-- uid=415200401:24:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh dear, just when I thought we  
were getting you motivated to  
at least try...

<!-- uid=415200401:25:1 -->

**Thokk:** Eeek!

<!-- uid=415200401:26:1 -->

**Makoto:** What was that explosion?!

<!-- uid=415200401:27:1 -->

**Skull:** Ladies, I've got bad news! That  
big hunk of ice looks like it's  
about to fall apart!

<!-- uid=415200401:28:1 -->

**Grimm:** That fire giantess is trying  
to reawaken!

<!-- uid=415200401:29:1 -->

**Thokk:** Crap! It's Hellfire Urdr!

<!-- uid=415200401:30:1 -->

**Makoto:** Ugh, so the time's finally come,  
huh?

<!-- uid=415200401:31:1 -->

**Thokk:** Makoto, wh-what are we going  
to do?

<!-- uid=415200401:32:1 -->

**Makoto:** We need to figure out what's going  
on first and contact Kirito and  
the others while we're at it.

<!-- uid=415200401:33:1 -->

**Makoto:** But we shouldn't count on them  
being able to help much in this  
situation.

<!-- uid=415200401:34:1 -->

**Makoto:** They're all fairy players, so  
hardly any of them will be able  
to make to Helheim, I imagine.

<!-- uid=415200401:35:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yeah, good point...

<!-- uid=415200401:36:1 -->

**Makoto:** ...

<!-- uid=415200401:37:1 -->

**Thokk:** ...

<!-- uid=415200401:38:1 -->

**Makoto:** All quiet on the home front right  
now, from the look of it.

<!-- uid=415200401:39:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yeah. I wonder if we could save her  
to local storage like Kirito  
mentioned earlier.

<!-- uid=415200401:40:1 -->

**Makoto:** We don't have that kind of time.

to life. We've got one choice.

<!-- uid=415200401:41:1 -->

**Thokk:** I'll talk to Asuna and the others.  
I need to discuss developing that  
new VRMMO with them anyway.

do it, are you? You can't do that!

<!-- uid=415200401:43:1 -->

**Thokk:** You don't know what you're talking  
about! You don't get how hard it  
is for people to make video games!

So how can you--

**Thokk:** I never said I wouldn't do it!

<!-- uid=415200401:46:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wait, you didn't? Then...?

## Story 415200501 · Nibelungen Purgatory

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Rising~

**Kirito:** New Project Proposal, Codename:  
Nibelungen Purgatory.

<!-- uid=415200501:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** This is really impressive, Thokk!  
I can't believe you came up with  
it in just a few days!

<!-- uid=415200501:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, I'm already intrigued just  
seeing the title and cover! You  
did great!

<!-- uid=415200501:3:1 -->

**Thokk:** I... I'm glad you two like it  
so far...

<!-- uid=415200501:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Alright, let's delve into the  
nitty gritty details and see--

<!-- uid=415200501:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** W-Wait! Before you do that!

<!-- uid=415200501:6:2 -->

**Kirito:** Huh? What is it?

<!-- uid=415200501:7:1 -->

**Thokk:** Would it be good enough if this  
new game was only designed for  
what Urdr needs?

<!-- uid=415200501:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Uh, well... That's definitely  
important, I'll give you that.

<!-- uid=415200501:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** But I hope it's something that'll  
still be fun to play, especially  
with you making it, Thokk.

<!-- uid=415200501:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** I knew you'd say that...

<!-- uid=415200501:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh? What is it...?

<!-- uid=415200501:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** N-No! I'm glad you have high hopes  
for me. I just don't know if I'll  
be able to live up to them.

<!-- uid=415200501:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** What are you talking about, Thokk?  
You made Helheim singlehandedly.  
That's no mean feat!

<!-- uid=415200501:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sure, the Seed can automate a lot  
of things, but you still created  
an area all by yourself.

<!-- uid=415200501:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** He's right. When I visited it, I  
was impressed at how well made it  
was. The NPCs were great, too!

<!-- uid=415200501:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** Hrm...

<!-- uid=415200501:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** I don't get it. Why would you  
draft up this proposal unless you  
actually planned to make it?

<!-- uid=415200501:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's the thing: she hasn't made  
any more progress knowing that  
you guys will be interested in it.

<!-- uid=415200501:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Why? Does knowing we'll be playing  
it add more pressure? Thokk, you  
shouldn't worry about that.

<!-- uid=415200501:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** Look, I'm the type who doesn't  
like to show my plans to those who  
are going to play my stuff.

<!-- uid=415200501:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** I'd rather they enjoy it fresh  
when it's all developed and ready  
to actually be played, you know?

<!-- uid=415200501:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, jeez. I had no idea.

<!-- uid=415200501:23:1 -->

**Makoto:** Thokk, you can't keep waffling on  
this issue forever. We have to  
figure out what we're going to do.

<!-- uid=415200501:24:1 -->

**Makoto:** The way you're talking, it sounds  
to me like you haven't made up  
your mind either way, have you?

<!-- uid=415200501:25:1 -->

**Thokk:** L-Leave me alone! Who asked for  
your opinion, anyway?

<!-- uid=415200501:26:1 -->

**Makoto:** You really don't have to debate it  
so much in your head. Just think  
of it as a great opportunity.

<!-- uid=415200501:27:1 -->

**Makoto:** I'll tell you, Thokk. Nobody is  
good at what they do from the  
start. Not even us grown ups.

<!-- uid=415200501:28:1 -->

**Makoto:** You've got such wonderful help.  
Take advantage of it! Use it to  
grow and improve bit by bit.

<!-- uid=415200501:29:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's how you get better at  
anything: by pushing yourself and  
learning as you go along.

<!-- uid=415200501:30:1 -->

**Thokk:** Ugh, I can't believe I'm getting  
lectured on how to grow up by  
someone like you. This sucks.

<!-- uid=415200501:31:1 -->

**Makoto:** What did you just say?! I'm just  
trying to help here!

<!-- uid=415200501:32:1 -->

**Kirito:** L-Let's change the subject. Where  
does this "Nibelungen Purgatory"  
title come from?

<!-- uid=415200501:33:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm guessing Nibelungen comes from  
Wagner's The Ring of the Nibelung,  
which is based on Norse sagas.

<!-- uid=415200501:34:1 -->

**Makoto:** Right. The idea is to basically do  
what Wagner did with Norse myths,  
but with the world of ALO instead.

<!-- uid=415200501:35:1 -->

**Makoto:** Which is to say, take the existing  
foundation of ALO and expand it  
into new story territory.

<!-- uid=415200501:36:1 -->

**Asuna:** That makes sense. So then why is  
"purgatory" in the name, too?

<!-- uid=415200501:37:1 -->

**Makoto:** Thokk wants to create her new world  
to leave a real mark on those who  
play the game.

<!-- uid=415200501:38:1 -->

**Makoto:** It combines aspects of heaven and  
the underworld. What sits between  
them? Purgatory, of course.

<!-- uid=415200501:39:1 -->

**Kirito:** Haha, wow, that's elaborate.  
I agree that it definitely makes  
a strong first impression.

<!-- uid=415200501:40:1 -->

**Thokk:** That's all my plan is right now,  
impressions. It's all up in the  
air, so don't get too attached.

<!-- uid=415200501:41:1 -->


## Story 415200601 · Door To Another Dimension

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Rising~

**Thokk:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=415200601:1:1 -->

**Makoto:** What's up? You worried about  
something else now?

**Thokk:** I was just thinking about the  
makeup of the whole team going

**Thokk:** I know game development is a team  
effort, but I really doubt I'll  
get along with them...

<!-- uid=415200601:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** I'm just a middle schooler with  
bad social skills. I shouldn't be  
running the show here!

<!-- uid=415200601:6:1 -->

**Makoto:** It's going to take courage for  
sure. That's where strength comes  
from: overcoming tough obstacles.

<!-- uid=415200601:7:1 -->

**Thokk:** Grr, easy for you to say. You're  
a grown up. You're not the one  
who has to pull this off somehow.

<!-- uid=415200601:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** Yes, but with age comes wisdom.  
But it's not just you I'm thinking  
about here, either.

<!-- uid=415200601:9:1 -->

**Makoto:** Asuna really wants to help, too.  
That's why I keep trying to push  
you, as a sort of favor to her.

<!-- uid=415200601:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** Huh? I don't get it. I know that  
you go way back with Kirito and  
Leafa.

<!-- uid=415200601:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** But I thought you and Asuna don't  
have that much history in  
comparison.

<!-- uid=415200601:12:1 -->

**Makoto:** We don't. But Asuna's been a good  
influence on the two of them,  
on Kazu and Sugu.

<!-- uid=415200601:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** They've changed because of her.  
Before, things were a bit strained  
between them, you could say.

<!-- uid=415200601:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** Oh, I never realized that.

<!-- uid=415200601:15:1 -->

**Makoto:** But thanks to Asuna and ALO,  
they've turned into better kids as  
a whole.

<!-- uid=415200601:16:1 -->

**Makoto:** There's nobody more concerned for  
Hellfire Urdr's well being than  
Asuna. She truly wants to help.

<!-- uid=415200601:17:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's why I turned to you, Thokk.  
I'm useless at making games.  
I don't even know where to begin!

<!-- uid=415200601:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** But you're different. You have  
those skills and I hope you'll use  
them for such a good cause.

<!-- uid=415200601:19:1 -->

**Thokk:** Wow, Makoto, I...I don't know  
what to say.

<!-- uid=415200601:20:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hehe, I'm sorry if it feels like  
I'm driving you hard. In the end,  
I respect that it's your decision.

<!-- uid=415200601:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** ...

<!-- uid=415200601:23:1 -->

**Thokk:** Don't tell me--

<!-- uid=415200601:24:1 -->

be at it again?!

<!-- uid=415200601:25:1 -->

**Thokk:** No, that's not it! My inventory

<!-- uid=415200601:26:1 -->

<!-- uid=415200601:27:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wait, this black void: isn't this

<!-- uid=415200601:28:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yeah, but the scenery ahead looks

wave is at work!

**Makoto:** Huh? What does that even mean?!  
Crap, it's trying to suck us in!

<!-- uid=415200601:30:1 -->

**Thokk:** Urrrgh... H-Hraaagh!

<!-- uid=415200601:31:1 -->

**Makoto:** Aaaaaah!

<!-- uid=415200601:32:1 -->


## Story 415200701 · Time Axis Wanderer

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Rising~

**Makoto:** ...

<!-- uid=415200701:1:1 -->

**Makoto:** U-Ungh... Huh?

<!-- uid=415200701:2:1 -->

**Makoto:** Where are we...?  
Oh, Thokk! There you are!

<!-- uid=415200701:3:1 -->

**Thokk:** Zzz... Sorry... I don't think  
I can eat another strawberry...

<!-- uid=415200701:4:1 -->

**Makoto:** Thokk, wake up! You're dreaming.

<!-- uid=415200701:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** Huh? Oh, Makoto! Where are we?  
I don't think I recognize this  
place...

<!-- uid=415200701:6:1 -->

**Makoto:** Neither do I. When I woke up, we  
both somehow ended up here.

<!-- uid=415200701:7:1 -->

**Thokk:** If we look like this, we must  
still be in ALO... Or, maybe not,  
now that I think about it.

<!-- uid=415200701:8:1 -->

**Thokk:** That white tower... I don't  
remember seeing anything like  
that in ALO.

<!-- uid=415200701:9:1 -->

**Makoto:** So we're in another VRMMO, then?  
But wait, doesn't your appearance  
change if you convert your avatar?

<!-- uid=415200701:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** I don't think we are. There's an  
urban legend that's been floating  
around that might explain things.

<!-- uid=415200701:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** Rumor has it there's some kind of  
warp that can take people to  
different dimensions.

<!-- uid=415200701:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** They say people can visit from  
different time streams, as well as  
be sent to other worlds entirely.

<!-- uid=415200701:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wow, that sounds crazy. We'll be  
able to get back to ALO, though,  
won't we?

<!-- uid=415200701:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** If I were to guess what's going  
on, I'd say some sort of computing  
process has fallen behind.

<!-- uid=415200701:15:1 -->

**Thokk:** Knowing that, I'd say if we give  
it time to catch up, we'll likely  
make it back, yeah.

<!-- uid=415200701:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** Otherwise, I doubt there'd be much  
of a rumor, would there?

<!-- uid=415200701:17:1 -->

**Makoto:** That makes sense...  
Huh? What the--?

<!-- uid=415200701:18:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Well, guess we should get going.

<!-- uid=415200701:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, might as well.

<!-- uid=415200701:20:1 -->

I just saw two boys emerge?  
Wait, not just that...

**Thokk:** One of them looked just like  
Kirito!

<!-- uid=415200701:22:1 -->

**Makoto:** He did. But he looked a little  
different, like he was somehow  
a bit more mature.

<!-- uid=415200701:23:1 -->

**Thokk:** His clothes were different, too.  
He had no fairy wings, either...  
But that was definitely Kirito!

<!-- uid=415200701:24:1 -->

**Makoto:** Yeah! Let's speak with him!  
Heeey! Kirito! Over here!

<!-- uid=415200701:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** Eugeo, do you sense that?

<!-- uid=415200701:26:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Yeah. The enemy's waiting to  
ambush us nearby.

<!-- uid=415200701:27:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's weird. Did he not hear me?

<!-- uid=415200701:28:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hey, Kirito! Can you hear me?!  
Hey, Kazu!

<!-- uid=415200701:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** Stay alert! This could be  
dangerous!

<!-- uid=415200701:30:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Right!

<!-- uid=415200701:31:1 -->

**Thokk:** Aaah! What just happened?!

<!-- uid=415200701:33:1 -->

**Makoto:** That red knight just came out of  
nowhere and attacked them!

<!-- uid=415200701:34:1 -->

**Makoto:** From the way he's acting,  
I almost wonder if Kirito can't  
hear us?

## Story 415200801 · Kirito and Eugeo

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Rising~

## Story 415400101 · The Awaited New Game

new VRMMO to save Hellfire Urdr?

<!-- uid=415400101:8:1 -->

<!-- uid=415400101:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. As a cop, she can be pretty  
strict at times, but all things  
considered, she's a good person.

<!-- uid=415400101:16:1 -->

## Story 415400201 · Battle System Conference

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Tensions~

**Thokk:** The Cardinal System's emotional  
analysis function lets me do a lot  
with the synchronization system.

<!-- uid=415400201:1:1 -->

**Thokk:** An AI can examine each member's  
emotions, status, and requests  
and compile them into patterns.

<!-- uid=415400201:2:1 -->

**Thokk:** From there, it can deliver what it  
deems to be the best response as  
text windows to the other players.

<!-- uid=415400201:3:1 -->

**Thokk:** And the system's speedy enough  
that it should make even boss  
raids perfectly doable, too.

<!-- uid=415400201:4:1 -->

**Makoto:** Yeah, I think so. Communicating  
with everyone's a piece of  
cake even without anyone talking.

<!-- uid=415400201:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** Hee hee, I'm glad! It's a fresh  
way to fight in a fresh, new game!  
Just as it should be!

<!-- uid=415400201:6:1 -->

**Thokk:** But...I guess this means I have  
to put extra thought into how  
enemy Mobs are made up now.

<!-- uid=415400201:7:1 -->

**Makoto:** Really? What makes this game so  
different?

<!-- uid=415400201:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** If you want to give players a hard  
fight, isn't it enough to raise  
enemy stats and call it a day?

<!-- uid=415400201:9:1 -->

**Thokk:** I mean, sure, that's part of it,  
but doing only that is the  
easy way out, if you ask me.

<!-- uid=415400201:10:1 -->

**Makoto:** What else do you plan to do,  
then? Like make their routines  
varied and complex?

<!-- uid=415400201:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** Ooh, look at you! You're sounding  
like a real developer now! I'm  
impressed, Makoto!

<!-- uid=415400201:12:1 -->

**Makoto:** Haha, what can I say? I've been  
studying up a little. Glad to hear  
it's starting to pay off.

<!-- uid=415400201:13:1 -->

**Thokk:** I swear, you like to brag over the  
littlest things sometimes. That's  
what makes you you, I guess.

<!-- uid=415400201:14:1 -->

**Makoto:** Anyway, getting back to those  
enemies, how does my idea sound  
about mixing those routines up?

<!-- uid=415400201:15:1 -->

**Thokk:** It's good! I plan on doing that,  
too, but the issue runs a bit  
deeper for me.

<!-- uid=415400201:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** I want things to feel right  
thematically. I wanna explore  
why they're attacking the player.

<!-- uid=415400201:17:1 -->

**Thokk:** Stuff like that. I'm trying to  
make things more meaningful for  
players when they encounter them.

<!-- uid=415400201:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hmm... Okay, now I think you've  
lost me again, Thokk.

<!-- uid=415400201:19:1 -->

**Makoto:** Sounds like it'll take a lot of  
thought, especially since Kirito  
and the others want to play it.

<!-- uid=415400201:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yeah, definitely... You know,  
that reminds me.

<!-- uid=415400201:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** Kirito and I had an interesting  
conversation a while back...

<!-- uid=415400201:22:1 -->


## Story 415400301 · Gunned Down

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Tensions~

**Thokk:** I still remember what Kirito said  
to me well. I think it went  
something like this...

<!-- uid=415400301:1:1 -->

**Thokk:** H-Hey, Spriggan!

<!-- uid=415400301:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** I have an actual name, you know.  
I'd appreciate it if you called me  
that one of these days.

<!-- uid=415400301:3:1 -->

**Thokk:** Whatever, Spriggan. There's  
something I wanna ask you!

<!-- uid=415400301:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Uh, sure. What is it?

<!-- uid=415400301:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** You know that incident that  
happened in GGO a while back?

<!-- uid=415400301:6:1 -->

**Thokk:** The one with Death Gun?

<!-- uid=415400301:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Y-Yeah? Why do you ask...?

<!-- uid=415400301:8:1 -->

**Thokk:** That player with the long, black  
hair and androgynous avatar...  
That was you, wasn't it?

<!-- uid=415400301:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Uh... Yeah, that's right.

<!-- uid=415400301:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Haha, I'm guessing you could tell  
based on the way I fight, even  
in that getup, huh?

<!-- uid=415400301:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yeah. It's recognizable if you  
know what to look for. Guess I  
can't say I'm too surprised.

<!-- uid=415400301:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, I'd appreciate it if you  
keep it to yourself, okay?

<!-- uid=415400301:13:1 -->

**Thokk:** I won't. Not like I have many  
people in my life to tell other  
than Makoto anyway.

<!-- uid=415400301:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Haha, that's true. Anyway, why  
did you want to know that?

<!-- uid=415400301:15:1 -->

**Thokk:** I... I saw you fight Death Gun  
in that footage.

<!-- uid=415400301:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** Wasn't it scary going up against someone  
you knew was killing players out  
in the real world?

<!-- uid=415400301:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's an interesting question...  
I won't lie to you and pretend  
I wasn't scared at all.

<!-- uid=415400301:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** But there was someone I had to  
protect. That's what gave me the  
strength I needed to fight him.

<!-- uid=415400301:19:1 -->

**Thokk:** You mean Sinon?

<!-- uid=415400301:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. That girl with the blue hair  
who was fighting alongside me,  
that was Sinon.

<!-- uid=415400301:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** ...

<!-- uid=415400301:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Also, when you have the threat of  
death looming of you, it can  
have a funny effect on you.

<!-- uid=415400301:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** It might scare you and make you  
slip up, or...it might unleash  
your true strength. I should know.

<!-- uid=415400301:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** I've been there before and I think  
that experience, for better or  
worse, helped me with Death Gun.

<!-- uid=415400301:25:1 -->

**Thokk:** Huh... I've never thought about  
that before.

<!-- uid=415400301:26:1 -->

**Thokk:** How death and fear can be used  
to give you strength...

<!-- uid=415400301:27:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ahaha, it probably doesn't make  
much sense, I know. Try not to  
think about it too hard.

<!-- uid=415400301:28:1 -->

**Thokk:** ...

<!-- uid=415400301:29:1 -->


## Story 415400401 · To the Old GGO

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Tensions~

<!-- uid=415400401:21:1 -->

point, then he and Sinon should  
be fighting Death Gun right now!

to Thokk's emotions, then it  
must be trying to...

## Story 415401101 · Creator of the New World

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Tensions~

**Makoto:** Well, how's development work  
coming along, Thokk? Everything  
looking good?

<!-- uid=415401101:1:1 -->

**Thokk:** You bet! Once I remembered we're  
doing this to save Hellfire Urdr,  
I felt myself get real pumped!

<!-- uid=415401101:2:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's good! So what's the basic  
concept behind the world and  
stuff?

<!-- uid=415401101:3:1 -->

**Thokk:** That's the neat part: Nibelungen  
Purgatory's gonna take place in  
a world of angels!

<!-- uid=415401101:4:1 -->

**Makoto:** Angels? Why those?

<!-- uid=415401101:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** Well, fairies are ALO's whole  
deal, so I can't just up and copy  
what that game's already doing.

<!-- uid=415401101:6:1 -->

**Thokk:** I want my VRMMO to be unique  
and completely different, so  
that's why we're doing angels!

<!-- uid=415401101:7:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh, fair enough. I guess I see  
your point.

<!-- uid=415401101:8:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yeah. It takes place in a world far  
above the realm of humans, where  
angels rule over matters of death.

<!-- uid=415401101:9:1 -->

**Makoto:** Okay, but what makes your angels  
so different from ALO's fairies  
in practice?

<!-- uid=415401101:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** Well, the first thing you should  
know is these aren't necessarily  
the nice, normal angels you know.

<!-- uid=415401101:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** They're way more powerful than  
people and hold the souls of the  
dead captive to put them to work.

<!-- uid=415401101:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** The player's just your average  
human who ends up stumbling into  
Purgatory, the angels' world.

<!-- uid=415401101:13:1 -->

**Thokk:** Over time, they see how human  
souls are treated like slaves at  
the hands of the angels.

<!-- uid=415401101:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** And eventually, they enter a fight  
to liberate the humans! That's  
basically my game in a nutshell.

<!-- uid=415401101:15:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wow! So the angels are bad guys!  
Sounds like a pretty dark game  
you and your team are making.

<!-- uid=415401101:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yeah, if ALO could be described  
as "light" fantasy in terms of  
vibe, our game is dark fantasy.

<!-- uid=415401101:17:1 -->

**Thokk:** It's another way to help ensure  
our VRMMO stands out and feels  
different in comparison.

<!-- uid=415401101:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** It sounds like an intriguing story  
for sure, but also maybe a little  
scary and bleak, too.

<!-- uid=415401101:19:1 -->

**Thokk:** Don't worry. There's more to it  
than just that.

<!-- uid=415401101:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** When the angels first show up,  
they're cold and brutal. You're  
meant to really fear them.

<!-- uid=415401101:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** But as they fight the humans and  
learn their perspective, they  
start to have a change of heart.

<!-- uid=415401101:22:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's always a good way to amp up  
drama, having characters from  
different sides come together.

<!-- uid=415401101:23:1 -->

**Makoto:** Reminds me of a samurai movie  
or something.

<!-- uid=415401101:24:1 -->

**Thokk:** Haha, leave it to you to compare  
my game to samurai movies.

<!-- uid=415401101:25:1 -->

**Thokk:** But yeah, I figure doing that will  
ensure players who come to it for  
the story will enjoy it, too.

<!-- uid=415401101:26:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's cool. What sort of role  
will Hellfire Urdr have once she  
converts into that world, then?

<!-- uid=415401101:27:1 -->

**Thokk:** Well...

<!-- uid=415401101:28:1 -->


## Story 415401201 · Urdr's New Home

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Tensions~

**Makoto:** Interesting. So she's going to be  
a villager whose home was wiped  
out by an angel scheme.

<!-- uid=415401201:1:1 -->

**Makoto:** And then fueled by her anger,  
she'll step foot into Purgatory  
all on her own.

<!-- uid=415401201:2:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's pretty different from what  
I thought you might have in mind  
for her.

<!-- uid=415401201:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** I thought she'd be a navigational  
character or an assistant of some  
sort like Yui.

<!-- uid=415401201:4:1 -->

**Thokk:** Navigational characters don't all  
have to be all-knowing people who  
just dump tons of info on you.

<!-- uid=415401201:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** They can also be characters who  
help move the story along, even if  
they don't know everything.

<!-- uid=415401201:6:1 -->

**Makoto:** True. Your setting provides a good  
reason for Hellfire Urdr to let  
loose with all that anger.

<!-- uid=415401201:7:1 -->

**Makoto:** But it's not like the angels  
directly kill anyone in the human  
realm themselves, right?

<!-- uid=415401201:8:1 -->

**Thokk:** Right. They don't directly meddle  
with humans down below. But they  
do put them up to nasty things.

<!-- uid=415401201:9:1 -->

**Thokk:** Kirito told me that there are  
forces in Midgard trying to start  
a war in that game, too.

<!-- uid=415401201:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** So I took some inspiration from  
that and put my own spin on it.

they're gods, controlling the  
lives of people so ruthlessly.

<!-- uid=415401201:12:1 -->

friendly beings you hear about in  
a lot of other stories.

noble cause.

<!-- uid=415401201:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** I'm hoping the scale and scope  
of it really elevates the whole  
thing as a dark fantasy story.

<!-- uid=415401201:15:1 -->

**Makoto:** Now I understand why you call it  
Nibelungen Purgatory. The world  
might be full of angels...

<!-- uid=415401201:16:1 -->

**Makoto:** But to the people inhabiting it,

<!-- uid=415401201:17:1 -->

**Thokk:** Hee hee, exactly! I'm glad you

<!-- uid=415401201:18:1 -->

**Thokk:** Nibelungen Purgatory,

<!-- uid=415401201:19:1 -->

**Makoto:** Now you've really got me  
interested, Thokk! I can't wait  
to check it out!

<!-- uid=415401201:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** Well, you'll just have to wait  
until it's finished. We still have  
a lot of work to do on it.

**Thokk:** Just don't tell anyone about this

**Selka:** Hehe, pretty awesome, isn't it?

them all growing so healthily.  
However...

supposed to grow this much,  
it takes several more days.

<!-- uid=415700501:19:1 -->

**Azariya:** How did they mature so fast,  
I wonder?

<!-- uid=415700501:20:1 -->

**Selka:** Er... Well...

<!-- uid=415700501:21:1 -->

**Azariya:** Selka, did you do something to  
these crops that you weren't  
supposed to?

<!-- uid=415700501:22:1 -->

**Selka:** N-No, ma'am! Not at all! Really!  
Y-You see...

<!-- uid=415700501:23:1 -->

**Selka:** Solus has blessed them with so  
much sunlight lately that they  
just grew really fast!

<!-- uid=415700501:24:1 -->

**Azariya:** ...

<!-- uid=415700501:25:1 -->

**Selka:** ...

<!-- uid=415700501:26:1 -->

<!-- uid=415700501:27:1 -->

## Story 415700601 · Various Duties

Event Story  
Return to Rulid Village

**Alice:** Hehe, sounds like a close call.

<!-- uid=415700601:1:1 -->

**Selka:** Yeah, but it ended up causing  
another problem later on.

<!-- uid=415700601:2:1 -->

**Alice:** What do you mean?

<!-- uid=415700601:3:1 -->

**Selka:** Well...

<!-- uid=415700601:4:1 -->

<!-- uid=415700601:5:1 -->

field?! Why is it ruined?!

<!-- uid=415700601:6:1 -->

<!-- uid=415700601:8:1 -->

**Azariya:** Calm down, Selka.

<!-- uid=415700601:9:1 -->

**Azariya:** It wasn't a human who destroyed  
this field. Judging by the bite  
marks that were left...

<!-- uid=415700601:10:1 -->

**Azariya:** These crops were ravaged by  
wild animals.

<!-- uid=415700601:11:1 -->

**Selka:** Wild animals? This far inside  
the village?

<!-- uid=415700601:12:1 -->

**Azariya:** Normally, it would be unthinkable.  
But I hear monsters have begun to  
roam the forests and mountains.

<!-- uid=415700601:13:1 -->

**Azariya:** They drove the animals out of  
their natural habitat, forcing  
them to move near the village.

<!-- uid=415700601:14:1 -->

**Azariya:** It's possible that they waited for  
us humans to fall asleep before  
wreaking havoc on the crops.

<!-- uid=415700601:15:1 -->

**Selka:** Well, whatever happened, we can't  
let them get away with this!

<!-- uid=415700601:16:1 -->

**Selka:** Sister, you've got to teach me  
a Sacred Arts that'll let me get  
rid of those creatures! Please!

<!-- uid=415700601:17:1 -->

**Azariya:** Must we discuss this again? Yes,  
it may be my responsibility to  
teach and look after you,

<!-- uid=415700601:18:1 -->

**Azariya:** But it's also my job to protect  
you and keep you safe.

<!-- uid=415700601:19:1 -->

**Azariya:** If anything happened to you,  
I don't know what I would say  
to the village chief...

<!-- uid=415700601:20:1 -->

**Selka:** But that doesn't mean we shouldn't  
do anything about this...

<!-- uid=415700601:21:1 -->

**Azariya:** That's for us grown-ups to worry  
about. I don't want you to put  
yourself in harm's way. Got it?

<!-- uid=415700601:22:1 -->

**Selka:** Grr!

<!-- uid=415700601:23:1 -->


## Story 415700701 · Only Action

Event Story  
Return to Rulid Village

**Alice:** Well? Did you back down?

**Selka:** Of course not! I went straight to  
Father and talked to him about it.

<!-- uid=415700701:2:1 -->

**Alice:** ...And what did he say?

<!-- uid=415700701:3:1 -->

**Selka:** He said the same thing as Sister  
Azariya. "Just leave it to the

<!-- uid=415700701:4:1 -->

might've been why I didn't

<!-- uid=415700701:6:1 -->

**Selka:** I felt like his unwillingness to  
do anything about the situation  
was why we lost you too.

<!-- uid=415700701:7:1 -->

**Selka:** I knew I had to take action like  
Kirito and Eugeo always did.

<!-- uid=415700701:8:1 -->

**Selka:** Even if what I did was a little  
reckless, it was still better  
than doing nothing.

<!-- uid=415700701:9:1 -->

**Alice:** So what did you do?

<!-- uid=415700701:10:1 -->

**Selka:** I learned a Sacred Arts to ward off

fields every night before bed.

<!-- uid=415700701:11:1 -->

**Alice:** That's very impressive.

<!-- uid=415700701:12:1 -->

**Selka:** Maybe. The animals stopped going

<!-- uid=415700701:13:1 -->

**Selka:** But the grown-ups were also

<!-- uid=415700701:14:1 -->

**Selka:** So I don't know if it was my

<!-- uid=415700701:15:1 -->

**Alice:** Even if it turns out that it wasn't  
due to your efforts, it's the  
thought that counts.

<!-- uid=415700701:16:1 -->

**Alice:** You were determined to act, to  
do something about the crops.  
That's what matters.

<!-- uid=415700701:17:1 -->

**Alice:** Such strong determination can be  
a great catalyst to bring about  
real change.

<!-- uid=415700701:18:1 -->

**Alice:** Much like you just said, Kirito and  
Eugeo themselves embody such  
a noble ideal...

<!-- uid=415700701:19:1 -->

**Selka:** ...Alice?

<!-- uid=415700701:20:1 -->

**Alice:** Ah, never mind...

<!-- uid=415700701:21:1 -->

**Alice:** In any case, I'm glad you were  
able to protect the crops from  
such beasts.

<!-- uid=415700701:22:1 -->

**Selka:** Well... there's... more to the  
story than just that.

<!-- uid=415700701:23:1 -->

**Alice:** Oh...?

## Story 415700801 · A Bad Feeling

Event Story  
Return to Rulid Village

**Selka:** Hah! Hyah!

forest.

<!-- uid=415700801:24:1 -->

<!-- uid=415700801:25:1 -->

**Azariya:** After being driven out and with no  
food left to scavenge, they  
must be desperate.

<!-- uid=415700801:26:1 -->

**Azariya:** They could be so hungry, they  
decided to attack the children  
out of sheer desperation.

<!-- uid=415700801:27:1 -->

**Selka:** That's terrible! We have to go  
save them!

**Selka:** I couldn't tell the adults about

## Story 415700901 · Strive Onwards

Event Story  
Return to Rulid Village

**Selka:** Open up!

**Selka:** Well, there's this area deep

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Liberation~

**Villager:** ...And it was when the village

**Asuna:** ...I hope I did the right thing.

## Story 416300801 · Ronie's Memories ~Justice~

Event Story  
Gossip on the Battlefield

**Ronie:** One day, my friend Tiese and  
I went to see Kirito and Eugeo  
about our roommate, Frenica.

<!-- uid=416300801:1:1 -->

**Ronie:** She was a page too, but her elite  
disciple treated her horribly, and  
we didn't know what do.

<!-- uid=416300801:2:1 -->

**Ronie:** When we went to see them...

<!-- uid=416300801:3:1 -->

**Tiese:** My father says that a noble should  
always be aware of the effect  
their actions have on others.

<!-- uid=416300801:4:1 -->

**Tiese:** Humbert's actions may not be  
violating the Taboo Index or  
school regulations, but...

<!-- uid=416300801:5:1 -->

**Tiese:** But... Frenica cried herself to  
sleep last night.

<!-- uid=416300801:6:1 -->

**Tiese:** How can that be okay?  
I don't understand...

<!-- uid=416300801:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Your father sounds like a great  
man. I'd love to meet him someday.

<!-- uid=416300801:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** He was telling you about something  
known in Fren...

<!-- uid=416300801:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** I mean, in the sacred words as  
"noblesse oblige."

<!-- uid=416300801:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Basically, it means nobles--or  
really, anyone with power--are  
obligated to use it...

<!-- uid=416300801:11:1 -->

## Story 416700301 · Gathering Information

Event Story  
Sword God of the Sacred Mountain

**Kirito:** ...And that's why it's just the  
three of us here. It was all Liz's  
idea.

<!-- uid=416700301:1:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Huh. But I don't get it. Wouldn't

teamed up instead?

<!-- uid=416700301:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, but you're forgetting Liz's

the reason behind this split.

<!-- uid=416700301:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** If this was a quest for gear, that  
division could get a little...  
heated, to put it lightly.

<!-- uid=416700301:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** But since the reward is money,  
the split works differently.  
It's more straightforward.

<!-- uid=416700301:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** The amount of money is simply  
split evenly based on the number  
of people in the party.

<!-- uid=416700301:8:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Oh, I think I get where this is  
going now.

<!-- uid=416700301:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Basically, the smaller the party,  
the more money each individual  
member can earn.

<!-- uid=416700301:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Exactly.

<!-- uid=416700301:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** The amount of money to be made  
with just three people compared to  
nine is like night and day.

<!-- uid=416700301:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Plus...it's entirely possible there  
might be an extra bonus for the  
first party that beats it, too.

<!-- uid=416700301:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's all the more reason to keep  
the number of party members down  
to a bare minimum.

<!-- uid=416700301:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** That Liz, she sure seems to have
