<!-- uid=416700301:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Do you think she might actually  
BE that desperate for money?

<!-- uid=416700301:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Probably. She must've hit rock  
bottom if she's willing to  
admit it so openly.

<!-- uid=416700301:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** There's just one thing her little  
plan didn't count on.

<!-- uid=416700301:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** The fact that the boss is ridiculously hard...

<!-- uid=416700301:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Right. There was no way the game  
was ever going to let us have that  
money without working for it.

<!-- uid=416700301:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** We'll need a plan in order to beat  
it. For now, I say we head back to

**Kirito:** How'd you two do? Any luck?

## Story 416700401 · Kirito and Argo

Event Story  
Sword God of the Sacred Mountain

**Argo:** Heyo, Kii-boy! Long time, no see!

Sword God of the Sacred Mountain

## Story 417000701 · Imposing Threat

Event Story  
The Twisted Emperor and Phantom Knights: Part 2

**Joker:** Seems like the emperor headed  
farther up.

<!-- uid=417000701:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Everything past here is all new  
territory to us. Let's proceed  
with extreme caution.

<!-- uid=417000701:3:1 -->

**Oracle:** Whoa, get a load of all this

in the system?

<!-- uid=417000701:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's hard to say. We never made it

to compare it with.

<!-- uid=417000701:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ideta mentioned wanting to  
wipe everyone out, but how does  
he plan on doing that?

<!-- uid=417000701:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** After SAO, VR headsets came under  
regulation, so it would be hard to

<!-- uid=417000701:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Right. So unless he intends to

goal remains an open question.

**Oracle:** Think about it. All the prisoners

**Kirito:** That's true, but what would be the

zeroed out in the game's servers?

real Ideta, not just his Shadow?

The Twisted Emperor and Phantom Knights: Part 2

## Story 417000901 · The Calling Card's Recipient

Event Story  
The Twisted Emperor and Phantom Knights: Part 2

**Queen:** Well, if we're going to send him a  
calling card, we need info like  
his full name and location.

<!-- uid=417000901:1:1 -->

data on all those victims, right?

## Story 417101201 · Far Enough

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Ascension~

**Warla:** ...

<!-- uid=417101201:1:1 -->

**Warla:** \*sigh\*...  
Listen, I'm glad you've  
gotten so into this...

<!-- uid=417101201:2:1 -->

**Warla:** But what am I supposed to do  
with that...?

<!-- uid=417101201:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** W-Warla...?

<!-- uid=417101201:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wait, the way she's speaking...  
Could that be...?

<!-- uid=417101201:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, Thokk?

<!-- uid=417101201:6:1 -->

**Thokk:** I've stopped Warla's avatar for a  
sec so I can talk to you. I had to  
when I saw you in that much pain.

<!-- uid=417101201:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** W-Wait, really...? Then what  
about the game...?

<!-- uid=417101201:8:1 -->

**Thokk:** Just like I messaged you, we're  
almost at the end here, so it  
needs to come to a stopping point.

<!-- uid=417101201:9:1 -->

**Thokk:** You fight Warla again,  
ending Part 1...

<!-- uid=417101201:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** I was thinking the game could be  
three, maybe four parts.

<!-- uid=417101201:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** I've been thinking a lot about  
the new place where Hellfire  
Urdr's avatar will live.

<!-- uid=417101201:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** A soul forced to live in a certain  
spot due to the circumstances  
in this game...

<!-- uid=417101201:13:1 -->

**Thokk:** But in a way, that's your fate if  
you're someone living in a  
virtual world...

<!-- uid=417101201:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well... Yeah, maybe. But it's the  
same for us humans living in  
the real world.

<!-- uid=417101201:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Lots of rules and restrictions  
take our freedom, forcing us  
to live a certain way.

<!-- uid=417101201:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yeah, I get that too.  
...Which is why I wanted Warla  
to understand it as well.

<!-- uid=417101201:17:1 -->

**Thokk:** A vicious cycle made by the  
human world's negative feelings...  
Purgatory and its angels...

<!-- uid=417101201:18:1 -->

**Thokk:** Humans might be responsible for  
all that, but it's also humans who  
can put a stop to it...

<!-- uid=417101201:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** So this place... is a story meant  
to teach her about the world...  
so she understands human emotions?

<!-- uid=417101201:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** Basically, yep. Warla was a little  
girl who only knew anger after her  
parents were killed.

<!-- uid=417101201:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** By going to Purgatory and the  
surface, learning all about human  
emotions, and becoming an angel,

<!-- uid=417101201:22:1 -->

**Thokk:** instead of destroying this  
cursed world, she would see it  
turn into a place of purification.

<!-- uid=417101201:23:1 -->

**Thokk:** It's the story of it becoming the  
world-healing higher-ranking  
angel it should've always been...

<!-- uid=417101201:24:1 -->

**Thokk:** That was my idea for it all.

<!-- uid=417101201:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** So when we heard the phrase  
higher-ranking angel...

<!-- uid=417101201:26:1 -->

**Thokk:** That meant this world as a whole.

<!-- uid=417101201:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** Um... Does that mean Warla is  
going to turn back into the girl  
we know after this?

<!-- uid=417101201:28:1 -->

**Thokk:** Hehehe... For now, yes.

<!-- uid=417101201:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** I see... But you're right.  
Hellfire Urdr's emotions  
are more complex than...

<!-- uid=417101201:30:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...something that could be fully  
resolved through that earlier  
event alone.

<!-- uid=417101201:31:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm glad you let us know that your  
plan to save her takes all of this  
into consideration...

<!-- uid=417101201:32:1 -->

**Thokk:** Really? What kind of developer  
shows up to give spoilers right  
in the middle of their game?

<!-- uid=417101201:33:1 -->

**Thokk:** But I understand how Asuna feels.  
I let you know the plot since it's  
not like I wanted you to be sad.

<!-- uid=417101201:34:1 -->

**Asuna:** I-I kind of feel bad now, Thokk.

<!-- uid=417101201:35:1 -->

**Thokk:** Don't worry about it. I'm just  
glad you're sticking with a game  
as hard as this one.

<!-- uid=417101201:36:1 -->

**Sinon:** Phew... Well, I guess that does it  
for our testing session?

<!-- uid=417101201:37:1 -->

**Liz:** Though... We haven't had that much  
time to have fun with our gear.  
Can we play a little longer?

<!-- uid=417101201:38:1 -->

**Thokk:** Hehehe, of course I'd be happy for  
you to play to your heart's  
content!

<!-- uid=417101201:39:1 -->

**Kirito:** What do you think, Thokk? Did it  
have all the results you wanted?

<!-- uid=417101201:40:1 -->

**Thokk:** Do you really have to ask?!  
I wanna keep this feeling up  
as I make the rest of the game!

<!-- uid=417101201:41:1 -->

**Liz:** Oh! We need to let Makoto and  
Yuuki know about this.

<!-- uid=417101201:42:1 -->

**Makoto:** I see. So she did have a plan  
behind everything...

<!-- uid=417101201:43:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yep. I'm satisfied with it too,  
and it's only made me want to  
save Warla that much more!

<!-- uid=417101201:44:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. The added difficulty just  
makes rescuing her feel that much

<!-- uid=417101201:45:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Speaking of Warla...   
where's Thokk?

<!-- uid=417101201:46:1 -->

**Sinon:** She apparently reset all the  
settings, and Warla's data was

<!-- uid=417101201:47:1 -->

## Story 417700201 · The Dreaming City

not belonging to any of those.

**Kirito:** There are also fields like  
Jotunheimr and Nibelheim which  
are unrelated to the nine domains.

<!-- uid=417700201:19:1 -->

<!-- uid=417700201:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** It does. But I guess what's

<!-- uid=417700201:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** You read that recipe book

<!-- uid=417700201:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...I don't really get it, but are

rare items too?

## Story 417700301 · Dozing Off in a Dreamlike World

Event Story  
Brilliant Bosses in the Dreaming City ~Part 1~

**Kirito:** Heh... So, are Liz and Silica here  
too?

<!-- uid=417700301:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, looks like we came here one

<!-- uid=417700301:2:1 -->

that book... and those two were  
with me.

<!-- uid=417700301:3:1 -->

sleeping body vanished all  
of a sudden!

quest.

players here.

surprising any players who might  
be around you...

reading a book suddenly vanish  
into thin air.

any nearby books... resulting in  
you coming here as well, I guess.

the dungeon here is built in a

**Asuna:** We aren't quite sure. They're

**Kirito:** Hngh? What's this light?!

someone new has been

<!-- uid=417700301:25:1 -->

<!-- uid=417700301:26:1 -->

**Asuna & Kirito:** !

<!-- uid=417700301:27:1 -->

**Kirito:** Whoa... Now this I didn't expect!

<!-- uid=417700301:28:1 -->


## Story 417700401 · Unexpected Development

## Story 418100201 · On the search for sweets

Event Story  
Yokai Parade Under the Full Moon

**Leafa:** Wow, it's been a long time since

<!-- uid=418100201:1:1 -->

this, I don't really play games

it seems like a tough one.

## Story 418200301 · Rules for Pop Star Online

Event Story  
Pop Star Online Part 1 (Renewal)

**Kirito:** So uh, yeah...  
Singing fundamentals...

class or at karaoke,

up on STAGE?!

**Asuna:** Oh yeah?

**Kirito:** Seems so. You all have a bunch of  
singing stats, right? Like volume  
and range?

**Leafa:** Uhh... Yeah! I found mine.

**Kirito:** Those stat values affect how  
you'll sound when you start  
singing.

<!-- uid=418200301:8:1 -->

**Yuuki:** So even people who can really belt  
it in real life might get stuck  
with low stats in-game.

<!-- uid=418200301:9:1 -->

**Yuuki:** That's what you're saying, right?

<!-- uid=418200301:10:1 -->

our avatars, but our singing  
stats start at zero.

<!-- uid=418200301:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Just like everyone else's.  
It's a level playing field.

<!-- uid=418200301:12:1 -->

start at zero, too?

singing stats.

**Silica:** That's not fair!

<!-- uid=418200301:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** In fact, all I can do is fight.

<!-- uid=418200301:17:1 -->

sidelines, watching you all  
perform.

<!-- uid=418200301:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** \*sigh\*...

**Leafa:** What are you so sad about?

<!-- uid=418200301:20:1 -->

want to sing on stage that badly!

**Asuna:** Haha! If I had to guess...

component.

<!-- uid=418200301:23:1 -->

**Sinon:** Ah... Yeah, I'll buy that.

<!-- uid=418200301:24:1 -->

## Story 418200601 · Tips to get better

Event Story  
Pop Star Online Part 1 (Renewal)

**Kirito:** Gather 'round, guys.

<!-- uid=418200601:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** What's up?

<!-- uid=418200601:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** I want to set up a schedule for  
singing lessons as we head to the  
next town.

<!-- uid=418200601:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Lessons, huh?

<!-- uid=418200601:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yep. Leafa and I have been  
researching ways to raise  
everyone's singing stats.

rid of this awful, so-called  
"auto-tune," right?

<!-- uid=418200601:6:1 -->

becomes a form of auto-tune that  
actually helps you.

<!-- uid=418200601:7:1 -->

**Leafa:** It makes your voice more powerful,  
and adds effects like vibrato  
and pitch correction.

<!-- uid=418200601:8:1 -->

**Silica:** Ooh! Then I want to level up as  
fast as possible!

<!-- uid=418200601:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Me too. I'd love to stop sounding  
like some sort of earthquake.

<!-- uid=418200601:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...

<!-- uid=418200601:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** You're not on board, Sinon?

<!-- uid=418200601:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** Honestly?

<!-- uid=418200601:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** I decided to check this out with  
all of you because it's a special  
event. But it's just not my thing.

<!-- uid=418200601:14:1 -->

**Liz:** That's okay. You can't just tell  
people to be pop stars and expect  
everyone to be cool with it.

<!-- uid=418200601:15:1 -->

**Silica:** Yeah. I'm sad you're leaving,  
but I understand.

<!-- uid=418200601:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wait a second.

<!-- uid=418200601:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** Uh... Why?

<!-- uid=418200601:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** I know what you're trying to say,  
and I can't force you to stick  
with us.

<!-- uid=418200601:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** But just perform in two more—no,  
one more concert with us.

<!-- uid=418200601:21:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...

<!-- uid=418200601:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Now that I know how to raise your  
singing stats, it occurred to me  
what my part is in all this.

<!-- uid=418200601:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** It was right there all along.  
I'm the manager who's supposed  
to guide you through your careers.

<!-- uid=418200601:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** I need to train you until you  
all become superstars.

<!-- uid=418200601:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, yes...

<!-- uid=418200601:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** But that also means it's my job  
to keep you all motivated.

<!-- uid=418200601:27:1 -->

**Kirito:** Just try performing one more time.  
If you're still not feeling it  
after that, you can log out.

<!-- uid=418200601:28:1 -->

**Kirito:** Will you stick with me until then?

<!-- uid=418200601:29:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...Fine.

<!-- uid=418200601:30:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yay, Sinonon!

<!-- uid=418200601:31:1 -->

**Sinon:** Why so surprised? Turning down an  
offer like that would just be  
mean.

<!-- uid=418200601:32:1 -->

**Sinon:** It's not like I was trying to  
start drama or anything. I'll give  
it one more shot.

<!-- uid=418200601:33:1 -->

**Kirito:** Thank you!

<!-- uid=418200601:34:1 -->

Event Story  
The Brides of Your Dreams ~Part 1~

**Alice:** Now... I would never do something

<!-- uid=418600501:22:1 -->

## Story 418601101 · Bercouli appears

Event Story  
The Brides of Your Dreams ~Part 1~

**Fanatio:** Stop this conflict...?

<!-- uid=418601101:1:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Of course. Shouldn't that be  
obvious?

<!-- uid=418601101:2:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Two of my adorable subordinates  
are fighting for some nonsensical  
reason.

**Bercouli:** How could I ignore that?  
I'd be setting a bad example  
as the leader of the knights.

quarrelling over the right to

**Fanatio:** Y-Yes...

<!-- uid=418601101:6:1 -->

**Bercouli:** You're that desperate to win this  
hair accessory?

<!-- uid=418601101:7:1 -->

**Fanatio:** ...Yes.

<!-- uid=418601101:8:1 -->

**Fanatio:** As you know, Your Excellency,

a very long time.

<!-- uid=418601101:9:1 -->

everything I had and losing...  
I saw my immaturity.

**Fanatio:** I want to become stronger as a  
knight and more beautiful as a  
woman.

**Fanatio:** And I thought this prize might  
make this dream come true...

<!-- uid=418601101:12:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=418601101:13:1 -->

**Bercouli:** You know what I think, Fanatio?

**Bercouli:** Do you really need something

**Fanatio:** Ngh...?!

**Bercouli:** I would never forbid a woman from

<!-- uid=418601101:20:1 -->

**Bercouli:** You're already quite beautiful

**Fanatio:** ...!

**Fanatio:** Alice!

**Alice:** Uh... Y-Yes?

**Fanatio:** I apologize. I shouldn't have

**Fanatio:** And... Miss Ronie, was it? Please

**Fanatio:** I was a bit mean to you.

**Ronie:** Y-Yes! Of course!

<!-- uid=418601101:30:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Thank goodness...

<!-- uid=418601101:33:1 -->

**Fanatio:** It may all be make-believe in the

<!-- uid=418601101:34:1 -->

**Fanatio:** Through this, your hearts can

**Fanatio:** Never forget that...

**Bercouli:** Fanatio is right.

Lady Fanatio...

<!-- uid=418601101:39:1 -->

**Alice:** (Still... this seems like more

<!-- uid=418601101:40:1 -->

**Alice:** (Could this dream... be trying to

<!-- uid=418601101:41:1 -->


## Story 418601201 · Lessons from a strange dream

Event Story  
The Brides of Your Dreams ~Part 1~

**Alice:** This is...!

<!-- uid=418601201:1:1 -->

**Ronie:** Is this our destination?

<!-- uid=418601201:2:1 -->

**Alice:** It seems that way. I think we only

**Alice:** ...

**Ronie:** I still have a long way to go...

**Ronie:** I want to become an incredible

<!-- uid=418601201:24:1 -->

**Ronie:** Someone who can stand alongside  
not just Kirito, but you, Lady

<!-- uid=418601201:26:1 -->

## Story 418700101 · New Rivals

## Story 418700201 · Alice's Determination

Event Story  
The Brides of Your Dreams ~Part 2~

**Ronie:** What...? All of us, together?

**Tiese:** Yes. If you and Lady Alice would

**Alice:** I could understand if you wanted

Event Story  
The Brides of Your Dreams ~Part 2~

## Story 419201201 · Unexpected Reward

Event Story  
Carol Under the Starry Sky (Renewal)

**Yui:** That black-cloaked Cait Sith is  
most definitely an enemy NPC.

<!-- uid=419201201:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, his "I am a Cait Sith"  
statement of the obvious  
was totally an NPC line.

<!-- uid=419201201:2:1 -->

**Yui:** If I were to hazard a guess, I'd  
say that he was created as part  
of the Divine Object quest.

<!-- uid=419201201:3:1 -->

**Yui:** Likely, Cardinal decided the quest  
needed a specific antagonist for  
you to face.

<!-- uid=419201201:4:1 -->

**Yui:** And I have bad news: the personal  
data used to generate him is  
based off of—

<!-- uid=419201201:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, I know.  
Eugeo and Alice, right?

<!-- uid=419201201:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** What?! No way!

<!-- uid=419201201:7:1 -->

**Yui:** So you noticed, Daddy?

<!-- uid=419201201:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** It was an educated guess.  
I thought to myself: why, and how,  
did Cardinal create this NPC?

<!-- uid=419201201:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Then it all clicked. Bad guy boss  
character for the epic Divine  
Object quest. But where to get...

<!-- uid=419201201:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...the template? Well, with Alice  
and Eugeo on our side, it needed  
an equally smart and badass enemy.

<!-- uid=419201201:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** So Cardinal took all the data it'd  
gathered on the two and used that  
to generate an advanced AI NPC.

<!-- uid=419201201:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** In other words, it made a big,  
smart, scary boss for us.

<!-- uid=419201201:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Why did it use data from both  
Alice AND Eugeo?

<!-- uid=419201201:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Balance. It needed someone as  
tough as both of them put together  
to even the playing field.

<!-- uid=419201201:15:1 -->

**Yui:** I agree with your assessment of  
the situation, Daddy.

<!-- uid=419201201:16:1 -->

**Yui:** I can almost guarantee that he'll  
be back to cause trouble as you  
work on the Divine Object quest.

<!-- uid=419201201:17:1 -->

**Yui:** And unlike most monsters, we won't  
be able to predict how or when  
he'll move to oppose us.

<!-- uid=419201201:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah...

<!-- uid=419201201:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** So we have to fight a ridiculously  
smart NPC? This sounds like it'll  
be worse than PvP...

<!-- uid=419201201:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Let's keep this a secret from  
Alice and Eugeo for now.

<!-- uid=419201201:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** I mean, if we tried to explain it,  
their heads would probably  
explode.

<!-- uid=419201201:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** We definitely don't want that...  
Still, Cardinal really likes  
making our lives difficult.

<!-- uid=419201201:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** Seriously. It's picked up some  
reaaally annoying tricks lately.

<!-- uid=419201201:24:1 -->

<!-- uid=419500101:23:1 -->

## Story 419500201 · Stop Being Lazy

Event Story  
Summer Brings the Roaring Waves ~Part 1~

**Kazuto:** They were thrown from their world  
into ALO by accident...

<!-- uid=419500201:1:1 -->

**Kazuto:** But for whatever reason, ALO's  
program saw them as intruders.

<!-- uid=419500201:2:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I don't know what kind of  
relationship they have to the  
Seed, but this caused a big issue.

<!-- uid=419500201:3:1 -->

**Kazuto:** They're incompatible with the  
world of ALO...to the point their  
existence threatens its integrity.

<!-- uid=419500201:4:1 -->

**Kazuto:** It took a lot of work, but we  
found a place inside ALO where  
they wouldn't affect it too much.

<!-- uid=419500201:5:1 -->

**Kazuto:** And that place is Midgard.  
The as-of-yet not implemented land  
of humans.

<!-- uid=419500201:6:1 -->

**Kazuto:** As long as nothing crazy has  
happened, I assume they should  
still be there.

<!-- uid=419500201:7:2 -->

**Kazuto:** Speaking of which, I doubt they're  
working or anything either.

<!-- uid=419500201:8:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Talk about lucky! Every day is  
like summer break for them.

<!-- uid=419500201:9:1 -->

**Yui:** Knowing them, I think whatever  
they're doing is more productive  
than you, Daddy...

<!-- uid=419500201:10:1 -->

**Yui:** But this is a good opportunity!  
It's been a while, why don't we go  
to Midgard!

<!-- uid=419500201:11:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Yeah, might be worth a visit.  
There's some restrictions there  
which is why we don't go so often.

<!-- uid=419500201:12:1 -->

**Yui:** Yes, the restrictions are in line  
thematically too. Midgard is far  
from Alfheim and its fairies.

<!-- uid=419500201:13:1 -->

**Yui:** The distance means that human NPCs  
there are unused to seeing gods,  
demons, and even fairies.

<!-- uid=419500201:14:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Yeah, means we need to not stand  
out and cause a scene, or better  
yet, avoid the NPCs.

<!-- uid=419500201:15:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Well, first things first, we need  
to actually see if they're free!

<!-- uid=419500201:16:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Okay, Yui, you've convinced me.  
Let's log in.

<!-- uid=419500201:17:1 -->

**Yui:** Yay! I was waiting to hear you say  
that!

<!-- uid=419500201:18:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Just logging in to the game makes  
you that happy...? Was I being  
that much of a lazy bum?

<!-- uid=419500201:19:1 -->

**Yui:** Yes, you were!

<!-- uid=419500201:20:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...Sorry if I worried you, Yui.  
I'll try to be more careful in the  
future.

<!-- uid=419500201:21:1 -->

## Story 419700101 · Hell Fire Urdr

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Part 1~

<!-- uid=419700101:1:1 -->

<!-- uid=419700101:2:1 -->

Her spirit was split off  
completely from the real one.

<!-- uid=419700101:6:1 -->

enemy in that realm Thokk  
created, Helheim, as I remember.

reacted to Thokk's Divine Object,  
Chronos Zone.

Object, so it probably wasn't  
a coincidence, to say the least.

<!-- uid=419700101:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** It seems that Hellfire Urdr is  
trapped by her anger.

<!-- uid=419700101:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** If we have to, we could dispel  
that anger by defeating her, but  
I don't want it to come to that.

<!-- uid=419700101:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Me neither. At the end of the day,

effects from our quest.

<!-- uid=419700101:12:1 -->

for what happened, too.

<!-- uid=419700101:13:1 -->

happen one way or another.

<!-- uid=419700101:15:1 -->

would've just riled her up one way  
or another.

<!-- uid=419700101:16:1 -->

<!-- uid=419700101:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** I agree. That's why I think we

to do about it moving forward.

concrete ideas about what you want  
to do, though?

<!-- uid=419700101:19:1 -->

Urdr exists in the same plane as

<!-- uid=419700101:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** As long as they have to coexist,  
there's a risk some unforeseen  
trouble could crop up eventually.

<!-- uid=419700101:21:1 -->

<!-- uid=419700101:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** As long as she has a proper AI,

<!-- uid=419700101:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** We have experience with this.

<!-- uid=419700101:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** We just had to extract their data

<!-- uid=419700101:27:1 -->

<!-- uid=419700101:28:1 -->

<!-- uid=419700101:29:1 -->

**Makoto:** Huh? What is it...?

safe place to save Hellfire  
Urdr before it's too late.

<!-- uid=419700401:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** And I get that! Really!

<!-- uid=419700401:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** But people like Kirito, Asuna,  
Leafa, Yuuki, and more will still  
end up visiting it, right?

<!-- uid=419700401:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** Thinking about that makes me  
really nervous, you know?

<!-- uid=419700401:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** I guess they'll come check it out,  
yeah. They're like family. It's  
only natural they'd be interested.

<!-- uid=419700401:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** Exactly! I can't put any old VRMMO  
together, not when I know there'll  
be such talented players in it!

<!-- uid=419700401:15:1 -->

**Thokk:** I know I'm still just an amateur,  
but we're talking about my pride  
as a game developer here!

<!-- uid=419700401:16:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wow, I didn't realize you were  
thinking from that perspective.  
Color me impressed.

<!-- uid=419700401:17:1 -->

**Thokk:** Well, I am. Like, I'm sure if they  
played it, they wouldn't say  
anything mean to my face.

<!-- uid=419700401:18:1 -->

**Thokk:** But I'm scared they'd really feel  
there wasn't much to play or it'd  
be rough around the edges.

<!-- uid=419700401:19:1 -->

**Thokk:** Argh, I can't stand it!  
I'm heckin' anxious right now!

<!-- uid=419700401:20:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wait, what was that word you--  
OH, I get it. The slang you kids  
use is so cute. I love it.

<!-- uid=419700401:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** I'm serious! This is a big deal to  
me!

<!-- uid=419700401:22:1 -->

**Makoto:** I hear you, I promise.  
But still...

<!-- uid=419700401:23:1 -->

**Thokk:** But nothing! I'm scared and this  
isn't going away anytime soon!

<!-- uid=419700401:24:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh dear, just when I thought we  
were getting you motivated to  
at least try...

<!-- uid=419700401:25:1 -->

**Thokk:** Eeek!

<!-- uid=419700401:26:1 -->

**Makoto:** What was that explosion?!

<!-- uid=419700401:27:1 -->

**Skull:** Ladies, I've got bad news! That  
big hunk of ice looks like it's  
about to fall apart!

<!-- uid=419700401:28:1 -->

**Grimm:** That fire giantess is trying  
to reawaken!

<!-- uid=419700401:29:1 -->

**Thokk:** Crap! It's Hellfire Urdr!

<!-- uid=419700401:30:1 -->

**Makoto:** Ugh, so the time's finally come,  
huh?

<!-- uid=419700401:31:1 -->

**Thokk:** Makoto, wh-what are we going  
to do?

<!-- uid=419700401:32:1 -->

**Makoto:** We need to figure out what's going  
on first and contact Kirito and  
the others while we're at it.

<!-- uid=419700401:33:1 -->

**Makoto:** But we shouldn't count on them  
being able to help much in this  
situation.

<!-- uid=419700401:34:1 -->

**Makoto:** They're all fairy players, so  
hardly any of them will be able  
to make to Helheim, I imagine.

<!-- uid=419700401:35:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yeah, good point...

<!-- uid=419700401:36:1 -->

**Makoto:** ...

<!-- uid=419700401:37:1 -->

**Thokk:** ...

<!-- uid=419700401:38:1 -->

**Makoto:** All quiet on the home front right  
now, from the look of it.

<!-- uid=419700401:39:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yeah. I wonder if we could save her  
to local storage like Kirito  
mentioned earlier.

<!-- uid=419700401:40:1 -->

**Makoto:** We don't have that kind of time.  
She's showing signs of coming back  
to life. We've got one choice.

<!-- uid=419700401:41:1 -->

**Thokk:** I'll talk to Asuna and the others.  
I need to discuss developing that  
new VRMMO with them anyway.

<!-- uid=419700401:42:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wait, what's there to discuss?  
You're not thinking of refusing to  
do it, are you? You can't do that!

<!-- uid=419700401:43:1 -->

**Thokk:** You don't know what you're talking  
about! You don't get how hard it  
is for people to make video games!

<!-- uid=419700401:44:1 -->

do it, you wanted to do it right!  
So how can you--

<!-- uid=419700401:45:1 -->

**Thokk:** I never said I wouldn't do it!

<!-- uid=419700401:46:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wait, you didn't? Then...?

<!-- uid=419700401:47:1 -->


## Story 419700501 · Nibelungen Purgatory

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Part 1~

**Kirito:** New Project Proposal, Codename:  
Nibelungen Purgatory.

<!-- uid=419700501:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** This is really impressive, Thokk!  
I can't believe you came up with  
it in just a few days!

<!-- uid=419700501:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah, I'm already intrigued just  
seeing the title and cover! You  
did great!

<!-- uid=419700501:3:1 -->

**Thokk:** I... I'm glad you two like it  
so far...

<!-- uid=419700501:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Alright, let's delve into the  
nitty gritty details and see--

<!-- uid=419700501:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** W-Wait! Before you do that!

<!-- uid=419700501:6:2 -->

**Kirito:** Huh? What is it?

<!-- uid=419700501:7:1 -->

**Thokk:** Would it be good enough if this  
new game was only designed for  
what Urdr needs?

<!-- uid=419700501:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Uh, well... That's definitely  
important, I'll give you that.

<!-- uid=419700501:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** But I hope it's something that'll  
still be fun to play, especially  
with you making it, Thokk.

<!-- uid=419700501:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** I knew you'd say that...

<!-- uid=419700501:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh? What is it...?

<!-- uid=419700501:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** N-No! I'm glad you have high hopes  
for me. I just don't know if I'll  
be able to live up to them.

<!-- uid=419700501:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** What are you talking about, Thokk?  
You made Helheim singlehandedly.  
That's no mean feat!

<!-- uid=419700501:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sure, the Seed can automate a lot  
of things, but you still created  
an area all by yourself.

<!-- uid=419700501:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** He's right. When I visited it, I  
was impressed at how well made it  
was. The NPCs were great, too!

<!-- uid=419700501:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** Hrm...

<!-- uid=419700501:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** I don't get it. Why would you  
draft up this proposal unless you  
actually planned to make it?

<!-- uid=419700501:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's the thing: she hasn't made  
any more progress knowing that  
you guys will be interested in it.

<!-- uid=419700501:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Why? Does knowing we'll be playing  
it add more pressure? Thokk, you  
shouldn't worry about that.

<!-- uid=419700501:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** Look, I'm the type who doesn't  
like to show my plans to those who  
are going to play my stuff.

<!-- uid=419700501:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** I'd rather they enjoy it fresh  
when it's all developed and ready  
to actually be played, you know?

<!-- uid=419700501:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, jeez. I had no idea.

<!-- uid=419700501:23:1 -->

**Makoto:** Thokk, you can't keep waffling on  
this issue forever. We have to  
figure out what we're going to do.

<!-- uid=419700501:24:1 -->

**Makoto:** The way you're talking, it sounds  
to me like you haven't made up  
your mind either way, have you?

<!-- uid=419700501:25:1 -->

**Thokk:** L-Leave me alone! Who asked for  
your opinion, anyway?

<!-- uid=419700501:26:1 -->

**Makoto:** You really don't have to debate it  
so much in your head. Just think  
of it as a great opportunity.

<!-- uid=419700501:27:1 -->

**Makoto:** I'll tell you, Thokk. Nobody is  
good at what they do from the  
start. Not even us grown ups.

<!-- uid=419700501:28:1 -->

**Makoto:** You've got such wonderful help.  
Take advantage of it! Use it to  
grow and improve bit by bit.

<!-- uid=419700501:29:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's how you get better at  
anything: by pushing yourself and  
learning as you go along.

<!-- uid=419700501:30:1 -->

**Thokk:** Ugh, I can't believe I'm getting  
lectured on how to grow up by  
someone like you. This sucks.

<!-- uid=419700501:31:1 -->

**Makoto:** What did you just say?! I'm just  
trying to help here!

<!-- uid=419700501:32:1 -->

**Kirito:** L-Let's change the subject. Where  
does this "Nibelungen Purgatory"  
title come from?

<!-- uid=419700501:33:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm guessing Nibelungen comes from  
Wagner's The Ring of the Nibelung,  
which is based on Norse sagas.

<!-- uid=419700501:34:1 -->

**Makoto:** Right. The idea is to basically do  
what Wagner did with Norse myths,  
but with the world of ALO instead.

<!-- uid=419700501:35:1 -->

**Makoto:** Which is to say, take the existing  
foundation of ALO and expand it  
into new story territory.

<!-- uid=419700501:36:1 -->

**Asuna:** That makes sense. So then why is  
"purgatory" in the name, too?

<!-- uid=419700501:37:1 -->

**Makoto:** Thokk wants to create her new world  
to leave a real mark on those who  
play the game.

<!-- uid=419700501:38:1 -->

**Makoto:** It combines aspects of heaven and  
the underworld. What sits between  
them? Purgatory, of course.

<!-- uid=419700501:39:1 -->

**Kirito:** Haha, wow, that's elaborate.  
I agree that it definitely makes  
a strong first impression.

<!-- uid=419700501:40:1 -->

**Thokk:** That's all my plan is right now,  
impressions. It's all up in the  
air, so don't get too attached.

<!-- uid=419700501:41:1 -->


## Story 419700601 · Door To Another Dimension

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Part 1~

**Thokk:** Hmm...

<!-- uid=419700601:1:1 -->

**Makoto:** What's up? You worried about  
something else now?

**Thokk:** I was just thinking about the  
makeup of the whole team going  
into this big project.

**Thokk:** I know game development is a team  
effort, but I really doubt I'll  
get along with them...

<!-- uid=419700601:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** I'm just a middle schooler with  
bad social skills. I shouldn't be  
running the show here!

<!-- uid=419700601:6:1 -->

**Makoto:** It's going to take courage for  
sure. That's where strength comes  
from: overcoming tough obstacles.

<!-- uid=419700601:7:1 -->

**Thokk:** Grr, easy for you to say. You're  
a grown up. You're not the one  
who has to pull this off somehow.

<!-- uid=419700601:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** Yes, but with age comes wisdom.  
But it's not just you I'm thinking  
about here, either.

<!-- uid=419700601:9:1 -->

**Makoto:** Asuna really wants to help, too.  
That's why I keep trying to push  
you, as a sort of favor to her.

<!-- uid=419700601:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** Huh? I don't get it. I know that  
you go way back with Kirito and  
Leafa.

<!-- uid=419700601:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** But I thought you and Asuna don't  
have that much history in  
comparison.

**Makoto:** We don't. But Asuna's been a good  
influence on the two of them,  
on Kazu and Sugu.

<!-- uid=419700601:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** They've changed because of her.  
Before, things were a bit strained  
between them, you could say.

<!-- uid=419700601:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** Oh, I never realized that.

<!-- uid=419700601:15:1 -->

**Makoto:** But thanks to Asuna and ALO,  
they've turned into better kids as  
a whole.

<!-- uid=419700601:16:1 -->

**Makoto:** There's nobody more concerned for  
Hellfire Urdr's well being than  
Asuna. She truly wants to help.

<!-- uid=419700601:17:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's why I turned to you, Thokk.  
I'm useless at making games.  
I don't even know where to begin!

<!-- uid=419700601:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** But you're different. You have  
those skills and I hope you'll use  
them for such a good cause.

<!-- uid=419700601:19:1 -->

**Thokk:** Wow, Makoto, I...I don't know  
what to say.

<!-- uid=419700601:20:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hehe, I'm sorry if it feels like  
I'm driving you hard. In the end,  
I respect that it's your decision.

<!-- uid=419700601:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** ...

<!-- uid=419700601:22:1 -->

**Makoto:** Huh? Wh-What's happening?!

<!-- uid=419700601:23:1 -->

**Thokk:** Don't tell me--

<!-- uid=419700601:24:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh crap! Could Hellfire Urdr

<!-- uid=419700601:25:1 -->

**Thokk:** No, that's not it! My inventory

<!-- uid=419700601:26:1 -->

**Thokk:** Is this the Chronos Zone?!

<!-- uid=419700601:27:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wait, this black void: isn't this

<!-- uid=419700601:28:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yeah, but the scenery ahead looks

<!-- uid=419700601:29:1 -->

**Makoto:** Huh? What does that even mean?!  
Crap, it's trying to suck us in!

<!-- uid=419700601:30:1 -->

**Thokk:** Urrrgh... H-Hraaagh!

<!-- uid=419700601:31:1 -->

**Makoto:** Aaaaaah!

<!-- uid=419700601:32:1 -->


## Story 419700701 · Time Axis Wanderer

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Part 1~

**Makoto:** ...

<!-- uid=419700701:1:1 -->

**Makoto:** U-Ungh... Huh?

<!-- uid=419700701:2:1 -->

**Makoto:** Where are we...?  
Oh, Thokk! There you are!

<!-- uid=419700701:3:1 -->

**Thokk:** Zzz... Sorry... I don't think  
I can eat another strawberry...

<!-- uid=419700701:4:1 -->

**Makoto:** Thokk, wake up! You're dreaming.

<!-- uid=419700701:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** Huh? Oh, Makoto! Where are we?  
I don't think I recognize this  
place...

<!-- uid=419700701:6:1 -->

**Makoto:** Neither do I. When I woke up, we  
both somehow ended up here.

<!-- uid=419700701:7:1 -->

**Thokk:** If we look like this, we must  
still be in ALO... Or, maybe not,  
now that I think about it.

<!-- uid=419700701:8:1 -->

**Thokk:** That white tower... I don't  
remember seeing anything like  
that in ALO.

<!-- uid=419700701:9:1 -->

**Makoto:** So we're in another VRMMO, then?  
But wait, doesn't your appearance  
change if you convert your avatar?

<!-- uid=419700701:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** I don't think we are. There's an  
urban legend that's been floating  
around that might explain things.

<!-- uid=419700701:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** Rumor has it there's some kind of  
warp that can take people to  
different dimensions.

<!-- uid=419700701:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** They say people can visit from  
different time streams, as well as  
be sent to other worlds entirely.

<!-- uid=419700701:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wow, that sounds crazy. We'll be  
able to get back to ALO, though,  
won't we?

<!-- uid=419700701:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** If I were to guess what's going  
on, I'd say some sort of computing  
process has fallen behind.

<!-- uid=419700701:15:1 -->

**Thokk:** Knowing that, I'd say if we give  
it time to catch up, we'll likely  
make it back, yeah.

<!-- uid=419700701:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** Otherwise, I doubt there'd be much  
of a rumor, would there?

<!-- uid=419700701:17:1 -->

**Makoto:** That makes sense...  
Huh? What the--?

<!-- uid=419700701:18:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Well, guess we should get going.

<!-- uid=419700701:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, might as well.

<!-- uid=419700701:20:1 -->

**Makoto:** I wasn't imagining things, right?  
I just saw two boys emerge?  
Wait, not just that...

<!-- uid=419700701:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** One of them looked just like  
Kirito!

<!-- uid=419700701:22:1 -->

**Makoto:** He did. But he looked a little  
different, like he was somehow  
a bit more mature.

<!-- uid=419700701:23:1 -->

**Thokk:** His clothes were different, too.  
He had no fairy wings, either...  
But that was definitely Kirito!

<!-- uid=419700701:24:1 -->

**Makoto:** Yeah! Let's speak with him!  
Heeey! Kirito! Over here!

<!-- uid=419700701:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** Eugeo, do you sense that?

<!-- uid=419700701:26:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Yeah. The enemy's waiting to  
ambush us nearby.

<!-- uid=419700701:27:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's weird. Did he not hear me?

**Makoto:** Hey, Kirito! Can you hear me?!  
Hey, Kazu!

<!-- uid=419700701:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** Stay alert! This could be  
dangerous!

<!-- uid=419700701:30:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Right!

<!-- uid=419700701:31:1 -->

**Thokk:** Aaah! What just happened?!

<!-- uid=419700701:33:1 -->

**Makoto:** That red knight just came out of  
nowhere and attacked them!

<!-- uid=419700701:34:1 -->

**Makoto:** From the way he's acting,  
I almost wonder if Kirito can't  
hear us?

<!-- uid=419700701:35:1 -->


## Story 419700801 · Kirito and Eugeo

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Part 1~

**Eugeo:** Y-You've got it wrong! We aren't  
using any dark arts, I swear!

<!-- uid=419700801:1:1 -->

**Thokk:** Looks like they're arguing about  
something.

<!-- uid=419700801:2:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yikes! The three of them just  
started firing off at each other!

<!-- uid=419700801:4:1 -->

**Makoto:** Kirito and that other boy are  
going to be in trouble if we  
don't back them up!

<!-- uid=419700801:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** Hold your horses. Can't you see?  
We're not able to actually  
interact with this world.

<!-- uid=419700801:6:1 -->

**Makoto:** What...? Hey, you're right.  
What's going on here?

<!-- uid=419700801:7:1 -->

**Thokk:** We're basically invisible in this  
place. Like ghosts, unable to  
touch anything.

<!-- uid=419700801:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** Yeah, that makes sense.  
I can't really think of any other  
explanation for it...

<!-- uid=419700801:9:1 -->

**Makoto:** Why else would all three of them  
be oblivious to us while they  
all fight so close by?

<!-- uid=419700801:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** Exactly. It must have something  
to do with the fact that we came  
here on a time stream.

<!-- uid=419700801:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** Our ability to interfere with  
whatever happens here has been  
restricted.

<!-- uid=419700801:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Form Element! Shield Shape!  
Discharge!

<!-- uid=419700801:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** ...Weird. It looks like fighting  
works a lot differently here than  
we're used to in ALO.

<!-- uid=419700801:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** To put it lightly. People don't  
seem to be as agile, either, or  
fly through the air.

<!-- uid=419700801:15:1 -->

**Thokk:** Their attacks look heavier, too.  
Like each move has more force  
or the sheer data is denser.

<!-- uid=419700801:16:1 -->

**Makoto:** Yeah. Everything has more weight  
and impact. It's more realistic.

<!-- uid=419700801:17:1 -->

**Thokk:** It's a really different atmosphere  
compared to games that try to  
be flashy with their effects.

<!-- uid=419700801:18:1 -->

**Thokk:** I think it's fair to say we're  
definitely not in ALO anymore.

<!-- uid=419700801:19:1 -->

**Thokk:** ...

<!-- uid=419700801:20:1 -->

**Makoto:** Huh? What's the matter, Thokk?

<!-- uid=419700801:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** I know I shouldn't say this when  
Kirito's fighting so hard, but  
this battle is really something.

<!-- uid=419700801:22:1 -->

**Thokk:** I've never seen combat like this  
in any VRMMO before. There's...  
a lot for me to learn from this.

<!-- uid=419700801:23:1 -->

**Makoto:** Heh, always wanting to learn, huh?

<!-- uid=419700801:24:1 -->


## Story 419700901 · The Duo's Will

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Part 1~

**Kirito:** The paralysis will wear off in a  
few minutes. Once you can speak,  
I need you to do something.

<!-- uid=419700901:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Start casting Enhance Armament,   
but make sure the  
knights don't catch you, okay?

<!-- uid=419700901:2:1 -->

**Eugeo:** K-Kirito...

<!-- uid=419700901:3:1 -->

**Thokk:** I get it. Kirito was just acting  
like he was defeated.

<!-- uid=419700901:4:1 -->

**Makoto:** We sure climbed pretty high up  
to keep watching those two fight,  
though, I've got to say.

<!-- uid=419700901:5:1 -->

**Makoto:** But it was definitely worth it.  
All those battles were completely  
incredible to watch.

<!-- uid=419700901:6:1 -->

**Makoto:** They were seriously life and  
death, and I don't say that  
lightly.

<!-- uid=419700901:7:1 -->

**Thokk:** Kirito and that blond boy with  
him, Eugeo, they're fighting such  
tough enemies all by themselves.

<!-- uid=419700901:8:1 -->

**Thokk:** You can tell just by looking at  
them that they both have such  
incredibly strong willpower.

<!-- uid=419700901:9:1 -->

**Thokk:** They must have such deep trust  
in each other in order to be able  
to fight like that.

<!-- uid=419700901:10:1 -->

**Makoto:** Definitely. Just look at the  
way he was whispering to Eugeo,  
too.

<!-- uid=419700901:11:1 -->

**Makoto:** I think he was doing that to try  
and draw the enemy's attention  
toward himself.

<!-- uid=419700901:12:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's such a risky move. You have  
to really believe you know what  
you're doing to pull such a thing.

<!-- uid=419700901:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** And he knows how to coordinate.  
As someone who mostly fights  
solo, that looks pretty dang hard.

<!-- uid=419700901:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** Didn't you say you started  
practicing kendo 'cause you're  
such a Shinsengumi fan?

<!-- uid=419700901:15:1 -->

**Thokk:** They were famous for killing  
their targets in groups, so to  
hear you say that is surprising.

<!-- uid=419700901:16:1 -->

**Makoto:** No, my DAD loves them and forced  
it on me. My swordfighting style's  
otherwise rooted solely in kendo.

<!-- uid=419700901:17:1 -->

**Thokk:** Ah, gotcha. My bad, hee hee.

<!-- uid=419700901:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** Anyway, point being, speaking as  
someone used to fighting mostly  
on her own, one-on-one...

<!-- uid=419700901:19:1 -->

**Makoto:** Watching those two gave me a real  
appreciation for how important

## Story 419701401 · Battle System Conference

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Part 1~

**Thokk:** The Cardinal System's emotional  
analysis function lets me do a lot  
with the synchronization system.

<!-- uid=419701401:1:1 -->

**Thokk:** An AI can examine each member's  
emotions, status, and requests  
and compile them into patterns.

<!-- uid=419701401:2:1 -->

**Thokk:** From there, it can deliver what it  
deems to be the best response as  
text windows to the other players.

<!-- uid=419701401:3:1 -->

**Thokk:** And the system's speedy enough  
that it should make even boss  
raids perfectly doable, too.

<!-- uid=419701401:4:1 -->

**Makoto:** Yeah, I think so. Communicating  
with everyone's a piece of  
cake even without anyone talking.

<!-- uid=419701401:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** Hee hee, I'm glad! It's a fresh  
way to fight in a fresh, new game!  
Just as it should be!

<!-- uid=419701401:6:1 -->

**Thokk:** But...I guess this means I have  
to put extra thought into how  
enemy Mobs are made up now.

<!-- uid=419701401:7:1 -->

**Makoto:** Really? What makes this game so  
different?

<!-- uid=419701401:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** If you want to give players a hard  
fight, isn't it enough to raise  
enemy stats and call it a day?

<!-- uid=419701401:9:1 -->

**Thokk:** I mean, sure, that's part of it,  
but doing only that is the  
easy way out, if you ask me.

<!-- uid=419701401:10:1 -->

**Makoto:** What else do you plan to do,  
then? Like make their routines  
varied and complex?

<!-- uid=419701401:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** Ooh, look at you! You're sounding  
like a real developer now! I'm  
impressed, Makoto!

<!-- uid=419701401:12:1 -->

**Makoto:** Haha, what can I say? I've been  
studying up a little. Glad to hear  
it's starting to pay off.

<!-- uid=419701401:13:1 -->

**Thokk:** I swear, you like to brag over the  
littlest things sometimes. That's  
what makes you you, I guess.

<!-- uid=419701401:14:1 -->

**Makoto:** Anyway, getting back to those  
enemies, how does my idea sound  
about mixing those routines up?

<!-- uid=419701401:15:1 -->

**Thokk:** It's good! I plan on doing that,  
too, but the issue runs a bit  
deeper for me.

<!-- uid=419701401:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** I want things to feel right  
thematically. I wanna explore  
why they're attacking the player.

<!-- uid=419701401:17:1 -->

**Thokk:** Stuff like that. I'm trying to  
make things more meaningful for  
players when they encounter them.

<!-- uid=419701401:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hmm... Okay, now I think you've  
lost me again, Thokk.

<!-- uid=419701401:19:1 -->

**Makoto:** Sounds like it'll take a lot of  
thought, especially since Kirito  
and the others want to play it.

<!-- uid=419701401:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yeah, definitely... You know,  
that reminds me.

<!-- uid=419701401:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** Kirito and I had an interesting  
conversation a while back...

<!-- uid=419701401:22:1 -->


## Story 419701501 · Gunned Down

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Part 1~

**Thokk:** I still remember what Kirito said

something like this...

that one of these days.

**Thokk:** The one with Death Gun?

<!-- uid=419701501:7:1 -->

<!-- uid=419701501:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** Haha, I'm guessing you could tell  
based on the way I fight, even  
in that getup, huh?

have a funny effect on you.

worse, helped me with Death Gun.

**Thokk:** ...

## Story 419701601 · To the Old GGO

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Part 1~

## Story 419702301 · Creator of the New World

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Part 1~

**Makoto:** Well, how's development work  
coming along, Thokk? Everything  
looking good?

<!-- uid=419702301:1:1 -->

**Thokk:** You bet! Once I remembered we're  
doing this to save Hellfire Urdr,  
I felt myself get real pumped!

<!-- uid=419702301:2:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's good! So what's the basic  
concept behind the world and  
stuff?

<!-- uid=419702301:3:1 -->

**Thokk:** That's the neat part: Nibelungen  
Purgatory's gonna take place in  
a world of angels!

<!-- uid=419702301:4:1 -->

**Makoto:** Angels? Why those?

<!-- uid=419702301:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** Well, fairies are ALO's whole  
deal, so I can't just up and copy  
what that game's already doing.

<!-- uid=419702301:6:1 -->

**Thokk:** I want my VRMMO to be unique  
and completely different, so  
that's why we're doing angels!

<!-- uid=419702301:7:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh, fair enough. I guess I see  
your point.

<!-- uid=419702301:8:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yeah. It takes place in a world far  
above the realm of humans, where  
angels rule over matters of death.

<!-- uid=419702301:9:1 -->

**Makoto:** Okay, but what makes your angels  
so different from ALO's fairies  
in practice?

<!-- uid=419702301:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** Well, the first thing you should  
know is these aren't necessarily  
the nice, normal angels you know.

<!-- uid=419702301:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** They're way more powerful than  
people and hold the souls of the  
dead captive to put them to work.

<!-- uid=419702301:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** The player's just your average  
human who ends up stumbling into  
Purgatory, the angels' world.

<!-- uid=419702301:13:1 -->

**Thokk:** Over time, they see how human  
souls are treated like slaves at  
the hands of the angels.

<!-- uid=419702301:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** And eventually, they enter a fight  
to liberate the humans! That's  
basically my game in a nutshell.

<!-- uid=419702301:15:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wow! So the angels are bad guys!  
Sounds like a pretty dark game  
you and your team are making.

<!-- uid=419702301:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yeah, if ALO could be described  
as "light" fantasy in terms of  
vibe, our game is dark fantasy.

<!-- uid=419702301:17:1 -->

**Thokk:** It's another way to help ensure  
our VRMMO stands out and feels  
different in comparison.

<!-- uid=419702301:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** It sounds like an intriguing story  
for sure, but also maybe a little  
scary and bleak, too.

<!-- uid=419702301:19:1 -->

**Thokk:** Don't worry. There's more to it  
than just that.

<!-- uid=419702301:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** When the angels first show up,  
they're cold and brutal. You're  
meant to really fear them.

<!-- uid=419702301:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** But as they fight the humans and  
learn their perspective, they  
start to have a change of heart.

<!-- uid=419702301:22:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's always a good way to amp up  
drama, having characters from  
different sides come together.

<!-- uid=419702301:23:1 -->

**Makoto:** Reminds me of a samurai movie  
or something.

<!-- uid=419702301:24:1 -->

**Thokk:** Haha, leave it to you to compare  
my game to samurai movies.

<!-- uid=419702301:25:1 -->

**Thokk:** But yeah, I figure doing that will  
ensure players who come to it for  
the story will enjoy it, too.

<!-- uid=419702301:26:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's cool. What sort of role  
will Hellfire Urdr have once she  
converts into that world, then?

<!-- uid=419702301:27:1 -->

**Thokk:** Well...

<!-- uid=419702301:28:1 -->


## Story 419702401 · Urdr's New Home

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Part 1~

**Makoto:** Interesting. So she's going to be  
a villager whose home was wiped  
out by an angel scheme.

<!-- uid=419702401:1:1 -->

**Makoto:** And then fueled by her anger,  
she'll step foot into Purgatory  
all on her own.

<!-- uid=419702401:2:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's pretty different from what  
I thought you might have in mind  
for her.

<!-- uid=419702401:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** I thought she'd be a navigational  
character or an assistant of some  
sort like Yui.

<!-- uid=419702401:4:1 -->

**Thokk:** Navigational characters don't all  
have to be all-knowing people who  
just dump tons of info on you.

<!-- uid=419702401:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** They can also be characters who  
help move the story along, even if  
they don't know everything.

<!-- uid=419702401:6:1 -->

**Makoto:** True. Your setting provides a good  
reason for Hellfire Urdr to let  
loose with all that anger.

<!-- uid=419702401:7:1 -->

**Makoto:** But it's not like the angels  
directly kill anyone in the human  
realm themselves, right?

<!-- uid=419702401:8:1 -->

**Thokk:** Right. They don't directly meddle  
with humans down below. But they  
do put them up to nasty things.

<!-- uid=419702401:9:1 -->

**Thokk:** Kirito told me that there are  
forces in Midgard trying to start  
a war in that game, too.

<!-- uid=419702401:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** So I took some inspiration from  
that and put my own spin on it.

<!-- uid=419702401:11:1 -->

**Makoto:** The angels practically sound like  
they're gods, controlling the  
lives of people so ruthlessly.

<!-- uid=419702401:12:1 -->

**Makoto:** They're definitely not the  
friendly beings you hear about in  
a lot of other stories.

<!-- uid=419702401:13:1 -->

**Thokk:** To the angels, ruling over the  
foolish human world is a right and  
noble cause.

<!-- uid=419702401:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** I'm hoping the scale and scope  
of it really elevates the whole  
thing as a dark fantasy story.

<!-- uid=419702401:15:1 -->

**Makoto:** Now I understand why you call it  
Nibelungen Purgatory. The world  
might be full of angels...

<!-- uid=419702401:16:1 -->

**Makoto:** But to the people inhabiting it,  
it's hardly paradise. They're  
stuck in limbo as slaves.

<!-- uid=419702401:17:1 -->

**Thokk:** Hee hee, exactly! I'm glad you  
were able to figure it out!

<!-- uid=419702401:18:1 -->

**Thokk:** Nibelungen Purgatory,  
NP for short.

<!-- uid=419702401:19:1 -->

**Makoto:** Now you've really got me  
interested, Thokk! I can't wait  
to check it out!

<!-- uid=419702401:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** Well, you'll just have to wait  
until it's finished. We still have  
a lot of work to do on it.

<!-- uid=419702401:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** Just don't tell anyone about this  
story stuff, okay? I don't want  
them spoiled before playtesting.

<!-- uid=419702401:22:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hee hee, sure thing. I'll make  
sure nobody else finds out.

<!-- uid=419702401:23:1 -->

## Story 419800201 · Apathetic Angel

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Part 2~

**Kirito:** A battle between evil angels and

<!-- uid=419800201:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** I see, interesting.

**Kirito:** So angels would seem like

name because rescuing Urdr was its  
main goal at the time.

**Thokk:** This is a new game, so we wanna

its world.

<!-- uid=419800201:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** That's why I wanna be as original

enemy angels.

<!-- uid=419800201:12:1 -->

<!-- uid=419800201:13:1 -->

and toys...

<!-- uid=419800201:14:1 -->

were like statues. It was  
pretty creepy...

<!-- uid=419800201:21:1 -->

**Makoto:** Were they powerful?

<!-- uid=419800201:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Reasonably powerful, I guess...

to kill players.

**Thokk:** Hrmm...

## Story 419901001 · Omen of Progress

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Part 3~

**Villager:** ...And it was when the village  
was in a drought that Ortlinde  
descended from the heavens.

## Story 419901401 · Leap of Motivation

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Part 3~

**Makoto:** You're Yuuki the Imp, right?

<!-- uid=419901401:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yes, that's right. I was telling  
her about this world, and she said  
she just had to visit it herself

<!-- uid=419901401:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** even if it's still in development.  
Thokk said she didn't mind,

## Story 419902901 · The Existence of Angels

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Part 3~

**Ortlinde:** Angels are born as a result of  
Purgatory using human souls  
as catalysts.

<!-- uid=419902901:1:1 -->

**Ortlinde:** We are tragic beings, ones with  
supernatural powers because  
we are creatures of the soul.

<!-- uid=419902901:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** Well... You do hear these kinds  
of story premises a lot.

<!-- uid=419902901:3:1 -->

**Liz:** But if you were originally human  
souls, why have you forgotten that  
and tried to rule humans instead?

<!-- uid=419902901:5:1 -->

**Ortlinde:** It would not be an exaggeration to  
call it nothing short of human  
sin...

<!-- uid=419902901:6:1 -->

**Ortlinde:** Negative human emotions such as  
malice, rage, and sorrow take  
shape and rise to the skies.

<!-- uid=419902901:7:1 -->

**Ortlinde:** What they created was the very  
world that we inhabit.

<!-- uid=419902901:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** A world of negative emotions...?

<!-- uid=419902901:9:1 -->

**Liz:** That's what Purgatory is? Well...  
When you put it that way, it does  
make sense.

<!-- uid=419902901:10:1 -->

**Ortlinde:** Souls are meant to be saved, yet  
these human souls were lost  
before they could ever be rescued.

<!-- uid=419902901:11:1 -->

**Ortlinde:** Dominated by negative emotions,  
they are transformed into angels  
who toy with humanity.

<!-- uid=419902901:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** In other words...

<!-- uid=419902901:13:1 -->

**Liz:** It's a vicious cycle?

<!-- uid=419902901:14:1 -->

**Ortlinde:** You brave Nibelungen may be able  
to stay composed in our world...

<!-- uid=419902901:15:1 -->

**Ortlinde:** But those who wander into it,  
in the grips of anger...

<!-- uid=419902901:16:1 -->

**Ortlinde:** ...are in grave danger of having  
their souls transformed into  
angels...

<!-- uid=419902901:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** What?!

<!-- uid=419902901:18:1 -->

**Liz:** Oh no, it couldn't be...!

<!-- uid=419902901:19:1 -->

## Story 419903601 · Far Enough

Event Story  
Nibelungen Purgatory ~Part 3~

**Warla:** ...

<!-- uid=419903601:1:1 -->

**Warla:** \*sigh\*...

sec so I can talk to you. I had to  
when I saw you in that much pain.

<!-- uid=419903601:7:1 -->

about the game...?

needs to come to a stopping point.

<!-- uid=419903601:9:1 -->

ending Part 1...

<!-- uid=419903601:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** I was thinking the game could be  
three, maybe four parts.

<!-- uid=419903601:11:1 -->

**Thokk:** I've been thinking a lot about  
the new place where Hellfire  
Urdr's avatar will live.

<!-- uid=419903601:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** A soul forced to live in a certain  
spot due to the circumstances  
in this game...

<!-- uid=419903601:13:1 -->

**Thokk:** But in a way, that's your fate if  
you're someone living in a  
virtual world...

<!-- uid=419903601:14:1 -->

same for us humans living in  
the real world.

<!-- uid=419903601:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Lots of rules and restrictions  
take our freedom, forcing us  
to live a certain way.

<!-- uid=419903601:16:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yeah, I get that too.  
...Which is why I wanted Warla  
to understand it as well.

<!-- uid=419903601:17:1 -->

**Thokk:** A vicious cycle made by the  
human world's negative feelings...  
Purgatory and its angels...

<!-- uid=419903601:18:1 -->

**Thokk:** Humans might be responsible for  
all that, but it's also humans who  
can put a stop to it...

<!-- uid=419903601:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** So this place... is a story meant  
to teach her about the world...  
so she understands human emotions?

<!-- uid=419903601:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** Basically, yep. Warla was a little  
girl who only knew anger after her  
parents were killed.

<!-- uid=419903601:21:1 -->

**Thokk:** By going to Purgatory and the  
surface, learning all about human  
emotions, and becoming an angel,

<!-- uid=419903601:22:1 -->

**Thokk:** instead of destroying this  
cursed world, she would see it  
turn into a place of purification.

<!-- uid=419903601:23:1 -->

**Thokk:** It's the story of it becoming the  
world-healing higher-ranking  
angel it should've always been...

<!-- uid=419903601:24:1 -->

**Thokk:** That was my idea for it all.

<!-- uid=419903601:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** So when we heard the phrase  
higher-ranking angel...

<!-- uid=419903601:26:1 -->

**Thokk:** That meant this world as a whole.

<!-- uid=419903601:27:1 -->

going to turn back into the girl  
we know after this?

<!-- uid=419903601:28:1 -->

Hellfire Urdr's emotions  
are more complex than...

resolved through that earlier  
event alone.

<!-- uid=419903601:31:1 -->

into consideration...

<!-- uid=419903601:32:1 -->

<!-- uid=419903601:33:1 -->

I let you know the plot since it's  
not like I wanted you to be sad.

<!-- uid=419903601:34:1 -->

<!-- uid=419903601:35:1 -->

**Thokk:** Don't worry about it. I'm just

as hard as this one.

<!-- uid=419903601:36:1 -->

for our testing session?

<!-- uid=419903601:39:1 -->

<!-- uid=419903601:40:1 -->

save Warla that much more!

<!-- uid=420000401:13:1 -->

**Seiko:** Strongest swordsmen of the  
 Bakumatsu period or not, it  
 doesn't mean they were right.

<!-- uid=420000401:14:1 -->

**Seiko:** Back then, there was a lot of  
 turmoil in Japan over who should  
 rule it, and about its borders...

<!-- uid=420000401:15:1 -->

**Seiko:** I think that everyone was doing  
 their best to fight for what they  
 believed to be right.

<!-- uid=420000401:16:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Everyone fighting for what they  
 believe to be right, huh...

<!-- uid=420000401:17:1 -->

**Suguha:** Hey, I know! Now that you're back  
 in town, Sei, why don't you try  
 giving ALO a shot too?

<!-- uid=420000401:18:1 -->

**Seiko:** Huh? ALO... Is that the game you  
 were talking about before?

<!-- uid=420000401:19:1 -->

**Suguha:** That's the one! You could be a  
 hero in a virtual world as well  
 as the real one!

<!-- uid=420000401:20:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Well, it's not like that's the  
 goal of the game or anything.

<!-- uid=420000401:21:1 -->

**Seiko:** I-I don't know. My dad never  
 bought me any video games  
 when I was growing up...

<!-- uid=420000401:22:1 -->

**Seiko:** So even now I'm really bad when it  
 comes to technical stuff like  
 that... I'm sure I'd be terrible.

<!-- uid=420000401:23:1 -->

**Suguha:** Not at all. You're really athletic  
 and good at kendo, so I bet you'd  
 be a top player in no time.

<!-- uid=420000401:24:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Yeah, in VR you can make full use  
 of video game skills AND real-  
 world skills. It's pretty awesome.

<!-- uid=420000401:25:1 -->

**Seiko:** Um, what do you mean by that?

<!-- uid=420000401:26:1 -->

## Story 420000601 · Log In

## Story 420000701 · Go to Hell

Event Story  
Helheim's invasion ~Part 1~

**Makoto:** Thokk...? N-Nice to meet you too,  
 Miss Thokk.

<!-- uid=420000701:1:1 -->

**Thokk:** No need for formalities.

<!-- uid=420000701:2:1 -->

**Makoto:** Okay, Thokk, I already have a  
 question... Given what you said

<!-- uid=420000701:3:1 -->

<!-- uid=420000701:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** But trust me, there's already a  
 Nibelheim, and it's a totally

<!-- uid=420000701:6:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hell from Norse mythology...  
 This whole game is based on  
 Norse mythology, right?

<!-- uid=420000701:7:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yup. The more you know about it,  
 the more you can appreciate  
 the game.

<!-- uid=420000701:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** So then, technically...  
 I AM in ALO...

<!-- uid=420000701:9:1 -->

**Thokk:** Technically, sure, but this  
 ain't Alfheim.

<!-- uid=420000701:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** It's more like the underworld...  
 A land of the dead with precious  
 few opportunities to visit it.

<!-- uid=420000701:11:1 -->

**Makoto:** What do you mean by "underworld"?

<!-- uid=420000701:12:1 -->

**Makoto:** I thought that this game was  
 about becoming a fairy and  
 fighting for justice.

<!-- uid=420000701:13:1 -->

**Thokk:** Ha ha ha! Have you even  
 seen yourself, lady?

<!-- uid=420000701:14:1 -->

**Makoto:** Seen myself...?

<!-- uid=420000701:15:1 -->

**Thokk:** Here, you can borrow my mirror.  
 Take a look.

<!-- uid=420000701:16:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wha?! Wh-Wh-What the...?!

<!-- uid=420000701:17:1 -->

**Makoto:** What the heck is this?! At least  
 I'm still a girl, but...

<!-- uid=420000701:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** Armor? Bat wings?!

<!-- uid=420000701:19:1 -->

**Makoto:** I don't look anything like a  
 fairy! I'm more like a demon  
 or a devil!

<!-- uid=420000701:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** Yup! That's how you know you  
 belong here in Helheim.

<!-- uid=420000701:21:1 -->

**???:** Hey! Look who's up!

<!-- uid=420000701:22:1 -->

**???:** Thank goodness. We were  
 worried about you.

<!-- uid=420000701:23:1 -->

**Makoto:** Um... Do I know you two?  
 Actually... I do think I  
 recognize your voices...

<!-- uid=420000701:24:1 -->

**???:** My name's Skull! I'm the one with  
 the awesome helmet and my calling-  
 card scythe! Good to meet ya!

<!-- uid=420000701:25:1 -->

**???:** I'm Grimm. How do you like my  
 horns? Beautiful, aren't they?

<!-- uid=420000701:26:1 -->

**Thokk:** These are the ones who  
 brought you here.

<!-- uid=420000701:27:1 -->

**Makoto:** Skull in skeleton armor,  
 and Grimm in blue sheepskin...

<!-- uid=420000701:28:1 -->

**Makoto:** Oh, I remember now. I heard your  
 voices right before I came here...  
 Hm?

<!-- uid=420000701:29:1 -->

**Makoto:** In other words, I was supposed to  
 be a fairy, and you two brought me  
 here against my will?!

<!-- uid=420000701:30:1 -->

**Thokk:** Ha ha ha, you got it.

<!-- uid=420000701:31:1 -->

**Makoto:** H-Hey! How could you do this  
 to me?!

<!-- uid=420000701:32:1 -->

**Grimm:** I'm so glad we got a strong one.

<!-- uid=420000701:33:1 -->

**Skull:** You said it! We're gonna make  
 a great team!

<!-- uid=420000701:34:1 -->

**Makoto:** Huh? Come on, listen to me!

<!-- uid=420000701:35:1 -->

**Thokk:** I wouldn't expect much in the way  
 of conversation from them. Or from  
 most of this world's residents.

<!-- uid=420000701:36:1 -->

**Thokk:** Grimm and Skull here are NPCs,

<!-- uid=420000701:37:1 -->

**Makoto:** NPCs? What's that?

<!-- uid=420000701:38:1 -->

**Thokk:** Short for "non-player character"?

<!-- uid=420000701:39:1 -->

**Thokk:** I'm surprised you've never heard  
 the term before. I take it you  
 don't play many video games?

<!-- uid=420000701:40:1 -->

**Makoto:** N-No. This is actually my first  
 time trying one, pretty much...

<!-- uid=420000701:41:1 -->

**Thokk:** Wow... I didn't think there was  
 anyone like you still around.

<!-- uid=420000701:42:1 -->

 conversation, right? Does that

<!-- uid=420000701:45:1 -->

<!-- uid=420000701:50:1 -->

**Skull:** Alright! Let's see how our new

<!-- uid=420000701:51:1 -->

**Makoto:** Huh?

## Story 420000801 · A Tutorial

Event Story  
Helheim's invasion ~Part 1~

**Makoto:** Whew... I'm still alive...

<!-- uid=420000801:1:1 -->

**Skull:** Not bad, Makoto!

<!-- uid=420000801:2:1 -->

**Grimm:** I knew you had what it takes.

<!-- uid=420000801:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wh-What's the big idea?! Why'd you  
 two gang up on me out of nowhere?!

<!-- uid=420000801:4:1 -->

**Thokk:** They've been demons a lot longer  
 than you have, so they were seeing  
 if you could keep up.

<!-- uid=420000801:5:1 -->

**Thokk:** Basically, a tutorial battle.

<!-- uid=420000801:6:1 -->

**Makoto:** Tutorial? So, this kind of thing  
 is common in video games?

<!-- uid=420000801:7:1 -->

**Thokk:** Sure is. Developers have been  
 using them to bring new players  
 up to speed for some time now.

<!-- uid=420000801:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hmm. I think I get it, but I'm  
 still not totally sure...

<!-- uid=420000801:9:1 -->

**Thokk:** The point is, keep going through  
 this part, and you'll know how to  
 play the game once you're done.

<!-- uid=420000801:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** So just play along and do what  
 they tell you.

<!-- uid=420000801:11:1 -->

**Makoto:** O-Okay... Wait, no! NOT okay!

<!-- uid=420000801:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** What's the matter?

<!-- uid=420000801:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** Why am I a demon in the first  
 place?!

<!-- uid=420000801:14:1 -->

**Makoto:** The whole reason I started this  
 game was to be a fairy and  
 fight for justice!

<!-- uid=420000801:15:1 -->

**Thokk:** Ha ha, is that so? Well, too bad.  
 You're a demon now, so you  
 better make the best of it.

<!-- uid=420000801:16:1 -->

**Makoto:** ...

<!-- uid=420000801:17:1 -->

**Skull:** This world is where denizens  
 of the light world go once  
 they've died.

<!-- uid=420000801:18:1 -->

**Grimm:** That's right. We used to belong to  
 another world too, before we were  
 killed and ended up here.

<!-- uid=420000801:19:1 -->

**Makoto:** Huh? You were killed?

<!-- uid=420000801:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** What'd I tell you? Helheim is  
 hell. The land of the dead.

<!-- uid=420000801:21:1 -->

**Makoto:** Then... Skull and Grimm have both  
 already been killed once before?

<!-- uid=420000801:22:1 -->

**Thokk:** That's the long and short of it.

<!-- uid=420000801:23:1 -->

**Makoto:** How awful...

<!-- uid=420000801:24:1 -->

**Skull:** Okay, let's keep going! We still  
 gotta see how strong you are!

<!-- uid=420000801:25:1 -->

**Makoto:** You mean there's more?!

<!-- uid=420000801:26:1 -->


## Story 420000901 · Real

Event Story  
Helheim's invasion ~Part 1~

**Skull:** Alright, on to the next one!

<!-- uid=420000901:1:1 -->

**Makoto:** Now where are they taking me?

<!-- uid=420000901:2:1 -->

**Thokk:** They're showing you around

**Makoto:** B-But I don't want to live in a

<!-- uid=420000901:6:1 -->

**Thokk:** Ha ha ha, the newer the newbie,

<!-- uid=420000901:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** Eep... What is this place?

<!-- uid=420000901:9:1 -->

**Makoto:** Aah! I thought these were rocks

 all skulls!

<!-- uid=420000901:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** How many times do I hafta tell

 shouldn't let something

**Thokk:** Aha... So that's why you're so

**Thokk:** I THOUGHT you had a real knack for

 officers as strong as you?

<!-- uid=420000901:16:1 -->

**Makoto:** Well, a lot of my colleagues do  
 practice martial arts. In my case,

**Thokk:** Oho.

<!-- uid=420000901:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** I'm happy to see that I can move  
 and act here just like I can in

<!-- uid=420000901:19:1 -->

**Makoto:** Now I see what Kazu and Sugu meant  
 when they said that real-world  
 experience pays off.

<!-- uid=420000901:20:1 -->

**Thokk:** Just so you know, you shouldn't go  
 around blabbing things that could

<!-- uid=420000901:21:1 -->

**Makoto:** Huh? ...Oh my gosh, you're right!

<!-- uid=420000901:22:1 -->

**Thokk:** Ha ha ha!

<!-- uid=420000901:23:1 -->

**Makoto:** Why didn't you warn me  
 sooner, Thokk?!

<!-- uid=420000901:24:1 -->

**Thokk:** Sorry 'bout that. Lucky for you,

 careful from now on, 'kay?

<!-- uid=420000901:25:1 -->

**Skull:** Ooh, what a great skull!  
 I'm keeping it.

<!-- uid=420000901:26:1 -->

**Grimm:** You never get tired of collecting  
 dead bodies, do you?

<!-- uid=420000901:27:1 -->

**Skull:** Hey, I may have flesh of my own

**Makoto:** Skeleton? Like some kind of  
 costume you wear on Halloween?

<!-- uid=420000901:29:1 -->

**Skull:** Halloween...? Oh, you mean  
 that festival they hold in the  
 living world.

<!-- uid=420000901:30:1 -->

**Skull:** No way, I was nothing as  
 cute as that! I was way  
 bigger and scarier!

<!-- uid=420000901:31:1 -->

**Makoto:** What about you, Grimm?  
 What did you used to look like?

<!-- uid=420000901:32:1 -->

**Grimm:** I used to be a lot bigger too.  
 Ever heard of the proud and

<!-- uid=420000901:33:1 -->

**Makoto:** Baphomet...? Is that a game  
 term too?

<!-- uid=420000901:34:1 -->

**Thokk:** Nah, that's a demon from old  
 literature. Why don't you do a

**Makoto:** You mean, search the web?  
 I'm... not very good at that  
 sort of thing either.

<!-- uid=420000901:36:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hm...? Wait a second. I just had a  
 conversation with them...

<!-- uid=420000901:37:1 -->

**Thokk:** Those two may not have individual  
 AI, but they can still carry on  
 simple conversations.

<!-- uid=420000901:38:1 -->

**Thokk:** They're designed to pick up on key  
 words from your speech and create

<!-- uid=420000901:39:1 -->

**Thokk:** It's kind of like those concierge

<!-- uid=420000901:40:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hm? Concierge? Are you talking

<!-- uid=420000901:41:1 -->

**Thokk:** \*sigh\*... I'm getting an

<!-- uid=420000901:42:1 -->

**Thokk:** Let me guess: your dad or grandpa

<!-- uid=420000901:43:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wha?! How did you know?!

<!-- uid=420000901:44:1 -->


## Story 420001001 · A Suggestion

Event Story  
Helheim's invasion ~Part 1~

**Makoto:** Yah!

<!-- uid=420001001:1:1 -->

**Thokk:** Okay, Makoto. That takes care of  
 your first quest.

**Thokk:** Makoto...

## Story 420001101 · An Invasion

Event Story  
Helheim's invasion ~Part 1~

**Makoto:** Wh-What do you mean, invade the  
 world of the living?

<!-- uid=420001101:1:1 -->

**Makoto:** Isn't that the fairy world? The  
 place where I was trying to go  
 originally...?

<!-- uid=420001101:2:1 -->

**Thokk:** That's the one! Now you're  
 gonna go and attack it.

<!-- uid=420001101:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** Wh-Why?!

<!-- uid=420001101:4:1 -->

## Story 420001301 · I am...

Event Story

<!-- uid=420001301:6:1 -->

**Monster:** KKKAAGAAAWW!

<!-- uid=420001301:11:1 -->

**Makoto:** My name is Makoto. In the real  
world I'm a rookie police officer.

<!-- uid=420001301:12:1 -->

**Makoto (Seiko):** I work in a small police station  
in the city of Kawagoe in Saitama  
Prefecture, just outside Tokyo.

<!-- uid=420001301:13:1 -->

**Makoto (Seiko):** It so happens I bumped into two  
childhood friends the other day,  
Kazuto and Suguha Kirigaya.

<!-- uid=420001301:14:1 -->

**Makoto (Seiko):** They're siblings, and I spent many  
years of my childhood learning  
kendo at their house's dojo.

<!-- uid=420001301:15:1 -->

**Makoto (Seiko):** I met them by chance and we caught  
up. But there was one thing that  
they recommended...

<!-- uid=420001301:16:1 -->

**Makoto (Seiko):** ALfheim Online. A virtual reality  
game set in a fictional world.

<!-- uid=420001301:17:1 -->

**Makoto (Seiko):** Naturally, I was interested.

<!-- uid=420001301:18:1 -->

**Makoto (Seiko):** I borrowed my dad's AmuSphere, which  
I needed to dive into the game.

<!-- uid=420001301:19:1 -->

**Makoto:** I was supposed to be plunged into  
Alfheim, become a fairy warrior,  
and take part in epic battles.

<!-- uid=420001301:20:1 -->

**Makoto:** But for some reason, I was sent to  
Helheim, the game's underworld,  
and trained as a demon warrior.

<!-- uid=420001301:21:1 -->

**Makoto:** Eventually, I was forced to join  
the demon army in their attack  
on the world of the fairies.

<!-- uid=420001301:22:1 -->

**Makoto:** The demons were sent to Helheim  
after being killed up above, so  
they bear a grudge against fairies.

<!-- uid=420001301:23:1 -->

**Makoto:** And so, along I went with the demon  
army, as I took my first steps into  
Alfheim in the land of the living.

<!-- uid=420001301:24:1 -->

## Story 420100301 · Seiko's Story

Event Story  
Helheim's invasion ~Part 2~

**Kazuto:** Hi Sugu. Ready to go home?

<!-- uid=420100301:2:1 -->

**Suguha:** Hey Kazuto! Yup, all set!

<!-- uid=420100301:3:1 -->

late, huh. I'm sorry I can only  
pick you up when I leave early.

<!-- uid=420100301:4:1 -->

**Suguha:** Don't worry about it!  
I'm just glad you're here!

<!-- uid=420100301:5:1 -->

**???:** Well now, if it isn't my favorite  
pair of siblings.

<!-- uid=420100301:6:1 -->

**Suguha:** Sei!

<!-- uid=420100301:7:1 -->

<!-- uid=420100301:8:1 -->

**Seiko:** Oh gosh, that's a good point!

this stuff, don't you, Kazu?

<!-- uid=420100301:14:1 -->

**Seiko:** ...

<!-- uid=420100301:15:1 -->

**Suguha:** Sei?

<!-- uid=420100301:16:1 -->

**Seiko:** Hey, Kazu. Speaking

<!-- uid=420100301:17:1 -->

**Seiko:** What if someone were to hack into

<!-- uid=420100301:18:1 -->

**Seiko:** But not do anything worse than

**Kazuto:** Hm? Well, hacking a security

**Kazuto:** Hmm... Well, putting the legality

<!-- uid=420100301:24:1 -->

<!-- uid=420100301:27:1 -->

**Seiko:** Well, she's good at computers,

**Suguha:** ...

**Kazuto:** Now I see what's going on.

<!-- uid=420100301:43:1 -->

impressed they're able to hack  
into the camera network at all.

## Story 420101401 · War Potential Analysis

Event Story  
Helheim's invasion ~Part 2~

**Kazuto:** ...

<!-- uid=420101401:1:1 -->

**Suguha:** ...

<!-- uid=420101401:2:1 -->

**Seiko:** Oh, hey! I thought you might  
come... Ahaha...

<!-- uid=420101401:3:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Seiko...

<!-- uid=420101401:4:1 -->

**Seiko:** Sorry, my shift'll be over soon.  
Can you wait a little longer?

<!-- uid=420101401:5:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Sure...

<!-- uid=420101401:6:2 -->

**Seiko:** So... Where should I start?

<!-- uid=420101401:7:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Why didn't you tell us you were  
playing ALO?

<!-- uid=420101401:8:1 -->

**Suguha:** Y-Yeah, Sei! Why'd you lie when we  
asked you about it?

<!-- uid=420101401:9:1 -->

**Seiko:** Sorry, you two... It's just...  
I thought I'd get to become  
a fairy and fight for justice.

<!-- uid=420101401:10:1 -->

**Seiko:** But I was forced to become a demon  
and kill fairies. I didn't want you  
two to know!

<!-- uid=420101401:11:1 -->

**Kazuto:** You say that, but it sure looked  
like you were having a blast as  
the demon queen...

<!-- uid=420101401:12:1 -->

**Seiko:** Ahaha, call it a change of heart.  
They might not look it, but those  
demons are actually pretty nice.

<!-- uid=420101401:13:1 -->

**Seiko:** As we fought together, I came  
to enjoy fighting as a demon.

<!-- uid=420101401:14:1 -->

**Kazuto:** And you were planning to tell  
us... when?

<!-- uid=420101401:15:1 -->

**Seiko:** I thought it'd be fun to surprise  
you once we'd destroyed all  
the fairy territories...

<!-- uid=420101401:16:1 -->

**Suguha:** Then why'd you run away halfway  
through the last attack?

<!-- uid=420101401:17:1 -->

**Seiko:** Well... Obviously I was surprised  
you found me out, but I also got  
a call for work.

<!-- uid=420101401:18:1 -->

**Seiko:** I always need to be ready to be  
on duty should anything come up,  
you see.

<!-- uid=420101401:19:1 -->

**Kazuto:** That makes sense. So, is the  
reason you look depressed  
also because of work?

<!-- uid=420101401:20:1 -->

**Seiko:** Ah...!

<!-- uid=420101401:21:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Has the case with the shut-in  
who's been hacking into security  
cameras been getting you down?

<!-- uid=420101401:22:1 -->

**Seiko:** Kazu... No way... You're psychic?!

<!-- uid=420101401:23:1 -->

**Seiko:** I never told you the girl in that  
case was a shut-in!

<!-- uid=420101401:24:1 -->

**Suguha:** Sherlock here deduced that from  
what you told us all on his own.

<!-- uid=420101401:25:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Whoa! So I was right!

<!-- uid=420101401:26:1 -->

**Seiko:** Ahaha, dreaming of becoming  
a private eye, Kazu?

<!-- uid=420101401:27:1 -->

**Seiko:** We could team up. A private eye  
and a cop. It'd make a fun TV  
show.

<!-- uid=420101401:28:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Ha ha, that would be fun. Changing

that good as a beginner.
