## Story 420101501 · The Real Meaning of the Activity

Event Story  
Helheim's invasion ~Part 2~

**Kazuto:** Who was it that taught you about  
OSSs and hiding your identity  
online?

<!-- uid=420101501:1:1 -->

**Seiko:** Oh, that was just our army's  
navigation gremlin.

<!-- uid=420101501:2:1 -->

**Seiko:** You fairies get a navigation pixie  
upon your first login if you're  
lucky, right?

<!-- uid=420101501:3:1 -->

**Kazuto:** We do... What's the gremlin's  
name?

<!-- uid=420101501:4:1 -->

**Seiko:** Thokk. She's usually about the  
size of my hand, but she can also  
grow to the size of a little girl.

<!-- uid=420101501:5:1 -->

**Kazuto:** And what does she say that she is?

<!-- uid=420101501:6:1 -->

**Seiko:** An NPC with high int...  
Uh, with high-level AI.

<!-- uid=420101501:7:1 -->

**Seiko:** I chat with the other demon NPCs  
too, but she's been my main partner,  
fighting and conversation-wise.

<!-- uid=420101501:8:1 -->

**Seiko:** Why do you ask?

<!-- uid=420101501:9:1 -->

**Suguha:** Hey, Kazuto, Thokk's the name of  
the giantess who appears in  
Helheim in Norse mythology.

<!-- uid=420101501:10:1 -->

**Seiko:** Huh... I didn't know that.

<!-- uid=420101501:11:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I think it was her who stalled  
the Sleeping Knights.

<!-- uid=420101501:12:1 -->

**Seiko:** Oh, I met them. The leader's  
a black-haired girl named Yuuki,  
right?

<!-- uid=420101501:13:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Apparently Thokk transformed from  
a little girl into a giantess right  
before they fought.

<!-- uid=420101501:14:1 -->

**Seiko:** A giantess? Really?! Wow, she never  
told me she had that kind of  
power.

<!-- uid=420101501:15:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Seiko, you're still a newbie to  
VRMMOs and haven't really chatted  
with many other players...

<!-- uid=420101501:16:1 -->

**Kazuto:** So I don't blame you for not  
noticing, but...

<!-- uid=420101501:17:1 -->

**Seiko:** But what?

<!-- uid=420101501:18:1 -->

**Kazuto:** That Thokk's not an NPC.  
She's a player.

<!-- uid=420101501:19:1 -->

**Seiko:** What? No way! Really?!

<!-- uid=420101501:20:1 -->

**Seiko:** B-But she told me she's an NPC!

<!-- uid=420101501:21:1 -->

**Kazuto:** And she might be. I can't say for  
sure right now, but I'd know if  
I talked to her.

<!-- uid=420101501:22:1 -->

**Seiko:** R-Right... But why would Thokk  
lie to me...?

<!-- uid=420101501:23:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Again, this is only speculation  
from what limited evidence  
I have, but...

<!-- uid=420101501:24:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I'd say Thokk is the creator of  
this Helheim's Invasion quest.

<!-- uid=420101501:25:1 -->

**Seiko:** Creator? Oh yeah, you asked me  
whether I came up with the quest  
back in ALO.

<!-- uid=420101501:26:1 -->

**Kazuto:** You're the only other player on  
the Helheim side. The creator  
isn't you, so I'd say it's her.

<!-- uid=420101501:27:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Is this girl pretty familiar with  
Helheim?

<!-- uid=420101501:28:1 -->

**Seiko:** Yeah, she really is. But I thought  
that was just because she's a  
navigation character.

<!-- uid=420101501:29:1 -->

**Kazuto:** And on top of that knowledge, she  
also has a bunch of strange  
abilities, right?

<!-- uid=420101501:30:1 -->

**Seiko:** She can detect things and open  
her HoloWindow to give orders  
to other demon NPCs...

<!-- uid=420101501:31:1 -->

**Suguha:** Sounds like she can do a lot.  
But it's weird how she's so  
obvious about it.

<!-- uid=420101501:32:1 -->

**Suguha:** She was chatting about herself to  
the Sleeping Knights too.

<!-- uid=420101501:33:1 -->

**Suguha:** Like, anyone who isn't Sei would  
know right away that she's a  
player!

<!-- uid=420101501:34:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Well, isn't it obvious? People who  
don't try hard to hide something  
usually want someone to notice.

<!-- uid=420101501:35:1 -->

**Suguha:** Notice what? That she's a player  
and the creator of this quest?

<!-- uid=420101501:36:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Maybe... Or maybe something else.

<!-- uid=420101501:37:1 -->


## Story 420101601 · A Bond in Helheim

Event Story

## Story 421000401 · What's Halloween?

Event Story  
Dazzling Halloween Night ~Part 1~

home country.

from my country see it as sort of  
fresh and exciting.

<!-- uid=421000401:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** What stand out the most are the  
sweets and the costumes,  
and then...

**Asuna:** So that's the general idea of what  
Halloween is all about.

**Ronie:** I don't think we would have ever  
come up with such a festival in  
our world!

way.

<!-- uid=421000401:18:1 -->

<!-- uid=421000601:36:1 -->

**Ronie:** ...

## Story 421100101 · The Halloween Dream

Event Story  
Dazzling Halloween Night ~Part 2~

**Ronie:** Lady Asuna, someone very dear to  
Kirito, showed up out of the blue  
one day.

<!-- uid=421100101:1:1 -->

**Ronie:** That night, we shared a tent  
together with Lady Alice and  
Sortiliena.

<!-- uid=421100101:2:1 -->

memories with Kirito and laughed  
with each other.

<!-- uid=421100101:3:1 -->

**Ronie:** It was truly unforgettable.  
That was also when Lady Asuna told  
us about the real world.

**Ronie:** Her stories about the real world  
were all wonderful, especially one  
in particular...

<!-- uid=421100101:5:1 -->

**Ronie:** It was about the tradition of  
wedding ceremonies!

<!-- uid=421100101:6:1 -->

**Ronie:** It must have left quite the  
impression on me, because right  
after I fell asleep...

<!-- uid=421100101:7:1 -->

**Ronie:** I had a strange dream where we  
all became brides and had to  
compete with each other!

<!-- uid=421100101:8:1 -->

**Ronie:** However, the dream itself wasn't  
the most unusual part of it all...

<!-- uid=421100101:9:1 -->

**Ronie:** Even though I had been asleep, the  
moment I woke up, I found myself  
feeling closer to Lady Alice!

<!-- uid=421100101:10:1 -->

**Ronie:** The excitement had got me worked  
up, so Lady Asuna told me about  
another real-world tradition.

<!-- uid=421100101:11:1 -->

**Ronie:** It was an amazing festival called  
Halloween! Soon enough, I was able  
to get back to sleep.

<!-- uid=421100101:12:1 -->

**Ronie:** But as soon as I did, I found  
myself in another dream...this  
time inspired by Halloween!

<!-- uid=421100101:13:1 -->

## Story 421100901 · More Than a Fantasy

Event Story  
Dazzling Halloween Night ~Part 2~

<!-- uid=421100901:21:1 -->

**Ronie:** Ungh...

**Ronie:** Ngh?!

**Tiese:** Get a grip, you dummy!

**Ronie:** You're right.

**Ronie:** I can't just give up!

## Story 421300101 · A Friendly Request

Event Story  
Romantic Diary in a Kimono Cafe

**Rika:** Umm...

<!-- uid=421300101:1:1 -->

**Young Woman:** Liz! Over here!

<!-- uid=421300101:2:1 -->

**Rika:** Ack...

<!-- uid=421300101:3:1 -->

**Rika:** Come on... This isn't the kind of  
place where you call someone  
by their character name, is it?

<!-- uid=421300101:4:1 -->

**Young Woman:** Oh, what's the big deal? I so  
rarely get to call you that  
I barely remembered it!

<!-- uid=421300101:5:1 -->

**Young Woman:** It's not like it's an embarrassing  
name, anyway.

<!-- uid=421300101:6:1 -->

**Young Woman:** It's a normal name, right?  
Well... I guess you might not  
look quite like a Lisbeth.

<!-- uid=421300101:7:1 -->

**Rika:** Well, yes. I'm about as Japanese  
as you can get...

<!-- uid=421300101:8:1 -->

**Rika:** Anyway, what's up? It's rare for  
us to go to the trouble of meeting  
in real life.

<!-- uid=421300101:9:1 -->

**Young Woman:** Yeah, that's true...

<!-- uid=421300101:10:1 -->

**Young Woman:** So, my main game was  
Asuka Empire, right?

<!-- uid=421300101:11:1 -->

**Rika:** Oh, right. You switched over, even  
though you were an ALO-only player  
when we first met.

<!-- uid=421300101:12:1 -->

**Young Woman:** That was a long time ago. But, you  
see, I actually quit Asuka Empire  
sometime last month.

<!-- uid=421300101:13:1 -->

**Young Woman:** I got married, and I thought it  
was the right time to quit VRMMOs  
completely.

<!-- uid=421300101:14:1 -->

**Rika:** What...?!

<!-- uid=421300101:15:1 -->

**Rika:** Hold on... You're at the kind of  
age where you get married?!

<!-- uid=421300101:16:1 -->

**Young Woman:** That's right! I'm quite a bit  
older than you, in spite of  
how I might look.

<!-- uid=421300101:17:1 -->

**Young Woman:** You're a student, right? Don't  
feel the need to act polite around  
me. This happens in online games.

<!-- uid=421300101:18:1 -->

**Rika:** ...W-Well, I guess if you're okay  
with that...

<!-- uid=421300101:19:1 -->

**Rika:** Oh, and... congratulations on  
getting married.

<!-- uid=421300101:20:1 -->

**Young Woman:** Thanks! So anyway, this is what  
I wanted to ask.

<!-- uid=421300101:21:1 -->

**Young Woman:** I know I quit AE, but there was  
one last thing I wish I could take  
care of.

<!-- uid=421300101:22:1 -->

**Young Woman:** Do you remember the cafe I ran  
over there?

<!-- uid=421300101:23:1 -->

**Rika:** Oh... Yeah, now that you mention  
it, you were doing that kind of  
thing, huh?

<!-- uid=421300101:24:1 -->

**Rika:** ...Hold on. You're not going to  
ask me to take over your store,  
are you?

<!-- uid=421300101:25:1 -->

**Rika:** I mean... You know that ALO's my  
main game. I wouldn't be able to  
handle running a shop...

<!-- uid=421300101:26:1 -->

**Young Woman:** I wouldn't ask that much of you.  
I gave the rights to the store to  
an AE-only friend of mine.

<!-- uid=421300101:27:1 -->

**Young Woman:** It's just... it sounds like  
business isn't going so well.

<!-- uid=421300101:28:1 -->

**Rika:** ...!

<!-- uid=421300101:29:1 -->

**Young Woman:** That's why I wanted to ask if you  
could help out at the store for  
a little while!

<!-- uid=421300101:30:1 -->

**Young Woman:** Just until things calm down!  
Today's my treat, of course,  
and... oh, right!

<!-- uid=421300101:31:1 -->

**Young Woman:** I'll even invite you to my  
wedding! How can you  
say no to that?!

<!-- uid=421300101:32:1 -->

**Rika:** ...I see. So you want me to help  
run a store in Asuka Empire...

<!-- uid=421300101:33:1 -->

**Rika:** Okay, I'm fine with that.  
I accept!

<!-- uid=421300101:34:1 -->

**Rika:** I think I'll have to pass on the  
wedding, though... Consider this  
my wedding present!

<!-- uid=421300101:35:1 -->


## Story 421300201 · Extra Help

Event Story  
Romantic Diary in a Kimono Cafe

**Rika:** Agh... What have I gotten myself  
into?

<!-- uid=421300201:1:1 -->

**Rika:** I didn't think much about saying  
yes, but once I did, she told me

**Suguha:** Me too! And I'd love to go back

**Rika:** Great! I was nearly about to have

**Rika:** That'd be too much for me to

**Rika:** It would be so great if you could

**Shino:** It's not like I have experience,

## Story 421300301 · Japanese Cafe

Event Story

**Liz:** Alrighty! Time to see how you

<!-- uid=421300301:1:1 -->

and tea. The problem is...

nearby, and most of our customers

<!-- uid=421300301:21:1 -->

**Sinon:** I see... So you're competing for

**Akane:** That's right. I never imagined  
this would happen right after  
I took over the store...

<!-- uid=421300301:23:1 -->

**Akane:** The old employees even quit,

**Liz:** And so we've come rushing in to

**Leafa:** What...?! N-No fair, Liz!

<!-- uid=421300301:30:1 -->

**Liz:** Silence! Pink hair has no place

<!-- uid=421300301:31:1 -->

**Leafa:** What...?!

<!-- uid=421300301:32:1 -->

**Leafa:** Aahh...! B-But how do we advertise

## Story 421300701 · Difficult Customer

Event Story  
Romantic Diary in a Kimono Cafe

**Unpleasant Man:** This is a big problem, you know!

you! Get a manager out here!

<!-- uid=421300701:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** Er, um... Y-Yes, sir! I'm terribly

**Sinon:** (What? A bug?)

**Sinon:** Hold on, Leafa. You shouldn't tell

**Sinon:** Excuse me, sir. I understand a

**Sinon:** Well, I'm having trouble spotting

**Leafa:** Huh?

**Leafa:** W-Wait... That's strange... There  
was something big and black in it

**Sinon:** Could it have gone somewhere?

<!-- uid=421300701:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** Maybe it flew off as soon as

<!-- uid=421300701:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** I'm pretty sure we'd notice if

around...

<!-- uid=421300701:11:1 -->

**Unpleasant Man:** Ngh... Hey! Are you calling me

**Sinon:** Of course not, sir. But it is

**Unpleasant Man:** And I'm saying there was one!  
Don't you know that the  
customer's always righ--

<!-- uid=421300701:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** Oh? Sir, it seems something just

<!-- uid=421300701:15:1 -->

**Unpleasant Man:** Huh?!

<!-- uid=421300701:16:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...Is this a toy bug? Oh, and it  
looks like there's food stuck  
to it too...

<!-- uid=421300701:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Don't tell me... Could it possibly  
be that what Leafa saw was...?

<!-- uid=421300701:18:1 -->

**Unpleasant Man:** Gah...!

**Leafa:** S-Sir?! What's the meaning of

<!-- uid=421300701:20:1 -->

**Unpleasant Man:** I... Don't ask me! What kinda  
joint is this, anyway? Accusing  
customers like this...!

<!-- uid=421300701:21:1 -->

**Unpleasant Man:** I-I'm out of here! See ya...

<!-- uid=421300701:22:1 -->

**Unpleasant Man:** ...Auhn?! H-Hey! What's going

<!-- uid=421300701:24:1 -->

**Sinon:** Sir... Even we can only tolerate  
so much tomfoolery.

<!-- uid=421300701:25:1 -->

**Sinon:** And also... I don't believe you've  
paid yet, have you?

<!-- uid=421300701:26:1 -->

**Unpleasant Man:** Ngh...!

<!-- uid=421300701:27:1 -->

**Unpleasant Man:** Y-You little... Here! Take it!  
I don't need your change, either!

<!-- uid=421300701:28:1 -->

**Sinon:** Very well, then... So we can  
keep this as a tip?

<!-- uid=421300701:29:1 -->

**Unpleasant Man:** Gah... Graaaahh!

<!-- uid=421300701:30:1 -->

**Sinon:** Ugh... Talk about a nightmare

<!-- uid=421300701:31:1 -->

**Customer:** Wh-Whoa... That waitress is

<!-- uid=421300701:32:1 -->

**Customer:** She stood her ground and argued

**Sinon:** What...?!

**Sinon:** (O-Oh no! Did I really do all of

## Story 421501201 · Justice and the World

Event Story  
Seeker of Arcana ~Blank Card~

**Leafa:** Look, so this is the deck of tarot

<!-- uid=421501201:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** The World...

<!-- uid=421501201:6:1 -->

<!-- uid=421501201:7:1 -->

## Story 421700301 · In My Dreams

Event Story  
Redux: Dazzling Halloween Night ~Part 1~ 

**Asuna:** A competition to see who could  
become the top bride?

<!-- uid=421700301:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Th-That sure sounds a lot more  
lively than a usual wedding

## Story 421700401 · What's Halloween?

Event Story  
Redux: Dazzling Halloween Night ~Part 1~ 

**Ronie:** What's...Halloween?

<!-- uid=421700401:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hehe, this might be a good one.

<!-- uid=421700401:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Halloween was a week ago, but  
that's okay. Let me tell you about  
it, Ronie.

<!-- uid=421700401:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Where I'm from, Halloween is  
actually more of a recent  
celebration.

<!-- uid=421700401:4:1 -->

**Ronie:** Was it started just recently?

<!-- uid=421700401:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, it's actually existed for a  
while, but in the sense it's  
originally from somewhere else.

<!-- uid=421700401:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** It wasn't until recently that it  
started to be celebrated in my  
home country.

<!-- uid=421700401:7:1 -->

**Ronie:** I thought people celebrated  
festivals because they were handed  
down for generations.

<!-- uid=421700401:8:1 -->

**Ronie:** Did the people where you're  
from have some any resistance  
to it?

<!-- uid=421700401:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hmm, I think Halloween is sort  
of a special case.

<!-- uid=421700401:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Because it's so unique, people  
from my country see it as sort of  
fresh and exciting.

<!-- uid=421700401:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Right, I'll tell you all about it!

<!-- uid=421700401:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** What stand out the most are the  
sweets and the costumes,  
and then...

<!-- uid=421700401:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** So that's the general idea of what  
Halloween is all about.

<!-- uid=421700401:14:1 -->

**Ronie:** Wow...

<!-- uid=421700401:15:1 -->

**Ronie:** Sweets, costumes, pumpkins...  
That sounds like such a fun  
tradition!

<!-- uid=421700401:16:1 -->

**Ronie:** I don't think we would have ever  
come up with such a festival in  
our world!

<!-- uid=421700401:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Us Japanese probably feel the same  
way.

<!-- uid=421700401:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** I don't think it'd be out of place  
here though. Underworld does have  
a Westernized theme, after all.

<!-- uid=421700401:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Halloween is said to originate  
from Ireland, so culturally it  
shouldn't be too out of place.

<!-- uid=421700401:20:1 -->

**Ronie:** Um, Lady Asuna...  
My apologies, but you lost me  
there...

<!-- uid=421700401:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, right! S-Sorry!  
I need to watch what I say more  
when I'm here.

<!-- uid=421700401:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** I accidentally keep talking about  
my world as if you'd understand it  
all...

<!-- uid=421700401:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** A-Anyway, that's the general idea  
about Halloween. Do you have any  
questions?

<!-- uid=421700401:24:1 -->

**Ronie:** Hm... I think I got the gist of  
it!

<!-- uid=422200901:21:1 -->

## Story 422300201 · Mishandling?!

Event Story  
Ancient Tale of Divine Beasts ~Part 2~

**Ronie:** This is the village that asked for  
help...

<!-- uid=422300201:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ngh...! The atmosphere here  
doesn't feel too great...

<!-- uid=422300201:2:1 -->

**Ronie:** R-Really?

<!-- uid=422300201:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah... It feels a lot worse  
around here than it did the  
last time we came.

<!-- uid=422300201:4:1 -->

**Eugeo:** It's like everyone's upset about  
something.

<!-- uid=422300201:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, the request was to "do away"  
with this thing...

<!-- uid=422300201:6:1 -->

**Tiese:** I understand why they're angry...

<!-- uid=422300201:7:1 -->

**Tiese:** But it's not like you fought it  
once and forgot about it, right?

<!-- uid=422300201:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah. It has been a few days...

<!-- uid=422300201:9:1 -->

**Eugeo:** We went back to the swamp multiple  
times and searched for its tracks.

<!-- uid=422300201:10:1 -->

**Eugeo:** But... the turtle would never show  
itself when we came around.

<!-- uid=422300201:11:1 -->

**Ronie:** Could it have been hiding?

<!-- uid=422300201:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** That is a possibility.

<!-- uid=422300201:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Not like it has any reason to be  
fighting us, right...?

<!-- uid=422300201:14:1 -->

**Tiese:** True... I suppose this turtle  
monster must not want to fight.

<!-- uid=422300201:15:1 -->

**Tiese:** The main reason it attacks the  
village is likely because it  
doesn't have enough to eat...

<!-- uid=422300201:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Exactly. Either way, we need to  
make things right here.

<!-- uid=422300201:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** (Also... we need to figure out  
what kind of creature this  
monster is in the first place...)

<!-- uid=422300201:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** (I find it hard to believe it's  
a turtle monster that just so  
happened to blow up in size...)

<!-- uid=422300201:19:1 -->

**Village Chief:** Ah, so you've come!

<!-- uid=422300201:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Chief, it's nice to see you again.

<!-- uid=422300201:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** As this is our second time here...  
we've come to handle it together  
with our two pages.

<!-- uid=422300201:22:1 -->

**Ronie & Tiese:** Nice to meet you!

<!-- uid=422300201:23:1 -->

**Village Chief:** I'm glad to hear that. We can use  
all the help we can get...!

<!-- uid=422300201:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** So, about your request...

<!-- uid=422300201:25:1 -->

**Village Chief:** Ah, yes. We have but one request  
for you.

<!-- uid=422300201:26:1 -->

**Village Chief:** I would like you... to finish off  
that turtle monster once and  
for all.

<!-- uid=422300201:27:1 -->

**Everyone:** ...!

<!-- uid=422300201:28:1 -->

**Village Chief:** It has grown even more ferocious  
since you went to the swamp...

<!-- uid=422300201:29:1 -->

**Village Chief:** Though it once hid, it now ruins  
our fields in broad daylight, even  
damaging the village itself.

<!-- uid=422300201:30:1 -->

**Village Chief:** The river still floods constantly,  
and we feel our existence here  
may be endangered...

<!-- uid=422300201:31:1 -->

**Village Chief:** I won't blame you for your earlier  
mishandling of the situation.  
Just, please...

<!-- uid=422300201:32:1 -->

**Village Chief:** Do away with that monster...!

<!-- uid=422300201:33:1 -->

**Tiese:** Mishandling...?!

<!-- uid=422300201:34:1 -->

**Tiese:** H-Hold on one second! Are you

<!-- uid=422300201:35:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Stop it, Tiese. The chief is  
right.

<!-- uid=422300201:36:1 -->

**Tiese:** What...?

<!-- uid=422300201:37:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I apologize, Chief. Please don't  
pay any mind to what she just

<!-- uid=422300201:38:1 -->

**Eugeo:** We promise... that we'll do away  
with this monster.

<!-- uid=422300201:39:1 -->

**Tiese:** ...!

<!-- uid=422300201:40:1 -->


## Story 422300301 · The Villagers' Perspective

Event Story  
Ancient Tale of Divine Beasts ~Part 2~

**Tiese:** ...

<!-- uid=422300301:1:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Tiese... Looks like there's  
something you want to say.

<!-- uid=422300301:2:1 -->

**Tiese:** Eugeo...!

<!-- uid=422300301:3:1 -->

**Tiese:** ...I'm sorry for being so  
thoughtless back there.

<!-- uid=422300301:4:1 -->

**Tiese:** You were defending me for my own  
sake, weren't you?

<!-- uid=422300301:5:1 -->

**Tiese:** It would've damaged the academy's  
reputation if I ripped into him...

<!-- uid=422300301:6:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Hm...

<!-- uid=422300301:7:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I guess I'd say you're half-right  
about that.

<!-- uid=422300301:8:1 -->

**Tiese:** What...?

<!-- uid=422300301:9:1 -->

**Eugeo:** It wasn't so much about the  
academy. I just thought it  
wouldn't end well for you.

<!-- uid=422300301:10:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Plus, it's only natural for the  
chief to say that we mishandled  
the situation.

<!-- uid=422300301:11:1 -->

**Tiese:** What do you mean by that...?

<!-- uid=422300301:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...You should probably hear this  
too, Ronie.

<!-- uid=422300301:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** I feel like Eugeo's about to give  
a really good speech here. Isn't  
that right?

<!-- uid=422300301:14:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Kirito... Could you please not  
make a joke out of everything?

<!-- uid=422300301:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ha ha, my bad. I do think I know  
what you're about to say here  
for the most part, though.

<!-- uid=422300301:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** And so... Ronie, I suggest you  
keep your ears wide open.

<!-- uid=422300301:17:1 -->

**Ronie:** Um... O-Okay!

<!-- uid=422300301:18:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Now I'm starting to feel  
embarrassed with you two  
looking at me so attentively...

<!-- uid=422300301:19:1 -->

**Eugeo:** W-Well, whatever... Ahem!

<!-- uid=422300301:20:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Kirito exaggerated when he said  
I have something big and important  
to say. However...

<!-- uid=422300301:21:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I want you to know that many of  
the villages in the Human Empire  
are not living lives of plenty.

<!-- uid=422300301:22:1 -->

**Eugeo:** They may not live hand-to-mouth,  
but steady harvests are the thing  
keeping their bellies full.

<!-- uid=422300301:23:1 -->

**Eugeo:** An attack on their fields...  
isn't too far off from an attack  
on their very lives.

<!-- uid=422300301:24:1 -->

**Ronie & Tiese:** !!

<!-- uid=422300301:25:1 -->

**Eugeo:** You're kind and smart girls.  
I know you'll be able to see it  
from the villagers' perspective.

<!-- uid=422300301:26:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I'm from a small village just like  
this one... Well, maybe a little  
bigger than here.

<!-- uid=422300301:27:1 -->

**Eugeo:** That's why it really hits home for  
me. Just how much pain and  
suffering they're going through...

<!-- uid=422300301:28:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I want you two... to become people  
who understand the pain of those  
in trouble.

<!-- uid=422300301:29:1 -->

**Tiese:** Eugeo...!

<!-- uid=422300301:30:1 -->

**Tiese:** I know exactly what you mean now!  
So much it hurts!

<!-- uid=422300301:31:1 -->

**Tiese:** I'll do everything I can to help  
resolve this situation!

<!-- uid=422300301:32:1 -->

**Ronie:** Me too! There may not be much  
I can do, but even so...!

<!-- uid=422300301:33:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Thanks, you two...

<!-- uid=422300301:34:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...Ah, ahem.

<!-- uid=422300301:35:1 -->

**Kirito:** As awkward as it is to have to  
follow that, may I say a word?

<!-- uid=422300301:36:1 -->

**Kirito:** Nothing as grand as what Eugeo  
said, though. This is just what  
we'll be doing next.

<!-- uid=422300301:37:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Of course, Kirito. Sorry for  
taking up so much time.

<!-- uid=422300301:38:1 -->

**Kirito:** I don't mind that. Anyway, now  
that I think we're all on the same  
page about the situation here...

<!-- uid=422300301:39:1 -->

**Kirito:** I think we need to consider  
what we ought to do. What  
do you think?

<!-- uid=422300301:40:1 -->


## Story 422300401 · Our First Priority

Event Story  
Ancient Tale of Divine Beasts ~Part 2~

<!-- uid=422300401:1:1 -->

<!-- uid=422300401:6:1 -->

been ruined and its future  
harvests are in peril.

**Kirito:** The turtle attacking the village's  
fields isn't the only reason it's  
facing this crisis.

<!-- uid=422300401:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Remember what the chief said?

causing damage too...

<!-- uid=422300401:12:1 -->

the nearby river?

**Ronie:** R-Right! The turtle doesn't have

well, but dealing with the turtle  
is all he can do for now...

surefire solutions myself.

<!-- uid=422300401:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** But... I do have an idea. The  
river, the village, the turtle,  
and the old local faith...

<!-- uid=422300401:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Even the fact that Genbu the water  
god oversees the north, where this  
village is in the Human Empire...!

<!-- uid=422300401:22:1 -->

## Story 422300601 · Downward Spiral

Event Story  
Ancient Tale of Divine Beasts ~Part 2~

**Kirito:** ...Was that turtle a god with the  
ability to calm the raging river,  
old man?

<!-- uid=422300601:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Because my guess... is that it's  
what you might call a water god.

<!-- uid=422300601:2:1 -->

**Ronie:** A... water god?!

<!-- uid=422300601:3:1 -->

**Tiese:** Gods like that really exist?!

<!-- uid=422300601:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, I wouldn't take the "god"  
part too literally.

<!-- uid=422300601:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** The turtle seemed to have the  
ability to control water by way  
of shaking the earth.

<!-- uid=422300601:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** If it does... it may be able to  
increase the water in the swamp to  
keep the flooding river in check.

<!-- uid=422300601:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's only natural for people of  
the area to deeply respect or even  
revere something with that power.

<!-- uid=422300601:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** But at some point, society began  
to frown upon doing so...

<!-- uid=422300601:9:1 -->

**Elder:** ...You're a sharp one.

<!-- uid=422300601:10:1 -->

**Elder:** I've not seen this god myself,  
but I have heard of its power...

<!-- uid=422300601:11:1 -->

**Elder:** It is exactly as you said. It  
could calm the raging river  
and bring bountiful harvests.

<!-- uid=422300601:12:1 -->

**Elder:** A riverside village's relationship  
with water is its most essential  
relationship of all.

<!-- uid=422300601:13:1 -->

**Elder:** But... that too is in the past.

<!-- uid=422300601:14:1 -->

**Elder:** It is nothing more than an  
inauspicious creature now.  
Just as I am.

<!-- uid=422300601:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...I can see how there would be  
less room to breathe as the Axiom  
Church spread further.

<!-- uid=422300601:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Even so, this creature you knew as  
a god of your land must have its  
own lifespan...

<!-- uid=422300601:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Without faith or interest, or  
more concretely, without any  
offerings...

<!-- uid=422300601:18:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...Oh! Then it won't be able to  
keep surviving!

<!-- uid=422300601:19:1 -->

**Ronie:** And that's why it messed up their  
fields? Because it got hungry?!

<!-- uid=422300601:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...It seems very likely.

<!-- uid=422300601:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** And if it's growing feebler, its  
powers must be declining too.  
In other words...

<!-- uid=422300601:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Its power to calm the water and  
pacify the earth...!

<!-- uid=422300601:23:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Oh...! Of course! That really does  
bring everything together...

<!-- uid=422300601:24:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Their faith, its health, and its  
protection were all linked. Now  
it's even harming the land...

<!-- uid=422300601:25:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Of course the turtle is going to  
start causing trouble. That's why  
it's rampaging around now...

<!-- uid=422300601:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's a downward spiral if I've  
ever heard one. Sheesh.

<!-- uid=422300601:27:1 -->

**Ronie:** Y-You're amazing, Kirito!

<!-- uid=422300601:28:1 -->

**Ronie:** You managed to figure that out  
when you barely had any clues  
at all...!

<!-- uid=422300601:29:1 -->

**Tiese:** You really do see things in a  
different way from the rest  
of us, Kirito...!

<!-- uid=422300601:30:1 -->

**Eugeo:** He's always had a sharp side to  
him.

<!-- uid=422300601:31:1 -->

**Eugeo:** It's just like you say, Tiese.  
It's like he's able to see  
things that we can't...

<!-- uid=422300601:32:1 -->

**Eugeo:** That's Kirito for you, I guess.  
He's the only one I know with  
insight like this!

<!-- uid=422300601:33:1 -->

**Kirito:** H-Ha... hahaha... I'm honored by  
all your praise...

<!-- uid=422300601:34:1 -->

**Kirito:** (I wouldn't call it insight. It's  
just that I have knowledge  
that the rest of you don't...)

<!-- uid=422300601:35:1 -->

**Kirito:** (It's almost like a cheat code, if  
I'm being honest. Not that I can  
tell anyone about it...)

<!-- uid=422300601:36:1 -->

Ancient Tale of Divine Beasts ~Part 2~

Event Story  
Ancient Tale of Divine Beasts ~Part 2~

**Kirito:** Whoa...!

**Village Chief:** What...?

**Kirito:** I understand how you feel,

**Tiese:** You can keep on giving us jobs

**Village Chief:** ...!

**Kirito:** He is the one surviving individual

its folk religion still existed...

<!-- uid=422300901:27:1 -->

**Kirito:** The one man who believes in its  
river-pacifying god of water...  
Genbu!

**Elder:** G-Genbu...! So that was the name  
of our deity...?!

<!-- uid=422300901:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** Erk... Wait, time out! I misspoke!

**Kirito:** You said you'd never encountered

**Kirito:** Does it look like a monster...

<!-- uid=422300901:38:1 -->

<!-- uid=422300901:39:1 -->

## Story 422301001 · Ronie's Prayer

Event Story  
Ancient Tale of Divine Beasts ~Part 2~

**Village Chief:** This monster? Our protector...?  
"Throughout the ages"...?

<!-- uid=422301001:1:1 -->

**Village Chief:** You tell me something like that  
out of the blue and just expect  
me to believe it?!

<!-- uid=422301001:2:1 -->

**Village Chief:** Proof! I need you to give me  
proof!

<!-- uid=422301001:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** What...?

<!-- uid=422301001:4:1 -->

**Village Chief:** How is this any different from the  
ramblings of a senile old man?!

<!-- uid=422301001:5:1 -->

**Village Chief:** Kirito! If you're going to make  
such claims... show me proof  
that this turtle protected us!

<!-- uid=422301001:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...!

<!-- uid=422301001:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** (H-He wants proof...?!)

<!-- uid=422301001:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** (...This isn't good. My reasoning  
is based on the existence of a  
company called Rath...)

<!-- uid=422301001:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** (But the people of Underworld  
would never understand me if  
I were to tell them that...!)

<!-- uid=422301001:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** (Wh-What should I do...?!)

<!-- uid=422301001:11:1 -->

**Ronie:** Kirito...

<!-- uid=422301001:12:1 -->

**Ronie:** ...Oh!

<!-- uid=422301001:13:1 -->

**Tiese:** Huh...? Wh-What's the matter,  
Ronie?!

<!-- uid=422301001:14:1 -->

**Ronie:** I just thought of something!

<!-- uid=422301001:15:1 -->

**Ronie:** Um... M-Mister local god!  
My name is Ronie!

<!-- uid=422301001:16:1 -->

**Ronie:** I have a request for you!  
Please... will you speak to me?!

<!-- uid=422301001:17:1 -->

**Everyone:** ?!

<!-- uid=422301001:18:1 -->

**Tiese:** She's talking to the big  
turtle...?

<!-- uid=422301001:19:1 -->

**Village Chief:** What's going on here...?  
There's no way a monster  
could understand our words...

**Ronie:** I... I really think it will!

<!-- uid=422301001:21:1 -->

**Ronie:** If this turtle is special like  
Kirito says... it should understand  
our words... and our prayers!

<!-- uid=422301001:22:1 -->

**Ronie:** I pray... to the three goddesses  
every day.

<!-- uid=422301001:23:1 -->

**Ronie:** I've always been certain that the  
goddesses understand my thoughts.

<!-- uid=422301001:24:1 -->

**Ronie:** And so... I'm sure the same would  
be true for a local god!

<!-- uid=422301001:25:1 -->

**Ronie:** Please! Won't you listen to me?!

<!-- uid=422301001:26:1 -->

**Ronie:** I'm new to this land... but  
there's someone here who's  
always believed in you!

<!-- uid=422301001:27:1 -->

**Elder:** ...!

<!-- uid=422301001:28:1 -->

**Ronie:** I beg of you... Answer us! Please!

<!-- uid=422301001:29:1 -->

**Massive Black Turtle:** ...

<!-- uid=422301001:30:1 -->

**Ronie:** Ahh!

<!-- uid=422301001:31:1 -->

**Kirito:** What's happening...?!

<!-- uid=422301001:32:1 -->

**Massive Black Turtle:** How many years have passed...  
since I last heard the prayers  
of men...?

<!-- uid=422301001:33:1 -->


## Story 422301101 · The Turtle's Request

Event Story  
Ancient Tale of Divine Beasts ~Part 2~

**Village Chief:** The turtle... It spoke...!

<!-- uid=422301101:1:1 -->

**Massive Black Turtle:** Of course I can speak. I've  
lived many times longer  
than all of you, after all...

<!-- uid=422301101:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** You're the god that's been  
protecting this village...  
A god of water, right?

**Massive Black Turtle:** I am nothing you can call a god...

strength to calm the river.

<!-- uid=422301101:4:1 -->

**Massive Black Turtle:** Of course... my power has faded  
considerably...

<!-- uid=422301101:5:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Is that... because of how little  
faith there is in you now?

**Massive Black Turtle:** It is not a mere matter of faith.  
My life was nearly exhausted.

<!-- uid=422301101:7:1 -->

**Massive Black Turtle:** I am no god. Only a creature that  
has lived for many years...

<!-- uid=422301101:8:1 -->

**Massive Black Turtle:** When my life fades away, my  
existence grows fragile and I am  
unable to control myself...

<!-- uid=422301101:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...I knew it.

<!-- uid=422301101:10:1 -->

**Ronie:** So your idea was spot on, Kirito!

<!-- uid=422301101:11:1 -->

**Massive Black Turtle:** I was able to return to my senses  
for a time because you called out  
to me in this way.

**Ronie:** I... I am most honored!

<!-- uid=422301101:13:1 -->

**Massive Black Turtle:** And... to think that there was  
still someone left who believed  
in me for so long...

<!-- uid=422301101:14:1 -->

**Massive Black Turtle:** Allow me to thank you.  
You have my gratitude...

<!-- uid=422301101:15:1 -->

**Elder:** Aaahhh...!

<!-- uid=422301101:16:1 -->

**Massive Black Turtle:** ...Allow me to take my leave.

appear before you for too long.

**Kirito:** What kind of reason is that...?

<!-- uid=422301101:18:1 -->

**Massive Black Turtle:** Perhaps I should not be saying

detest creatures like me.

<!-- uid=422301101:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...!

<!-- uid=422301101:20:1 -->

**Massive Black Turtle:** Ah. I do have one request for you.

<!-- uid=422301101:21:1 -->

**Massive Black Turtle:** You do not need to pray to me in  
the open. But if you could leave  
me some small offerings...

<!-- uid=422301101:22:1 -->

**Massive Black Turtle:** ...and even a bit of space in your  
hearts for me, your faith would  
be most appreciated.

<!-- uid=422301101:23:1 -->

**Massive Black Turtle:** I should then be able to continue  
protecting this land from water...  
so long as I live.

<!-- uid=422301101:24:1 -->

**Village Chief:** ...

<!-- uid=422301101:25:1 -->

**Village Chief:** ...It seems there really was a  
faith that we should never have  
let ourselves forget.

<!-- uid=422301101:26:1 -->

**Village Chief:** We'd lost sight of something  
truly important to us...

<!-- uid=422301101:27:1 -->

## Story 422900301 · Kirito's Plan

## Story 422900401 · Source of Doubt

Event Story  
Blissful School Days ~The End~

**Alice:** The two of us? Ugly fights...?

<!-- uid=422900401:6:2 -->

**Kirito:** That's right. The way I see it,

<!-- uid=422900401:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** I think this is just a weird  
situation that's gotten out  
of hand.

<!-- uid=422900401:8:1 -->

**Alice:** ...

<!-- uid=422900401:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** Asuna's been saying things to

the end of the festival to get

<!-- uid=422900401:11:1 -->

**Alice:** That... was unbecoming of me.

though.

<!-- uid=422900401:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** It felt like this went beyond me

between you two at some point.

<!-- uid=422900401:15:1 -->

**Alice:** ...I think that's a fair  
assessment.

<!-- uid=422900401:16:1 -->

**Alice:** Could it be... that you think that

in class?

direction.

**Kirito:** It's just... I think there's a kind

coming across to everyone too.

of you made up.

<!-- uid=422900401:22:1 -->

**Alice:** ...

**Alice:** But I suppose the doubt hanging

my poor relationship with Asuna...

<!-- uid=422900401:27:1 -->

**Alice:** But this problem won't be solved

<!-- uid=422901201:31:1 -->

<!-- uid=422901201:34:1 -->

<!-- uid=422901201:37:1 -->

<!-- uid=422901201:43:1 -->

**Asuna:** Something wrong, Kazuto?

<!-- uid=423500201:24:1 -->

**Kazuto:** No, it's... You just seemed to be  
acting the way you always do.

<!-- uid=423500201:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** Of course I am. I wouldn't ask you  
out on a date if I was feeling  
weird.

<!-- uid=423500201:26:1 -->

**Asuna:** If anything, you seemed a little  
drained yourself. Am I right?

<!-- uid=423500201:27:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...!

<!-- uid=423500201:28:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's why I wanted to spend the  
day together if we could.

<!-- uid=423500201:29:1 -->

**Asuna:** You went through a lot in UW,  
Kazuto--or Kirito, I guess...

<!-- uid=423500201:30:1 -->

**Asuna:** Even if things have settled down,  
it's not like everything came to a  
tidy little conclusion.

<!-- uid=423500201:31:1 -->

**Asuna:** I want to be there to support you  
in any way I can... In this world  
too.

<!-- uid=423500201:32:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Asuna...

<!-- uid=423500201:33:1 -->

**Asuna:** Heh heh heh... Okay, enough talk!  
Let's go! You're hungry, right?

<!-- uid=423500201:34:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...Yeah! Yeah, Asuna, you're  
exactly right...!

<!-- uid=423500201:35:1 -->


## Story 423500301 · Tons of Effort

Event Story  
Nostalgic Memories ~ SAO・ALO ~

**Kazuto:** Man, I'm stuffed!

**Kazuto:** You really know some good  
restaurants, Asuna.

<!-- uid=423500301:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** If anything, my recipes are more

<!-- uid=423500301:23:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Bringing food you invented in

That's pretty exciting.

**Asuna:** Ha ha, Kazuto, your eyes are so  
lit up!

**Asuna:** Okay, then you can look forward to

<!-- uid=423500301:27:1 -->


## Story 423500401 · Big Advantage

Event Story  
Nostalgic Memories ~ SAO・ALO ~

**Kazuto:** Okay, now that my stomach's nice  
and full...

<!-- uid=423500401:1:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...What did you want to do,  
anyway? It's not like we had  
any specific plans today...

<!-- uid=423500401:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hmm, well... I guess I don't have  
my heart set on anything in  
particular either...

<!-- uid=423500401:3:1 -->

**Kazuto:** So we're playing it by ear?

<!-- uid=423500401:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah... I don't see anything wrong  
with the occasional date like  
that, though, do you?

<!-- uid=423500401:5:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Heh... No, you're right.

<!-- uid=423500401:6:1 -->

**Kazuto:** You only need to come up with  
perfect strats before you try  
something in a game.

<!-- uid=423500401:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** That's going a little too far,  
Kazuto.

<!-- uid=423500401:8:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Really...?

<!-- uid=423500401:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'd like to ask you to give some  
thought to our dates before we go  
on them for the most part, okay?

<!-- uid=423500401:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** You're going to need to keep in  
mind that today's a special  
exception!

<!-- uid=423500401:11:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I-I'll be sure to remember that...

<!-- uid=423500401:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Okay. Good.

<!-- uid=423500401:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** What should we do, though...?  
Is there anywhere you wanted  
to go, Kazuto?

<!-- uid=423500401:14:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Me? That's a tough question to  
answer on the spot... Hm?

<!-- uid=423500401:15:1 -->

**Kazuto:** (Is that...?)

<!-- uid=423500401:16:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I found a good spot, Asuna.  
How about an arcade?

<!-- uid=423500401:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** Wow...! This looks interesting!

<!-- uid=423500401:18:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Right? There aren't many retro  
arcades like this one around  
these days.

<!-- uid=423500401:19:1 -->

**Kazuto:** That's hardly surprising when you  
can play FullDive games at home  
now, though.

<!-- uid=423500401:20:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Shooting games, racing games,  
fighting games, and all on real  
hardware...

<!-- uid=423500401:21:1 -->

**Kazuto:** These are practically outdated by  
now, but I think they have a  
certain charm to them, don't you?

<!-- uid=423500401:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yes, I guess you'd be right to say  
they're old-fashioned, but...

<!-- uid=423500401:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** There does seem to be something  
great about them that FullDive  
games can't offer.

<!-- uid=423500401:24:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Exactly. Take this game where you  
shoot a gun...

<!-- uid=423500401:25:1 -->

**Kazuto:** This gun's nothing like a real  
one, and it's nowhere near as  
immersive as a game like GGO...

<!-- uid=423500401:26:1 -->

**Kazuto:** But that's not necessarily a bad  
thing. More realism isn't  
automatically better.

<!-- uid=423500401:27:1 -->

**Kazuto:** That line of thinking is what got  
us games like SAO, in a way.

<!-- uid=423500401:28:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...!

<!-- uid=423500401:29:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Where a game over means death...  
And we have advances in technology  
to thank for worlds like that.

<!-- uid=423500401:30:1 -->

**Kazuto:** You can get killed in retro games  
like this without dying for real.  
That's a big advantage.

<!-- uid=423500401:31:1 -->

**Kazuto:** What good is a game if you can't  
enjoy playing it, right...?

<!-- uid=423500401:32:1 -->

**Kazuto:** This is a game, but it isn't  
something you play. How  
ridiculous can you get...?

<!-- uid=423500401:33:1 -->


## Story 423500501 · As Predicted

Event Story  
Nostalgic Memories ~ SAO・ALO ~

**Kayaba:** Attention, players. Welcome to  
my world.

<!-- uid=423500501:1:1 -->

**Kayaba:** My name is Akihiko Kayaba.  
I am the sole person who can  
control this world.

<!-- uid=423500501:2:1 -->

**Kayaba:** I'm sure you've already noticed  
that the logout button is missing  
from the main menu.

<!-- uid=423500501:3:1 -->

**Kayaba:** But this is not a defect in the  
game.

<!-- uid=423500501:4:1 -->

**Kayaba:** I repeat, this is not a defect in  
the game. It is a feature of  
Sword Art Online.

<!-- uid=423500501:5:1 -->

**Kayaba:** Until you reach the top level  
of this castle, you will not be  
able to log out of the game.

<!-- uid=423500501:6:1 -->

**Kayaba:** Furthermore, no one on the  
outside can shut down or remove  
the NerveGear.

<!-- uid=423500501:7:1 -->

**Kayaba:** Should this be attempted...

<!-- uid=423500501:8:1 -->

**Kayaba:** The transmitter inside will emit  
a powerful microwave, destroying  
your brain and ending your life.

<!-- uid=423500501:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** And that's how that so-called  
"game" started for us.

<!-- uid=423500501:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** In the game's first month, 2,000  
died...

<!-- uid=423500501:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Floor 1 has yet to be cleared.

<!-- uid=423500501:12:1 -->

**Kazuto & Asuna:** ...

<!-- uid=423500501:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...It does take me back, but I'd  
rather not dwell on it.

<!-- uid=423500501:14:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...Yeah. You wouldn't catch me  
dead thinking back on that fondly.

<!-- uid=423500501:15:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I guess I did meet you and all the  
others thanks to it...

<!-- uid=423500501:16:1 -->

**Kazuto:** But it still feels like we  
shouldn't be endorsing it  
uncritically.

<!-- uid=423500501:17:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...You know what it sounds like  
you're saying to me?

<!-- uid=423500501:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...That said, we can't reject  
SAO's existence outright.

<!-- uid=423500501:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** And I bet... that's because of the  
commander, right?

<!-- uid=423500501:20:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...Yeah.

<!-- uid=423500501:21:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Akihiko Kayaba... No, I guess  
I should call him Heathcliff now.

<!-- uid=423500501:22:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I still wonder sometimes what it  
is he really wanted to do...

<!-- uid=423500501:23:1 -->

**Kazuto:** How much of the world we live in  
now he predicted...

<!-- uid=423500501:24:1 -->


## Story 423500601 · The World He Wanted to See

Event Story  
Nostalgic Memories ~ SAO・ALO ~

**Kayaba:** Quite a view.

<!-- uid=423500601:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Akihiko Kayaba...

<!-- uid=423500601:2:1 -->

**Kayaba:** The SAO mainframe in Argus's  
fifth-level basement is deleting  
all data on its storage devices.

<!-- uid=423500601:3:1 -->

**Kayaba:** In ten minutes or so, everything  
in this world will vanish.

<!-- uid=423500601:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** What about the people down  
there...?

<!-- uid=423500601:5:1 -->

**Kayaba:** You needn't worry about them.  
Just a moment ago...

<!-- uid=423500601:6:1 -->

**Kayaba:** ...the remaining 6,147 surviving  
players were logged out.

<!-- uid=423500601:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** What about the ones who died?  
What about the 4,000 who died...?

<!-- uid=423500601:8:1 -->

**Kayaba:** Their minds will never return.  
In every world, once you die,  
you're gone.

<!-- uid=423500601:9:1 -->

**Kayaba:** I created this time because...  
I wanted a moment to speak  
with you at the end.

<!-- uid=423500601:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=423500601:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Why did you do this...?

<!-- uid=423500601:12:1 -->

**Kayaba:** Why, huh? I forgot a long time  
ago.

<!-- uid=423500601:13:1 -->

**Kayaba:** I wonder why. When I began  
developing the FullDive  
environment system...

<!-- uid=423500601:14:1 -->

**Kayaba:** No, long before that, I dreamed of  
nothing but creating that castle,  
a world that surpassed...

<!-- uid=423500601:15:1 -->

**Kayaba:** ...all our laws and all our  
restrictions.

<!-- uid=423500601:16:1 -->

**Kayaba:** And now I have seen someone  
surpass even my own world's laws.

<!-- uid=423500601:17:1 -->

**Kayaba:** How old was I when I was obsessed  
with the fantasy of a steel castle  
that floated in the sky?

<!-- uid=423500601:18:1 -->

**Kayaba:** I wanted to leave the ground,  
to fly to that castle...

<!-- uid=423500601:19:1 -->

**Kayaba:** For a long, long time, that was  
my only desire...

<!-- uid=423500601:20:1 -->

**Kayaba:** You know, Kirito, I still believe.

<!-- uid=423500601:21:1 -->

**Kayaba:** I believe that in some other  
world, that castle truly exists...

<!-- uid=423500601:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah... I hope it does.

<!-- uid=423500601:23:1 -->

**Everyone:** ...

<!-- uid=423500601:24:1 -->

**Kayaba:** ...I forgot to say this.  
Congratulations on beating  
the game, Kirito, Asuna.

<!-- uid=423500601:25:1 -->

**Kayaba:** Now then, I must be going.

<!-- uid=423500601:26:1 -->

**Asuna:** The world the commander wanted to  
see...

<!-- uid=423500601:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** I wonder if the world we live in  
now is that place he dreamed of.

<!-- uid=423500601:28:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...Hard to say.

<!-- uid=423500601:29:1 -->

**Kazuto:** There is one thing I feel  
confident saying, though.

<!-- uid=423500601:30:1 -->

**Kazuto:** So many of the things we've  
experienced here in this world...

<!-- uid=423500601:31:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...belong to a world that even the  
brilliant Akihiko Kayaba could  
never even imagine.

<!-- uid=423500601:32:1 -->

**Kazuto:** If he were still alive, I bet he'd  
think about what lies ahead in  
our future...

<!-- uid=423500601:33:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...And he'd be so curious to find  
out what happens next.

<!-- uid=423500601:34:1 -->


## Story 423500701 · The World Seed

Event Story  
Nostalgic Memories ~ SAO・ALO ~

**Asuna:** Kiritooo! Hey, over here!

<!-- uid=423500701:1:1 -->

**Kazuto:** H-Hold up, Asuna...

<!-- uid=423500701:2:1 -->

**Kazuto:** There's no reason to rush over  
like that.

<!-- uid=423500701:3:1 -->

**Kazuto:** We're in a park, surrounded by  
nature. You're supposed to take  
it slow here...

<!-- uid=423500701:4:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's hard to take that kind of old  
man talk seriously when it's  
coming from you, Kazuto...

<!-- uid=423500701:5:1 -->

**Kazuto:** It's not as if you're the super  
active type yourself, are you?

<!-- uid=423500701:6:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Didn't you play a bunch at the  
arcade, anyway?

<!-- uid=423500701:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** That... wasn't a good match for  
me, I guess you could say.

<!-- uid=423500701:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** Old games are so hard. I had so  
much trouble playing them!

<!-- uid=423500701:9:1 -->

**Kazuto:** They've got their own tricks you  
need to master. Being a gamer is  
all about adapting.

<!-- uid=423500701:10:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Game input devices have changed as  
games evolve...

<!-- uid=423500701:11:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Controllers, keyboards, mice,  
specialized hardware, and now  
the AmuSphere and the Augma...

<!-- uid=423500701:12:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Just because you've mastered one  
doesn't mean you've mastered all  
the rest, okay?

<!-- uid=423500701:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, I'm not a gamer.

<!-- uid=423500701:14:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Yeah, true, but...

<!-- uid=423500701:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** So you admit it? In other words,  
I don't need to be good at every  
game that's ever been released!

<!-- uid=423500701:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** And anyway, games these days have  
pretty similar controls, right?  
You can usually make do...

<!-- uid=423500701:17:1 -->

**Kazuto:** H-Hrrmph...!

<!-- uid=423500701:18:1 -->

**Kazuto:** \*sigh\*... Okay, I admit that what  
you're saying does make some  
sense...

<!-- uid=423500701:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kazuto... Why do you seem so down?

<!-- uid=423500701:20:1 -->

**Kazuto:** This is just the kind of thing  
gamers complain about.

<!-- uid=423500701:21:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Anyway, sorry to go back to  
Kayaba, but there is something  
he left us, remember?

<!-- uid=423500701:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh... You mean the Seed?

<!-- uid=423500701:23:1 -->

**Kazuto:** That's right. That thing is such  
an incredible program...

<!-- uid=423500701:24:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I mean, it's being used now by the  
majority of VRMMOs.

<!-- uid=423500701:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yes, and that's why it's so easy  
to convert now, and why learning  
controls is so simple...

<!-- uid=423500701:26:1 -->

**Kazuto:** That's the thing, though... Now  
all the fun of scrambling to come  
up with new moves and strats...

<!-- uid=423500701:27:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...Well, Kayaba's a scientist, not  
a gamer, right...?

<!-- uid=423500701:28:1 -->

**Kazuto:** So it just leaves a little  
something to be desired.

<!-- uid=423500701:29:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...I'm pretty sure that you're  
just about the only one who  
feels like that, Kazuto.

<!-- uid=423500701:30:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's basically a positive in every  
single way. We're able to have  
fun in ALO thanks to it too...

<!-- uid=423500701:31:1 -->


## Story 423500801 · A Disgusting Ruler

Event Story  
Nostalgic Memories ~ SAO・ALO ~

**Kazuto:** G-Gaaah...

<!-- uid=423500801:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Who needs difficult controls?  
For people like us, simple is  
best!

<!-- uid=423500801:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm grateful that the commander  
was a scientist over anything when  
I hear you say that kind of stuff.

<!-- uid=423500801:3:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Grrrmph...!

<!-- uid=423500801:4:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Well yeah, sure... The Seed's  
package really is an amazing  
program...

<!-- uid=423500801:5:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Especially that it's free. VRMMOs  
just cost so much to maintain...

<!-- uid=423500801:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** That was true for ALO. It nearly  
shut down because it couldn't  
afford the licensing fees, right?

<!-- uid=423500801:7:1 -->

**Kazuto:** That's hardly surprising when you  
consider all the trouble they  
caused.

<!-- uid=423500801:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...!

<!-- uid=423500801:9:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I couldn't believe it myself.  
Kayaba said he'd logged  
everyone out, but then...

<!-- uid=423500801:10:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I woke up, only to find out that  
you were still asleep... That's  
clearly an issue, right?

<!-- uid=423500801:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yes... And I really am grateful  
for what you did for me then...

<!-- uid=423500801:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** You weren't sure of what kind of  
position to take on the SAO  
incident just now...

<!-- uid=423500801:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** But I'd like to reject the idea  
that there was anything good  
about this incident at all...

<!-- uid=423500801:14:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Of course. What happened was a  
straight-up crime.

<!-- uid=423500801:15:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I had to throw myself into a VRMMO  
world in order to save you when  
you wouldn't wake up...

<!-- uid=423500801:16:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ALfheim Online... or ALO. A VRMMO  
set in the land of fairies.

<!-- uid=423500801:17:1 -->

**Kazuto:** A company known as RECT ran the  
game at the time.

<!-- uid=423500801:18:1 -->

**Kazuto:** In secret, though, they were  
running experiments on illegally  
imprisoned SAO survivors.

<!-- uid=423500801:19:1 -->

**Kazuto:** You were one of their victims.  
And the person responsible  
for it all...

<!-- uid=423500801:20:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...was a man named Nobuyuki Sugo,  
a guy who was attempting to marry  
you in the real world...

<!-- uid=423500801:21:1 -->

**Kazuto:** In ALO, he was Oberon, the Fairy  
King, a disgusting ruler of that  
world...

<!-- uid=423500801:22:1 -->


## Story 423500901 · A Place to Rest

Event Story  
Nostalgic Memories ~ SAO・ALO ~

**Oberon:** Call me His Highness...

<!-- uid=423500901:1:1 -->

**Oberon:** Fairy King Oberon!

<!-- uid=423500901:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ghaahk!

<!-- uid=423500901:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito!

<!-- uid=423500901:4:1 -->

**Oberon:** Well? You can't move, can you?

<!-- uid=423500901:5:1 -->

**Oberon:** This is gravity magic, coming out  
in the next patch. Maybe it's a  
little overpowered?

<!-- uid=423500901:6:2 -->

**Asuna:** Stop it, you coward!

<!-- uid=423500901:7:1 -->

**Oberon:** That said, Kirigaya... Or did  
you prefer Kirito?

<!-- uid=423500901:8:1 -->

**Oberon:** How did you get up here? I saw  
a strange program running.

<!-- uid=423500901:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** I flew with these wings.

<!-- uid=423500901:10:1 -->

**Oberon:** It doesn't matter. I can just  
ask your mind directly.

<!-- uid=423500901:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...What?

<!-- uid=423500901:12:1 -->

**Oberon:** You didn't really think I set this  
whole thing up for fun, did you?

<!-- uid=423500901:13:1 -->

**Oberon:** 300 former SAO players...

<!-- uid=423500901:14:1 -->

**Oberon:** Thanks to their cooperation, the  
fundamental technology for thought  
and memory control is 80% done.

<!-- uid=423500901:15:1 -->

**Oberon:** I'll achieve what no one ever has,  
the control of the human soul!  
The power of a god!

<!-- uid=423500901:16:1 -->

**Oberon:** Three cheers for virtual reality!  
...Hahahaha!

<!-- uid=423500901:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...Sugo!

<!-- uid=423500901:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** You'll never get away with this!

<!-- uid=423500901:19:1 -->

**Oberon:** Oh? Who's going to stop me?  
Sadly, there's no god in this  
world.

<!-- uid=423500901:20:1 -->

**Oberon:** Except for me!

<!-- uid=423500901:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sugo... really was despicable.

<!-- uid=423500901:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's still hard to believe that  
he really was like that...

<!-- uid=423500901:23:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I can't blame you. You're a  
trusting person.

<!-- uid=423500901:24:1 -->

**Kazuto:** And anyway, he knew your dad from  
work, right?

<!-- uid=423500901:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah...

<!-- uid=423500901:26:1 -->

**Kazuto:** In the end, we managed to crush  
Sugo's--Oberon's--ambitions. ALO  
is a clean and safe game now.

<!-- uid=423500901:27:1 -->

**Kazuto:** It's basically become our home  
at this point.

<!-- uid=423500901:28:1 -->

**Asuna:** Heh, you're right. In fact, that  
is where our home is...

<!-- uid=423500901:29:1 -->

**Kazuto:** The twenty-second floor of New  
Aincrad... Our log cabin.

## Story 423600801 · School Date

Event Story  
Nostalgic Memories ~ GGO・UW ~

**Kazuto:** I gotta admit, I'm glad I met with  
Sinon today...

<!-- uid=423600801:1:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Okay... Time to head to round  
three...!

<!-- uid=423600801:2:1 -->

**Alice:** You're late, Kirito!

<!-- uid=423600801:3:1 -->

**Kazuto:** S-Sorry...! I had to travel pretty  
far to get here...

<!-- uid=423600801:4:1 -->

**Alice:** I've no interest in any excuses.  
It's far past our appointed  
meeting time!

<!-- uid=423600801:5:1 -->

**Alice:** You realize that you're the one  
who thought you could arrive  
here by now, right?

<!-- uid=423600801:6:1 -->

**Alice:** If it's going to take more time,

no, it's always this way with you.

**Alice:** ...Well, I suppose it's fine. I am

out here today.

<!-- uid=423600801:9:1 -->

**Alice:** You've been having fun with all

you still found time for me.

<!-- uid=423600801:10:1 -->

**Alice:** I ought to be thanking you for

<!-- uid=423600801:11:1 -->

**Alice:** So excuse me... I haven't upset

<!-- uid=423600801:12:1 -->

**Kazuto:** You don't need to apologize,

my fault for being late.

<!-- uid=423600801:13:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...Are you sure about this,  
though? As I assume you  
know, today I...

<!-- uid=423600801:14:1 -->

**Alice:** You went on dates with Asuna and

<!-- uid=423600801:15:1 -->

**Alice:** I have no qualms with that.

<!-- uid=423600801:16:1 -->

**Kazuto:** O-Okay, if you say so...

<!-- uid=423600801:17:1 -->

**Kazuto:** And wait, Alice? Why are you  
dressed up like that?

**Kazuto:** That's... a uniform. And not just  
any uniform, it's a Survivor  
School uniform...

<!-- uid=423600801:19:1 -->

considerate.

**Kazuto:** Considerate...?

<!-- uid=423600801:21:1 -->

**Alice:** Indeed. When I heard that you went  
on many a date today...

<!-- uid=423600801:22:1 -->

**Alice:** I felt like meeting you as well,  
but I also had a sense of unease.

<!-- uid=423600801:23:1 -->

**Alice:** I thought you may be sick and  
tired of these dates you've been  
going on with women...

<!-- uid=423600801:24:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Urk...?!

**Kazuto:** (Well, normally I'd be delighted

<!-- uid=423600801:26:1 -->

**Kazuto:** (But a triple-header of all  
things? I even feel physically  
exhausted...)

**Alice:** And that is why I found myself

just as important as function.

<!-- uid=423600801:28:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...And that's why you're wearing  
a school uniform?

<!-- uid=423600801:29:1 -->

**Alice:** Indeed. This allows you to

new and exciting, does it not?

**Kazuto:** Well, sure... a little...?

**Alice:** Excellent! Then why don't we get  
going?

**Kazuto:** Sure, but... where is it you

<!-- uid=423600801:33:1 -->

**Kazuto:** You just told me to come here.

it's pretty late too...

<!-- uid=423600801:34:1 -->

**Alice:** Where else? Just look at how I'm

**Kazuto:** How you're...

**Alice:** How would you like to go on a

## Story 423600901 · Cherished Memory

Event Story  
Nostalgic Memories ~ GGO・UW ~

**Kazuto:** You at school, huh...?

<!-- uid=423600901:1:1 -->

**Alice:** What's the matter? Why are you  
staring at me so intently?

<!-- uid=423600901:2:1 -->

**Kazuto:** No, it's just that I thought you  
wouldn't have trouble sneaking  
in if you're dressed like that.

<!-- uid=423600901:3:1 -->

**Alice:** Don't be ridiculous...! I'm no  
thief. I'll be sure to get proper  
permission.

<!-- uid=423600901:4:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Seriously...? Do they give  
permission for stuff like this...?

<!-- uid=423600901:5:1 -->

**Kazuto:** It's a pretty innocent school,  
you know...

<!-- uid=423600901:6:1 -->

**Alice:** I think it should be fine, so long  
as you're with me.

<!-- uid=423600901:7:1 -->

**Alice:** It's not as if I'm an unknown,  
suspicious character to the  
school either.

<!-- uid=423600901:8:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...I guess you're right. You're  
almost a celebrity of sorts.

<!-- uid=423600901:9:1 -->

**Alice:** Indeed, but I dare not say that my  
renown will address all problems  
on its own.

<!-- uid=423600901:10:1 -->

**Alice:** I'll be counting on you, Kirito.  
I hope you'll show me the school  
you're attending.

<!-- uid=423600901:11:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...Okay, okay. It's not like I'd  
be able to say no if you're that  
interested in this.

<!-- uid=423600901:12:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Still... it does feel a little odd  
to be heading to the Survivor  
School together with you.

<!-- uid=423600901:13:1 -->

**Kazuto:** It wasn't long ago that we were  
yelling and fighting all the time,  
but now...

<!-- uid=423600901:14:1 -->

**Alice:** That's how you see it.

<!-- uid=423600901:15:1 -->

**Alice:** It isn't a matter of the distant  
past from my perspective.

<!-- uid=423600901:16:1 -->

**Alice:** My memories of the time we spent  
together... are truly irreplaceable  
to me.

<!-- uid=423600901:17:1 -->

**Alice:** Even if you don't remember much  
of it.

<!-- uid=423600901:18:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Ack...!

<!-- uid=423600901:19:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I-It's not like my memories have  
been wiped completely clean,  
you know!

<!-- uid=423600901:20:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I did remember a good bit of it  
after I regained consciousness...

<!-- uid=423600901:21:1 -->

**Alice:** Even so, I'm sure the two of us  
understood that time in different  
ways.

<!-- uid=423600901:22:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Well, I mean...

<!-- uid=423600901:23:1 -->

**Kazuto:** The memories are there, but  
they're not based on my own  
experiences.

<!-- uid=423600901:24:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I was just... watching. As you and  
all the others helped me and  
protected me.

<!-- uid=423600901:25:1 -->

**Alice:** ...You did more than just watch.

<!-- uid=423600901:26:1 -->

**Alice:** You were always trying to fight.  
You were always trying... to  
protect someone.

<!-- uid=423600901:27:1 -->

**Alice:** Even when you didn't seem to be  
there, unable to stand on your  
own, if someone was in trouble...

<!-- uid=423600901:28:1 -->

**Alice:** You went and tried to pick up a  
sword for their sake, even if you  
had to crawl your way to it.

<!-- uid=423600901:29:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...

<!-- uid=423600901:30:1 -->

**Alice:** That, too, is one of my cherished  
memories...

<!-- uid=423600901:31:1 -->

**Alice:** What's the matter? Why the  
somber look?

<!-- uid=423601001:7:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Oh, it's just... I don't think I

<!-- uid=423601001:8:1 -->

**Kazuto:** If I'm being honest, I'd prefer it  
if people didn't go out of their  
way to bring that time up to me...

<!-- uid=423601001:9:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Anyway... why don't we talk about  
what happened next?!

<!-- uid=423601001:10:1 -->

**Kazuto:** You fought a horde of goblins at  
Rulid Village, right?

<!-- uid=423601001:11:1 -->

**Kazuto:** In that shining armor of yours!  
I bet you looked so cool!

<!-- uid=423601001:12:1 -->

**Alice:** I'm not so certain. If anything,  
that is a story I'm not all that  
proud of...

<!-- uid=423601001:13:1 -->

**Alice:** A minor occurrence among all the  
tales that circulate among UW.

<!-- uid=423601001:14:1 -->

**Alice:** Like a small skirmish compared to  
your battle with Emperor Vecta  
after you returned to us.

<!-- uid=423601001:15:1 -->

**Kazuto:** No way! Definitely not!

<!-- uid=423601001:16:1 -->

**Kazuto:** There's you, Asuna, and  
Leafa and Sinon too...

<!-- uid=423601001:17:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I'll never get sick of hearing  
about all you did in my place!

<!-- uid=423601001:18:1 -->

**Kazuto:** If you respect me, I've gotta pay  
that respect back to you, and with  
tons of interest on top!

<!-- uid=423601001:19:1 -->

**Alice:** I'm... not exactly sure of your  
logic here...

<!-- uid=423601001:20:1 -->

**Kazuto:** What do you mean? I'm being  
serious!

<!-- uid=423601001:21:1 -->

**Alice:** Kirito...

<!-- uid=423601001:22:1 -->


## Story 423601101 · Blue Rose

Event Story  
Nostalgic Memories ~ GGO・UW ~

**Alice:** So this is the path you always  
take to go to school.

<!-- uid=423601101:1:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Yeah, I guess it is.

<!-- uid=423601101:2:1 -->

**Alice:** I see... And this is what you see  
as you head to schoo... Hm?

<!-- uid=423601101:3:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Is something the matter?

<!-- uid=423601101:4:1 -->

**Alice:** Oh, no. I just happened to see a  
store selling flowers.

<!-- uid=423601101:5:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Flowers...?

<!-- uid=423601101:6:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I guess you're right. Huh, so  
there's a florist over there.

<!-- uid=423601101:7:1 -->

**Alice:** You're saying... you never noticed  
until now?

<!-- uid=423601101:8:1 -->

**Alice:** I think that's being a little too  
inattentive, don't you?

<!-- uid=423601101:9:1 -->

**Alice:** Coming from a fighter with your  
abilities, too... I can't say I'm  
very impressed.

<!-- uid=423601101:10:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Listen, I do enjoy being treated  
like some great fighter in this  
world too, but...

<!-- uid=423601101:11:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I'm really just a regular student.  
There are lots of things that I  
don't notice.

<!-- uid=423601101:12:1 -->

**Alice:** Even the existence of a florist  
on your way to school?

<!-- uid=423601101:13:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...W-Well, yeah.

<!-- uid=423601101:14:1 -->

**Kazuto:** (Alice's mood is taking a turn for  
the worse...! I know what this  
situation needs...)

<!-- uid=423601101:15:1 -->

**Kazuto:** (A present!)

<!-- uid=423601101:16:1 -->

**Kazuto:** You really do have a girlish side  
to you, though. Noticing a florist  
like this...

<!-- uid=423601101:17:1 -->

**Alice:** I think anyone would notice a shop  
like that, regardless of gender.

<!-- uid=423601101:18:1 -->

**Kazuto:** \*cough\* \*cough\*  
Well, anyway! Maybe this  
is some kind of sign!

<!-- uid=423601101:19:1 -->

**Kazuto:** We are on a date, after all...  
Would you allow me to present  
you with a gift of flowers?

<!-- uid=423601101:20:1 -->

**Alice:** ...

<!-- uid=423601101:21:1 -->

**Alice:** Do you really take me for the kind  
of woman whose favor can be  
curried with a gift of flowers?

<!-- uid=423601101:22:1 -->

**Kazuto:** No, I'd never! I just thought that  
some beautiful flowers would be  
the perfect match for you...

<!-- uid=423601101:23:1 -->

**Alice:** ...!

<!-- uid=423601101:24:1 -->

**Alice:** M-Men like you...! I see they  
aren't lying when they speak of  
your experience with women!

<!-- uid=423601101:25:1 -->

**Alice:** You're trying to twist me around  
your little finger! Kirito...  
I feel ashamed!

<!-- uid=423601101:26:1 -->

**Alice:** You should be embarrassed for  
yourself, secretly training in  
such lecherous ways...!

<!-- uid=423601101:27:1 -->

**Kazuto:** You say that, but you're the one  
who brought flowers up in the  
first place...

<!-- uid=423601101:28:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Anyway, let me buy you some  
flowers. Hmm, which would  
match you the best...?

<!-- uid=423601101:29:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Guess we gotta start with  
Osmanthus. Wait, that was a tree,  
wasn't it? Okay, what else...?

<!-- uid=423601101:30:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Ah...!

<!-- uid=423601101:31:1 -->

**Kazuto:** These flowers...!

<!-- uid=423601101:32:1 -->

**Alice:** ...Kirito? Did you find something?

<!-- uid=423601101:33:1 -->

**Kazuto:** You wouldn't expect a tiny florist  
in a town like this to be selling  
flowers like these.

<!-- uid=423601101:34:1 -->

**Alice:** Are these... blue roses...?

<!-- uid=423601101:35:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...They are.

<!-- uid=423601101:36:1 -->

**Kazuto:** These didn't originally exist in  
nature here in the real world.

<!-- uid=423601101:37:1 -->

**Kazuto:** As you'd expect, most roses are  
red.

<!-- uid=423601101:38:1 -->

**Kazuto:** But lots of people put incredible  
effort into creating a blue rose.

<!-- uid=423601101:39:1 -->

**Kazuto:** It's only recently that blue  
roses have become available  
for people to buy.

<!-- uid=423601101:40:1 -->

**Kazuto:** They're still rare flowers,  
though.

<!-- uid=423601101:41:1 -->

**Kazuto:** You barely ever see them being  
sold in a store as cut flowers  
like this...

<!-- uid=423601101:42:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Just coming across them is  
something like a miracle...

<!-- uid=423601101:43:1 -->

<!-- uid=423601101:44:1 -->

**Alice:** !!

## Story 423601201 · Into the Future

Event Story  
Nostalgic Memories ~ GGO・UW ~

**Eugeo:** ...Kirito.

<!-- uid=423601201:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** !

<!-- uid=423601201:2:1 -->

**Eugeo:** It's me, Kirito.

<!-- uid=423601201:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Eugeo... So you were still alive.

<!-- uid=423601201:4:1 -->

**Eugeo:** This is me as I exist within your  
memories. A fragment of memory  
that I left behind.

<!-- uid=423601201:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Memories...

<!-- uid=423601201:6:1 -->

**Eugeo:** That's right. Did you forget  
already? We seemed so certain  
back then. Memories...

<!-- uid=423601201:7:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...live on inside of us.

<!-- uid=423601201:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...Thank you, Eugeo.

<!-- uid=423601201:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's because you were there,  
because you rescued me... that  
I'm here like this, healthy.

<!-- uid=423601201:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** My memories of the time we spent  
together will never fade.

<!-- uid=423601201:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Because my memories live on inside  
of me, forever...

<!-- uid=423601201:12:1 -->

**Kazuto:** That little meeting with Eugeo  
turned into a core part of who  
I am as a person now...

<!-- uid=423601201:13:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Life really is a funny thing.  
What can you call that if  
not a miracle?

<!-- uid=423601201:14:1 -->

**Alice:** ...It's no miracle, Kirito.

<!-- uid=423601201:15:1 -->

**Alice:** I believe destiny is what brought  
us together.

<!-- uid=423601201:16:1 -->

**Kazuto:** !

<!-- uid=423601201:17:1 -->

**Alice:** You, Eugeo, and... Alice Zuberg.

<!-- uid=423601201:18:1 -->

**Alice:** The meeting of the three  
ultimately created a revolutionary  
force in the land of Underworld.

<!-- uid=423601201:19:1 -->

**Alice:** It may be thanks to the two no  
longer with us now that we're able  
to celebrate our days like this...

<!-- uid=423601201:20:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...Yeah, you might be right.

<!-- uid=423601201:21:1 -->

**Kazuto:** We're able to live like this  
thanks to everyone's support,  
after all.

<!-- uid=423601201:22:1 -->

**Alice:** Indeed. We mustn't forget that...

<!-- uid=423601201:23:1 -->

**Alice:** That is why I believe that more  
than anything... we must continue  
to remember.

<!-- uid=423601201:24:1 -->

**Kazuto:** We need to keep remembering...?

<!-- uid=423601201:25:1 -->

**Alice:** That's right. There are many  
irreplaceable memories within  
all our hearts.

<!-- uid=423601201:26:1 -->

**Alice:** Each a unique experience.  
To experience them once more...

<!-- uid=423601201:27:1 -->

**Alice:** ...Which is to say, to have a  
vicarious experience of them,  
is quite a difficult task.

<!-- uid=423601201:28:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...Humans forget as they live.  
That's just who we are.

<!-- uid=423601201:29:1 -->

**Alice:** Yes, but I do not believe that  
we're completely powerless.

<!-- uid=423601201:30:1 -->

**Alice:** All the ever-glistening memories  
deep within our hearts...

<!-- uid=423601201:31:1 -->

**Alice:** If we refuse to forget them,  
if we continue to remember them...

<!-- uid=423601201:32:1 -->

**Alice:** ...I want to believe that we can  
do it too. Don't you, Kirito?

<!-- uid=423601201:33:1 -->

**Kazuto:** So you're saying that memories  
don't vanish, huh?

<!-- uid=423601201:34:1 -->

**Alice:** That I am.

<!-- uid=423601201:35:1 -->

**Kazuto:** ...What a weird coincidence. Asuna  
said something just like that when  
we said goodbye earlier today.

<!-- uid=423601201:36:1 -->

**Alice:** Did she now?

<!-- uid=423601201:37:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Yes, and this is how I replied.

<!-- uid=423601201:38:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Every time you say goodbye,  
it's because you got to meet  
someone new...

<!-- uid=423601201:39:1 -->

**Alice:** ...An extremely simple statement,  
but a good one.

<!-- uid=423601201:40:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Heh heh... Right?

<!-- uid=423601201:41:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Whoa, what am I doing?! This isn't  
the kind of conversation you have  
in front of a shop!

<!-- uid=423601201:42:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Anyway, I'll buy these blue roses,  
and... let's go to the Survivor  
School with them.

<!-- uid=423601201:43:1 -->

**Kazuto:** It'll almost feel like Eugeo is  
there with us if we do, right...?

<!-- uid=423601201:44:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I'm starting to feel like I need  
to show him my school too!

<!-- uid=423601201:45:1 -->

**Alice:** ...What a wonderful thought.

<!-- uid=423601201:46:1 -->

**Alice:** In that case... let's go, Kirito.

<!-- uid=423601201:47:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Yeah!

<!-- uid=423601201:48:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...And with that, our adventures  
came to a close for now.

<!-- uid=423601201:49:1 -->

**Kirito:** But, of course, this isn't where  
it all stops. It's not an ending.

<!-- uid=423601201:50:1 -->

**Kirito:** We'll never stop moving forward,  
toward the dawn of a new age...

<!-- uid=423601201:51:1 -->

**Kirito:** Even further into the future!

<!-- uid=423601201:52:1 -->


## Story 440100101 · I am...

Event Story  
Helheim's invasion ~Vigorous Attack~

**Makoto:** Hmm... Those two...

<!-- uid=440100101:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh?

<!-- uid=440100101:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** That woman at the front of the  
demon army... She's staring  
awfully intently at us...

<!-- uid=440100101:3:1 -->

just coming for us like everyone  
else?

<!-- uid=440100101:4:1 -->

**Thokk:** Hey, Earth to Makoto! If you dally  
any longer, Skull's gonna chew ya  
out again.

<!-- uid=440100101:5:1 -->

**Makoto:** Y-Yeah, I know, Thokk...

<!-- uid=440100101:6:1 -->

**Monster:** KKKAAGAAAWW!

<!-- uid=440100101:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Urk, Asuna, we should deal with  
these flying monsters first!

<!-- uid=440100101:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** O-Okay...

<!-- uid=440100101:9:1 -->

**Thokk:** C'mon, Makoto, keep moving!

<!-- uid=440100101:10:1 -->

**Makoto:** R-Right.

<!-- uid=440100101:11:1 -->

**Makoto:** My name is Makoto. In the real  
world I'm a rookie police officer.

<!-- uid=440100101:12:1 -->

**Makoto (Seiko):** I work in a small police station  
in the city of Kawagoe in Saitama  
Prefecture, just outside Tokyo.

<!-- uid=440100101:13:1 -->

**Makoto (Seiko):** It so happens I bumped into two  
childhood friends the other day,  
Kazuto and Suguha Kirigaya.

<!-- uid=440100101:14:1 -->

**Makoto (Seiko):** They're siblings, and I spent many  
years of my childhood learning  
kendo at their house's dojo.

<!-- uid=440100101:15:1 -->

**Makoto (Seiko):** I met them by chance and we caught  
up. But there was one thing that  
they recommended...

<!-- uid=440100101:16:1 -->

**Makoto (Seiko):** ALfheim Online. A virtual reality  
game set in a fictional world.

<!-- uid=440100101:17:1 -->

**Makoto (Seiko):** Naturally, I was interested.

<!-- uid=440100101:18:1 -->

**Makoto (Seiko):** I borrowed my dad's AmuSphere, which  
I needed to dive into the game.

<!-- uid=440100101:19:1 -->

**Makoto:** I was supposed to be plunged into  
Alfheim, become a fairy warrior,  
and take part in epic battles.

<!-- uid=440100101:20:1 -->

**Makoto:** But for some reason, I was sent to  
Helheim, the game's underworld,  
and trained as a demon warrior.

<!-- uid=440100101:21:1 -->

**Makoto:** Eventually, I was forced to join  
the demon army in their attack  
on the world of the fairies.

<!-- uid=440100101:22:1 -->

**Makoto:** The demons were sent to Helheim  
after being killed up above, so  
they bear a grudge against fairies.

<!-- uid=440100101:23:1 -->

**Makoto:** And so, along I went with the demon  
army, as I took my first steps into  
Alfheim in the land of the living.

<!-- uid=440100101:24:1 -->


## Story 440100201 · Between Real and Virtual

Event Story  
Helheim's invasion ~Vigorous Attack~

**Skull:** Wahoo! C'mon, let's have a few

**Makoto:** Victory? But because of us, that

**Makoto:** Gah, the weight of guilt lies

<!-- uid=440100201:11:1 -->

**Seiko:** ...

**Seiko:** \*sigh\*...

## Story 440100301 · Pretend Play

Event Story  
Helheim's invasion ~Vigorous Attack~

**Makoto:** \*sigh\*...

<!-- uid=440100301:1:1 -->

**Thokk:** I see, I see. And so you never  
spilled the beans that you've  
been playing the game?

<!-- uid=440100301:2:1 -->

**Makoto:** Well, yeah. They know I'm a police  
officer!

<!-- uid=440100301:3:1 -->

**Makoto:** How can I tell them I'm a police  
officer by day but join forces  
with evil by night?!

<!-- uid=440100301:4:1 -->

**Thokk:** Wahaha, you crack me up!

<!-- uid=440100301:5:1 -->

**Makoto:** I'm trying to be serious here!

<!-- uid=440100301:6:1 -->

**Thokk:** You're honest to a fault, Makoto.

<!-- uid=440100301:7:1 -->

**Thokk:** This world is just a fully  
immersive role-playing game.  
Don't take it too much to heart.

<!-- uid=440100301:8:1 -->

**Makoto:** What do you mean by that?

<!-- uid=440100301:9:1 -->

**Thokk:** Well, simply put, you're given an  
avatar and you play the role of an  
inhabitant of this world.

<!-- uid=440100301:10:1 -->

**Thokk:** You're free to act differently  
here, just like the NPCs. Hell, you  
can even change your gender.

<!-- uid=440100301:11:1 -->

**Makoto:** That's right... MMORPG... The RPG  
stands for role-playing game,  
doesn't it? I think I get it now.

<!-- uid=440100301:12:1 -->

**Thokk:** Good, good! Glad to hear it!

<!-- uid=440100301:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** Although, I bet my dad would  
freak if he found out... He'd be  
like "What are you thinking!"

<!-- uid=440100301:14:1 -->

**Thokk:** Ah, yeah, you borrowed the  
AmuSphere from your pa, didn't  
you?

<!-- uid=440100301:15:1 -->

## Story 440100401 · The Fans of Seven

Event Story  
Helheim's invasion ~Vigorous Attack~

**Makoto:** Where are we?

<!-- uid=440100401:1:1 -->

**Thokk:** Land of the Pooka, the musical  
fairies. I guess it's a little to the  
northwest of Arun.

<!-- uid=440100401:2:1 -->

**Makoto:** I must say... Demon powers sure  
are useful. We can teleport through  
darkness from Helheim in a second!

<!-- uid=440100401:3:1 -->

frightening to the fairies
