<!-- uid=440100401:4:1 -->

find ourselves in a pinch, we can

<!-- uid=440100401:5:1 -->

to stay on the defensive. Seems  
almost kind of... cheap.

<!-- uid=440100401:6:1 -->

**Thokk:** Well, YEAH, we are demons!  
Ain't it great?

<!-- uid=440100401:7:1 -->

**Makoto:** Okay, okay, I get it.  
So... We're going to attack  
Pooka territory now?

<!-- uid=440100401:8:1 -->

**Grimm:** Yeah. They can use their music to  
buff their comrades. But other  
than that, they're not too strong.

<!-- uid=440100401:9:1 -->

**Skull:** If we're gonna fight all the fairies,  
we might as well start with the  
weakest ones! It's common sense!

<!-- uid=440100401:10:1 -->

**Makoto:** Sheesh, this sounds awfully cheap  
too.

<!-- uid=440100401:11:1 -->

<!-- uid=440100401:12:1 -->

<!-- uid=440100401:13:1 -->

<!-- uid=440100401:14:1 -->

**Seven:** I was pretty popular, if I say so

concerts...

<!-- uid=440100401:15:1 -->

idol anymore?

**Feliz:** Which means they couldn't be  
your fans out there...

<!-- uid=440100401:18:1 -->

**Seven:** What?! Why!

<!-- uid=440100401:19:1 -->

**Feliz:** Well... I don't think I've ever  
seen you surrounded by fans  
since we met.

<!-- uid=440100401:20:1 -->

**Seven:** Ouch, you don't pull your punches.  
I guess NPCs with high-level AI  
don't always read the room...

<!-- uid=440100401:21:1 -->

**Feliz:** But you know, Seven, I'd love to  
hear you sing sometime. I like to  
sing too.

<!-- uid=440100401:22:1 -->

**Seven:** Aw, thanks, Feliz...

<!-- uid=440100401:23:1 -->

**Sphica:** Waaah! Big news, Seven!

<!-- uid=440100401:24:1 -->

**Seven:** Where's the fire, Sphica? It's  
probably just my fans swarming  
outside, right?

<!-- uid=440100401:25:1 -->

**Sphica:** N-No, it's not! It's the demons  
Asuna warned us about! They've  
brought their army!

<!-- uid=440100401:26:1 -->

Event Story

## Story 440101101 · A Fairy Standing in the Way

## Story 440101201 · Killer Moves

Event Story  
Helheim's invasion ~Vigorous Attack~

**Rain:** Yaaaaah!

<!-- uid=440101201:1:1 -->

**Grimm:** Ack!

<!-- uid=440101201:3:1 -->

**Skull:** Ngh... This ain't good...  
She's devilishly strong...  
for a fairy...

<!-- uid=440101201:4:1 -->

**Rain:** Phew... Seems like you two are in  
control here.

<!-- uid=440101201:5:1 -->

**Rain:** So if I take you out, then your  
army's morale's gonna drop faster  
than a sinking ship.

<!-- uid=440101201:6:1 -->

**Rain:** This is the end for you! You'll  
regret killing my sister and Agil!

<!-- uid=440101201:7:1 -->

**Rain:** Now take THIS!

<!-- uid=440101201:8:1 -->

**Rain:** ...!

<!-- uid=440101201:10:1 -->

**Makoto:** Just... in time!

<!-- uid=440101201:11:1 -->

**Grimm:** Makoto!

<!-- uid=440101201:12:1 -->

**Skull:** Hey, Makoto! What're you doing  
here?! You're supposed to be  
fighting over there!

<!-- uid=440101201:13:1 -->

**Makoto:** We'll talk later! We need to take  
her out first!

<!-- uid=440101201:14:1 -->

**Rain:** Hm...? You're wielding your weapon  
two-handed? And that pose seems...  
awfully kendo-like.

<!-- uid=440101201:15:1 -->

**Makoto:** Seems you're no pushover either.  
I didn't think I'd fight against a  
dual-wielder! Hehe, this'll be fun!

<!-- uid=440101201:16:1 -->

**Rain:** ...!

<!-- uid=440101201:18:1 -->

**Makoto:** You're wide open!

<!-- uid=440101201:19:1 -->

**Rain:** Ungh!

<!-- uid=440101201:20:1 -->

**Makoto:** I see.

<!-- uid=440101201:21:1 -->

**Rain:** You see what?!

<!-- uid=440101201:22:1 -->

**Makoto:** You are strong, I'll admit it. But  
it's a strength nurtured in this  
world only.

<!-- uid=440101201:23:1 -->

**Makoto:** You over-rely on the reflexes from  
gaming. I'm guessing you don't  
exercise much in the real world.

<!-- uid=440101201:24:1 -->

**Rain:** ...!

<!-- uid=440101201:25:1 -->

**Makoto:** I respect the time it took for you  
to get such good reflexes and  
gaming skills.

<!-- uid=440101201:26:1 -->

**Makoto:** But that means nothing if you  
haven't trained your real body!

<!-- uid=440101201:27:1 -->

**Rain:** Just who are you?

<!-- uid=440101201:28:1 -->

**Makoto:** Hraaaagh!

<!-- uid=440101201:29:1 -->

**Rain:** Nnngh...

<!-- uid=440101201:31:1 -->

**Makoto:** This is the end!

<!-- uid=440101201:32:1 -->

**Rain:** Th-Thousand... Rain!

<!-- uid=440101201:33:1 -->

**Makoto:** AAAAAAHHH!

<!-- uid=440101201:35:1 -->

**Makoto:** Nngh...

<!-- uid=440101201:36:1 -->

**Rain:** That was too close...

<!-- uid=440101201:37:1 -->

**Makoto:** What... was that...?

<!-- uid=440101201:38:1 -->

**Rain:** Let's just call it my special  
attack. Though the specifics  
are a trade secret.

<!-- uid=440101201:39:1 -->

**Rain:** All I need to do is hit you one  
more time with it and your health  
will be all gone!

<!-- uid=440101201:40:1 -->

**Makoto:** No... Am I really gonna lose...?

<!-- uid=440101201:41:1 -->

**Rain:** Get ready...! Cut my target to  
pieces, chiliad blades...  
Final Thousand Rain!

<!-- uid=440101201:42:1 -->

**Makoto:** But why do I not want to lose?  
For myself? Because of pride?

<!-- uid=440101201:44:1 -->

**Makoto:** No... It's for this world. I like  
it here... I don't want to stop  
existing as a demon here!

<!-- uid=440101201:45:1 -->

**Makoto:** Fighting with everyone, just like  
I did with kendo in the past...  
I enjoy it too much!

<!-- uid=440101201:46:1 -->

**Makoto:** YAAAAAAH!

<!-- uid=440101201:47:1 -->

**Rain:** A one-handed strike this time?  
Heh, that won't change a thing!  
Thousand Rain cuts down all!

<!-- uid=440101201:48:1 -->

**Makoto:** AAAAAAHHH!!

<!-- uid=440101201:49:1 -->

**Rain:** What's going on?! There's a huge  
effect appearing around her sword  
as she's striking!

<!-- uid=440101201:50:1 -->

**Rain:** No way...! She's destroying all of  
my weapons!

<!-- uid=440101201:52:1 -->

**Makoto:** HYAAAH!

<!-- uid=440101201:53:1 -->

**Rain:** AHHHHHHHH!

<!-- uid=440101201:55:1 -->

**Thokk:** Now that was something, Makoto!  
Good work.

<!-- uid=440101201:56:1 -->

**Makoto:** Huh? You were watching, Thokk?

<!-- uid=440101201:57:1 -->

**Thokk:** Hell to the yes. You did that  
striking kendo move you were going  
on about earlier, didn't ya?

<!-- uid=440101201:58:1 -->

**Makoto:** It's dangerous, though, so I've  
never tried it in real life. But  
now that we're in a game...

<!-- uid=440101201:59:1 -->

**Thokk:** Your strike was one-handed, though.  
Was that still kendo?

<!-- uid=440101201:60:1 -->

**Makoto:** No... Kendo strikes are pretty  
different.

<!-- uid=440101201:61:1 -->

**Makoto:** It's actually from a Shinsengumi  
drama my dad showed me. It's a  
special move of theirs.

<!-- uid=440101201:62:1 -->

**Makoto:** Mine was only an imitation, but I  
suddenly thought in the moment  
that it'd work.

<!-- uid=440101201:63:1 -->

**Thokk:** So after destroying the weapons,  
you canceled the strike motion,  
then moved to a sideways slash?

<!-- uid=440101201:64:1 -->

**Makoto:** Yeah. It's difficult, but the true  
benefit of the technique is that  
you can add successive moves.

<!-- uid=440101201:65:1 -->

**Makoto:** I realized just striking her  
attacks out of the way wouldn't  
let me win.

<!-- uid=440101201:66:1 -->

**Thokk:** I see, I see. That move might've  
been an OSS, you know. There  
was a special effect, right?

<!-- uid=440101201:67:1 -->

**Makoto:** Huh? What's an OSS?

<!-- uid=440101201:68:1 -->

**Thokk:** Uh, well...

<!-- uid=440101201:69:1 -->

**Makoto:** Ah! Wait, Thokk, how did your  
battle go? I never asked!  
How'd you defeat her?

<!-- uid=440101201:70:1 -->

**Thokk:** Hey, hey, don't bombard me with  
questions. We'll talk once we've  
finished this battle, alright?

<!-- uid=440101201:71:1 -->

**Makoto:** O-Oh, yeah, sure.

<!-- uid=440101201:72:1 -->

## Story 440200201 · Strategy Meeting in the Real World

Event Story  
Helheim's invasion ~Confrontation~

**Asuna:** What could this mean?

<!-- uid=440200201:1:1 -->

**Asuna:** Do you  
think there's an ALO player with  
a demon avatar out there?

<!-- uid=440200201:2:1 -->

**Rika:** Maybe it's some kind of random  
bonus for first-time divers?

<!-- uid=440200201:3:1 -->

**Suguha:** Or an existing player found a rare  
event and used it to change races?

<!-- uid=440200201:4:1 -->

**Keiko:** If that were the case, you just  
know they'd be talking it up on  
social media!

<!-- uid=440200201:5:1 -->

**Kazuto:** That's true...

<!-- uid=440200201:6:1 -->

**Nanairo:** I'll try doing a search for  
anything like that. Help  
me out, sis.

<!-- uid=440200201:7:1 -->

**Nijika:** Alright.

<!-- uid=440200201:8:1 -->

**Yui:** Oh, we can handle that.  
It's our specialty, after all.  
Come on, Strea.

<!-- uid=440200201:9:1 -->

**Strea:** You got it, big sis.

<!-- uid=440200201:10:1 -->

**Agil:** Back to the demons... It's not  
just that they're tough. They know  
how to analyze a battle too.

<!-- uid=440200201:11:1 -->

**Agil:** When we used our ballistae on  
them, they knew to go after that  
team and take them out first.

<!-- uid=440200201:12:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I wonder if a player did that  
too... It IS possible to command  
NPC armies like in an RTS here.

<!-- uid=440200201:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** So, rather than focusing on beating  
their leaders, maybe we should  
gather more forces of our own?

<!-- uid=440200201:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Actually... now that I think of it,  
it might be crucial that we do  
that as soon as possible.

<!-- uid=440200201:15:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Yeah... This is a full-blown war  
now. We need more than just  
a few powerful allies helping us.

<!-- uid=440200201:16:1 -->

**Agil:** The first "M" in VRMMO does stand  
for "massive," after all.

<!-- uid=440200201:17:1 -->

**Suguha:** Hang on, though. The other  
races in ALO are all still  
fighting each other, right?

<!-- uid=440200201:18:1 -->

**Suguha:** It's gonna be way harder to gather  
allies across race lines than it  
is from the same race alone.

<!-- uid=440200201:19:1 -->

**Rika:** Good point. The Salamanders were  
even raging online about how they  
were gonna beat the demons first.

<!-- uid=440200201:20:1 -->

**Keiko:** So Klein aside, I guess we  
won't be able to count on  
any of them for help...

<!-- uid=440200201:21:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I think it's worth trying an ALO-  
wide summon anyway. We can't  
afford to be divided right now.

<!-- uid=440200201:22:1 -->

**Yui:** Mommy, Daddy... I'm afraid we  
couldn't find anything about a  
player using a demon avatar.

<!-- uid=440200201:23:1 -->

**Strea:** There were a few obvious lies and  
jokes about playing as one, but  
pretty much nothing credible.

<!-- uid=440200201:24:1 -->

**Kazuto:** I see...

<!-- uid=440200201:25:1 -->

**Yui:** There is one thing we noticed,  
though...

<!-- uid=440200201:26:1 -->

**Seiko:** Ugh... I'm exhausted...

<!-- uid=440200201:27:1 -->

**Seiko:** I guess I HAVE been involved in  
an awful lot of warfare lately...

<!-- uid=440200201:28:1 -->

**Seiko:** And here I thought that games were  
supposed to be light fun. I had no  
idea they could be so much work...

<!-- uid=440200201:29:1 -->

**Seiko:** Still... I have to admit there's  
also something surprisingly...  
fulfilling about them.

<!-- uid=440200201:30:1 -->

**Seiko:** Hm? It's one of my colleagues  
from Hakodate...

<!-- uid=440200201:31:1 -->

**Colleague:** Hello?

<!-- uid=440200201:32:1 -->

**Seiko:** Oh, hey, it's good to hear from  
you. What's up?

<!-- uid=440200201:33:1 -->

**Colleague:** Seiko, do you have a moment right  
now? Sorry to spring this on you  
so suddenly!

<!-- uid=440200201:34:1 -->

**Seiko:** Oh, sure, no problem...  
What's this all about?

<!-- uid=440200201:35:1 -->

**Colleague:** Remember how you helped out with  
that inquiry for the Ministry of  
Health, Labor, and Welfare?

<!-- uid=440200201:36:1 -->

**Seiko:** Oh, yeah... I did a deposition  
about households suspected  
of neglecting their children.

<!-- uid=440200201:37:1 -->

**Colleague:** Do you also remember Haru Kiyono?  
One of the teens from one of the  
households we investigated?

<!-- uid=440200201:38:1 -->

**Seiko:** Haru Kiyono... Yeah, I remember  
her... She was still in elementary  
school back then, right?

<!-- uid=440200201:39:1 -->

**Seiko:** As I recall, one of her neighbors  
informed us that her parents  
had a tendency to neglect her.

<!-- uid=440200201:40:1 -->

**Seiko:** But it wasn't very serious, so we  
decided to just keep an eye on  
them... Why, what happened?!

<!-- uid=440200201:41:1 -->

**Colleague:** Oh, no, they stopped neglecting  
her after that, so that's okay.  
But now there's another problem.

<!-- uid=440200201:42:1 -->

**Colleague:** Can you tell me everything  
you know about Haru?

<!-- uid=440200201:43:1 -->

**Seiko:** Huh?

<!-- uid=440200201:44:1 -->

surprised to see it was you here,  
Lady Alice.

<!-- uid=810800801:15:1 -->

**Alice:** Surprised, you say...

<!-- uid=810800801:16:1 -->

**Eldrie:** I mean th-that in the most  
positive sense of the word! I was  
amazed at your culinary skill!

<!-- uid=810800801:17:1 -->

**Eldrie:** To see your skills with not only  
a sword, but a whisk! Not only in  
battle, but also in the kitchen!

<!-- uid=810800801:18:1 -->

**Eldrie:** Yet despite the difference, your  
valiant figure remains the same!  
I was moved, truly!

<!-- uid=810800801:19:1 -->

**Alice:** \*sigh\*...

<!-- uid=810800801:20:1 -->

**Alice:** Eldrie... You are a poor judge.

<!-- uid=810800801:21:1 -->

**Eldrie:** Eep?!

<!-- uid=810800801:22:1 -->

**Alice:** Or rather, I should say when it  
comes to me, your superior, you  
tend towards flattery.

<!-- uid=810800801:23:1 -->

**Alice:** My skills in the kitchen are  
nothing special, I assure you.

<!-- uid=810800801:24:1 -->

**Eldrie:** You are too modest, Lady Alice...

<!-- uid=810800801:25:1 -->

**Alice:** No. At the very least, I have no  
skills worthy of any special  
praise.

<!-- uid=810800801:26:1 -->

**Alice:** I expect the majority of those in  
the Human Empire are just as  
skilled in the kitchen as myself.

<!-- uid=810800801:27:1 -->

**Alice:** Frankly, your attempt to give  
me undeserved praise is rather  
tasteless.

<!-- uid=810800801:28:1 -->

**Alice:** I do not approve of such behavior.  
...Be more careful in the future.

<!-- uid=810800801:29:1 -->

**Eldrie:** O-Of course! I understand  
completely!

<!-- uid=810800801:30:1 -->


## Story 810800901 · A Troublesome Disciple

Event Story  
Sugary Sweet Secret Treat

**Alice:** Now then, how long do you intend  
to stand there, Eldrie?

<!-- uid=810800901:1:1 -->

**Alice:** I am busy. Not only that, I am  
pressed to finish this in time.

<!-- uid=810800901:2:1 -->

**Alice:** I don't need to spell it out for  
you, do I? I don't have time to  
waste with idle chitter-chatter.

<!-- uid=810800901:3:1 -->

**Eldrie:** A thousand apologies! I know  
nothing of sweets, so didn't  
grasp the severity of the matter.

<!-- uid=810800901:4:1 -->

**Alice:** Yes, even without you telling me,  
I am well aware...

<!-- uid=810800901:5:1 -->

**Alice:** I have no qualms with that,  
Eldrie, but...

<!-- uid=810800901:6:1 -->

**Eldrie:** Y-Yes?

<!-- uid=810800901:7:1 -->

**Alice:** An Integrity Knight does not need  
to bother themselves with making  
confectionaries. However...

<!-- uid=810800901:8:1 -->

**Alice:** No matter what pursuit you may  
engage in, you must not allow  
yourself to stagnate.

<!-- uid=810800901:9:1 -->

**Eldrie:** Y-You are quite right!

<!-- uid=810800901:10:1 -->

**Alice:** Then how about you fill your time  
with training instead of idle  
conversation, hm?

<!-- uid=810800901:11:1 -->

**Eldrie:** Ah...! R-Right away, Lady Alice!

<!-- uid=810800901:12:1 -->

**Eldrie:** Now, if you will excuse me!

<!-- uid=810800901:13:1 -->

**Alice:** One moment.

<!-- uid=810800901:14:1 -->

**Alice:** Take this with you.

<!-- uid=810800901:15:1 -->

**Eldrie:** Wh-What is this for...?

<!-- uid=810800901:16:1 -->

**Alice:** It is a trial run of the chocolate  
I am intending to make for Uncle.

<!-- uid=810800901:17:1 -->

**Alice:** Do not think I misunderstood your  
persistence in coming here. You  
wish to try some, yes?

<!-- uid=810800901:18:1 -->

**Eldrie:** Ack...!

<!-- uid=810800901:19:1 -->

**Alice:** Personally, I don't think men  
should interest themselves with  
sweets, but never mind that now.

<!-- uid=810800901:20:1 -->

**Alice:** As I mentioned before, it's  
nothing special, but if you  
don't mind that...

<!-- uid=810800901:21:1 -->

**Eldrie:** Thank you kindly, Lady Alice!  
I look forward to eating it!

<!-- uid=810800901:22:1 -->

**Alice:** Honestly... What a troublesome  
disciple...

<!-- uid=810800901:23:1 -->

**Alice:** Ah, look at the time... I need to  
get back to work...

<!-- uid=810800901:24:1 -->

**Alice:** Right, this is it. I need to make  
sure it is something I will not  
be ashamed to give Uncle.

<!-- uid=810800901:25:1 -->


## Story 810801001 · Sweet Temptation

Event Story  
Sugary Sweet Secret Treat

**Sortiliena:** Phew... Are we done...?

<!-- uid=810801001:1:1 -->

**Ronie:** Yeah! I think it's perfect!

<!-- uid=810801001:2:1 -->

**Tiese:** You said it. It looks absolutely  
delicious!

<!-- uid=810801001:3:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Heh heh, thank you. I didn't do  
much to help, but I am absolutely  
exhausted.

<!-- uid=810801001:4:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I'm not sure which is more tiring,  
making sweets or sword practice.

<!-- uid=810801001:5:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** To think that cooking was such an  
elaborate and fatiguing process...

<!-- uid=810801001:6:1 -->

**Ronie:** I think it's mentally exhausting,  
more than anything...

<!-- uid=810801001:7:1 -->

**Tiese:** You have to constantly be on the  
lookout to make sure the amounts  
are correct.

<!-- uid=810801001:8:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I see. So that's why making  
confectionaries is so taxing.

<!-- uid=810801001:9:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** But why did you two settle on  
chocolate in the end? Why not  
a cake or something else?

<!-- uid=810801001:10:1 -->

**Ronie:** Because chocolate is really good  
at helping you recover from  
fatigue!

<!-- uid=810801001:11:1 -->

**Ronie:** Not only that, we wanted to give  
something that means something  
to the recipient...

<!-- uid=810801001:12:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...I see.

<!-- uid=810801001:13:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I can't believe I didn't realize  
you were both making this  
for someone else.

<!-- uid=810801001:14:1 -->

**Ronie:** W-Wait, we didn't tell you...?!

<!-- uid=810801001:15:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** You did not. All I knew was that  
you were looking for a place to  
cook.

<!-- uid=810801001:16:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** To think you were making a gift...  
Hmm...

<!-- uid=810801001:17:1 -->

**Ronie:** What's wrong, Sortiliena...?

<!-- uid=810801001:18:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Oh, nothing. Just thinking.

<!-- uid=810801001:19:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** But you two should probably get  
going.

<!-- uid=810801001:20:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Chocolate doesn't spoil so easily,  
but I don't think there's harm in  
handing it over straight away.

<!-- uid=810801001:21:1 -->

**Ronie:** T-True... We would like to deliver  
them as soon as possible, but...

<!-- uid=810801001:22:1 -->

**Tiese:** Right... We haven't tidied up at  
all...

<!-- uid=810801001:23:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Don't worry about that. We can  
tidy up later.

<!-- uid=810801001:24:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** It might take some time to get  
back here, but it's still somewhat  
early in the day.

<!-- uid=810801001:25:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Why don't you two hurry along and  
surprise your friends first?

<!-- uid=810801001:26:1 -->

**Ronie:** A-Are you sure?!

<!-- uid=810801001:27:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Of course. No one else will be  
using this kitchen for the rest  
of the day, after all.

<!-- uid=810801001:28:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Which means you don't have to  
worry about leaving it in a mess  
just yet.

<!-- uid=810801001:29:1 -->

**Tiese:** Well, if it's all right with you,  
then okay.

<!-- uid=810801001:30:1 -->

**Ronie:** Thank you so much, Sortiliena!

<!-- uid=810801001:31:1 -->

**Tiese:** We'll be back as soon as we can!  
Don't clean up without us, okay?

<!-- uid=810801001:32:1 -->

**Ronie:** Yeah, take a well-earned break!  
See you in a bit!

<!-- uid=810801001:33:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Heh heh, I am not used to people  
making such a fuss over me.

<!-- uid=810801001:34:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I do wonder who the lucky  
recipients of their chocolate  
could be.

<!-- uid=810801001:35:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** We were so busy with the actual  
cooking that we weren't able to  
chat too much...

<!-- uid=810801001:36:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...

<!-- uid=810801001:37:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** What should I do with the  
chocolate I made...?

<!-- uid=810801001:38:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** I intended to eat it myself, but  
I suppose I could give it to  
someone too...

<!-- uid=810801001:39:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** ...

<!-- uid=810801001:40:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Hmm, would this chocolate preserve  
well if I use a cryogenic Sacred  
Art, I wonder...

<!-- uid=810801001:41:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** If so, then I would be able to  
give it to Kirito...

<!-- uid=810801001:42:1 -->

**Sortiliena:** Maybe he'll act sweet towards me  
if I give him something equally  
sweet... Heh heh.

<!-- uid=810801001:43:1 -->


## Story 810801101 · A Strange Name

Event Story  
Sugary Sweet Secret Treat

**Ronie:** K-Kirito!

<!-- uid=810801101:1:1 -->

**Tiese:** Eugeo! We want to talk to you!

<!-- uid=810801101:2:1 -->

**Kirito & Eugeo:** ?!

<!-- uid=810801101:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wh-Whoa, calm down, okay?

<!-- uid=810801101:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** We always have time for you two,  
so what was it you wanted to talk  
about?

<!-- uid=810801101:5:1 -->

**Tiese:** I-I'm glad to hear that! Thank  
you!

<!-- uid=810801101:6:1 -->

**Tiese:** ...Okay. Are you ready, Ronie?

<!-- uid=810801101:7:1 -->

**Ronie:** Y-Yeah...

<!-- uid=810801101:8:1 -->

**Ronie:** Kirito!

<!-- uid=810801101:9:1 -->

**Tiese:** Eugeo!

<!-- uid=810801101:10:1 -->

**Both:** These are for you!

<!-- uid=810801101:11:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Um, what's happening...?

<!-- uid=810801101:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Th-This sure is out of the blue...  
Let's see what's inside the  
wrapping...

<!-- uid=810801101:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ooh, chocolate!

<!-- uid=810801101:14:1 -->

**Ronie:** Y-You are quite right!

<!-- uid=810801101:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ah! It must be that time of year!

<!-- uid=810801101:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Boy, am I surprised. I didn't  
realize Valentine's Day existed  
here too...

<!-- uid=810801101:17:1 -->

**Ronie:** Huh...?

<!-- uid=810801101:18:1 -->

**Ronie:** What did you just say, Kirito?

<!-- uid=810801101:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Gack...!

<!-- uid=810801101:20:1 -->

**Eugeo:** So I'm not the only one who had no  
idea what you just meant.

<!-- uid=810801101:21:1 -->

**Eugeo:** What did you say? Something-time  
day? Is today a special day or  
something?

<!-- uid=810801101:22:1 -->

**Tiese:** Today? I don't think so... Though  
there is a tradition around this  
time of year, not just today.

<!-- uid=810801101:23:1 -->

**Eugeo:** There is?

<!-- uid=810801101:24:1 -->

**Tiese:** Yeah, it's where nobles give  
sweets to express their day-to-day  
gratitude for the recipient.

<!-- uid=810801101:25:1 -->

**Tiese:** But I never knew it had a name...

<!-- uid=810801101:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=810801101:27:1 -->

**Kirito:** You all misheard me! Yeah, that  
must be it...! Anyway, uh, I have  
something I need... to do...

<!-- uid=810801101:28:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Whoa! Kirito, where are you going?  
Get back here!

<!-- uid=810801101:29:1 -->

**Eugeo:** You can't just run out on a  
conversation! I can't believe you!

<!-- uid=810801101:30:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Ronie, Tiese, wait a sec, okay?  
I'll go drag him back here...

<!-- uid=810801101:31:1 -->

**Tiese:** W-Wait, Eugeo...!

<!-- uid=810801101:32:1 -->

**Ronie:** N-Now they're both gone...

<!-- uid=810801101:33:1 -->

**Ronie:** We didn't get to tell them the  
most important part!

<!-- uid=810801101:34:1 -->

**Tiese:** To be honest, I'm more relieved  
than anything...

<!-- uid=810801101:35:1 -->

**Ronie:** ...Me too, I guess.

<!-- uid=810801101:36:1 -->

**Ronie:** Thinking about it, it is pretty  
weird... Giving sweets to confess  
your love? Talk about unique.

<!-- uid=810801101:37:1 -->

**Tiese:** Right? Plus, they would probably  
wonder why sweets and love are  
connected in the first place!

<!-- uid=810801101:38:1 -->

**Ronie:** You said it...

<!-- uid=810801101:39:1 -->

**Tiese:** When they get back, let's just  
forget this whole thing and focus  
on them eating the chocolate.

<!-- uid=810801101:40:1 -->

**Tiese:** It tasted really good when we were  
making it, so I'm sure they'll  
love it!

<!-- uid=810801101:41:1 -->

**Ronie:** ...Yeah! It's not what we had in  
mind originally, but it sounds  
good to me.

<!-- uid=810801101:42:1 -->

**Ronie:** We can tell them how we feel  
another time... right?

<!-- uid=810801101:43:1 -->


## Story 810801201 · Showing Thanks

Event Story  
Sugary Sweet Secret Treat

**Alice:** He should be around here...

<!-- uid=810801201:1:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Hm...

<!-- uid=810801201:2:1 -->

**Alice:** Uncle!

<!-- uid=810801201:3:1 -->

**Bercouli:** What's wrong, Alice? Are you so  
surprised to see me?

<!-- uid=810801201:4:1 -->

**Alice:** ...In truth, yes, somewhat.

<!-- uid=810801201:5:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Oh?

<!-- uid=810801201:6:1 -->

**Alice:** I do not have that many chances  
to meet with you, after all.

<!-- uid=810801201:7:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Now that you mention it, yes...  
We do not have many opportunities  
to do so.

<!-- uid=810801201:8:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Anyhow, here I am. Did you need  
anything?

<!-- uid=810801201:9:1 -->

**Bercouli:** First Fanatio, now you...  
No, I should not pry...

<!-- uid=810801201:10:1 -->

**Alice:** ???

<!-- uid=810801201:11:1 -->

**Alice:** Did something happen with  
Fanatio...?

<!-- uid=810801201:12:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Ah, sorry, I didn't mean to  
say that out loud. You see,  
well...

<!-- uid=810801201:13:1 -->

**Bercouli:** She asked me for some advice  
about cathedral security earlier.

<!-- uid=810801201:14:1 -->

**Bercouli:** I thought maybe you had come to do  
the same.

<!-- uid=810801201:15:1 -->

**Alice:** I see.

<!-- uid=810801201:16:1 -->

**Alice:** Well, no matter what it was, my  
business with you is different  
from Fanatio's.

<!-- uid=810801201:17:1 -->

**Alice:** Uncle, please accept this.

<!-- uid=810801201:18:1 -->

**Bercouli:** ...What a beautifully wrapped  
gift. What's inside?

<!-- uid=810801201:19:1 -->

**Alice:** Some chocolates I made. They are  
not too bad, if I say so myself.

<!-- uid=810801201:20:1 -->

**Bercouli:** ...I see.

<!-- uid=810801201:21:1 -->

**Alice:** I heard that people give sweets to  
express their gratitude around  
this time of year, you see.

<!-- uid=810801201:22:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Hm, yes... These are excellently  
made.

<!-- uid=810801201:23:1 -->

**Bercouli:** ...You've shown impressive skill  
in cooking. Though that shouldn't  
matter, I suppose.

<!-- uid=810801201:24:1 -->

**Alice:** No, Uncle. Thank you for your  
kindness, but I must disagree.

<!-- uid=810801201:25:1 -->

**Alice:** I worked hard on their  
presentation and taste, so the  
quality does matter to me.

<!-- uid=810801201:26:1 -->

**Bercouli:** ...Ah.

<!-- uid=810801201:27:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Yes, you are quite right.

<!-- uid=810801201:28:1 -->

**Bercouli:** Let me just say that I am very  
happy to receive this. I shall  
enjoy them later.

<!-- uid=810801201:29:1 -->

**Alice:** Please do. I would appreciate  
that.

<!-- uid=810801201:30:1 -->

**Alice:** After all, it is true beyond  
a doubt that I am genuinely  
grateful to you, Uncle...

<!-- uid=810801201:31:1 -->


## Story 811000101 · The World and Justice

Event Story  
Seeker of Arcana ~Success~

**Kirito:** It all started when they added  
the fortunetelling skill to ALO  
the other day...

<!-- uid=811000101:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sugu got obsessed with raising  
her fortunetelling skill.

<!-- uid=811000101:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** She went around telling everyone's  
fortunes to get her skill level  
up, and then...

<!-- uid=811000101:2:2 -->

**Kirito:** She triggered a promotion quest  
that only players at a certain  
skill level can attempt.

<!-- uid=811000101:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** A bunch of us who happened to be  
around helped Leafa with  
this quest, but...

<!-- uid=811000101:3:2 -->

**Kirito:** ...It ended up being a pretty  
tricky one.

<!-- uid=811000101:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** I shouldn't have forgotten that  
fortunetelling is something like  
the epitome of the occult...

<!-- uid=811000101:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** So it only made sense for this  
promotion quest to be challenging   
too!

<!-- uid=811000101:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** The moment we set foot in the  
dungeon for the quest, a warp trap  
scattered the party...

<!-- uid=811000101:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** What's more, a special debuff in  
the dungeon had lowered our stats  
to near-beginner levels!

<!-- uid=811000101:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sugu and I met up quick enough,  
but we struggled to defeat enemies  
who we'd normally shrug off...

<!-- uid=811000101:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** It wasn't long until we were in a  
truly desperate situation!

<!-- uid=811000101:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** But that's when the white cards we  
got from a mysterious NPC called  
the Fortuneteller began to glow...

<!-- uid=811000101:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Moments later, Leafa and I had  
been transformed into tarot-themed  
forms!

<!-- uid=811000101:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** We were somehow able to make it  
out of that crisis thanks to this  
new power, but...

<!-- uid=811000101:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** The quest isn't over yet!

<!-- uid=811000101:13:2 -->

**Kirito:** We have to meet back up with the  
others in this dungeon ASAP!  
Asuna, Sinon, Rain, and Seven!

<!-- uid=811000101:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** Tarot cards are the theme here.  
Strangely enough, it's the exact  
thing Leafa got obsessed with...

<!-- uid=811000101:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Could that be the key to clearing  
this quest?

<!-- uid=811000101:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** If that's the case, we're going to  
have to...

<!-- uid=811000101:17:1 -->


## Story 811000201 · Meet-up

Event Story  
Seeker of Arcana ~Success~

**Kirito:** Sugu! Did you find everyone else?!

<!-- uid=811000201:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** No, I couldn't find anyone...

<!-- uid=811000201:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh... Me neither.

<!-- uid=811000201:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** I don't think this dungeon is  
that big...

<!-- uid=811000201:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** How much of the map is left...?  
Hm?

<!-- uid=811000201:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey, Sugu? Did you already check  
here, where this path ends?

<!-- uid=811000201:6:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hmm...? Oh, I might not have  
looked there yet.

<!-- uid=811000201:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, seriously? This might just be  
the answer, then.

<!-- uid=811000201:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** I get the feeling there's a big  
room there based on how this  
map looks...!

<!-- uid=811000201:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ah...!

<!-- uid=811000201:10:1 -->

**Asuna:** Kirito! Leafa!

<!-- uid=811000201:11:1 -->

**Leafa:** Whoa! Asunaaa! And everyone else  
is here too!

<!-- uid=811000201:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** Ah, so the final two have appeared  
at last.

<!-- uid=811000201:13:1 -->

**Rain:** I'm just glad they're all right.  
Wait. Ah, um...?

<!-- uid=811000201:14:1 -->

**Seven:** Is it just me, or do they look  
different from how they did when  
we entered this dungeon...?

<!-- uid=811000201:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** Y-You're right. Leafa looks cooler  
somehow, while Kirito...

<!-- uid=811000201:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...is cosplaying a king?

<!-- uid=811000201:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Of course I'm not! You're making  
it sound like I'm some sort of  
weirdo!

<!-- uid=811000201:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Or rather... Heh heh heh.

<!-- uid=811000201:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** If you look at me and think of a  
king, I'd say you have some  
studying to do, Asuna.

<!-- uid=811000201:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Grr...!

<!-- uid=811000201:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'm not letting that one slide!

<!-- uid=811000201:22:1 -->

**Sinon:** That's right, Kirito. Now you're  
the one saying weird things to  
rile people up.

<!-- uid=811000201:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** Let me have this, Sinon.

<!-- uid=811000201:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** After all the special tutoring  
Asuna doled out to me on  
the way here,

<!-- uid=811000201:25:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'd like to get at least a little  
revenge!

<!-- uid=811000201:26:1 -->

**Asuna:** On the way here? I don't recall  
doing anything that'd make you  
want to get revenge on me.

<!-- uid=811000201:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** All we did was study the tarot  
together, right? Why would  
that...?

<!-- uid=811000201:28:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hm...? Hrrrm?

<!-- uid=811000201:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, so did you fiiinally figure  
it out?

<!-- uid=811000201:30:1 -->

**Kirito:** And anyway, if I really were a  
ruler, you'd still be wrong. I'd  
be the Emperor in that case!

<!-- uid=811000201:31:1 -->

**Kirito:** But now I'm the king of all  
kings... The greatest, most  
perfect existence...!

<!-- uid=811000201:32:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ah, ah... Aaahh!

<!-- uid=811000201:33:1 -->

**Asuna:** You're... the World! You're  
dressed up like the World!

<!-- uid=811000201:34:1 -->

**Kirito:** Heh heh heh... So you've finally  
figured it out!

<!-- uid=811000201:35:1 -->

## Story 811000701 · Strategy Meeting

Event Story  
Seeker of Arcana ~Success~

**Sinon:** ...I see. Okay, let's go over the  
situation here.

<!-- uid=811000701:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** First off, we're in a bad spot,  
but it could be worse.

<!-- uid=811000701:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** This is a very simple room. A pit  
is in the middle, and we have to  
fly over it to move forward.

<!-- uid=811000701:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** On that side is a lone enemy who's  
a fairly good shot. I imagine that  
in order to clear this...

<!-- uid=811000701:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** We'll have to defeat him. Still,  
it's important to remember that  
our goal here is something else.

<!-- uid=811000701:5:1 -->

**Rain:** ...We need to awaken to the power  
of the tarot, right?

<!-- uid=811000701:6:1 -->

**Sinon:** Exactly. That's the most vital  
thing here.

<!-- uid=811000701:7:2 -->

**Sinon:** It's likely that completing this  
room will be enough to satisfy the  
conditions for this awakening...

<!-- uid=811000701:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** But if we get through it and  
nothing happens... that's  
going to be a little rough.

<!-- uid=811000701:9:1 -->

**Seven:** I wonder if we'll be sent to yet  
another room in that case.

<!-- uid=811000701:10:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...I'd want to avoid that if at  
all possible.

<!-- uid=811000701:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Then again... we might not be able  
to stay pure of mind if we're too  
focused on these tarot cards.

<!-- uid=811000701:12:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...What do you mean?

<!-- uid=811000701:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Fortunetellers say that the Arcana  
symbolizes various possibilities  
held within a person.

<!-- uid=811000701:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** For example, Leafa's was Justice.  
But...

<!-- uid=811000701:15:1 -->

**Asuna:** I think the cards just recognized  
a natural part of who she is.

<!-- uid=811000701:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** I doubt Leafa ever thought  
something like, "I should act  
in the name of justice!"

<!-- uid=811000701:17:1 -->

**Seven:** So no ulterior motives allowed.

<!-- uid=811000701:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** Right. That's why I think it'd be

much on the Arcana.

<!-- uid=811000701:19:1 -->

**Asuna:** Our main focus... should be on how  
we can best make it through this  
room!

<!-- uid=811000701:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well, I say that, but it doesn't  
look like I can be of much  
help in that regard... Sorry.

<!-- uid=811000701:21:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...It's fine, Asuna. We just have  
to work hard while you can't,  
that's all.

<!-- uid=811000701:22:1 -->

doing?

<!-- uid=811000701:23:1 -->

defeat him from afar...

<!-- uid=811000701:24:1 -->

because of the debuff, right?

<!-- uid=811000701:25:1 -->

**Sinon:** Ngh?!

<!-- uid=811000701:26:1 -->

**Sinon:** (Seven's right...! I'm clearly a

<!-- uid=811000701:27:1 -->

**Sinon:** (I hate to admit it, but looking  
at this objectively, we can't rely

**Sinon:** (But even then...!)

## Story 440700301 · Defective Starting Location

Event Story  
Gabbing Goddesses

## Story 440700401 · The Only Way to Protect Others

Event Story  
Gabbing Goddesses

**Leafa:** D.I.L... I heard her name after  
we fought.

<!-- uid=440700401:1:1 -->

**Leafa:** She was...a very bad person.

<!-- uid=440700401:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** I didn't know what to do at first.  
No matter how evil, she was  
artificial fluctlight too...

<!-- uid=440700401:3:1 -->

**Leafa:** But...I realized I just had  
to do it.

<!-- uid=440700401:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** I don't mind getting injured.  
I was in a pretty awful physical  
state afterwards, in fact...

<!-- uid=440700401:5:1 -->

**Leafa:** But...I realized that sometimes  
the only way to protect others is  
to use my sword.

<!-- uid=440700401:6:1 -->

**Leafa:** To protect lives, to protect  
people's honor, and...

<!-- uid=440700401:7:1 -->

**Lilpilin:** I'mma human!!

<!-- uid=440700401:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** To protect someone's determination  
and resolution!

<!-- uid=440700401:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...Wow, I never knew...

<!-- uid=440700401:10:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeah...

<!-- uid=440700401:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** At the very least, I don't think  
you did a single thing wrong.

<!-- uid=440700401:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** I think I agree with you there.

<!-- uid=440700401:13:1 -->

**Asuna:** Not that I'd ever say with  
certainty that I could have acted  
the way you did...

<!-- uid=440700401:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** But from the sound of it, did  
Terraria's regeneration ability  
actually work against you...?

<!-- uid=440700401:15:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...Yes, it did.

<!-- uid=440700401:16:1 -->

**Leafa:** Earth Goddess Terraria's unique  
ability is known as Unlimited  
Automatic Regeneration.

<!-- uid=440700401:17:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yikes... Sounds pretty gnarly.

<!-- uid=440700401:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** What? No it doesn't! The name's as  
normal as can be!

<!-- uid=440700401:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** Are you sure about that?

<!-- uid=440700401:20:1 -->

**Sinon:** It seems natural to imagine that  
if any wound you take is healed...

<!-- uid=440700401:21:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...That also means you'll never  
die, no matter how much damage  
and pain you take.

<!-- uid=440700401:22:1 -->

**Leafa:** Urk...?!

<!-- uid=440700401:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** Judging by your reaction, Sinon's  
guess hit the mark, huh?

<!-- uid=440700401:24:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...Yes, you're exactly right.

<!-- uid=440700401:25:1 -->

**Leafa:** I'm sure you've taken damage in  
Underworld yourselves, but in my  
case...

<!-- uid=440700401:26:1 -->

**Leafa:** Well, my body was healed no matter  
how much it was stabbed by blades  
and tentacles.

<!-- uid=440700401:27:1 -->

**Leafa:** If my arm got cut off, I'd grow  
another one. Most of all, my  
abilities were so defense-focused.

<!-- uid=440700401:28:1 -->

**Leafa:** Not being able to defeat all the  
enemies in one fell swoop really  
slowed me down...

<!-- uid=440700401:29:1 -->

**Asuna:** In other words, you were a tank.

<!-- uid=440700401:30:1 -->

**Sinon:** A complete tank. One with no  
attackers around to help, at that.

<!-- uid=440700401:31:1 -->

**Leafa:** ...Exactly. In fact, I think that

there...

**Sinon:** ...Yes, I think she would have  
been fine there as an offensive  
character.

<!-- uid=440700401:33:1 -->

**Asuna:** She has excellent mobility,  
powerful area effect attacks, and

<!-- uid=440700401:34:1 -->

<!-- uid=440700401:35:1 -->

**Leafa:** If I had been with Sinon there,

<!-- uid=440700401:36:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...Jeez, what am I supposed to say

<!-- uid=440700401:37:1 -->

**Sinon:** But anyway, I think you and I

<!-- uid=440700401:38:1 -->

**Leafa:** What? Really?

<!-- uid=440700401:39:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yes, I think she's right.

<!-- uid=440700401:40:1 -->

**Asuna:** We asked Sinonon to rescue Alice

<!-- uid=440700401:41:1 -->

**Leafa:** Oh... I see.

<!-- uid=440700401:42:1 -->

**Sinon:** Right? And if I went to where

<!-- uid=440700401:43:1 -->

Gabbing Goddesses

<!-- uid=811700801:13:1 -->

<!-- uid=811700801:14:1 -->

**Alice:** ...Though, of course, it isn't as

**Alice:** As you all know, it's long been

quality to them.

<!-- uid=811700801:24:1 -->

**Alice:** In a play, one thinks of, models,

<!-- uid=811700801:25:1 -->

**Alice:** It's not unusual for two actors

## Story 811701001 · A Special Friend

Event Story  
Blissful School Days ~Interlude~

**Kirito:** \*sigh\*...

<!-- uid=811701001:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** How did things turn out this  
way...?

<!-- uid=811701001:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** My relationships with both Asuna  
and Alice are an awkward mess  
now...

<!-- uid=811701001:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** I'm going to hurt one or the other  
no matter what my answer is...  
What am I supposed to do?!

<!-- uid=811701001:4:1 -->

**Kirito:** There's no way to beat this one...

<!-- uid=811701001:5:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Kirito!

<!-- uid=811701001:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hm...? Oh, Eugeo.

<!-- uid=811701001:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Man, you sure know how to  
disappear at the worst possible  
times...

<!-- uid=811701001:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** You wouldn't believe what I had to  
go through. Asuna and her friends  
showed up at the cafeteria...

<!-- uid=811701001:9:1 -->

<!-- uid=811701001:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...Word travels fast. Don't tell  
me the whole school is talking  
about it already...

<!-- uid=811701001:11:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Ahaha, well, I'll leave that part  
up to your imagination...

<!-- uid=811701001:12:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Anyway, there's someone I want  
you to meet.

<!-- uid=811701001:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Me...?

<!-- uid=811701001:14:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Yeah. I feel like you'll get  
along.

<!-- uid=811701001:15:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Can I come out already, Eugeo?

<!-- uid=811701001:16:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Yeah, go ahead.

<!-- uid=811701001:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...!

<!-- uid=811701001:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** (Th-This girl... She's...!)

<!-- uid=811701001:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...Who are you again?

<!-- uid=811701001:20:1 -->

**Yuuki:** My name's Yuuki! Nice to meet you,  
Kirito!

<!-- uid=811701001:21:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yuuki...

<!-- uid=811701001:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** (What is this funny feeling  
I have...?)

<!-- uid=811701001:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** (There's something about her that  
reminds me of Eugeo... But why?)

<!-- uid=811701001:24:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Sorry for vanishing earlier right

<!-- uid=811701001:25:1 -->

**Eugeo:** To make up for that, I thought

<!-- uid=811701001:28:1 -->

**Eugeo:** That seems like a bit of a rough

<!-- uid=811701001:29:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I feel like we'd best be described

shared goal.

<!-- uid=811701001:30:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Ooh, I like that one!

<!-- uid=811701001:31:1 -->

**Yuuki:** So yeah, Kirito! The two of us

<!-- uid=811701001:32:1 -->

**Kirito:** I... see. I guess I kind of

<!-- uid=811701001:33:1 -->

**Eugeo:** By the way, Kirito, she might

<!-- uid=811701001:34:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...What do you mean by that?

<!-- uid=811701001:35:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Yuuki here... is friends with  
Asuna.

<!-- uid=811701001:36:1 -->

**Kirito:** !!

<!-- uid=811701001:37:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Maybe not just any friend, either.  
Yuuki... is a special friend to  
Asuna.

<!-- uid=811701001:38:1 -->

**Eugeo:** In a very true sense...

<!-- uid=811701001:39:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Considering that, she might be  
able to give you useful advice.

<!-- uid=811701001:40:1 -->


## Story 811701101 · No Way Out

Event Story  
Blissful School Days ~Interlude~

**Kirito:** O-Oh, I see...

<!-- uid=811701101:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Okay, then... I'll swallow my  
pride and ask! Please, I'm  
out of ideas!

<!-- uid=811701101:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** What am I supposed to do? If I at  
least have a plan to fix this, I  
can start working toward that...

<!-- uid=811701101:3:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hmm. Well...

<!-- uid=811701101:4:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Do you understand why Asuna got  
mad at you in the first place,  
Kirito?

<!-- uid=811701101:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** I... think I do.

<!-- uid=811701101:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** She's mad because I was so quick  
to agree to take the role of  
Romeo.

<!-- uid=811701101:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** My friend Alice also said it's  
possible to fall in love with  
someone if you play lovers.

<!-- uid=811701101:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Of course that's going to bother  
Asuna, right?

<!-- uid=811701101:9:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hrmm, okay...

<!-- uid=811701101:10:1 -->

**Yuuki:** So you're saying that if you could  
travel back in time, you wouldn't  
take the role?

<!-- uid=811701101:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Of course I wouldn't! That's when  
everything started to take a turn  
for the worse!

<!-- uid=811701101:12:1 -->

**Yuuki:** But... wouldn't this Alice girl  
get mad at you then?

<!-- uid=811701101:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...Huh?

<!-- uid=811701101:14:1 -->

**Yuuki:** And if you're going to hold a play  
as a class, everyone needs to help  
out and do their part!

<!-- uid=811701101:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Mmf...!

<!-- uid=811701101:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** (Sh-She's absolutely right...!)

<!-- uid=811701101:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** Y-Yeah, true... If I completely  
refused to play Romeo, the class's  
mood would probably be ruined...

<!-- uid=811701101:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** So... doesn't that mean there's  
no way out of this?!

<!-- uid=811701101:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wh-What am I supposed to do...?!

<!-- uid=811701101:20:1 -->


## Story 811701201 · Full Speed Ahead

Event Story  
Blissful School Days ~Interlude~

**Yuuki:** You really don't get it, Kirito!  
Man, you've got it tough, Eugeo!

<!-- uid=811701201:1:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Ahaha... Well, that's Kirito for  
you.

<!-- uid=811701201:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wha...?!

<!-- uid=811701201:3:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I'm asking you too here, Yuuki.  
What should Kirito do...?

<!-- uid=811701201:4:1 -->

**Yuuki:** It's simple. Kirito and Asuna  
aren't the ones who need to  
make up here.

<!-- uid=811701201:5:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I think you need Asuna and Alice  
to be on good terms again.

<!-- uid=811701201:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ohhh!

<!-- uid=811701201:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hm? Asuna and Alice...?

<!-- uid=811701201:8:1 -->

**Yuuki:** That's right. You're not the one  
causing the most trouble here,  
Kirito.

<!-- uid=811701201:9:1 -->

**Yuuki:** It's Asuna and Alice who are.  
You're just stuck in the middle  
between them, I think.

<!-- uid=811701201:10:1 -->

**Yuuki:** But it's not as if they don't like  
each other or have a strained  
relationship, right?

<!-- uid=811701201:11:1 -->

**Eugeo:** That's true. I'd say... that those  
two have a very healthy  
relationship as rivals.

<!-- uid=811701201:12:1 -->

**Eugeo:** That's true when it comes to  
studying, school activities, and  
of course romance as well...

<!-- uid=811701201:13:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Asuna's in the lead right now...  
But there's no telling what the  
future might bring.

<!-- uid=811701201:14:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Exactly!

<!-- uid=811701201:15:1 -->

**Yuuki:** So, Kirito... That must be enough  
for you to know what to do now,  
right?

<!-- uid=811701201:16:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I think this goes without saying,  
but Asuna loves you, Kirito.

<!-- uid=811701201:17:1 -->

**Yuuki:** It's just that she's a diva  
at times, or can be a bit  
of a handful, I guess...?

<!-- uid=811701201:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...Well, I can't pretend like I  
don't know what you're  
talking about.

<!-- uid=811701201:19:1 -->

**Yuuki:** But that's part of what makes  
Asuna who she is!

<!-- uid=811701201:20:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I want for you two to always be  
on good terms. So...

<!-- uid=811701201:21:1 -->

**Yuuki:** You can do this, Kirito! It's all  
riding on what you do next!

<!-- uid=811701201:22:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Alright, I think that's enough  
from me! Thanks, Eugeo! See ya!

<!-- uid=811701201:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh? W-Wait...!

<!-- uid=811701201:24:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...She left before I could even  
thank her for the advice...

<!-- uid=811701201:25:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Don't worry about it. Just thank  
her the next time you meet.  
I could even tell her for you.

<!-- uid=811701201:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** I appreciate the offer, but...  
I really would like to thank  
her myself.

<!-- uid=811701201:27:1 -->

**Kirito:** And I need to thank you too,  
of course! That introduction to  
Yuuki was a lifesaver!

<!-- uid=811701201:28:1 -->

**Kirito:** But... there's something odd about  
her too. She was wearing our  
uniform. Is she an underclassman?

<!-- uid=811701201:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** I've never heard Asuna talk about  
a friend like her before...

<!-- uid=811701201:30:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Don't worry too much about it.  
You can always ask Asuna later,  
right?

<!-- uid=811701201:31:1 -->

**Eugeo:** But... I think you have more  
urgent matters for the time being.

<!-- uid=811701201:32:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...Yeah, you're right.

<!-- uid=811701201:33:1 -->

**Kirito:** I finally know where I need to be  
heading. All that's left now...  
is to go for it, full speed ahead!

<!-- uid=811701201:34:1 -->

## Story 902001301 · Episode 5.5 Digest

Event Story  
SAO A GGO Digest

**M:** Pito... We don't have to log in  
to GGO to have this conversation,  
you know.

<!-- uid=902001301:1:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Of course we do!  
It's all about the ambience!

<!-- uid=902001301:2:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Now, tell me everything I missed  
with Squad Jam! I'm SO  
bummed I couldn't participate!

<!-- uid=902001301:3:1 -->

**M:** I'm sure you're already  
aware of the outcome...

<!-- uid=902001301:4:1 -->

**Pitohui:** But I want to know HOW it  
happened! Show me the play-by-play  
of LLENN's battle scenes!

<!-- uid=902001301:5:1 -->

**M:** Very well. Team LM's start location  
was in a densely forested area.

<!-- uid=902001301:6:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Yeesh.  
What a lousy spot.

<!-- uid=902001301:7:1 -->

**M:** Here's the results of the first  
satellite scan at 14:10 hours.

<!-- uid=902001301:8:1 -->

**M:** We were captured by an aggressive  
all-machine gun team.  
Firepower junkies.

<!-- uid=902001301:9:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Ha ha! Aww, look how adorable  
LLENN is here!

<!-- uid=902001301:10:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Ha ha ha ha ha!  
And that face she's making!

<!-- uid=902001301:11:1 -->

**M:** You're a bully. Anyway.

<!-- uid=902001301:12:1 -->

**M:** Here's the third scan. Just  
30 minutes into the battle,  
and only a few teams remained.

<!-- uid=902001301:13:1 -->

**M:** The two of us found ourselves  
up against a pro team.

<!-- uid=902001301:14:1 -->

**Pitohui:** That's the part where you  
bravely ran away again, I guess?

<!-- uid=902001301:15:1 -->

**M:** No. We had to defeat them in order  
to win, so we engaged.  
I'm happy to say our risk paid off.

<!-- uid=902001301:16:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Ooo, intriguing...!  
How'd you do it?

<!-- uid=902001301:17:1 -->

**M:** See for yourself...

<!-- uid=902001301:18:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Pfftt... BWA HA HA HA HA HA!  
What the hell is that?!  
A SUITCASE?!

<!-- uid=902001301:19:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Ha ha ha ha ha! Of course  
this'd work! She's tiny! How  
genius!

<!-- uid=902001301:20:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Ha ha ha ha! Incredible!  
That's just the kind of LLENN  
antics I wanted to see!

<!-- uid=902001301:21:1 -->

**M:** That left just three teams  
remaining. Our next opponents  
were a group called MMTM.

<!-- uid=902001301:22:1 -->

**M:** They'd cleared out most of the  
north-west of the field by this  
point. Nothing to trifle with.

<!-- uid=902001301:23:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Ooh, I heard rumors about this  
in town! You used that shield  
that hides bullet lines...

<!-- uid=902001301:24:1 -->

**Pitohui:** ...and took 'em out with sniper  
fire, huh? Pulling out all the  
fancy stops, I see.

<!-- uid=902001301:25:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Yeah! Good job, LLENN!

<!-- uid=902001301:26:1 -->

**M:** We survived an hour.

<!-- uid=902001301:27:1 -->

**Pitohui:** And?  
What do you want, a pat on the  
back?

<!-- uid=902001301:28:1 -->

**M:** No thanks. Anyway, there was  
just one team left, but we let  
our guard down.

<!-- uid=902001301:29:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Noooo!  
Not my poor widdle LLENN!

<!-- uid=902001301:30:1 -->

**Pitohui:** So who were the last men standing?

<!-- uid=902001301:31:1 -->

**M:** They weren't.  
This was an all-female team  
called "SHINC."

<!-- uid=902001301:32:1 -->

**M:** They were fearsome as Amazons.

<!-- uid=902001301:33:1 -->

**M:** After recovering HP,  
we tried to blindside the enemy...

<!-- uid=902001301:34:1 -->

**M:** ...with a solo charge from LLENN  
to get them where we wanted  
them.

<!-- uid=902001301:35:1 -->

**Pitohui:** That's a surprisingly reckless  
strategy for you. Oh, I get it!  
You read my letter.

<!-- uid=902001301:36:1 -->

**Pitohui:** You had to make absolutely sure  
that you wouldn't die, huh.

<!-- uid=902001301:37:1 -->

**M:** It was the best strategy available,  
and it went well. Watch what  
LLENN does here: it's intense!

<!-- uid=902001301:38:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Woohoo! Way to go, LLENN!  
Good hustle! That's my girl!

<!-- uid=902001301:39:1 -->

**M:** And that's all for our battles  
in Squad Jam. Satisfied?

<!-- uid=902001301:40:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Aaah, LLENN was amazing!  
So amazing I wanna die!  
So amazing I wanna kill her!!

<!-- uid=902001301:41:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Why, cruel fate? Why couldn't I be  
there for such an inspiring  
display of bloodlust? WHYYY?!

<!-- uid=902001301:42:1 -->

**M:** There's no use complaining  
about it now...

<!-- uid=902001301:43:1 -->

**Pitohui:** I'm so gonna make up  
for this next time!

<!-- uid=902001301:44:1 -->

**Pitohui:** They oughtta do a rerun  
of Squad Jam! Right?

<!-- uid=902001301:45:1 -->

**M:** Uh...  
Nice as that would be,  
it's not that simple.

<!-- uid=902001301:46:1 -->

**M:** I doubt the writer would want  
to host this again.  
It costs money, too.

<!-- uid=902001301:47:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Well, then I'll organize my OWN one!  
Any complaints?

<!-- uid=902001301:48:1 -->

**M:** Jeez...

<!-- uid=902001301:49:1 -->

**Pitohui:** You're invited too, of course!  
It's mandatory.

<!-- uid=902001301:50:1 -->

**Pitohui:** And it'll be all flashy and  
you can fight and fight  
and fight and fight and--!!

<!-- uid=902001301:51:1 -->

**M:** And then what?

<!-- uid=902001301:52:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Isn't obvious?

<!-- uid=902001301:53:1 -->

**Pitohui:** Die!

<!-- uid=902001301:54:1 -->

**Narration:** To be continued...

**Kirito:** I'm back...

<!-- uid=1000013101:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** Still hard to believe that PSO went from  
a joke to a full VRMMO using the Seed.

<!-- uid=1000013101:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Goes to show how much VR  
has expanded over time, doesn't it?

**Kirito:** Oh hey, Asuna! I see you're still  
using the same idol outfit as before.

<!-- uid=1000013101:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yup! And it's still the cutest, isn't it?

<!-- uid=1000013101:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** Of course! You look stunning...

<!-- uid=1000013101:7:1 -->

**Lisbeth:** And again, you both start acting   
'lovey dovey' like the last time   
we were here.

<!-- uid=1000013101:8:1 -->

**Asuna:** It's not like that, Liz!  
Right, Kirito?

<!-- uid=1000013101:9:2 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah... I was just... y'know...

<!-- uid=1000013101:10:1 -->

**Lisbeth:** Oh well, beggars can't be choosers.

<!-- uid=1000013101:11:1 -->

**Silica:** Hello again, Kirito! Asuna!  
Good morning!

<!-- uid=1000013101:12:1 -->

**Silica:** And it IS morning this time! Hehe!

**Leafa:** Looks like we're all back  
for some more PSO! YES!

<!-- uid=1000013101:14:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I can't wait to get up on stage again!

## Story 1000014201 · Who Am Ai?

Event Story  
Who Am Ai?

**Kirito:** Ai!

<!-- uid=1000014201:1:1 -->

**Ai:** Just in time, Kirito!

<!-- uid=1000014201:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ai!

<!-- uid=1000014201:3:2 -->

**Ai:** Asuna too?

<!-- uid=1000014201:4:1 -->

**Ai:** Did you two miss me that much?

<!-- uid=1000014201:5:1 -->

**Ai:** I appreciate the sentiment, but  
where are all your other idol friends?

<!-- uid=1000014201:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** We need to talk.

<!-- uid=1000014201:7:1 -->

**Ai:** Oh? Why's that?

<!-- uid=1000014201:8:1 -->

**Kirito:** Who are you?

<!-- uid=1000014201:9:1 -->

**Ai:** I'm Ai Hoshino!  
Your next top idol of PSO! Who else?

<!-- uid=1000014201:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** I know what you are, Ai.

<!-- uid=1000014201:11:1 -->

**Kirito:** Don't think you can lie your  
way out of this one either. 

<!-- uid=1000014201:12:1 -->

**Ai:** ...

<!-- uid=1000014201:13:1 -->

**Ai:** That's funny.

<!-- uid=1000014201:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** What?

<!-- uid=1000014201:15:2 -->

**Ai:** Aren't you two lying right now?

<!-- uid=1000014201:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Why would we lie?

<!-- uid=1000014201:17:1 -->

**Ai:** Come on, Kirito!

<!-- uid=1000014201:18:1 -->

**Ai:** I can smell a lie from a mile away!

<!-- uid=1000014201:19:1 -->

**Ai:** You told me that you were  
gonna give it your all in this  
competition! 

<!-- uid=1000014201:20:1 -->

**Ai:** To become the next top idol!

<!-- uid=1000014201:21:1 -->

**Ai:** Now I see you doing the complete  
opposite in trying delve into my own  
life?

<!-- uid=1000014201:22:1 -->

**Ai:** Pretty selfish of you, ain't it, Kirito?

<!-- uid=1000014201:23:1 -->

**Kirito:** That's...!

<!-- uid=1000014201:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** We want to help you, Ai!

<!-- uid=1000014201:25:1 -->

**Asuna:** Your kids... They deserve to see you again...

<!-- uid=1000014201:26:2 -->

**Ai:** The twins, huh?

<!-- uid=1000014201:27:1 -->

**Ai:** They fill me with such a deep  
warmth whenever I think about them.

<!-- uid=1000014201:28:1 -->

**Ai:** But what if what I'm feeling  
right now is a lie?

<!-- uid=1000014201:29:1 -->

**Asuna:** Huh...?

<!-- uid=1000014201:30:2 -->

**Ai:** I have my memories...   
my looks...  
my voice...

<!-- uid=1000014201:31:1 -->

**Ai:** But just like this world...

<!-- uid=1000014201:32:1 -->

**Ai:** It's all a lie!

<!-- uid=1000014201:33:1 -->

**Ai:** I think...

<!-- uid=1000014201:34:1 -->

**Asuna:** Ai...

<!-- uid=1000014201:35:2 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=1000014201:36:1 -->

**Ai:** Hehe... Sad, isn't it?

<!-- uid=1000014201:37:1 -->

**Ai:** I die only to be thrown back  
into being an idol. 

<!-- uid=1000014201:38:1 -->

**Ai:** Is it a blessing or a curse?

<!-- uid=1000014201:39:1 -->

**Ai:** I'll leave that thought up to you!

<!-- uid=1000014201:40:1 -->

**Ai:** So chin up, you two!  
There's an idol competition coming up!

<!-- uid=1000014201:41:1 -->

**Ai:** And I expect that you give it your all!

<!-- uid=1000014201:42:1 -->

**Ai:** For everyone's sakes...

<!-- uid=1000014201:43:1 -->

**Ai:** ...and mine.

<!-- uid=1000014201:44:1 -->

**Ai:** Anywho, see you guys at the dome!

<!-- uid=1000014201:45:1 -->

**Asuna:** Is that it...?

<!-- uid=1000014201:46:2 -->

**Asuna:** Is Ai all just a lie?

<!-- uid=1000014201:47:1 -->

**Asuna:** Is there nothing we can do?

<!-- uid=1000014201:48:1 -->

**Kirito:** I don't know, Asuna...

<!-- uid=1000014201:49:1 -->

**Kirito:** I don't...

<!-- uid=1000014201:50:1 -->

**???:** What happened to our manager and great Diva?

<!-- uid=1000014201:51:1 -->

**Asuna:** ...!

<!-- uid=1000014201:52:2 -->

**Sinon:** Weren't we excited about today's competition?

<!-- uid=1000014201:53:1 -->

**Asuna:** But Sinonon... Ai is...!

<!-- uid=1000014201:54:1 -->

**Sinon:** Who cares what Ai is or isn't?

<!-- uid=1000014201:55:2 -->

**Sinon:** That doesn't matter!

<!-- uid=1000014201:56:1 -->

**Sinon:** You think Ai would want you moping  
around instead of singing your hearts out?

<!-- uid=1000014201:57:1 -->

**Sinon:** We have come too far to let  
some sad story bring us down!

<!-- uid=1000014201:58:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Sinon's right! And I don't know  
about you two, but me and the others  
came here to have a good time!

<!-- uid=1000014201:59:2 -->

**Yuuki:** And you can't have fun if you're  
constantly worrying about what happened  
in the past of someones' life!

<!-- uid=1000014201:60:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yuuki...

<!-- uid=1000014201:61:1 -->

**Leafa:** Don't be such a worry wort, bro!

<!-- uid=1000014201:62:3 -->

**Lisbeth:** We came here to compete!

<!-- uid=1000014201:63:1 -->

**Silica:** It's what Ai would want!

<!-- uid=1000014201:64:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=1000014201:65:1 -->

**Kirito:** You're all right.

<!-- uid=1000014201:66:1 -->

**Kirito:** This isn't the last stop on  
our quest to stardom. 

<!-- uid=1000014201:67:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yeah, we're only just getting started!

<!-- uid=1000014201:68:1 -->

**Kirito:** You're right, Leafa. Everyone.

<!-- uid=1000014201:69:1 -->

**Kirito:** So we might as well put our skills  
to the test and make a run at  
beating Ai!

<!-- uid=1000014201:70:1 -->

**Kirito:** And like Yuuki said,  
the point of all this is to have fun.

<!-- uid=1000014201:71:1 -->

**Asuna:** You're right.

<!-- uid=1000014201:72:3 -->

**Asuna:** But Ai's been here for a long time...

<!-- uid=1000014201:73:1 -->

**Lisbeth:** Well then we just need to show her  
what these gals can really do!

<!-- uid=1000014201:74:1 -->

**Silica:** Yeah!

<!-- uid=1000014201:75:1 -->

**Leafa:** Yup!

<!-- uid=1000014201:76:1 -->

**Sinon:** Of course.

<!-- uid=1000014201:77:1 -->

**Yuuki:** I'm in all the way!

<!-- uid=1000014201:78:2 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, let's not get down on ourselves.

<!-- uid=1000014201:79:1 -->

**Kirito:** She may be better than us overall,...

<!-- uid=1000014201:80:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...but we'll show Ai what we're  
capable of when we put our minds to it!

<!-- uid=1000014201:81:1 -->

**Asuna:** Darn right we will!

<!-- uid=1000014201:82:2 -->

**Yuuki:** Ai Hoshino!  
Prepare to meet your match!

<!-- uid=1000014201:83:1 -->

## Story 400901001 · What the Frost Giants Seek

Event Story  
What the Frost Giants Seek

<!-- uid=400901001:12:1 -->

<!-- uid=400901001:28:1 -->

**キリト:** 何!?

<!-- uid=400901001:29:1 -->

**霜の巨人:** グロオオオオッーーー!!

<!-- uid=400901001:30:1 -->

**シノン:** くっ、こっちに近づいてくる!

<!-- uid=400901001:31:1 -->

**リズ:** でも今はそれしかないみたいね……!

<!-- uid=401700601:31:1 -->

<!-- uid=401700601:32:1 -->

Event Story  
Royal Promise

## Story 401900701 · Back to the Surface

Event Story  
Royal Promise

**アスナ:** うーん……

<!-- uid=401900701:1:1 -->

**キリト:** 村人全員に話しかけてみても、

<!-- uid=401900701:2:1 -->

<!-- uid=401900701:5:1 -->

**アスナ:** この島すごく大きいから、

<!-- uid=401900701:6:1 -->

**キリト:** そうだな  
闇雲に探してどうにかなる

<!-- uid=401900701:8:1 -->

**キリト:** うーん……

<!-- uid=401900701:9:1 -->

ユイ、今いいか?

**ユイ:** はい、パパ  
どうしましたか?

<!-- uid=401900701:11:1 -->

書き込みはあるかな?

<!-- uid=401900701:12:1 -->

**ユイ:** はい、検索しますね……

他のプレイヤーの攻略状況を

<!-- uid=401900701:14:1 -->

**キリト:** ああ

<!-- uid=401900701:15:1 -->

**ユイ:** ……検索結果が出ました

<!-- uid=401900701:16:1 -->

**ユイ:** プレイしている人数は

<!-- uid=401900701:17:1 -->

**ユイ:** 公式情報が掲載されていないため

知られていないようですね……

<!-- uid=401900701:18:1 -->

**キリト:** そうか……

<!-- uid=401900701:19:1 -->

<!-- uid=401900701:20:1 -->

**シリカ:** あはは……  
みんな考えることは  
一緒みたいですね

<!-- uid=401900701:21:1 -->

**ユイ:** あっ、ちょっと待ってください  
一つ変わった書き込みを

<!-- uid=401900701:22:1 -->

**アスナ:** どんな内容なの?

<!-- uid=401900701:23:1 -->

<!-- uid=401900701:24:1 -->

**キリト:** なんだと……?

<!-- uid=401900701:25:1 -->

**リーファ:** ん……  
それってあたし達が探してる

<!-- uid=401900701:26:1 -->

**キリト:** 妙だな……  
このイベントはパーティ毎に  
別に発生するんじゃないのか?

<!-- uid=401900701:27:1 -->

**アスナ:** 一時的マップに  
なってないってことだよね……

<!-- uid=401900701:28:1 -->

**アスナ:** ヨツンヘイムのエクスキャリバーの  
ときと同じように  
ユニーククエなのかな?

<!-- uid=401900701:29:1 -->

<!-- uid=401900701:30:1 -->

**ユウキ:** でもいったい誰が……

<!-- uid=401900701:31:1 -->

<!-- uid=401900701:32:1 -->

**キリト:** ヒントはサラマンダーってことか……

<!-- uid=401900701:33:1 -->

**キリト:** 了解だ、  
ユイありがとな

<!-- uid=401900701:34:1 -->

**ユイ:** いいえ、どういたしまして!

<!-- uid=401900701:35:1 -->

**リーファ:** どうするのお兄ちゃん?  
そのさらった奴を探すために、  
サラマンダー領に行ってみるとか?

<!-- uid=401900701:36:1 -->

**キリト:** いや、恐らくはまだこの辺にいる

**アスナ:** そうだね  
そして恐らくはニエルドさんの

<!-- uid=401900701:39:1 -->

<!-- uid=401900701:40:1 -->

**リーファ:** うん、ラーンさんも大事な物を託した

そうなんだろうね

<!-- uid=401900701:41:1 -->

**キリト:** よし、この島周辺を  
もう少し探ってみるか……

<!-- uid=401900701:42:1 -->

**リーファ:** でもどこから調べるの?

## Story 401901201 · From the Island

Event Story  
Royal Promise

**キリト:** えーっ、コホン

<!-- uid=401901201:1:1 -->

**キリト:** これはあくまで  
俺の想像なんだが……

<!-- uid=401901201:2:1 -->

**キリト:** あの大きな島はALOの中でも  
恐らく自動生成クエでできた  
エリアだろう

<!-- uid=401901201:3:1 -->

**アスナ:** 開発者のハンドメイドじゃない  
ってことだよね?  
でもどうしてそう思うの?

<!-- uid=401901201:4:1 -->

**キリト:** カーディナルは世界の神話を参考に  
シナリオや設定を盛るからな

<!-- uid=401901201:5:1 -->

**キリト:** 今回も日本の昔話ネタを  
持ってきたんだろうけど……

<!-- uid=401901201:6:1 -->

**キリト:** 恐らくそれに対して、開発側から  
待ったがかかったんじゃないかな

<!-- uid=401901201:7:1 -->

**リーファ:** 待った……?

<!-- uid=401901201:8:1 -->

**キリト:** 日本の神話は北欧神話メインの  
ALOにとってはあまりにも  
荒唐無稽だ

<!-- uid=401901201:9:1 -->

**キリト:** もちろん今回は昔話のツギハギ部分を  
埋めて、そこそこうまく  
落とし込めてたとは思うが……

<!-- uid=401901201:10:1 -->

**キリト:** 普通に考えると、  
神や巨人や、魔法使いの物語に  
浦島太郎が出るのは崩壊してる

<!-- uid=401901201:11:1 -->

**シリカ:** ええと……  
待ったをかけたというのは、  
世界観が合わないからなんですか?

<!-- uid=401901201:12:1 -->

**キリト:** ああ、消すつもりなのか、  
様子を見るつもりなのかは  
わからないけど……

<!-- uid=401901201:13:1 -->

**キリト:** 告知がいまだになかったのは、  
そういうことなんだと思う

<!-- uid=401901201:14:1 -->

**アスナ:** 少し違うけど、エクスキャリバーの  
クエストでも自動生成による  
心配事はあったよね

<!-- uid=401901201:15:1 -->

**アスナ:** あのままスリュムが地上に侵攻すれば  
アルンやイグシティが  
崩壊していたかもしれない……

<!-- uid=401901201:16:1 -->

**キリト:** そうだな、あれに比べたら今回規模は  
小さいけど、運営側の判断で  
やりすぎと思ったのかもしれない

<!-- uid=401901201:17:1 -->

**ユウキ:** えっと、要するに……

<!-- uid=401901201:18:1 -->

**ユウキ:** 「なあなあ、自動生成で  
こんなクエが作られちゃったけど  
世界観的に大丈夫かよ?」

<!-- uid=401901201:19:1 -->

**ユウキ:** 「日本の昔話はさすがにやりすぎかもな  
でもいきなり消去する前に  
問題ないか確認しておくか～」

<!-- uid=401901201:20:1 -->

**ユウキ:** って感じで今も  
話し合ってるってこと?

<!-- uid=401901201:21:1 -->

**キリト:** はは、まああくまで想像だけどな

<!-- uid=401901201:22:1 -->

**シリカ:** で、でもあたしは  
あの二人の話好きでしたよ

<!-- uid=401901201:23:1 -->

**シリカ:** できれば消さずに……  
二人の物語の続きとかも  
見てみたいです

<!-- uid=401901201:24:1 -->

**キリト:** まあこのシナリオが好評なら  
続きがあるかもしれないし、  
気長に待つとしようぜ

<!-- uid=401901201:25:1 -->

**リーファ:** ふふっ、そうだね

<!-- uid=401901201:26:1 -->

## Story 402600201 · Paint Arrows

Event Story  
Bean Wars

**Leafa:** Ooh, I'm on the human team!

<!-- uid=402600201:1:1 -->

**Silica:** Me too!

<!-- uid=402600201:2:1 -->

**Recon:** G-Gaaah...  
I'm on the ogre team...

<!-- uid=402600201:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** Same here.

<!-- uid=402600201:4:1 -->

**Alicia:** Alright, humans over there, ogres  
over here. We're going to explain  
the rules.

<!-- uid=402600201:5:1 -->

**Alicia:** Each team decides a leader. If you  
decrease the other leader's HP  
to a certain point, you win!

<!-- uid=402600201:6:1 -->

**Alicia:** Of course, we don't want anyone  
losing ALL their HP, so please be  
careful not to take it that far.

<!-- uid=402600201:7:1 -->

**Sakuya:** There are also a few special  
rules just for this event.

<!-- uid=402600201:8:1 -->

**Sakuya:** The human team will be based  
inside the ruins in Sylph  
territory.

<!-- uid=402600201:9:1 -->

**Sakuya:** The ogre team will try to  
infiltrate that base and attack  
the human leader.

<!-- uid=402600201:10:1 -->

**Sakuya:** It's basically that old adage of  
"Ogres out, luck in."

<!-- uid=402600201:11:1 -->

**Leafa:** Then what do the humans do?

<!-- uid=402600201:12:1 -->

**Sakuya:** The humans cannot leave the ruins.  
They will stay there and protect  
their leader from the ogres.

<!-- uid=402600201:13:1 -->

**Silica:** Hmmm... That puts the human team  
at a disadvantage right off the  
bat...

<!-- uid=402600201:14:1 -->

**Sakuya:** That's why we've prepared a  
special item for the human team.

<!-- uid=402600201:15:1 -->

**Sakuya:** This.

<!-- uid=402600201:16:1 -->

**Sinon:** That is one colorful arrow...

<!-- uid=402600201:17:1 -->

**Sakuya:** It deals no damage, but it does  
dye whatever it strikes a very  
vibrant shade.

<!-- uid=402600201:18:1 -->

**Alicia:** Just like what happens when you  
get shot by a paintball gun.

<!-- uid=402600201:19:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Yes, but of course we cannot get  
guns in ALO, so this will have  
to do instead.

<!-- uid=402600201:20:1 -->

**Alicia:** Any ogre who gets hit by this  
arrow has to immediately lie down  
and play dead.

<!-- uid=402600201:21:1 -->

**Silica:** What?!

<!-- uid=402600201:22:1 -->

**Sakuya:** This is the best we could do.

<!-- uid=402600201:23:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Originally we wanted to get some  
sort of bean-shooting weapon for  
you,

<!-- uid=402600201:24:1 -->

**Sakuya:** but considering this is a  
player-organized event, we weren't  
able to work it out.

<!-- uid=402600201:25:1 -->

**Sinon:** Okay, I get it. At first glance,  
the ogres seem to have the  
advantage,

<!-- uid=402600201:26:1 -->

**Sinon:** but we have to really be careful  
not to get hit by even one  
of those Paint Arrows.

<!-- uid=402600201:27:1 -->

**Alicia:** Alright, that's pretty much it!

<!-- uid=402600201:28:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Now you can start discussing  
strategy with your teams.

<!-- uid=402600201:29:1 -->


## Story 402600301 · Race Settings

Event Story  
Bean Wars

**Recon:** Sinon! Heeey, Sinon!

<!-- uid=402600301:1:1 -->

**Recon:** Huh?  
She was just here a minute ago...

<!-- uid=402600301:2:1 -->

**Sakuya:** What's the matter, Recon?

<!-- uid=402600301:3:1 -->

**Recon:** Oh, Lady Sakuya! Did you see  
where Sinon went?

<!-- uid=402600301:4:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Well, she was selected to be the  
ogre leader, wasn't she?

<!-- uid=402600301:5:1 -->

**Sakuya:** So then...

<!-- uid=402600301:6:1 -->

**Recon:** Huh? What is it?

<!-- uid=402600301:7:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Hehe, never you mind.  
You'll find out when you  
see her again.

<!-- uid=402600301:8:1 -->

**Recon:** Oh, okay... Um, Lady Sakuya,  
are you an ogre too?

<!-- uid=402600301:9:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Yes. Of course, the lords can't  
actually participate in battle,

<!-- uid=402600301:10:1 -->

**Sakuya:** but we can at least act as  
advisors to our respective teams.

<!-- uid=402600301:11:1 -->

**Recon:** I see...

<!-- uid=402600301:12:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Oh... Speaking of which, I think  
I see our Lord Ogre now...

<!-- uid=402600301:13:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...

<!-- uid=402600301:14:1 -->

**Recon:** Sinon, where did you run off  
to? You're our leader, you can't  
just...dis...

<!-- uid=402600301:15:1 -->

**Recon:** ...appear...

<!-- uid=402600301:16:1 -->

**Sinon:** \*sigh\*... I would like it on the  
record I did NOT agree to this.

<!-- uid=402600301:17:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Hahaha, but it looks so good on  
you, Sinon!

<!-- uid=402600301:18:1 -->

**Sinon:** I understand having the leaders  
wear a special uniform...  
But this...

<!-- uid=402600301:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** You might as well have painted  
a target on my back!

<!-- uid=402600301:20:1 -->

**Sakuya:** It's quite possible the humans  
will hide their leader deep within  
the ruins to protect them, right?

<!-- uid=402600301:21:1 -->

**Sakuya:** But the ogres can't do anything  
similar to make it just as obvious  
who THEIR leader is.

<!-- uid=402600301:22:1 -->

**Sakuya:** We discussed this problem of  
fairness, and this is the solution  
we arrived at.

<!-- uid=402600301:23:1 -->

**Recon:** So that's why our leader has to  
wear this special costume...

<!-- uid=402600301:24:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Ha ha, exactly.

<!-- uid=402600301:25:1 -->

**Sakuya:** We designed it ourselves and had  
the devs make it especially for  
this event.

<!-- uid=402600301:26:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Alicia and I broke out into  
giggles when we finished it.  
It was just so adorable.

<!-- uid=402600301:27:1 -->

**Sinon:** Your sense of humor is so warped,  
both of you...

<!-- uid=402600301:28:1 -->

**Sinon:** Wear it yourself, if you get such  
a big kick out of it...

<!-- uid=402600301:29:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Oh, I wouldn't dream of it.

<!-- uid=402600301:30:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Everyone agreed that we couldn't  
have chosen a more capable leader  
than you, Sinon.

<!-- uid=402600301:31:1 -->

**Recon:** Sh-She's right!  
I think so too!

<!-- uid=402600301:32:1 -->

**Sinon:** Ugh, fine... Let's just start  
already.

<!-- uid=402600301:33:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Do us ogres proud, you two.

<!-- uid=402600301:34:1 -->


## Story 402600401 · Leadership

Event Story  
Bean Wars

**Announcer:** I'm pleased to inform you that  
the joint Sylph-Cait Sith Setsubun  
battle will now begin!

<!-- uid=402600401:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** Here we go...

<!-- uid=402600401:2:1 -->

**Sinon:** The ruins are just ahead, but be  
careful. We're well within range

<!-- uid=402600401:5:1 -->

<!-- uid=402600401:6:1 -->

to victory.

**Recon:** Okay!

<!-- uid=402600401:20:1 -->

Event Story

**???:** Found you!

## Story 402600601 · Seasoned Sniper

Event Story  
Bean Wars

**Sakuya:** So they've got archers stationed  
all around the entrance...

<!-- uid=402600601:1:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah, that's why we came back.  
We have to organize ourselves  
better.

<!-- uid=402600601:2:1 -->

**Sakuya:** And we've already sustained a  
number of losses, including  
Recon...

<!-- uid=402600601:3:1 -->

**Sinon:** Unfortunately. Those Paint Arrows  
are pretty accurate.

<!-- uid=402600601:4:1 -->

**Sinon:** They're the ones with the  
advantage, not us...

<!-- uid=402600601:5:1 -->

**Sinon:** At this rate, not a single ogre  
will be able to get close to the  
ruins, let alone inside them.

<!-- uid=402600601:6:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Don't lose hope yet, Sinon.

<!-- uid=402600601:7:1 -->

**Sakuya:** The battle's only just begun.

<!-- uid=402600601:8:1 -->

**Sinon:** Don't worry, I've got a lot of  
fight left in me.

<!-- uid=402600601:9:1 -->

**Sinon:** We just have to figure out what  
to do about those Paint Arrows...

<!-- uid=402600601:10:1 -->

**Sylph:** Hey, who the heck are you?! Only  
Sylph and Cait Sith players are  
allowed here!

<!-- uid=402600601:11:1 -->

**Sinon:** What's going on?

<!-- uid=402600601:12:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Quite the commotion at our camp's  
entrance...

<!-- uid=402600601:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey guys!

<!-- uid=402600601:14:1 -->

**Sinon:** K-Kirito?! What are you doing  
here?

<!-- uid=402600601:15:1 -->

**Sakuya:** As you can see, we're in the  
middle of a joint Sylph-Cait Sith  
Setsubun Battle.

<!-- uid=402600601:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** Yeah, I know I'm not supposed  
to be here, sorry.

<!-- uid=402600601:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** It just looked too fun not to  
come check it out.

<!-- uid=402600601:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** I was just passing by and thought  
you'd at least let me hang out  
as an observer or something.

<!-- uid=402600601:19:1 -->

**Sinon:** You stick your nose into  
literally everything, don't you?

<!-- uid=402600601:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey, Sinon, what's that fun  
get-up you're wearing?

<!-- uid=402600601:21:1 -->

**Sinon:** Hng...! N-None of your business!  
And quit eyeballing me!

<!-- uid=402600601:22:1 -->

**Sylph:** Hurry up and leave already,  
Spriggan!

<!-- uid=402600601:23:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Oh, leave him be. He's a friend.

<!-- uid=402600601:24:1 -->

**Sakuya:** I think we can let him stay,  
if all he wants to do is watch.

<!-- uid=402600601:25:1 -->

**Sylph:** If that's what you wish,  
Lady Sakuya...

<!-- uid=402600601:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** Thanks. So, how're things going?

<!-- uid=402600601:27:1 -->

**Sinon:** Not good... The other team has a  
special weapon that's giving us  
trouble.

<!-- uid=402600601:28:1 -->

**Sinon:** The rules are that if you get hit  
by it even once, you're out.

<!-- uid=402600601:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh... What kind of weapon?

<!-- uid=402600601:30:1 -->

**Sakuya:** It's basically the fantasy version  
of a paint gun.

<!-- uid=402600601:31:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ah, okay. That does make things  
difficult.

<!-- uid=402600601:32:1 -->

**Sinon:** Yeah.

<!-- uid=402600601:33:1 -->

**Kirito:** But you're an ace sniper, Sinon.

<!-- uid=402600601:34:1 -->

**Kirito:** Can't you scout ahead and take  
out those paint archers?

<!-- uid=402600601:35:1 -->

**Sinon:** I did that earlier and managed to  
take out Silica...

<!-- uid=402600601:36:1 -->

**Sinon:** But everyone on the human team  
has those arrows.

<!-- uid=402600601:37:1 -->

**Sinon:** I can't take ALL of them out  
on my own.

<!-- uid=402600601:38:1 -->

**Kirito:** Well, it'd be a tall order...  
But actually, I think you could.

<!-- uid=402600601:39:1 -->

**Sinon:** Huh? What're you talking about?!

<!-- uid=402600601:40:1 -->

**Kirito:** I get wanting to win quickly, but  
maybe stop thinking only about  
going after the players themselves.

<!-- uid=402600601:41:1 -->

**Sinon:** ...!

<!-- uid=402600601:42:1 -->


## Story 402600701 · An Observer

Event Story  
Bean Wars

**Leafa:** Hahaha! Things couldn't be going  
more perfectly!

<!-- uid=402600701:1:1 -->

**Silica:** Grrr, Leafaaaa!

<!-- uid=402600701:2:1 -->

**Silica:** We may be doing better overall,

<!-- uid=402600701:4:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hahaha, sorry...

<!-- uid=402600701:5:1 -->

safe and sound, Silica.

<!-- uid=402600701:6:1 -->

feeling wary of our Paint Arrows.

<!-- uid=402600701:7:1 -->

**Alicia:** I bet they're trying to figure out  
a strategy to cope with them  
right now.

<!-- uid=402600701:8:1 -->

**Leafa:** I still don't feel right just  
sitting on my butt here the  
whole time...

<!-- uid=402600701:9:1 -->

**Leafa:** Even if I am the leader...

<!-- uid=402600701:10:1 -->

**???:** Huh, so you did choose Sugu—I

<!-- uid=402600701:11:1 -->

**Leafa:** Who's there?!

<!-- uid=402600701:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hey. Looks like things are  
going well.

<!-- uid=402600701:13:1 -->

**Silica:** Wh-What are you doing here?!

**Kirito:** Well, I heard the Sylphs and Cait  
Siths were doing something fun  
together,

<!-- uid=402600701:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** so I came by to check it out

<!-- uid=402600701:16:1 -->

**Kirito:** I already stopped by the ogre  
camp.

<!-- uid=402600701:17:1 -->

**Alicia:** Nahaha, you really do go wherever

<!-- uid=402600701:18:1 -->

**Leafa:** S-So what was going on with  
Sinon and everyone?!

<!-- uid=402600701:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ah... You know I can't say.

<!-- uid=402600701:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** It's not like I'm spying for

<!-- uid=402600701:21:1 -->

**Silica:** I-I suppose you're right...

<!-- uid=402600701:22:1 -->

**Leafa:** Ugh, fine... We don't need spies,  
anyway.

<!-- uid=402600701:23:1 -->

**Leafa:** There's nothing they can do as  
long as we have our Paint Arrows.

<!-- uid=402600701:24:1 -->

**Leafa:** We just gotta keep doing what  
we've been doing, everyone!

<!-- uid=402600701:25:1 -->

**Silica:** Right!

<!-- uid=402600701:26:1 -->

**Kirito:** Hehe... Don't underestimate  
them...

<!-- uid=402600701:27:1 -->

Event Story  
Bean Wars

**Silica:** Oh! Look!
