## Story 402600901 · Advice

Event Story  
Bean Wars

**Human Team Member:** The ogres took out everyone  
stationed at the entrance!

<!-- uid=402600901:1:1 -->

**Human Team Member:** Th-They even got Silica...!

<!-- uid=402600901:2:1 -->

**Leafa:** Wh-What?!

**Alicia:** Uh-oh... That's not good.

**Alicia:** Silica must have fallen

<!-- uid=402600901:29:1 -->


## Story 402601001 · Personal Fighting Style

Event Story  
Bean Wars

**Sinon:** Phew... We finally made it into  
the belly of the beast.

<!-- uid=402601001:1:1 -->

## Story 402601201 · The Expositor

Event Story  
Bean Wars

**Alicia:** Heeey, Kiritoooo!

<!-- uid=402601201:1:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Hehe, Kiritooo...

<!-- uid=402601201:2:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wh-What is with you two?

<!-- uid=402601201:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** Don't tell me you're still trying  
to enlist me as a mercenary...

<!-- uid=402601201:4:1 -->

**Alicia:** Maaaybe!

<!-- uid=402601201:5:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Only if you'd be interested in  
something like that.

<!-- uid=402601201:6:1 -->

**Kirito:** H-Hey, don't get so close to me!

<!-- uid=402601201:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** I don't want to get in trouble  
with the harassment code!

<!-- uid=402601201:8:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Hehe, then I suppose we'll just  
stay right here.

<!-- uid=402601201:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** \*sigh\*...

<!-- uid=402601201:10:1 -->

**Kirito:** So what do you want?

<!-- uid=402601201:11:1 -->

**Alicia:** You know how you said you just  
"happened to be in the  
neighborhood" for the battle?

<!-- uid=402601201:12:1 -->

**Sakuya:** That was a lie, wasn't it?

<!-- uid=402601201:13:1 -->

**Kirito:** \*gulp\*...

<!-- uid=402601201:14:1 -->

**Alicia:** I knew it! It's written all over  
your face!

<!-- uid=402601201:15:1 -->

**Kirito:** Ehehe... Once I heard about what  
you were doing, I just had to come  
see for myself...

<!-- uid=402601201:16:1 -->

**Sakuya:** So you didn't stop by with the  
intention to counsel your dear  
friends Leafa and Sinon?

<!-- uid=402601201:17:1 -->

**Kirito:** O-Of course not... The thought  
never crossed my mind...

<!-- uid=402601201:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** But I felt bad for the ogres...  
They looked like they were at  
their wit's end...

<!-- uid=402601201:19:1 -->

**Kirito:** I just wanted to help them see  
they still had a chance, to help  
Sinon see she could do it...

<!-- uid=402601201:20:1 -->

**Alicia:** I see. Well, in any case, that did  
give us a pretty exciting finish  
to the battle.

<!-- uid=402601201:21:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Then I suppose we owe you our  
gratitude for helping make this  
event a big success.

<!-- uid=402601201:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Y-You're giving me way too  
much credit...

<!-- uid=402601201:23:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Well, the two of us were meant  
to be advisors to each team's  
leader.

<!-- uid=402601201:24:1 -->

**Sakuya:** We have a lot of room for  
improvement if our roles were  
so easily usurped by you.

<!-- uid=402601201:25:1 -->

**Alicia:** You're right!

<!-- uid=402601201:26:1 -->

**Alicia:** Maybe we should have Kirito come  
be the advisor for all of our  
joint events!

<!-- uid=402601201:27:1 -->

**Sakuya:** That's a fantastic idea.

<!-- uid=402601201:28:1 -->

**Kirito:** Sure, I'd be happy to help out  
whenever I have the time.

<!-- uid=402601201:29:1 -->

**Sakuya:** That would be much appreciated.

<!-- uid=402601201:30:1 -->

**Leafa:** Hey, look who's here!

<!-- uid=402601201:31:1 -->

**Sinon:** What were the three of you talking  
about, all huddled together  
like this?

<!-- uid=402601201:32:1 -->

**Leafa:** Ooh, I bet they were trying to  
reel him in for some twisted  
scheme again.

<!-- uid=402601201:33:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Hehe...

<!-- uid=402601201:34:1 -->

**Alicia:** Nahaha...

<!-- uid=402601201:35:1 -->

**Leafa:** I knew it!

<!-- uid=402601201:36:1 -->

**Kirito:** I-It's not like that, Leafa!  
And you two! Don't put  
ideas into her head!

<!-- uid=402601201:37:1 -->

**Leafa:** So what WERE you talking about?

<!-- uid=402601201:38:1 -->

**Kirito:** W-Well... Um...

<!-- uid=402601201:39:1 -->

**Leafa:** See? You won't even tell me!  
You're up to something!

<!-- uid=402601201:40:1 -->

**Kirito:** B-Back me up here, guys!

<!-- uid=402601201:41:1 -->

**Sakuya:** Hehehe...

<!-- uid=402601201:42:1 -->

**Alicia:** Ahaha!

<!-- uid=402601201:43:1 -->


## Story 640031 · Character Introduction: Yuuki

Character Introduction Story  
\[Trick or Treat\] Yuuki

**Yui:** Trick or treaaaaat!

<!-- uid=640031:1:1 -->

**Yui:** Give me something good to eat!  
If you don't, I'll...  
do something naughty!

<!-- uid=640031:2:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hahaha!

<!-- uid=640031:3:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hey, Asuna. Hey, Yui.

<!-- uid=640031:4:1 -->

**Yui:** Hi, Yuuki!

<!-- uid=640031:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Good to see you, Yuuki!

<!-- uid=640031:6:1 -->

**Yui:** Yuuki, trick or treat!

<!-- uid=640031:7:1 -->

**Yuuki:** Hehe, here you go.

<!-- uid=640031:8:1 -->

**Yui:** Yaaay, candy!

<!-- uid=640031:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** What do we say, Yui?

<!-- uid=640031:10:1 -->

**Yui:** Thank you very much, Yuuki!

<!-- uid=640031:11:1 -->

**Yuuki:** You're very welcome.  
But anyway... Hehe...

<!-- uid=640031:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** Huh? What are you laughing for?

<!-- uid=640031:13:1 -->

**Yuuki:** You were just so funny, watching  
over Yui as she went around...  
Ahaha...

<!-- uid=640031:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** What?! What do you mean?  
Did I do something weird?

<!-- uid=640031:15:1 -->

**Yuuki:** You were grinning from ear to ear  
the whole time! Such a proud  
mommy, hehe.

<!-- uid=640031:16:1 -->

**Asuna:** I-I was...?  
Now I feel embarrassed...

<!-- uid=640031:17:1 -->

**Yuuki:** You know, there were a lot of  
other players besides me watching  
you guys...

<!-- uid=640031:18:1 -->

**Asuna:** Wh-What?  
C-Cut it out!  
My face is already bright red!

<!-- uid=640031:19:1 -->

**Yui:** Is it embarrassing when other  
players look at you, Mommy?

<!-- uid=640031:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** Umm... Well...a little...

<!-- uid=640031:21:1 -->

**Yui:** Well, why don't we go to a street  
in that temporary area where  
there are only NPCs?

<!-- uid=640031:22:1 -->

**Yui:** Then you won't get embarrassed,  
right?

<!-- uid=640031:23:1 -->

**Asuna:** Well...  
Maybe not as much.

<!-- uid=640031:24:1 -->

**Asuna:** I might still get a little  
embarrassed, though...

<!-- uid=640031:25:1 -->

**Yuuki:** That's right. There is an area  
like that near here.

<!-- uid=640031:26:1 -->

**Yuuki:** It's not part of any major quest or  
anything right now, but why don't  
we go walk around there anyway?

<!-- uid=640031:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh...  
Okay, why not?

<!-- uid=640031:28:1 -->

**Yui:** I want to trick or treat there  
too!

<!-- uid=640031:29:1 -->

**Asuna:** Of course!

<!-- uid=640031:30:1 -->


## Story 1040041 · Character Introduction: Asuna

Character Introduction Story  
\[Gremlins at Midnight\] Asuna

**Asuna:** Hey, maybe we should try and get  
one of those Halloween-exclusive  
outfits or something too!

<!-- uid=1040041:1:1 -->

**Silica:** Good idea! After all, we can't  
really wear Halloween costumes  
that look like that in reality!

<!-- uid=1040041:2:1 -->

**Liz:** Totally! So should we give one of  
those Halloween subquests a shot?

<!-- uid=1040041:3:1 -->

**Asuna:** Sure! Let me see what our  
choices are...

<!-- uid=1040041:4:1 -->

**Silica:** Okay!

<!-- uid=1040041:5:1 -->

**Asuna:** Hmmm... Here's a list of the  
Halloween-exclusive items you  
can get...

<!-- uid=1040041:6:1 -->

**Asuna:** Whoa... There's so many!

<!-- uid=1040041:7:1 -->

**Liz:** Seriously... And they all look  
like total cosplays!

<!-- uid=1040041:8:1 -->

**Liz:** You were right, Silica! We'd never  
be able to wear that in reality!

<!-- uid=1040041:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** And that's exactly why we're  
doing it in a VRMMO!

<!-- uid=1040041:10:1 -->

**Liz:** Hehe, true.

<!-- uid=1040041:11:1 -->

**Silica:** Um... But the avatars we converted  
over from SAO do kind of look  
like we do in real life...

<!-- uid=1040041:12:1 -->

**Silica:** So if someone asked me if  
I was comfortable wearing any  
of these outfits at all...

<!-- uid=1040041:13:1 -->

to say... Hehehe...

<!-- uid=1040041:14:1 -->

<!-- uid=1040041:15:1 -->

be weird to wear in real life,  
but it wouldn't be as fun to wear

<!-- uid=1040041:16:1 -->

absolutely nothing like you either.  
How we are right now is awesome

<!-- uid=1040041:17:1 -->

like in reality without it actually  
BEING reality! Make sense?

<!-- uid=1040041:18:1 -->

You're so right!

<!-- uid=1040041:19:1 -->

**Silica:** I completely agree too!

<!-- uid=1040041:20:1 -->

**Liz:** Hehe, then what are we waiting  
for? Let's pick out our costumes!

<!-- uid=1040041:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah!

## Story 640071 · Character Introduction: Asuna

Character Introduction Story  
\[Dreams in Crimson\] Asuna

**アスナ:** キリトくん、キリトくん

<!-- uid=640071:1:1 -->

**キリト:** ん、どうしたんだ?

<!-- uid=640071:2:1 -->

**アスナ:** 今度このクエストに  
付き合ってもらっていいかな?

<!-- uid=640071:3:1 -->

**キリト:** これは……おお  
振袖装備をもらえるクエストか

<!-- uid=640071:4:1 -->

**キリト:** 正月も近いし、  
こういう季節物装備を  
報酬にしてるんだな

<!-- uid=640071:5:1 -->

**アスナ:** うん、そうなんだ  
柄の違う振袖がいくつかあってね

<!-- uid=640071:6:1 -->

**アスナ:** それぞれが報酬になってる  
クエストも別に用意されてる  
らしいんだ

<!-- uid=640071:7:1 -->

**キリト:** アスナはどれがいいんだ?

<!-- uid=640071:8:1 -->

**アスナ:** この花柄のやつかな  
可愛らしさと気品を兼ねてるって  
感じがするでしょ

<!-- uid=640071:9:1 -->

**アスナ:** うっ  
ああっ……

<!-- uid=640071:10:1 -->

**キリト:** えっ?  
突然なんでため息?

<!-- uid=640071:11:1 -->

**アスナ:** だってわたしいつも現実だと  
お正月は京都で親戚と集まってるって  
言ってるでしょ……

<!-- uid=640071:12:1 -->

**アスナ:** なんかこの振袖の選ぶ基準が、  
大人に褒めてほしいっていう受けを  
狙ってるみたいって気づいて……

<!-- uid=640071:13:1 -->

**キリト:** はは、別にいいじゃないか  
一年経って成長した姿を見てもらう

<!-- uid=640071:14:1 -->

**アスナ:** そうなんだけど……  
そういうのに反抗してたわりに、

<!-- uid=640071:15:1 -->

**アスナ:** 無意識には褒めてくれることが  
嬉しかったのかなあって……

<!-- uid=640071:16:1 -->

**キリト:** まあどっちも本心ってことだろう  
ありがたい反面若干の煩わしさも  
あるのが、血縁だからな

<!-- uid=640071:17:1 -->

**アスナ:** うん、そうだね……

<!-- uid=640071:18:1 -->

**キリト:** で、アスナが欲しいやつは  
どんなクエストをこなせば  
いいんだ?

<!-- uid=640071:19:1 -->

**アスナ:** あっ、そうそう  
それなんだけどね……

<!-- uid=640071:20:1 -->


## Story 1040061 · Character Introduction: Yuuki

Character Introduction Story  
\[Tomboy Queen\] Yuuki

**ユウキ:** わあ、綺麗な水辺だね

水泳レッスンスタート!

## Story 20180331 · Story 20180331

**Agil:** Yo, Kirito. You hear the news?

<!-- uid=20180331:1:1 -->

**Kazuto:** No. What news?

<!-- uid=20180331:2:1 -->

**Agil:** About the beta test for PSO.

<!-- uid=20180331:3:1 -->

**Kazuto:** PSO...?  
Oh, right, Pop Star Online.

<!-- uid=20180331:4:1 -->

**Kazuto:** That was that joke VRMMO  
online for April Fool's, right?  
Wait... Did you say "beta"?

<!-- uid=20180331:5:1 -->

**Agil:** Yup. They decided to turn their  
little one-off joke into a  
full-scale VRMMO.

<!-- uid=20180331:6:1 -->

**Agil:** Apparently, the thing was so  
popular, even the devs were  
surprised.

<!-- uid=20180331:7:1 -->

**Agil:** So they decided to revive it as a  
real game, and they're starting  
the beta test soon.

<!-- uid=20180331:8:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Ha ha, wow. That's pretty crazy.

<!-- uid=20180331:9:1 -->

**Asuna:** No way!  
They're relaunching PSO?

<!-- uid=20180331:10:1 -->

**Kazuto:** That's what I hear. You really  
had a fun time playing it, if I  
remember right.

<!-- uid=20180331:11:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah! It was a lot of fun to  
travel around singing.

<!-- uid=20180331:12:1 -->

**Asuna:** It really felt like we were idols  
going on a musical world tour!  
It was definitely a unique VRMMO.

<!-- uid=20180331:13:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Hmm, well, yeah, it was unique.  
But all that fighting was pretty  
orthodox. It's not THAT special.

<!-- uid=20180331:14:1 -->

**Asuna:** Oh, you're still just mad that you  
couldn't get up on stage and sing  
with us, Mr. Manager!

<!-- uid=20180331:15:1 -->

**Agil:** You didn't sing at all? That's  
a waste. Wasn't that the whole  
point of the game?

<!-- uid=20180331:16:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Yeah, but it was an "idol" theme,  
and they programmed it so  
only girls could be singers.

<!-- uid=20180331:17:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Thus I ended up as Asuna's idol  
group's manager. Yay.

<!-- uid=20180331:18:1 -->

**Agil:** Oh yeah. I vaguely remember you  
mentioning this to me before.

<!-- uid=20180331:19:1 -->

**Agil:** Oho, what do we have here?  
Looks like this site's got a scoop  
on PSO.

<!-- uid=20180331:20:1 -->

**Kazuto:** What's it say?  
Hmm... They changed up the theme?

<!-- uid=20180331:21:1 -->

**Asuna:** Yeah! It says they decided to  
scrap the "idols only" thing.

<!-- uid=20180331:22:1 -->

**Asuna:** Instead, you form a band, put on  
concerts, and fight off monsters!

<!-- uid=20180331:23:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Ahh, so it's not just idols now.  
It's bands.

<!-- uid=20180331:24:1 -->

**Agil:** That sounds like it could be fun.  
And look, it even says both guys  
and girls can get on stage.

<!-- uid=20180331:25:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Dude! Really?!

<!-- uid=20180331:26:1 -->

**Kazuto:** That means I can actually play  
this time, instead of sitting  
around twiddling my thumbs.

<!-- uid=20180331:27:1 -->

**Asuna:** I knew it. You're still pouting  
about that manager thing.

<!-- uid=20180331:28:1 -->

**Agil:** Hmm... If it's a band game, does  
that mean a four or five person  
team is the minimum to play?

<!-- uid=20180331:29:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Maybe... Let's see. We have me,  
Asuna, and Yui, Agil and Klein,  
Liz, Silica, Sugu, Sinon, Yuuki...

<!-- uid=20180331:30:1 -->

**Asuna:** We usually can get eight people  
together regularly, so two bands?

<!-- uid=20180331:31:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Well, I want to invite Seven and  
Rain. They played with us last  
time, and I bet they'd have fun.

<!-- uid=20180331:32:1 -->

**Asuna:** Okay! Can I invite Strea and  
Philia too?

<!-- uid=20180331:33:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Sure, but if everyone can make it,  
we have way more than two bands.  
How do we pick band members?

<!-- uid=20180331:34:1 -->

**Agil:** Eh, don't worry about it. It's a  
limited beta. Let's just invite  
everyone and go wild.

<!-- uid=20180331:35:1 -->

**Agil:** First people to log in band up,  
and we go from there.

<!-- uid=20180331:36:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Yeah, good idea.

<!-- uid=20180331:37:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Hmm. I bet it'll be hard to switch  
instruments, so we'll have to work  
that out at the start too.

<!-- uid=20180331:38:1 -->

**Asuna:** Instruments will probably end up  
being your class, like races in  
ALO or jobs in Asuka Empire.

<!-- uid=20180331:39:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Yeah! Oh man, what do I pick?!

<!-- uid=20180331:40:1 -->

**Agil:** Well, everyone wants to be the  
guitarist. It's sort of a given.

<!-- uid=20180331:41:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Ha ha, yeah. Alright!  
Let me message everyone!

<!-- uid=20180331:42:1 -->

**Asuna:** Go for it!

<!-- uid=20180331:43:1 -->


## Story 20180424 · Story 20180424

**Nanairo:** Hah! Seven and co. pull off a come  
from behind win and the crowd goes  
wild! Wooo! Ha ha ha!

<!-- uid=20180424:1:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Grr...

<!-- uid=20180424:2:1 -->

**Nanairo:** Now, since WE won the battle  
of the bands in the PSO beta,  
NOT YOU...

<!-- uid=20180424:3:1 -->

**Nanairo:** You've gotta admit defeat!  
Come on! I wanna hear you say it!  
"I lost and Seven's the best!"

<!-- uid=20180424:4:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Gnnnrgh...

<!-- uid=20180424:5:1 -->

**Agil:** What's with the rage, Kirito?  
You seemed fine with losing  
when we saw the end results.

<!-- uid=20180424:6:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Yeah, but having her rub it in my  
face does not a happy me make.

<!-- uid=20180424:7:1 -->

**Asuna:** I for one am impressed. We all  
thought you had it in the bag.

<!-- uid=20180424:8:1 -->

**Nijika:** We didn't think we had much of  
a chance either.

<!-- uid=20180424:9:1 -->

**Nijika:** But when we saw how creative both  
of your bands were,

<!-- uid=20180424:10:1 -->

**Nijika:** we figured hey, if we were going  
to make music in VR, we might  
as well put our own spin on it.

<!-- uid=20180424:11:1 -->

**Nijika:** That's why we decided to start  
making our own songs from scratch.

<!-- uid=20180424:12:1 -->

**Kazuto:** You did have the advantage of  
having two singer-songwriters  
on your side.

<!-- uid=20180424:13:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Plus Seven's leet hacker skills to  
implement them in PSO's overly  
complex DAW.

<!-- uid=20180424:14:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Even if I had thought of that  
tactic, I'd never be able to pull  
it off.

<!-- uid=20180424:15:1 -->

**Nanairo:** Well, yeah. But Leafa and Sinon  
were a huge part of our win too.

<!-- uid=20180424:16:1 -->

<!-- uid=20180424:17:1 -->

<!-- uid=20180424:18:1 -->

**Nanairo:** but on stage, they pulled off a  
pro-level performance.

<!-- uid=20180424:19:1 -->

**Kazuto:** That's some praise coming from  
you. I guess a band's always a  
team effort, huh?

<!-- uid=20180424:20:1 -->

**Asuna:** I was impressed by your strategy,  
Kirito. Premiere made the perfect  
super weapon.

<!-- uid=20180424:21:1 -->

**Kazuto:** Heh, thanks. I did have experience  
as a manager here, so I used that  
to produce a Japanese-y group.

<!-- uid=20180424:22:1 -->

**Kazuto:** But I never thought there'd be a  
band that could compete.

<!-- uid=20180424:23:1 -->

**Nanairo:** Well, you were real super.  
We were way more super,  
though! Hah!

<!-- uid=20180424:24:1 -->

**Kazuto:** \*sigh\* Yes, you were.

<!-- uid=20180424:25:1 -->

**Agil:** Well, win or lose, I had a fun  
time with our band.

<!-- uid=20180424:26:1 -->

**Nanairo:** You were great on stage, Agil!  
Your shows really had a rock  
festival vibe.

<!-- uid=20180424:27:1 -->

**Nanairo:** Anyway, VR is a great medium for  
music. It was fantastic to have so  
much variety at our fingertips!

<!-- uid=20180424:28:1 -->

**Asuna:** The beta may be over, but I hope  
they release the game soon!

<!-- uid=20180424:29:1 -->

**Kazuto:** We'll win next time for sure!

<!-- uid=20180424:30:1 -->

**Nanairo:** Hah! Fat chance!

<!-- uid=20180424:31:1 -->

**Asuna:** I'll beat the both of you!

<!-- uid=20180424:32:1 -->


## Story 20190331 · Story 20190331

**Kirito:** (This story takes place back when  
Alice and Eugeo were searching for  
the Divine Objects in ALO...)

<!-- uid=20190331:1:1 -->

**Kirito:** (It was like something out of a  
dream, tucked away and forgotten  
in the back of my mind...)

<!-- uid=20190331:2:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Kirito.

<!-- uid=20190331:3:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...

<!-- uid=20190331:4:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Kirito!

<!-- uid=20190331:5:1 -->

**Kirito:** Huh? ...Oh, sorry, Eugeo. Guess  
I was spacing out a bit.

<!-- uid=20190331:6:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Well, try to keep it together.  
Otherwise we'll never find our way  
out of this underground cavern.

<!-- uid=20190331:7:1 -->

**Kirito:** R-Right...

<!-- uid=20190331:8:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Wait a second... Are you sleepy?

<!-- uid=20190331:9:1 -->

**Kirito:** N-No, it's not that...

<!-- uid=20190331:10:1 -->

**Eugeo:** ...I'm sorry, Kirito. It HAS been  
one thing after another lately.  
I guess you must be pretty tired.

<!-- uid=20190331:11:1 -->

**Alice:** ...

<!-- uid=20190331:12:1 -->

**Kirito:** Alice...

<!-- uid=20190331:13:1 -->

**Alice:** Do not push yourself beyond your  
limits. A good swordfighter must  
ensure they remain in good health.

<!-- uid=20190331:14:1 -->

**Kirito:** ...Is that your way of showing  
you're worried about me?

<!-- uid=20190331:15:1 -->

**Alice:** I-I am merely saying that you  
should rest, so you do not impede  
our search for the Divine Objects.

<!-- uid=20190331:16:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Ha ha, see? Alice thinks you should  
rest too. Come on, it's time we  
set up camp for the night anyway.

<!-- uid=20190331:17:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Why don't you go ahead and sleepfirst, Kirito?

<!-- uid=20190331:18:1 -->

**Kirito:** Thanks, you two, but I'm fine.  
I've just had trouble falling  
asleep these last few days.

<!-- uid=20190331:19:1 -->

**Alice:** I hope that is not because you are  
worried about us, is it?

<!-- uid=20190331:20:1 -->

**Kirito:** Oh, no, it's not that...

<!-- uid=20190331:21:1 -->

**Eugeo:** But you ARE tired, right? Be  
honest, Kirito... Do you need  
someone to sleep with you?

<!-- uid=20190331:22:1 -->

**Kirito:** Wh-Where'd that come from?!  
O-Of course I don't.

<!-- uid=20190331:23:1 -->

**Alice:** I am told the inhabitants of this  
world will sometimes share their  
sleeping quarters with another,

<!-- uid=20190331:24:1 -->

**Alice:** so that they may relax over the  
course of a leisurely conversation  
and thus better fall asleep.

<!-- uid=20190331:25:1 -->

**Eugeo:** I'd sleep with you myself, but I'm  
not sure I'd be of much comfort...  
Why don't you do it, Alice?

<!-- uid=20190331:26:1 -->

**Alice:** Wh-Why would I do such a thing?!  
If it is not within your ability,  
then go and ask Asuna!

<!-- uid=20190331:27:1 -->

<!-- uid=20190331:28:1 -->

**Alice:** ...  
Well...

<!-- uid=20190331:29:1 -->

**Kirito:** S-Slow down. I-I'm okay, really...

for me is more than enough.

<!-- uid=20190331:30:1 -->

some rest. I shall take the first  
watch.

<!-- uid=20190331:31:1 -->

**Eugeo:** Okay, Alice. I'll trade places

<!-- uid=20190331:32:1 -->

**Kirito:** Kind of a chilly place to fallasleep, though, isn't it?

<!-- uid=20190331:33:1 -->

<!-- uid=20190331:34:1 -->

**Kirito:** So I guess we're sleeping together

<!-- uid=20190331:36:1 -->

<!-- uid=20190331:37:1 -->

**Alice:** ...
